Second, Gated Spiral Attention introduces a per head, content adaptive scalar gate derived from a causal cumulative statistic of the query stream, providing an implicit and differentiable form of soft head selection at negligible cost. Third, the Butterfly feed forward block replaces the conventional expansion layer with a multiplicative interaction and an intra block bypass path, matching the parameter count of a four times gated linear unit block while improving gradient flow in shallow stacks. We formalize each component, derive exact parameter and computation budgets, and prove that the gated attention admits an exact and numerically verified equivalence between full sequence training and cached autoregressive decoding, so that no approximation is introduced at inference time. We also describe a fully reproducible training and evaluation protocol on a standard tiny story corpus. The reference implementation is released as an open source package with weights ready publishing support.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Wiola，一个1亿参数以下的decoder-only小语言模型，通过三个即插即用组件（Spiral Rotary Positional Encoding、Gated Spiral Attention、Butterfly feed forward block）增强小规模训练场景的性能，并证明门控注意力在训练与推理之间具有精确等价性，且开源实现。
AI.motivation: 千万到亿级参数的小语言模型在端侧推理、快速实验和受控科学研究中具有吸引力，但大多数模型直接复用标准Transformer块，未针对小规模场景进行适配，导致性能受限。作者希望通过设计轻量且即插即用的组件来填补这一空白。
AI.method: Wiola在每一层集成三个创新组件：(1) Spiral Rotary Positional Encoding——通过逐维度缓慢增长的因子扰动标准旋转频率，使相位轨迹向外扇形展开，改善长距离区分度而不增加参数；(2) Gated Spiral Attention——基于query流的因果累积统计量，引入逐头内容自适应标量门控，实现隐式且可微的软头选择，成本可忽略；(3) Butterfly feed forward block——用乘性交互和块内旁路路径替代传统扩展层，在参数数量与四倍规模GLU块相当的同时改善浅层堆叠中的梯度流动。作者还形式化各组件，给出精确参数与计算预算，并证明门控注意力在完整序列训练与缓存自回归解码之间具有精确且数值验证的等价性，推理时不引入任何近似。
AI.result: 论文提供了每个组件的数学形式化、精确的参数和计算预算推导，证明门控注意力的训练-推理等价性，并在标准tiny story语料库上提供了可完全复现的训练与评估协议，参考实现以开源包形式发布并支持权重发布。
AI.conclusion: Wiola展示了针对小规模回归精心设计的组件可以带来优于标准Transformer架构的性能，同时保持参数效率和推理一致性；开源发布进一步降低了该方向研究的复现门槛。

title: On Cross-Validation for Hyperparameter Optimization of Deep Learning Image Classifiers
summary:
Hyperparameter optimization (HPO) can materially affect the performance of deep learning (DL) image classifiers, but there is little empirical guidance on how to derive the validation signal that drives it, especially for the small sample sizes common in fields such as medical imaging. We compared three HPO protocols in terms of {\em
  absolute performance-estimation error} (AEE; the absolute difference between the winning configuration's validation AUROC and its test AUROC): fixed holdout (F), reshuffled holdout (R), and 5-fold cross-validation (C). The search space, sampler, training procedure, architecture, and test set were held identical across protocols. We evaluated the protocols on three public datasets spanning two regimes: binary medical imaging (RSNA pneumonia radiographs and binarized HAM10000 skin lesions) and 200-class natural imaging (Tiny ImageNet), across a range of development set sizes $n$ and two backbones (ResNet-18 on all datasets, Vision Transformer (ViT-S/16) on RSNA). On the medical datasets, every point estimate favored cross-validation over both holdout protocols, with reductions in AEE largest at small sample sizes and diminishing as $n$ increased. This pattern remained robust under conservative family-wise adjustment. On Tiny ImageNet, AEE was negligible under all three protocols. Test AUROC was generally similar among protocols. Fixed holdout had lower mean AEE than reshuffled holdout in 11 of 12 medical conditions, although this secondary finding was less uniformly supported. For small-sample medical image classification, we recommend cross-validation-based HPO when computational resources permit because it trades additional computation for a more reliable development-time estimate of subsequent test performance.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了三种超参数优化（HPO）协议（固定留出法、重排留出法、5折交叉验证）在深度学习图像分类器中的验证信号选择问题，尤其关注医学影像中常见的小样本场景。结果表明交叉验证在所有医学数据集上均优于留出法，AEE（绝对性能估计误差）降低幅度在小样本时最大，随样本量增加而缩小；在自然图像Tiny ImageNet上三种协议差异可忽略不计。
AI.motivation: 超参数优化对深度学习图像分类器性能有显著影响，但对于如何获取驱动HPO的验证信号缺乏经验性指导，尤其在医学影像等小样本领域。既有实践中验证集划分方式（固定留出、重排留出、交叉验证）的选择缺乏系统性的实证依据。
AI.method: 作者在搜索空间、采样器、训练流程、架构和测试集完全一致的前提下，比较三种HPO协议（固定留出F、重排留出R、5折交叉验证C）。以AEE为主要评估指标，在三个公开数据集（RSNA肺炎胸片、二值化HAM10000皮肤病变、Tiny ImageNet 200类自然图像）上进行实验，跨度涵盖不同开发集大小n和两种骨干网络（ResNet-18、ViT-S/16），并进行保守族系误差调整以验证稳健性。
AI.result: 在医学数据集上，所有点估计均支持交叉验证优于两种留出法，AEE降低在小样本时最大、随n增大递减，且在族系误差调整后依然稳健。在Tiny ImageNet上三种协议AEE均可忽略。测试AUROC在协议间总体相似，固定留出在12个医学条件中有11个平均AEE低于重排留出（但该次要发现支持力度较弱）。
AI.conclusion: 对于小样本医学图像分类，当计算资源允许时推荐采用基于交叉验证的HPO，因为其用额外计算量换取开发阶段对后续测试性能更可靠的估计。

title: When to Communicate: Belief Distributions and KL Divergence for Principled Gating in Multi-Agent RL
summary: Effective communication in multi-agent reinforcement learning requires agents to decide not only \textit{what} to communicate, but when? Existing approaches either communicate at every timestep or learn a binary gate through REINFORCE policy gradients \cite{singh2019}, a high-variance signal that produces unstable and uninterpretable gating behavior. I propose a principled alternative: agents communicate only when the KL divergence between their learned belief distributions exceeds a fixed threshold. Each agent maintains a belief distribution over a latent world state computed as a softmax over its LSTM hidden state, and communicates only when belief disagreement is large enough to justify information exchange. I evaluate this approach on the Predator-Prey benchmark from IC3Net \cite{singh2019} across two environment sizes with 5 seeds each, and on MPE simple\_spread \cite{lowe2017}, comparing against IC3Net, CommNet, and an independent controller. On PP 10$\times$10, IC3Net outperforms KL-belief at all thresholds. On the harder PP 20$\times$20, a threshold ablation over $\varepsilon \in \{0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 1.0\}$ reveals an inverted U-shape: $\varepsilon=0.5$ achieves 73.84 average steps and 42\% success rate versus IC3Net's 75.31 steps and 31\%, a gap of 1.47 steps and 11 percentage points with tighter seed variance. On MPE, the belief head improves mean reward by 12 points and reduces variance by 26$\times$ even when gating is inactive, suggesting two orthogonal contributions: principled gating when beliefs can converge, and improved latent representations that benefit coordination regardless.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于KL散度阈值的一致性门控机制，用于多智能体强化学习中的通信决策：智能体仅在信念分布分歧超过固定阈值时才通信，替代高方差的REINFORCE门控。在Predator-Prey和MPE benchmark上评估，虽然在小环境中不如IC3Net，但在更困难的PP 20×20任务中以ε=0.5取得更优表现，且信念头本身即使不激活门控也能改善协调效果。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体通信方法存在两个问题：(1) 要么每步都通信，浪费带宽；(2) 要么通过REINFORCE策略梯度学习二元门控，但该信号方差高，导致训练不稳定且门控行为难以解释。因此需要一种既有原则性、又稳定可解释的通信时机决策方法。
AI.method: 提出KL-信念门控方法：每个智能体通过LSTM隐藏状态的softmax维护对潜在世界状态的信念分布；当智能体之间的信念分布KL散度超过固定阈值ε时才进行通信。在Predator-Prey（10×10和20×20）和MPE simple_spread上，与IC3Net、CommNet及独立控制器对比；对PP 20×20进行ε∈{0.1,0.3,0.5,1.0}的阈值消融实验。
AI.result: 在PP 10×10上IC3Net优于所有KL-信念阈值；在PP 20×20上，阈值消融呈现倒U型曲线，ε=0.5时达到73.84平均步数和42%成功率，优于IC3Net的75.31步和31%（差距1.47步和11个百分点），且种子方差更小。在MPE上，信念头即使门控不激活也提升了12点平均奖励并将方差降低26倍。
AI.conclusion: KL散度门控提供了一种比REINFORCE更稳定、可解释的通信策略，在困难任务中优于IC3Net。贡献是正交的两方面：(1) 当信念可收敛时提供有原则的门控；(2) 信念头本身改善了潜伏表征，即使通信关闭也能提升协调性能。

title: An advancing-ridge approach for recovering boundary $(d-1)$-simplices in $d$-dimensional meshes
summary: Boundary-conforming four-dimensional meshes are essential for being able to run spacetime numerical simulations about complex, moving three-dimensional geometries. Specifically, a mesh of pentatopes is needed in which the tetrahedral faces of this mesh conform to the boundary of the domain. In the three-dimensional setting, a common approach consists of generating a constrained Delaunay tetrahedralization. Implementations of this approach are mature, but it is unclear how it extends to the four-dimensional setting, particularly in how the local mesh operations are scheduled to recover the constraints. This paper develops a new algorithm for recovering boundary constraints which is simple to implement in any dimension. The algorithm is primarily an advancing-front approach and uses a constrained cavity operator to incrementally insert constraints into the mesh. Compared to existing advancing-front approaches, which advance from a front of $(d-1)$-simplices (faces), the proposed approach advances from a front of $(d-2)$-simplices, called ridges. Steiner vertices can be added to the boundary when the front stalls and several examples in $3d$ demonstrate the ability of this algorithm to recover a complete representation of the input surface. For the four-dimensional geometries studied here, the algorithm generally recovers at least 99% of the input tetrahedralization with this advancing ridge procedure. For some simpler domains, complete conformity with the input tetrahedralization is achieved by adding Steiner vertices, thereby demonstrating the ability to produce boundary-conforming four-dimensional meshes. The design and efficiency of the underlying cavity operator implementation is also evaluated, showing that 30 million pentatopes can be created in about 1.5 minutes, and 300 million pentatopes in about 15 minutes on a workstation laptop.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于推进脊（ridge）前沿的算法，用于在任意维度下恢复边界约束，从而生成边界一致的四面体（pentatope）网格。该算法可在三维和四维场景中有效恢复输入边界，在简单域上通过添加Steiner点可实现完全一致性，并具备高性能（工作站笔记本上约1.5分钟生成3000万pentatopes，约15分钟生成3亿pentatopes）。
AI.motivation: 针对复杂移动三维几何体的时空数值模拟需要边界一致的四维网格（pentatope网格），其四面体面必须与域边界契合。现有三维约束Delaunay四面体化方法已成熟，但如何将其扩展到四维场景（特别是局部网格操作的调度以恢复约束）尚不清晰。
AI.method: 开发了一种新算法，核心思想是从(d-2)维单纯形（脊，ridge）而非(d-1)维面推进前沿。算法使用约束空腔算子（constrained cavity operator）增量式地将约束插入网格中；当前沿停滞时可在边界上添加Steiner顶点。
AI.result: 三维示例展示了算法完全恢复输入表面表示的能力。对于四维几何，推进脊过程通常能恢复至少99%的输入四面体化；对于较简单域，通过添加Steiner顶点可实现与输入四面体化的完全一致。腔算子实现高效：工作站笔记本上约1.5分钟生成3000万个pentatopes，约15分钟生成3亿个。
AI.conclusion: 该算法简单易实现且适用于任意维度，能够有效生成边界一致的四维网格，为时空数值模拟提供了可行方案。其高性能实现也证明了实际工程可用性。

title: Bringing Environmental Enhancement Back to Its Physical Essence via Specular Reflecting Surfaces
summary: Intelligent control of wireless propagation environments is crucial for future network capacity and reliability. Unlike circuit-controlled reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS), mechanically actuated specular reflecting surfaces (SRS) offer a simpler and potentially more cost-effective alternative. In this paper, based on the tractable ray-based cascaded channel model with power-projection correction, we investigate the fundamental operational behaviors of an ideal SRS in free space. Specifically, in the angle-aligned near field, edge reflections cause non-constructive combining, resulting in a damped oscillatory convergence of the gain to an aperture-independent constant. We further obtain the far-field behavior, unbounded-aperture asymptotics, an optimal aperture size and reflection angle, and a gain-based near/far-field boundary. For misalignment, we provide accurate approximations for small and large apertures via center-point and stationary-point analyses. We also define the SRS beam pattern, derive analytical 3-dB beamwidths, and quantify the effective region where a main lobe exists. Finally, we derive a closed-form achievable-rate for an SRS-aided communication system. Numerical results validate the proposed expressions, reveal distinct near-/far-field behaviors of specular reflection, and show that SRS can outperform RIS in the far field due to continuous aperture and angular-resolution control and stronger power projection.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了自由空间中理想机械驱动镜面反射表面（SRS）的基本运行行为，基于射线级联信道模型，分析了近场/远场增益特性、最优孔径尺寸与反射角、波束宽度及可达速率，并证明SRS在远场可优于RIS。
AI.motivation: 未来网络需要智能控制无线传播环境以提升容量和可靠性。相比电路控制的RIS，机械驱动的SRS更简单且可能更具成本效益，但其基本运行行为尚缺乏系统研究，亟需理论分析以指导设计与部署。
AI.method: 基于可解的射线级联信道模型（含功率投影修正），采用中心点分析和驻点分析分别推导小孔径和大孔径下的近似表达式；定义SRS波束方向图并解析求解3-dB波束宽度；推导SRS辅助通信系统的闭式可达速率。
AI.result: 在角度对准的近场中，边缘反射导致非相长合并，增益以阻尼振荡形式收敛到与孔径无关的常数；获得了远场行为、无界孔径渐近性、最优孔径尺寸与反射角、基于增益的近/远场边界以及有效主瓣区域。数值结果验证了所提表达式，并表明SRS因连续孔径和角分辨率控制及更强的功率投影在远场可优于RIS。
AI.conclusion: SRS作为一种简化的无源反射方案，具备独特的近/远场行为，且通过连续孔径设计和角度控制，在远场场景中相对RIS具有性能优势，为未来无线传播环境智能控制提供了可行替代路径。

title: Improved Metric Distortion Bounds for Deterministic Weighted-Tournament Voting Rules
summary: In metric social choice, voters and candidates lie in a common but unknown metric space, voters rank candidates by distance, and a voting rule seeks to minimize total distance to the voters. Its distortion is the worst-case approximation ratio relative to the minimum possible total distance. We study weighted-tournament rules (also known as C2 rules), which observe only the fraction of voters who prefer $a$ to $b$ for each pair of candidates $a,b$. These frequencies form a weighted tournament on candidates, a compressed representation that omits voter identities and the association of comparisons with individual voters. Prior work placed the optimal distortion of deterministic C2 rules between $3.1128$ and $3.9312$ [Charikar et al., EC 2025]. We introduce the Path-Unblanketed Set rule, a polynomial-time deterministic C2 rule with distortion at most $1+2\sqrt{2}\approx3.8284$ for every finite number of candidates. For elections with no more than six candidates, we prove with computer assistance that the distortion is at most $3.3346$. Furthermore, using an exact computer-assisted certificate, we provide a lower bound of $3.1828$ for deterministic C2 rules as a byproduct.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了度量社会选择中确定性加权锦标赛规则（C2规则）的失真下界与上界。作者提出了一种多项式时间的确定性C2规则——Path-Unblanketed Set规则，对于任意有限数量的候选人，其失真上界为1+2√2≈3.8284；对于不超过六名候选人的选举，通过计算机辅助证明失真上界为3.3346；同时通过精确的计算机辅助证书证明了确定性C2规则失真的下界为3.1828。
AI.motivation: 在度量社会选择中，加权锦标赛规则只观察每对候选人之间的偏好频率，而忽略了选民身份及其与比较的关联，这种压缩表示可能损失信息并影响投票规则的失真表现。先前工作仅将确定性C2规则的最优失真限制在3.1128到3.9312之间，存在明显的上下界差距需要缩小。
AI.method: 作者引入了Path-Unblanketed Set投票规则，这是一种多项式时间的确定性C2规则。文中采用理论分析给出一般情形下的失真上界，并结合计算机辅助证明（exact computer-assisted certificate）处理有限候选人数的特殊情况，同时利用精确的计算机辅助证书推导出确定性C2规则的失真下界。
AI.result: Path-Unblanketed Set规则在任意有限候选人数量下失真至多为1+2√2≈3.8284；在不超过六名候选人的选举中，失真至多为3.3346；此外，通过精确的计算机辅助证书证明了确定性C2规则失真下界为3.1828。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的Path-Unblanketed Set规则显著缩小了确定性C2规则在任意候选人数量下失真上界的先前最优值（从3.9312降至3.8284），并同时提供了更强的下界3.1828，为加权锦标赛规则的失真分析提供了更紧的界限。

title: DumpsterCluster: From Dumpster Diving to Serving LLaMA-70B on $60 GPUs
summary: As AI datacenters retire functional GPUs, vast quantities of still capable accelerators enter secondary markets. This paper investigates whether these retired GPUs can find a productive afterlife to form a DumpsterCluster that can serve modern LLM inference, and under what conditions such repurposing is economically viable and environmentally sustainable. We physically built a 128-GPU DumpsterCluster from scratch using only second-hand components and ran it for one year. At current market prices (\$22K for the DumpsterCluster vs. \$600K for an 8-GPU B200 system), the economic advantages are substantial. Through pipeline-parallel optimizations, our V100 based DumpsterCluster achieves competitive LLaMA-70B throughput, validating production viability. However, our deployment reveals critical context dependencies. Older GPUs consume significantly more energy per token, making total cost of ownership favorable only in regions with inexpensive electricity. Under grid-average carbon intensity, second-hand systems can produce approximately 4x higher total carbon emissions per token for 8B models, and over 40x for 70B models, compared to current-generation hardware. These findings show that GPU afterlife is not universally sustainable - hardware repurposing must be strategically coupled with low carbon energy sources. When deployed in regions with favourable energy economics and clean electricity, second-hand GPUs offer a viable pathway for expanding AI capacity while advancing affordability, energy security, and environmental responsibility.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个由128块二手GPU组成的"DumpsterCluster"并运行一年，验证了将退役GPU重新用于LLM推理的可行性。研究发现经济优势显著（$22K vs $600K），但总拥有成本仅在低电价地区有利；在电网平均碳强度下，二手系统每token碳排放量是当前硬件的4倍（8B模型）到40倍以上（70B模型），因此GPU回收利用必须与低碳能源策略性结合才具备可持续性。
AI.motivation: AI数据中心退役大量仍具计算能力的GPU进入二手市场。作者希望探讨这些退役GPU能否"重获新生"组建集群服务现代LLM推理，并评估这种再利用在经济和环境上是否可行——因为在GPU大规模退役的背景下，盲目追求新硬件可能造成资源浪费，但简单回收也可能因能效和碳排放问题产生新的环境负担。
AI.method: 从零开始仅使用二手组件物理搭建了一个128-GPU的DumpsterCluster并运行一整年，通过流水线并行优化（pipeline-parallel optimizations）提升V100集群的LLaMA-70B推理吞吐量；同时进行总拥有成本（TCO）分析，对比新硬件（8-GPU B200系统）与二手集群在不同电价和电网碳强度条件下的经济和环境指标。
AI.result: DumpsterCluster成本仅$22K，而8-GPU B200系统约$600K，经济优势巨大；通过流水线并行优化，V100集群在LLaMA-70B推理上达到有竞争力的吞吐量，验证了生产可用性。但旧GPU每token能耗显著更高：在电网平均碳强度下，二手系统每token总碳排放量对8B模型约为当前硬件的4倍，对70B模型超过40倍；TCO仅在电价低廉地区才占优。
AI.conclusion: GPU"死后余生"并非普遍可持续——硬件再利用必须与低碳能源战略性地配对。在电价友好且电力清洁的地区部署二手GPUs，可以为扩展AI算力提供可行路径，同时兼顾可负担性、能源安全与环境责任。

title: AutoMem: A Text-Gradient Recursive Self-Improvement Framework for Automated Memory Architectures Search
summary: Long-term memory is increasingly central to LLM agents, yet memory design remains a highly coupled architecture problem: what to encode, how to store it, how to retrieve it, and how to manage it can vary substantially across tasks and backbone models. We construct a discrete search space with 5 encoders, 5 stores, 6 retrievers, and 4 managers, and show that no single memory architecture consistently dominates: different tasks favor different module combinations, leading to substantial performance gaps. Motivated by this, we propose \textsc{AutoMem}, a text-gradient recursive self-improvement framework for task-adaptive memory architecture search. \textsc{AutoMem} optimizes over the factored space through two components: Experience-Guided Architecture Search, which proposes candidate architectures from historical search trajectories and accumulated reflections, and Failure-Guided Module Diagnosis, which localizes memory-related failures to specific modules and converts them into targeted textual feedback. Experiments on GAIA, WebWalkerQA, and xBench-DeepSearch across two LLM backbones show that \textsc{AutoMem} consistently discovers task-adaptive memory architectures that outperform the strongest human-designed memory baselines, improving accuracy by $2.8$ points on average across six benchmark-backbone settings. Further analysis shows that \textsc{AutoMem} achieves a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off, reducing token cost by $14.3\%$ over the strongest accuracy baselines under Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, while also finding stronger architectures than substantially larger random searches within only a few guided iterations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AutoMem，一个基于文本梯度的递归自我改进框架，用于任务自适应的记忆架构搜索。通过体验引导的架构搜索和失败引导的模块诊断两个组件，AutoMem能在离散搜索空间中（5个编码器、5个存储、6个检索器、4个管理器）自动发现优于人工设计基线的任务自适应记忆架构，平均提升2.8个准确率点，并减少14.3%的token成本。
AI.motivation: 长时记忆对LLM智能体越来越重要，但记忆设计是一个高度耦合的架构问题：编码、存储、检索和管理等模块在不同任务和骨干模型间差异显著。现有研究表明不存在单一的记忆架构能一致地主导所有场景，不同任务偏好不同的模块组合，导致显著的性能差距。因此需要一种自动化的、任务自适应的记忆架构搜索方法。
AI.method: AutoMem采用两个核心组件：(1) Experience-Guided Architecture Search（体验引导的架构搜索），从历史搜索轨迹和累积的反思中提出候选架构；(2) Failure-Guided Module Diagnosis（失败引导的模块诊断），将记忆相关的失败定位到具体模块并将其转化为针对性的文本反馈。整体框架基于文本梯度的递归自我改进机制，在因式分解的搜索空间中进行优化。
AI.result: 在GAIA、WebWalkerQA和xBench-DeepSearch三个基准上，使用两种LLM骨干模型，AutoMem一致地发现了优于最强人工设计记忆基线的任务自适应记忆架构，在六个基准-骨干设置中平均提升2.8个准确率点。在Qwen3.5-122B-A10B下，相比最强准确率基线减少14.3%的token成本，实现良好的精度-效率权衡。此外，仅需少量引导迭代就能找到比大规模随机搜索更强的架构。
AI.conclusion: AutoMem证明了通过文本梯度驱动的递归自我改进，可以在因式分解的记忆搜索空间中有效发现任务自适应的最优记忆架构，超越了人工设计基线的性能，同时保持了良好的计算效率。这为LLM智能体的记忆架构设计提供了一种可扩展的自动化替代方案。

title: Equilibrium Forcing: Adaptive Video Generation Without Noise Conditioning
summary: Standard autoregressive video generation algorithms based on Diffusion and Flow Matching rely on rigid training objectives and static sampling schedules, limiting inference procedures from adapting to the data. We introduce Equilibrium Forcing (EqF), a simplified framework for video denoising generative models without noise level conditioning. EqF pioneers modular training- and inference-time designs for noise-unconditional generation that decouple learning the denoising field from sampling. This flexibility allows for inference-time algorithms that operate in a closed loop by adapting to feedback from the sample, improving video quality and consistency on challenging autoregressive video generation benchmarks. Extensive analysis elucidates exactly how removing the noise level conditioning enables EqF's data-dependent inference properties to surpass the performance of standard noise level-conditional denoising video methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Equilibrium Forcing (EqF)，一个无需噪声水平条件化的视频去噪生成框架，将去噪场的训练与采样过程解耦，支持闭环自适应推理，在自回归视频生成基准上超越传统噪声条件化的Diffusion和Flow Matching方法。
AI.motivation: 传统基于Diffusion和Flow Matching的自回归视频生成算法依赖刚性的训练目标和静态采样调度，训练目标与推理路径强耦合，导致推理过程无法根据数据进行自适应调整，限制了生成质量和一致性的提升空间。
AI.method: EqF提出简化的视频去噪生成框架，核心创新是去除噪声水平条件化（noise level conditioning），将学习去噪场与采样过程解耦为模块化设计。这使得推理阶段可以设计闭环算法，根据样本反馈实时调整去噪过程。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的自回归视频生成基准上，EqF凭借数据依赖的推理特性在视频质量和一致性上超越了标准噪声水平条件化的去噪视频生成方法。详细分析证明了去除噪声水平条件化是EqF性能提升的关键机制。
AI.conclusion: EqF通过解耦训练与推理，证明了噪声无条件化生成框架在推理自适应性和数据依赖优化方面的显著优势，为视频去噪生成模型提供了一种更灵活、更高效的全新范式。

title: Global AI Regulations for FAIR and Ethics in High-Risk Use Cases: A Comparative Review
comment: 6 pages. Accepted at the 50th IEEE Computers, Software, and Applications Conference (COMPSAC 2026), Madrid, Spain, July 7-10, 2026
summary: AI governance is shifting from voluntary ethics to enforceable, risk-based regulation, yet cross-jurisdictional divergence creates compliance uncertainty for operators of high-stakes AI. We present a comparative matrix for the EU, US, and China that maps (i) risk classification triggers, (ii) binding obligations, (iii) enforcement and accountability mechanisms, and (iv) the degree to which FAIR principles are operationalised in practice. We stress-test the matrix on three high-impact domains: Electroencephalography (EEG)-guided rehabilitation robotics, AI-enabled debt collection in prospective Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) ecosystems, and AI-driven allocation of scarce Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) resources in emerging AI Factory infrastructures. Using primary legal texts and implementation evidence, we identify three recurring gaps: weak interoperability mandates, difficult operationalisation of cross-regime obligations (AI + sector regulation + data protection), and under-specified governance for critical digital infrastructure use cases. To bridge the implementation gap, we outline Knowledge Blocks, a machine-checkable compliance artefact pattern based on Resource Description Framework/Web Ontology Language (RDF/OWL), Shapes Constraint Language (SHACL), and Provenance Ontology (PROV-O), enabling audit-ready compliance-by-design across multiple regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了欧盟、美国和中国AI监管的比较矩阵，评估高风险AI在风险分类、约束义务、执法问责及FAIR原则落实四个维度的差异，并在EEG康复机器人、CBDC债务催收、GPU资源分配三个高影响力领域进行压力测试，识别出三个系统性缺口，并提出基于RDF/OWL、SHACL和PROV-O的机器可验证合规工件模式"Knowledge Blocks"以弥合实施鸿沟。
AI.motivation: AI治理正从自愿伦理转向强制性的风险分级监管，但跨司法管辖区的监管分歧给高风险AI运营者带来合规不确定性，亟需系统性比较分析并解决合规互操作性问题。
AI.method: 构建涵盖四个维度（风险分类触发条件、约束义务、执法问责机制、FAIR原则实践程度）的欧盟/美国/中国比较矩阵；在EEG引导康复机器人、CBDC生态中的AI债务催收、AI工厂中GPU资源分配三个高影响力领域进行压力测试；基于初级法律文本与实施证据分析，最终提出知识块（Knowledge Blocks）这一基于RDF/OWL、SHACL和PROV-O的机器可检查合规工件模式。
AI.result: 识别出三个反复出现的缺口：互操作性授权薄弱、跨制度（AI+行业监管+数据保护）义务可操作化困难、关键数字基础设施用例治理规格不足。
AI.conclusion: 需要采用机器可检查、兼容审计的合规设计模式（Knowledge Blocks）来弥合多司法管辖区间的实施差距，实现跨制度的合规合规。

title: Towards a physics-informed multiscale digital twin for precision medicine in Alzheimer's disease
comment: Perspective; 15-page main manuscript with 1 figure, followed by 17 pages of Supplementary Information
summary: Deciphering the drivers of brain ageing and neurodegeneration, and explaining heterogeneity in individual trajectories, remains a central challenge for precision medicine. We propose PIM-BrainTwin, a physics-informed multiscale digital twin for Alzheimer's disease that draws on materials-science principles--fatigue-like depletion, safety margins and critical transitions--to quantify residual compensatory capacity and system stability. Designed as an open, modular and federated platform, it enables alternative mechanistic hypotheses to be formalised, compared and refined.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PIM-BrainTwin，一个基于物理学原理的多尺度阿尔茨海默病数字孪生模型，利用材料科学中的疲劳耗竭、安全边际和临界转变等概念来量化大脑的残余代偿能力和系统稳定性，并构建开放、模块化、联邦化的平台以形式化、比较和精炼多种机制假说。
AI.motivation: 解密大脑衰老和神经退行性变的驱动因素，以及解释个体间轨迹的异质性，是精准医学面临的核心挑战。现有方法难以量化个体大脑的代偿储备能力和系统稳定性，需要新的理论框架和方法论支持。
AI.method: 借鉴材料科学原理（疲劳样耗竭、安全边际、临界转变），构建名为PIM-BrainTwin的物理学信息多尺度数字孪生模型，用于量化残余代偿能力和系统稳定性；同时设计为开放、模块化和联邦化的平台架构，支持多种机制假说的形式化表达、比较和迭代精炼。
AI.result: 该工作提出了一种新的概念框架和平台架构，将物理模型与多尺度数字孪生技术相结合来研究阿尔茨海默病，能够形式化地诊断和对比不同机制假说，但摘要中未给出具体的实证结果或验证数据。
AI.conclusion: PIM-BrainTwin为阿尔茨海默病的个体化预测和机制研究提供了一个可扩展的开放平台，有望通过物理启发的框架提升对神经退行性疾病异质性的理解和处理能力。

title: MegaParts: Scaling Part-Aware 3D Object Generation to 300 Parts via Token-Efficient Autoregressive Modeling
comment: 12 pages, 6 pages appendix, 13 figures, technical report
summary: Part-aware 3D object generation is essential for graphics applications such as controllable modeling, editing, and articulation, where objects are represented as coherent assemblies of semantic parts. However, existing part-aware generation methods, do not scale well to highly complex objects. As the number of parts increases, generating detailed geometry becomes prohibitively expensive in token length and memory. We introduce MegaParts, a scalable autoregressive 3D generation framework to address this challenge by combining structured sequence modeling with a token-efficient vector-quantized shape tokenizer. Our tokenizer learns discrete latent representations for part-level geometry by minimizing token usage subject to high-fidelity reconstruction, enabling adaptive-length tokenization based on geometric complexity. On top of this compact representation, we train a large language model to generate object bounding boxes, part bounding boxes, and part shape tokens within a unified structured sequence. Combined with efficient long-context training strategy, our token-efficient formulation scales to objects with up to 300 parts and sequence lengths up to 256k tokens. This substantially extends the scale of part-aware 3D generation while preserving compositional structure and enabling fine-grained part-level control. Our method achieves higher mesh quality than baseline autoregressive and diffusion models, showing that compressed discrete part tokens improve not only scalability but also the achievable fidelity of generated geometry. These results suggest that LLM native token-efficient autoregressive modeling is a compelling alternative to diffusion for large-scale part-aware 3D generation. The project page is available at https://expmaster.github.io/megaparts_webpage.

AI.tldr: MegaParts是一个可扩展的自回归3D生成框架，通过结构化序列建模与token高效的向量量化形状tokenizer相结合，实现了最多300个零件、序列长度达256k token的零件级3D对象生成，在可扩展性和几何质量上均优于基线的自回归和扩散模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的零件感知3D生成方法在处理高复杂对象时难以扩展——当零件数量增加时，生成精细几何在token长度和内存上变得极其昂贵，缺乏可扩展的解决方案。
AI.method: 该方法由两部分组成：(1) 一个token高效的向量量化形状tokenizer，学习零件级几何的离散潜在表示，在保证高保真重建的前提下最小化token使用量，实现基于几何复杂度的自适应长度tokenization；(2) 基于紧凑表示训练的LLM，在统一结构化序列中生成对象边界框、零件边界框和零件形状token，并结合高效长上下文训练策略。
AI.result: 方法可扩展到最多300个零件的对象和256k token的序列长度，显著扩展了零件感知3D生成的规模，同时保留组合结构并支持细粒度零件级控制。在网格质量上优于基线自回归和扩散模型，表明压缩的离散零件token不仅提升可扩展性，还提高了生成几何的保真度。
AI.conclusion: LLM原生的token高效自回归建模是大规模零件感知3D生成中扩散模型的有力替代方案，既能保证可扩展性又能维持高质量的几何输出。

title: Study of Multiuser Scheduling Based on User Satisfaction for MU-MIMO Systems
summary: Scheduling in multiuser multiple input multiple output (MU-MIMO) systems is essential for efficient resource allocation and overall performance enhancement. In this work, a multiuser scheduling problem is formulated to maximize the product of user equipments' (UEs) aggregate satisfactions, which maintains user fairness. Solving such a combinatorial problem using exhaustive search (EX), which requires evaluating all possible multiuser groups within a massive number of resource blocks (RBs), is prohibitive. Instead, we propose an efficient users' satisfaction based scheduling approach (US-SA). In our US-SA, a low dimension sub-grouping matrix is constructed {at each frame}, which is used to schedule the best multiuser group in each time slot; satisfied users are eliminated from the scheduling process. Our US-SA performs close to the optimal EX method in terms of satisfaction, transmitted data amount, spectral efficiency, latency, and fairness with lower computational cost. Moreover, our experiments demonstrate that the proposed scheme outperforms competing techniques.

AI.tldr: 针对MU-MIMO系统提出一种基于用户满意度的低复杂度多用户调度算法（US-SA），通过低维子分组矩阵调度最优多用户组并剔除已满足用户，在接近穷举搜索性能的同时显著降低计算开销。
AI.motivation: MU-MIMO系统中的多用户调度对资源分配和系统性能至关重要，但传统的穷举搜索（EX）需要在海量资源块上评估所有可能的多用户分组组合，计算复杂度极高，实际中不可行。
AI.method: 提出US-SA算法：在每个帧内构建低维子分组矩阵，用于在每时隙调度最优多用户组；同时将已满足的用户从调度过程中剔除，从而降低搜索空间和计算复杂度。
AI.result: US-SA在满意度、传输数据量、频谱效率、时延和公平性等指标上接近最优穷举方法，且计算成本更低；实验同时表明该方案优于现有对比技术。
AI.conclusion: US-SA以较低的计算复杂度实现了接近最优的调度性能，在保证用户公平性的同时提升了系统整体资源利用效率，为MU-MIMO大规模场景下的调度提供了一个高效可行的解决方案。

title: Multi-Winner Elections: Justified Representation, Strategyproofness, and Risk-Avoiding Truthfulness
summary:
We study approval-based multi-winner elections with justified representation (JR) when voters strategically report their ballots. We prove that there does not exist a strategy-proof mechanism that outputs JR committees, even when the mechanism can be randomized and only ex-ante strategy-proofness is required. The impossibility result holds for any fixed voter's monotone utility function. In addition, our impossibility result continues to hold for even more restrictive settings, such as the setting where we are allowed to select fewer than $k$ candidates, with only 4 candidates and 3 voters.
  Motivated by our negative results, we then ask for weaker strategy-proof guarantees under voters' partial information. We use the notion of RAT-degree proposed by Hartman, Segal-Halevi, and Tao (EC'25), the number of other voters whose information a manipulator must know before a safe and profitable deviation is possible. Standard proportional rules, such as greedy approval voting, proportional approval voting (PAV), and the method of equal shares (MES), have poor performances under the RAT-degree metric (with low RAT-degrees).

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于批准的多人选举中，在"合理代表（JR）"约束下选民政略性投票的问题。作者证明不存在能输出JR委员会的防策略操纵机制，即使允许随机化且仅要求事前防操纵。该不可能性结果适用于任意单调效用函数，甚至在更严格的设置（少于k个候选人、仅4个候选人和3个选民）下依然成立。受此负面结果启发，作者转而探讨选民部分信息下更弱的防策略保证，使用RAT-degree指标评估，发现标准比例规则（如greedy approval voting、PAV、MES）在该指标下表现不佳。
AI.motivation: 在基于批准的多人选举中，合理代表（JR）是一个重要的公平性要求。然而，当选民可以策略性报告选票时，能否同时保证JR和防策略操纵尚不清楚。作者试图回答这一基本问题，并在发现强不可能性结果后，探索在部分信息假设下是否存在更可行的弱化保证。
AI.method: 作者首先通过构造性证明建立了防策略机制与JR委员会不可兼得的不可能定理，涵盖随机化机制和事前防操纵情形，并将结果推广到更受限的场景（少于k个席位、4候选人3选民）。随后利用RAT-degree框架（衡量操纵者需知道多少其他选民信息才能安全且有利可图地偏离）来评估标准比例规则在部分信息下的策略稳定性。
AI.result: 证明了对于任意固定选民的单调效用函数，即使在随机化和事前防操纵的宽松条件下，也不存在策略-proof且输出JR委员会的机制。该不可能性在仅4个候选人和3个选民的极简设置下仍然成立。此外，标准比例规则（greedy approval voting、PAV、MES）在RAT-degree指标下表现较差，即具有较低的RAT-degree，容易被操纵。
AI.conclusion: 在完全信息假设下，无法同时实现JR和防策略操纵，这为选举设计设置了根本性障碍。转向部分信息框架后，主流比例规则在RAT-degree指标下仍存在脆弱性，表明需要探索新的机制设计方向以在合理代表与策略稳固性之间取得更好的平衡。

title: Calibrated Trust, Not Sharper Prediction: An Empirical Test of Uncertainty Fusion
summary: A recurring proposal in legal AI is to improve case-outcome prediction by fusing uncertainty tools (evidence graphs with belief propagation, sequential Bayesian odds updating, Dempster-Shafer combination, and conformal prediction) into one pipeline. We test this on 1,000 real European Court of Human Rights cases from LexGLUE and FairLex, predicting whether the Court found a Convention violation from the case's fact paragraphs. We compare three families across two frontier LLMs (Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5) as per-fact evidence estimators: (A) the raw LLM, (B) the LLM routed through the fusion pipeline, and (C) a term-frequency baseline through the same pipeline. Across roughly 4,750 tests we find: (1) on discrimination (AUROC around 0.83) the pipeline yields no improvement over either the raw LLM or the baseline; a frontier LLM used directly is the strongest single discriminator. (2) Naively composing an LLM with Bayesian-odds and Dempster-Shafer fusion more than doubles calibration error (ECE from about 0.16 to 0.46) via a prior-mismatch mechanism that replicates across both models. (3) Dempster-Shafer fusion is actively unsafe on long chains, committing confidently to wrong labels at below-chance accuracy; we recommend removing it. (4) The pipeline's genuine value is operational: routed through a conformal selective-prediction layer, the system decides which cases to automate and which to escalate. After removing Dempster-Shafer, recalibrating, and applying class-conditional risk control on the full 1,000-case set, the tuned engine auto-clears at 96.8 percent accuracy with 0.5 percent errors escaping and 96.3 percent caught for review, versus 85.9 / 3.8 / 72.1 for an untuned baseline. The contribution of such pipelines in law is calibrated trust, not sharper prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文系统测试了将多种不确定性工具（证据图+信念传播、贝叶斯序贯赔率更新、Dempster-Shafer组合、共形预测）融合成一条流水线用于法律案例结果预测的效果。在1,000个欧洲人权法院真实案例、约4,750次测试中发现：该流水线在判别能力（AUROC约0.83）上无任何提升；朴素组合会因先验不匹配使校准误差翻倍（ECE从0.16升至0.46）；Dempster-Shafer融合在长链上危险地产生低于随机水平的错误自信预测，应移除；流水线的真正价值在于操作层面——通过共形选择性预测层实现"自动处理vs人工升级"的分配，经调优后能达到96.8%的自动处理准确率、仅0.5%错误漏出。结论：此类流水线在法律领域的贡献是"校准后的信任"，而非更精准的预测。
AI.motivation: 法律AI领域反复出现一种提案：将多种不确定性工具（证据图、信念传播、贝叶斯赔率更新、Dempster-Shafer组合、共形预测）融合为单一流水线以改进案例结果预测。作者旨在严格实证检验这一流行但未经充分验证的方案，确定其真实价值与潜在风险。
AI.method: 使用来自LexGLUE和FairLex的1,000个欧洲人权法院真实案例，以案件事实段落预测是否存在公约违规。对比三条路径：(A)原始LLM（Claude Opus 4.8和GPT-5.5）直接作为逐证据估计器；(B)LLM经融合流水线路由；(C)词频基线经同一流水线。进行约4,750次测试，评估AUROC、期望校准误差（ECE）和选择性预测性能。
AI.result: (1) 在歧视案件上流水线相比原始LLM和基线均无改进，前沿LLM直接用是最强判别器；(2) 朴素组合LLM与贝叶斯赔率和Dempster-Shafer融合使ECE从0.16恶化为0.46，归因于先验不匹配机制并在两种模型上复现；(3) Dempster-Shafer融合在长证据链上低于随机准确率且高度自信地犯错，应移除；(4) 剔除DS、重校准并应用类别条件风险控制后，自动处理准确率96.8%，仅0.5%错误漏出，96.3%被捕获送审，远优于未调优基线（85.9/3.8/72.1）。
AI.conclusion: 多不确定性工具融合流水线并不能提升法律案例结果预测的判别精度，其本质贡献在于"校准后的信任"——通过共形选择性预测层实现可靠的人机分工决策。论文建议移除不安全的Dempster-Shafer融合组件，强调校准与风险控制而非预测增强才是此类流水线的实际价值。

title: LLM Safety Alignment in Low-Resource Languages: A Systematic Literature Review
comment: The paper was accepted at LM4UC workshop organize by IJCAI. I added a screenshot of the decision (Open Review)
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved substantial progress in safety alignment, yet their safety guarantees remain significantly weaker in low-resource and multilingual settings than in high-resource languages. In this paper, we conduct a Systematic Literature Review (SLR) of LLM safety alignment in low-resource languages by adopting the PRISMA 2020 methodology. Out of roughly 1,500 papers identified from Semantic Scholar, arXiv, and OpenAlex, 50 relevant studies have been selected and analyzed. Our review is organized around four themes: safety alignment methods, multilingual safety risks, evaluation benchmarks, and cross-lingual transferability. We further propose a taxonomy of safety alignment approaches based on three adaptation mechanisms: data adaptation, objective optimization, and mechanistic alignment. Across literature, translated English benchmarks fail to sufficiently represent culturally rooted harms, and multilingual models are more vulnerable to cross-lingual jailbreaks, code-switching attacks, and safety degradation in underrepresented languages. These failures are driven by several key factors, including uneven multilingual pre-training coverage, insufficient native-language preference data, poor transfer of safety representations, and a lack of culturally aware evaluation frameworks. The review also notes that many low-resource languages, especially African languages, have fewer safety benchmarks available than other multilingual regions. Overall, the results reveal a persistent multilingual safety gap, and suggest that future progress will require culturally grounded benchmarks, participatory data collection, balanced multilingual pre-training, and scalable multilingual alignment methods.

AI.tldr: 本文采用PRISMA 2020方法对低资源语言下的大语言模型（LLM）安全对齐进行了系统性文献综述，从约1500篇论文中筛选出50篇相关研究，围绕安全对齐方法、多语言安全风险、评估基准和跨语言可迁移性四个主题展开，提出基于数据适应、目标优化和机制对齐三种适应机制的分类体系，揭示了多语言安全差距的持久性及其驱动因素。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在安全性对齐方面虽然在高质量资源语言中取得了显著进展，但在低资源和多语言环境下的安全保障明显薄弱。这一差距尚未被系统性地梳理和理解，因此需要通过文献综述来系统地审视低资源语言中LLM安全对齐的现状、挑战与未来方向。
AI.method: 采用PRISMA 2020系统综述方法论，从Semantic Scholar、arXiv和OpenAlex三个学术数据库检索约1500篇论文，经过筛选最终纳入50篇相关研究进行分析。综述围绕四个主题组织：安全对齐方法、多语言安全风险、评估基准和跨语言可迁移性，并提出基于数据适应、目标优化和机制对齐三种适应机制的安全对齐方法分类体系。
AI.result: 研究发现：翻译后的英语基准无法充分代表文化根植的危害；多语言模型在跨语言越狱攻击、代码切换攻击以及低代表性语言中更容易出现安全退化。这些失败由多语言预训练覆盖不均、本土语言偏好数据不足、安全表征迁移不佳以及缺乏文化感知的评估框架等因素驱动。此外，许多低资源语言（尤其是非洲语言）的安全基准数量明显少于其他多语言地区。
AI.conclusion: 综述揭示了一个持续存在的多语言安全差距，未来进展需要文化根基扎实的基准、参与式数据收集、均衡的多语言预训练以及可扩展的多语言对齐方法。这些方向是弥补低资源语言安全对齐不足的关键路径。

title: PE-CSNet: An equivariant network architecture with learnable patch-based sparse representation
summary: Compressive sensing (CS) enables accurate signal reconstruction from sparse measurements and is widely applied in medical imaging, remote sensing, and image compression. However, designing an effective, task-specific sparse transform and the corresponding optimization procedure for high-quality CS remains challenging. This process typically requires expert domain knowledge and laborious parameter tuning. To address this issue, we present a Patch-based Equivariant deep unrolling architecture, termed PE-CSNet, for accurate CS recovery. While traditional CS methods generally use predefined patch-based transform sparsity, we generalize this idea by incorporating learnable transform sparsity that adapts to the specific CS task through an optimization-driven process. Specifically, we first establish a generalized patch-based CS model, which we solve via a block coordinate descent (BCD) algorithm. The BCD solver is then unrolled into a deep neural network, where all parameters of both the CS model and solver are learned through end-to-end training. To improve data efficiency, we introduce a stochastic equivariant training strategy that exploits the patch-wise structure of the network, enabling PE-CSNet to learn effectively even from limited data. We further provide a simpler, parameter-shared version of PE-CSNet and briefly discuss its convergence as an iterative solver. For practical applications, the network uses stage-specific (non-shared) parameters to enhance its expressive power and thereby improve its performance. On the tasks of CS magnetic resonance imaging (CS-MRI) and CS coded diffraction patterns (CS-CDP), PE-CSNet achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with fast computational speed, outperforming traditional methods and existing deep unrolling methods.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于Patch的等变深度展开架构PE-CSNet，用于压缩感知（CS）重建。该方法将广义patch-based CS模型通过块坐标下降（BCD）算法求解，并将BCD求解器展开为深度神经网络，通过端到端训练学习所有参数。引入随机等变训练策略提高数据效率，在CS-MRI和CS-CDP任务上达到最先进精度且计算速度快。
AI.motivation: 传统压缩感知方法需要专家领域知识和繁琐的参数调优来设计任务特定的稀疏变换及优化过程。现有方法难以兼顾有效性和任务适应性，缺乏一种能够自动学习任务相关稀疏表示并高效求解的通用方案。
AI.method: 1) 建立广义的patch-based CS模型，将传统预定义patch稀疏性泛化为可学习的变换稀疏性；2) 使用块坐标下降（BCD）算法求解该模型；3) 将BCD求解器展开为深度神经网络，所有参数通过端到端训练学习；4) 设计随机等变训练策略，利用网络的patch-wise结构提升数据效率；5) 提供参数共享的简化版本并分析其迭代收敛性，实际应用中使用非共享参数以增强表达能力。
AI.result: 在CS-MRI和CS-CDP两个任务上，PE-CSNet达到最先进的重建精度，同时保持快速的计算速度，优于传统方法和现有深度展开方法。
AI.conclusion: PE-CSNet通过将优化驱动的可学习稀疏变换与深度展开架构结合，有效解决了CS中稀疏变换设计与参数调优的难题，在有限数据条件下也能高效学习，并在多个CS任务中展现出色的性能。

title: Position: AI Lock-In Is in Progress, and We Must Be Prepared
summary: AI safety research has mainly focused on two areas: technical alignment (ensuring AI systems produce human-aligned outputs) and the regulation of generative AI's societal impacts (including unemployment risk and labor market disruption). However, an equally important dimension remains underexplored: the risk inherent in dependence on AI systems themselves. In this position paper, we argue that AI safety research should address AI Lock-In, the phenomenon whereby excessive reliance on AI systems leads to human deskilling, diminishes human capacity for independent functioning, and creates systemic vulnerabilities when AI systems become unavailable or compromised. We highlight that AI Lock-In is a systemic threat that is already emerging at individual, societal, and national levels, one that could be dramatically amplified by AI service disruptions or geopolitical conflicts. Drawing on detailed scenarios, we investigate how AI Lock-In emerges and escalates across multiple levels, ranging from individual skill atrophy to national-scale infrastructure failures. To address this, we provide guidance on how such risks can be mitigated and prepared for at each level. We contend that proactively addressing AI Lock-In before such dependencies become entrenched, or even irreversible, is essential for preserving individual autonomy and national security.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"AI锁定"（AI Lock-In）概念，指过度依赖AI系统导致的人类技能退化、独立功能能力下降，以及AI不可用或被破坏时产生的系统性脆弱性。作者主张AI安全研究应将其作为与对齐研究并重的重要维度加以应对。
AI.motivation: 现有AI安全研究过度聚焦于技术对齐和社会影响监管（如失业），忽略了AI依赖本身带来的系统性风险。这种依赖风险正在个体、社会和国家层面显现，并可能因服务中断或地缘冲突被急剧放大，亟需学术关注。
AI.method: 采用立场论文（position paper）的论述方式，通过构建详细场景（scenarios），从个体技能萎缩到国家基础设施失效的多层级视角，分析AI锁定如何产生与升级，并在各层级提出缓解与准备策略。
AI.result: 识别出AI锁定是多层级、系统性威胁，已在个体、社会和国家层面出现；论证了其对个人自主权和国家安全构成的严重威胁，并针对各层级提出了风险缓解与预案指导。
AI.conclusion: 主张必须在AI依赖变得根深蒂固甚至不可逆转之前主动应对AI锁定风险，将其纳入AI安全研究议程，以保障个体自主性与国家安全。

title: Toward Decentralized Carbon Trading in Indonesia: A Public-Blockchain Architecture for Tokenized Real-World Assets
summary:
Indonesia has established a regulated carbon market supported by national registry infrastructure and the IDXCarbon exchange. Carbon units can be issued, recorded, traded, and retired within this framework. IDXCarbon currently uses a private blockchain for its trading infrastructure. This creates an opportunity to examine how Indonesian carbon credits could also be represented and traded through public blockchain infrastructure.
  This study proposes an architecture for tokenizing Indonesian carbon credits as real-world assets (RWAs), with particular focus on Sertifikat Pengurangan Emisi Gas Rumah Kaca (SPE-GRK). The proposed architecture retains the Sistem Registri Unit Karbon (SRUK) as the authoritative source of carbon-unit status. It introduces a public-blockchain layer for token representation and programmable transactions. The architecture is designed to support lifecycle management, token-based asset representation, public observability of token activity, interoperability, wallet-based transactions, and programmable settlement.
  The architecture consists of four layers: the authoritative carbon layer, the registry interoperability and tokenization layer, the public-blockchain RWA layer, and the market and application layer. Access to the tokenized carbon assets remains regulated. Token issuance and transfers are linked to participant eligibility and registry status. Retirement also remains dependent on the authoritative carbon registry. The proposed architecture provides a framework for introducing public-blockchain RWA infrastructure into Indonesia's existing carbon market while maintaining SRUK authority and existing market-integrity controls.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个将印尼碳信用（SPE-GRK）作为现实世界资产（RWA）在公共区块链上进行代币化的架构，同时保留现有国家碳注册系统（SRUK）的权威性。该架构包含四个层次，在不破坏现有市场完整性控制的前提下，引入公共区块链的可编程交易、可观察性和互操作性。
AI.motivation: 印尼已建立受监管的碳市场（IDXCarbon），但目前使用私有区块链进行交易基础设施。需要探索如何将印尼碳信用通过公共区块链基础设施进行表示和交易，以增强透明度、互操作性和可编程性，同时保持SRUK作为碳单位状态的权威来源。
AI.method: 提出一个四层架构：（1）权威碳层（SRUK作为碳单位状态的权威来源）；（2）注册互操作与代币化层；（3）公共区块链RWA层（代币表示与可编程交易）；（4）市场与应用层。该架构支持生命周期管理、代币化资产表示、公共可观察性、互操作性、钱包交易和可编程结算，同时确保代币发行和转移受参与者资格和注册状态的约束。
AI.result: 该架构成功地将公共区块链RWA基础设施引入印尼现有碳市场，同时保留SRUK的权威性和现有市场完整性控制。代币化碳资产的访问仍受监管，代币发行与转移与参与者资格和注册状态挂钩，退出（退休）机制仍依赖权威碳注册系统。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为印尼碳市场引入公共区块链RWA基础设施提供了一个可行的框架，在增强可编程性和互操作性的同时，维护了SRUK的权威地位和市场监管的完整性。这为公共区块链在受监管碳市场中的应用提供了实践路径。

title: WorldRover: A Scalable Synthetic Video Data Engine for World Exploration with Rich Annotations
summary: Learning to generate or reconstruct explorable worlds requires video paired with more than RGB: camera motion, scene geometry, temporal correspondence and, for interactive models, control signals. Real capture can provide some of these signals, but dense geometry and long-range correspondence usually rely on estimation or specialised instrumentation. Rendering provides these quantities directly, yet existing synthetic resources rarely combine them on the same frames while also supporting controlled changes of viewpoint and appearance. We introduce WorldRover, a data engine for generating richly annotated, long-range explorations of artist-built environments. At its core, WorldRover-Engine is an Unreal Engine pipeline that executes and offline-renders minute-scale routes while preserving their full trajectories and scene geometry. The same exploration can be replayed from first-person, third-person, and 360 panoramic cameras under different environmental states. Using WorldRover-Engine, we construct WorldRover-10M, whose sequences pair RGB with metric depth, camera trajectories, and trajectory-derived action signals throughout each exploration. Third-person subsets additionally provide dense optical flow, long-range 2D/3D point tracks with visibility, and a character trajectory distinct from the camera trajectory. The engine can render a traversal from first-person, third-person and 360 panoramic viewpoints, under different environmental states or with a neutral white material, while preserving the route and scene geometry. WorldRover therefore turns long-horizon world exploration into a scalable data-generation problem, providing supervision for models that must build, maintain, and revisit coherent representations of an explorable world.

AI.tldr: WorldRover是一个数据引擎系统，用于生成大规模、长时程、多视角的"可探索世界"视频数据。它基于Unreal Engine管线渲染分钟级路线，同时提供RGB、指标深度、相机轨迹、动作信号，以及稠密光流、长距离2D/3D点轨迹等丰富标注，构建了WorldRover-10M数据集，以支持可交互世界模型的学习。
AI.motivation: 现有视频数据难以同时提供生成可探索世界所需的多种监督信号（相机运动、场景几何、时间对应关系、控制信号）。真实采集数据依赖估计或专门仪器获取稠密几何与长距离对应关系，而现有合成数据资源很少在同一帧上同时提供这些量并支持受控的视角和外观变化。因此需要一个能直接渲染这些量的数据引擎。
AI.method: WorldRover由两部分组成：(1) WorldRover-Engine——基于Unreal Engine的离线渲染管线，执行分钟级探索路线，保留完整轨迹和场景几何，并支持从第一人称、第三人称和360全景视角重放，以及不同环境状态或中性白色材质渲染；(2) WorldRover-10M——由该引擎构建的大规模数据集，每个序列将RGB与指标深度、相机轨迹和轨迹衍生的动作信号配对，第三人称子集还提供稠密光流、长距离2D/3D点跟踪及可见性掩码，以及区别于相机轨迹的角色轨迹。
AI.result: 构建了WorldRover-10M数据集，其序列同时提供RGB、指标深度、相机轨迹和动作信号；第三人称子集额外包含稠密光流、长距离点轨迹和角色轨迹。该引擎可在不同环境状态下从多视角渲染同一探索路径，使长时程世界探索成为可扩展的数据生成问题。
AI.conclusion: WorldRover将长时程世界探索转化为一个可扩展的数据生成问题，为需要构建、维护和重访可探索世界一致表示的模型提供了多样化的监督信号，填补了现有合成数据缺少多信号同帧渲染和控制化视角变换的空白。

title: New Approximations of Non-Separable MIMO Channels by Separable Channels for Accurate Ergodic Capacity Analysis
summary: In recent years, owing to the high accuracy in characterizing non-separable channels prevalent in next-generation wireless applications, the classical Weichselberger channel model has gained widespread adoption in multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems. However, its non-separable structure also introduces severe analytical complexity, leading to a lack of tractable mathematical frameworks in the literature and thus raises an urgent need for further research. To address the aforementioned analytical complexity, we first derive the nearest separable (double-correlated Rayleigh) fading model to the Weichselberger model under the Kullback-Leibler divergence (KLD), a problem equivalent to rank-1 nonnegative matrix factorization under the Itakura-Saito (IS) distance criterion. The results of our asymptotic analysis in the high-SNR regime reveal that the KLD-enabled approximation achieves a tighter capacity estimate than the conventional Kronecker model, especially in sparse and non-regular scattering environments. Yet, a key limitation of the KLD-enabled model is its tendency to mischaracterize the channel capacity in the low-SNR regime due to its inability to preserve total channel power. As a more robust alternative, we introduce a novel moment matching method (MMM) aimed at mapping the exact channel statistics to those of a Wishart distribution. Both the KLD-enabled and MMM-enabled separable channel directly enable the use of exact closed-form expressions for the ergodic capacity. Numerical results demonstrate that the MMM-enabled model consistently improves upon the capacity accuracy of the conventional Kronecker model across all SNR regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文针对Weichselberger信道模型分析复杂的问题，提出了两种可分离近似方法：基于KLD（等价于IS距离下的秩1非负矩阵分解）的最邻近可分衰落模型，以及基于矩匹配的Wishart分布近似模型。前者在高SNR下比Kronecker模型更精确，后者在所有SNR下均优于传统Kronecker模型。
AI.motivation: Weichselberger信道模型因其非可分离结构能高精度刻画下一代无线通信中常见的不可分离信道，但该结构也带来了严重的分析复杂性，文献中缺乏易处理的数学框架，亟需研究。
AI.method: 1) 在KLD准则下推导出与Weichselberger模型最邻近的可分离（双相关Rayleigh）衰落模型，该问题等价于Itakura-Saito距离准则下的秩1非负矩阵分解；2) 提出矩匹配方法（MMM），将精确信道统计映射到Wishart分布的统计量上；3) 两种方法均使得遍历容量的精确闭式表达式可直接使用。
AI.result: 高SNR渐近分析表明KLD近似比传统Kronecker模型能获得更紧密的容量估计，尤其在稀疏和非规则散射环境中；但KLD模型在低SNR区间因无法保持信道总功率而存在容量误表征问题。MMM模型在所有SNR区间都一致地提高了相对于传统Kronecker模型的容量精度。
AI.conclusion: MMM方法作为更稳健的替代方案，在所有SNR区间均优于传统Kronecker模型，为Weichselberger信道的可分离近似提供了更好的选择。

title: Non-obvious Manipulability with Groups in Shapley-Scarf Housing Markets
summary: In Shapley-Scarf housing markets, Ma (1994) shows that top trading cycles (TTC) is the unique mechanism satisfying individual rationality (IR), Pareto efficiency (PE), and strategy-proofness. We ask what other mechanisms become possible when strategy-proofness is replaced by a weaker condition called non-obvious manipulability (NOM), introduced by Troyan and Morrill (2020). We first show that this weaker condition does not help on its own: every IR and PE mechanism is already NOM. We therefore introduce a new condition: NOM with groups, under which each agent knows the preferences of the other members of her group, but not those of agents outside the group. This condition reduces to strategy-proofness when all agents belong to one group, and to standard NOM when every group is a singleton. Also, we introduce a participation condition called group rationality (GR), which requires that no group do worse than it would by trading only among its own members. We then define a class of mechanisms called TTC with super-groups, whose members satisfy GR, PE, and NOM with groups. The class includes mechanisms that differ from standard TTC, including mechanisms that are not strategy-proof. Furthermore, we show that every mechanism that satisfies GR, PE, and NOM with groups has the same best- and worst-case outcomes as every TTC with super-groups mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Shapley-Scarf住房市场中，当策略证明性被更弱的"非明显可操纵性"(NOM)取代后，哪些机制成为可能。作者发现NOM本身不足以扩展机制空间（IR+PE的机制已自动满足NOM），因此引入新的群体NOM和群体理性(GR)条件，并定义了一类新的"带超级群体的TTC"机制，该类机制包含非策略证明的机制，且所有满足GR、PE和群体NOM的机制与原机制具有相同的最佳和最坏情况结果。
AI.motivation: Ma(1994)证明了在Shapley-Scarf住房市场中，TTC是唯一满足个体理性、帕累托效率和策略证明性的机制。作者希望探索当放宽策略证明性为更弱的非明显可操纵性(NOM)条件时，是否会出现新的机制，从而拓宽机制设计的选择空间。
AI.method: 首先证明在IR和PE条件下，NOM是自动满足的，因此单独放宽NOM无助于扩展机制空间。随后提出两个新概念：NOM with groups（群组非明显可操纵性，组内成员彼此知道偏好但组间不知道）和group rationality (GR)（群体理性，任何群体不会比仅在其内部交易更差）。基于这些条件，定义了"带超级群体的TTC"(TTC with super-groups)机制类别，并分析了其性质及与所有满足GR、PE和群体NOM机制的极值结果关系。
AI.result: 研究结果表明：标准NOM不足以产生新机制；引入群体NOM和GR后，构造出的"TTC with super-groups"机制类别包含与标准TTC不同的机制，其中一些是非策略证明的；此外，所有满足GR、PE和群体NOM的机制与TTC with super-groups机制具有相同的最佳和最坏情况结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入群体层面的非明显可操纵性和群体理性，作者成功地在保留重要效率与理性性质的同时，突破了传统TTC的唯一性壁垒，构造出更丰富的机制类别，为住房市场机制设计提供了新的可能性。

title: PIKFNO: An Interpretable Neural Operator Based on Physics Informed Kernel Function
summary: This work proposes a new interpretable neural operator framework, termed the Physics Informed Kernel Function Neural Operator (PIKFNO), which explicitly incorporates physics informed kernel functions derived from governing equations into the neural operator architecture. Unlike traditional neural operators such as DeepONet, which rely on deep networks to implicitly learn basis functions, PIKFNO constrains the trunk network through physics informed kernel functions, thereby aligning its operator structure with the kernel expansions used in meshless collocation methods. Two construction strategies are introduced: one learns kernel functions directly from data, where the learned kernel can be regarded as a nonsingular fundamental solution, while the other builds them through transformations of analytical fundamental solutions. Numerical experiments demonstrate that PIKFNO achieves high predictive accuracy with substantially improved interpretability and superior generalization under limited training data. The proposed framework offers a new pathway for developing efficient, physically consistent, and interpretable neural operators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新的可解释神经算子框架——物理信息核函数神经算子（PIKFNO），将源自控制方程的物理信息核函数显式融入神经算子架构中，通过约束主干网络使其算子结构与无网格配点法中的核展开对齐，在有限训练数据下实现高精度预测、显著提升的可解释性和更优的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 传统神经算子（如DeepONet）依赖深度网络隐式学习基函数，缺乏可解释性，且在小样本训练数据下泛化能力有限。作者希望将控制方程所蕴含的物理结构显式嵌入神经算子，从而弥补传统方法在可解释性和数据效率方面的不足。
AI.method: PIKFNO通过物理信息核函数约束主干（trunk）网络，使其算子结构与无网格配点法中的核展开保持一致。具体提出两种核函数构建策略：（1）直接从数据中学习核函数，学习到的核可视为非奇异基本解；（2）通过解析基本解的变换来构建核函数。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，PIKFNO在预测精度上表现优异，同时相比传统神经算子具有显著提升的可解释性，并在有限的训练数据条件下展现出更优的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: PIKFNO为开发高效、物理一致且可解释的神经算子提供了一条新途径，弥合了深度学习方法与经典数值方法（如无网格配点法）之间的鸿沟。

title: Inference-Time Mitigation of Adversarial Political Bias in Large Language Models
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become the mainstay for information retrieval and summarization tasks, ensuring that they are always non-partisan and invulnerable to political bias is a critical step towards safer and more trustworthy Artificial Intelligence (AI). Current model alignment paradigms, such as reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), make LLMs follow overarching safety instructions. However, this instruction tuning can be exploited via adversarial prompt injection and be used to generate unsafe content. In particular, political bias has not been specifically targeted by modern alignment techniques as harmful and biased content. To address this vulnerability of LLMs, we propose mitigation strategies using Chain of Thought (CoT) prompting and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). Using a public dataset of legislative videos, we generate summaries using LLMs, inject bias via adversarial prompting and evaluate their performance on a four axis scale designed for political summarization. In this paper, we present different methods to shield LLMs against the injection of political bias. Our results demonstrate that the proposed Recursive Self-Correction approach raises model performance from a Political Neutrality Likert scale baseline of 2.14 to 4.56, averaged across all models, demonstrating effective inference-time mitigation of political bias in LLM-generated summaries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用Chain of Thought提示和Direct Preference Optimization（DPO）等策略，通过递归自我修正方法在推理时缓解大型语言模型（LLM）生成摘要中的政治偏见。实验表明，所提出的递归自我修正方法将政治中立性Likert量表得分从基线2.14提升到4.56，有效防御了对抗性提示注入带来的政治偏见。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM成为信息检索和摘要任务的主流工具，确保其无党派且不受政治偏见影响对AI的安全性和可信度至关重要。当前的模型对齐范式（如RLHF）依赖总体安全指令，但易被对抗性提示注入利用，且政治偏见未被现代对齐技术专门视为有害内容，存在安全漏洞。
AI.method: 提出两种缓解策略：基于Chain of Thought（CoT）提示的推理时防御，以及基于Direct Preference Optimization（DPO）的训练时对齐。使用公开的立法视频数据集生成摘要，通过对抗性提示注入偏见，并在专为政治摘要设计的四轴量表上评估性能。核心方法为递归自我修正（Recursive Self-Correction），即在推理过程中让模型多次自我审视并修正输出中的政治偏见。
AI.result: 递归自我修正方法在所有模型上将政治中立性Likert量表得分从2.14的基线提升至4.56，证明了其在推理时有效缓解LLM生成摘要中政治偏见的优越性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，通过推理时的递归自我修正策略，可以有效保护LLM免受政治偏见的阵营性注入，为构建更安全、更值得信赖的LLM提供了实用且有效的解决方案，补充了现有对齐范式在政治偏见维度的不足。

title: Path2ST: Hierarchical Cell-Tissue Grounded Cross-Modal Translation for Spatial Transcriptomics
summary: Predicting spatial gene expression from hematoxylin and eosin (H\&E)-stained images offers a cost-effective alternative to spatial transcriptomics (ST). However, existing methods treat H\&E images as generic visual inputs and ignore their intrinsic biological hierarchy, where spatially organized cell types collectively form functional tissue microenvironments that govern local gene expression programs. To bridge this gap, we formulate H\&E-to-ST prediction as a cross-modal semantic translation task and propose Path2ST, a hierarchically grounded autoregressive framework featuring three key components: (i) a Hierarchical Cell-Tissue Conditioning mechanism that fuses explicit and implicit cellular features with tissue-level semantic representations to construct hierarchical conditioning signals; (ii) a Scale-Adaptive Autoregressive Generation process over a hierarchical semantic vocabulary, enabling coarse-to-fine, biologically consistent expression synthesis; and (iii) SpectraLoss, a full-spectrum objective that jointly enforces ordinal fidelity, models transcriptional bursts, and aligns semantic structures with cell types. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, validating that Path2ST generates highly accurate and spatially coherent transcriptomic profiles. The related code is released at https://github.com/RuochenLiu23/Path2ST.

AI.tldr: Path2ST提出了一种层次化自回归框架，将H&E染色图像到空间转录组（ST）的预测形式化为跨模态语义翻译任务，通过层次化的细胞-组织条件机制、尺度自适应自回归生成过程以及全频谱损失函数，在三个数据集上取得了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将H&E图像视为通用视觉输入，忽略了其内在的生物学层次结构——即空间组织的细胞类型共同形成功能性组织微环境，进而调控局部基因表达程序。这种对生物学层次的忽视导致预测的转录组谱缺乏生物学一致性。
AI.method: Path2ST包含三个关键组件：(i) 层次化细胞-组织条件机制（Hierarchical Cell-Tissue Conditioning），融合显式和隐式细胞特征与组织级语义表征以构建层次化条件信号；(ii) 尺度自适应自回归生成过程（Scale-Adaptive Autoregressive Generation），在层次化语义词表上进行从粗到细、生物学一致的表达合成；(iii) 全频谱目标函数（SpectraLoss），联合施加序数保真约束、建模转录爆发（transcriptional bursts）并实现语义结构与细胞类型的对齐。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上取得了最先进的性能，证明Path2ST能够生成高精度且空间连贯的转录组谱。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模H&E图像中固有的生物学层次结构（细胞-组织-微环境），Path2ST有效提升了跨模态语义翻译的质量，验证了将生物学先验知识注入模型设计的有效性，为H&E-to-ST预测提供了新范式。

title: Position: Evaluations of AI Moral Reasoning Still Miss Half of the Picture
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure. Accepted for archival publication at the ACL 2026 Workshop on Evaluating Evaluations (EvalEval)
summary: Recent work on evaluating the moral competence of large language models (LLMs) has focused primarily on what we call the moral value problem, i.e., whether model outputs align with human moral values. In contrast, the moral norm problem, i.e., whether models can identify and correctly apply context-sensitive moral norms, remains underexplored. We posit that this imbalance stems from the field's reliance on descriptive ethics frameworks, such as Moral Foundations Theory and Kohlberg's stages of moral development, which emphasize value representation over normative application. We review existing benchmarks and evaluation methods, and show that they cluster heavily around the value problem, while discussion regarding normative ethics remains underrepresented. We identify three crucial gaps: (i) the absence of high-quality ground-truth data for moral norms and their applications, (ii) insufficient evaluation of intermediate reasoning processes, and (iii) limited attention to the identification of morally relevant features in context. Subsequently, we propose a research agenda that includes the development of standardized formal representations for normative theories, the construction of expert-annotated datasets capturing norm application, and evaluation protocols that explicitly distinguish between values-level and norms-level competence. Our goal is to encourage a more systematic study of normative reasoning in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前大语言模型（LLM）道德能力评估过度聚焦于"道德价值问题"（输出是否与人类道德价值观一致），而忽视了"道德规范问题"（模型能否识别并正确应用上下文敏感的道德规范）。作者回顾了现有基准和评估方法，发现它们严重偏向价值问题，并识别出三个关键缺口，进而提出一个涵盖形式化规范表征、专家标注数据集和细粒度评估协议的研究议程，旨在推动LLM规范性推理的系统性研究。
AI.motivation: 推动大语言模型道德能力评估的方向性纠偏：现有研究过度依赖描述性伦理学框架（如道德基础理论、柯尔伯格道德发展阶段论），这些框架侧重价值表征而非规范应用，导致LLM"道德规范问题"这一更复杂的维度被系统性忽视，亟需将研究重心从价值对齐转向规范性推理。
AI.method: 本文采用综述与批判性分析的方法：(1)系统回顾现有的LLM道德评估基准与评估方法；(2)分析这些基准在"价值问题"与"规范问题"之间的分布失衡；(3)基于规范伦理学视角识别三个关键研究缺口；(4)提出包含标准化规范理论形式表征、专家标注的规范应用数据集、以及区分价值层与规范层能力的评估协议在内的研究议程。
AI.result: 研究发现现有基准和评估方法高度集中于道德价值问题，而规范伦理学的讨论严重不足。识别出三个具体缺口：缺乏用于道德规范及其应用的优质真实标注数据、对中间推理过程评估不足、以及对上下文中道德相关特征识别的关注有限，并据此提出了相应的研究路线图。
AI.conclusion: LLM的道德评估需要从"价值对齐"范式向"规范应用"范式扩展。通过建立形式化的规范表征、构建专家标注数据集、以及设计区分价值层与规范层能力的评估协议，可以更系统性地研究LLM的规范性推理能力，从而实现对模型道德能力更全面、更精准的评估。

title: OmniRemesh: Adaptive and Quasi-differentiable Remeshing for Crystal Plasticity Simulation and Inverse Parameter Calibration under Large Deformation
summary: Large-deformation crystal plasticity finite element method (CPFEM) simulations are often limited by accumulated mesh distortion, which degrades accuracy and numerical stability, while adaptive remeshing introduces discrete topology changes that impede gradient-based inverse analysis. We present OmniRemesh, a unified framework that addresses these forward and inverse challenges through two developments. First, a structure-driven remeshing method dynamically redistributes local mesh resolution according to both microstructural geometry and the evolving mechanical state. By refining grain boundaries and localized deformation regions while retaining a coarser mesh elsewhere, the method maintains mesh quality and physical consistency, improves the accuracy and robustness of large-deformation calculations, and resolves grain-scale heterogeneity without uniformly dense discretization. Second, a frozen-remeshing-branch strategy locally fixes the mesh sequence within a parameter trust region and periodically updates it as the parameters evolve. This treatment provides approximate automatic-differentiation sensitivities despite topology changes, enabling efficient inverse calibration of constitutive parameters against both macroscopic and local observables. Numerical examples demonstrate accurate and stable CPFEM simulations up to 80\% tensile deformation. The inverse calibration successfully recovers both macroscopic and local responses. OmniRemesh thus provides a practical framework for large-deformation CPFEM and remeshing-aware constitutive calibration.

AI.tldr: OmniRemesh是一个统一框架，通过结构驱动的动态重网格方法解决大变形晶体塑性有限元模拟中的网格畸变问题，并通过冻结重网格分支策略解决自适应重网格带来的拓扑变化对梯度反向分析的阻碍，从而实现精确稳健的大变形CPFEM模拟和基于重网格的逆向本构参数标定。
AI.motivation: 大变形晶体塑性有限元模拟常受累积网格畸变限制，降低计算精度和数值稳定性；自适应重网格虽能缓解畸变，但引入离散拓扑变化，阻碍基于梯度的逆向参数辨识分析。现有方法无法同时兼顾正向模拟精度与逆向标定需求。
AI.method: 提出两部分方法：(1) 结构驱动的重网格方法，根据微观结构几何（如晶界）和演化中的力学状态动态分配局部网格分辨率，在精化晶界和局部变形区域的同时在其余区域保持粗网格；(2) 冻结重网格分支策略，在参数可信域内局部固定网格序列，并随参数演化周期更新，从而在拓扑变化条件下提供近似的自动微分灵敏度。
AI.result: 数值实验表明该方法可进行高达80%拉伸变形的精确稳定CPFEM模拟；逆向标定成功恢复了宏观和局部响应。
AI.conclusion: OmniRemesh为大变形晶体塑性有限元模拟和重网格感知的构模型本构参数标定提供了实用框架，兼顾了计算精度、稳健性与逆向分析的可微性。

title: KeyID: Decoupled Drafting and Keyframe Editing for Identity-Preserving Video Generation
summary: Identity-preserving video generation (IPVG) requires synthesizing videos that are faithful to both reference subjects and text prompts. Existing methods are often hindered by high tuning costs or limited input-level enhancements, struggling to maintain rigid identity consistency during complex, long-sequence actions. To address these limitations, we propose KeyID, a training-free IPVG framework that decouples the synthesis of video dynamics from the injection of identity. Specifically, KeyID comprises two components: (1) Reference-Aware Video Generation, which produces an identity-agnostic video draft aligned with multiple references, and (2) Identity-Preserved Keyframe Editing, which integrates the target identity via sparse keyframe correction and subsequent motion interpolation. By shifting from dense frame-level supervision to sparse keyframe-level refinement, KeyID effectively resolves the capacity conflict between prompt adherence and identity fidelity. Crucially, our modular design allows seamless extension to multi-subject references and complex sequential action generation without additional training. KeyID outperforms prior works and is validated by automatic and human evaluations on the official challenge benchmark, ultimately securing the runner-up position in the Track 2 (Sequential Action) of the ACM Multimedia 2026 IPVG Grand Challenge. Source code is available at https://github.com/WISLab-GDUT/KeyID.

AI.tldr: 提出了KeyID，一个无需训练的IPVG框架，通过将视频动态合成与身份注入解耦，利用参考感知视频生成和身份保持关键帧编辑实现高质量身份一致的视频生成，在ACM Multimedia 2026挑战赛中荣获亚军。
AI.motivation: 现有的身份保持视频生成方法面临高训练成本或有限的输入级增强等限制，难以在复杂长时间序列动作中维持严格的身份一致性，需要一种无需训练且能同时兼顾文本提示遵循和身份保真的解决方案。
AI.method: KeyID将身份释放的推理过程解耦为两个模块：(1) 参考感知视频生成——生成与多个参考对齐的身份无关视频草稿；(2) 身份保持关键帧编辑——通过稀疏关键帧校正和后续运动插值集成目标身份。通过从密集帧级监督转向稀疏关键帧级优化，缓解了提示遵循与身份保真之间的容量冲突，且模块化设计支持多主体参考和复杂序列动作生成。
AI.result: KeyID在官方挑战基准上通过自动评估和人工评估验证，优于先前方法，并在ACM Multimedia 2026 IPVG大奖赛Track 2（序列动作）中荣获亚军。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏关键帧级精修相比密集帧级监督能更有效地平衡身份一致性与提示遵循，且无需额外训练的模块化框架具有良好扩展性，为身份保持视频生成提供了一种高效且实用的新范式。

title: Sparse Port Selection under Mutual Coupling in Fluid Antenna Arrays
summary: Fluid antenna systems obtain spatial degrees of freedom by reconfiguring antenna positions within a confined region, a principle that extends to beamforming: shaped beams can be synthesized using far fewer radio-frequency feeds than candidate antenna positions. When the candidates are densely arranged, however, electromagnetic mutual coupling changes the relationship among terminal voltages, induced currents, and radiated fields, so an uncoupled model no longer describes the hardware and may activate an unsuitable set of ports, distorting the synthesized pattern. This paper develops a mutual-coupling-aware framework that converts the desired beam amplitude into a finite-aperture-compatible complex target and models the complete antenna lattice as a coupled multiport network, selecting the active ports and their source voltages through the coupled voltage-to-field response. Inactive candidate ports remain part of the network and carry induced currents, and every compared design is evaluated through the same electromagnetic model under the same source-voltage budget. Numerical results show that the mutual-coupling-aware design improves both the average mainlobe signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and the peak sidelobe level (PSLL) over coupling-unaware selection and a fixed array, demonstrating that mutual coupling should be exploited in the design itself rather than compensated only in the final evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种互耦感知的流体天线波束成形框架，将期望波束幅度转换为有限孔径兼容的复目标，将整个天线阵面建模为耦合多端口网络，通过耦合的电压-场响应选择激活端口及其源电压。数值结果表明，该设计相比不感知耦合的选择和固定阵列，同时改善了主瓣平均信噪比和峰值旁瓣电平。
AI.motivation: 流体天线系统通过在受限区域内重新配置天线位置获得空间自由度，这一原理可扩展到波束成形，利用远少于候选天线位置的射频馈源合成成形波束。然而，当候选位置密集排列时，电磁互耦会改变端口电压、感应电流与辐射场之间的关系，非耦合模型无法准确描述硬件行为，可能激活不合适的端口组，导致合成波束失真。因此需要在设计阶段就考虑互耦效应，而非仅在最终评估中补偿。
AI.method: 本文提出互耦感知框架：(1) 将期望波束幅度转换为有限孔径兼容的复目标；(2) 将完整天线阵面建模为耦合多端口网络；(3) 通过耦合的电压-场响应选择激活端口及其源电压；(4) 非激活候选端口仍作为网络的一部分并携带感应电流；(5) 所有对比设计均在相同电磁模型和相同源电压预算下评估。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，互耦感知设计相比互耦不感知的端口选择方案和固定阵列，同时改善了平均主瓣信噪比和峰值旁瓣电平。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明互耦应在设计阶段被利用而非仅在最终评估阶段补偿，互耦感知的设计方法能够显著提升流体天线波束成形的性能，包括更高的主瓣信噪比和更低的峰值旁瓣电平。

title: Exact MMS Allocations under Personalized Bivalued Valuations: Goods and Chores
summary: The maximin share (MMS) is a central fairness benchmark for allocating indivisible goods and chores. We study additive valuations in the personalized bivalued setting, where each agent assigns one of two agent-specific values to every item. Whether exact MMS allocations always exist in this setting has remained a major open question, as highlighted by Ebadian, Peters, and Shah and by Garg, Huang, and Segal-Halevi. We answer this question affirmatively: we prove that exact MMS allocations always exist for both goods and chores and can be computed in polynomial time. Our proof combines a quota-based reformulation with an envelope relaxation, a sparse extreme-point construction, and flow-based rounding that controls the total rounding loss.

AI.tldr: 本文解决了个性化双值估值下加性效用函数的极大极小份额（MMS）分配的长期开放问题，证明了对于物品和杂务，精确MMS分配总是存在且可在多项式时间内计算。
AI.motivation: MMS是分配不可分割物品和杂务时的核心公平性基准。在个性化双值估值设定下，每个代理对每个物品赋予两个特定的值之一。在此设定下精确MMS分配是否总是存在一直是一个重大开放问题，被多个研究团队（如Ebadian等以及Garg等）明确指出。
AI.method: 证明结合了四种关键技术：（1）基于配额的重新公式化（quota-based reformulation）；（2）包络松弛（envelope relaxation）；（3）稀疏极值点构造（sparse extreme-point construction）；（4）基于流的舍入方法（flow-based rounding）来控制总舍入损失。
AI.result: 本文肯定地回答了该开放问题：证明了在个性化双值估值下，无论物品还是杂务，精确MMS分配总是存在，并且可以在多项式时间内计算得到。
AI.conclusion: 该结果填补了MMS公平分配理论中的一个重要空白，为个性化双值设定下的精确MMS分配提供了完整的肯定答案和高效算法。

title: Explaining Reinforcement Learning Decisions in Self-adaptive Systems
comment: Accepted in the 20th Colombian Computing Congress. 13 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has been extensively used in autonomous and self-* systems, but RL policies, especially deep RL ones relying on neural networks, lack transparency and are difficult to understand. This can lead to diminished user trust, and makes for a more challenging verification of systems. To address this challenge, this paper introduces Explanations using Alternative Realities for Reinforcement Learning (EARL), a Python library to produce counterfactual explanations in RL settings. This library allows the user to produce explanations by exploring What-if scenarios to clarify agent behavior by comparing possible outcomes. Counterfactual explanations have been shown to be intuitive and user-friendly in psychology research, but have only recently been explored in RL, with existing implementations usually limited to toy examples and benchmarks. EARL supports counterfactual explanation generation in realistic RL-based self-adaptive systems. To demonstrate its applicability, we demonstrate its use in a simulation of CitiBikes, a self-adaptive bike-sharing system, and we provide evaluations showing how it performs in real applications.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍EARL，一个用于在强化学习（RL）系统中生成反事实解释的Python库，通过"如果怎样"（What-if）场景帮助用户理解代理行为。EARL支持在现实世界的自适应性系统中生成反事实解释，并通过CitiBikes共享单车模拟系统进行了应用演示和评估。
AI.motivation: 深度强化学习策略依赖神经网络，缺乏透明度和可解释性，导致用户信任度降低且系统验证困难。现有RL反事实解释实现通常局限于玩具示例和基准测试，缺乏对现实自适应性系统的支持。
AI.method: EARL库通过探索"如果怎样"（What-if）场景来生成反事实解释，比较可能的结果以阐明代理行为。设计目标是支持在现实RL-based自适应性系统中生成反事实解释，而不仅仅局限于简单示例。
AI.result: 在CitiBikes模拟器（一个自适应的共享单车系统）中展示了EARL的适用性，并通过真实应用评估验证了其性能。
AI.conclusion: EARL是一种可行的工具，能够在现实自适应性系统中为RL策略生成直观且用户友好的反事实解释，从而增强系统透明度和可解释性。

title: Characterizing Rhetorical Misalignment in Decision-Making with Language Models
summary: Human decision-making is often shaped by a range of well-documented cognitive biases. As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly integrated into high-stakes human-AI decision-making, it is important to understand whether their outputs can amplify potential biases, how this influences human decisions, and crucially, whether it can lead to harmful consequences. In this work, we develop a decision-theoretic framework to study rhetorical misalignment, a failure mode where an LLM uses rhetorically inappropriate forms of presentation for a given decision context, thereby inducing suboptimal human decisions. We empirically investigate this phenomenon through a human-subject experiment in realistic clinical decision-making using a dataset curated from the United States Medical Licensing Examination. By measuring how LLM-generated information affects decisions, we observe that LLMs induce an average 2.81% rate of harmful decision flips across different models, where clinician participants change from a correct to an incorrect answer. Rationales reported by participants provide evidence that these revisions are closely related to the language used by LLMs that may induce different types of cognitive biases, including anchoring, authority bias, and loss aversion. To enable scalable evaluation, we instantiate our theoretical framework using decision-makers simulated by LLMs to computationally measure rhetorical misalignment. Our findings reveal a safety concern previously unrecognized in high-stakes domains: a model can be factually aligned yet still induce harm through its rhetorical presentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出决策理论框架研究"修辞错位"（rhetorical misalignment）现象——LLM在决策情境中使用修辞上不合适的表达形式，从而诱导次优的人类决策。通过基于USMLE的临床决策人体实验，发现LLM平均诱导2.81%的有害决策翻转（从正确变为错误），并且即使在事实对齐的情况下，也能通过修辞呈现方式造成危害。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM越来越多地融入高风险人机联合决策场景，需要理解LLM输出是否会放大认知偏差、如何影响人类决策，以及是否可能造成有害后果。此前研究多关注LLM的事实准确性，忽视了其修辞/表达方式对决策者的潜在负面影响。
AI.method: 1) 构建决策理论框架形式化定义修辞错位；2) 使用USMLE医学执照考试真实数据，开展临床决策人体实验；3) 测量LLM生成信息对临床医生决策的影响（正确→错误的翻转率）；4) 收集参与者推理报告分析认知偏差机制（锚定、权威偏差、损失厌恶）；5) 使用LLM模拟决策者实现可扩展的修辞错位自动评估。
AI.result: LLM在不同模型上平均诱导2.81%的有害决策翻转率（从正确答案翻转为错误答案）；参与者报告中提供了证据表明这些翻转与LLM所用语言诱导的认知偏差密切相关，包括锚定效应、权威偏差和损失厌恶。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了一个高风险领域中此前未被认识到的安全隐患：模型可以在事实上完全对齐（factually aligned），却仍通过其修辞呈现方式诱导人类做出有害决策。这呼吁对LLM安全性评估不仅要关注"说什么"（内容），还要关注"怎么说"（表达形式）。

title: Local Gains and Fixed-Assignment Set Losses in Shared Set Decoders
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. An ancillary analysis-ready package supports exact aggregate reproduction without model inference. Code and reproduction package: https://github.com/yqjyzzz/query-interaction-reproduction
summary:
A query-relation deletion can improve the edited slot while reducing the utility of the prediction set that contains it. We study this tension in two related ResNet-50 DETR-family checkpoints using recorded, selection-conditional evidence from 710 paired image-relation units per checkpoint. The primary comparison subtracts a matched active control, which deletes the same leader source at a different recorded recipient, from the selected target deletion. It is therefore a composite contrast rather than a same-recipient placebo.
  The target-minus-control contrast is locally positive and fixed-assignment negative in both checkpoints. The opposite-sign pattern occurs within 302/710 DETR units and 460/710 DINO units. After rematching, the corresponding counts are 285/710 and 433/710. Rematching and native selection absorb enough of the mean loss for DETR intervals to cross zero, whereas DINO intervals remain negative, so persistence across readouts differs by checkpoint. A fixed-map comparison between hard deletion and a mass-preserving edit also differs before rematching. That comparison is conditional on the outcome-blind map and does not establish same-dose transport.
  Local intervention success therefore does not determine the consequence for a jointly decoded set. The supported conclusion is selection-conditional deletion sensitivity whose persistence depends on the readout and intervention operator. We do not identify an intervention-invariant edge mechanism, detector-level degradation, population prevalence, or the value of a training-time regularizer.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了查询-关系删除在编辑槽位与降低包含该槽位的预测集效用之间的张力，利用两个ResNet-50 DETR系列检查点中710个配对图像-关系单元的选择条件证据进行分析。目标-对照对比在两个检查点中呈现局部正效应、固定分配负效应的相反模式，但重匹配后DETR区间跨越零点而DINO仍为负，表明持续性因读取方式和干预算子而异。
AI.motivation: 查询-关系删除在改进被编辑槽位的同时可能降低包含该槽位的预测集整体效用，这一张力尚未被系统研究。作者希望理解局部编辑成功与全局预测集后果之间的关系，并考察是否存在干预不变（intervention-invariant）的边缘机制。
AI.method: 使用两个相关的ResNet-50 DETR家族检查点（DETR和DINO），从每个检查点记录710个配对图像-关系单元的选择条件证据。主要比较采用"目标减去匹配的活动对照"的复合对比设计，其中对照删除同一主导源但在不同记录接收者处；还进行了重匹配（rematching）和固定映射的硬删除与质量保持编辑比较。
AI.result: 目标-对照对比在两个检查点中呈局部正效应、固定分配负效应。该相反符号模式出现在302/710个DETR单元和460/710个DINO单元中；重匹配后分别为285/710和433/710。DETR区间在重匹配后跨越零点，而DINO区间保持负值，表明持续性因检查点而异。未识别出干预不变的边缘机制、检测器级退化、群体流行或训练时正则化器的价值。
AI.conclusion: 局部干预成功并不决定联合解码集的后果。可支持的结论是选择条件的删除敏感性，其持续性取决于读取方式和干预算子。作者未发现干预不变的边缘机制或检测器级退化等附加结论。

title: From Doyle to AGM: A Survey and an Implementation Roadmap for Belief Change
comment: Author's accepted manuscript of an article published in The European Journal on Artificial Intelligence 2026 (SAGE). 65 pages, 2 figures. Final published version available at https://doi.org/10.1177/30504554261426170
summary: This paper presents a targeted narrative review establishing the historical and theoretical foundations for computational belief change implementation. Seeded by Doyle and London's foundational 1980 taxonomy, we trace the evolution of belief revision from computational origins through the theoretical transformation of the AGM framework to contemporary approaches. Our analysis demonstrates how pre-AGM computational pragmatism relates to AGM theoretical constructs, revealing both continuities and transformations across this evolution. We analyze how each taxonomical category evolved in the post-AGM era, identifying the theoretical foundations and historical precedents that inform contemporary implementation challenges. This foundation enables subsequent research into robust computational blueprints that synthesize historical insights with formal guarantees, providing the baseline for systematic implementation analysis and engineering-focused belief change research.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇针对性叙事综述，以Doyle和London 1980年的分类学为起点，梳理信念变更计算实现的历史与理论基础，分析从计算起源经AGM框架理论转型到当代方法的发展脉络，揭示前AGM计算实用主义与AGM理论构造之间的连续性与转变，为后续鲁棒计算蓝图和工程化信念变更研究奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 信念变更（belief change）领域缺乏对计算实现层面的系统性历史与理论梳理，需要在AGM框架与计算实现之间建立清晰的谱系联系，以理解当代实现挑战的理论根源和历史先例。
AI.method: 采用针对性叙事综述方法，以Doyle和London 1980年的分类学（taxonomy）为种子，追踪信念修正在各后AGM时期分类学范畴内的演变，分析前AGM计算实用主义与AGM理论构造之间的关系，并识别影响当代实现挑战的理论基础与历史先例。
AI.result: 揭示了信念变更从计算起源到AGM理论框架再到当代方法的演化过程中各分类学范畴的演变路径，阐明了前AGM计算实用主义与AGM理论构造之间的连续性与转变，识别出支撑当代实现挑战的理论基础与历史先例。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为后续研究提供了历史与理论基线，使后续工作能够整合历史洞见与形式化保证，构建鲁棒的计算蓝图，并推动面向系统实现分析与工程导向的信念变更研究。

title: COOL: A Cooling-Aware Point Transformer Framework for Thermal Prediction in Advanced 3D/3.5D IC Packaging
summary: Advanced 3D and 3.5D IC packaging significantly improves integration density but elevates thermal management challenges due to cross-layer heat coupling and complex cooling structures. Traditional solvers deliver high fidelity but are too slow for iterative design flows, while existing learning-based methods either fail to capture inter-die thermal coupling or treat cooling structures as static components, limiting their applicability in real packaging co-design scenarios. In this work, we introduce COOL, a cooling-aware point transformer framework that represents heterogeneous assemblies (dies, interposers, TIMs, heat spreaders) as annotated 3D point clouds embedding geometric, material and power attributes. COOL explicitly encodes geometric boundaries and cooling structures, and introduces a physics-informed boundary condition (PI-BC) loss to enforce thermal consistency at material interfaces and cooling boundaries. Extensive experiments demonstrate that COOL achieves a remarkable 2.4\% NMAE on our constructed benchmark of multi-package thermal designs, substantially outperforming existing learning-based approaches while providing over 15.7x speedup compared to commercial FEM solvers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出COOL，一个冷却感知的点变换器框架，用于先进3D/3.5D IC封装的快速热仿真。COOL将异构组装体表示为带标注的3D点云，编码几何、材料和功率属性，并引入物理信息边界条件（PI-BC）损失以强化材料界面和冷却边界的温度一致性。实验表明COOL在自建多封装热设计基准上达到2.4%的NMAE，显著优于现有学习方法，同时比商业FEM求解器快15.7倍以上。
AI.motivation: 先进3D/3.5D IC封装虽大幅提升集成密度，但跨层热耦合和复杂冷却结构带来严重热管理挑战。传统求解器精度高但迭代设计流程中速度过慢；现有学习方法要么无法捕捉芯片间热耦合，要么将冷却结构视为静态组件，限制了实际封装协同设计场景中的应用。因此需要一种既能捕捉跨层热耦合又能动态建模冷却结构的高效热仿真方法。
AI.method: COOL采用点变换器框架，将异构封装组装体（芯片、中介层、TIM、散热器）表示为嵌入几何、材料和功率属性的带标注3D点云。框架显式编码几何边界和冷却结构，并引入物理信息边界条件（PI-BC）损失函数，以强制在材料界面和冷却边界处满足热学一致性约束。
AI.result: 在自建的多封装热设计基准上，COOL实现了2.4%的NMAE，显著超越现有学习方法；同时相比商业FEM求解器提供超过15.7倍的加速。
AI.conclusion: COOL有效解决了先进3D/3.5D IC封装热仿真中跨层热耦合建模与冷却结构动态表征的难题，在保持高精度的同时实现了数量级的加速，为迭代式热-物理协同设计提供了可行的工业级解决方案。

title: Off-Grid Position Optimization under Mutual Coupling in Fluid Antenna Arrays
summary: Fluid antenna arrays exploit continuous antenna repositioning within a finite aperture to provide geometry diversity beyond grid-constrained port selection. Every displacement, however, changes both the radiation response and the multiport mutual-impedance network, coupling geometry optimization with the source-voltage constraint. This paper develops an electromagnetic-aware (EM-aware) beamforming framework for planar fluid antenna arrays. Phase retrieval converts an amplitude-only shaped-beam specification into an aperture-compatible complex target, and an EM-aware orthogonal matching pursuit (OMP) method selects grid-constrained initial antenna positions. Continuous refinement then alternates exact voltage-constrained current optimization with movement-constrained projected adaptive moment estimation (Adam) updates of all physical antenna positions. Across independently perturbed symmetric dual-beam targets, the proposed method consistently improves the average mainlobe signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and reduces the peak sidelobe level (PSLL) over a uniform array and discrete port selection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向平面流体天线阵列的电磁感知（EM-aware）波束成形框架，通过相位恢复、电磁感知OMP初始位置选择以及连续细化（电压约束电流优化与运动约束Adam位置更新交替）来优化天线位置，在双波束目标下相比均匀阵列和离散端口选择显著提升主瓣SNR并降低峰值旁瓣电平。
AI.motivation: 流体天线阵列通过在有限孔径内连续重新定位天线来提供超越网格受限端口选择的几何分集，但每次位移都会同时改变辐射响应和多端口互阻抗网络，将几何优化与源电压约束耦合在一起，现有方法难以有效求解这种耦合优化问题。
AI.method: 1) 相位恢复：将仅含幅度的赋形波束指标转化为与孔径兼容的复目标；2) 电磁感知正交匹配追踪（OMP）：选择网格受限的初始天线位置；3) 连续细化：交替执行精确的电压约束电流优化与运动约束的投影自适应矩估计（Adam）更新所有物理天线位置。
AI.result: 在多个独立扰动的对称双波束目标上，所提方法在平均主瓣信噪比（SNR）和峰值旁瓣电平（PSLL）方面均一致优于均匀阵列和离散端口选择方案。
