AI.conclusion: 所提出的电磁感知波束成形框架能够有效解决流体天线阵列中几何优化与源电压约束耦合的问题，持续改善波束成形性能，验证了连续天线重定位相比离散端口选择的优势。

title: When Search Eats the Web: A Model of Corpus Erosion under Generative Extraction
summary: Generative search engines (GSEs) answer user queries directly from crawled web content. The capture of value from the corpus without a visit returned to the source (we call this capture extraction) diverts the traffic that finances content production. In response, publishers may restrict crawler access to their websites. In this paper, we model the crawlable corpus as a common-pool resource: the crawlable commons. It is described by three quantities: volume, average quality, and lifetime. Under two types of responses of publishers we prove that extraction degrades all three at once: publishers opt out, renewal loses its funding, and content becomes more perishable. After a given erosion threshold, the corpus goes extinct. A myopic GSE can cross this threshold, a long-run oriented GSE stays below it. We extend our model to several competing engines and prove, under a concavity condition on the steady-state value of the commons, that the symmetric equilibrium extraction rate is nondecreasing in their number and converges to the threshold. Adding users who strictly prefer direct answers, the assumption most favorable to extraction, we prove that the socially optimal extraction rate lies strictly below the erosion threshold, and no higher than the single engine's sustainable optimum. Finally, we discuss seven survival mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 将可爬取的网络内容建模为公共池资源（"可爬取公共资源"），证明生成式搜索引擎的提取行为会同时降低语料库的规模、质量和寿命，并可能导致语料库灭绝；短视型搜索引擎会跨越灭绝阈值，而长期导向型搜索引擎会保持在阈值以下；多个搜索引擎竞争时均衡提取率随数量递增并趋近阈值；即使在最有利于提取的假设下，社会最优提取率也严格低于灭绝阈值；最后讨论七种生存机制。
AI.motivation: 生成式搜索引擎直接基于爬取的网页内容回答用户查询，导致流量不再回流到内容来源（即"提取捕获"），从而剥夺了为内容生产提供资金支持的流量。出版商可能因此限制爬虫访问，威胁到可爬取语料库的存续。本文旨在从公共池资源的视角系统化建模并分析这一生态危机。
AI.method: 将可爬取语料库形式化为一个由体积、平均质量和寿命三个量描述的公共池资源模型。分别在出版商两种响应类型下证明提取对三个量的劣化效应及灭绝阈值的存在。扩展至多引擎竞争模型，在稳态价值凹性条件下证明对称均衡提取率随引擎数量的非降性并收敛至阈值。最后在引入偏好直接回答的用户这一最有利提取的假设下，分析社会最优提取率。
AI.result: 证明了提取同时劣化语料库的体积、质量和寿命；短视型GSE会跨越灭绝阈值而长期导向型不会；多引擎对称均衡提取率随引擎数量非降且收敛于阈值；社会最优提取率严格低于侵蚀阈值且不高于单引擎可持续最优。
AI.conclusion: 生成式搜索的提取行为对可爬取公共资源构成系统性侵蚀威胁，需要生存机制（共提出七种）来维持语料库的可持续性；在资源管理和搜索引擎设计之间需要更审慎的权衡。

title: Metaplasticity as adaptive gradient preconditioning for incremental learning
summary: Biological intelligence naturally prevents catastrophic forgetting through Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) theory, a macroscopic consolidation process driven at the local level by synaptic metaplasticity: the continuous, history-dependent neuromodulation of individual synapses. While artificial neural networks struggle with the stability-plasticity dilemma in non-stationary environments, existing solutions often require task labels or incur massive memory overhead, diverging from biological reality. Re-framing this localized neuromodulation as an optimization-driven process, we introduce $\textbf{SynGAP}$: $\textbf{Syn}$aptic $\textbf{G}$eometric $\textbf{A}$daptive $\textbf{P}$reconditioning. SynGAP is a task-free continual learning framework based on adaptive gradient preconditioning. Rather than relying on explicit episodic triggers, SynGAP simulates real-time metaplasticity by maintaining an exponential moving average of the Fisher Information Matrix over a continuous data stream. During the optimization step, these dynamic metaplastic states are translated into a bounded multiplicative mask that preconditions raw gradients, selectively attenuating updates to critical historical parameters. Empirical evaluations demonstrate SynGAP's superior ability to mitigate catastrophic forgetting compared to established baselines. On the Split CIFAR-100 benchmark, SynGAP delivers a $4\times$ increase in accuracy compared to EWC++ and outperforms Experience Replay (ER) by almost $10\%$, while reducing the forgetting measure by over $10\%$ against both methods. Furthermore, on the CORe50 benchmark, SynGAP achieves about $68\%$, a $10\%$ improvement over optimizer baselines. By mathematically formalizing continuous biological metaplasticity as stable gradient-based regularization, SynGAP offers a highly robust and memory-efficient solution for adaptive intelligence at the edge.

AI.tldr: SynGAP是一个基于生物互补学习系统(CLS)理论和突触元可塑性的任务无关持续学习框架，通过指数移动平均的Fisher信息矩阵模拟实时元可塑性，以有界乘法掩码对梯度进行预条件处理，在Split CIFAR-100和CORe50基准上显著优于EWC++和Experience Replay等基线方法。
AI.motivation: 生物智能通过互补学习系统（CLS）理论自然地避免了灾难性遗忘，其局部机制是突触元可塑性——持续、历史依赖的突触神经调节。而现有的人工神经网络在非平稳环境中面临稳定性-可塑性困境，已有解决方案往往需要任务标签或产生巨大的内存开销，这与生物现实不符。因此，需要一种无需任务标签、内存高效的持续学习框架。
AI.method: SynGAP将局部神经调节重新定义为优化驱动的过程，具体方法包括：(1) 在连续数据流上维护Fisher信息矩阵的指数移动平均，模拟实时的突触元可塑性状态；(2) 在优化步骤中，将这些动态元可塑性状态转化为有界乘法掩码，对原始梯度进行预条件处理；(3) 选择性衰减对关键历史参数的更新，从而在无任务标签的情况下实现持续学习。
AI.result: 在Split CIFAR-100基准上，SynGAP相比EWC++准确率提升4倍，相比Experience Replay（ER）提升近10%，且两种方法的遗忘指标均降低超过10%。在CORe50基准上，SynGAP达到约68%的准确率，比优化器基线提升10%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将连续的生物元可塑性数学形式化为稳定的基于梯度的正则化，SynGAP提供了一种高度鲁棒且内存高效的解决方案，适用于边缘计算场景下的自适应智能系统。

title: DeMTS: Denoising Trajectories as Multivariate Time Series for Hallucination Detection in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (D-LLMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for text generation. However, similar to autoregressive LLMs, D-LLMs remain vulnerable to hallucinations, where fluent outputs may contain factually incorrect or unsupported content. Although existing hallucination detection methods for D-LLMs attempt to leverage uncertainty trajectories of the denoising process to better identify hallucination signals, they typically compress the trajectories along either the temporal or token dimension, overlooking the useful information encoded in the complete two-dimensional token-step structure. Consequently, they may fail to capture hallucination-relevant patterns, such as inconsistent convergence and cross-token fault propagation, leading to suboptimal detection performance. To bridge this gap, we propose a D-LLM hallucination detection framework that formulates the Denoising trajectories as Multivariate Time Series over learnable latent variables (DeMTS for short). DeMTS employs a trajectory-preserving token-to-variable assignment module to convert token signals into stable latent variables. Based on these variables, we propose dynamic multivariate temporal modeling to progressively integrate inter-variable dependency modeling with temporal encoding for hallucination prediction. Extensive experiments on two D-LLMs backbones and three benchmarks demonstrate that DeMTS outperforms existing hallucination detection methods while maintaining strong robustness, efficiency, and cross-task transferability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeMTS框架，将扩散大语言模型（D-LLM）的去噪轨迹建模为潜在变量上的多变量时间序列，以更全面地捕捉幻觉相关的模式（如不一致收敛和跨token故障传播），从而提升幻觉检测性能。
AI.motivation: D-LLM在文本生成中仍存在幻觉问题，现有检测方法虽利用去噪过程的不确定性轨迹，但通常沿时间或token维度压缩轨迹，忽略了完整的二维token-step结构中所蕴含的幻觉相关信息（如不一致收敛和跨token故障传播），导致检测性能次优。
AI.method: DeMTS框架包含两个核心模块：（1）轨迹保持的token到变量分配模块，将token信号转换为稳定的潜在变量；（2）动态多变量时序建模模块，渐进式地整合变量间依赖建模与时间编码，用于幻觉预测。具体上，去噪轨迹被形式化为可学习潜在变量上的多变量时间序列。
AI.result: 在两个D-LLM骨干和三个基准上的大量实验表明，DeMTS优于现有幻觉检测方法，同时保持强鲁棒性、效率和跨任务迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过保留去噪轨迹的二维完整结构并将其建模为多变量时间序列，DeMTS能更好地捕捉幻觉相关模式，从而显著提升D-LLM幻觉检测的效果。

title: VideoGAIA: A Benchmark for General AI Assistants on Agentic Video Understanding
summary: Video understanding is a fundamental task for evaluating the capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing leading models have already achieved approximately 90% accuracy on the Video-MME leaderboard, suggesting that conventional single-turn video understanding tasks are becoming increasingly saturated and insufficient for assessing the intelligence of advanced MLLMs. Towards this end, we introduce VideoGAIA, an agentic video understanding benchmark for general artificial intelligence (AI) assistants. Moving beyond one-shot video question answering, VideoGAIA formulates video understanding as a multi-turn, tool-augmented interaction process, where models must iteratively perceive videos, invoke external tools, gather complementary information, and integrate multimodal evidence across turns. VideoGAIA contains 271 model-human co-designed tasks covering diverse and complex real-world scenarios. Each video-question-answer instance is independently verified by three human experts to ensure both correctness and appropriate difficulty. All evaluated MLLMs, including frontier models such as GPT-5.5 and Kimi-K3, achieve less than 60% accuracy on VideoGAIA, highlighting its value as a high-quality and timely benchmark for evaluating next-generation MLLMs. We hope that VideoGAIA will facilitate the transition from conventional video understanding toward agentic video understanding.

AI.tldr: 视频理解在多模态大语言模型领域面临饱和问题，现有模型在Video-MME上已达约90%准确率。作者提出VideoGAIA——一个智能体驱动的视频理解基准测试，将视频理解从单轮问答转变为多轮、工具增强的交互过程，要求模型迭代感知视频、调用外部工具、集成多模态证据。当前包括GPT-5.5、Kimi-K3在内的前沿模型准确率均低于60%，凸显该基准对下一代MLLM评估的价值。
AI.motivation: 现有的视频理解基准（如Video-MME）已接近饱和，主流模型准确率高达约90%，难以有效区分和评估先进MLLM的智能水平。因此需要一种更复杂、更接近真实应用的视频理解评估范式。
AI.method: 将视频理解任务重构为多轮、工具增强的智能体交互过程，要求模型迭代地感知视频、调用外部工具、收集补充信息并跨轮次整合多模态证据。包含271个人机协同设计的任务，覆盖多样复杂真实场景，每个实例由三位人类专家独立验证以保证正确性和难度。
AI.result: 所有被评估的MLLM（包括GPT-5.5和Kimi-K3等前沿模型）在VideoGAIA上的准确率均低于60%，显著低于其在传统视频基准上的表现，证明该基准具备区分度和挑战性。
AI.conclusion: VideoGAIA是一个高质量、及时的基准，能够推动视频理解从传统范式向智能体（agentic）范式转变，为下一代MLLM的评估提供更有效的工具。

title: Position: AI Governance Needs ISO-like Interoperability Protocols, Not Just Laws
comment: Accepted to ICML 2026 Position Paper Track (Spotlight) (OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=TE3ceHd4YU)
summary: As Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems become deeply integrated into critical global infrastructure, the urgency for robust governance frameworks has intensified. However, current approaches, led by jurisdiction-specific laws, policies, and voluntary frameworks such as the EU AI Act, China's algorithm governance, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework in the U.S., create a fragmented regulatory landscape. In this position paper, we argue that \textbf{\textit{AI governance must be built not on laws alone, but on ISO-like interoperability protocols that enable standardized, machine-readable risk communication across borders}}. Drawing on the success of the GDPR, which was operationalized through standards like ISO 27001 and Privacy by Design, we propose the development of standardized AI \textit{nutrition labels} containing unified metrics for bias, energy usage, and data provenance to facilitate cross-jurisdictional compliance. These manifests would lower barriers for small and medium enterprises (SMEs), reduce redundant regulatory efforts, and build public trust. The paper addresses concerns that standards may stifle innovation by advocating for modular, versioned protocols designed to evolve in tandem with technological change. Overall, we call for a shift from siloed legal compliance toward interoperable technical conformance, enabling a shared global language for responsible AI deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文主张AI治理不应仅依赖法律，而应建立类似ISO的组织互操作协议，通过标准化的机器可读"营养标签"（涵盖偏见、能耗和数据溯源指标）实现跨司法辖区的合规，以应对当前碎片化的监管格局。
AI.motivation: 当前AI治理由各司法辖区各自为政的法律、政策和自愿框架主导（如欧盟AI法案、中国算法治理、美国NIST框架），造成监管碎片化，缺乏跨边境的标准化风险沟通机制，增加合规负担并阻碍全球负责任AI部署。
AI.method: 借鉴GDPR通过ISO 27001和Privacy by Design等技术标准实现可操作性这一成功经验，提出开发标准化的AI"营养标签"——包含偏见、能耗和数据溯源等统一指标的机器可读清单，采用模块化、版本化协议设计以与技术演进同步。
AI.result: 提议的方法可降低中小企业合规门槛、减少重复监管投入并建立公众信任；同时回应了"标准可能扼杀创新"的担忧。
AI.conclusion: 呼吁从孤立的法定合规转向可互操作的技术一致性验证，建立负责任AI部署的共享全球语言。

title: AccountAgent: AI Accounting Assistant System
summary: The AI Accounting Assistant System is an innovative tool that improves the accuracy and efficiency of financial management and is becoming a core support for enterprise accounting. It relies on machine learning, natural language processing, and data visualization to automate the full accounting agent including bookkeeping, report generation, and data analysis, substantially reducing manual operations and minimizing human error. Designed to resolve the pain points of low efficiency, cumbersome workflows, and data lag in traditional accounting, the system shifts financial work from repetitive labor toward high-value decision support. It deeply mines historical financial data, precisely identifies operating trends, and provides real-time, targeted insight for strategic planning, risk prevention, and operating decisions. By reconstructing the accounting agent, the system realizes automated bookkeeping, intelligent analysis, and efficient compliance, driving the accounting profession from a bookkeeping orientation toward a management orientation. This document presents the architecture, methodology, key algorithms, and functional modules of the platform.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种AI会计助理系统，利用机器学习、自然语言处理和数据可视化技术实现记账、报表生成和数据分析的全面自动化，旨在解决传统会计工作中效率低、流程繁琐和数据滞后等问题，推动会计职业从记账导向向管理导向转型。
AI.motivation: 传统会计核算存在效率低下、工作流程繁琐、数据滞后等痛点，大量人工操作易出错且难以满足企业对实时决策支持的需求。系统旨在将财务工作从重复性劳动转变为高价值决策支持，提升企业财务管理的准确性与效率。
AI.method: 系统融合机器学习、自然语言处理和数据可视化三大核心技术，构建完整的会计智能体（accounting agent），覆盖记账、报表生成和数据分析全流程。通过深度挖掘历史财务数据，识别经营趋势，并提供实时、针对性的洞察用于战略规划、风险防控和经营决策。平台包含架构设计、方法论、关键算法和功能模块。
AI.result: 系统实现了自动化记账、智能化分析和高效合规，显著减少人工操作并最大限度降低了人为错误，能够为企业战略规划、风险防范和经营决策提供实时的、有针对性的洞察，驱动会计职业从记账导向向管理导向转型。
AI.conclusion: AI会计助理系统通过重构会计流程，实现了财务管理的自动化与智能化，已成为企业会计的核心支持工具，推动会计专业从记账职能向管理咨询职能转变。

title: Time- and Space-Efficient List Decoding up to Capacity
summary:
In the theory of error correcting codes, list-decoding refers to the following problem. Given a code $C \subseteq Σ^N$ and a received word $y \in Σ^N$, find all codewords $c \in C$ so that $δ(c,y) \leq ρ$, where $δ$ is relative Hamming distance and $ρ\in (0,1)$. Codes that approach the optimal trade-off between the rate $R := \log_{|Σ|}(|C|) / N$ and the list-decoding radius $ρ$ are said to achieve capacity.By now, there are constructions of capacity-achieving list-decodable codes with fast near-linear-time list-decoding algorithms, but most existing work has not considered space complexity.
  In a recent line of work, Cook and Moshkovitz (2024, 2025, 2026) initiated the study of low-space deterministic algorithms for error correcting codes. In particular, in their 2026 paper, they gave a construction of list-decodable codes with deterministic near-linear-time and sublinear space list-decoding algorithms. However, these codes were far from achieving capacity.
  In this paper, we present list-decodable codes approaching capacity with deterministic time- and space-efficient list-decoding algorithms. More precisely, for any $R \in (0,1)$ and any arbitrarily small constant $τ> 0$, we present a family of codes $C\subseteq Σ^N$ with rate $R$ that are deterministically list-decodable up to radius $ρ= 1 - R - τ$, in time $N^{1 + τ}$ and space $N^τ$ with constant output list size and constant alphabet size. Our results can be extended to capacity-achieving list-recoverable codes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了接近容量（capacity）的列表可解码（list-decodable）纠错码构造，该构造支持确定性近线性时间和次线性空间（时间N^(1+τ)、空间N^τ）的列表解码算法，适用于任意码率R∈(0,1)且解码半径ρ=1-R-τ，输出列表大小和字母表大小均为常数。
AI.motivation: 现有容量可达的列表可解码码虽已有近线性时间解码算法，但大多数工作未考虑空间复杂度。Cook和Moshkovitz近年开启了低空间确定性纠错码的研究，但其2026年的构造虽然实现了确定性近线性时间和亚线性空间解码，却远未达到容量。因此需要一个既能接近容量又具有时间和空间双重效率的构造。
AI.method: 作者提出了一个新的列表可解码码族构造，对于任意R∈(0,1)和任意小常数τ>0，该码族以码率R达到列表解码半径ρ=1-R-τ，并配备了确定性解码算法，时间复杂度为N^(1+τ)，空间复杂度为N^τ，输出列表大小和字母表大小均为常数。
AI.result: 对于任意R∈(0,1)和任意小常数τ>0，构造了码率R的码族，可确定性列表解码至半径ρ=1-R-τ，时间N^(1+τ)、空间N^τ，常数量输出列表和常量字母表。结果还可推广到容量可达的列表可恢复（list-recoverable）码。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次实现了同时接近容量（rate-radius权衡最优）且具备确定性近线性时间与亚线性空间列表解码算法的纠错码构造，填补了该领域在空间复杂度方面的空白，并可进一步扩展到列表可恢复码场景。

title: Maximum-Cost Strategic Facility Location: The Limits of Randomization
summary:
We consider strategic facility location in Euclidean space $\mathbb R^d$, where a mechanism selects a single facility based on the reported locations of $n$ agents and seeks to minimize the maximum distance from any agent to the facility. The optimal approximation ratio of deterministic strategyproof mechanisms is $2$. Whether randomization can yield a universal constant improvement over this factor has remained a major open question. We show that for $d \geq 2$, every strategyproof-in-expectation mechanism has approximation ratio at least \[
  α(\mathcal M) \ge 2 - e^{-Θ(\sqrt d)} - O\left(n^{-2/(d-1)}\right). \] Therefore, no strategyproof-in-expectation mechanism can guarantee a $(2-\varepsilon)$-approximation uniformly over all $n$ and $d$, for any universal constant $\varepsilon>0$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究欧几里得空间中战略性设施选址问题，证明在d≥2维空间中，任何策略防范（期望意义下）机制的近似比至少为2 - e^{-Θ(√d)} - O(n^{-2/(d-1)})，即随机化无法对任意n和d带来普遍的常数改进。
AI.motivation: 确定性策略防范机制的最优近似比为2是已知结果，但随机化能否带来统一的常数改进一直是该领域的重大开放问题。本文旨在解答这一开放问题。
AI.method: 通过构造维度相关的下界分析，利用指数衰减项e^{-Θ(√d)}和关于n的项O(n^{-2/(d-1)})来刻画策略防范期望机制的近似比下界。
AI.result: 证明对任意d≥2，任何策略防范期望机制的近似比至少为2 - e^{-Θ(√d)} - O(n^{-2/(d-1)})，从而排除了对所有n和d一致成立(2-ε)-近似机制的存在性。
AI.conclusion: 随机化策略防范机制无法在所有维度和代理人数上保证对2的普遍常数改进，回答了该领域的一个重要开放问题。

title: Fractional Optimizers Meet Fractal Activation Functions: An Empirical Study of Multi-Scale Optimization in Neural Network
comment: Quite extensive paper, more than 100 pages
summary: Fractional optimization methods and fractal activation functions are two independent directions for improving neural network training. Fractional optimizers extend first-order optimization through fractional derivatives and memory effects, whereas fractal activations introduce multi-scale nonlinear representations based on self-similar Weierstrass- and Blancmange-type functions. Here, we investigate their interaction within a unified experimental framework. We evaluate fractional optimizer families on Ackley and Himmelblau benchmark surfaces, in standard form and with additive Weierstrass-type perturbations, and then in feed-forward neural networks with conventional and fractal activations on ten classification datasets. The comparison includes standard methods, regularization-style optimizers, explicit and adaptive memory-based fractional optimizers, and other representative literature methods. Overall, fractional optimization and fractal activations show useful but selective pairings. Regularization-style fractional scaling performs well with selected fractal activations in network training, while Grünwald--Letnikov memory is most relevant on perturbed surfaces. Adaptive memory improves plain memory substitution in several cases, supporting controlled fractional memory as a promising direction rather than a universal replacement.

AI.tldr: 本文在统一实验框架下研究了分数阶优化方法与分形激活函数两种独立改进神经网络训练策略之间的相互作用。实验覆盖了基准曲面（含Weierstrass扰动）和十组分类数据集的前馈神经网络，发现两者存在有用但选择性的配对关系：正则化式分数阶缩放与特定分形激活函数配合良好，Grünwald-Letnikov记忆在扰动曲面上最有价值，自适应记忆在多数情况下优于普通记忆替换。
AI.motivation: 分数阶优化器和分形激活函数分别从优化算法和网络结构两个方向改进神经网络训练，但此前两者作为独立方向被研究，缺乏对它们交互作用的系统探讨。本文旨在统一框架下揭示二者的协同或冲突关系，明确各自的适用场景。
AI.method: 在Ackley和Himmelblau基准曲面（标准形式与加性Weierstrass扰动）上评估分数阶优化器族，并在十组分类数据集上的前馈神经网络中结合常规与分形激活函数进行对比。比较对象包括标准方法、正则化式优化器、显式与自适应记忆的分数阶优化器，以及其他代表性文献方法。
AI.result: 分数阶优化与分形激活呈现有用的但选择性的配对效果：正则化式分数阶缩放配合特定分形激活在网络训练中表现良好；Grünwald-Letnikov记忆在扰动曲面上最为相关；自适应记忆在多个场景下优于普通记忆替换。
AI.conclusion: 受控的分数阶记忆（特别是自适应形式）是神经网络优化的有前景方向，但不构成对传统方法的普遍替代；其有效性依赖具体任务、曲面特征与激活函数的选择。

title: Automatic or Controlled? Repetition Priming Reveals Divergent Processing in Base LLMs, Instruct LLMs, and Humans
summary: Words recur constantly in natural language use, yet it remains unclear whether language models reactivate prior representations or re-evaluate repeated words afresh, and whether post-training changes this default behavior. We apply repetition priming (Shiffrin and Schneider, 1977) to 15 models across five model families (1.5B-14B parameters) in two tasks, semantic categorization and cloze completion, with matched human experiments using identical stimuli. We find that base models exhibit automatic processing: they show immediate facilitation that remains stable across lags, partially survives context removal, and correlates with attention to prior occurrences. Instruct models exhibit controlled processing: their facilitation decays with lag, collapses without expected context, and reverses to interference at larger scales. Within the Qwen 2.5 family, this dissociation increases monotonically with model scale, suggesting that post-training progressively alters repetition processing. Humans show a hybrid profile, with lag-sensitive facilitation resembling instruct models but without interference, suggesting that neither model type fully captures human cognition. Our findings reveal a qualitative shift in how language models process repeated information after post-training and provide mechanistic evidence for the divergence between model behaviors.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过对15个模型（五个模型家族，1.5B-14B参数）应用重复启动范式，发现基础模型对重复词呈现自动加工（即时易化、跨延迟稳定、与注意力相关），而指令微调模型呈现受控加工（易化随延迟衰减、缺乏上下文时反转干扰）。这种分离在Qwen 2.5家族中随模型规模单调增加，表明后训练逐步改变重复信息处理方式。人类表现出介于两者之间的混合特征。
AI.motivation: 自然语言中词语频繁重复，但语言模型处理重复词时是重新激活先前表征还是重新评估未知，以及后训练是否改变这一默认行为，这些问题尚未明确。理解这一点有助于揭示语言模型内部处理机制与人类认知之间的差异。
AI.method: 采用Shiffrin和Schneider的重复启动范式，在语义分类和完形填空两个任务中测试15个模型（五个家族，1.5B-14B），并使用相同刺激进行匹配的人类对照实验。比较基础模型与指令微调模型在多个时间延迟（lag）下的行为差异，并结合注意力分析。
AI.result: 基础模型表现出自动加工：即时易化在不同延迟下保持稳定，部分在去除上下文后仍存在，且与对先前出现的注意力相关。指令模型表现出受控加工：易化随延迟衰减，缺乏期望上下文时崩溃并转为干扰，且在更大规模时干扰更强。在Qwen 2.5家族中，这一分离随规模单调增长。人类表现出延迟敏感易化（类似指令模型）但无干扰现象。
AI.conclusion: 后训练使语言模型处理重复信息的方式发生质性转变，从自动加工转向受控加工。这种转变随模型规模增大而加剧，但指令微调模型与人类认知仍存在差异（人类的易化不转化为干扰），揭示模型行为与人类认知之间的机制性分歧。

title: DeCo-MIL: Debiased Counterfactual Reasoning for Long-Tailed Whole Slide Image Analysis
summary: Multiple instance learning (MIL) is widely used for weakly supervised whole slide image (WSI) analysis. However, under long-tailed distributions, MIL-based WSI analysis faces a nested dual long-tail: an inter-slide class long tail and an intra-slide long tail of instance-level discriminative evidence. The two long tails are coupled: tail classes have few training slides, while their limited diagnostic evidence is concentrated in a few patches and obscured by abundant within-bag redundancy. This coupling biases models toward head classes and degrades rare-class recognition. To address this, we propose DeCo-MIL for long-tailed WSI analysis, which jointly alleviates the nested dual long-tail through frequency-debiased counterfactual reasoning. For the inner long tail, DeCo-MIL clusters patches into tissue-morphology anchors, replaces each anchor with its matched normal prototype to perform a counterfactual intervention, and estimates its counterfactual contribution to the ground-truth class using class-frequency-corrected predictions. These contributions guide redundancy masking to preserve scarce discriminative instances. For the outer long tail, DeCo-MIL constructs anchor-stratified pseudo-bags from redundancy-reduced bags and combines tail-aware oversampling with consistency regularization, increasing effective supervision for tail classes while preserving tissue-morphology composition. Extensive experiments on three long-tailed WSI benchmarks demonstrate that DeCo-MIL achieves state-of-the-art performance in both tail-class recognition and overall classification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeCo-MIL框架，通过频率去偏的反事实推理联合缓解长尾WSI分析中的嵌套双重长尾问题（类间长尾与实例级判别证据的类内长尾），在三个长尾WSI基准上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 多实例学习（MIL）在弱监督全切片图像（WSI）分析中被广泛使用，但在长尾分布下存在嵌套的双重长尾问题：切片间类别长尾与切片内实例级判别证据长尾。这两者耦合在一起——尾类训练切片少，且其有限的判别证据集中在少数补丁中并被袋内冗余掩盖，导致模型偏向头类、尾类识别性能退化。
AI.method: DeCo-MIL通过频率去偏的反事实推理联合缓解嵌套双重长尾。对于内层长尾：将补丁聚类为组织形态锚点，用匹配的正常原型替换每个锚点进行反事实干预，利用类别频率校正的预测估计其反事实贡献，据此进行冗余掩码以保留稀缺判别实例。对于外层长尾：由冗余减少的袋构造锚点分层的伪袋，结合尾类感知过采样与一致性正则化，增加尾类有效监督同时保持组织形态组成。
AI.result: 在三个长尾WSI基准上的大量实验表明，DeCo-MIL在尾类识别和整体分类方面均达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: DeCo-MIL通过反事实推理和频率去偏策略，有效解耦并缓解了嵌套双重长尾问题，为长尾WSI分析提供了新的解决方案。

title: Position: Certified Correctness in Neural Constraint Reasoning Requires Symbolic Integration
summary: Neural solvers for constraint satisfaction problems have achieved remarkable in-distribution accuracy, yet they suffer from a fundamental limitation persistent constraint violations occur under distribution shifts even when the model reports high confidence. This position paper argues that when hard constraints exist and the cost of verification is relatively low, neural constraint reasoning must prioritize symbolic integration over pure learning. We justify our focus on Sudoku as a representative NP-complete testbed because it exhibits a sharp asymmetry between easy verification and hard solving: checking a candidate solution requires only polynomial time $O(n^{2})$, while finding a solution may require exponential search. Through a comprehensive survey of solving methods spanning deterministic algorithms, metaheuristic optimization, learning-based approaches, and language-conditioned reasoning, we demonstrate that neural-only methods without instance-level certification fail to achieve the provable correctness that symbolic and neuro-symbolic approaches provide. We advocate for a bidirectional integration in which neural methods enhance symbolic solvers by learning heuristics and converting percepts into symbols, while symbolic methods verify neural outputs to ensure their reliability. To operationalize this position, we propose a multi-agent certified reasoning framework that demonstrates how this integration can achieve both computational efficiency and provable correctness.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文，主张在存在硬约束且验证成本较低的场景下，神经约束求解必须优先考虑符号集成而非纯学习。以数独为代表性测试平台，通过全面调研论证神经-符号双向集成框架（多智能体认证推理）是同时实现计算效率和可证明正确性的关键。
AI.motivation: 神经求解器在分布内数据上表现优异，但在分布偏移下即使模型输出高置信度仍会出现持续性的约束违例。这种缺乏可证明正确性的根本局限促使作者论证：当硬约束存在且验证成本相对低廉时，纯学习方法不足以胜任约束满足问题，必须引入符号集成。
AI.method: 选取数独作为代表性NP完全测试平台（利用其验证易、求解难的对称性），对确定性算法、元启发式优化、学习方法及语言条件推理等求解方法进行全面调研和对比分析；在此基础上提出一个多智能体认证推理框架，实现神经方法与符号方法的双向集成——神经方法通过学习启发式并转化感知为符号来增强符号求解器，符号方法则验证神经输出以确保可靠性。
AI.result: 调研表明，缺乏实例级认证的纯神经方法无法提供符号和神经-符号方法所能实现的可证明正确性；所提出的多智能体认证推理框架能够同时兼顾计算效率与可证明正确性。
AI.conclusion: 当硬约束存在且验证成本低于求解成本时，神经约束推理应转向神经-符号双向集成范式：神经方法提升符号求解器的启发式能力，符号方法为神经输出提供实例级认证与可靠性保障，从而在高效计算与形式化正确性之间取得平衡。

title: Historical Backtesting for Scientific Question Discovery: A Protocol and Astronomy Pilot
comment: 27 pages, 10 tables. Benchmark, code, frozen instances, and the prospective 2026 submission: https://github.com/nonameisready/scientific-question-discovery-benchmark
summary: Systems that generate scientific research questions are evaluated today by expert scores, LLM-as-judge ratings, or curated case studies -- all subjective, none falsifiable. We formalize historical backtesting as an alternative: a system generates questions from a corpus frozen at a historical cutoff, the questions are frozen before any access to later literature, and a temporally isolated future corpus then determines whether each question was subsequently answered, partially addressed, independently posed, or ignored, and whether its underlying premise was supported or refuted. The protocol is model-agnostic: any system that emits frozen questions can be scored. We release reproducible astronomy instances with temporally isolated corpora, frozen questions, auditable labels, four reference baselines, and a submission interface. Two findings result. First, evidence-structure-first generation outperforms LLM-only prompting: across a generator decomposition crossed with a four-cutoff stress test (2010-2024, 798 judged questions) whose last window postdates model training, LLM-only generation shows memorized relevance without specific foresight, while a generator using no model weights at all finds questions whose premises the future refutes in every era. Second, a seven-rater agreement study (two blinded human annotators, five judge models, 90 items) indicts the outcome taxonomy rather than the judge: two careful humans agree at kappa = 0.17, every judge model agrees with the professional annotator as well or better (0.17-0.26), and frontier models agree with one another at 0.60 -- certifying an LLM judge by model-model agreement would have overstated its reliability threefold. A prospective instance -- 200 questions frozen 2026-08-17, scored 2027-2030 -- is released so the central claims become contamination-free tests that time itself will grade.

AI.tldr: 本文提出历史回测协议来客观评估研究问题生成系统：从冻结的历史时间点语料生成问题，再由时间隔离的未来语料评判问题是否被回答、部分解决或独立提出，以及前提是否被证实或推翻。通过2010-2024年四个时间切点的798个评判问题发现：基于证据结构优先的生成方法优于纯LLM提示生成（后者表现出记忆性相关而非真正的预见性），同时七位评分者一致性研究揭示现有结果分类法本身存在严重标签不可靠问题（两位人类标注者kappa仅0.17），作者因此发布前瞻性基准实例（2026年冻结200个问题，2027-2030年评分）以消除测试污染，让时间本身成为最终裁判。
AI.motivation: 现有研究问题生成系统的评估依赖专家打分、LLM评判或案例研究，这些方法均为主观且不可证伪。作者旨在建立一种客观、可审计、可复现的评估协议，使系统评估脱离主观判断，并为科学问题生成提供可证伪性检验的替代方案。
AI.method: 采用历史回测协议：系统从历史时间截止点冻结的语料生成问题，所有问题在任何后续文献接触前冻结，随后用时间隔离的未来语料评判每个问题是否被回答、部分解决、独立提出或被忽视，以及其前提是否被支持或推翻。该协议与模型无关，任何输出冻结问题的系统均可评分。作者构建了可复现的天文学实例，包含时间隔离语料、冻结问题、可审计标签、四个参考基线及提交接口。实验设计了生成器分解与四切点压力测试（2010-2024），以及七评分者一致性研究（两位盲审人类标注者、五个评判模型、90个项目）。
AI.result: 两项关键发现：(1) 证据结构优先生成方法优于纯LLM提示：LLM-only生成表现出记忆性相关性但缺乏具体预见力，而不使用任何模型权重的生成器产生的问题在每一时代都会被未来证伪前提。(2) 七评分者一致性研究揭示结果分类法本身存在缺陷：两位仔细的人类标注者kappa仅0.17，所有评判模型与专业标注者一致性在0.17-0.26之间，而前沿模型彼此一致性达0.60——若仅依据模型间一致性认证LLM评判者，可靠性会被高估三倍。作者另发布前瞻性实例（2026-08-17冻结的200个问题，2027-2030评分）。
AI.conclusion: 历史回测为研究问题生成系统提供了可证伪的客观评估框架，但现有结果分类法不足以支撑可靠评估，需要改进标注体系。作者发布前瞻性基准实例以确保核心主张成为无污染测试，最终由时间本身（2027-2030年的未来文献）评判系统性结论。

title: Adaptive Unequal Error Protection for Semantic Split Learning over Wireless Channels
comment: Accepted for publication at IEEE Communications Letters
summary: We propose a task-aware semantic split learning (SL) framework for wireless edge-cloud inference, in which the reliability of transmitted latent representations is dynamically adapted to their relevance for the downstream task. An autoencoder (AE)-based physical (PHY) layer enables end-to-end learning of the communication interface, while unequal error protection (UEP) is realized via mutual information (MI)-driven prioritization of latent components during training. The gradient of the estimated MI with respect to each latent component serves as a sensitivity-based proxy for task relevance, providing a fully learning-driven prioritization that adapts to both the data distribution and the downstream task. We further show that this prioritization translates into measurable physical-layer effects: MI-guided UEP assigns significantly higher transmit power to the most task-critical latent components compared to the equal error protection (EEP) baseline. Experiments on real-world IoT sensing data demonstrate consistent gains over equal and fixed-UEP baselines across SNR regimes. Additional analysis confirms ranking stability, estimator robustness and generalization across datasets and task types, indicating broad applicability of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向无线边缘云推理的任务感知语义分割学习（SL）框架，通过互信息（MI）驱动的非等差错保护（UEP）机制，在训练过程中自动调整不同潜变量的传输可靠性优先级，从而提升无线推理性能。
AI.motivation: 在无线边缘云推理场景中，传统分割学习（SL）对传输的潜表征施加均等差错保护（EEP），无法针对下游任务动态调整可靠性。现有固定UEP方案也缺乏任务感知性，无法适应数据分布和具体任务的差异，导致传输资源浪费或关键信息受损。
AI.method: 构建基于自编码器（AE）的物理层实现端到端通信学习；通过估计潜变量各分量与下游任务之间的互信息（MI），并利用MI对每个潜分量的梯度作为任务相关性的敏感度代理；在训练过程中据此实现MI驱动的UEP，为关键潜分量分配更高的发射功率。
AI.result: 在真实IoT感知数据上的实验表明，所提方案相比均等差错保护（EEP）和固定UEP基线，在不同信噪比区间均取得一致性能增益；MI引导的UEP为最关键的潜分量分配了显著更高的发射功率；排名稳定性、估计器鲁棒性以及跨数据集和任务类型的泛化性能均得到验证。
AI.conclusion: MI驱动的UEP能够将任务相关性度量有效转化为物理层功率分配，实现完全学习驱动的自适应优先级排序，具备跨场景广泛适用性，为无线边缘云推理中的语义通信提供了一个通用且鲁棒的框架。

title: Witness-Certified Fair Division with Comparison Queries
summary: We study fair division of indivisible goods when agents' valuations are accessed only through ordinal comparisons between bundles, with arbitrary tie-breaking. In this model, even deciding whether a given allocation is envy-free up to one good (EF1) can be impossible. This suggests explicit fairness certificates as a natural algorithmic object. Our main contribution is a certificate-preserving scaling framework, which recursively contracts goods, solves a smaller instance, and expands the solution while repairing an explicit envy-eliminating witness certificate. For arbitrary identical monotone valuations, this yields a certified EF1 allocation for $n$ agents and $m$ goods using $O(n \log n \log(m/n))$ comparison queries, within an $O(\log n)$ factor of the $Ω(n \log (m/n))$ communication lower bound. For identical additive valuations, we additionally obtain a $1/2$-MMS guarantee within the same query complexity. For non-identical additive valuations, exploiting our EF1+$1/2$-MMS algorithm, we accelerate the existing matching-based PROP1+$1/2$-MMS framework, improving the query complexity from $O(n^4\log m)$ to $O(n^3\log m)$. Finally, we study the structure of such certificates through $k$-witness EF1, a hierarchy between EF1 and EFX.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了仅通过序数比较（而非基数价值）访问agent偏好的不可分割物品公平分配问题，提出了一个证书保留（certificate-preserving）的缩放框架，能够在任意相同的单调估值下以O(n log n log(m/n))次比较查询构造经过认证的EF1分配，并扩展到1/2-MMS保证、PROP1+1/2-MMS优化以及k-witness EF1层次结构。
AI.motivation: 在公平分配不可分割物品的研究中，当agent的估值只能通过序数比较（bundles之间的比较）来获取且允许任意打破平局时，即使判断一个给定分配是否为EF1也可能无法实现。这促使研究者将显式公平证书（explicit fairness certificates）作为自然的算法对象，以在不确定性下提供可验证的公平性保证。
AI.method: 核心方法是提出一个证书保留的缩放框架：通过递归地收缩物品（contracts goods）、求解更小的实例、再展开解并修复显式的消除嫉妒的见证证书（envy-eliminating witness certificate）。针对不同场景分别设计算法：任意相同单调估值下的certified EF1、相同可加估值下的1/2-MMS保证、非相同可加估值下利用EF1+1/2-MMS算法加速现有的基于匹配的PROP1+1/2-MMS框架，以及引入k-witness EF1作为介于EF1和EFX之间的层级结构。
AI.result: 对于任意相同的单调估值，在n个agent和m个物品下以O(n log n log(m/n))次比较查询实现certified EF1分配，与Ω(n log(m/n))的通信下界相差O(log n)因子。对于相同可加估值，在相同查询复杂度内额外获得1/2-MMS保证。对于非相同可加估值，将PROP1+1/2-MMS的查询复杂度从O(n^4 log m)改进为O(n^3 log m)。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过证书保留缩放框架为序数比较模型下的公平分配提供了系统性的算法工具，在查询复杂度上接近通信下界，同时将EF1、MMS、PROP1等经典公平性概念统一在一个可验证的证书框架内，并通过k-witness EF1揭示了EF1与EFX之间更深层的结构性联系。

title: Early Cycle Charge Trajectory Generative Prediction and Full Life Cycle Health Management of Iron-Chromium Flow Batteries Based on FlowBD-E1
summary: Long-duration stationary energy storage requires batteries whose degradation can be detected before substantial capacity loss has accumulated. Iron-chromium redox flow batteries are attractive for this role because they use abundant and low-cost active species, yet their operation is shaped by slow chromium kinetics, hydrogen evolution, membrane crossover and electrolyte imbalance. These coupled processes gradually reshape the full charge voltage/current (V/I) trajectory, but most battery prognostic studies either focus on lithium-ion cells or compress ageing into scalar capacity and state-of-health (SOH) labels. Here we study an industrial 33 kW Fe-Cr redox flow battery and introduce FlowBD-E1, an early-cycle generative forecasting framework that predicts complete future charge V/I trajectories from only the first few cycles. The model combines a multi-scale convolutional encoder, a lifecycle Transformer and an age-aware FiLM decoder, and we compare three deployment strategies: single-step latent extrapolation (SLE), recursive latent forecasting (RLF) and teacher-forced updating (TFU). Using the first 9 of 289 cycles, RLF achieved a joint V/I mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 0.731% over the remaining lifecycle and produced SOH estimates below 1% MAPE. Ablation and independent-sequence tests showed that the age-aware generative architecture outperformed LSTM and TCN baselines and retained sub-percent errors under industrial validation. These results suggest that early-cycle trajectory generation can turn a short commissioning record into a long-horizon diagnostic signal for flow-battery management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FlowBD-E1，一种早期循环生成式预测框架，仅用前9个循环即可预测工业33 kW铁铬液流电池未来289个循环的完整充电V/I轨迹。该模型结合多尺度卷积编码器、生命周期Transformer和年龄感知FiLM解码器，在联合V/I平均绝对百分比误差(MAPE)为0.731%的同时，SOH估计误差低于1%。
AI.motivation: 长时间储能电池需要在容量大量损失前检测到退化迹象。铁铬液流电池虽然使用丰富且低成本的活性物质，但其运行受缓慢的铬动力学、析氢、膜交叉污染和电解液失衡等耦合过程影响，这些过程会逐渐重塑充电V/I轨迹。现有电池预测研究多聚焦于锂离子电池或仅将老化压缩为标量容量和SOH标签，缺乏利用完整轨迹进行早期预测的方法。
AI.method: 提出FlowBD-E1框架，由三部分组成：(1)多尺度卷积编码器提取轨迹特征；(2)生命周期Transformer建模时间序列依赖；(3)年龄感知FiLM(特征级线性调制)解码器生成未来轨迹。同时比较三种部署策略：单步潜在外推(SLE)、递归潜在预测(RLF)和教师强制更新(TFU)，其中RLF效果最优。基于前9个循环(共289个循环)进行预测。
AI.result: 使用前9个循环，RLF策略在剩余生命周期上取得联合V/I MAPE为0.731%，SOH估计的MAPE低于1%。消融实验和独立序列测试表明，年龄感知生成式架构优于LSTM和TCN基线，在工业验证下保持亚百分比误差。
AI.conclusion: 早期循环轨迹生成可以将短暂的调试/启动记录转化为长时程的流电池管理诊断信号，为铁铬液流电池的长时程健康管理提供了新的可行性路径。FlowBD-E1证明了仅用极少早期数据即可高质量预测完整生命周期V/I演化。

title: Domain Agnostic Text Redaction from Natural Language Rules using Instruction Tuning
summary: With the increasing digitization of personal and corporate communication, the automatic sanitization of textual data has become a crucial component of data privacy and compliance frameworks. Traditional text sanitization solutions are majorly suitable for obscuring sensitive data with standard structure such as Personal Identifiable Information (PII). These solutions do not provide transparent justification for their redaction, which makes it difficult to audit them. This paper introduces an explainable, domain-agnostic text redaction solution that uses natural language rules of redaction, applied via an instruction-tuned language model, to identify and redact sensitive information in unstructured documents. Unlike traditional text sanitization, this method enables a user to conveniently define any sensitive information; which may be structured (e.g.\ PII) or unstructured (e.g.\ legal terms and conditions) in natural language. A general-purpose LLM generates or augments these natural language rules of redaction from the user's definition, which are then used to instruction-fine-tune a smaller language model that reasons the rules step-by-step over any given document to identify and redact the corresponding sensitive content, while providing transparent justifications for each redaction and highlighting the specific rule that triggered the decision. This explanation is generated in natural language to support human reviewers and auditors in understanding why specific content was redacted. A reconstruction-based metric is used to estimate the probability of recovering redacted information from the sanitized document, quantifying redaction coverage. The solution shows high reconstruction error and high redaction precision, making it suitable for automated text sanitization in critical applications such as legal discovery, medical documentation, and corporate information governance.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种可解释、领域无关的文本脱敏解决方案，利用自然语言规则通过指令微调的语言模型识别和删除非结构化文档中的敏感信息，并提供透明的脱敏理由。
AI.motivation: 传统文本脱敏方案主要适用于遮蔽结构化的个人信息（PII），无法灵活定义非结构化敏感信息，且缺乏透明的脱敏依据，导致审计困难。
AI.method: 使用通用大语言模型（LLM）从用户定义中生成或扩充自然语言脱敏规则，然后用这些规则指令微调一个较小的语言模型，使其逐步推理并识别文档中的敏感内容进行脱敏，同时提供自然语言解释和触发规则说明。采用基于重建的指标评估脱敏覆盖度。
AI.result: 该方案实现了高重建误差（即脱敏后的信息难以恢复）和高脱敏精度，适用于法律发现、医疗文档和企业信息治理等关键场景的自动化文本脱敏。
AI.conclusion: 该可解释、领域无关的文本脱敏方法弥补了传统方案在灵活性和可审计性方面的不足，为自动化文本净化提供了可行的解决方案。

title: AeroGround: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Aerial-Ground Collaborative Reasoning
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have been widely employed in understanding and reasoning tasks for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). Existing UAV benchmarks primarily focus on aerial-view scenarios. However, whether current VLMs can perform well on understanding and reasoning tasks in aerial-ground collaborative scenarios which are practical in real-world applications like rescue and infrastructure inspection remains underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce AeroGround, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating VLMs in aerial-ground collaborative reasoning. AeroGround is built upon a simulated aerial-ground dataset containing approximately 29,000 multimodal observation groups from diverse open environments, and provides 2,250 high-quality question-answering instances covering cross-view correspondence, spatial understanding, and reasoning. Experiments on 16 pretrained VLMs, together with two domain-adapted variants, reveal a substantial gap between current models and human performance: the best model achieves an average accuracy of 54.4%, whereas humans reach 93.3%. By systematically revealing the strengths and limitations of existing models in aerial-ground collaborative reasoning, AeroGround provides a foundation for developing more capable aerial-ground collaborative embodied intelligence systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AeroGround，一个用于评估视觉语言模型（VLMs）在空地协同推理能力的综合基准。该基准基于模拟的空地数据集，包含约29,000个多模态观测组和2,250个高质量问答实例，覆盖跨视角对应、空间理解和推理三个任务。实验表明，16个预训练VLM及2个领域自适应变体的最佳平均准确率仅为54.4%，远低于人类的93.3%，揭示了当前模型在空地协同场景中的显著差距。
AI.motivation: 现有无人机（UAV）基准主要聚焦于纯空中视角场景，但空地协同场景（如救援、基础设施巡检等实际应用）中VLM的理解与推理能力尚未被充分探索。为填补这一研究空白，作者构建了AeroGround这一专门的评估基准。
AI.method: AeroGround基于模拟空地数据集构建，包含约29,000个来自多种开放环境的多模态观测组，并提供2,250个高质量问答实例，涵盖跨视角对应（cross-view correspondence）、空间理解（spatial understanding）和推理（reasoning）三大类任务。研究对16个预训练VLM及2个领域自适应变体进行了系统评估。
AI.result: 最佳VLM的平均准确率为54.4%，而人类表现达到93.3%，两者之间存在显著差距。实验系统性地揭示了现有模型在空地协同推理中的优势与局限性。
AI.conclusion: AeroGround基准填补了空地协同场景下VLM评估的空白，为开发更强大的空地协同具身智能系统提供了基础支撑。

title: Position: Want Better ML Reviews? Stop Asking Nicely and Start Incentivizing with a Credit System
summary: With soaring submission counts, stricter reciprocal review policies, widespread adoption of platforms like OpenReview, and without the offsetting pressure of publication fees, the machine learning (ML) community has one of the largest scholarly presences among all scientific fields. And yet, \textbf{almost \textit{everyone} has \textit{many} unpleasant things to share about their review experience.} Worse, there is little public space to seriously discuss, let alone debate, what makes a review system effective or how it might be improved.\quad In this position paper, we expand our discussion from two core problems: \textit{How can we reasonably limit submission volume?} and \textit{How can we incentivize good and discourage bad reviewing?} We first assess the strengths and shortcomings of existing attempts to address such problems. Specifically, we present four takes on some popular conference mechanisms and propose two alternative designs for improvement.\quad Our general position is that meaningful improvement in ML peer review won't come from polite best-practice suggestions tucked into Calls for Papers or Reviewer Guidelines: it requires \textbf{enforceable yet fine-grained procedural safeguards} paired with \textbf{a currency-like credit system (e.g., our proposed \textit{OpenReview Points})}. ML practitioners can ``earn'' such points by contributing good review practices, and ``spend'' them across one or multiple major conferences to redeem different kinds of ``perks,'' such as complimentary registration or the right to request additional review resources.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文，针对机器学习社区同行评审体系中的核心困境（投稿量激增、评审质量下滑等），提出需要从"温和建议"转向"可执行的程序性保障+类货币信用积分系统"的改进方案。
AI.motivation: 机器学习领域的投稿量持续攀升、互审政策趋严、OpenReview等平台广泛应用，但几乎所有人都有不愉快的评审体验，且缺乏公开严肃讨论评审体系有效性的空间。作者希望填补这一空白，系统讨论如何限制投稿量以及如何激励好的评审、抑制差的评审。
AI.method: 作者以立场论文形式，首先界定两个核心问题（限制投稿量、激励/抑制评审行为），然后评估现有流行会议机制的优势与不足（提出四种观点），最后提出两种替代设计方案，核心是"可执行的精细化程序保障"配合"类货币信用积分系统（OpenReview Points）"，允许ML从业者通过良好评审行为赚取积分并在多个会议间消费以兑换福利。
AI.result: 该论文提出了OpenReview Points这一类货币信用积分系统的具体设计构想，将评审贡献与可兑换福利挂钩，形成跨会议的激励闭环；同时强调程序性保障而非仅靠道德呼吁。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为ML同行评审的有意义改进不会来自论文征集或评审指南中的礼貌性最佳实践建议，而必须依赖可执行的程序性保障与类货币信用体系相结合的系统性变革。

title: Maximal correlation under cardinality constraints
summary: In this paper, we define and analyze the quantized maximal correlation, an extension of the notion of maximal correlation restricted to functions taking values in sets of bounded cardinality. We derive an upper bound on the quantized maximal correlation by showing that the correlation between any quantized functions of $X$ and $Y$ is related to the MMSE distortion in quantization of a particular linear combination of random variables. Following this, we leverage rate-distortion techniques and anti-concentration inequalities to further bound this MMSE, which results in explicit bounds on the quantized maximal correlation. Unlike the quantized maximal correlation itself, which does not generally tensorize, our bounds on the mean squared error do tensorize, resulting in a dimension-free upper bound on the quantized maximal correlation for product distributions. Our results also lead to improved bounds on the isoperimetric constants of reversible Markov chains and product chains, strengthening classical results such as those by Alon and Milman.

AI.tldr: 本文定义了量化最大相关（quantized maximal correlation），并通过对MMSE失真的界分析，推导出量化最大相关的显式上界；该界可张量化，从而为乘积分布提供无维数上界，并改进了可逆马尔可夫链与乘积链的等周常数界。
AI.motivation: 已有最大相关的概念在取值无界时难以直接应用于离散或量化场景，需要引入取值受限（有界基数）的量化函数版本，并分析其性质与可操作性边界。
AI.method: 首先证明量化函数的相关性与特定随机变量线性组合的MMSE量化失真相关；随后利用率失真理论与反集中不等式进一步约束MMSE，得到显式上界；由于MMSE界的可张量化特性，进一步获得乘积分布下与维数无关的量化最大相关上界。
AI.result: 得到了量化最大相关的显式上界；该界在乘积分布下可张量化且与维数无关；并改进了Alon和Milman关于可逆马尔可夫链及其乘积链的等周常数经典结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过MMSE与率失真方法，量化最大相关的上界得以有效地刻画，其可张量化性质为高维场景提供了简洁且强化的理论工具。

title: On the Incompatibility of Weighted PROPX and Pareto Optimality for Indivisible Chores
summary: Proportionality (PROP) is one of the simplest fairness criteria for allocating items among agents with additive preferences. With indivisible chores, however, PROP is not always satisfiable. We study proportionality up to any item (PROPX), which requires every agent to satisfy proportionality after any chore is removed from her bundle. Under strictly positive costs, we settle the weighted compatibility question negatively: weighted PROPX and Pareto optimality are incompatible already for two agents and four chores. Moreover, for every $n\geq3$, we give an $n$-agent, $(n+1)$-chore counterexample whose shares can be arbitrarily close to equal. These counterexamples are item-minimal: under strictly positive costs, weighted PROPX and Pareto optimality are always compatible when the number of chores is at most the number of agents, and they are compatible for two agents with at most three chores. Our impossibility result contrasts with the compatibility theorem of Mahara (2026) for weighted envy-freeness up to one item (EF1) and Pareto optimality .

AI.tldr: 本文研究不可分割家务分配中的比例公平性（PROPX）与帕累托最优的兼容性问题。在严格正成本下，证明了加权PROPX与帕累托最优不兼容（即使在两个代理四件家务的极小情况下），并给出了n代理n+1件家务的反例，同时证明了当家务数量不超过代理数量时两者总是兼容的。
AI.motivation: 比例性（PROP）是加性偏好下物品分配中最简单的公平准则之一，但对于不可分割的家务，PROP并不总是可满足的。因此需要研究放宽的PROPX准则，特别是其与效率（帕累托最优）的兼容性问题，这在公平分配理论中是核心问题。
AI.method: 通过构造性的反例证明加权PROPX与帕累托最优的不兼容性：首先给出两个代理四件家务的最小反例，然后推广到n个代理n+1件家务的更一般反例（份额可任意接近相等）。同时通过构造性证明，表明在严格正成本下，当家务数量不超过代理数量时，加权PROPX与帕累托最优总是兼容的。
AI.result: 在严格正成本下，加权PROPX与帕累托最优不兼容，即使对于两个代理和四件家务也是如此；对每个n≥3，构造了n代理n+1件家务的反例，其份额可任意接近均等。这些反例在物品数量上是最小的：家务数不超过代理数时两者总是兼容，两代理情况下最多三件家务时也兼容。
AI.conclusion: 加权PROPX与帕累托最优在严格正成本下本质上不兼容，这与Mahara（2026）关于加权EF1与帕累托最优兼容的结论形成鲜明对比，表明即使在相似的公理化框架下，不同公平准则与效率的兼容性也可能截然不同。

title: Randomly initialized autoencoders: fixed points and edge-of-chaos
summary:
In this paper we study autoencoders, a special class of deep neural nets (DNNs) whose performance can be characterized via their fixed points. This perspective naturally raises questions of existence, stability, and basins of attraction of these fixed points. These questions are addressed via the contractive properties of autoencoders, and are closely related to the notion of edge-of-chaos.
  Edge-of-chaos (EoC) is an important notion in the theory of DNNs. It describes the critical regime separating ordered and chaotic signal propagation through a randomly initialized network. Initialization at or near this critical regime offers several theoretical and practical advantages, including stability of the network w.r.t. perturbations of the input. EoC was previously introduced for broad classes of neural networks using mean-field averaging methods. In this paper we modify the notion of EoC for the study of autoencoders. Specifically, we introduce local and global EoC for autoencoders that control local (small) and global (arbitrary) perturbations of the input respectively.
  The study of stability of autoencoders falls within the scope of nonlinear problems in Random Matrix Theory (RMT). Our analysis of local EoC is based on spectral techniques of RMT, whereas global EoC is studied by employing Sudakov-Fernique inequality for Gaussian processes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了自编码器的固定点及其稳定性，通过收缩性质和边缘混沌（EoC）概念来刻画其动力学行为，并分别利用随机矩阵理论（RMT）的谱方法和Sudakov-Fernique不等式来分析局部与全局EoC。
AI.motivation: 自编码器是一类特殊的深度神经网络，其性能可通过固定点来表征。然而，关于这些固定点的存在性、稳定性及吸引域的问题尚未得到充分研究。这些性质与边缘混沌概念密切相关，而边缘混沌此前仅针对一般神经网络通过均值场方法引入，尚未针对自编码器进行专门定义和分析。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 本文从自编码器的收缩属性出发，将边缘混沌概念修改并引入到自编码器研究中，提出了局部边缘混沌（控制输入的小扰动）和全局边缘混沌（控制输入的任意扰动）。局部EoC的分析基于随机矩阵理论中的谱技术，而全局EoC的分析则利用Sudakov-Fernique不等式来处理高斯过程。
AI.result: 研究揭示了自编码器固定点的存在性、稳定性与收缩属性之间的内在联系，建立了局部和全局边缘混沌的判定条件，为自编码器在临界初始状态下的稳定性提供了理论保证。
AI.conclusion: 本文将边缘混沌概念成功推广至自编码器，通过随机矩阵理论和高斯过程不等式分别建立了局部与全局稳定性的分析框架，为理解自编码器的动力学行为及其在临界初始化下的优势提供了理论基础。

title: Which Question Is Your Attention Metric Answering? Attention Rows as Compositional Data
summary: Each row of a transformer's attention matrix is a probability distribution over tokens, and in trained models most of that probability lands on a single \emph{sink} token, usually the first. Standard tools for comparing attention rows (cosine similarity, Jensen--Shannon divergence, Shannon entropy) therefore hinge on a choice papers rarely report: keep the sink, or drop it and renormalize. This choice can reverse conclusions. On ten pretrained models from five families, 17--47% of verdicts about which of two heads is more similar flip with the convention, and the most prominent structure in a standard BERT head-clustering pipeline is an artifact of it. The reason is that one-number summaries mix two questions: how much attention the sink takes, and how the rest is divided among the content tokens. Treating rows as compositional data separates them exactly: the Aitchison distance splits orthogonally into a sink term and a content term, entropy splits by an exact identity, and the content distance is characterized by invariances the transformer itself possesses. The separation matters in practice: most measured entropy collapse during training is the sink growing, not attention sharpening (30% of the drop at 70M parameters, 95% at 1B, 79% at 1.4B), and pruning heads with the wrong channel can inflate perplexity more than a hundredfold. We map where each convention is safe, test a frozen out-of-sample predictor (one confirmation, one abstention, one failure), and release code regenerating every number.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示Transformer注意力矩阵分析中一个被忽视但影响深远的实践选择——是否保留或丢弃sink token并重新归一化——会显著改变甚至逆转关于注意力头相似性、熵坍缩和剪枝的结论。作者将注意力行视为成分数据（compositional data），使用Aitchison距离将其正交分解为sink项和内容项，并在十个预训练模型上验证了这一分解的必要性和实用性。
AI.motivation: 标准工具（余弦相似度、JS散度、Shannon熵）在比较注意力行时依赖于一个通常不报告的预处理选择：是保留sink token还是丢弃后重新归一化。这个看似随意的选择可以逆转结论（17-47%的头相似性判定翻转），且标准BERT头聚类的显著结构实际上是该选择的人为产物。现有方法无法区分两个根本不同的问题：sink吸收了多大注意力，以及剩余注意力如何在内容token之间分配。
AI.method: 将每个注意力行视为成分数据（compositional data），利用Aitchison距离将其正交分解为独立的sink项和内容项，熵则通过精确恒等式进行分离。在十个来自五个家族的预训练模型上系统比较不同约定下的结论，并在训练过程中追踪熵坍缩的来源，同时测试不同通道对剪枝效果的影响。
AI.result: 在十个预训练模型上，17-47%的注意力头相似性判定会因该约定而翻转；标准BERT头聚类中最显著的结构是该约定的伪影。训练中熵坍缩的大部分实际上来自sink的增长而非注意力锐化：70M参数时占30%，1B时占95%，1.4B时占79%。使用错误通道进行剪枝可使困惑度膨胀超过百倍。
AI.conclusion: 处理注意力行时必须明确指定sink的处理约定，且最好将其视为成分数据并分离出sink项与内容项，才能获得有意义的分析结果。作者给出了各约定何时安全的映射，并通过冻结的样本外预测器进行了验证（一次确认、一次弃权、一次失败），同时开源了可复现所有数字的代码。

title: Braided Vision Transformer for Stroke Detection in Multi-view Retinal Fundus Imaging
summary: Stroke remains a leading cause of mortality and morbidity worldwide, emphasizing the importance of its accurate and immediate assessment. Retinal fundus imaging has emerged as a promising modality for stroke assessment, as the retina reflects cerebrovascular and neurological risk factors. Contrary to conventional neuroimaging techniques, retinal fundus imaging offers a non-invasive, cost-effective, and portable alternative for rapid screening. This paper explores the feasibility of retinal fundus imaging for stroke and transient ischemic attack (TIA) detection using macula-centric and optic nerve head-centric views captured from both eyes. Our study introduces, to the best of our knowledge, the first vision transformer model for retinal fundus imaging in stroke assessment, offering a novel approach for capturing retinal patterns. Thereby, we propose the Braided Vision Transformer (BViT) model, which extracts representative features from the given multi-view images while simultaneously capturing inter-view relationships across both eyes, enabling a more informative understanding of retinal biomarkers associated with cerebrovascular events. Experiments conducted on our collected Stroke-Data dataset demonstrate that BViT achieves an AUC score of 0.75 for stroke detection, outperforming regular vision transformers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于视网膜眼底影像的卒中及短暂性脑缺血发作检测方法，首次将视觉 Transformer 应用于该领域，并提出 Braided Vision Transformer (BViT) 模型，通过多视角（黄斑中心视图和视神经乳头中心视图）及双眼图像捕捉跨视角关系，在自建 Stroke-Data 数据集上取得0.75的AUC，优于常规视觉 Transformer。
AI.motivation: 卒中仍是全球致死致残的主要原因之一，需要快速准确的评估手段。传统神经影像技术虽准确但成本高、不便于便携筛查。视网膜眼底影像作为一种非侵入性、经济、便携的替代方案，能够反映脑血管及神经风险因素，因此探索其用于卒中检测的可行性具有重要临床意义。
AI.method: 该研究构建了首个用于卒中评估的视网膜眼底影像视觉 Transformer 模型，即 Braided Vision Transformer (BViT)。该模型从双眼的多视角图像（黄斑中心视图和视神经乳头中心视图）中提取代表性特征，同时捕捉双眼之间及多视角之间的相互关系，从而更全面地理解与脑血管事件相关的视网膜生物标志物。实验基于自建的 Stroke-Data 数据集进行验证。
AI.result: 在自建 Stroke-Data 数据集上的实验表明，BViT 模型在卒中检测任务上取得了0.75的AUC分数，性能优于常规视觉 Transformer 模型。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了视网膜眼底影像结合 BViT 模型用于卒中及 TIA 检测的可行性，为卒中快速筛查提供了一种新颖且有效的深度学习方法，但AUC为0.75表明仍有进一步优化空间，未来可能需要更大规模的数据验证和模型改进。

title: Longitudinal and Graph-Augmented Prediction of Adolescent Substance Use Onset in the ABCD Study
comment: 8 pages main text, 10 pages total, 4 tables
summary: Early identification of adolescent substance-use risk is an important prevention challenge, yet the relative value of baseline characteristics, longitudinal trajectories, and relational context remains unclear. Using data from approximately 11,860 participants in the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) Study, we compare cross-sectional, longitudinal, and graph-based approaches for predicting alcohol sipping, alcohol use, marijuana use, and alcohol/marijuana use. We evaluate tree-based models, recurrent neural networks, and Temporal Graph Convolutional Networks (T-GCNs) constructed from family, school, and feature-similarity graphs. Longitudinal models consistently outperform baseline models, with temporal XGBoost achieving the strongest standalone performance. Although T-GCNs generally do not surpass temporal XGBoost, graph-derived risk scores provide complementary information. Combining temporal XGBoost and T-GCN predictions through score-level stacking yields the best performance across all outcomes, achieving AUC-ROC values above 0.79. Feature analyses identify peer deviance, age, externalizing symptoms, parental monitoring, cultural norms, and neighborhood context as important predictors of substance use onset. These findings demonstrate the value of longitudinal modeling for substance-use prediction and suggest that graph-based representations can provide effective auxiliary risk signals.

AI.tldr: 本文利用ABCD研究中约11,860名青少年数据，比较了横截面、纵向和基于图的方法在预测物质使用（酒精尝试、酒精使用、大麻使用及酒精/大麻使用）中的表现。纵向模型始终优于横截面基线，其中时间XGBoost表现最佳；虽然T-GCN未能超越时间XGBoost，但其图派生风险评分提供互补信息。通过分数级堆叠结合两者预测取得最佳性能，AUC-ROC均高于0.79。
AI.motivation: 早期识别青少年物质使用风险是重要的预防挑战，但目前基线特征、纵向轨迹和关系背景在预测中的相对价值尚不明确，需要系统性比较不同建模方法以确定最佳预测策略。
AI.method: 使用ABCD研究约11,860名参与者的数据，对比三类方法：(1)横截面模型（基线特征）；(2)纵向模型（树模型与循环神经网络RNN）；(3)基于图的模型——从家庭、学校和特征相似性图构建时序图卷积网络（T-GCN）。最终通过分数级堆叠整合时间XGBoost与T-GCN预测。
AI.result: 纵向模型一致优于基线模型，时间XGBoost为最佳独立模型；T-GCN总体未超越时间XGBoost但提供互补信号。堆叠融合后所有结局的AUC-ROC均超过0.79。重要预测因子包括同伴偏差、年龄、外化症状、父母监控、文化规范和邻里环境。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明纵向建模对物质使用预测有明显价值，图表示可提供有效的辅助风险信号，提示了多源信息融合策略在预防性筛查中的潜力。

title: Deploying Frontier Agentic Technology in MOOSEnger, a Multiphysics-Capable AI Assistant
summary:
The Multiphysics Object-Oriented Simulation Environment (MOOSE) is an open-source finite-element framework for building multiphysics simulation applications. Using a multiphysics environment effectively demands specialized expertise, creating a barrier for many domain scientists and engineers. MOOSEnger, developed at Idaho National Laboratory (INL), is a domain-specific, tool-enabled AI agent built for the MOOSE Framework. This work extends MOOSEnger with a harness focused on locally-hosted models. The harness gives the agent a full pipeline: it retrieves contextual knowledge from the MOOSE repository, validates and diagnoses the resulting input through interaction with the simulation executable environment, and extracts and stores lessons in a persistent memory.
  The resulting framework is demonstrated on an engineering problem from the National Reactor Innovation Center Virtual Test Bed (VTB), illustrating its potential to support realistic multiphysics simulation workflows. Additionally, the agent performance is evaluated on different categories including diffusion, Navier--Stokes, phase field, plasticity, porous media flow, solid mechanics, transient heat transfer, and reactor mesh generation. Each category consists of 25 prompts/cases. We compare MOOSEnger-Gemma4 against MOOSEnger-GPT-5.2, alongside baseline Gemma4 and GPT-5.2 without agentic capabilities. MOOSEnger-GPT-5.2 shows a slight edge, achieving a 90\% success rate versus 76.5\% for MOOSEnger-Gemma4. The baseline models perform far worse, at just 5\% (GPT-5.2) and 0\% (Gemma4), underscoring the impact of the agentic harness.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了MOOSEnger框架的扩展，一个基于MOOSE有限元仿真环境构建的领域专用AI智能体。扩展引入了一个本地模型托管框架，提供从知识检索、仿真验证到经验持久化的完整管道，并在8类共200个多物理场仿真案例上评估了性能。
AI.motivation: MOOSE多物理场仿真框架虽功能强大，但使用门槛高，需要跨领域专业知识和仿真经验。这阻碍了许多领域科学家和工程师充分利用该工具。现有AI智能体可能依赖云端模型或缺乏完整的仿真工作流支撑，需要构建一个可本地部署、具备完整仿真闭环能力的智能体框架来降低使用壁垒。
AI.method: 将MOOSEnger智能体扩展为一个支持本地托管模型的框架（harness），其完整管道包括：(1) 从MOOSE代码仓库检索上下文知识；(2) 通过与仿真可执行环境交互来验证和诊断输入文件；(3) 将经验教训提取并存储到持久化记忆中。该框架在INL开发，针对MOOSE框架定制。
AI.result: 在8个类别（扩散、Navier-Stokes、相场、塑性、多孔介质流、固体力学、瞬态热传导、反应堆网格生成）各25个案例上评估：MOOSEnger-GPT-5.2成功率达90%，MOOSEnger-Gemma4达76.5%，而基线模型GPT-5.2和Gemma4分别仅为5%和0%，凸显了智能体框架的显著增益。该框架还在国家反应堆创新中心虚拟试验台（VTB）的工程问题上进行了演示。
AI.conclusion: 智能体框架（harness）是提升大语言模型处理多物理场仿真任务能力的关键因素，其带来的性能提升远大于模型本身的选择差异。MOOSEnger框架展示了将领域知识检索、仿真环境交互验证和持久化记忆相结合的有效性，有望支持真实世界的多物理场仿真工作流。

title: Revisiting Shannon's Source Coding Theorem with Distributional Uncertainty under the Nonlinear Expectation Theory
summary: In classical information theory, a source is modeled by a single, precisely known probability distribution. However, in the increasingly complex communication networks full of unanticipated, nonstationary, and heterogeneous random events, the assumption of precise and well-defined probability distributions to describe random variables appears somewhat idealized. Therefore, it is important to characterize the uncertainty of distributions of source messages, subject to relaxing the assumption of deterministic probability models for analyzing information sources in information theory. Based on the nonlinear expectation theory, a novel axiomatical system that extends classical probability theory, this paper investigates the information sources whose distributions themselves are uncertain, and refers to them as uncertain-distribution sources. We generalize the fundamental concept information entropy to nonlinear information entropy, which describes the measurement of the amount of information contained in a uncertain-distribution source. By using the strong law of large numbers under sublinear expectation, we establish a nonlinear source coding theorem, which not only shows that the nonlinear information entropy is the upper bound for the infimum of achievable coding rate of uncertain-distribution sources under the maximum error probability criterion, but also determines a cluster point of the coding rate of uncertain-distribution sources under the minimum error probability criterion. Our findings reveal that the introduction of nonlinear expectation theory allows for a more comprehensive understanding of information sources.

AI.tldr: 本文基于非线性期望理论，将经典信息论中假设概率分布精确已知的框架推广到分布本身不确定的情形，提出"不确定分布信源"概念，并将信息熵推广为非线性信息熵，建立了非线性信源编码定理。
AI.motivation: 经典信息论假设信源服从精确已知的概率分布，但现实中通信网络面临着非平稳、异构和不可预测的随机事件，这种假设过于理想化。因此需要一种能够刻画信源消息分布本身不确定性的理论框架。
AI.method: 基于非线性期望理论（推广经典概率论的公理化系统），将分布不确定的信源建模为不确定分布信源；利用次线性期望下的大数定律，将经典信息熵推广为非线性信息熵，并据此建立非线性信源编码定理。
AI.result: 非线性源编码定理表明：在最大误差概率准则下，非线性信息熵是可实现编码速率下确界的上界；在最小误差概率准则下，确定了不确定分布信源编码速率的聚点。
AI.conclusion: 非线性期望理论的引入使得对信息源的理解更加全面，突破了经典概率模型精确性的限制，为处理分布不确定的信源提供了严格的数学框架。

title: Incorporating Bounded Rationality into Electric Vehicle Highway Charging Decisions: A Bayesian Game Analysis
comment: Published in IEEE Internet of Things Journal, vol. 12, no. 11, pp. 15249-15260, 2025. An earlier version appeared in Proc. 14th ACM International Conference on Future Energy Systems (e-Energy), 2023. MATLAB code available at https://github.com/T-Lab-CUHKSZ/-IOTJ25-Incorporating-Bounded-Rationality-into-Electric-Vehicle-Highway-Charging-Decisions
summary: Electric vehicles (EVs) represent a critical intelligent terminal within the Internet of Things (IoT). Despite the year-on-year growth in EV penetration, the highway driving experience still requires improvement. Accurate prediction of EV highway charging behavior is crucial to addressing this issue. This paper introduces a novel bounded rationality framework to analyze highway charging decisions. Specifically, we utilize prospect theory to capture the tendency of drivers to reserve more electricity than theoretically necessary. We then propose a Bayesian game in which EV drivers, unaware of others' decisions, aim to minimize costs, including range anxiety, charging fees, and queuing time. To gain insights into the game, we prove the existence and uniqueness of the Bayesian Nash Equilibrium in two practical scenarios. Our numerical experiments, based on real-life data, demonstrate that drivers' risk aversion tendency significantly influence EV charging decisions, charging demand, queuing lengths at charging stations, and the departure rate on the highway network. Furthermore, our strategy reduces cumulative EV cost and CSs' charging costs compared to other benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于前景理论的有限理性框架，通过贝叶斯博弈建模电动汽车（EV）在高速公路上的充电决策，考虑驾驶员的里程焦虑、充电费用和排队时间，并证明两种实际场景下贝叶斯纳什均衡的存在性与唯一性。真实数据实验表明该策略能降低EV累计成本和充电站充电成本。
AI.motivation: 电动汽车渗透率逐年增长，但高速公路驾驶体验仍待改善。精确预测EV高速公路充电行为对解决这一问题至关重要，而现有研究未充分考虑驾驶员的有限理性（如倾向于预留多余电量的风险规避行为）。
AI.method: 1）利用前景理论（Prospect Theory）刻画驾驶员倾向于预留多余电量的有限理性行为；2）构建贝叶斯博弈模型，其中EV驾驶员在不知他人决策的情况下，最小化包含里程焦虑、充电费用和排队时间的综合成本；3）证明两种实际场景下贝叶斯纳什均衡的存在性与唯一性；4）基于真实数据进行数值实验验证。
AI.result: 数值实验表明：驾驶员的（风险规避）倾向显著影响EV充电决策、充电需求、充电站排队长度以及高速公路网络的车流驶离率；所提策略相比其他基准方案，能有效降低累计EV成本和充电站的充电成本。
AI.conclusion: 该有限理性框架下的贝叶斯博弈模型能更准确地刻画和预测高速公路EV充电行为，为优化高速公路充电体验和充电站运营提供理论支撑。

title: Valid Per-Field Selective Risk Control for Document Extraction: Three Failure Modes, a Validity Ladder, and When Conditioning Pays
comment: 14 pages. Seed-pinned, regression-gated harness (Apache-2.0): https://github.com/bhaskargurram-ai/verifydoc . Companion benchmark paper: VerifyDocBench
summary: Per-field accept/review with selective risk at most alpha -- accept a field only if the error rate among accepted fields is controlled -- is the trust contract document-extraction systems need, and the natural procedure silently violates it on real documents. On 13,859 genuine claude-sonnet-5 fields from 800 CORD receipts (49.0% correct) we diagnose three failure modes: document clustering (design effect 1.84-2.45), score-refit leakage (coverage 0.416 at risk 0.127, violating alpha=0.10 in 95% of splits), and a tie-mass pathology (a degenerate score collapses the threshold grid, 0.030 to 0.001). We organize the fixes as a validity ladder, guarantee form stated per tier. A fit/val split protocol restores expected-selective-risk control for a learned fusion: coverage 0.318 at risk 0.096 at nominal alpha=0.10, no tolerance band (production variant 0.326) -- an on-average point whose realized risk exceeds alpha in 47.5% of resplits, not a certificate. Mondrian Learn-then-Test with exact binomial tails yields per-group PAC certificates: field-iid 0.171 at risk 0.068, cluster-corrected 0.140, doc-iid 0.060 -- the only tier matching documents, honestly near-vacuous today. Support-bin, the pre-specified provenance taxonomy, wins every rigor tier on the sonnet CORD capture (p<1e-4, Bonferroni-corrected) -- a win that does not replicate on the same documents under haiku or qwen -- while on higher-accuracy corpora pooled thresholds win: conditioning helps exactly where pooled cannot certify, subsumed by a learned score elsewhere. A frozen-configuration confirmation on selection-untouched claude-haiku-4-5 held at both risk levels, and a blind three-annotator human-gold audit verifies the practical tier's accepted-set risk at 1.3% against its 10% budget (Fleiss' kappa=0.83; labels err one-sidedly pessimistic). Released Apache-2.0 with seed-pinned, regression-gated procedures.

AI.tldr: 本文研究文档抽取系统的逐字段接受/评审（per-field accept/review）任务，目标是在可选择性风险α下有保证地控制接受字段的错误率。核心发现是自然流程（naive procedure）在真实文档上会静默违反该保证；作者在13,859个真实字段上诊断出三种失效模式（文档聚类、评分重拟合泄漏、平票质量退化），并提出"有效性阶梯"（validity ladder）来组织修复方案，各层级给出不同强度的保证形式。最终通过Mondrian Learn-then-Test实现每组的PAC证书，经冻结配置确认和人工审计验证。
AI.motivation: 文档抽取系统需要一个信任契约：接受一个字段的前提是其错误率在接受的字段集合中得到控制（即选择性风险≤α）。然而，自然的两阶段流程（先训练评分器、再对阈值调优）在真实文档上会因文档内聚类相关性、验证集数据泄漏和评分退化等问题静默违背这一保证。本文旨在系统性地诊断这些失效模式，并提供有严格统计保证的替代方案。
AI.method: 作者在800份CORD收据上的13,859个claude-sonnet-5字段（真实正确率49.0%）上诊断出三种失效模式：(1) 文档聚类效应（design effect 1.84-2.45）；(2) 评分-重拟合泄漏（在风险0.127时覆盖率仅0.416，违反α=0.10且在95%的划分中违约）；(3) 平票质量退化（退化评分使阈值网格坍缩，风险从0.030降至0.001）。据此提出"有效性阶梯"，每层有明确的保证形式：fit/val划分协议恢复期望选择性风险控制；Mondrian Learn-then-Test结合精确二项尾部给出各组PAC证书（字段iid、聚类校正、文档iid三档）；支持箱（support-bin）预注册来源分类法用于逐组验证。最后用冻结配置在未触及选择的claude-haiku-4-5上确认，并做三位标注者的盲法人类金标审计。
AI.result: fit/val划分协议使学习融合器在名义α=0.10下达到覆盖率0.318、风险0.096（生产变体0.326），但这是平均意义上的结果，其实际风险在47.5%的重划分中超过α，并非证明书。Mondrian Learn-then-Test在字段iid下达到覆盖率0.171、风险0.068（聚类校正0.140，文档iid 0.060），是唯一与文档匹配的层级，但当前诚实地接近空无意义。支持箱在此捕获中赢下所有严格性层级（Bonferroni校正p<1e-4），但该优势在haiku或qwen下不可复制；在高准确率语料上合并阈值更优。冻结配置确认在claude-haiku-4-5的两个风险水平均通过；盲法三标注者审计验证实践层级的接受集风险为1.3%（预算10%），Fleiss' kappa=0.83，标签偏悲观。
AI.conclusion: 自然的选择性接受流程在真实文档上不可靠，必须通过分层手段明确保证形式。选择性风险控制要求根据数据特征（聚类相关性、泄漏、评分质量）匹配适当的有效性层级：期望风险控制够用但非证书，PAC证书严格但当前近于平凡。支持箱等条件化方法在特定模型-语料组合上有效但不具有跨模型泛化性；学习得到的融合评分在可认证性不足的场景中可作为替代。实践层级（经人工审计）目前是在成本与保证之间最可行的折衷，但认证严格性与实用覆盖率之间的张力和所得最优。完整代码和程序以Apache-2.0发布，含种子固定和回归门控。

title: Class Imbalance and Batch Effects in LLM-Based Screening for Systematic Reviews
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at ENIAC 2026 (National Meeting on Artificial and Computational Intelligence), part of BRACIS 2026
summary: This study analyses LLMs in imbalanced binary classification, using study screening in systematic reviews as the application domain. An experiment was conducted in five reviews, comparing individual and batch processing, with and without prevalence metadata. The results indicate a limited influence of the prevalence metadata, with no evidence that it improves performance. In contrast, batch processing produced larger behavioral changes that varied according to the prevalence of the class. The aggregate and item-level analyses did not always coincide. Therefore, batch processing should be evaluated not only in terms of cost, but also in relation to its effects on decision-making behavior.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了LLM在不平衡二元分类中的表现，以系统综述中的研究筛选为应用场景。实验在五个综述中进行，比较了单独处理与批量处理、有无患病率元数据两种条件。结果表明患病率元数据的影晌有限且未证其提升性能，而批量处理引发了更大的行为变化，且变化方向取决于类别不平衡程度。聚合层面与条目层面的分析结果并不总是一致，因此批量处理不应仅从成本角度评估，还需考虑其对决策行为的影响。
AI.motivation: 不平衡二元分类是实际应用中常见且具有挑战性的问题，LLM在这一场景下的行为尚未被充分理解。本研究以系统综述的研究筛选为应用域，旨在揭示LLM在不平衡分类中的决策行为及其影响因素。
AI.method: 在五个系统综述数据上开展实验，系统比较两种处理方式（单独处理与批量处理）和两种信息条件（有无患病率元数据），并同时进行聚合层面与条目层面的分析以全面考察LLM的决策行为。
AI.result: 患病率元数据对LLM性能影响有限，未发现其能提升性能的证据；批量处理则引发更大的行为变化，且变化随类别患病率不同而各异；聚合层和条目层分析结论并非总是一致。
AI.conclusion: 批量处理不应仅从成本节省角度评估，还必须考虑其对决策行为的影响；同时提示研究者在评估LLM分类性能时需关注分析粒度的选择，聚合与条目层面的结论可能产生分歧。

title: A Vision Transformer for ECG-Based Detection of Left Ventricular Systolic Dysfunction Across Multiple Clinical Sites
comment: 19 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables; includes supplementary material with 3 additional figures
summary: Reduced left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) is frequently asymptomatic and often detected only after advanced heart failure develops. Electrocardiograms are recorded routinely yet underused for this condition, because reduced LVEF has no single diagnostic waveform. We trained an ensemble of vision transformers from scratch to detect reduced LVEF ($\leq$40%) from 12-lead ECGs, analyzing each heartbeat individually, using 10,142 patients across seven sites in three US health systems. In a held-out external cohort of 4,092 patients from three geographically independent US clinical sites at a real-world reduced-LVEF prevalence of 8.72%, the model achieved an AUROC of 0.88 (95% CI 0.86-0.89), sensitivity 81.2%, specificity 81.0%, and negative predictive value 97.8%. Sensitivity remained high across sex, race, ethnicity, and comorbidity subgroups, while specificity was lower in older patients and those with atrial fibrillation or cardiomyopathy. Beat-level attention maps provided interpretability into the model's predictions, showing consistent focus on the QRS complex rather than the P wave. These findings support the potential of routine ECGs as a scalable first-pass triage step to identify patients who should undergo echocardiography for reduced ejection fraction across diverse patient populations.

AI.tldr: 该研究训练了一个从头开始的视觉Transformer集成模型，用于从12导联心电图检测左心室射血分数降低（LVEF≤40%），在来自三个美国医疗系统七个站点的10,142名患者上训练，并在外部独立队列的4,092名患者中实现了AUROC 0.88、敏感性81.2%、特异性81.0%和97.8%的阴性预测值，表明常规ECG可作为可扩展的初步分诊工具指导超声心动图检查。
AI.motivation: 左心室射血分数降低（LVEF降低）常常无症状，往往在晚期心力衰竭发展后才被发现。尽管心电图是常规记录并广泛可用的检查手段，但由于LVEF降低没有单一诊断波形，心电图在该场景下未得到充分利用。亟需一种可扩展、低成本的方法来早期筛查LVEF降低患者，以便及时安排超声心动图检查。
AI.method: 训练了一个视觉Transformer（Vision Transformer）集成模型，从头开始训练，对12导联ECG中的每个心跳进行逐一分析以检测LVEF≤40%。模型在三个美国医疗系统中的七个站点共10,142名患者上进行训练和验证，并使用来自三个地理独立的美国临床站点、真实LVEF降低患病率为8.72%的外部队列（4,092名患者）进行独立评估。
AI.result: 在外部验证队列中，模型达到AUROC 0.88（95% CI 0.86-0.89），敏感性81.2%，特异性81.0%，阴性预测值97.8%。敏感性在性别、种族、民族和合并症亚组中保持高水平；特异性在老年患者及合并房颤或心肌病的患者中较低。注意力图谱显示模型主要聚焦于QRS波群而非P波，提供了可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现支持将常规心电图作为可扩展的初步分诊工具，用于在多样化患者群体中识别需要接受超声心动图检查的LVEF降低患者，具有早期筛查和及时干预的潜在临床价值。

title: SKILL: Self-correcting Knowledge-guided Iterative Large Language Model Agent for Logic Optimization
summary: Logic synthesis optimization poses significant challenges due to exponentially growing search spaces, sparse reward signals, and diverse logic structures. Traditional expert-designed flows lack adaptability, while reinforcement learning (RL) methods often suffer from low sample efficiency and limited interpretability. We introduce SKILL, a Self-correcting Knowledge-guided Iterative Large Language Model Agent that unifies multi-agent LLM reasoning and RL-based environment interaction for automated synthesis optimization. SKILL coordinates three specialized LLMs: GPT-4o for strategic planning, Claude Sonnet 4 for detailed reasoning, and Gemini 2.5 Pro for efficient analysis with a PPO-based RL agent that learns actionable policies through direct interaction with synthesis tools. A novel self-correcting module monitors environment feedback (PDA metrics), detects suboptimal behaviors, and invokes LLM-guided recovery strategies. Evaluations on IWLS, OpenCores, and EPFL benchmarks show SKILL achieves a 12.4 % PDA improvement over expert flows and 86.3% success rate on logic systems up to 500K gates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SKILL框架，一个自纠错的知识引导式迭代大语言模型代理，通过统一多智能体LLM推理与基于强化学习的环境交互，实现逻辑综合优化自动化。SKILL协调三个专用LLM（GPT-4o用于策略规划、Claude Sonnet 4用于细节推理、Gemini 2.5 Pro用于高效分析）并搭配PPO强化学习代理，通过自纠错模块监控环境反馈（PDA指标）并调用LLM引导的恢复策略。在IWLS、OpenCores和EPFL基准上，SKILL相比专家流程实现了12.4%的PDA提升，在多达50万门的逻辑系统上达到86.3%的成功率。
AI.motivation: 逻辑综合优化面临搜索空间指数级增长、奖励信号稀疏以及逻辑结构多样化等重大挑战。传统专家设计的流程缺乏适应性，而现有强化学习方法存在样本效率低和可解释性受限的问题，亟需一种既具适应性又高效可解释的优化方法。
AI.method: SKILL采用多智能体LLM协作架构：GPT-4o负责战略规划，Claude Sonnet 4负责详细推理，Gemini 2.5 Pro负责高效分析；同时集成基于PPO的强化学习智能体，通过与逻辑综合工具的直接交互学习可执行策略。核心创新是自纠错模块，该模块监控PDA等环境反馈指标，检测次优行为并触发LLM引导的恢复策略。
AI.result: 在IWLS、OpenCores和EPFL基准测试上，SKILL相比专家流程实现了12.4%的PDA（性能-延迟-面积）指标提升，并在规模高达50万门的逻辑系统上达到86.3%的成功率。
AI.conclusion: SKILL验证了将多智能体LLM推理与RL环境交互统一用于逻辑综合优化的有效性，通过自纠错机制显著提升了优化效果与成功率，为自动化逻辑综合优化提供了一种兼具适应性、可解释性和可扩展性的新范式。

title: REFLEX: Reflexive Equilibrium Fixed-point Learning for Endogenous eXchanges
summary: In over-the-counter corporate bond markets, dealers compete for client trades by quoting bid and ask prices. Tighter quotes attract more business, but also informed customers more likely to trade ahead of adverse price moves, leaving the dealer holding the risk. As dealers increasingly use machine learning to set quotes, they retrain these models on the trades their own quotes attract, creating a feedback loop in which each model reshapes the market that generates its next training data. The question is therefore not only whether a quoting model performs well, but whether the market it creates stays stable as the model learns from it. Existing performative prediction theory gives a sharp stability condition, yet expresses it through abstract properties of the learning objective a trading desk cannot measure before deployment. We introduce REFLEX, a framework that replaces those unobservable quantities with three measurable features of dealer behavior: how strongly trading volume responds to tighter quotes, how sharply the dealer's objective bends around its optimum, and how quickly informed flow increases as spreads narrow. REFLEX combines these into a single retraining modulus, a pre-deployment stability margin estimated from a desk's own quote and execution history that predicts whether repeated retraining will converge or amplify itself. In simulation, predicted and measured stability agree within 8%, and competing dealers increase instability by 1.74x with two and 3.16x with three, as predicted. Where ordinary retraining becomes unstable at modulus 1.21, a structurally anchored correction converges as blind retraining collapses. Calibrated over 36 years of public market data, stability headroom falls roughly 4.4x for investment grade and 4.3x for high yield from calm to crisis regimes. Ultimately, REFLEX turns an abstract convergence theorem into a market-level safety margin.

AI.tldr: REFLEX是一个为场外公司债券市场的做市商报价模型提供预部署稳定性评估的框架。它将原有的表演性预测理论中不可观测的抽象条件，转化为可从做市商自身报价和执行历史中测量的三个行为特征——交易量对报价松紧的响应强度、目标函数在最优点的弯曲程度、以及知情交易流随价差收窄的增速——并合并为一个"再训练模量"作为稳定性边际。模拟结果表明预测与实测稳定性误差在8%以内，竞争做市商会显著放大不稳定性；在36年公开市场数据的校准中，从平静期到危机期投资级和高收益债券的稳定性余量分别下降约4.4倍和4.3倍。
AI.motivation: 做市商使用机器学习设置报价时，模型会在自己创生的交易数据上反复再训练，形成反馈回路。关键在于不仅要问报价模型表现如何，还要问模型学习过程中创生的市场是否保持稳定。现有表演性预测理论给出了清晰的稳定性条件，但用学习目标的抽象性质表达，交易台在部署前无法测量这些量，需要将这些不可观测条件转化为可测量的做市商行为特征。
AI.method: REFLEX框架将表演性预测理论中不可观测的稳定性条件替换为三个可测量特征：交易量对报价收窄的响应强度、做市商目标函数在最优点的局部曲率、知情流随价差收窄的增速。三者组合为一个"再训练模量"，作为预部署稳定性边际，由做市商自带报价和执行历史估计，用于预测反复再训练将收敛还是自我放大。此外还引入了结构锚定修正方法，在盲目再训练崩溃时仍能保持收敛。
AI.result: 仿真中预测与实测稳定性在8%以内一致；竞争做市商使不稳定性分别放大1.74倍（两家）和3.16倍（三家），与预测相符；普通再训练在模量1.21处不稳定，而结构锚定修正保持收敛。基于36年公开市场数据的校准显示，从平静到危机行情，投资级和高收益的稳定性余量分别下降约4.4倍和4.3倍。
AI.conclusion: REFLEX将抽象收敛定理转化为可操作的市场级安全边际，使交易台能在部署前用自身的历史数据评估机器学习报价模型的稳定性风险，预见竞争环境和市场状态变化对稳定性的影响，并可采用结构锚定修正来避免盲目再训练导致的不稳定性。

title: Cramér-Rao Bound Analysis for Cell-Free ISAC Systems with Fluid Intelligent Metasurfaces
summary: Fluid intelligent metasurface (FIM) is an emerging antenna architecture that continuously reshapes its physical geometry to optimize wireless performance. While existing studies on FIM-aided integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) rely on co-located single-base-station (BS) deployments, they fundamentally underutilize FIM's morphological flexibility due to restricted observation angles. In this paper, we investigate a FIM-augmented cell-free ISAC architecture, where distributed access points (APs) collaboratively observe a target from diverse angles. We derive the complete Fisher information matrix for target angle estimation and obtain a closed-form localization CRB that explicitly quantifies the angular diversity gain. By analyzing the block structure of the Fisher information matrix, we uncover three cell-free-specific phenomena: (i) cross-AP information coupling, (ii) multiplicative Tx--Rx FIM coupling, and (iii) angular diversity amplification. Under a 28\,GHz configuration with four APs and eight FIM elements per AP, our analysis shows that distributed angular diversity amplifies the FIM morphing gain to 15.8\,dB, compared to only 0.4\,dB in a single-AP pair deployment with the same total antenna count. We further propose an alternating optimization algorithm for joint beamforming and FIM shape design via semidefinite relaxation whose tightness is formally proved. Numerical results confirm that the proposed cell-free FIM-ISAC architecture achieves a 4.5\,dB localization CRB reduction over the single-AP fixed-array baseline at 10\,dB sensing SNR while maintaining communication quality-of-service constraints across the entire Pareto frontier.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种流体质智能表面（FIM）增强的无蜂窝ISAC架构，通过分布式接入点从多角度协同观测目标，推导了完整的Fisher信息矩阵和闭式克拉美-罗界（CRB），揭示了跨AP信息耦合、收发FIM耦合和角度分集放大三种无蜂窝特有现象，并通过交替优化算法实现联合波束成形与FIM形状设计。
AI.motivation: 现有FIM辅助的ISAC研究仅基于单基站共址部署，限制了FIM形态重构灵活性在观测角度的利用潜力。作者旨在通过无蜂窝架构充分利用FIM的角度分集增益，解决单AP部署下观测角度受限的问题。
AI.method: 推导了目标角度估计的完整Fisher信息矩阵及CRB闭式表达式；通过分析FIM的块结构揭示了三种无蜂窝特有现象；提出了基于半定松弛（SDR）的交替优化算法用于联合波束成形和FIM形状设计，并形式化证明了松弛的紧性。
AI.result: 在28 GHz频段、4个AP和每AP 8个FIM单元的配置下，分布式角度分集将FIM形态增益放大至15.8 dB（单AP对部署仅0.4 dB）；相比单AP固定阵列基线，在10 dB感知信噪比下实现4.5 dB的定位CRB降低，并在整个Pareto前沿维持通信QoS约束。
AI.conclusion: 无蜂窝FIM-ISAC架构能显著提升定位精度并放大FIM的形态调控增益，为未来分布式智能超表面通信感知一体化系统提供了理论分析与算法支撑。

title: Group-Fair Metric Distortion of Facility Assignment Problems
summary: We study the group-fair distortion of metric facility assignment problems, where a set of agents, partitioned into unknown groups, must be assigned to a collection of facilities, possibly subject to capacity or other feasibility constraints. Given an assignment, each agent incurs a cost that depends on both its distance to its assigned facility and, via an affinity factor, the average distance of the other members in its group to their assigned facilities. We consider full-information algorithms, which have complete knowledge of the metric space, and ordinal-information algorithms, which know the distances between facilities and only the rankings of the agents over facilities (sorted by increasing distance). We establish worst-case distortion upper bounds in terms of the Max-of-Sum and Sum-of-Max social objectives, which combine the classic utilitarian and egalitarian social cost measures. We also derive informational lower bounds for one-sided matching and clustering, two fundamental and well-studied problems captured by our model, that match our upper bounds exactly for Max-of-Sum and asymptotically for Sum-of-Max.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究度量设施分配问题中的群体公平失真，代理被划分为未知群体并分配到设施，成本同时取决于个体到设施的距离和群体内其他成员的平均距离。论文分析全信息算法（了解完整度量空间）与序数信息算法（仅了解设施间距离和代理对设施的排序），建立了Max-of-Sum和Sum-of-Max两种社会目标下的最坏情况失真上界，并对一对一匹配和聚类两个基础问题推导出信息论下界，其中Max-of-Sum下界精确匹配、Sum-of-Max下界渐近匹配。
AI.motivation: 现有度量设施分配问题的失真分析通常假设代理的效用仅取决于个体到设施的距离，但现实场景中（如公共服务分配、学校招生等），代理的满意度还受同组其他成员分配结果的影响，即存在群体层面的正外部性（affinity effect）。此外，代理的分组信息通常是未知的，这给算法设计带来额外挑战。论文旨在理解在信息受限（序数信息）条件下，如何评估和保证群体公平的分配质量。
AI.method: 论文将群体公平引入度量设施分配问题，定义每个代理的成本为其到分配设施的距离加上（通过亲和因子加权的）同组其他成员到其分配设施的平均距离。考虑两种信息设置：全信息算法（掌握完整度量空间）和序数信息算法（仅掌握设施间距离及代理对设施的偏好排序）。针对Max-of-Sum（最大群体效用之和，反映群体层面最坏情况）和Sum-of-Max（群体内最大个体成本之和，反映个体层面最坏情况）两种社会目标，推导最坏情况失真上界，并针对一对一匹配和聚类两个特例建立信息论下界。
AI.result: 论文建立了Max-of-Sum和Sum-of-Max目标下的最坏情况失真上界。对于一对一匹配和聚类问题，推导出的信息论下界在Max-of-Sum目标下与上界精确匹配，在Sum-of-Max目标下与上界渐近匹配，表明所提出的上界在相应问题上是紧的或几乎紧的。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为群体公平约束下的度量设施分配问题提供了全面的失真分析框架，刻画了全信息和序数信息设置下的算法性能边界。通过建立匹配和聚类问题的紧下界，证明所提出的失真上界在理论上是最优或渐近最优的，为后续在群体公平感知的机制设计中设计高效算法提供了理论基准。

title: BDIP-Net: Dual-Interaction Graph Learning for Property Prediction of Bilayer Materials
summary: Stacked bilayer materials exhibit rich stacking-dependent properties driven by the interplay between strong intra-layer bonding and weak inter-layer van der Waals interactions. The computational discovery of such materials is challenging because accurate structure generation typically relies on expensive DFT-based optimization, while existing machine-learning models often fail to explicitly distinguish different interaction types during property prediction. To address these challenges, we propose a machine-learning framework for efficient construction and property prediction of stacked bilayer materials. The framework employs a MatterSim-D3-based structural optimization workflow to generate DFT-quality bilayer structures from monolayer building blocks and stacking configurations at substantially reduced computational cost.
