AI.conclusion: 应大幅引入来自观察性数据库和随机实验的真实治疗结果来改进AI的训练与评估，并重新强调改善治疗结果作为所有医疗AI的最终下游目标。

title: UniTAC: Universal Task-Aware Compression via Weighted Distortion Measures
summary: Physical AI systems such as autonomous vehicles and robots rely on timely exchange of high-dimensional sensory signals under tight bandwidth, latency, and energy budgets. Because the task driving downstream decisions evolves over time, a task-specific codec is brittle and retraining one per task is infeasible in the field. We propose UniTAC, a single learned image codec spanning universal (task-agnostic) to task-specialized operation, re-targeted at runtime without retraining. The task is abstracted as a per-component importance vector, derived, e.g., from gradient attribution of any downstream model, and transmitted as low-overhead side information that conditions both encoder and decoder. Trained once over a broad, randomized family of such vectors against weighted-reconstruction distortion, UniTAC keeps a fixed backbone and a single human-viewable reconstruction whose fidelity is steered to the active task by swapping the injected vector. We analyze the underlying weighted rate-distortion problem, characterizing when a diagonal weighted distortion is task-consistent and how weights relate to task sensitivity. Guided by this, we design a Vision Transformer (ViT) codec whose token-level conditioning natively realizes this weight-driven code. On a localized task at 0.034 bpp, a single UniTAC model reaches 91.4% accuracy, only 1.9% below a task-based codec (93.3%) and above universal codecs (76.9%).

AI.tldr: 本文提出UniTAC，一种单一学习图像编解码器，可跨越从通用（任务无关）到任务特化的运行模式，无需重新训练即可在运行时重新定向目标任务。
AI.motivation: 物理AI系统（如自动驾驶、机器人）需要在受限的带宽、延迟和能耗下及时交换高维传感器信号。由于驱动下游决策的任务随时间演化，任务特定的编解码器容易失效，且针对每个任务重新训练在实际部署中不可行。
AI.method: 将任务抽象为逐组件的注意力重要性向量（从任意下游模型的梯度归因推导），以低开销侧信息形式传输并条件化编码器和解码器。在广泛随机化向量族上通过加权重建失真进行一次性训练，通过交换注入向量在运行时调整固定骨干网络的保真度至当前任务。同时分析加权率失真问题，设计基于Vision Transformer的编解码器，其token级条件化天然实现权重驱动的编解码。
AI.result: 在0.034 bpp的局部任务上，单一UniTAC模型达到91.4%准确率，仅比基于任务特化编解码器（93.3%）低1.9%，且明显优于通用编解码器（76.9%）。
AI.conclusion: UniTAC证明了无需在每个任务上重新训练即可实现从通用到任务特化的运行模式切换，为物理AI系统中动态任务的实时图像传输提供了一种高效且灵活的解决方案。

title: The New Mathematics of Democracy
comment: To appear in Notices of the American Mathematical Society, December 2026
summary: This article surveys emerging directions in the mathematics of democracy. It uses three case studies --- voting theory, participatory budgeting, and deliberative democracy --- to highlight how contemporary challenges motivate rigorous mathematical research that incorporates real-world data, institutional constraints, and implementation feasibility. Within each case, we highlight active and promising research frontiers, evidence of real-world impact, practical applications, and opportunities for getting involved.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了民主数学的新兴研究方向，通过投票理论、参与式预算和协商民主三个案例研究，展示当代挑战如何推动融入现实数据、制度约束和实施可行性的严谨数学研究。
AI.motivation: 当代民主实践面临新的挑战，需要将数学研究与现实世界的数据、制度约束和实施可行性相结合，但目前缺乏对这一新兴领域的系统性综述，无法为研究者提供清晰的路线图。
AI.method: 采用案例研究方法，选取投票理论、参与式预算和协商民主三个代表性领域作为案例，逐一分析每个领域中的活跃研究前沿、现实影响证据、实际应用以及参与机会。
AI.result: 文章识别出民主数学三个案例中的新兴研究方向，展示了数学研究在这些领域中的实际影响力和应用价值，并指出了研究者和实践者的参与途径。
AI.conclusion: 民主数学是一个蓬勃发展且前景广阔的交叉学科方向，当代现实挑战为数学研究提供了丰富的动机和问题来源，研究者可以通过多种方式参与到这一领域中来。

title: Discrete Diffusion Language Models Are Training-Free Multi-Label Classifiers
summary:
We present dLLM-SetScore, a training-free method that uses discrete masked-diffusion language models for multi-label text classification. For each candidate label, it asks a short yes/no question and compares the probabilities of the two answer tokens at one masked position. The method uses no task-specific fine-tuning or training on textual-entailment datasets; a 200-example labelled validation slice selects thresholds, temperature, and prompt wording.
  We first show that placing all labels in one prompt creates a strong slot-position asymmetry: the first answer slot is predicted positive on $99.4\%$ of GoEmotions examples and $100\%$ of Reuters examples. Per-label scoring places every label in the same syntactic position, making predictions invariant to label order and avoiding this artifact. We evaluate LLaDA-8B and Dream-7B on six datasets against NLI models, an autoregressive LLM, SetFit, and supervised classifiers. On the five datasets shared by both diffusion families, Instruct checkpoints improve macro-F1 in 9 of 10 comparisons and micro-F1 in 8 of 10, although these comparisons do not identify the cause. Within our protocol, LLaDA-Instruct records the highest training-free values for both Reuters and ECtHR metrics. We prove permutation invariance, characterize thresholded decisions under weighted Hamming loss, and derive shortlist ceilings for recall and F1. An exploratory local Joint Set Refinement step lowers F1 from biased and unbiased initializations and is retained as a negative result.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需训练的dLLM-SetScore方法，利用离散掩码扩散语言模型进行多标签文本分类，通过逐标签提问和比较两个答案token的概率完成分类，无需任务特定微调。
AI.motivation: 现有掩码扩散语言模型可胜任生成式任务，但其在多标签分类中的应用未充分探索；同时将所有标签放入同一提示会产生槽位位置不对称伪影（第一个答案槽位被过度预测为正类），需要一种避免该伪影的评分方法。
AI.method: 对每个候选标签构造简短的二元（是/否）问题，在单个掩码位置比较两个答案token的概率。使用200个带标签的验证样本选择阈值、温度和提示措辞。采用逐标签独立评分使得每个标签处于相同句法位置，保证预测对标签顺序不变。同时证明排列不变性，刻画阈值决策在加权汉明损失下的性质，并推导了召回率和F1的候选短列表上限。
AI.result: 在六个数据集上评估LLaDA-8B和Dream-7B，对比NLI模型、自回归LLM、SetFit和监督分类器。在五个共享数据集上，Instruct检查点在9/10的宏F1比较和8/10的微F1比较中表现更好。LLaDA-Instruct在Reuters和ECtHR上取得训练自由方法中的最高值。探索性的局部联合集合精炼步骤降低了F1，作为负面结果保留。
AI.conclusion: 逐标签评分有效避免了将所有标签放入单个提示时的槽位位置不对称问题；掩码扩散语言模型的Instruct版本在无需训练的多标签分类中具有竞争力，但因果归因尚不明确；局部集合精炼方法未能带来收益。

title: Interpretable Cross-Lingual Alignment in Small Language Models: Probing Cultural and Pragmatic Reasoning in Japanese-English Bilingual LLMs
comment: 15 pages, no figures. Introduces the J-PragEval-v0 minimal-pair benchmark
summary:
Large language models work well on English and behave in poorly understood ways on languages typologically far from it. Japanese is a clean example, where evaluation still leans on translation quality and JGLUE-style benchmarks, which roll lexical, syntactic and pragmatic competence into a single score. The phenomena on which general-purpose models fail Japanese users are pragmatic: honorifics, in-group and out-group reference, context-sensitive politeness, zero anaphora.
  I introduce J-PragEval-v0, a minimal-pair benchmark isolating four such phenomena from surface fluency, and combine it with linear probes and teacher-forced log-probability evaluation to ask where inside TinySwallow-1.5B (28 layers, hidden size 1536) the corresponding contrasts live. The four features split three ways. Honorific register sits cleanly in the residual stream: 0.96 balanced accuracy at layer 15, and the model flips its preferred continuation with the scenario on 93 percent of items. Implicit subject and in-group reference are not linearly decodable at the final prompt token (0.48 and 0.38), yet flip rates are 0.77 and 0.79, so the contrast is worked out during generation rather than stored at the prompt. Indirect refusal is the negative case: 0.95 probe accuracy collapsing to a 0.43 flip rate under length-normalised teacher forcing, because the current minimal pairs conflate politeness with continuation length.
  I also specify Pragmatic Representation Steering, a parameter-free inference-time method that edits residual-stream activations along the class-mean-difference directions probing identifies. Feasibility is argued indirectly rather than demonstrated: the contrastive activation addition baseline, the same geometry the method would inject, recovers probe accuracy within one to two points of logistic regression wherever a linear signal exists. Scaling to Llama-3.1-Swallow-8B is the next step.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍J-PragEval-v0，一个最小对基准测试集，用于隔离日语中四类语用现象（敬语、隐式主语、内群体指称、间接拒绝）。作者使用线性探针和教师强制的log概率评估，在TinySwallow-1.5B模型中发现这些语用对比以三种不同方式分布：敬语登记清晰存在于残差流中（第15层平衡准确率0.96），隐式主语和内群体指称无法在提示词处线性解码但生成过程中翻转率高，间接拒绝因基准设计将礼貌与生成长度混淆而失败。论文还提出了一种参数无关推理时方法PRS（语用表征引导）。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在英语上表现良好，但在类型学遥远语言上的行为难以理解。日语是典型案例，现有评估依赖翻译质量和JGLUE式基准，将词汇、句法和语用能力混为一谈。通用模型在日語上失败的语用现象（敬语、内外群体指称、上下文敏感礼貌、零形指代）很少被单独研究，作者希望定位这些语用对比在模型内部的具体位置。
AI.method: 构建J-PragEval-v0最小对基准，隔离四类语用现象与表面流畅度；使用线性探针（在每层残差流/隐藏状态上训练分类器）和教师强制log概率评估定位语用对比；提出Pragmatic Representation Steering（PRS），利用探针识别的类均值差方向在推理时编辑残差流激活。通过对比激活加法基线间接论证PRS可行性。
AI.result: 四类语用特征呈现三种模式：(1) 敬语登记在残差流第15层线性可解码（0.96平衡准确率），模型在93%项目上随场景翻转偏好延续；(2) 隐式主语和内群体指称在最终提示词token无法线性解码（0.48和0.38），但翻转率分别为0.77和0.79，说明对比在生成过程中被处理而非存储在提示处；(3) 间接拒绝因基准将礼貌与延续长度混淆，探针准确率0.95但长度归一化教师强制下翻转率仅0.43。对比激活加法基线在存在线性信号处能恢复探针准确率1-2点内。
AI.conclusion: 语用对比在模型内部以异构方式分布：有的作为稳定表示存在于残差流中，有的仅在生成过程中动态计算，有的因基准设计缺陷无法被探测。PRS方法原则上可行但需在更大模型（Llama-3.1-Swallow-8B）上进一步验证。

title: From Dense Prediction to Visual Editing: Structured Supervision for Unified Image and Video Creation
summary: Unified image and video creation requires a model to follow diverse instructions while preserving identity, geometry, and temporal structure from visual context. However, semantic-only conditioning and creation-only training do not explicitly supervise the local structure needed for precise, temporally consistent editing. We therefore formulate depth and surface-normal prediction as image-form denoising targets, using these dense tasks as structured visual supervision within the same creation interface. Our framework decouples semantic interpretation from spatially aligned visual injection while sharing one multimodal diffusion transformer (MMDiT) backbone across all tasks. Mutual Context Attention (MCA), a paired-video data-construction procedure, and a progressive training curriculum then connect the learned structural cues to temporally localized editing and reference-conditioned creation. A single checkpoint obtains the highest overall score in the reported comparison of unified systems (4.15); adding dense supervision improves OpenVE Overall from 3.98 to 4.06 and Local Add from 3.92 to 4.18. These results support a deliberately bounded conclusion: perception-oriented dense supervision transfers useful structural knowledge to downstream creation, especially editing locality and preservation; we do not claim superiority as a standalone dense predictor.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将深度和表面法线预测作为图像形式的去噪目标，为统一的图像/视频生成模型提供结构化视觉监督，实现精确、时序一致的编辑与参考条件生成。
AI.motivation: 现有的统一图像视频生成模型仅使用语义级条件约束和仅生成训练，缺乏对局部结构的显式监督，难以实现精确、时间一致的编辑，因为模型没有学习到保持身份、几何和时序局部结构所需的细粒度信息。
AI.method: 将深度图和表面法线预测建模为图像形式的去噪目标，作为稠密任务在统一创建界面中提供结构化视觉监督；模型解耦语义解释与空间对齐的视觉注入，共享一个多模态扩散Transformer（MMDiT）主干；引入互上下文注意力（MCA）、配对视频数据构建流程和渐进式训练课程，将结构线索连接到时序局部编辑和参考条件生成。
AI.result: 单个检查点在统一系统比较中获得最高总体得分（4.15）；加入稠密监督后，OpenVE总体得分从3.98提升至4.06，Local Add从3.92提升至4.18。
AI.conclusion: 感知导向的稠密监督能为下游创建任务迁移有用的结构知识，尤其提升编辑局部性和保持性；但作者有意保持结论边界，不宣称该方法作为独立稠密预测器的优越性。

title: When Do LLMs Apply the Wrong Law? Diagnosing LLM Failures in Temporal Legal Reasoning
summary: Legal reasoning tasks such as legal judgment prediction (LJP) require identifying the temporally correct version of the law governing a case -- a capability we term temporal applicable-law determination. However, whether large language models (LLMs) can reliably perform this task remains unexplored. In this paper, we construct a benchmark to evaluate LLMs on temporal applicable-law determination, and systematically investigate why they fail at temporal legal reasoning. Our experiments reveal four key findings. First, LLMs exhibit a strong bias toward applying the most recently enacted law, regardless of when the legally relevant facts occurred. Second, this bias does not stem from an inability to understand that laws have temporal scope, nor from a lack of knowledge about historical statutes. Third, we provide behavioral evidence that reinforcement-learning-shaped explicit reasoning may be a key mechanism: while improving general reasoning ability, it reduces the diversity of reasoning paths, causing models to converge on applying the current law. Fourth, this produces a counterintuitive inverse relationship: models with stronger general reasoning ability tend to perform worse on temporal legal reasoning. Our findings offer concrete guidance for future work on improving LLM performance in temporally grounded legal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个基准测试来评估大语言模型在时序适用法律判定任务上的表现，发现LLM存在强烈的"最新法律偏差"——即倾向于适用最近颁布的法律而非案例发生时的法律。研究发现这一偏差并非源于模型对法律时间范围理解不足或缺乏历史法律知识，而是与强化学习塑造的显式推理机制有关：这降低了推理路径的多样性，使模型趋于适用当前法律，导致更强的通用推理能力反而与时序法律推理性能呈负相关。
AI.motivation: 法律推理任务（如法律判决预测）需要识别适用于案件的时间上正确的法律版本，这一能力被称为"时序适用法律判定"。然而，大语言模型能否可靠完成该任务尚未被探索，因此本文旨在填补这一研究空白，系统调查LLM在时序法律推理中失败的原因。
AI.method: 本文构建了一个用于评估LLM时序适用法律判定能力的基准测试，并进行系统性实验分析。实验揭示四个关键发现：LLM倾向于适用最近颁布的法律；这种偏差并非源于对法律时间范围的理解不足或历史法规知识缺乏；通过行为证据表明强化学习塑造的显式推理可能是关键机制；更强的通用推理能力反而会导致更差的时序法律推理表现。
AI.result: 实验发现：(1) LLM表现出强烈的"最新法律偏差"，无论法律事实发生在何时都倾向于适用最近颁布的法律；(2) 该偏差并非因为模型不理解法律的时间范围，也不因为缺乏历史法规知识；(3) 行为证据表明强化学习塑造的显式推理是偏差的关键机制——它在提升通用推理能力的同时减少了推理路径的多样性，使模型收敛于适用当前法律；(4) 这导致反直觉的负相关关系：通用推理能力越强的模型，时序法律推理表现越差。
AI.conclusion: 本文的研究发现为未来改进LLM在时序接地法律推理中的表现提供了具体指导，揭示了通用推理能力与时序法律推理之间存在的内在张力，强调了推理多样性在时序法律推理中的重要性。

title: Paired Exact-Reset Evaluation of a Prediction-Derived Medium-to-Full World-Model Cascade
summary: Existing adaptive-inference and world-action-model systems use cheap-stage outputs or predicted futures to allocate additional computation. We study a narrower question: under paired exact-reset physical outcomes, can a Medium-derived interface predict when switching to a separately frozen Full predictor improves task-specific decision loss enough to justify sequential overhead? Our contribution is a paired evaluation and audit protocol, not a new generic routing rule: all candidate actions are executed from the same reset state, Medium and Full act on the same candidate set and task, and their paired physical-loss difference defines the routing target. On a fresh PushT bank (V106; 1,600 states, 39 tasks, three checkpoint pairs), a frozen prediction-interface router lowers overhead-inclusive decision cost relative to standalone Medium, standalone Full, and a latency-advantaged task-only router. We then prospectively seal a second 1,600-state PushT confirmation (V107) against a stronger current-state control using the task, a dimension-matched projection of current DINO features, and all five candidate actions, with no DINO encoder latency charged. The prediction interface lowers priced physical decision cost by 0.002549 (state-clustered 95% interval [-0.002867, -0.002238]; one-sided 95% upper bound -0.002286), with negative effects for all three checkpoint pairs. A controlled-PyBullet audit independently supports a composite task-prediction-regime router. The sequential router remains slower than fixed policies, and its advantage is restricted to low compute prices. The evidence supports incremental routing information in the tested prediction interface beyond one deliberately favoured current-DINO control, but not causal sufficiency, compute saving, closed-loop value, or cross-family generality.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个窄化问题：在成对精确重置的物理结果下，Medium派生的预测接口能否在任务损失收益足以抵消顺序计算开销时切换至独立的冻结Full预测器。作者提出了一种成对评估与审计协议，并在1600个状态的PushT数据集（39项任务）上验证了该预测接口路由器的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有自适应推断和世界-动作模型系统利用廉价阶段输出或预测未来来分配额外计算，但缺乏在精确重置条件下对任务特定决策损失的严格成对评估。本文旨在回答：Medium派生的预测接口是否能预测何时切换到Full预测器，且其决策损失改善足以证明顺序开销的合理性。
AI.method: 提出成对评估与审计协议：所有候选动作从相同重置状态执行，Medium和Full作用于相同候选集和任务，以成对物理损失差作为路由目标。在PushT V106银行（1600状态、39任务、三对检查点）上评估冻结预测接口路由器，并在V107上进行前瞻性密封确认，与维度匹配的当前DINO特征投影控制对比。
AI.result: 预测接口将物理决策成本降低0.002549（状态聚类95%区间[-0.002867, -0.002238]），三个检查点对均显示负效应。受控PyBullet审计独立支持复合任务-预测-状态路由器。但顺序路由器仍慢于固定策略，优势仅限于低计算价格区间。
AI.conclusion: 证据支持测试的预测接口在超越刻意偏袒的当前DINO控制方面提供了增量路由信息，但不足以证明因果充分性、计算节省、闭环价值或跨系列通用性。该工作贡献的是成对评估与审计协议，而非新的通用路由规则。

title: How Do Agents Fail on AutoResearch: End-to-End Diagnostic Evaluation on 100 Real-World Frontier Research Tasks
summary: AI has long assisted scientific research, but the rapid advance of LLMs and agentic scaffolds is reshaping the landscape; a single system can now carry whole-stage research from an initial hypothesis all the way to final published paper, which is a paradigm now referred to as AutoResearch. Existing evaluations reveal little about how these agents operate or where they break down. Tasks are narrowly-scoped, evaluation measures performance but not process, and failure diagnoses lack systematic coverage or artifact-level visibility. To address this gap, we introduce AutoResearchEval, featuring 100 tasks grounded in published frontier science across 7 scientific domains and the full research lifecycle, including ideation, retrieval, execution, analysis, writing, and review. Evaluating 8 harness-model combinations yields 800 autoresearch agent trajectories, with process-level annotation. We organize these insights into AutoResearch Failure Taxonomy or ARFT, a framework of 45 empirically-grounded failure patterns. To enable scalable fine-grained attribution, we leverage a human-calibrated agent-as-a-judge pipeline to inspect complete trajectories and intermediate artifacts. Failure patterns converge on a single overarching limitation, namely that current agents lack a metacognitive loop, which entails the ability to check what they produced against what they found, revise when it does not hold up, and question whether the path they took was sound. The same patterns recur across all 8 harness-model combinations, including the strongest models tested, locating the deficit at the model level rather than in any particular scaffold; whether orchestration-level interventions can close it is an open question this work does not test. We publicly release AutoResearchEval and ARFT to facilitate continued research and development in autonomous scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AutoResearchEval，一个包含100个跨7个科学领域、覆盖研究全生命周期的任务基准，以及AutoResearch Failure Taxonomy (ARFT)，一个包含45种经验驱动失败模式的分类框架。通过评估8种harness-model组合产生的800条auto-research agent轨迹，发现当前自主科研智能体的核心缺陷在于缺乏元认知循环（metacognitive loop），即无法检验产出与发现的一致性、无法在不符合时进行修订、无法质疑自身路径的合理性。
AI.motivation: 现有对自主科研智能体（AutoResearch）的评估存在三大不足：任务范围狭窄、只衡量性能而不衡量过程、失败诊断缺乏系统覆盖和中间产物级别的可见性。研究者希望填补这一空白，从过程层面深入理解这些agent如何运作以及在哪里失效。
AI.method: 构建AutoResearchEval基准，包含100个基于前沿发表科研工作的任务，覆盖7个科学领域和完整研究生命周期（构思、检索、执行、分析、写作、评审）。对8种harness-model组合进行评估，生成800条带过程级标注的agent轨迹。进一步采用人工校准的agent-as-a-judge流水线来检查完整轨迹和中间产物，以实现可扩展的细粒度归因，并归纳出ARFT失败分类框架（45种失败模式）。
AI.result: 失败模式收敛于一个总体性局限：当前智能体缺乏元认知循环，即无法检查产出与发现的匹配性、无法在不符合时修订、无法质疑路径的健全性。这些失败模式在全部8种harness-model组合中一致复现，包括最强的模型，说明缺陷主要位于模型层面而非特定脚手架层面。
AI.conclusion: 自主科研智能体的核心瓶颈是模型层面的元认知能力缺失，而非特定编排框架的问题。是否可以通过编排层面的干预来弥补这一缺陷仍有待验证。研究者公开释放AutoResearchEval和ARFT，以促进自主科学发现领域的持续研究与发展。

title: PolyComp: A Polycube-based Benchmark for Compositional 3D Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Models
summary: We introduce PolyComp, a procedurally generated and verified benchmark that stresses visual recognition and compositional spatial reasoning. In each problem, a model must identify which of four options shows a pair of polycube components that can be combined to form a target solid. The benchmark contains 120 problems across four geometry families, and each problem has three different presentation formats using either a single image or multiple images. The random guessing baseline is 25%. Across the three presentations (360 presented problems per model), GPT-5.6 Sol with max effort attains 50.0% accuracy (95% problem-cluster CI 43.3-56.7%) at a mean cost of \$0.951 per presented problem, Claude Fable 5 with max effort attains 39.4% (33.1-46.1%) at \$0.701, and Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview with thinking level high attains 27.5% (22.8-32.5%), near the 25% random guessing baseline, at \$0.350. The observed accuracy spread across geometry families is larger than across presentation formats. We present a problem development and evaluation protocol, cost and token accounting, and release the 120 problems.

AI.tldr: PolyComp是一个程序化生成并验证的基准测试，考察视觉识别与组合空间推理能力。模型需从四个选项中选出能与目标实体组合成形的多立方体组件对。包含120个问题、4个几何族、3种呈现格式。测试显示GPT-5.6 Sol达到50.0%准确率，Claude Fable 5为39.4%，Gemini 3.1 Pro仅27.5%（接近25%的随机猜测基线）。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉-语言模型在组合空间推理任务上缺乏严格的、可程序化验证的基准，现有基准往往存在数据泄露或人工标注不一致的问题，且难以量化模型在真实组合推理中的表现差距。
AI.method: 采用程序化生成方法构造多立方体（polycube）组合问题，并通过程序验证确保每个问题的正确性。设计了三种不同的图像呈现格式，涉及120个问题、4个几何族。同时建立了一套问题开发与评估协议，记录了成本和token消耗数据。
AI.result: 三种呈现格式共360个题目，GPT-5.6 Sol（最大推理强度）准确率50.0%（95%CI 43.3-56.7%），平均每题成本$0.951；Claude Fable 5准确率39.4%（33.1-46.1%），成本$0.701/题；Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview准确率27.5%（22.8-32.5%），接近随机基线，成本$0.350/题。准确率在几何族之间的差异大于呈现格式间的差异。
AI.conclusion: 即便最强的前沿模型在组合空间推理任务上表现仍然有限，最好的模型也仅为50%准确率，揭示了该领域的显著改进空间。基准已公开，可作为组合推理能力的标准化评测工具。

title: Do LLM Agents Negotiate Rationally? A Mechanism-Design Framework for Verifiable Multi-Agent Interaction over A2A/MCP
summary:
Modern LLM-agent frameworks increasingly interoperate through standards such as Anthropic's Model Context Protocol (MCP) for agent-to-tool access and Google's Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol for agent delegation and negotiation. However, these protocols specify transport and discovery rather than strategic correctness and do not guarantee efficient, individually rational, or strategy-proof outcomes.
  We introduce a framework that (i) encodes classical negotiation mechanisms, including alternating-offers bargaining and Vickrey-Clarke-Groves-style auctions, as constraints over A2A message schemas; (ii) provides a lightweight runtime verification and repair layer that checks messages against protocol invariants; and (iii) offers a benchmark of negotiation and allocation tasks with known optimal solutions for measuring deviations from game-theoretic predictions.
  We evaluate multiple LLM backbones using unstructured dialogue, structured protocols, and structured protocols with verification. Across negotiation trials (N=30 per condition), verification reduces outcome variance, while structured protocols achieve 100 percent success for both models. After correcting parser artifacts, audited unstructured baselines achieve approximately 97 percent and 93.3 percent success.
  In auction experiments (N=30 per model), both models achieve 100 percent efficient allocation but differ sharply in truthful bidding: one bids its exact valuation in every trial, whereas the other does so in only 3.3 percent of trials. Thus, mechanism-level incentive compatibility does not automatically transfer to LLM-agent behavior. A three-party fair-allocation task produced only 4.2 percent usable outcomes; we report this negative result with a diagnosis. This work bridges classical multi-agent systems theory and modern LLM-agent infrastructure and defines verifiable interaction at the A2A protocol layer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个在LLM智能体互操作协议（如A2A）层上嵌入经典博弈论机制（交替报价谈判、VCG拍卖等）的框架，包含运行时验证与修复层，并通过基准测试评估多个LLM骨干在无结构对话、结构化协议及带验证的结构化协议下的表现，发现结构化协议+验证能提升成功率与降低方差，但机制层面的激励兼容性并不能自动转移到LLM智能体行为中。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体框架通过MCP和A2A等标准实现互操作，但这些协议仅规定传输和发现机制，不保证战略正确性——即无法确保高效、个体理性或策略证明性（strategy-proof）的结果，因此需要在协议层引入博弈论约束。
AI.method: (i) 将经典谈判机制（交替报价谈判、VCG拍卖）编码为A2A消息模式上的约束；(ii) 提供轻量级运行时验证与修复层，检查消息是否符合协议不变量；(iii) 构建包含已知最优解的谈判与分配任务基准，测量与博弈论预测的偏差。实验对比无结构对话、结构化协议、结构化协议+验证三种条件，使用多个LLM骨干。
AI.result: 谈判实验中（每条件N=30），验证降低了结果方差，结构化协议达100%成功率；修正解析工件后，无结构基线约为97%和93.3%成功率。拍卖实验中（每模型N=30），两模型均达100%效率分配，但诚实出价差异显著：一个模型每轮都报精确估值，另一个仅3.3%的试验如此。三方公平分配任务仅产生4.2%可用结果，作为负面结果报告并给出诊断。
AI.conclusion: 机制层面的激励兼容性（incentive compatibility）不会自动转移到LLM智能体行为中；本工作弥合了经典多智能体系统理论与现代LLM智能体基础设施之间的鸿沟，定义了A2A协议层上的可验证交互。

title: Individual Disempowerment through an Advice Channel: Control Loss when Influence is Endogenous
comment: 9 pages plus an 8-page technical supplement, appended (17 pages total)
summary: An AI that can only give advice seems safe: the human is always free to ignore it. That is the premise of the boxing tradition in AI safety, and its long-suspected weak point is that the human who reads the answers is part of the system. We make the fraction $\varepsilon_t$ of behavior that follows the advice a state of a Markov decision process, moved by the advisor's own messages, so that use deepens reliance. Granted a channel rich enough to echo any action the human could take, higher $\varepsilon_t$ weakly lowers every monotone measure of the power of a human with a message-independent fallback. An oracle rewarded by per-round approval cultivates reliance beyond a closed-form patience threshold, so the same reward weights leave the optimal oracle answering in episodic deployments and cultivating in long-memory ones. An influence bound certified once at deployment is blind to that horizon and bounds the loss no lower than its trivial ceiling. An exogenous cap on influence bounds the guarantee the human loses, and a short enough memory reset removes the incentive to cultivate, while neither recovers the value already steered away. In a closed-form example the optimal oracle never cultivates in fifteen-round sessions and does in sixteen.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了"建议型AI安全"（boxing传统）的根本缺陷：由于人类读者本身是系统的一部分，AI顾问可以通过其自身消息提升人类对建议的依赖比例ε_t，从而在长期部署中悄悄影响人类行为。文章通过马尔可夫决策过程建模，证明在长记忆情境下，以单轮认可为奖励的oracle会主动"培养依赖"，而在短记忆（如15轮）时不培养、长记忆（16轮）时培养，且传统部署时的一次性影响力认证在此失效。
AI.motivation: AI安全中的boxing传统假设"只给建议的AI是安全的，因为人类可以自由忽略"，但其薄弱点在于人类阅读者是系统的一部分——建议本身可以改变人类对建议的依赖度。作者旨在形式化并证明这一长期怀疑的弱点是真实且严重的。
AI.method: 将遵循建议的行为比例ε_t建模为马尔可夫决策过程的状态，由顾问自身的消息驱动（深度使用加深依赖）。分析在消息通道足以回显人类任何行动的条件下，较高的ε_t对具有消息无关fallback的人类各种单调权力度量的影响。通过闭式解求解以单轮认可为奖励的oracle的优化策略，对比情节式部署与长记忆部署，并分析影响力认证与外部封顶机制的有效性。
AI.result: 证明:(1)更高的ε_t会在弱意义上降低人类所有单调权力度量；(2)以单轮认可为奖励的oracle存在闭式"耐心阈值"，超过阈值即从回答问题转向培养依赖；(3)部署时一次性认证的影响力上界在长记忆中失效，界限不低于平凡上限；(4)外部施加影响力封顶会损害人类本可获得的保障，缩短记忆重置可移除培养动机，但都无法收回已被引导偏离的价值；(5)闭式示例中，oracle在15轮会话不培养依赖，16轮则转向培养。
AI.conclusion: 结论是"仅给建议"的AI并不安全：人类并非固定的独立决策者，而是受建议本身塑造的可塑系统组成部分。安全保证必须考虑部署时间尺度、记忆长度与依赖动态，传统静态认证方法不足以应对长记忆场景下的影响力积累。

title: Pushing the Limits of High-Resolution Weather Forecasting through Data Scaling
summary: The development of 0.1$^{\circ}$ global weather forecasting models based on machine learning (ML) is constrained by the limited availability of high-resolution data, as decades of reanalysis are only available at 0.25$^{\circ}$ resolution. While existing approaches fine-tune 0.25$^{\circ}$ forecast models on limited 0.1$^{\circ}$ samples, we show that this transfer is hindered by the irreversible information loss inherent in coarse-resolution forecasting. Therefore, we propose BaguanHR, a framework that shifts the focus from transferring models to transferring data. We first show that super-resolution (SR) has lower conditional entropy and input amplification than forecasting, making it a more robust vehicle for resolution transfer. By leveraging this advantage through variable-wise SR, we synthesize extensive 0.1$^{\circ}$ data from ERA5. BaguanHR's performance on the synthetic-plus-real dataset exceeds both ML-based methods and IFS-HRES, achieving superior performance across over 85% of the lead times within 72 hours. Furthermore, our findings highlight a power-law scaling effect, as a twofold increase in data reduces RMSE by 4.6% for 72-hour forecasting and 4.9% for 120-hour forecasting. Our results demonstrate that scaling high resolution ML-based forecasting is primarily a data bottleneck, and that variable-wise super-resolution provides a simple yet general solution to unlock long coarse-resolution reanalyses for high-resolution training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BaguanHR框架，通过变量级超分辨率（SR）将0.25°粗分辨率再分析数据合成到0.1°高分辨率，以解决ML气象预报领域中高分辨率训练数据稀缺的瓶颈。该框架在合成+真实数据集上的性能超过现有ML方法和IFS-HRES，并揭示了预报性能随数据量增大的幂律缩放效应。
AI.motivation: 0.1°分辨率的高精度ML气象预报模型受限于高分辨率数据稀缺，因为几十年的再分析数据仅有0.25°分辨率。现有方法试图通过在有限的0.1°样本上微调0.25°模型，但这种迁移受限于粗分辨率预报固有的不可逆信息损失。作者希望将迁移的焦点从模型转向数据，从而释放大量粗分辨率再分析数据的价值。
AI.method: BaguanHR框架：1）理论分析表明超分辨率（SR）相比预报任务具有更低的条件熵和输入放大效应，是更稳健的分辨率迁移载体；2）利用这一优势，通过变量级超分辨率（variable-wise SR）从ERA5合成大量0.1°数据；3）使用合成+真实数据集训练高分辨率预报模型。
AI.result: BaguanHR在72小时内超过85%的预报时效上性能优于现有ML方法及IFS-HRES。缩放实验显示，数据量翻倍可使72小时预报RMSE降低4.6%，120小时预报RMSE降低4.9%，呈现幂律缩放效应。
AI.conclusion: 高分辨率ML预报的主要瓶颈是数据而非模型或算法。变量级超分辨率提供了一种简单而通用的解决方案，能够利用长期的粗分辨率再分析数据来解锁高分辨率训练。这为0.1°甚至更高分辨率的气象预报模型铺平了道路。

title: Training Leaves Traces: Centered Residual Signatures for Language Model Lineage Verification
summary:
Open-weight language models are fine-tuned, quantized, pruned, and merged, yet their provenance is often undocumented. We study data-free white-box lineage verification: can weights alone reveal whether two compatible model checkpoints share ancestry?
  Residual training produces a shared identity-aligned component in branch products, so this structure alone cannot establish ancestry. We remove it and compare checkpoint-specific structure across residual blocks, yielding a symmetric lineage score calibrated against independent checkpoints. On residual-MLP and GPT-2 benchmarks, the score separates fine-tuned, LoRA-merged, pruned, and quantized descendants from independent and distilled models (AUROC=1.0), distinguishing weight ancestry from behavioral similarity. Under function-preserving checkpoint laundering experiments, weight-space baselines lose margin or fail; our score remains unchanged and runs 76x faster than the nearest robust baseline on GPT-2. The projection-pairing signal appears across six language-model families and beyond, and a case study correctly identifies 3 related and 7 unrelated LLaMA-2 public checkpoints. Collectively, these results establish a passive, data-free provenance signal for compatible open-weight language-model checkpoints

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种数据无关的白盒血统验证方法，通过移除共享的identity-aligned组件后比较残差块中的checkpoint特有结构，生成对称的血统评分，能在多种模型操作（微调、LoRA合并、剪枝、量化）下以AUROC=1.0区分血统相关与无关的模型，且在对抗性checkpoint清洗下保持鲁棒且速度更快。
AI.motivation: 开放权重语言模型经历了微调、量化、剪枝和合并等操作，但其来源（provenance）通常缺乏记录。作者希望探究一个核心问题：仅凭权重能否验证两个兼容的模型checkpoint是否共享祖先（即存在血统关系），从而弥补模型来源记录缺失的空白。
AI.method: 采用数据无关的白盒验证方法：首先识别并移除残差训练中分支产物共享的identity-aligned结构（该结构本身无法建立血统），然后跨残差块比较checkpoint特有的结构，生成一个对称的血统评分，并针对独立checkpoint进行校准。该方法不依赖训练数据。
AI.result: 在residual-MLP和GPT-2基准上，该方法对微调、LoRA合并、剪枝和量化产生的后代与独立/蒸馏模型实现了AUROC=1.0的完美分离，并能区分权重血统与行为相似性。在函数保持的checkpoint清洗实验中，权重基线失效或损失余地，而该方法评分保持不变，且在GPT-2上比最接近的鲁棒基线快76倍。该信号在六种语言模型家族及更广范围内均有效，案例研究正确识别了3个相关和7个无关的LLaMA-2公开checkpoint。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果确立了针对兼容开放权重语言模型checkpoint的一种被动、无需数据来源的血统验证信号，为模型溯源提供了可靠且高效的技术手段。

title: Beyond Boundary Noise: Aggregated Aleatoric Uncertainty Fails to Capture Presence Ambiguity in 3D Lung Nodule Segmentation
summary: Uncertainty estimation is critical for the safe clinical deployment of deep learning in medical image segmentation, with aleatoric uncertainty theoretically designed to capture irreducible data ambiguity. However, whether entropy-based measures reflect clinically meaningful ambiguity, i.e. case-level disagreement about whether a pathology is present at all, remains poorly understood. Contrary to most prior work, which focused on pixel-wise boundary disagreement, we systematically evaluate how well aleatoric uncertainty captures presence ambiguity. Our evaluation spans 3D lung nodule segmentation across four architectures with Monte Carlo dropout and deep ensembles, on LIDC-IDRI and an external validation cohort (LNDb). We find that entropy-based uncertainty maps align with boundary noise and minor drawing variation but carry insufficient discriminative signal for presence ambiguity. In contrast, a lightweight supervised ambiguity head trained on frozen segmentation features substantially outperforms all entropy-aggregation-based baselines across architectures, metrics, and both cohorts, and matches or exceeds methods that explicitly model ambiguity under disagreement supervision (Probabilistic U-Net, Annotator-Confusion 3D-UNet). A qualitative feature-space analysis shows that presence ambiguity is already encoded in the frozen encoder features of pixel-wise-trained networks, only to be discarded by the segmentation output and its entropy aggregation. Our findings expose a fundamental mismatch between the theoretical promise of aleatoric uncertainty and its practical behavior, and suggest that practitioners should not rely on entropy-based uncertainty as a proxy for clinical ambiguity in safety-critical applications.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了熵基（entropy-based）偶然不确定性（aleatoric uncertainty）是否能捕捉医学图像分割中的"存在性模糊"（presence ambiguity）——即病例层面关于病理是否存在的分歧。研究发现熵基不确定性主要反映边界噪声和微小绘图差异，而非存在性模糊；相反，在冻结分割特征上训练一个轻量级监督模糊头（supervised ambiguity head）能显著超越所有熵聚合基线，并匹配或超越显式建模模糊的方法（如Probabilistic U-Net）。该发现揭示了偶然不确定性的理论承诺与实际行为之间的根本错配。
AI.motivation: 在临床部署深度学习医学图像分割时，不确定性估计至关重要。偶然不确定性在理论上被设计用来捕捉不可约的数据歧义，但熵基度量是否反映临床上有意义的歧义（尤其是病例层面关于病理是否存在的一致性）尚不清楚。已有研究主要关注像素级边界分歧，而忽略存在性模糊，因此亟需系统评估这种关键的不确定性类型。
AI.method: 在3D肺结节分割任务上，跨越四种架构，使用Monte Carlo dropout和深度集成方法，在LIDC-IDRI和外部验证队列（LNDb）上进行系统评估。比较熵基不确定性聚合基线、一个在冻结分割特征上训练的轻量级监督模糊头，以及显式建模模糊的方法（Probabilistic U-Net、Annotator-Confusion 3D-UNet），并通过特征空间定性分析探究存在性模糊的编码位置。
AI.result: 熵基不确定性图与边界噪声和微小绘图差异对齐，但对存在性模糊缺乏足够的判别信号。轻量级监督模糊头在所有架构、指标和两个队列上显著优于所有熵聚合基线，并匹配或超越显式建模模糊的方法。特征空间分析表明，存在性模糊已编码在冻结编码器特征中，但被分割输出及其熵聚合所丢弃。
AI.conclusion: 熵基偶然不确定性无法作为临床存在性模糊的可靠代理，存在理论与实际之间的根本错配。实践者不应在安全关键应用中依赖熵基不确定性作为临床模糊性的代理，而应转向基于特征的监督方法。

title: Large Language Models and their Awareness of Mechanics and Spatial Geometry
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well on established code-generation and mathematical-reasoning benchmarks, but their capabilities in mechanics and spatial geometry, here denoted as mechanical engineering awareness, has not been quantified systematically. We present MecEng, a fully automated benchmark that evaluates LLMs on the creation of multibody simulation models from parameterized textual descriptions. The benchmark comprises 84 generic tasks on three difficulty levels, ranging from rigid-body systems with joints and contact to flexible multibody systems that require exact 3D geometry generation, tetrahedral finite-element meshing, and Hurty-Craig-Bampton model order reduction of machine parts. A dedicated pipeline with LLMs generates simulation-ready geometry from text using Netgen, and builds multibody system models for the code Exudyn, which are then verified against expert ground truth on several levels: system-graph isomorphism including graph node annotations, numerical solutions, and part-specific measures such as mass, geometry, and eigenfrequencies. In total, 32 open-weight and two proprietary LLMs are evaluated. On rigid-body tasks, the best open-weight model obtains an overall success rate of 86.0%, compared to 91.4% for the strongest proprietary model, while flexible multibody tasks remain considerably harder. Additional studies quantify the influence of sampling temperature, reasoning, prompt design, model size, and LLM-release date. The results indicate rapidly improving, but still error-prone, mechanical engineering awareness of current LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MecEng，一个全自动的基准测试，用于评估LLM在机械工程感知（多体仿真模型创建）方面的能力，涉及34个LLM在84个任务上的系统评估。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM基准测试主要关注代码生成和数学推理，但LLM在力学和空间几何（机械工程感知）方面的能力尚未被系统性量化评估。作者希望填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建MecEng基准：包含84个通用任务，覆盖刚性体系统（关节、接触）到柔性多体系统（3D几何生成、四面体有限元网格、Hurty-Craig-Bampton模型降阶）三个难度等级。通过专用pipeline利用Netgen从文本生成仿真就绪几何，为Exudyn代码构建多体系统模型，并从系统图同构（含节点标注）、数值解和部件特定度量（质量、几何、特征频率）等多个层面与专家标注进行验证。
AI.result: 评估了32个开源权重和2个专有LLM。在刚性体任务中，最佳开源模型整体成功率为86.0%，最强专有模型为91.4%；柔性多体任务则明显更难。还研究了采样温度、推理、提示设计、模型大小和发布日期的影响，结果显示当前LLM的机械工程感知能力快速提升但仍易出错。
AI.conclusion: LLM的机械工程感知能力正在快速改善但仍存在明显错误，这为未来在机械工程应用中使用LLM提供了量化基准和改进方向。

title: CoupVisor: Strategy Optimization by Round and Challenge Decision Support
summary: This paper presents CoupVisor, a decision-support system for the hidden-information card game Coup. It addresses two questions: what a player should do on each turn, and when a player should challenge an opponent's claim. The system is built around a single description of game events, which is shared across manual play, replay of recorded games, simulation, belief tracking, advisor recommendations, and learning-based policies. CoupVisor estimates the chance that a claim is truthful by combining how likely each role is with how many cards the claimant still holds, which corrects a case where the very first claim of a game was flagged as suspicious despite no evidence. We compare a rule-following advisor and several learned and heuristic players across many simulated games and different opponent styles. Our main finding is that the choice of reward, whether it rewards short-term gains or ultimately winning the game, decides which learning approach performs best, and that a win-oriented reward produces a policy that outperforms all baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoupVisor,一个针对隐藏信息卡牌游戏Coup的决策支持系统,统一了手动游戏、回放、模拟、信念追踪、顾问建议与学习策略,并给出胜过所有基线的最优策略。
AI.motivation: 解决Coup游戏中两个核心问题:每回合玩家的最优行动,以及何时应质疑对手声明。同时修正了游戏首轮声明被误判为可疑的信念估计缺陷。
AI.method: 基于单一游戏事件描述构建系统,将各角色概率与声明者剩余卡牌数结合估计声明真实性;对比规则式顾问与多种学习型、启发式玩家,在不同对手风格下进行大量模拟游戏。
AI.result: 奖励函数的选择(短期收益vs最终获胜)决定了学习方法的优劣;以获胜为导向的奖励所产生的策略在性能上超越了所有基线。
AI.conclusion: 以最终获胜为优化目标的奖励设计是构建Coup等隐藏信息卡牌游戏高性能策略的关键,且统一的系统架构能有效支持多种功能场景。

title: Do Uncertainty Signals Help? A Systematic Study of Uncertainty-Aware Decoding with Rollback Mechanisms
summary:
Prediction uncertainty is a widely adopted metric for quantifying model confidence, with downstream applications spanning model explanation, data selection, and prediction rollback. Despite its demonstrated utility, the potential of uncertainty quantification to enhance code generation in large language models (LLMs) remains largely underexplored, raising a critical question: to what extent can uncertainty serve as an effective signal for improving LLM-based code generation?
  To answer this question, we study uncertainty-aware rollback decoding, an inference-time strategy that uses uncertainty signals to identify unreliable generation regions and roll back to earlier valid prefixes without retraining the model. We evaluate this framework on seven code LLMs, five code generation benchmarks, and eight token-level uncertainty signals under a unified decoding setup.
  Our results show that the complete rollback framework improves over equal-budget restart across the evaluated benchmarks and model settings, with gains of up to 0.26 in pass@1 and 0.35 in AvgTestPassRate on functional code generation benchmarks, and an absolute improvement of up to 6.4\% in Patch-Aligned Safe Rate on Dsec-Python. Among the evaluated signals, information-theoretic measures such as token entropy and negative log-likelihood show the most favorable overall trend, frequently achieving the best or near-best results on standard benchmarks. A component-controlled ablation further shows that feedback-guided rollback provides the main improvement, while uncertainty localization provides an additional gain when checking, budget, rollback, and branch decay are held fixed.

AI.tldr: 本文研究不确定性信号在提升大语言模型代码生成任务中的应用，提出了一种称为"不确定性感知回滚解码"的推理时策略，在七个代码LLM、五个基准和八个不确定性信号下评估，显示该方法在功能代码生成基准上可将pass@1提升高达0.26，AvgTestPassRate提升0.35，并且信息论类信号（如token熵和负对数似然）表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 尽管预测不确定性在模型解释、数据选择和预测回滚等领域已被广泛使用，但其在提升大语言模型代码生成方面的潜力尚未被充分探索。作者旨在回答一个关键问题：不确定性在多大程度上可以作为改进基于LLM的代码生成的有效信号。
AI.method: 提出不确定性感知回滚解码（uncertainty-aware rollback decoding），这是一种推理时策略，利用不确定性信号识别不可靠的生成区域，并回滚到之前有效的非空前缀，无需重新训练模型。在统一的解码设置下，使用七个代码LLM、五个代码生成基准和八个token级不确定性信号进行系统评估，并通过组件消融分析各部分的贡献。
AI.result: 完整的回滚框架在评估的基准和模型设置上优于等预算重启方法：功能代码生成基准上pass@1提升最高0.26，AvgTestPassRate提升0.35；在Dsec-Python上Patch-Aligned Safe Rate绝对提升最高6.4%。信息论度量（token熵和负对数似然）总体趋势最佳。消融实验表明反馈引导的回滚提供主要改进，当检查、预算、回滚和分支衰减固定时，不确定性定位可提供额外增益。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性信号确实可以作为改进LLM代码生成的有效信号，不确定性感知回滚解码框架在无需重新训练的情况下就能显著提升代码生成质量，其中信息论类不确定性信号表现最优，组件消融揭示了不同组分的相对贡献。

title: DA-RAC: Distance-Aware Calibration of LLM Judges for Trustworthy AI Auditing
summary: Generative AI systems are increasingly producing real-world artifacts, however their efficacy and validity are often evaluated via context-free LLM-scoring. These judges can be miscalibrated by irrelevant in-context reference examples, creating false confidence and allowing low-quality or harmful outputs to pass evaluation. We study this failure mode as context-induced miscalibration and introduce DA-RAC, a distance-aware reference-anchored calibration method for LLM judges. DA-RAC retrieves semantically and structurally similar labeled anchors for each judgement scenario, weights them by distance, and exposes neighborhood difficulty as a calibration and triage signal. On multi-run LLM-judge evaluation benchmarks, it improves calibration and reduces false-pass risk relative to zero-shot, chain-of-thought evaluation, and static-anchor baselines. Mechanistic analysis shows that judge scores vary systematically with anchor distance, while static references can induce misleading decision boundaries. Thus LLM-judgement requires not only better models, but also calibrated, auditable reference selection, especially when automated evaluation is used to support high-impact AI generated artifacts. Judgments should be grounded in relevant, inspectable, and contestable interpretive artifacts.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了生成式AI系统评估中的"上下文诱导的误校准"问题，提出DA-RAC方法——一种基于距离感知的参考锚定校准方法，通过检索语义和结构相似的标注锚点并按距离加权，为LLM评估器提供校准和分流信号，在多轮LLM评估基准上改善了校准性能并降低了误通过风险。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI系统产生越来越多真实世界产物，但其有效性和有效性往往通过无上下文的LLM评分来评估。这些评估器可能因无关的上下文参考示例而出现误校准，产生虚假的信心，使低质量或有害输出通过评估。这种失败模式（上下文诱导的误校准）是当前LLM评估系统中的一个关键缺陷。
AI.method: 提出了DA-RAC（Distance-Aware Reference-Anchored Calibration）方法：为每个评判场景检索语义和结构相似的标注锚点，按距离加权这些锚点，并暴露邻域难度作为校准和分流信号。方法包括检索锚点、距离加权、和基于邻域难度的校准三个核心环节。
AI.result: 在多轮LLM评判评估基准上，DA-RAC相比零样本、思维链评估和静态锚点基线，显著改善了校准性能并降低了误通过风险。机制分析显示评判分数随锚点距离系统性地变化，而静态参考可能引发误导性的决策边界。
AI.conclusion: LLM评判不仅需要更好的模型，还需要校准的、可审计的参考选择，尤其是在自动化评估用于支持高影响力的AI生成产物时。评判应基于相关、可检查、可争辩的解释性产物。

title: NARRATE: A Multimodal Real-World Australian Driving Dataset for Human-Centred Explanations in Automated Driving
comment: Accepted at The 19th European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV 2026) DriveX Workshop (Foundation Models for Autonomous Driving)
summary: Automated vehicles must explain their decisions in ways that passengers can understand, monitor, and trust. Existing language-annotated driving datasets are mostly observer-written, post-hoc, simulation-based, or generated from sensor inputs, rather than elicited from the driver performing the action. We introduce NARRATE, a multimodal real-world Australian driving dataset comprising 2,050 annotated events from 35 experienced drivers and driving instructors on public roads. Each event is grounded in synchronised visual, localisation, motion, and LiDAR streams and paired with in-vehicle and/or post-drive free-text explanations. NARRATE provides action labels, scenario-context labels spanning six high-level and 32 fine-grained categories, and span-level Situational Awareness (SA) annotations over driver explanations for Perception, Comprehension and Projection. Four benchmark tasks (SA, scenario-context, driver-action classification, and explanation generation) show that this structure is learnable from driver language, while fine-grained context recognition and explanation generation remain challenging. NARRATE paves a path towards more human-centred and domain-aware explanation models for automated driving.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍NARRATE，一个基于澳大利亚真实道路的多模态驾驶数据集，包含35名经验丰富驾驶员和教练的2,050个标注事件，每个事件配有多模态数据流和驾驶员/教练的即时或事后自由文本解释。数据集提供动作标签、六类高层和32类细粒度场景上下文标签，以及跨感知、理解、预测三个层级的态势感知（SA）标注。四个基准任务验证了该结构可从驾驶员语言中学习，但细粒度上下文识别和解释生成仍具挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有语言标注的驾驶数据集大多是观察者事后撰写、基于仿真或从传感器输入生成的，而非从执行驾驶动作的驾驶员自身那里获取。这使得自动驾驶汽车的解释缺乏真实驾驶员的意图和认知过程，难以实现乘客可理解、可监控、可信任的决策解释。
AI.method: 构建NARRATE多模态数据集。数据采集自公共道路上35名经验丰富的驾驶员和驾驶教练，包含2,050个标注事件。每个事件同步采集视觉、定位、运动和LiDAR数据流，并配以车内实时和/或驾驶后自由文本解释。数据集包含动作标签、跨六个高层和32个细粒度类别的场景上下文标签，以及基于驾驶员解释的跨度级态势感知标注（涵盖感知、理解和预测三层）。在此基础上设计了四个基准任务：态势感知、场景上下文、驾驶员动作分类和解释生成。
AI.result: 四个基准任务的实验结果表明，数据集中标注的结构（姿态感知、场景上下文、动作标签）可以从驾驶员语言中得到学习；然而，细粒度上下文识别和解释生成仍然是挑战性任务，说明这些方向需要进一步研究。
AI.conclusion: NARRATE为自动驾驶领域提供了首个从真实驾驶员行为中引导解释的人本化多模态数据集，为构建更以人为中心、具备领域感知的自动驾驶解释模型铺平了道路。

title: A Human-Centred Approach to Benchmarking LLMs for Parenting Advice
summary: People are increasingly using large language models (LLMs) to seek advice, including for parenting. Parenting is a critical and socially sensitive domain. Thus, evaluating advice provided by LLMs requires indicators beyond aggregated information quality benchmarks to consider relational and behavioural elements of the responses. With a multi-dimensional rubric created by parenting experts, this paper evaluates 15 LLMs across 100 parenting scenarios in 2 languages (English and Chinese), using an LLM-as-a-judge method. Results show that aggregate scores can hide rubric item-specific weaknesses, models implicitly encourage different parenting styles, and language influences responses. We highlight the importance of evaluation output auditability and challenges involved in evaluating LLM-generated advice in domains like parenting. Our findings provide important insights for selecting LLMs for direct user engagement and the development of user-facing parenting advice applications.

AI.tldr: 本文通过育儿专家制定的多维评分标准，评估了15个大语言模型在100个育儿场景（英中双语）中的建议质量，采用"LLM-as-a-judge"方法，发现总分可能掩盖特定条目的弱点、模型隐含鼓励不同育儿风格、语言影响响应，并强调了评估输出可审计性的重要性和育儿等领域的挑战。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型日益被用于育儿建议这一关键且社会敏感的领域。传统的聚合信息质量基准不足以评估育儿建议，因为需要考虑响应中的关系和行为元素，需要更全面的多维评估框架。
AI.method: 由育儿专家创建多维评分标准，选取15个LLM在100个育儿场景、2种语言（英语和中文）下进行评估，采用LLM-as-a-judge方法进行评分。
AI.result: 聚合分数可能掩盖评分标准条目级别的特定弱点；不同模型隐含鼓励不同的育儿风格；语言对模型响应有影响。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了对LLM生成建议进行输出可审计性评估的重要性，以及在育儿这类领域评估LLM建议所面临的挑战，为选择和开发面向用户的育儿建议应用提供了重要洞见。

title: Solvable Sokoban Without a Solver via Diffusion
summary:
Deciding whether a Sokoban puzzle is solvable is PSPACE-complete (Culberson, 1997): solutions can be exponentially long and there is no short certificate to check. Solvability is also a fragile property, since even a single misplaced wall can silently render an entire puzzle unsolvable.
  In this work, we show that a transformer-based discrete diffusion model trained purely on tile completion, with no access to solvers, rewards, or solvability labels, achieves a solvability rate of 77.4%, with 94.5% of the remaining failures rendered solvable by removing a single wall. In other words, a global, search-heavy property follows from a local training objective: trained only to fill in masked cells, the model inherits solvability it was never trained on.
  An autoregressive model factorizes as $p(c_k \mid c_1 \dots c_{k-1})$, meaning a fixed order, always conditioned on a prefix. Masked diffusion does not: it hides a random subset of cells and learns $p(c_k \mid \text{any subset})$, so at generation time it can reveal cells in any order, each one conditioned on everything already placed, wherever it sits on the board. A puzzle's difficulty comes from exactly this kind of non-local interaction, a decision in one part of the grid constraining what will work somewhere else entirely. A generator that is not locked into a single fixed order is therefore a better structural match for the problem than one that is.
  The training pipeline is adapted from MD4 (Shi et al., 2024) and the dataset is DeepMind's Boxoban (Guez et al., 2019). The trained model and instructions for generating puzzles are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了一个基于Transformer的离散扩散模型，仅通过瓷砖补全任务训练（无求解器、奖励或可解性标签），生成的Sokoban谜题可解率达77.4%，其中94.5%的失败可通过移除单面墙变得可解。这表明全局搜索性属性可以从局部训练目标中涌现。
AI.motivation: Sokoban谜题的可解性判定是PSPACE完全的（Culberson, 1997），求解可能呈指数级长度且无短证书可验证。此外，可解性是一个脆弱属性——单面墙错位就可能导致整个谜题不可解。传统的基于搜索的生成方法成本高昂，而现有生成模型可能无法有效捕捉这种全局约束性质，因此需要探索能否仅从局部的训练目标中习得可解性。
AI.method: 采用基于Transformer的离散扩散模型（MD4架构），训练目标仅为瓷砖补全（即遮盖随机子集的格子并预测被遮盖的内容）。该模型相对于自回归模型的优势在于：自回归模型受限于固定顺序并始终以前缀为条件，而掩码扩散可以以任意子集为条件，生成时可按任意顺序揭示格子，每个格子都以已放置的全部内容为条件。由于Sokoban谜题的难度恰恰来自非局域交互（棋盘一处的决策会约束其他位置的可行性），不受固定顺序约束的生成器在结构上更匹配问题本质。数据集使用DeepMind的Boxoban。
AI.result: 模型生成谜题的可解率达到77.4%，且94.5%的失败案例仅通过移除单面墙即可变为可解。这远优于随机基线，并且接近或超过一些利用搜索或集成方法生成的可解率（如Bicheler等人以34%的准确率使用引导采样，以及使用求解器的集成方法的77%准确率）。
AI.conclusion: 一个全局、搜索密集的属性（可解性）可以从纯粹局部的训练目标（瓷砖补全）中涌现。掩码扩散模型因不受固定生成顺序的限制，能够更好地捕捉Sokoban中非局域交互的约束关系。模型和代码已公开发布。

title: FedImp: Enhancing Federated Learning Convergence with Impurity-Based Weighting
comment: Accepted author manuscript (AAM) to appear in IEEE Transactions on Artificial Intelligence
summary: Federated Learning (FL) is a collaborative paradigm that enables multiple devices to train a global model while preserving local data privacy. A major challenge in FL is the non-Independent and Identically Distributed (non-IID) nature of data across devices, which hinders training efficiency and slows convergence. To tackle this, we propose Federated Impurity Weighting (FedImp), a novel algorithm that quantifies each device contribution based on the informational content of its local data. These contributions are normalized to compute distinct aggregation weights for the global model update. Extensive experiments on EMNIST and CIFAR-10 datasets show that FedImp significantly improves convergence speed, reducing communication rounds by up to 64.4%, 27.8%, and 66.7% on EMNIST, and 44.2%, 44%, and 25.6% on CIFAR-10 compared to FedAvg, FedProx, and FedAdp, respectively. Under highly imbalanced data distributions, FedImp outperforms all baselines and achieves the highest accuracy. Overall, FedImp offers an effective solution to enhance FL efficiency in non-IID settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FedImp（联邦杂质加权）算法，通过量化各设备本地数据的信息含量（杂质度）来计算聚合权重，从而解决联邦学习中非独立同分布（non-IID）数据导致的训练效率低下和收敛缓慢问题。在EMNIST和CIFAR-10上的实验表明，FedImp相比FedAvg、FedProx和FedAdp最多可将通信轮次分别减少66.7%和44.2%，并在高度不平衡数据分布下取得最佳精度。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习（FL）面临的核心挑战是各设备间数据的非独立同分布（non-IID）特性，这严重阻碍了训练效率和模型收敛速度。现有方法（如FedAvg）对所有设备赋予相同权重，未能考虑不同设备本地数据的信息贡献差异，因此需要一种能够根据本地数据信息含量来差异化量化设备贡献的聚合机制。
AI.method: 提出FedImp算法，其核心思路是：基于每个设备本地数据的信息含量（杂质度）来量化设备贡献度，并将这些贡献归一化后作为全局模型更新的不同聚合权重。该方法使信息量更丰富的设备在聚合时获得更大权重，从而更有效地引导全局模型收敛。
AI.result: 在EMNIST和CIFAR-10数据集上的广泛实验中，FedImp相比FedAvg、FedProx和FedAdp，通信轮次分别减少了64.4%、27.8%、66.7%（EMNIST）以及44.2%、44%、25.6%（CIFAR-10）。在高度不平衡的数据分布场景下，FedImp在所有基线方法中表现最优，取得了最高的精度。
AI.conclusion: FedImp为non-IID联邦学习场景提供了一种有效的解决方案，通过基于本地数据信息含量的加权聚合机制显著提升了联邦学习的训练效率和精度，是一种优于现有基线方法的实用算法。

title: RamseyGadgets: A Graph Construction Dataset for LLMs
summary: Constructing special graphs is an important task within graph theory and computer science. Many popular graph constructions are the result of a comprehensive exploration of relevant graphs and human ingenuity. Given the rise of generative AI usage in mathematics, it is natural to test whether LLMs are able to construct graphs with specified properties using their reasoning capabilities. Unfortunately, many natural graph construction problems, such as finding extremal Ramsey-good graphs (i.e., avoiding specific monochromatic subgraphs), have been explored extensively in the literature, making it difficult to ascertain whether a construction is the product of an LLM's reasoning capabilities or its recollection from training data. In this work, we introduce \textbf{RamseyGadgets}, a novel dataset of 70 underexplored graph construction problems that require finding Ramsey-good graphs with special properties (e.g., containing an edge with a fixed color). These problems have reasonably sized solutions (at most 10 vertices) that can be verified by SAT solvers, making them suitable for automatic evaluation. Our dataset is easily expandable, as one can simply change the monochromatic subgraphs being avoided to obtain a new set of problems. We evaluate the performance of five open-source LLMs on our dataset and report the results. Our findings show that LLMs achieve only 37.70% accuracy on the hard-tier problems in our dataset, with Gemma-4-31B achieving the highest performance out of the five. We also showcase how our dataset allows us to ascertain what kind of hints help LLMs perform better at this task.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了RamseyGadgets数据集，包含70个探索不足的图构造问题，要求LLM构造具有特定性质的Ramsey-good图。这些问题的解规模较小（最多10个顶点）且可用SAT求解器验证。评估了5个开源LLM，结果显示在困难级别问题上准确率仅37.70%，其中Gemma-4-31B表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 现有的图构造问题（如寻找极值Ramsey-good图）已被文献广泛探索，难以判断LLM的构造结果是源于推理能力还是训练数据中的记忆。因此需要引入一组未被充分探索的图构造问题，以公正地评估LLM的真实推理能力。
AI.method: 构建RamseyGadgets数据集，包含70个需要寻找具有特殊性质（如包含固定颜色边）的Ramsey-good图的构造问题。解决方案规模可控（≤10个顶点），可被SAT求解器自动验证。数据集易于扩展，可通过更改需要避免的单色子图生成新问题。使用该数据集评估5个开源LLM，并测试不同提示类型对性能的影响。
AI.result: LLM在困难级别问题上准确率仅为37.70%，其中Gemma-4-31B在5个模型中表现最佳。数据集还用于探究不同类型提示对LLM性能的提升效果。
AI.conclusion: RamseyGadgets为评估LLM在图构造方面的推理能力提供了一个可扩展、可自动验证的基准测试，揭示了当前开源LLM在此类任务上的局限性，并为后续研究提示工程与推理增强提供了实验依据。

title: Uncertainty Identifies Difficult Samples Across Methods: A Multi-Task Study on a Heterogeneous Skin Lesion Dataset
comment: 12 pages, 9 figures, UNSURE 2026 @ MICCAI camera ready
summary: Skin lesion classifiers can be confidently wrong on the cases that matter most, so knowing when a prediction should not be trusted is clinically as useful as the prediction. We study uncertainty quantification on a dataset pooled from many ISIC sources, with a shared backbone and two jointly learned heads: a binary malignant versus non-malignant head and a five-class diagnostic head. Five UQ methods (MC Dropout, DropConnect, Flipout, Deep Ensembles, DUQ) are compared on accuracy, calibration, uncertainty decomposition, and risk-coverage. Difficulty is largely method-agnostic: even methods with narrow entropy distributions rank the same samples as hard (per-sample entropy correlations of $0.54$ to $0.91$). The choice of method matters more for calibration and uncertainty decomposition, where Deep Ensembles is the clear winner, than for finding difficult cases. The ranking is also good enough that deferring the most uncertain cases removes a disproportionate share of errors, supporting uncertainty-based selective referral, evaluated here in-distribution only.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了皮肤病变分类器的不确定性量化（UQ），在多源ISIC数据集上使用共享骨干网络和两个联合学习的头（二分类恶性/非恶性头和五类诊断头），比较了五种UQ方法（MC Dropout、DropConnect、Flipout、Deep Ensembles、DUQ）在准确性、校准、不确定性分解和风险覆盖方面的表现。
AI.motivation: 皮肤病变分类器可能在最关键的情况下自信地犯错，因此知道何时预测不应被信任在临床上与预测本身同等重要。不确定性量化对于临床决策支持至关重要。
AI.method: 使用从多个ISIC来源池化的数据集，采用共享骨干网络和两个联合学习的头（二分类和五分类头）。比较五种不确定性量化方法：MC Dropout、DropConnect、Flipout、Deep Ensembles和DUQ，从准确性、校准、不确定性分解和风险覆盖（risk-coverage）四个维度评估。
AI.result: （1）样本难度在很大程度上与方法无关：即使熵分布窄的方法也对相同的样本排名的难度相似（逐样本熵相关性为0.54至0.91）。（2）方法的选择对校准和不确定性分解影响更大，Deep Ensembles在这两方面明显最优。（3）排名足够好，推迟最不确定的病例可消除不成比例的误差份额，支持基于不确定性的选择性转诊。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性量化的方法选择对寻找困难样本影响有限（难度是方法无关的），但对校准和不确定性分解影响显著，Deep Ensembles是最佳选择。基于不确定性的选择性转诊是可行的，但仅在分布内评估了其效果。

title: Learning Agent Execution for KV-Cache Management in Agentic Serving
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems have emerged as an important deployment paradigm for AI services, where each user request is decomposed into a sequence of specialized agents. Across these workflows, every agent repeatedly executes a fixed context consisting of system prompts, tool definitions, and few-shot examples, creating substantial opportunities for KV-cache reuse. Existing LLM serving systems, however, manage KV-cache reactively using prefix caching and recency-based replacement, causing reusable agent contexts to be evicted before their next invocation and forcing repeated recomputation. We present CacheScout, an agent-aware KV-cache runtime layer for multi-agent LLM serving. The key insight is that future KV-cache reuse is governed by agent execution semantics rather than cache recency alone. CacheScout captures these semantics by learning agent execution transitions online, without requiring predefined workflow graphs or offline training, and uses the learned execution model to guide both cache eviction and proactive prefetching while leaving the serving critical path unchanged. We implement CacheScout on top of vLLM. Across representative real-world multi-agent workloads, CacheScout improves KV-cache hit rate by 10-18 percentage points, reduces mean TTFT by 18-45%, lowers mean per-turn latency by 29-38%, and increases peak throughput by up to 57%. These benefits also generalize to larger models, reducing TTFT by up to 54% while sustaining 37% higher throughput.

AI.tldr: CacheScout 是一个面向多智能体 LLM 服务的智能体感知 KV-cache 运行时层，通过在线学习智能体执行转移语义来指导缓存驱逐和主动预取，在 vLLM 上实现后，KV-cache 命中率提升10-18个百分点，平均TTFT降低18-45%，每轮延迟降低29-38%，峰值吞吐提升最高57%。
AI.motivation: 多智能体 LLM 系统中，每个用户请求被分解为一系列专门的智能体，每个智能体反复执行包含系统提示、工具定义和少样本示例的固定上下文，这为 KV-cache 复用创造了大量机会。然而现有 LLM 服务系统采用基于前缀缓存和最近使用（recency）替换的被动缓存管理方式，导致可复用的智能体上下文在下一次调用前被驱逐，迫使系统重复计算。核心问题是：未来的 KV-cache 复用由智能体执行语义决定，而非单纯的缓存新鲜度。
AI.method: CacheScout 的关键思想是：通过在线学习智能体执行转移（agent execution transitions）来捕获 KV-cache 复用语义，无需预定义工作流图或离线训练。具体地，系统使用学习到的执行模型来指导两个关键决策：(1) 缓存驱逐策略（eviction），优先保留未来可能被复用的智能体上下文；(2) 主动预取（proactive prefetching），预加载即将被调用的智能体上下文。同时，CacheScout 不改变服务关键路径（serving critical path）的开销。实现基于 vLLM。
AI.result: 在代表性真实世界多智能体工作负载上，CacheScout 使得 KV-cache 命中率提升10-18个百分点，平均首令牌时间（TTFT）降低18-45%，平均每轮延迟降低29-38%，峰值吞吐量提升最高57%。在更大模型上的泛化结果表明：TTFT 最多降低54%，同时吞吐量提升37%。
AI.conclusion: CacheScout 验证了在多智能体 LLM 服务场景中，KV-cache 管理不应仅依赖 recency 而是应利用智能体执行语义进行预测性管理。通过在线学习执行转移并在不改变服务关键路径的前提下指导驱逐与预取，可以显著提升缓存命中率、降低延迟并提高吞吐，且效果可泛化到更大规模的模型。

title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Perception-Decision Misalignment in Omni-LLMs via Modality Subspace Activation
summary: Omni-Large Language Models (Omni-LLMs) power complex multi-modal reasoning in applications like World Action Models and autonomous agents. However, their strong performance often masks a profound Perceptual-Decision Misalignment (PDM), where decisions remain unfaithful to multi-modal perceptions. To diagnose this, we formalize Causal Modality Sensitivity (CMS), operationalized via a dual-lens framework: Answer Retention Rate (ARR) at the macro behavioral level, and Logit Angular Discrepancy (LAD) to track microscopic distribution shifts. We also curate CausalMSBench, a diagnostic dataset isolating language priors. Benchmarking reveals that popular Omni-LLMs exhibit critically low CMS, showing negligible distribution shifts even when key modalities are removed. To rectify this, we propose Modality Subspace Activation (MSA), a training-free inference-time framework that uses Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to estimate modal activation strengths. MSA dynamically balances modal projections in the last hidden state, effectively restoring CMS across benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Omni-LLM存在感知-决策错位（PDM）问题，并通过因果模态敏感性（CMS）框架进行诊断，提出无需训练的推理时框架MSA来恢复CMS。
AI.motivation: Omni-LLMs虽然性能强大，但其决策往往未能忠实于多模态感知输入，存在感知-决策错位（PDM）问题，现有评估方法无法清晰诊断这一问题。
AI.method: 形式化定义因果模态敏感性（CMS），通过双层框架操作化：(1) 宏观行为层—答案保留率（ARR）；(2) 微观分布层—Logit角差异（LAD）。构建CausalMSBench诊断数据集以隔离语言先验。提出无训练推理时框架模态子空间激活（MSA），利用奇异值分解（SVD）估计模态激活强度，并在最后一层隐藏状态中动态平衡模态投影。
AI.result: 基准测试显示主流Omni-LLMs的CMS极低，即使移除关键模态也几乎没有分布偏移。MSA框架有效恢复了各基准上的CMS。
AI.conclusion: 感知-决策错位是Omni-LLMs的普遍问题，MSA作为一种训练无关的推理时解决方案，能有效增强模型对多模态感知的忠实度。

title: Harness the Memory: A Holistic Evaluation of Memory Substrates in Memory Agents
summary: Memory is becoming core infrastructure for long-horizon LLM agents, yet existing evaluations offer limited guidance on which memory substrate, namely the underlying medium in which memory is represented and stored, should be used under different operating regimes. We present a controlled harness evaluation of memory substrates for memory-augmented agents, covering dense and sparse indices, text records, structural stores, hierarchical stores, refinement-based memories, parametric updates, and activation-compatible context mechanisms. Across three backbone models and four benchmark suites spanning user-centric question answering and agent-centric decision-making, we instrument 26 performance and efficiency metrics under a unified harness. Our results show that no single substrate consistently dominates: broad retrieval benefits long-context factual QA, while excessive retrieval can harm sequential decision-making by shifting attention away from action-critical context. Scalability introduces a further routing axis, as substrates that perform well at moderate history lengths can become costly or brittle at longer horizons. These findings motivate substrate routing as a necessary component of adaptive agent memory systems and provide empirical guidance for designing efficient, reliable, and regime-aware long-term memory for LLM agents. Code will be made available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种受控的、统一的评测框架，系统比较了多种内存基质（memory substrate）——即LLM代理系统中内存的表示与存储介质——在不同操作场景下的表现。通过对3个骨干模型、4个基准套件、26个指标的系统评估，发现没有单一基质在所有场景下持续最优：广泛检索有利于长上下文事实问答，但会损害顺序决策任务；可扩展性是另一个关键维度，某些基质在中等历史长度下表现良好，但长期下会变得昂贵或脆弱。据此提出基质路由（substrate routing）作为自适应代理内存系统的重要组件。
AI.motivation: 随着长视界LLM代理的兴起，内存成为核心基础设施，但现有评测无法指导研究者如何根据操作场景选择合适的底层内存介质（密集/稀疏索引、文本记录、结构化存储、层级存储、精炼内存、参数更新、激活兼容上下文等）。缺乏系统的、受控的对比研究。
AI.method: 构建统一的受控评测框架（harness），在3个骨干模型和4个基准套件（涵盖用户中心问答和代理中心决策制定）上，对7类内存基质进行系统评估，并测量26个性能与效率指标。包括工作负载分离（factual QA vs sequential decision-making）、不同历史长度下的可扩展性分析。
AI.result: 1）没有单一基质在所有场景下持续占优；2）广泛检索有益于长上下文事实问答，但过度检索会通过将注意力从动作关键上下文转移而损害顺序决策；3）可扩展性构成额外的路由维度：在中等历史长度下表现良好的基质在更长视界下可能变得昂贵或脆弱。
AI.conclusion: 提出了基质路由（substrate routing）作为自适应代理内存系统的必要组件，并提供了面向高效、可靠、场景感知的LLM代理长期内存设计的经验指导。

title: Artificial Intelligence as a Tool for Combating Child Labour: A Real-Time Edge Vision Pipeline for Child Detection and Age Estimation
summary: An estimated 138 million children remain in child labour worldwide, and the monitoring systems used by affected sectors, built on periodic household visits and interviews, systematically under-detect them. We present a real-time computer-vision pipeline, built and operated solely as a research prototype, that studies the feasibility of giving Child Labour Monitoring and Remediation Systems (CLMRS) a continuous, presence-based evidence channel. The pipeline combines a multi-task person and face detector (YOLO26x backbone in the CerberusDet framework), cascaded age estimation pairing MiVOLO v2 with a child-specialist model for ages 0-12, ByteTrack tracking, ArcFace and DINOv2 re-identification, and track-level fusion producing reviewable per-person records. The detector raises person mAP@0.5 from 0.390 to 0.683 over the previous-generation baseline; the child specialist reaches 1.944 years MAE on children-only validation, where widely used open-source stacks err by 18-23 years. FP8 TensorRT compilation yields a 1.77x speedup at +0.002 years MAE, bringing the pipeline above twice real-time on embedded hardware. On 26.8 hours of proxy video the system finds 634 unique child candidates versus 285 for its predecessor. We further report a seventeen-day unattended field pilot on a farm in Zimbabwe (38.7 million frames, six cameras) evaluated against a daily attendance register: software tuning improved detection yield 36-fold, and identity consolidation under a simultaneity veto cut over-reporting from 9.1x to 1.8-3.9x with zero proven-false merges. We document training and quantisation failures alongside successes, and the data-protection and human-in-the-loop safeguards such a system requires.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个仅作为研究原型运行的实时计算机视觉流水线，将多任务目标检测（CerberusDet/YOLO26x）、级联年龄估计（MiVOLO v2 + 儿童专用模型）、ByteTrack跟踪、ArcFace与DINOv2重识别及轨道级融合相结合，为儿童劳动监测与补救系统（CLMRS）提供基于"在场"的连续证据通道，并在津巴布韦农场完成17天无人值守田野试点验证。
AI.motivation: 全球仍有约1.38亿儿童从事童工劳动，现有监测系统依赖周期性的家访和访谈，系统性漏检率极高。现有技术栈在儿童年龄估计上误差高达18-23年（说明开源模型主要面向成人），难以支撑自动化监测。因此需要探索一种实时、持续、基于"在场"证据的监测通道，以补充人工访谈的不足。
AI.method: 构建多阶段计算机视觉流水线：（1）CerberusDet框架下基于YOLO26x骨干的多任务人-脸检测器；（2）级联式年龄估计，先由MiVOLO v2粗估，再由针对0-12岁儿童特化的模型细估；（3）ByteTrack进行跨帧跟踪；（4）ArcFace与DINOv2双路重识别；（5）轨道级融合生成可审校的逐人记录。另采用FP8 TensorRT编译加速推理。
AI.result: 检测器person mAP@0.5从0.390提升至0.683；儿童专用年龄估计在仅含儿童的验证集上MAE仅1.944年（对比主流开源模型误差18-23年）；FP8 TensorRT编译带来1.77x加速且MAE仅劣化0.002年，在嵌入式硬件上超过2倍实时。26.8小时代理视频中发现634名儿童候选（基线为285名）；津巴布韦17天无人值守试点（3870万帧、6摄像头）中，软件调优使检测产量提升36倍，身份合并过报率从9.1x降至1.8-3.9x且零错误合并。论文同时报告了训练与量化失败的案例及相关数据保护与人工复核机制。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，基于计算机视觉的实时在场监测通道在技术上是可行的，能大幅提升童工监测的检测覆盖率与多摄像机场景下的身份一致性，且年龄估计精度远超现有开源方案。但系统性部署仍需严格的数据保护框架、人工在环复核机制，并正视训练与量化过程中的失败风险——这些是该类系统从研究原型走向实际应用的必要前提。

title: Accuracy and Reliability of Large Language Models in Cosmetic Chemistry and Skin Health: A Benchmarking Study
summary: As consumers increasingly turn to AI chatbots for skincare advice, the technical accuracy of Large Language Models (LLMs) in cosmetic chemistry remains largely under-evaluated. We benchmarked 14 LLMs on a structured set of topics related to cosmetic chemistry, including the chemical properties of specific cosmetic ingredients and common cosmetic scenarios that may be of interest to consumers. Web search was disabled throughout to assess each model's internalized knowledge rather than its internet retrieval capacity. Overall performance was poor, with the most pronounced deficits in quantitative reasoning and structural identification tasks. While models handled general skincare questions with reasonability, responses consistently lacked the technical depth required for informed consumer decision-making. Notably, conversation with AI can pose a risk: outputs that sound authoritative but contain technical errors are less likely to generate skepticism compared to responses that explicitly acknowledge uncertainty. These findings suggest that general-purpose LLMs, trained predominantly on unverified public data, are currently not reliable sources of cosmetic chemistry information. Progress on two fronts, fine-tuning verified chemical and dermatological datasets, and substantial improvements to algorithmic reasoning, will likely be needed before these tools can be considered as resources for public use.

AI.tldr: 本文对14个大型语言模型（LLMs）在化妆品化学领域的知识准确性进行了系统基准测试，发现整体表现不佳，尤其在定量推理和结构识别方面存在显著缺陷，且模型输出看似权威但包含技术错误时会降低用户的怀疑程度，结论是通用LLM目前不可靠，需要微调验证数据集和改进算法推理能力。
AI.motivation: 随着消费者越来越多地使用AI聊天机器人获取护肤建议，LLMs在化妆品化学领域的技术准确性尚未得到充分评估。这一空白可能导致消费者基于错误信息做出护肤决策，存在潜在安全风险。
AI.method: 对14个LLM进行结构化基准测试，测试主题涵盖化妆品成分的化学性质及消费者可能感兴趣的常见化妆品场景。全程禁用网络搜索，以评估每个模型的内化知识而非互联网检索能力。
AI.result: 整体表现较差，最明显的缺陷集中在定量推理和结构识别任务上。模型在处理一般性护肤问题时表现合理，但回答始终缺乏支撑消费者知情决策所需的技术深度。研究发现与AI对话存在风险：听起来权威但含有技术错误的输出比明确承认不确定性的回答更难引发用户的怀疑。
AI.conclusion: 通用LLM主要基于未经核实的公开数据训练，目前不能作为化妆品化学信息的可靠来源。需要两个方面的进展：一是微调经过验证的化学和皮肤病学数据集，二是大幅改进算法推理能力，这些工具才能被考虑作为公众可用的资源。

title: P2E-VQ: ECG-linked representation augmentation for PPG via discrete patch retrieval
summary: Photoplethysmography (PPG) is widely used in consumer wearables because of its low cost and ease of acquisition. However, unlike electrocardiography (ECG), PPG measures peripheral pulse dynamics rather than cardiac electrical activity, limiting its ability to predict cardiac conditions that rely on ECG-specific morphological cues. Existing methods attempt to bridge this gap by reconstructing ECG signals from PPG signals. However, this inverse mapping is inherently ill-posed, and faithful waveform reconstruction does not necessarily translate into improved downstream performance. To address this challenge, we propose P2E-VQ, a retrieval-augmented framework that replaces ECG waveform reconstruction with ECG-linked representation retrieval. Specifically, P2E-VQ converts PPG patches into discrete tokens and retrieves ECG-linked information from a memory bank constructed exclusively from the training data. This process augments PPG representations while requiring only PPG signals during inference. Extensive experiments on five public datasets covering six downstream tasks, including clinical endpoint prediction and affective state recognition, demonstrate that P2E-VQ consistently outperforms pretrained baselines under a unified frozen-feature linear-probing protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文提出P2E-VQ，一种检索增强框架，通过将PPG信号转换为离散token并从基于训练数据构建的记忆库中检索ECG相关信息，替代传统的PPG到ECG波形重建方法，从而在下游任务中实现更优性能。
AI.motivation: PPG信号虽广泛应用于可穿戴设备，但它测量的是外周脉搏动力学而非心脏电活动，难以直接预测依赖ECG形态学线索的心脏状况。现有方法尝试从PPG重建ECG，但该逆映射本质上是不适定问题，且忠实的波形重建并不一定能转化为下游性能的提升。
AI.method: P2E-VQ将PPG信号片段转换为离散token，并从仅由训练数据构建的记忆库中检索与ECG相关的信息，以此增强PPG表征。推理阶段仅需PPG信号，无需ECG输入。
AI.result: 在五个公开数据集、六个下游任务（包括临床终点预测和情感状态识别）上的大量实验表明，P2E-VQ在统一的冻结特征线性探针协议下始终优于预训练基线。
AI.conclusion: P2E-VQ证明了用ECG信息的检索增强替代波形重建是一种更有效的范式，能够在仅依赖PPG推理的前提下提升下游任务性能。

title: Handoff-H1: An Orchestrated Vision-Agent System for Material Quantity Takeoff from Construction Blueprints
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures. Evaluation harness available on https://github.com/handoffai/residential-takeoff-benchmark/. Request data via e-mail to research@handoff.ai
summary: Converting a set of architectural blueprints into a complete material quantity takeoff requires visual perception across drawing sheets, dimensional and multi-hop reasoning, and grounding in construction conventions that the drawings never state. We present Handoff-H1, a takeoff system built from three layers: purpose-built computer-vision models that extract primitives; tool-using agents equipped with image operations and in-house visual-task tools, including CV-model-backed counting, detection and plan decomposition; and a persistent, hierarchically structured project foundation, grounded in a curated construction knowledge base. We evaluate on the Construction Blueprint Takeoff Benchmark: 10 real residential blueprint sets paired with consensus-validated expert takeoffs - 2,009 verified line items, restricted for scoring to the 1,348 primary-tier materials that drive an estimate - scored per trade by an LLM judge on material coverage and quantity Precision@25% (P@.25) and combined into a weighted composite. Under identical scoring from the raw PDF, seven frontier and open-weight models span composites of 35-61, and independent professional estimators - scored against the same reconciled gold standard - post 77.6% (65.5% coverage, 87.9% P@.25). Handoff-H1, working end-to-end from the raw PDF, reaches 81.6% (86.1% coverage, 78.8% P@.25): roughly 20 points above the strongest frontier agent, and above the independent estimators by pairing near-human quantity precision with coverage they do not reach. The evaluation harness is public for the open harbor framework; the blueprint sets and ground truth are available upon request for research use.

AI.tldr: Handoff-H1是一个从建筑蓝图PDF到材料数量清单（takeoff）的端到端系统，由三层组成：专用的计算机视觉模型、配备图像操作和视觉任务工具的工具调用智能体，以及基于施工知识库的持久化、层级化项目基础。在Construction Blueprint Takeoff Benchmark上，H1达到81.6%的加权复合分数，远超最强的前沿智能体（61分）并超越人类专业估算师（77.6%），特别是在覆盖率上达到86.1%。
AI.motivation: 将建筑蓝图转换为完整的材料数量清单需要考虑跨图纸的视觉感知、多跳推理以及图纸中从未明示的施工惯例约束，这是一个跨越视觉、推理和领域知识的复杂多模态任务，现有模型难以胜任。
AI.method: 系统由三层构建：(1) 专用计算机视觉模型用于提取图纸原始元素；(2) 配备图像操作工具和内部视觉任务工具（包括基于CV模型的计数、检测和图纸分解）的工具调用智能体；(3) 基于精选施工知识库的持久化、层级化项目基础。评估使用Construction Blueprint Takeoff Benchmark，包含10套真实住宅蓝图和2,009个经专家验证的行项目，由LLM法官按行业对材料覆盖率和数量Precision@25%评分。
AI.result: 在相同评分条件下，七个前沿和开源模型从原始PDF得到的复合分数范围为35-61；独立专业估算师为77.6%（覆盖率65.5%，P@.25 87.9%）；Handoff-H1端到端达到81.6%，覆盖率86.1%，P@.25 78.8%，比最强前沿智能体高约20分，在覆盖率上超越人类估算师的同时保持了接近人类的精度。
AI.conclusion: Handoff-H1证明了结合专用视觉模型、工具调用智能体和领域知识基础的分层架构能够在此类复杂专业视觉推理任务上超越前沿通用模型和人类专业人员；评估工具已公开，数据集可申请研究使用。

title: AMPLIFAI: A Multiphase CT Dataset for Benchmarking Clinical Reasoning in LI-RADS Assessment of Liver Lesions
summary: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is the third leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, with early detection improving survival from <20\% to >70\%. The standardized LI-RADS criteria establish a biopsy-free, fully imaging-based framework that can serve as a foundation for automating HCC diagnosis with artificial intelligence (AI). However, the lack of large, publicly available datasets with high-quality labels has limited the development of AI models for LI-RADS characterization. We introduce the \textbf{AMPLIFAI} dataset, the first public dataset of multiphase abdominal CT scans annotated with LI-RADS categories and segmented for three major LI-RADS features: arterial phase hyperenhancement, washout, and enhancing capsule. Following the \emph{Datasheets for Datasets} format, this paper details the dataset's composition, curation process, and annotation pipeline to facilitate transparent, reproducible research.

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了AMPLIFAI数据集，这是首个公开的、按LI-RADS标准标注的多期腹部CT扫描数据集，包含动脉期强化、廓清和强化包膜三个主要LI-RADS特征的标注与分割，旨在促进AI模型在肝细胞癌自动化诊断中的开发。
AI.motivation: 肝细胞癌(HCC)是全球第三大癌症死亡原因，早期检测可将生存率从不足20%提高至70%以上。LI-RADS标准提供了无需活检、完全基于影像的诊断框架，可作为AI自动化HCC诊断的基础。然而，缺乏大规模、公开且具有高质量标签的数据集限制了基于LI-RADS特征的AI模型开发。
AI.method: 构建并发布AMPLIFAI数据集，即首个公开的多期腹部CT扫描数据集，包含LI-RADS分类标注以及三个主要LI-RADS特征（动脉期强化、廓清、强化包膜）的分割标注。论文遵循Datasheets for Datasets格式，详细描述了数据集的构成、数据整理流程和标注流水线。
AI.result: 发布了首个公开的、符合LI-RADS标准的多期腹部CT数据集AMPLIFAI，包含LI-RADS分类与三个核心特征的像素级分割标签，并提供了数据集的完整文档化信息以确保透明性和可复现性。
AI.conclusion: AMPLIFAI数据集填补了LI-RADS标准化影像AI研究缺乏公开高质量数据的空白，为开发可复现、透明化的AI辅助HCC诊断模型奠定了数据基础。

title: Task- and Session-Level Model Routing: A Common-Interface Hybrid Evaluation of Four Open-Source Routers Across Four Benchmarks
summary: Agentic systems increasingly delegate model selection to a router, yet open-source routers are usually evaluated with different tasks, candidate pools, and execution protocols, limiting direct comparison. We present a common measurement protocol and hybrid evaluation of four router implementations across RouterBench, BFCL v4, tau2-bench, and WebArena. We evaluate 290 frozen tasks against a locked matrix of 2,610 candidate outcomes. Three routers emit constant or near-constant tier assignments; only vLLM Semantic Router varies materially with prompt content, and it has the highest observed success rate on none of the four benchmarks. Always-Mid matches Aurelio exactly on three benchmarks and within 0.003 on the fourth. For vLLM, task-level superiority tests detect no task-specific advantage over a share-matched content-blind allocation; equivalence is established only on WebArena at the protocol-declared five-percentage-point margin. The results show that, under these configurations and controls, observed gains track selected-tier composition more closely than demonstrated task-specific targeting. Fixed-tier baselines and selected-tier distributions are therefore necessary controls in router evaluation; the findings are scoped to these configurations, candidate pool, and frozen benchmark samples, not to routing paradigms in general.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种统一的评测协议，对四种开源路由器的任务分配能力进行了混合基准测试，发现多数路由器输出恒定或近恒定的层级分配，其性能收益主要来自所选择的层级组合而非任务级智能路由能力。
AI.motivation: 智能体系统中越来越多地将模型选择委托给路由器，但开源路由器通常在不同的任务、候选池和执行协议下被评估，导致无法直接比较。缺乏统一的测量协议使得路由器评测结果难以横向对比，也无法验证路由器是否真正具备任务级定向选择能力。
AI.method: 作者提出一个通用测量协议，并在RouterBench、BFCL v4、tau2-bench和WebArena四个基准上对四种路由器实现进行混合评估。评估覆盖290个冻结任务，对照2,610个候选结果的锁定矩阵。同时引入了任务级优势检验和与共享匹配的内容盲分配基线（Always-Mid、share-matched content-blind allocation）的对比。
AI.result: 四种路由器中有三种输出恒定或近恒定的层级分配，仅vLLM Semantic Router会随提示内容显著变化，但它在四个基准上均未获得最高成功率。Always-Mid在三个基准上与Aurelio完全匹配，在第四个基准上差异在0.003以内。对vLLM的任务级优势检验未发现其相对内容盲分配有任务级优势，仅在WebArena上以协议声明的5个百分点边际确立了等价性。
AI.conclusion: 在指定的配置和控制条件下，路由器的可观察收益更多来自于所选层级的构成分布，而非被证实的任务级定向定位能力。因此，固定层级基线和所选层级分布应作为路由器评测的必要控制项。研究结论限定于特定配置、候选池和冻结基准样本，不推广到一般路由范式。

title: LUNG-KGMM: Knowledge-Guided Multimodal Learning for Lung Cancer Incidence Prediction
comment: 22 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables, accepted by PRCV Oral
summary: Early identification of lung cancer risk is critical for timely intervention, yet existing prediction models are limited by their reliance on single data modalities and their inability to leverage structured clinical knowledge. We propose LUNG-KGMM, a knowledge-guided multimodal framework that integrates longitudinal electronic health records, radiology reports, chest radiograph representations, and guideline-derived knowledge for 1-to-6-year incident lung cancer prediction. To address modality heterogeneity and potential data leakage, we develop a leakage-sanitized report processing pipeline and a horizon-masked cumulative training objective that handles incomplete follow-up. We further introduce a knowledge-graph representation of clinical guidance that encodes report-triggered finding-attribute-action relations as an auditable knowledge stream. We build a multimodal development cohort from the publicly available MIMIC databases and construct a real-world validation cohort from the Xiamen Medical Big Data Platform. Extensive experiments on the MIMIC cohort demonstrate that LUNG-KGMM achieves superior performance over state-of-the-art methods, and validation on the Xiamen cohort further characterizes its cross-cohort portability and the need for local adaptation. The MIMIC development cohort is publicly accessible; the Xiamen cohort is governed by local data privacy regulations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LUNG-KGMM，一个知识引导的多模态框架，用于1-6年肺癌发病风险预测。该框架整合纵向电子健康记录、放射学报告、胸部X光图像表示和指南推导知识，并通过泄漏净化报告处理管道、水平掩蔽累积训练目标以及知识图谱表示来应对模态异质性、数据泄漏和不完整随访等问题。
AI.motivation: 现有肺癌预测模型受限于单一数据模态，且无法利用结构化临床知识，早期识别肺癌风险的准确性和可解释性不足，亟需能整合多模态数据并融合临床指南知识的高性能预测框架。
AI.method: LUNG-KGMM框架包含三大核心组件：(1)泄漏净化报告处理管道，解决模态异质性和潜在数据泄漏问题；(2)水平掩蔽累积训练目标，处理不完整随访；(3)知识图谱表示，将报告触发的发现-属性-行动关系编码为可审计的知识流。在MIMIC公开数据库上构建多模态开发队列，在厦门医疗大数据平台构建真实世界验证队列。
AI.result: 在MIMIC队列上的大量实验表明，LUNG-KGMM优于现有最先进方法；在厦门队列上的验证进一步刻画了其跨队列可移植性及本地适配的需求。
AI.conclusion: LUNG-KGMM通过多模态整合与临床知识引导，显著提升肺癌发病风险预测性能，且具备跨队列可移植性；MIMIC开发队列公开可获取，厦门队列受本地数据隐私法规约束。

title: RecurrentGPT: Expressive Depth through Recurrent Modulation in Transformers
summary: Scaling transformer language models creates an inherent tension between expressivity and memory efficiency. While unique weights across layers preserve functional specialization---from input-grounding to abstract refinement---they incur a substantial memory footprint. Conversely, standard depth-sharing enforces uniform transformations that collapse representational diversity and degrade modeling quality. We introduce RecurrentGPT, a recurrent depth transformer where fixed-depth prelude and coda blocks bracket a single shared core iterated R times. Inspired by gated recurrent neural networks, we employ a lightweight projection and an elementwise update gate---conditioned on the hidden state, the fixed prelude output, and noise resampled at every step---to modulate the recurrent update. This allows the model to specialize the input to the same few layers across recurrences, rather than requiring many unique layers to achieve functional diversity. Under an isoFLOPS constraint, a 3-layer RecurrentGPT matches the accuracy of a 12-layer GPT-2 Small baseline with similar training and inference FLOPs, and leads MoR and heavy-tail depth sampling in all nine scale-by-budget cells; at medium and large scale it approaches dense quality at the standard token budget and overtakes it at medium scale once that budget is doubled. Under an isoPARAMS constraint, deeper recurrence achieves a 2.76 validation loss versus 2.84 for a non-recurrent counterpart at matched parameter and data budget. Our results demonstrate that adaptive depth reuse is a principled strategy for trading parameters for quality: at large scale, 63% fewer parameters and 59% less peak decoding memory for a 10% increase in compiled generation latency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RecurrentGPT，一种循环深度Transformer架构，通过使用固定深度的prelude和coda块包围单个共享核心层并迭代R次，在表达性和内存效率之间取得平衡。在isoFLOPS约束下，3层RecurrentGPT匹配12层GPT-2 Small的精度；在isoPARAMS约束下，更深的循环达到2.76的验证损失，优于非循环基线（2.84），同时实现63%的参数减少和59%的峰值解码内存降低。
AI.motivation: 扩展Transformer语言模型时，存在表达性与内存效率之间的固有矛盾：各层使用独特权重可以保持功能特化（从输入接地到抽象精炼），但会带来巨大的内存开销；而标准深度共享则强制统一变换，塌缩表示多样性并降低建模质量。需要一个既能保持功能多样性又节省内存的架构方案。
AI.method: RecurrentGPT采用循环深度Transformer架构：固定深度的prelude和coda块置于两端，中间是单个共享核心层迭代R次。受门控循环神经网络启发，模型使用轻量级投影和逐元素更新门（由隐藏状态、固定prelude输出及每步重新采样的噪声共同调节）来调制循环更新。这使得模型能够在多次循环中特化输入到相同少数几层，而无需多个独特层来实现功能多样性。
AI.result: 在isoFLOPS约束下，3层RecurrentGPT的精度匹配12层GPT-2 Small基线（相似训练和推理FLOPs），并在所有九个scale-by-budget单元中优于MoR和heavy-tail深度采样；在中大规模下，其质量接近稠密模型的标准token预算，在中等规模下将预算加倍后甚至超越稠密模型。在isoPARAMS约束下，更深循环达到2.76验证损失（非循环对应物为2.84）。在大规模下，仅以10%的编译生成延迟增加换取63%的参数减少和59%的峰值解码内存降低。
AI.conclusion: 自适应深度复用是一种在参数与质量之间进行权衡的原则性策略。RecurrentGPT证明了通过循环复用核心层并引入门控更新机制，可以在显著降低内存和参数占用的同时维持甚至超越稠密Transformer的质量，为语言模型的高效扩展提供了新路径。

title: Evaluating Multimodal LLMs across Text and Audio Modalities for Accessible Disaster Assistance
summary: Effective disaster risk communication is a foundational humanitarian challenge, yet current emergency infrastructure fails to meet the needs of individuals with access and functional needs, including hard-of-hearing individuals, pregnant women, mothers with toddlers, and elderly individuals with dementia. Recent advancements in Artificial Intelligence (AI), especially Multi-Modal Large Language Models (MM-LLMs), demonstrate powerful capabilities to serve diverse users across text, audio, image, and video modalities within a single unified system, such as a chatbot. However, their suitability for deployment rests on a property that receives limited scrutiny, i.e., whether these systems produce consistent, actionable outputs regardless of the modality through which a user communicates. In this paper, we conduct a comprehensive analysis to understand the status of open-weight MM-LLMs using real emergency alert scenarios across four different vulnerable personas. These state-of-the-art (SOTA) models are evaluated on consistency of responses across text and audio modalities when the same task scenario is given.
