Findings indicate that no model achieves reliable consistency across modalities, and that performance gaps are heightened for personas with access needs, introducing modality-dependent inequity that undermines the humanitarian value of these systems. These results inform concrete design recommendations for building equitable, trustworthy, and inclusive AI tools for disaster risk communication.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了开放权重多模态大语言模型（MM-LLMs）在灾害风险沟通场景中，针对四类具有无障碍需求的人群（听障人士、孕妇、带幼儿的母亲、痴呆老人），在文本和音频两种模态下输出的响应一致性。研究发现没有任何模型能够在跨模态间保持可靠的一致性，且对于有无障碍需求的人群，性能差距更为显著，导致模态依赖的不公平现象，削弱了这些人道主义AI系统的价值。
AI.motivation: 有效的灾害风险沟通是人道主义领域的基础性挑战，但现有的应急基础设施无法满足具有无障碍需求人群的需要。虽然MM-LLMs展现出为多样化用户提供统一多模态服务的潜力（如聊天机器人），但其部署适用性取决于一个鲜少被审视的关键属性——系统能否在不同模态下产生一致且可执行的输出。本研究正是为了填补这一空白。
AI.method: 作者使用真实紧急警报场景，针对四种不同的弱势人群画像（听障人士、孕妇、带幼儿的母亲、老年痴呆患者），对多个开放权重的SOTA多模态大语言模型进行全面分析。具体评估方式是：在给定相同任务场景的情况下，比较模型在文本和音频两种模态下输出的响应一致性。
AI.result: 研究表明：没有任何模型能够在文本和音频模态之间实现可靠的响应一致性；对于有特殊无障碍需求的人群，性能差距进一步加剧；这种模态依赖的不公平现象削弱了这些系统的人道主义价值。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为构建公平、可信、包容的灾害风险沟通AI工具提供了具体的设计建议，强调了在AI驱动的人道主义系统中必须重视跨模态一致性和不同人群的差异化需求。

title: pico-type: A 1.5M-Parameter Byte-Level Multi-Head Content Classifier
summary: We introduce pico-type, a byte-level multi-head content classifier with approximately 1.5 million parameters that simultaneously predicts seven content properties from raw UTF-8 bytes in a single forward pass. Operating directly at the byte level -- no tokenizer, no subword vocabulary, no pretrained embeddings -- pico-type classifies coarse type (12 classes), modality (8), subtype (24), code language (62), text language (30), file MIME type (90), and risk flags (6-label multi-label: API keys, JWTs, passwords, emails, phone numbers, SSH keys). The architecture combines a learned byte embedding, three convolutional blocks with growing receptive fields, two bidirectional attention layers with rotary position encodings, and a statistical pooling layer feeding seven Matryoshka-style classification heads. Four tiered variants (tiny/small/base/pro) share the same trunk with sliced representations from 16 to 576 dimensions, yielding ONNX exports under 210 KB and CPU inference under 10 ms. Trained on a mixture of synthetic templates and real-world data (8709 GitHub code samples, 5000 Wikipedia articles), pico-type achieves 60.3 percent code language accuracy on The Heap benchmark (24 languages) and 98.2 percent text language accuracy on Wikipedia (30 languages) -- improvements of +57 and +79 percentage points respectively over the synthetic-only baseline. Format-based heads (coarse, modality, subtype, file_mime, risk) maintain 100 percent accuracy on synthetic benchmarks. The model, code, and pretrained weights are released under Apache 2.0.

AI.tldr: pico-type 是一个约150万参数的字节级多头内容分类器，无需分词器或预训练嵌入，直接从原始UTF-8字节预测七种内容属性，包括类型、模态、子类型、代码语言、文本语言、MIME类型和风险标志，提供四种规模变体且模型体积小于210KB。
AI.motivation: 传统内容分类器依赖分词器、子词词表和预训练嵌入，导致模型庞大且推理缓慢。作者希望设计一个极轻量、快速的字节级分类器，能在单次前向传播中同时预测多个内容属性，且易于部署（CPU推理小于10ms）。
AI.method: 架构包含学习型字节嵌入、三个卷积块（感受野逐层扩大）、两个带旋转位置编码的双向注意力层、统计池化层，以及七个Matryoshka式分类头。提供tiny/small/base/pro四种变体（维度16到576），共享同一主干并切片表示。训练数据混合合成模板和真实数据（8709个GitHub代码样本、5000篇维基百科文章）。
AI.result: 在The Heap基准上代码语言准确率达60.3%（24种语言），维基百科文本语言准确率98.2%（30种语言），分别比仅用合成数据训练的基线提升+57和+79个百分点。基于格式的分类头（类型、模态、子类型、MIME、风险）在合成基准上保持100%准确率。ONNX导出小于210KB，CPU推理小于10ms。
AI.conclusion: pico-type证明了在没有分词器和预训练嵌入的情况下，小规模字节级模型也能在单一前向传播中高效完成多属性内容分类任务。模型、代码和权重已以Apache 2.0协议开源。

title: A Pilot Study of Autocompleting Tokenizers
summary: Modern input methods routinely rely on autocomplete to omit information that can be recovered from local context. Inspired by these autocomplete-assisted writing systems, we investigate whether Transformer inputs can be compressed in a similar manner. Byte-level tokenization offers a simple and language-independent alternative to subword tokenization, but its longer input sequences typically result in increased computational cost and reduced model quality. We propose a compression scheme that employs a lightweight autoregressive byte language model to identify and remove bytes that are easily predictable from their surrounding context before Transformer processing. The resulting compressed representation is then provided as input to a standard encoder--decoder Transformer. Experiments on machine translation show that a substantial fraction of source-language bytes can be omitted without degrading translation quality. On English--French, our best method preserves translation performance while reducing source sequence length by nearly one-third. Additional experiments on Finnish--English, Russian--English, and Chinese--English demonstrate that the approach generalizes across diverse writing systems and morphological typologies, yielding comparable or improved translation quality at compression ratios between 0.47 and 0.67. These findings suggest that many input bytes are predictable enough to be represented implicitly rather than explicitly, providing a simple mechanism for reducing the sequence-length overhead associated with byte-level models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种字节级压缩方案：借鉴自动补全输入法的思想，利用轻量级自回归字节语言模型在Transformer处理前识别并移除可从上下文轻松预测的字节，从而压缩输入序列长度。在多个机器翻译任务上，该方法在不损失翻译质量的前提下将源序列长度压缩至原来的47%-67%。
AI.motivation: 字节级分词是子词分词简单且语言无关的替代方案，但会产生更长的输入序列，导致计算成本增加和模型质量下降。作者希望借鉴自动完成辅助输入系统（autocomplete）的思想，通过压缩不可预测性低的字节来降低字节级模型的序列长度开销。
AI.method: 提出一种压缩方案：使用一个轻量级自回归字节语言模型来估计每个字节在给定上下文中的可预测性，据此识别并移除那些容易被周围上下文预测的字节；将压缩后的表示作为标准编码器-解码器Transformer的输入进行后续处理。
AI.result: 在英语-法语任务中，该方案在不损失翻译质量的前提下将源序列长度缩短近三分之一。在芬兰语-英语、俄语-英语和汉语-英语任务中，该方法在不同书写系统和形态学类型上均表现良好，在0.47到0.67的压缩比下取得了相当或更优的翻译质量。
AI.conclusion: 大量输入字节具有足够高的可预测性，可以被隐式表示而非显式编码，这为减少字节级模型的序列长度开销提供了一种简单有效的机制，且该方法能跨语言、跨书写系统泛化。

title: Qwen-Video-Edit: Instruction-Based Video Editing by Repurposing an Image Editing Model
summary: Instruction-based video editing is commonly built on video-pretrained generative backbones: a video diffusion transformer is adapted, at considerable cost, to condition on a source video and an editing instruction. In this report we explore a different route and show that a strong instruction-based image editing model can edit videos by operating directly on video-VAE latents. Starting from Qwen-Image-Edit, we arrange the latent frames of a Wan~2.1 video VAE as tiles of one large virtual image, reuse the editor's image positional encoding for every tile, and bridge the two latent spaces with a pair of lightweight input/output projections warm-started from the editor's own patchify and unpatchify layers, so that at initialization a (static) video is embedded exactly as an image the model already understands. The whole system is then fine-tuned on the public Ditto-1M editing triplets, and a few denoising steps of Wan~2.2 serve as an optional temporal enhancer. We motivate the design with a chain of zero-training observations: the stock image editor already edits a video presented as a contact sheet; it is indifferent to whether the sheet's tokens come from one joint encode or from per-frame encodes stitched in latent space; and it even edits genuine video latents zero-shot to a clearly recognizable degree, leaving fine-tuning only a fidelity gap to close. Our results suggest that, despite the large investment in training video latent spaces, per-frame video latents remain close enough to the image domain that mature image editing priors transfer with minimal adaptation. Project Page: https://yunpeng1998.github.io/Qwen-Video-Edit-Page; Code: https://github.com/yunpeng1998/Qwen-Video-Edit; Model: https://huggingface.co/yunpeng1998/Qwen-Video-Edit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于图像编辑模型直接处理视频VAE潜在空间的方法：将Wan 2.1视频VAE的潜在帧排布为一张大虚拟图像的tiles，借用Qwen-Image-Edit的图像位置编码，并用轻量输入/输出投影桥接两个潜在空间，在Ditto-1M上微调后即可实现指令式视频编辑，无需训练视频扩散骨干网络。
AI.motivation: 传统的指令式视频编辑通常需要基于预训练的视频生成骨干（如视频扩散Transformer）进行昂贵的大规模适配，成本高且资源消耗大。作者希望探索一条低成本途径，验证是否可以直接利用成熟的图像编辑模型来编辑视频，避免对视频专用潜在空间进行大规模训练投资。
AI.method: 以Qwen-Image-Edit为起点，将Wan 2.1视频VAE的潜在帧排列为一张大型虚拟图像的tiles，复用编辑器的图像位置编码；用一对轻量输入/输出投影（从编辑器的patchify/unpatchify层初始化）桥接图像与视频两种潜在空间，使得静态视频在初始化时精确地嵌入为模型已理解的图像；在公共Ditto-1M编辑三元组上微调，并用Wan 2.2的少量去噪步作为可选的时序增强器。作者通过一系列零训练观察（接触表编辑、联合编码vs逐帧拼接等）验证设计动机。
AI.result: 零训练观察表明：原始图像编辑器已能编辑以接触表形式呈现的视频；它对联合编码或逐帧拼接的token不敏感；甚至能在零样本下以可辨识程度编辑真实视频潜在空间。经过微调后仅需补充保真度差距即可完成高质量视频编辑。
AI.conclusion: 逐帧视频潜在空间与图像域足够接近，使成熟的图像编辑先验能以极小的适配代价迁移到视频编辑任务，表明无需在训练视频潜在空间上大规模投入即可实现强指令式视频编辑。

title: When Uncertainty Isn't Enough: An Empirical Study of Self-Correction in Code Generation
summary: Large language models for code generation often produce incorrect solutions without reliable indicators of failure. We study whether uncertainty estimation methods developed for natural language transfer to code generation, and whether such signals can improve code generation via selective self-correction. We evaluate five uncertainty methods: mean token entropy, verbalized confidence, $P(\text{True})$, entropy ensembles, and semantic entropy probes, across three small code LLMs on HumanEval and BigCodeBench. We find that multi-sample $P(\text{True})$ achieves the strongest correlation with correctness, while all the other methods, including semantic entropy probes, yield only weak correlation. We then use these uncertainty signals to drive three self-correction policies: adaptive decoding, uncertainty-based regeneration, and verification-based regeneration. Our results reveal a stronger negative finding than anticipated: uncertainty-based self-correction fails to reliably improve Pass@1, degrading accuracy in 5 of 6 configurations across both benchmarks ($-3$pp to $-10$pp), and adaptive decoding degrades accuracy in 4 of 6 configurations. Only verification-based self-correction reliably improves Pass@1, with gains of $+6$ to $+26$ percentage points on HumanEval and $+8$ to $+20$ percentage points on BigCodeBench, scaling inversely with baseline strength. These findings replicate consistently across both benchmarks and suggest that cheap uncertainty estimators are insufficient on their own to improve code correctness, and that their practical value lies in serving as gating signals for costlier execution-based correction loops rather than as standalone substitutes for verification.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了五种不确定性估计方法在代码生成任务中的有效性，发现多样本P(True)与正确性的相关性最强，但基于不确定性的自纠正（包括自适应解码和不确定性驱动的重新生成）在多数配置下会降低Pass@1准确率，而基于验证的自纠正能够始终稳定地提升Pass@1（+6至+26个百分点）。不确定性估计的价值不在于独立使用，而在于作为成本更高的执行验证循环的筛选信号。
AI.motivation: 代码生成的大语言模型常常产生错误代码且缺乏可靠的失败指标。作者希望探究自然语言处理中开发的不确定性估计方法能否迁移到代码生成任务，以及这些不确定性信号能否通过选择性自纠正来改善代码生成质量。
AI.method: 评估五种不确定性方法（平均token熵、口头化置信度、P(True)、熵集成、语义熵探针），在三个小型代码LLM上测试HumanEval和BigCodeBench两个基准。随后使用这些信号驱动三种自纠正策略：自适应解码、基于不确定性的重新生成、基于验证的重新生成。
AI.result: 多样本P(True)与正确性的相关性最强，而其他方法（包括语义熵探针）仅产生弱相关性。基于不确定性的自纠正未能在6个配置中的5个上可靠提升Pass@1（下降3至10个百分点），自适应解码在6个配置中的4个上降低准确率。仅有基于验证的自纠正能可靠提升Pass@1，在HumanEval上提升+6至+26个百分点，在BigCodeBench上提升+8至+20个百分点，且增益与基线强度呈反比。
AI.conclusion: 廉价的不确定性估计器单独使用不足以改善代码正确性，其实际价值在于作为更昂贵的执行验证循环的门控信号，而非作为验证的独立替代品。

title: Ring-based Spatial Transformer: Learning Non-linear Spatial Interactions between Building Distribution and Pedestrian Flow
summary: This study proposes a ring-based SpatialTransformer to learn how building uses at different distances from a railway station interact to generate pedestrian flow. Concentric ring buffers at 100-meter intervals up to 800 meters were defined around 100 randomly selected stations in Tokyo, treating each ring as a spatial token. Self-Attention was applied to learn inter-zone interactions directly from data, without prior structural assumptions. GPS-derived walking trip counts served as the target variable and Geographically Weighted Regression as the baseline. Across 30 independent trials, the SpatialTransformer consistently outperformed GWR in predictive accuracy. SHAP analysis revealed that mid-to-outer distance zone features dominate pedestrian flow prediction, while features from the 0-100m zone contributed little. The attention matrix showed that each distance zone attends most strongly to spatially distant zones, demonstrating that pedestrian flow is regulated by structural interactions across the entire catchment area rather than by any single zone in isolation. These findings challenge the compact city assumption that station-proximate development maximizes pedestrian flow, and suggest that land use distribution across the full walkable catchment area deserves greater consideration in urban planning practice.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出基于环形缓冲区的空间Transformer模型，用于学习火车站周边不同距离圈层用地功能间的交互对步行人流的影响。模型在东京100个车站的预测精度上优于地理加权回归，SHAP分析发现中远距离圈层特征主导人流预测，注意力矩阵显示各距离圈层主要关注空间上较远的区域，挑战了"紧凑城市"假设下车站邻近开发最大化人流量的传统观点。
AI.motivation: 传统紧凑城市理论认为车站邻近区域的土地利用对步行人流贡献最大，但这一假设缺乏对站域内不同距离圈层间空间交互作用的系统验证。现有方法（如GWR）难以捕捉跨区域的非线性结构交互，需要一种无需先验结构假设的模型来揭示站域用地功能与步行人流间的复杂关系。
AI.method: 以东京随机选取的100个车站为中心，构建100米间隔、最深800米的同心环形缓冲区，每个环作为一个空间token输入Transformer；通过自注意力机制直接学习环间交互；以GPS获取的步行出行次数为因变量，以地理加权回归作为基线模型进行性能对比。
AI.result: 在30次独立试验中，SpatialTransformer的预测精度持续优于GWR；SHAP分析表明中远距离圈层特征对人流预测贡献最大，而0-100米近距圈层贡献甚微；注意力矩阵显示各距离圈层对空间上较远区域的关注度最高。
AI.conclusion: 步行人流并非由单一近距圈层决定，而是由整个步行可达腹地范围内用地功能的跨区域结构交互共同调节。该发现挑战了紧凑城市的基本假设，建议城市规划应将完整步行集散区的用地结构纳入更全面的考量。

title: Why Vision Fails as a Universal Bridge: Rectifying Modality Asynchrony in Multilingual MLLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) exhibit substantial performance degradation in non-English visual reasoning, despite the strong multilingual competence of their text-only backbones. While mechanistic evidence from text-only models suggests that non-English inputs are routed through an English-centric latent space, the multimodal implications of this phenomenon remain unexplored. Through rigorous mechanistic analysis, we identify the \textbf{Ghost Anchor} phenomenon: a temporal modality asynchrony where linguistic translation to the English semantic manifold completes in early layers, while visual semanticization remains immature. Consequently, visual signals are physically present yet functionally invisible during the early alignment window. To rectify this, we propose \textbf{ANCHOR}, a training framework employing Proactive Visual Anchoring (PVA) to accelerate early visual semantic emergence, ensuring visual representations proactively guide linguistic translation. Mechanistic interventions confirm that ANCHOR successfully restores the causal influence of visual signals during early translation. Furthermore, extensive experiments on XMMMU, MaXM, and CVQA demonstrate that ANCHOR consistently outperforms standard baselines, achieving robust visual reasoning across both fine-tuned and zero-shot languages.

AI.tldr: 本文通过机制性分析发现多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)在非英语视觉推理中存在"Ghost Anchor"现象——语言翻译早于视觉语义化完成，导致视觉信号在早期对齐窗口内"物理存在但功能不可见"。为此提出ANCHOR训练框架，通过主动视觉锚定(PVA)加速早期视觉语义涌现，使视觉表征主动引导语言翻译，在XMMMU、MaXM和CVQA基准上持续优于基线。
AI.motivation: 尽管MLLMs的纯文本骨干具有强大的多语言能力，但它们在非英语视觉推理中表现出显著的性能退化。文本模型已有机制证据表明非英语输入通过英语中心潜在空间路由，但这一现象在多模态场景下的影响尚未被探索。作者希望从机制层面揭示这一退化的根因并提出针对性解决方案。
AI.method: 首先通过严格的机制分析识别出"Ghost Anchor"现象：概念的模态异步性——语言到英语语义流形的翻译在早期层完成，而视觉语义化尚未成熟。随后提出ANCHOR训练框架，核心组件为主动视觉锚定(PVA)，通过加速早期视觉语义涌现，使视觉表征在语言翻译过程中发挥主动引导作用，并结合机制性干预验证效果。
AI.result: 在XMMMU、MaXM和CVQA三个基准上，ANCHOR一致性地优于标准基线。机制性干预证实ANCHOR成功恢复了视觉信号在早期翻译阶段的因果影响力，在微调语言和零样本语言场景下均实现了稳健的视觉推理性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作从机制层面揭示了MLLMs非英语视觉推理退化的根因（Ghost Anchor），并通过PVA训练框架有效修复了视觉与语言模态间的时间对齐问题，为非英语多模态推理提供了新的方法论路径。

title: Zero-Shot Adaptation of Medical Vision Foundation Models for High-Frequency Micro-Ultrasound Prostate Segmentation
summary:
Prostate cancer claims a life every 80 seconds. Early detection is needed to prevent disease progression, and both PSA density calculation and biopsy decisions rely on knowing the exact boundary of the gland. Conventional ultrasound at 6-12 MHz blurs this boundary, missing one in three high-risk cancers. Micro-ultrasound (29 MHz) improves resolution threefold but introduces dense acoustic speckle that obscures the outer wall; given the same image, two clinicians draw outlines differing by over 10% in area. Supervised methods are costly and generalise poorly across scanners. Can a foundation model segment the prostate with no training data?
  We present the first zero-shot pipeline for this modality: MedSAM, pre-trained on over 1.5 million medical images, localises the prostate; we then apply CLAHE to sharpen the outer wall, binary dilation to recover missed pixels, and Fourier smoothing (4 modes, s=1.05) to refine the boundary. MedSAM requires a spatial prompt, so we evaluate bounding-box and point-click strategies across 75 patients of the Micro-Ultrasound Prostate Segmentation dataset (2,621 slices).
  On the 20-patient held-out test set, the pipeline reduces mean boundary-distance error by 45% (Dice 0.749+/-0.043 to 0.865+/-0.029; HD95 217.2+/-36.9 to 120.1+/-26.1 px), reaching Dice 0.859 across the cohort. Its mean overlap shows no significant difference from the three non-expert rater groups (p>0.19), while segmenting 38-52% more consistently (lower inter-patient standard deviation). Point-click prompts fail regardless of placement (best Dice=0.350), because speckle gives no stable local contrast. Only an approximate bounding box is required, so any clinic can deploy it without data collection, annotation, or retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个针对微超声前列腺分割的零样本管道，利用医学基础分割模型MedSAM并结合CLAHE增强、二值膨胀和傅里叶平滑等后处理步骤，在无需训练数据的情况下将Dice从0.749提升至0.865，边界距离误差降低45%，其分割一致性与非专家放射科医生相当。
AI.motivation: 前列腺癌早期检测需要精确定位腺体边界，但常规超声分辨率不足且微超声虽分辨率更高却引入密集散斑噪声掩盖外壁轮廓。有监督方法成本高昂且跨设备泛化差，因此需要探索无需训练数据即可实现可靠分割的零样本方案。
AI.method: 采用预训练于150万+医学图像的MedSAM作为基础分割模型；使用边界框和点点击两种空间提示策略进行评估；后处理流程包括：CLAHE锐化外壁、二值膨胀恢复遗漏像素、傅里叶平滑（4个模式，s=1.05）细化边界。在75名患者的Micro-Ultrasound Prostate Segmentation数据集（2621个切片）上评估。
AI.result: 在20名患者留出测试集上，管道将平均边界距离误差降低45%（Dice从0.749±0.043提升至0.865±0.029；HD95从217.2±36.9降至120.1±26.1像素），全队列Dice达0.859。与三个非专家评分组无显著差异（p>0.19），且分割一致性高出38-52%。点点击提示失败（最佳Dice=0.350），仅需近似边界框提示即可。
AI.conclusion: 零样本管道结合基础模型与轻量后处理可在微超声前列腺分割中达到与人类专家相当的性能，且无需数据收集、标注或重训练，任何诊所均可直接部署；但方法依赖边界框提示，点点击方式因散斑缺乏稳定局部对比而不可行。

title: Cross-Domain Industrial Fault Detection by Causal Mechanism Monitoring
summary: Unsupervised fault detection in industrial systems is dominated by reconstruction based methods that monitor individual sensor marginal distributions. This misses coupling faults, where the physical relationship between sensor groups breaks while marginal statistics remain normal. Such faults evade marginal monitoring and persist as latent failures, with direct consequences for system reliability and safety. We propose CMR-Mamba (Causal Mechanism Representation Mamba), which trains per domain Mamba state-space encoders on healthy data. A causal cross-modal predictor regularises these encoders so that the effect-channel manifold reflects the normal cause-to-effect coupling. Anomalies are scored by k-nearest-neighbour (kNN) distance on this manifold or by the mechanism residual between the observed and the causally predicted effect embedding. We evaluate CMR-Mamba on electromechanical (Paderborn bearings), hydraulic (ZeMA) and cyber-physical (SWaT) coupling-fault domains. Ablations establish two findings. First, k-NN manifold scoring, rather than the encoder family, is the dominant source of gain over reconstruction-error scoring, improving baselines by up to 0.42 AUROC and exceeding the gain from causal regularisation. Second, aggregate AUROC is saturated by easy faults that any strong method solves, so the methods separate only on the low-separability subset. There CMR-Mamba leads the evaluated baselines on Paderborn artificial defects and on SWaT stealthy attacks, which keep every sensor inside its normal range and which marginal methods detect only at chance. CMR-Mamba therefore offers an interpretable and consistently competitive approach to coupling-fault detection across mechanical, hydraulic and cyber-physical systems. Code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/status/CMR_Mamba_MFD_1177.

AI.tldr: 提出CMR-Mamba，一种基于因果机制表示的无监督耦合故障检测方法，通过每个领域的Mamba状态空间编码器配合因果跨模态预测器，将正常数据的因果耦合关系编码到效应通道流形上，用kNN距离或机制残差进行异常评分，在机电、液压和工控三个系统上评估，并在低可分离性故障子集上领先基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的无监督故障检测以重建式方法为主，仅监控单个传感器边际分布，无法检测传感器组之间物理耦合关系被破坏的耦合故障。这类故障在边际统计正常的情况下会作为潜在失效持续存在，直接影响系统可靠性和安全性。
AI.method: CMR-Mamba先在各领域中用健康数据训练Mamba状态空间编码器；通过因果跨模态预测器正则化这些编码器，使效应通道流形反映正常的因-果耦合关系；异常评分采用该流形上的k近邻距离，或观测效应嵌入与因果预测效应嵌入之间的机制残差。
AI.result: 在Paderborn轴承、液压ZeMA和工控SWaT三个耦合故障领域上评估。消融研究表明：kNN流形评分（而非编码器家族）是相对重建误差评分的主要增益来源，AUROC最高提升0.42，超过因果正则化的增益；聚合AUROC被简单故障饱和，各方法仅在低可分离性子集上拉开差距，CMR-Mamba在Paderborn人工缺陷和SWaT隐蔽攻击上领先，后者所有传感器均处于正常范围，边际方法仅达到随机水平。
AI.conclusion: CMR-Mamba提供了一种可解释且持续有竞争力的耦合故障检测方法，适用于机械、液压和工控系统，尤其擅长检测边际方法无法发现的隐蔽型耦合故障。

title: An automatic-differentiation framework for time-lapse electrical resistivity tomography inversion of hydrologic dynamics
comment: Main text: 10 figures. Supplementary Information: 2 figures and 2 tables
summary: Time-lapse electrical resistivity tomography (TL-ERT) provides spatially distributed information on subsurface hydrologic changes. However, inversion of long monitoring sequences is computationally demanding. Modifying the data misfit, regularization, model parameterization, or petrophysical transformation may also require new gradient derivations and separate implementations. Here, we present AD-TLERT, a unified, GPU-accelerated framework for time-lapse ERT inversion based on automatic differentiation. The framework integrates model parameterization, differentiable petrophysical transformations, forward modeling, data misfit, regularization and auxiliary constraints into a single computational chain. Alternative inversion formulations can therefore reuse the same PDE derivative implementation without re-deriving the complete ERT sensitivity for each case. Comparisons with pyGIMLi showed close agreement in the forward responses, gradients, and recovered resistivity models. Under the tested configuration, AD-TLERT achieved an approximately 51-fold speedup. Synthetic experiments showed that inversion choices affect the amplitude, geometry, and temporal behavior of recovered anomalies. By propagating gradients through the embedded petrophysical relationship, AD-TLERT enabled direct water-content inversion and yielded more accurate estimates than post-inversion conversion for the tested model. A field application further demonstrated how ERT, temperature, and soil-moisture observations can be combined to image snowmelt-driven hillslope wetting. AD-TLERT provides an efficient and flexible framework for time-lapse ERT inversion and hydrologic interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AD-TLERT，一个基于自动微分、GPU加速的统一时移电阻率层析成像（TL-ERT）反演框架，将模型参数化、岩石物理变换、正演模拟、数据失配、正则化和辅助约束集成到单一计算链中，实现约51倍加速，并支持直接含水量反演，在合成实验和野外应用中均取得良好效果。
AI.motivation: 传统TL-ERT反演对长监测序列计算开销大，且修改数据失配、正则化、模型参数化或岩石物理变换时，需要重新推导梯度并单独实现，缺乏统一灵活的框架。
AI.method: 基于自动微分构建GPU加速的统一反演框架AD-TLERT，将模型参数化、可微岩石物理变换、正演模拟、数据失配、正则化及辅助约束串联为单一计算链，复用相同的偏微分方程导数实现，无需为每种反演方案重新推导ERT灵敏度，并支持通过嵌入的岩石物理关系直接进行含水量反演。
AI.result: 与pyGIMLi对比，正演响应、梯度和恢复的电阻率模型高度一致；在测试配置下实现约51倍加速。合成实验表明反演选择影响恢复异常的幅度、几何形状和时间行为；直接含水量反演比后处理转换更准确。野外应用成功结合ERT、温度和土壤水分观测成像融雪驱动的山坡湿润过程。
AI.conclusion: AD-TLERT为时移ERT反演和水文解释提供了一个高效且灵活的统一框架，显著降低计算成本并简化多种反演方案的实现。

title: A Declarative-Procedural Perspective on Expert Routing in Bilingual Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
summary: We investigate whether Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models develop linguistically structured expert routing during bilingual language acquisition. Inspired by the Declarative-Procedural framework, we analyze lexical, grammatical, and syntactic processing in a decoder-only English-German MoE Transformer trained under sequential language exposure. We construct a probe-based validation set and extract token-level routing distributions to quantify category-dependent specialisation using mutual information, routing entropy, and Jensen-Shannon distance. The curriculum-trained model exhibits a peak mutual information of 0.1148 at layer 5, indicating category-dependent differences in routing distributions across linguistic categories. Surprisingly, a no-curriculum baseline trained on mixed English-German data shows stronger aggregate specialisation, reaching a peak mutual information of 0.2599 at the same layer. These results suggest that interpretable linguistic organization emerges within MoE routing patterns even without sequential language exposure. A replication at a second training seed shows that the no-curriculum condition's specialisation concentrates on a single language whose identity is seed-dependent, whereas the curriculum consistently yields a stable, language-balanced routing profile; rather than uniformly increasing specialisation, staged bilingual exposure reduces single-language dominance. The official Github repository: https://github.com/Amrit828/DP-Theory-MOE-Interpretability-Research

AI.tldr: 本文探究混合专家（MoE）语言模型在双语习得中是否会产生语言学结构化的专家路由模式。受陈述性-程序性框架启发，作者在顺序语言暴露条件下训练了一个仅解码器的英德MoE Transformer，通过探针验证集与token级路由分布，利用互信息、路由熵和Jensen-Shannon距离量化类别依赖的专门化。结果显示课程训练模型在第5层达到峰值互信息0.1148，而无课程基线（混合英德数据）在同一层表现出更强的整体专门化（0.2599）。进一步种子复现表明，无课程条件会集中于单一语言（依赖种子），而课程条件则稳定产生语言均衡的路由轮廓——分阶段双语暴露并未均匀增强专门化，而是减少单一语言主导性。
AI.motivation: 在网络课程背景下，现有关于MoE模型的研究多聚焦于性能与效率，对专家路由是否反映真实的语言结构组织缺乏深入理解。作者借助认知科学中的Declarative-Procedural框架，首次系统考察双语MoE在不同训练范式下的路由是否呈现词汇、语法、句法等范畴级专门化，以及顺序语言暴露与混合数据训练对此的影响，旨在揭示可解释的语言学组织在MoE路由中的涌现机制。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个仅解码器的英德MoE Transformer，在顺序语言暴露（课程学习）下训练，并设置混合英德数据的无课程基线。研究方法包括：(1) 构造基于探针的验证集以区分词汇、语法与句法处理；(2) 提取token级专家路由分布；(3) 使用互信息、路由熵和Jensen-Shannon距离三个指标量化不同语言范畴下路由分布差异的专门化程度；(4) 在第二个训练种子上进行复现实验以检验结果稳健性。
AI.result: 课程训练模型在第5层达到0.1148的峰值互信息，表明存在范畴依赖的路由差异；无课程基线在同一层达到0.2599的峰值互信息，整体专门化更强。种子复现显示无课程条件的专门化集中于单一语言（语言身份随种子变化），而课程条件始终产生稳定且语言均衡的路由分布。结论核心发现是：顺序双语暴露并非均匀增强专门化，而是抑制了单一语言主导的极端专门化倾向。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明MoE路由模式中能够涌现可解释的语言学组织，且混合数据训练也可产生这种组织。但关键的差异在于专门化的结构特性：无课程训练导致种子依赖的单语言主导型专门化，而顺序课程训练则塑造了稳定、语言均衡的路由轮廓。这一发现表明训练数据呈现顺序是影响MoE信息组织方式的重要因素，为可解释的MoE架构设计与双语语言模型训练策略提供了实证依据。

title: Where the Cost Falls: A Deployment-Aware Adoption Order for Stability Enhancements to Cycle-Consistent Adversarial Networks
summary: Teams that adopt cycle-consistent adversarial networks for unpaired image-to-image translation meet the same obstacles: adversarial training oscillates or collapses, cycle consistency preserves coarse layout while finer texture drifts, and a single discriminator judging global realism misses local artifacts. Four enhancements address these failures, and they are usually compared on output quality alone. We show that they also divide sharply by where their cost falls, and that this division, which follows from the architecture and not from any particular run, yields an adoption order for teams under a compute or latency budget. A Wasserstein objective with gradient penalty, a VGG19 perceptual loss on the cycle reconstruction, and multi-scale discriminators change training only, so a team can adopt or drop them without altering what ships. Self-attention alone persists into the deployed generator, with memory growing as the square of the feature-map size, which makes it the one component a resource-constrained team should defer. We integrate all four onto a lightly tuned baseline for horse-to-zebra translation, introduced one at a time on a fixed control and then combined, and for each we give the failure mode it targets and how it integrates. We document the collapse and reconstruction-artifact modes the baseline produced, report what visual inspection of saved samples showed for each variant, and report Fréchet Inception Distance and Kernel Inception Distance for the combined model. We specify the protocol still needed, covering the individual variants, perceptual similarity, and downstream segmentation, to rank these enhancements on measured evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文分析四类CycleGAN常用增强技术（Wasserstein梯度惩罚、VGG19感知损失、多尺度判别器、自注意力）在未配对图像翻译任务中的定位差异，指出它们按训练期成本vs部署期成本截然划分，并由此给出资源受限团队的采用顺序建议。现有研究仅关注输出质量，本文从成本与架构角度提出新视角。
AI.motivation: CycleGAN类方法在无配对图像翻译中面临对抗训练不稳定、循环一致性导致纹理漂移、单一判别器忽略局部伪影等共同障碍。现有四类增强技术虽被频繁采用，但研究几乎只比较输出质量，忽视了它们的成本发生在训练阶段还是部署阶段这一关键区别，导致资源受限团队缺乏明确的采纳依据。
AI.method: 将四项增强按成本落点归类：Wasserstein梯度惩罚、VGG19感知损失、多尺度判别器均只影响训练过程，可随队采用或弃用而不改变部署产物；自注意力则进入部署生成器，其内存随特征图尺寸平方增长。在轻度调优的horse-to-zebra基线上一项项引入再组合，记录各失败模式（训练崩溃、重建伪影）及视觉检查结果，并报告FID与KID指标。
AI.result: 四项增强在失败模式与整合方式上各有定位；资源受限团队应优先采纳训练期成本的三项增强，而将内存平方增长的注意力机制推迟。组合模型报告了FID和KID指标，视觉检查记录了各变体的伪影表现。同时指出仍需补充个体变体、感知相似度与下游分割的实验协议以给出有量化证据的排名。
AI.conclusion: 增强技术的采用顺序应基于其成本落在训练期还是部署期，这一划分源自架构本身而不依赖具体运行，为计算或延迟预算受限的团队提供了清晰的采纳次序：先采纳训练期增强，最后考虑自注意力。当前证据仍以视觉检查为主，需制定更完整的评测协议来支撑实证排名。

title: Position: AI Agents in Scientific Teams Should Be Studied as Human-Agent Systems
comment: 15 pages. Accepted at the COLM 2nd Workshop on Language Models for Scientific Discovery
summary: Large language model-based agents are increasingly deployed as collaborators in scientific discovery yet most current work focuses on the autonomous capabilities of "AI Scientists". We argue that this overlooks the social aspects of scientific teamwork, and that studying AI Scientists as human-agent systems (HAS)--where the unit of analysis is the human-agent pair--is both underexplored and undervalued. We establish these points through literature and empirical analysis, and highlight recent incidences and studies which show that deploying agents in science without accounting for human-agent dynamics introduces near-term risks, including reduced diversity of scientific inquiry. Through analysis of real-world case studies, we show that scientists and agents can augment each other's capabilities. We call for new research that adopts the HAS lens to develop mathematical frameworks for understanding and fostering human-AI synergy in scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文主张在研究"AI科学家"时，不应仅关注其自主能力，而应将人类-智能体二元组作为分析单元，采用人-智能体系统（HAS）视角进行研究，以更好地理解并促进人类与AI在科学发现中的协同增效。
AI.motivation: 当前大多数关于"AI科学家"的研究聚焦于智能体的自主能力，忽视了科学团队协作的社会属性。作者认为，将AI科学家作为人-智能体系统（HAS）来研究——即以人类-智能体对为分析单元——既未得到充分探索，也未受到足够重视。此外，在不考虑人-智能体动态的情况下部署智能体参与科学会产生近期风险，包括科学探究多样性的减少。
AI.method: 本文通过文献分析与实证分析相结合的方法，梳理了现有研究的局限，并通过真实案例研究表明科学家与智能体能够相互增强各自的能力。在此基础上，作者提出应建立数学模型框架来理解和促进科学发现中的人类-AI协同。
AI.result: 研究揭示了忽视人-智能体动态的近期风险（如科学探究多样性下降），并通过真实世界案例证明了人类科学家与AI智能体之间具有能力互补与增强的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 作者呼吁未来研究应采纳人-智能体系统（HAS）视角，发展数学框架以理解和促进科学发现中的人类-AI协同效应，从而在科学团队中实现更好的人机协作。

title: In-Context Learning to Assess Built Environment Impacts on Perceived Neighborhood Walkability Among Mobility-impaired Older Adults
summary: As global populations age, enhancing neighborhood walkability through inclusive urban design is important for mitigating built environment (BE) barriers that discourage physical activity and social participation among older adults. This study investigates the utility of in-context learning (ICL), using the transformer-based foundation model TabPFN, to determine how BE features influence perceived walkability, as measured by the Neighborhood Environment Walkability Scale (NEWS-A) survey. Using a small-scale dataset (N = 257) comprising a unique demographic of older adults with knee osteoarthritis or a history of falls, TabPFN achieved a macro F1 score of 54.89% for walkability perceptions categorized as Low, Neutral, and High using equal-width binning. This result outperformed optimized, grid-searched baseline models, including Random Forest (45.85%) and XGBoost (50.56%). To interpret these results, we employed Shapley Interaction Quantification (SHAP-IQ) to identify the hierarchical importance of feature interactions. Preliminary results revealed that the model's predictive logic was primarily driven by higher-order interactions. For example, the interaction between average street circuity and the ratio of drivable roads emerged as the primary discriminator of perceived walkability. Neighborhood greenery was found to have substantial predictive importance only when combined with an individual's fear of falling or perception of age-friendliness. Overall, ICL using TabPFN demonstrates superior performance on small-scale datasets, enhancing the fidelity of the resulting interpretive insights. Furthermore, SHAP-IQ provides a synergistic perspective on how higher-order feature interactions drive the model's predictions.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用基于Transformer的基础模型TabPFN通过上下文学习（ICL）分析小规模数据集（N=257），预测老年膝骨关节炎或跌倒史人群的步行适宜性感知，宏F1分数为54.89%，优于随机森林（45.85%）和XGBoost（50.56%）；并通过SHAP-IQ揭示高阶特征交互在预测中的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 全球人口老龄化背景下，通过包容性城市设计提升社区步行性对促进老年人的身体活动和社会参与至关重要。本研究旨在利用上下文学习（ICL）结合Transformer基础模型TabPFN，在小规模数据集上有效分析建筑环境（BE）特征如何影响老年人的步行性感知，以弥补传统模型在小样本场景下的性能不足。
AI.method: 采用基于Transformer的基础模型TabPFN进行上下文学习（ICL），对由257名膝骨关节炎或跌倒史老年人组成的独特人群数据进行分析。步行性感知通过NEWS-A调查问卷测量，采用等宽分箱划分为低、中、高三类。对比基线包括经过网格搜索优化的随机森林（Random Forest）和XGBoost模型。解释性分析采用Shapley Interaction Quantification（SHAP-IQ）来识别特征交互的层次重要性。
AI.result: TabPFN在预测步行性感知分类任务中取得54.89%的宏F1分数，显著优于随机森林（45.85%）和XGBoost（50.56%）。SHAP-IQ分析显示模型的预测逻辑主要由高阶特征交互驱动，其中平均街道迂回度与可驾驶道路比率的交互是最主要的判别因素；邻里绿化仅在结合个人跌倒恐惧或年龄友好性感知时才展现显著的预测重要性。
AI.conclusion: TabPFN结合上下文学习在小规模数据集中表现出优于传统基线模型的性能，提高了可解释洞见的保真度。SHAP-IQ提供了一个协同视角，揭示高阶特征交互如何驱动模型预测，为理解建筑环境对老年人步行性感知的影响提供了更深入的理解。

title: Left-Branching Transformers Excel at Right-Branching Languages: Data Shapes Word Order Preferences in Language Models
summary: We systematically compare word order preferences in decoder-only language models across 192 artificial languages and typologically diverse natural languages. On artificial languages, models exhibit a left-branching preference that aligns with neither natural language universals nor human word order learning biases. On natural languages, monolingual models show no clear base word order bias at small scales, but as data grows, a preference for right-branching subject-verb-object (SVO) languages emerges while SOV falls behind despite being the most frequent order cross-linguistically. This SVO advantage extends to multilingual models and correlates with language resource level and data quality rather than word order. Thus, the same architecture exhibits opposite preferences on artificial and natural languages, establishing that word order biases observed in practice are data-driven. Since highly-resourced languages are overwhelmingly SVO, these biases risk gradually reducing word order diversity, particularly in languages that productively use multiple word orders, with the widespread adoption of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统比较了decoder-only语言模型在192种人工语言和多种类型学多样的自然语言中的词序偏好，发现模型在人工语言上表现出左分支偏好，而在自然语言上随着数据量增加表现出SVO右分支偏好，且这一偏好与数据资源水平而非词序本身相关，揭示词序偏差本质上是数据驱动的。
AI.motivation: 探究decoder-only语言模型是否具有词序偏置，以及这种偏置是源于架构本身的固有倾向还是数据驱动的结果。已有研究在人工语言上发现左分支偏好，但这一偏好既不符合自然语言共性也不符合人类学习偏置；同时大型语言模型日益普及，其词序偏好可能对世界语言的多样性和少数语种的存续产生深远影响。
AI.method: 在192种人工语言上训练decoder-only模型并评估其词序偏好；同时在类型学多样的自然语言（涵盖不同语系、不同词序类型）上训练单语和多语模型，考察不同数据规模下模型对各类词序（尤其SVO vs SOV）的偏好差异，并将SVO优势与语言资源水平、数据质量进行相关性分析。
AI.result: 人工语言上模型表现出左分支偏好，与自然语言共性和人类学习偏置均不符；自然语言上小规模单语模型无显著基序偏好，但随数据增长SVO（右分支）语言获得明显优势，SOV尽管是跨语言频率最高的词序却表现落后。该SVO优势在多语模型中同样存在，且与语言资源水平和数据质量显著相关而非词序本身。
AI.conclusion: 相同的模型架构在人工语言和自然语言上表现出截然相反的词序偏好，证明LLMs中观察到的词序偏置是数据驱动的而非架构所固有。由于高资源语言绝大多数为SVO类型，这种偏差可能随着LLM的广泛使用而逐渐减少世界语言的词序多样性，尤其对灵活使用多种词序的语言构成潜在风险。

title: OvDSGG: End-to-End Open-Vocabulary Dynamic Scene Graph Generation
summary: Dynamic scene graphs (DSGs) capture spatio-temporal interactions across videos as $\langle$subject, predicate, object$\rangle$ triplets, and underpin downstream tasks such as video captioning, video question answering, and action analysis. However, end-to-end dynamic scene graph generation (DSGG) methods are closed-set: they recognize only objects and predicates from a fixed training vocabulary and struggle with the long-tailed distribution of rare concepts, severely limiting their real-world applicability. Existing open-vocabulary models typically inherit pretrained large language models, resulting in multi-stage training and inference with substantial cost. We introduce OvDSGG, the first end-to-end framework for open-vocabulary DSGG. OvDSGG builds on top of an open-vocabulary Spatial Backbone and a Temporal Backbone; we further propose a Triplet Feature Extraction Module that bridges them, and a Visual-Language Alignment Module that preserves open-vocabulary recognition by learning an adaptive decision boundary in the joint visual-language feature space, without expensive knowledge distillation in existing methods. We further introduce a rigorous open-vocabulary DSGG benchmark adapted from Action Genome, with disjoint Base/Novel splits for both objects and predicates. OvDSGG significantly outperforms open-vocabulary baselines across all metrics, with zero-shot Recall@$K$ scores 10.0--20.4 percentage point higher than the next-best baseline, while on closed-set DSGG remaining competitive with state-of-the-art models. Code and benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/jhelsby/OvDSGG/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OvDSGG，这是首个端到端的开放词汇动态场景图生成框架，通过开放词汇空间骨干网络与时间骨干网络相结合，引入三元组特征提取模块和视觉-语言对齐模块，在无需昂贵知识蒸馏的情况下实现开放词汇识别。在Action Genome基础上构建了严格的开集基准测试，零样本Recall@K指标超越最优基线10.0至20.4个百分点，同时闭集性能与SOTA相当。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端动态场景图生成方法受限于固定训练词汇表（闭集），无法泛化到稀有概念且受长尾分布影响；已有的开放词汇方法通常依赖预训练大语言模型，导致多阶段训练/推理且成本高昂。因此需要一种高效、端到端的开放词汇DSGG框架。
AI.method: OvDSGG构建于开放词汇的空间骨干网络和时间骨干网络之上，提出三元组特征提取模块（Triplet Feature Extraction Module）桥接两者，并设计视觉-语言对齐模块（Visual-Language Alignment Module），通过在联合视觉-语言特征空间中学习自适应决策边界来保持开放词汇识别能力，避免了现有方法中昂贵的知识蒸馏过程。同时构建了基于Action Genome的严格开放词汇DSGG基准，包含对象和谓词的互不相交的Base/Novel划分。
AI.result: 在各种指标上显著超越开放词汇基线，零样本Recall@K比次优基线高出10.0至20.4个百分点；在闭集动态场景图生成上仍与最先进模型保持竞争力。代码和基准已公开。
AI.conclusion: OvDSGG证明了无需大规模语言模型蒸馏即可实现高效的端到端开放词汇动态场景图生成，为DSGG在真实世界中的广泛应用（如视频描述、视频问答、动作分析）提供了可行方案，并为该领域提供了统一的开放词汇评测基准。

title: Beyond Correctness: Toward Automated Novelty Verification with Lean 4
comment: 20 pages. Preliminary version; a large-scale quantitative evaluation (N theorems x M models) is left to future work. Comments welcome. Code: https://github.com/ayrtonporto/avid-journal
summary:
Artificial intelligence systems applied to mathematics verify correctness but not novelty: an automatically generated theorem can compile in Lean without errors and yet be an already known result. This article presents AViD Journal, a pipeline that receives a LaTeX article, formalizes its statements in Lean 4, and issues a novelty verdict through a decision tree over three dimensions: prior existence in a formal corpus (Mathlib) and an informal one (TheoremSearch and Matlas, with temporal filter and LLM judge), non-triviality via automatic tactics, and structural distance between proofs measured as Jaccard distance over premise sets.
  Evaluation on papers withdrawn from arXiv due to declared duplication produced a result more informative than any performance measure: the identification of three obstacles that limit the approach regardless of this implementation. First, successful compilation of a Lean file does not guarantee semantic fidelity. Second, the recall ceiling is imposed by the coverage of theorem indices, not by the similarity metric. Third, arXiv removes the source code of articles upon withdrawal, compromising the reproducibility of any benchmark built upon them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AViD Journal流水线，用于自动检测数学定理的新颖性。该系统将LaTeX论文的命题形式化为Lean 4代码，通过决策树在三个维度上判定新颖性：形式语料库(Mathlib)与非形式语料库中的先验存在性、自动tactics验证的非平凡性、基于前提集合Jaccard距离的结构相似度。在arXiv撤回的重复论文上评估时，发现了三个根本性障碍：Lean编译成功不代表语义保真、召回率上限受限于定理索引覆盖率而非相似度度量、arXiv下架源码破坏了基准的可复现性。
AI.motivation: 现有的AI数学系统只能验证定理的正确性，无法判断其新颖性——一个定理可以在Lean中无错编译却已是已知结果。作者旨在构建一个自动化的论文新颖性判定系统，弥补形式化工具在创新性评估上的空白。
AI.method: 提出AViD Journal流水线架构：(1) 将LaTeX论文中的命题形式化为Lean 4代码；(2) 构建决策树在三个维度综合评判：先在形式语料库(Mathlib)与非形式语料库(TheoremSearch和Matlas，附时间过滤和LLM判断)中检查是否存在先验结果、通过自动tactics检验定理的非平凡性、用前提集合的Jaccard距离衡量证明的结构距离。
AI.result: 在因重复声明而从arXiv撤回的论文上评估，作者的发现比任何性能指标都更具信息量：识别出三个限制该方法的根本性障碍。其一，Lean文件的成功编译不能保证语义保真；其二，召回率上限由定理索引的覆盖率决定，而非相似度度量本身；其三，arXiv撤回文章时会移除源代码，破坏了基于这些论文构建的任何基准的可复现性。
AI.conclusion: AViD Journal证明了自动新颖性检测在数学领域的可行性方向，但揭示了三个与具体实现无关的结构性挑战：形式化转换的语义保真问题、定理索引覆盖不足导致的召回率瓶颈、以及arXiv撤回机制对基准复现性的破坏。这些发现为未来设计更可靠的数学新颖性评估系统提供了重要指引。

title: Quantifying Depth Sufficiency in Residual Neural Networks: A First-Order Criterion
summary: How can we determine whether a trained neural network is already deep enough? We study this under a fixed function-preserving residual-growth protocol specifying insertion locations, residual families, zero-output initializations, and zero-state first-order updates. We define first-order residual depth saturation as the absence of a strict local decrease from every admissible insertion. We prove residual non-degeneracy is necessary and sufficient: additional depth has first-order value exactly when conditional activation gradients have a nonzero projection onto at least one admissible residual tangent space. This boundary is shared by descent-compatible zero-state updates and invariant under regular local reparameterizations preserving that tangent space. Under residual-signal realizability, raw activation-gradient vanishing exactly certifies saturation. Across ResNets, GPT-2-style models, and continued-pretrained Pythia checkpoints, the maximum activation-gradient norm decreases toward a low-signal regime with depth. Function-preserving growth also achieves converged performance competitive with training from scratch. These results support activation-gradient magnitude as a conservative diagnostic of the remaining empirical first-order value of residual depth.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何判断一个已训练的神经网络是否"足够深"。作者在保留函数的残差增长协议（固定插入位置、残差族、零输出初始化和零状态一阶更新）下定义了"一阶残差深度饱和"概念，并证明残差非退化是充分必要条件：当且仅当条件激活梯度在至少一个可容许残差切线空间上有非零投影时，增加深度才具有一阶价值。在残差信号可实现性条件下，原始激活梯度消失精确地认证饱和。实验表明，ResNet、GPT-2风格模型和持续预训练的Pythia检查点中，最大激活梯度范数随深度递减至低信号区间，且保函数增长能达到与从头训练相当的收敛性能。
AI.motivation: 深度学习实践中，决定网络架构是否"已经足够深"通常依赖经验或反复试验，缺乏理论指导。本文旨在为"神经网络何时不再需要更多深度"这一问题提供严格的理论框架和可操作的诊断标准，填补深度饱和判定方面的理论空白。
AI.method: 作者在固定函数保留的残差增长协议下引入"一阶残差深度饱和"定义，通过分析条件激活梯度到可容许残差切线空间的正交性条件，证明残差非退化是深度增加具有一阶价值的充要条件。同时论证该边界对兼容下降的零状态更新共享，且在保持切线空间的规则局部重参数化下不变。实验上在ResNet、GPT-2风格模型和Pythia检查点上验证了激活梯度范数随深度的衰减趋势。
AI.result: 理论证明残差非退化等价于额外深度具有一阶价值；在残差信号可实现性条件下，激活梯度完全消失精确认证饱和。实验显示各类模型的最大激活梯度范数随深度下降至低信号区间，且函数保留式增长收敛性能与从头训练相当。
AI.conclusion: 激活梯度范数可以作为"残差深度剩余的实证一阶价值"的保守诊断指标，为判断网络是否需要继续加深提供了理论支撑和实用工具。

title: TRACE-BN: Transferring Bangla-English Tutoring Behavior to a Sub-1B Offline Language Model
summary: Bangla-English tutoring requires more than producing a correct translation: learners also need explanations of grammar differences, awareness of their likely errors, and targeted practice. We present TRACE-BN, a curriculum-guided dataset of structured tutoring traces for Bangla-speaking learners of English at the CEFR A1-A2 level. Each trace combines word-level glosses, literal and natural translations, Bangla grammar explanations, a plausible learner error, and a targeted practice question with its answer. The traces are generated by Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite as the teacher model from NCTB Classes 9-10 English curriculum units, then filtered for structural validity, script integrity, and semantic duplication. We transfer the resulting structured tutoring behavior to Qwen3-0.6B using LoRA with 4-bit quantization for resource-constrained offline deployment. On held-out inputs, schema validity increases from 85.4% to 95.8%, while, against teacher-model references, chrF++ improves from 15.28 to 34.77 and BLEU from 4.52 to 21.03. Field-level evaluation by two independent judges shows improvements across translation, grammar explanation, learner-error diagnosis, and practice alignment, while a human audit supports the quality of the supervision data. The results show that curriculum-guided structured supervision can transfer multi-component tutoring behavior to a sub-1B model under these resource constraints. The dataset, model checkpoints, and code are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/RaiyanKhaan/Trace-BN

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRACE-BN，一个面向孟加拉语英语学习者的课程引导式结构化辅导数据集（CEFR A1-A2级别），并用LoRA+4-bit量化将Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite生成的多组件辅导行为迁移到Qwen3-0.6B小模型上。实验表明，在小模型上schema有效性从85.4%提升到95.8%，chrF++从15.28提升到34.77，BLEU从4.52提升到21.03，人类评估也验证了各字段质量提升。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语-英语辅导不仅需要正确的翻译，还需提供语法差异解释、学习者常见错误提示以及针对性练习。现有系统缺乏同时覆盖这些多组件辅导行为的数据集，且大规模模型不适用于资源受限的离线部署场景。
AI.method: 从NCTB 9-10年级英语课程单元出发，使用Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite作为教师模型生成结构化辅导轨迹（包含词级注释、直译/意译、孟加拉语语法解释、学习者可能错误及针对性练习题），经结构有效性、脚本完整性和语义重复过滤后，通过LoRA+4-bit量化将辅导行为迁移到Qwen3-0.6B模型。
AI.result: 在保留测试集上，schema有效性从85.4%提升至95.8%；相对教师模型参考，chrF++从15.28提升至34.77，BLEU从4.52提升至21.03。两名独立评审员的字段级评估显示翻译、语法解释、学习者错误诊断和练习对齐均有提升，人工审计也支持监督数据质量。
AI.conclusion: 课程引导的结构化监督能够将多组件辅导行为有效迁移到sub-1B规模模型上，在资源受限的条件下仍保持较高的辅导质量。数据集、模型检查点和代码已公开。

title: Zero-MELO: Test-Time Evidence Calibration with Multimodal LLMs for Zero-Shot Micro-Gesture Recognition
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel in general video understanding, their capability in fine-grained and motion-centric tasks remains limited. This limitation is particularly critical in micro-gesture recognition (MGR), where micro-gestures (MGs) - subtle, short-duration, and spatially localized human movements - serve as key discriminative signals for implicit affective analysis, yet are easily neglected following common prompting practices. Although MGR has been intensively studied by many discriminative approaches, the use of MLLMs for MGR is underexplored, with notably poor performance. We hypothesize that the motion-sensitive representation ability of MLLMs is constrained by their inherent single-pass forward inference, which can be substantially enhanced through carefully designed test-time guidance. Motivated by this, building on our prior findings regarding temporal insensitivity in Video LLMs, we diagnose zero-shot MGR errors in the Negative Log-Likelihood (NLL) space. We observe that MLLMs suffer from two bottlenecks: 1) insufficient localized evidence and 2) severe score biases driven by language and motion-agnostic appearances. Thus, we propose a novel test-time evidence calibration framework that improves both reasoning details and prediction reliability. Specifically, we introduce a tree search mechanism to progressively acquire localized, fine-grained visual evidence, coupled with a test-time calibration module to mitigate score biases. The multi-cue fusion module then integrates evidence from multiple cues without relying on a single cue for final prediction. Our framework achieves mean-class accuracies of 26.84\% on iMiGUE and 22.10\% on MA-52, significantly outperforming the Qwen2.5-VL baseline, which produces 16.15\% and 10.20\%, respectively. The code will be available at https://zero-melo.github.io/Zero-MELO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Zero-MELO，一个用于多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）微手势识别（MGR）的测试时证据校准框架。通过树搜索机制逐步获取局部细粒度视觉证据，并结合测试时校准模块缓解语言和外观导致的分数偏差，最终通过多线索融合模块整合多源证据。在iMiGUE和MA-52基准上分别达到26.84%和22.10%的平均类准确率，显著优于Qwen2.5-VL基线。
AI.motivation: MLLMs在通用视频理解上表现优异，但在微手势识别这类细粒度、运动中心的任务上能力受限。微手势是短时、局部、细微的人类运动，是隐性情感分析的关键信号，但常见提示方式下容易被忽略。现有MGR研究以判别式方法为主，MLLMs在MGR上的应用探索不足且性能差。作者假设MLLMs的运动敏感表征能力受限于其固有单次前向推理，可通过精心设计的测试时引导来显著增强。
AI.method: 首先在负对数似然空间中诊断零样本MGR错误，识别出两个瓶颈：(1)局部证据不足；(2)语言和运动无关外观导致的严重分数偏差。然后提出测试时证据校准框架，包含三个核心模块：树搜索机制用于逐步获取局部细粒度视觉证据；测试时校准模块用于缓解分数偏差；多线索融合模块整合多个线索的证据，不依赖单一线索做最终预测。
AI.result: 在iMiGUE数据集上达到26.84%的平均类准确率，在MA-52数据集上达到22.10%，显著优于Qwen2.5-VL基线的16.15%和10.20%。
AI.conclusion: 通过诊断驱动的方法，证明了测试时引导可以显著增强MLLMs在微手势识别中的运动敏感表征能力。该框架有效解决了局部证据获取和分数偏差两个核心瓶颈，为MLLMs在细粒度运动理解任务中的应用提供了新思路。

title: Auditing an AI-Generated Mathematical Proof: A Correction to a Greedy Conditioning Lemma in Quantum Parallel Repetition
comment: 8 pages, 5 references, Auditing an OpenAI's Generated Mathematical Proof
summary:
Chapter 6 of OpenAI's *Ten Advances in Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science* claims an exponential parallel-repetition theorem for all finite two-player, one-round entangled games. Early in the proof, the chapter uses a quantitative greedy conditioning lemma. The lemma is meant to select a small set of coordinates (D) such that, after conditioning on winning every coordinate in (D), a randomly chosen remaining coordinate is won with average probability at least (1-δ). The statement is correct, but the proof as printed contains a polarity error. Its continuation test is written in terms of average success, while the next step requires a coordinate with a large conditional failure probability. That implication is false, and even simple examples can leave the printed procedure without a valid next move.
  This note gives an explicit counterexample, identifies the intended continuation condition, and supplies a complete corrected proof. The repair is local: it leaves the statement of the lemma and the parameters used later in the chapter unchanged. It should not, however, be read as an independent verification of the main parallel-repetition theorem. More broadly, the example shows how a mathematically plausible AI-generated argument can hide a small but decisive reversal between complementary events.

AI.tldr: 本文指出OpenAI《数学与理论计算机科学十大进展》第6章中平行重复定理证明里的一个量化贪婪条件化引理存在极性错误：证明中续接测试写成了平均成功概率，而下一步需要的是大条件失败概率的坐标，这个蕴含关系不成立。作者给出显式反例，指出正确的续接条件，并提供了完整的修正证明。
AI.motivation: 该引理的印出证明包含一个极性错误，其续接测试以平均成功概率表述，而后续步骤需要条件失败概率大的坐标，两者蕴含关系不成立，导致印出程序在简单例子下可能无法继续。
AI.method: 作者构造了一个显式反例展示印出证明的失败，指出本意的续接条件，并提供完整的修正证明。修正只影响局部，不改变引理陈述及后续章节使用的参数。
AI.result: 给出了显式反例，识别了预期的续接条件（即需要大条件失败概率的坐标），并提供了完整的修正证明。修复是局部的，不改变引理陈述和后续参数。
AI.conclusion: 该修正不应被视为对主平行重复定理的独立验证。更广泛地，该例子展示了数学上看似合理的AI生成论证可能隐藏互补事件之间的小但决定性的反转。

title: When Does the Best Sampling Temperature Rise with the Budget? Sufficient Conditions for Pass@k
comment: Theory paper, 13 pages, 1 analytical figure. Deterministic verification code is included as ancillary material. No new language-model experiment
summary: The temperature that maximizes pass@$k$ is often low for a small sampling budget and higher for a large budget. This pattern has been reported from Codex through recent multi-sample inference studies. It is not an algebraic property of pass@$k$: as Slocum et al. (ICLR 2025) observe, for one fixed task the maximizing temperature is independent of $k$. Building on that fixed-task observation and the hard/easy-task explanation, we give a formal population-level sufficient condition for the aggregate pattern. For task $X$, let $p_t(X)$ be one-sample success probability at temperature $t$, and define the conditional log-success response $m_t(u)=\mathbb{E}[\dot p_t(X)\mid p_t(X)=u]/u$. If $m_t(u)$ is nonincreasing in current success probability, then the normalized temperature derivative of aggregate pass@$k$ is nondecreasing in $k$. Consequently, derivative signs are nested across budgets; if each temperature-performance curve is strictly single-peaked, its unique maximizer is nondecreasing in $k$. The proof identifies the mechanism as a monotone-likelihood-ratio power tilt toward lower-success tasks. We derive a closed-form two-stratum phase diagram, including upward and downward regimes, and show that the marginal temperature derivative admits an exact $\mathrm{Beta}(2,k)$ kernel representation whose kernel concentrates at one-sample success of order $1/k$. Interpreting that scale as task-level localization additionally requires a regular, nonvanishing density-response factor near zero. A signed-moment representation yields diagnostic shape restrictions, while a short appendix records exact discrete refinements of the existing multi-configuration allocation formulation. No language model is trained, and no model query is used as an experimental measurement: the contribution is a conditional theory of an established empirical phenomenon, with assumptions that can be tested in future work.

AI.tldr: 本文对"pass@k随采样预算增大而最优温度升高的经验现象"给出了一个正式的人口层面充分条件。核心发现是：若条件对数成功响应函数m_t(u)在u上非增，则聚合pass@k的归一化温度导数关于k非降，从而累积了低成功任务的单调似然比功率倾斜。文章还给出了闭式两分层相图、Beta(2,k)核表示及符号矩诊断约束。
AI.motivation: 从Codex到近期多采样推理研究均观察到：在小采样预算下最大化pass@k的温度偏低，而在大预算下偏高。Slocum等人(ICLR 2025)指出这不是pass@k的代数性质——对单个固定任务，最优温度与k无关。本文旨在为这一聚合层面经验模式提供严格的理论解释，建立充分条件。
AI.method: 基于固定任务观察和难/易任务解释，作者定义p_t(X)为温度t下单样本成功概率，引入条件对数成功响应m_t(u)=E[ṗ_t(X)|p_t(X)=u]/u。证明若m_t(u)关于u非增（即当前成功率越低、温度边际效应越强），则聚合pass@k的归一化温度导数关于k非降。证明机制通过单调似然比功率倾斜向低成功任务累积实现。此外推导了两分层闭式相图（含向上/向下两个区间），并给出边际温度导数的精确Beta(2,k)核表示，核集中在约1/k量级的单样本成功率处。最后用符号矩表示导出诊断形状约束，并在附录中记录多配置分配公式的离散精确精化。
AI.result: 给出了聚合pass@k最优温度随k非降的充分条件（m_t(u)非增）；证明导数符号在预算间嵌套；若各温度-性能曲线严格单峰，则唯一最大化温度关于k非降。推导了两分层系统的闭式相图（含向上与向下两种机制），并建立了Beta(2,k)核表示，核集中于1/k尺度的任务局部化。符号矩表示提供了可检验的形状限制。
AI.conclusion: 本文是对既有经验现象的条件概率理论，不涉及任何语言模型训练或模型查询。贡献在于给出聚合pass@k最优温度随采样预算递增的正式充分条件，揭示其机制为单调似然比功率倾斜，并提供了可检验的假设与精确的数学表征，为未来实证验证留出空间。

title: Time as Structure: Temporal Dependency Graphs for Verifiable Deadline Computation over Legal Documents
summary: Miss a filing deadline by one day and the claim is barred, however strong the case. Computing that deadline is rarely simple: the period runs from a triggering event, is counted by a statutory convention, and may be suspended by a mandatory conciliation window. We ask whether a language model should answer such questions directly, or read the document and leave the arithmetic to code. We extract dated facts and their dependencies into a temporal dependency graph and compute deadlines from it with a calendar-correct engine. On UK Employment Appeal Tribunal judgments the engine reproduces six of seven timeliness rulings, and matches the judges' own dates to the day. The strongest of four language models, asked the same cases, gets the arithmetic right and the answer wrong: in six of twenty-one responses its stated verdict contradicts its own thinking, and every contradiction runs the same way, calling a late claim timely. To test the systems at scale we move the dismissal date across the statutory boundary, generating 427 cases whose answers are computed rather than annotated. On the cases both systems answer, the pipeline is right 90.2% of the time against 61.2% for direct answering. The limit is extraction: on contracts the errors are almost never in the arithmetic, but in choosing which event the period starts from.

AI.tldr: 本文研究立法时限计算的自动化：将事实抽取为时间依赖图并配合日历引擎计算截止日期，在UK就业上诉法庭判决中重现了七个时限裁定中的六个，且日期与法官完全一致。对比四个语言模型直接回答，最强模型在21次回答中有6次自相矛盾（均将逾期判为及时）。在427个生成案例中，流水线准确率90.2%，远高于直接回答的61.2%，瓶颈在于抽取而非算术。
AI.motivation: 法律时效计算涉及触发事件、法定计期规则和强制调解期暂停等复杂环节，错过一天即丧失请求权。作者想知道语言模型应直接回答还是阅读文档后将算术交给代码，以构建更可靠的时限计算系统。
AI.method: 将文档中的带日期事实及其依赖关系抽取为时间依赖图（temporal dependency graph），再用日历正确引擎（calendar-correct engine）从中计算截止日期。为规模化测试，将解雇日期跨法定边界移动，生成427个答案由计算而非标注的案例。
AI.result: 在UK Employment Appeal Tribunal判决上，引擎重现七分之六的时限裁定，日期与法官精确到天一致。最强语言模型在21次回答中有6次结论与自身推理矛盾，且矛盾方向一致——均将逾期视为及时。在427个生成案例中流水线正确率90.2% vs 直接回答61.2%。失败案例几乎全部来自事件起点选择错误而非算术错误。
AI.conclusion: 将文档理解和算术计算分离的流水线架构在处理法律时限计算上显著优于语言模型直接回答，主要瓶颈在于事实抽取环节，特别是确定计期起算事件。

title: Beam-Wise Statistical Background Subtraction for Static Roadside LiDAR: A Cross-Sensor Benchmark Study
comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE 29th International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC), Naples, Italy, September 15-18, 2026
summary: Background subtraction is a key preprocessing step for infrastructure-based LiDAR perception, enabling efficient isolation of dynamic traffic participants without semantic annotations. However, systematic cross-sensor evaluations and reproducible studies for static roadside LiDAR are missing. This paper presents a comparative benchmark of beam-wise statistical background subtraction for statically mounted LiDAR sensors. We formulate background estimation as a per-beam temporal modeling problem and investigate complementary statistical strategies that capture dominant as well as multi-modal background structures, combined with spatial filtering in the angular and 3D domain. To enable reproducible evaluation, we introduce HighwayScene, a new multi-LiDAR dataset recorded in a static roadside setup, and extend the public CoopScenes dataset with static/dynamic point-wise annotations. Across multiple scenes and heterogeneous sensing technologies, we demonstrate that beam-wise statistical modeling provides a robust and transferable solution. Combining lightweight per-beam models with spatial consistency filtering substantially improves precision while maintaining high recall and real-time capability. All datasets, annotations, and implementations are publicly released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了针对静态路边LiDAR感知的波束级统计背景减法基准，引入新的多LiDAR数据集HighwayScene和扩展的CoopScenes数据集，通过结合轻量级逐波束统计模型与空间一致性滤波，实现了鲁棒且可迁移的静态/动态点分割，并公开了全部数据与实现。
AI.motivation: 背景减法是基础设施LiDAR感知的关键预处理步骤，能在无语义标注的情况下高效分离动态交通参与者。然而，现有研究缺乏针对静态路边LiDAR的系统性跨传感器评估和可复现研究。
AI.method: 将背景估计建模为逐波束的时间序列问题，研究多种互补的统计策略来捕捉主导及多模态背景结构，并结合角度域和3D域的空间滤波。构建了HighwayScene多LiDAR数据集，并扩展了CoopScenes数据集的静态/动态逐点标注，用于可复现评估。
AI.result: 在多种场景和异构传感技术上的实验表明，波束级统计建模提供了鲁棒且可迁移的解决方案。轻量级逐波束模型结合空间一致性滤波显著提升了精度，同时保持了高召回率和实时性能。
AI.conclusion: 波束级统计背景减法结合空间滤波是一种高效、可迁移且实时的静态LiDAR动态目标分离方案，所有数据、标注和实现均已公开发布以促进可复现研究。

title: When Agentic Executions Fail: Detecting and Localizing Runtime Faults from Telemetry
summary: Reliability in LLM-based agentic systems is a property of the whole execution (its tool calls, model calls, guardrails, and inter-agent messages), not of the final answer alone, yet evaluating only task outcomes reveals little about how or why a run fails. We present AGENTCHAOSBENCH, a benchmark for detecting and localizing runtime faults in agentic systems from their execution telemetry. We run five heterogeneous applications that coordinate agents over the Agent-to-Agent protocol and call tools through the Model Context Protocol, and inject ten types of operational fault (unavailable or slow tools, corrupted or oversized responses, and delayed, looped, or misrouted delegations and bypassed guardrails) at their tool, model, guardrail, and inter-agent boundaries, alongside a no-fault control. The resulting dataset contains 275 sanitized traces: 250 faulty executions spanning ten fault types and 25 no-fault controls. Each faulty trace is aligned with the no-fault execution of the same input; fault-type labels and, where applicable, location labels are held out from diagnosis. On structured single-trace inputs, a first set of zero-shot LLM baselines shows the task is far from solved: local detectors up to 14B parameters reach only 13.6-19.2% top-1 fault-type accuracy and the frontier DeepSeek-v4-pro only 24.8%, while jointly identifying the fault type and its location tops out at 22%; reference-dependent faults (above all a bypassed guardrail) stay near-unsolved from a single trace. An aligned reference improves selected relative faults but does not resolve guardrail bypass. The held-out labels and compact prediction format support reproducible comparison of LLM-based and non-LLM diagnosis methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AGENTCHAOSBENCH，一个用于检测和定位LLM智能体系统运行时故障的基准。通过五个异构应用程序，注入十种操作故障（如工具不可用、响应损坏、延迟/循环/错误路由的委派、护栏绕过等），生成275条清洗后的轨迹（250条故障+25条无故障对照）。零样本LLM基线表现差：14B参数检测器故障类型top-1准确率仅13.6-19.2%，前沿模型DeepSeek-v4-pro仅24.8%，联合故障类型+位置最高22%，引用依赖型故障（尤其护栏绕过）几乎无法从单条轨迹解决。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体系统的可靠性是整个执行过程（工具调用、模型调用、护栏、智能体间消息）的属性，而不仅仅是最终答案。现有的评估只关注任务结果，无法揭示运行失败的方式和原因。因此需要从执行遥测数据中检测和定位运行时故障的基准。
AI.method: 构建AGENTCHAOSBENCH：在五个异构应用程序上（通过Agent-to-Agent协议协调智能体，通过Model Context Protocol调用工具），在工具、模型、护栏和智能体间边界注入十种故障类型（工具不可用/缓慢、响应损坏/过大、委派延迟/循环/错误路由、护栏绕过）以及无故障对照组。每条故障轨迹与同一输入的无故障执行轨迹对齐，保留故障类型标签和位置标签。对结构化单轨迹输入进行零样本LLM评估。
AI.result: 275条净化轨迹（250条故障+25条无故障）。本地检测器（最高14B参数）故障类型top-1准确率仅13.6-19.2%，DeepSeek-v4-pro为24.8%；联合识别故障类型和位置最高22%；引用依赖型故障（尤其护栏绕过）几乎无法从单条轨迹解决。对齐参考轨迹可改善部分相对故障，但不能解决护栏绕过。
AI.conclusion: 该任务远未解决，当前LLM在此诊断任务上表现不佳。数据集保留的标签和紧凑的预测格式支持LLM和非LLM诊断方法的可复现比较，为该领域后续研究提供基准基础。

title: ARGUS: Attention-Guided Transformers for Scalable Person Identification Using Wi-Fi Telemetry
summary: Passive, device-free person identification offers an alternative to camera- and wearable-based biometrics, yet existing wireless approaches rely largely on gait or activity cues and are rarely evaluated at scale. In this paper, we present \emph{Argus}, a passive Wi-Fi sensing system that identifies people from commodity Channel State Information (CSI) without requiring an attached device or a prescribed motion. Argus converts short CSI spans into compact \emph{statgrams}: statistical maps built from the channel views available on a given device. A lightweight decoder-only Transformer then reads coarse statgram patches as tokens, and segment-level logit aggregation combines evidence over time. On a 154-subject CSI dataset evaluated with a strict physical-segment split, Argus reaches $78.88\% \pm 1.62\%$ Top-1 accuracy on 6-second windows and $84.85\% \pm 1.31\%$ after aggregating 19 overlapping windows over a 60-second segment; Top-3 and Top-5 reach $98.61\%$ and $99.26\%$. For a 60-second statgram, Argus improves over a raw-CSI Transformer baseline by 7.75 points while using $4.4\times$ fewer FLOPs per window. Attention-guided compression preserves full single-window accuracy with only half of the EHealth patches. On WiMANS, a multi-user benchmark across three rooms and two Wi-Fi bands, Argus remains within 1.23 percentage points of the strongest per-configuration baselines on average while using $27\times$ fewer inference FLOPs. These results show that compact CSI statistics can scale passive identification while also exposing deployment limits in open-set rejection and cross-room transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出了Argus，一个基于Wi-Fi CSI的被动式无设备人员识别系统。它将CSI片段转换为紧凑的统计图（statgrams），通过轻量级decoder-only Transformer处理并聚合分段级logit。在154人数据集上达到78.88%的6秒Top-1准确率和84.85%的60秒聚合准确率，并在WiMANS基准上用27倍更少的推理FLOPs保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有基于无源Wi-Fi的人员识别方法大多依赖步态或活动特征，且很少在大规模数据集上评估。作者旨在开发一种不需要设备附着或预设动作、可大规模部署的被动人员识别方案。
AI.method: Argus将短CSI片段转换为紧凑的统计图（statgrams），统计图基于特定设备可用的信道视图构建。然后使用轻量级decoder-only Transformer将粗粒度statgram块读取为token，并通过分段级logit聚合在时间上整合证据。此外引入注意力引导的压缩策略，仅保留一半的EHealth patches即可保持完整准确率。
AI.result: 在154人数据集上，6秒窗口Top-1准确率78.88%±1.62%，60秒分段聚合后达84.85%±1.31%；Top-3和Top-5分别达98.61%和99.26%。相比原始CSI Transformer基线提高7.75个百分点，同时每窗口FLOPs减少4.4倍。在WiMANS多用户基准上，平均仅落后最强baseline 1.23个百分点，而推理FLOPs减少27倍。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的CSI统计特征可以在大规模场景下实现可扩展的被动人员识别，但同时也暴露了开放集拒绝和跨房间迁移方面的部署局限。

title: When Do Concepts Become Functionally Sufficient During Language-Model Training?
summary: Understanding a model and its learning mechanisms in depth requires identifying when its internal structures become useful, rather than simply looking at the final state. We study this through concept dynamics: at each layer and checkpoint, we decompose activations, select sparse soft masks, and inject masked reconstructions into the model. Concept analysis is therefore tested functionally: a mask is useful only insofar as it preserves a target under intervention. We compare sufficiency for activation reconstruction, linear decodability, true downstream preservation, and checkpoint transfer under learned alignment. The framework treats decomposition assumptions as hypotheses rather than interpretability guarantees, monitoring functional sufficiency across checkpoints and source-to-final reconstructability under learned alignment. At the shared fixed-penalty operating point across seven models, downstream masks retain substantially less soft mass than reconstruction masks; predictive-distribution shifts remain small.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种通过概念动力学研究模型内部结构有用性的框架，在不同层和检查点对激活进行分解，选择稀疏软掩码并注入掩码重建到模型中，以功能性方式测试概念分析的有效性。通过在七个模型上比较激活重建、线性可解码性、下游保留和检查点迁移等功能充分性，发现下游掩码保留的软质量远少于重建掩码，但预测分布偏移仍然较小。
AI.motivation: 深入理解模型及其学习机制需要识别内部结构在何时变得有用，而非仅关注最终状态。现有方法往往只检查模型的最终状态，忽略了学习过程中内部概念动态演化的过程。
AI.method: 在每层和检查点处分解激活，选择稀疏软掩码，并将掩码重建注入到模型中。通过比较四种功能性指标：激活重建充分性、线性可解码性、真实下游保留能力以及在学习对齐下的检查点迁移。将分解假设视为可检验的假设而非解释性保证，监控跨检查点的功能充分性和学习对齐下的源到最终可重建性。
AI.result: 在七个模型的共享固定惩罚操作点下，用于下游任务的掩码保留的软质量显著少于重建掩码；预测分布的偏移仍然很小，说明下游掩码虽然更稀疏但功能上仍能保持模型行为。
AI.conclusion: 概念分析应被视为功能性假设检验而非解释性保证；下游概念与重建概念在稀疏性-充分性权衡上存在系统性差异，且通过跨检查点监控可以追踪概念结构的形成与演化过程。

title: SpIn-ViT: Designing a Sparsity-Induced Vision Transformer That Is Mechanistically Interpretable
summary: Mechanistic interpretability has recently expanded to Vision Transformers (ViTs), with Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) increasingly used as post-hoc tools to decompose internal representations into sparse and more interpretable features. However, because post-hoc SAEs are trained on frozen representations after the ViT has already been optimized, their latent features are not directly aligned with the downstream classification objective. We introduce SpIn-ViT, a framework that jointly trains a pretrained ViT and a modified SAE end-to-end, directly aligning sparse patch-level representations with image classification. SpIn-ViT learns semantically coherent neuron activations that localize meaningful image regions while maintaining competitive predictive performance. We evaluate SpIn-ViT across nine image-classification benchmarks using classification accuracy, quantitative interpretability metrics, AI-based and Human evaluations. Compared with the previous state-of-the-art post-hoc SAE method, SpIn-ViT achieves 8.84% higher average classification accuracy, an AI-based interpretability score nearly four times as high, and a human-evaluation score more than twice as high. We further extract interpretable rule-sets using the SAE neurons to create neurosymbolic models which achieve 5.97% higher average classification accuracy while requiring a 58.8\% smaller rule-set than the neurosymbolic models created from the SOTA post-hoc SAE method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SpIn-ViT框架，将预训练ViT与修改后的稀疏自编码器（SAE）进行端到端联合训练，使稀疏补丁级表示直接与图像分类目标对齐。在九个基准上，相比SOTA事后SAE方法，分类准确率提升8.84%，AI可解释性分数提升近4倍，人类评估分数提升2倍以上；生成的神经符号模型准确率提升5.97%，同时规则集缩小58.8%。
AI.motivation: 现有事后SAE在冻结的ViT表示上训练，其潜在特征与下游分类目标不对齐，导致可解释性与任务性能之间存在脱节。
AI.method: 提出SpIn-ViT框架，将预训练ViT与改进的SAE进行端到端联合训练，直接对齐稀疏补丁级表示与图像分类目标，并利用SAE神经元提取可解释规则集以构建神经符号模型。
AI.result: 在九个图像分类基准上，相比SOTA事后SAE方法：分类准确率平均提升8.84%，AI可解释性分数提升近4倍，人类评估分数提升2倍以上；神经符号模型准确率提升5.97%且规则集缩小58.8%。
AI.conclusion: 端到端联合训练方式使SAE潜在特征与分类目标对齐，显著提升可解释性与分类性能的兼顾能力，并能在更紧凑的规则集下构建更准确的神经符号模型。

title: A Comprehensive Survey of Wireless Foundation Models for AI-Native 6G Networks
comment: 28 Pages, submitted to IEEE Communications Surveys and Tutorials
summary: Foundation models are emerging as a transformative paradigm for AI-native sixth-generation (6G) wireless networks by enabling scalable, transferable, and data-efficient intelligence across diverse communication tasks. Unlike conventional deep learning models that are trained for individual applications, wireless foundation models (WFMs) learn generalized representations from large-scale heterogeneous wireless data and can be efficiently adapted to communication, sensing, localization, and network optimization tasks with minimal task-specific supervision. Despite rapid progress, current research remains fragmented across architectures, training paradigms, and application domains, with no unified survey dedicated to the design, learning, and deployment of WFMs. This survey presents a comprehensive and unified review of wireless foundation models. We first establish the fundamental concepts of WFMs and introduce a taxonomy that organizes the field according to model architectures, pre-training paradigms, and applications. We then review representative architectures, self-supervised pre-training strategies, parameter-efficient adaptation methods, datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation methodologies, highlighting their roles in enabling transferable wireless intelligence. Furthermore, we examine emerging applications spanning physical-layer signal processing, network intelligence, and cross-layer optimization, and discuss the key challenges of data availability, generalization, interpretability, efficient edge deployment, and standardization. Finally, we outline future research directions toward scalable, trustworthy, and general-purpose wireless intelligence for AI-native 6G networks. This survey provides a comprehensive reference for researchers and practitioners developing next-generation intelligent wireless systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提供了无线基础模型（WFMs）的全面综述，涵盖概念、分类体系、架构、预训练策略、适配方法、数据集、基准、应用及挑战，为AI原生6G网络的智能无线系统发展提供参考。
AI.motivation: 当前基金模型在6G无线网络中的应用研究虽快速进展，但研究内容在架构、训练范式和领域应用上碎片化，缺乏统一的综述来系统性地梳理WFM的设计、学习与部署。
AI.method: 本文首先建立WFM的基本概念并提出根据模型架构、预训练范式和应用的分类体系，然后综述代表性架构、自监督预训练策略、参数高效适配方法、数据集、基准和评估方法，再考察物理层信号处理、网络智能和跨层优化等新兴应用，最后讨论挑战并展望未来方向。
AI.result: 形成了一套统一的WFM综述框架，覆盖从核心概念到前沿应用的完整技术栈，识别了数据可用性、泛化、可解释性、边缘高效部署和标准化等关键挑战，并指出了迈向可扩展、可信赖、通用型无线智能的未来研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为研究人员和从业者开发下一代智能无线系统提供了全面的参考，有助于加速WFM在AI原生6G网络中的研究和落地。

title: Take it Personally: The Limits of General SSL Representations for Real-Life PPG Emotion Detection
comment: 9 pages, 4 Figures, 2 Tables, Accepted as the 14th International Conference on Affective Computing and Intelligent Interaction (ACII 2026)
summary: While Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) effectively extracts general representations from noisy, unconstrained physiological signals such as photoplethysmography (PPG), its suitability for highly subjective tasks remains unproven. In this work, we evaluate the efficacy of PPG-based SSL for real-life intense emotion detection. First, we pretrain a Real-Life PPG encoder (RL-PPG) on unconstrained, real-life data. As a rigorous sanity check, we demonstrate that these representations transfer exceptionally well to an objective physical activity recognition task, yielding almost 5-fold increase in performance over baselines in a leave-one-subject-out evaluation (LOSO). However, when applied to a~subjective real-life emotion detection task, these same general representations fail to surpass naive baselines under the LOSO protocol. Using an Across-Time validation strategy, we establish that incorporating an individual's personal data during fine-tuning is the main driver of predictive performance, outweighing the benefits of population-level pretraining. Ultimately, our findings indicate that in the evaluated scenario, general SSL representations may be insufficient for subjective affective inference, suggesting that personalization is likely a key component for real-world emotion recognition. To support future research, we share the code and pretrained RL-PPG~encoder~weights.

AI.tldr: 该论文评估了基于光电容积脉搏波（PPG）的自监督学习（SSL）在真实场景强烈情绪检测中的效果。研究发现，预训练的通用表征在客观的身体活动识别任务中表现出色（性能提升近5倍），但在主观的情绪检测任务中无法超越简单的基线。跨时间验证策略表明，在微调时纳入个体个人数据是预测性能的主要驱动因素，而非群体级别的预训练，这暗示通用SSL表征可能不足以应对主观情感推断，个性化是关键要素。
AI.motivation: 自监督学习能从嘈杂、无约束的生理信号（如PPG）中有效提取通用表征，但其在高度主观任务中的适用性尚未得到验证。作者旨在探究SSL表征在真实生活环境中强烈情绪检测中的实际效能，以填补这一研究空白。
AI.method: 首先在无约束的真实生活数据上预训练一个Real-Life PPG编码器（RL-PPG）。然后进行两项评估：（1）客观的身体活动识别任务作为健全性检查，采用留一受试者（LOSO）评估；（2）主观的真实生活情绪检测任务，采用LOSO协议和Across-Time验证策略进行对比分析。
AI.result: （1）在身体活动识别任务中，RL-PPG预训练表征在LOSO评估下较基线性能提升近5倍。（2）在情绪检测任务中，同样的通用表征在LOSO协议下无法超越朴素基线。（3）Across-Time验证表明，微调时纳入个体个人数据是预测性能的主要驱动因素，其贡献超过群体级别预训练的收益。
AI.conclusion: 在所评估的场景中，通用SSL表征可能不足以支持主观情感推断。个性化很可能是真实世界情绪识别的关键组成部分。作者公开了代码和预训练权重以支持进一步研究。

title: Logical Embeddings for Argument Analysis
summary: We propose a new framework for machine-learning-oriented argument analysis tasks. Our proposal involves replacing traditional contextualized word embeddings used in most NLP tasks with logical embeddings, an alternative encoding that directly exploits argumentation structures. In essence, logical embeddings encapsulate the logical semantics of an argument, allowing for a better representation of its meaning. Supporting these embeddings is a mathematical logic-based similarity measure that offers a transparent notion of proximity and is guaranteed to satisfy several desirable theoretical properties that current cosine similarity-based contextualized word embeddings cannot assure. This similarity measure induces a positive semi-definite kernel on the set of arguments, enabling us to uniquely define logical embeddings using the theory of Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces (RKHS). Moreover, we prove that this encoding is optimal, in the sense that no logical information is lost in the process. As with other RKHS applications, logical embeddings can be used in numerous supervised and unsupervised tasks. We provide an implementation of the method and aim to test it against literature benchmarks. Additionally, we demonstrate that logical embeddings outperform most standard embedding methods on a classification task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向机器学习驱动的论证分析任务的新框架，用逻辑嵌入（logical embeddings）替代传统的上下文词嵌入，直接利用论证结构来编码论证的逻辑语义。该框架基于数学逻辑的相似性度量，满足理想的理论性质，并诱导正半定核，从而通过RKHS理论唯一定义逻辑嵌入，且证明该编码是逻辑无损的。实验表明逻辑嵌入在分类任务上优于大多数标准嵌入方法。
AI.motivation: 传统的上下文词嵌入（如基于余弦相似度的嵌入）虽然广泛应用于NLP任务，但在论证分析中缺乏对论证结构及其逻辑语义的直接利用，且余弦相似度度量无法保证某些理想的理论性质（如对称性、三角不等式等）。因此，需要一个能够直接编码论证逻辑结构、具有透明相似性度量的新嵌入框架。
AI.method: 作者提出逻辑嵌入来替代上下文词嵌入。具体方法包括：(1) 设计一种基于数学逻辑的相似性度量，替代余弦相似度；(2) 证明该相似性度量诱导正半定核（PSD kernel）；(3) 利用RKHS理论在这些核上唯一定义逻辑嵌入；(4) 证明该编码在逻辑信息上是无损的（最优性）；(5) 将逻辑嵌入应用于监督和无监督的论证分析任务。
AI.result: 作者提供了方法的实现，并在文献基准上进行了测试。在分类任务中，逻辑嵌入优于大多数标准嵌入方法。
AI.conclusion: 逻辑嵌入作为一种替代传统上下文词嵌入的新方案，能够直接利用论证结构，提供透明且满足理论性质的相似性度量，并在分类任务中展现出优于大多数标准嵌入方法的性能，有望成为论证分析领域的有力工具。

title: PaSTel: Anchoring Histology in Spatial Transcriptomics via Multi-Scale Hierarchical Bio-Prior Contrastive Pretraining
comment: This paper was accepted to the 3rd ICML 2026 Workshop on Multi-modal Foundation Models and Large Language Models for Life Sciences
summary: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) links tissue morphology with molecular programs, motivating multimodal pretraining methods that align histology images with gene expression. However, existing approaches suffer from two key limitations: spatially informative gene selection is often dominated by ubiquitous housekeeping genes, leading to weakly discriminative representations, and independent spot-patch alignment fails to capture spatial dependencies that are critical for tissue organization. To address these challenges, we introduce PaSTel, a hierarchical multimodal pretraining framework that integrates biological priors at three levels. At the spot level, TF-IDF reweighting is used to identify spatially informative genes; at the functional level, curated KEGG pathways serve as anchors for encoding global biological semantics; and at the regional level, spatial clustering aggregates neighboring spots to model meso-scale tissue structure. Across multiple downstream tasks, PaSTel consistently outperforms existing vision and vision-omics encoders, demonstrating that incorporating multiscale biological priors yields more informative and transferable representations for spatial transcriptomics.

AI.tldr: PaSTel是一个层次化多模态预训练框架，通过整合spot级TF-IDF重加权、功能级KEGG通路锚定和区域级空间聚类三个层次的生物先验，解决空间转录组学中基因选择被管家基因主导和独立spot-patch对齐忽略空间依赖性的问题，在多个下游任务中优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有空间转录组学多模态预训练方法存在两个关键局限：(1)空间信息基因选择常被广泛表达的管家基因主导，导致特征判别性弱；(2)独立的spot-patch对齐无法捕捉对组织结构至关重要的空间依赖性。
AI.method: 提出PaSTel层次化多模态预训练框架，在三个层次整合生物先验：spot级别使用TF-IDF重加权筛选空间信息基因；功能级别使用KEGG通路作为锚点编码全局生物学语义；区域级别使用空间聚类聚合邻近spots以建模介观尺度的组织结构。
AI.result: 在多个下游任务上，PaSTel一致性地优于现有的视觉和视觉-组学编码器，表明整合多尺度生物先验能产生更具信息量和可迁移性的空间转录组学表示。
AI.conclusion: 多尺度生物先验的引入能够显著提升空间转录组学多模态预训练的表征质量和泛化能力，为空间转录组学研究提供了更优的表示学习方法。

title: Synchronized Logit Steering: Real-world Steganography
summary: Steganography in large language models offers a way to embed hidden messages within natural-sounding text. Existing token and logit-level methods typically require the sender and receiver to share an identical prompt context, which is rarely guaranteed in production pipelines that use retrieval-augmented generation or proprietary system instructions. We introduce Synchronized Logit Steering (SLS), a deterministic steganographic scheme that eliminates this dependency by deriving a proxy prompt from the generated output itself, allowing both parties to reconstruct the same logit distribution without access to the original prompt. SLS encodes payload values as token ranks within high-entropy regions of the proxy prompt distribution, and we extend the scheme with periodic recurrence and payload bursts to scale information density. Across ShareGPT, GSM8K, and SWE-bench Verified, we show that the KL divergence between the true and proxy prompt distributions falls below 0.5 nats once the synchronization window reaches 40 tokens, and SLS encoding does not meaningfully disrupt this convergence relative to greedy generation. We also find that the periodic-burst variant achieves 0.20 bits per token, or roughly 10x the capacity of single-payload encoding. Kolmogorov-Smirnov tests further confirm that SLS outputs are statistically difficult to distinguish from greedy generations, demonstrating that covert, prompt-agnostic communication through LLMs is both practical and stealthy.

AI.tldr: 提出了同步对数几率引导（SLS）方法，一种无需共享提示上下文的确定性隐写方案，通过从生成输出本身推导代理提示来实现隐蔽通信，在保证统计隐蔽性的同时实现了更高的信息容量。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型隐写方法（基于token或logit级别）要求发送方和接收方共享完全相同的提示上下文，但在实际生产环境中，使用检索增强生成或专有系统指令时这一条件几乎无法保证，限制了隐写方案的应用。
AI.method: SLS从生成输出中推导一个代理提示（proxy prompt），使双方无需访问原始提示即可重建相同的logit分布。载荷值被编码为代理提示分布中高熵区域的token排名。进一步通过周期性复发和载荷突发（periodic-burst）机制来扩展信息密度。
AI.result: 在ShareGPT、GSM8K和SWE-bench Verified数据集上，当同步窗口达到40个token时，真实提示与代理提示分布之间的KL散度降至0.5 nats以下；周期性突发变体实现了0.20 bits/的token容量，约为单载荷编码的10倍；Kolmogorov-Smirnov检验确认SLS输出与贪心生成在统计上难以区分。
AI.conclusion: SLS证明了通过LLM进行隐蔽、提示无关的通信既实用又具有统计隐蔽性，解决了现有方法对共享提示上下文的依赖问题。

title: RouteTS: Frequency-Time Routing for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Real-world time series inherently intertwine global periodic structures with localized non-stationary variations. Existing approaches process these heterogeneous dynamics within a single computational domain, incurring fundamental limitations: time-domain models suffer from periodic misalignment over long horizons, while frequency-domain models over-smooth transient spikes. We argue that the optimal computational domain is not a property of the model, but of the data itself. Based on this principle, we propose RouteTS, a unified forecasting framework that partitions the frequency spectrum via amplitude routing and delegates components to their mathematically optimal domains. Dominant frequencies are processed by a complex-valued linear predictor in the frequency domain to preserve periodic structure, while residual spectral energy is reverted to the time domain and modeled by a lightweight MLP for local variations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RouteTS achieves competitive prediction accuracy across diverse real-world datasets, with routing decisions guided by the underlying spectral signature. Furthermore, the lightweight design of RouteTS provides significant computational efficiency advantages, offering a principled solution to the longstanding dilemma between global periodicity and local transience.

AI.tldr: RouteTS是一个统一的时序预测框架，通过频谱幅度路由将频率成分分配到其数学上最优的计算域：主导频率由频域复数线性预测器处理以保持周期结构，残差频谱能量在时域由轻量MLP建模局部变化，在精度和计算效率上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 真实世界的时间序列天然交织着全局周期结构与局部非平稳变化。现有方法在单一计算域内处理这些异构动力学，存在根本性局限：时域模型在长预测范围内存在周期错位问题，而频域模型则过度平滑瞬态尖峰。作者认为最优计算域不是模型的属性，而是数据自身的属性，因此需要一种根据数据频谱特征自适应选择计算域的方法。
AI.method: RouteTS框架包含三个关键步骤：(1) 通过幅度路由（amplitude routing）对频率谱进行分区，识别主导频率成分；(2) 将主导频率交由频域中的复数线性预测器处理，以保留周期结构；(3) 将剩余的频谱能量转回时域，由轻量级MLP建模局部变化。路由决策由底层频谱特征指导，实现数据驱动的自适应域分配。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界数据集上，RouteTS取得了具有竞争力的预测精度，且路由决策由底层频谱特征自然引导。其轻量级设计带来了显著的计算效率优势，在保证精度的同时大幅降低了计算开销。
AI.conclusion: RouteTS提供了一个有原则的解决方案来应对全局周期性与局部瞬变性之间的长期困境，证明了"最优计算域应由数据决定而非由模型决定"这一核心原则的有效性，为时序预测中的域选择问题提供了新的范式。

title: When AI Rewrites, Classifiers Relax: Uncertainty-Aware Sentiment Analysis on Sarcastic and AI-Paraphrased Social Text
summary: Sentiment classifiers are increasingly applied to social media content that is either sarcastic or AI-generated --- two distributional regimes where standard evaluations offer little guidance. We present a three-part empirical study of sentiment classifier behaviour under these conditions. First, we find that confidence scores on sarcastic text are significantly lower than on non-sarcastic text (Mann--Whitney $p = 2 \times 10^{-6}$), confirming that classifiers sense their own uncertainty on ironic content even without explicit uncertainty modelling. Second, and counterintuitively, we show that sentiment classifiers achieve higher accuracy on AI-paraphrased reviews than on the original human-authored text (RoBERTa: $+5.8$ pp for Qwen3.5-4B paraphrases, $+3.7$ pp for Gemma4-E4B), revealing a cross-domain stylistic alignment effect: AI paraphrases remove distributional noise that confounds Twitter-trained classifiers, producing cleaner, more prototypical sentiment text. Third, we demonstrate that a lightweight abstention wrapper --- flagging the $14\%$ of inputs with confidence below $0.6$ --- improves accuracy from 82.2\% to 88.9\% ($+6.7$ pp) on the retained set. We further compare Semantic Entropy and MC-Dropout-style disagreement as uncertainty signals and find near-identical AUROC ($0.650$ vs.\ $0.646$) on sarcastic text, suggesting that for short social media inputs, both methods are interchangeable.
