That window has two measured edges, a survival failure below and destruction above, and it falls at the same fractional depth in a 64-layer hybrid and a 62-layer dense model from another family. We localise where the variable is installed and read, not the route from the passage, which transports nothing. But the readout is not a calibrated measure of use: three components move it to within 12% of one another and differ 7.4x in what they do to the answer.

AI.tldr: 本文通过Jacobian透镜在开放权重语言模型的基准测试中发现，语言模型中"工作空间"式的读入门控并不存在；需求的提升会提高概念的表征可见性，但该效果并非由单一门决定，而是由中深度窗口内的注意力聚集驱动，且读出器并非可靠的"使用量"衡量标准。
AI.motivation: 语言模型能以某种可报告的形式持有潜在数量，且当任务需要灵活复用时该形式中呈现的数量更多。什么因素使表征进入这种形式尚不清楚，"工作空间"隐喻暗示存在一个决定"谁被放进去"的门控机制，本文旨在检验这一假设。
AI.method: 使用Jabobian透镜对开放权重模型进行分析，构建五个臂共享相同上下文的基准测试，将补丁深度与读出深度分离以定位传输机制，并测量百分位排名与选择校正后的基线对比，检验MLP输出与注意力中介的贡献。
AI.result: 未发现预测中存在的门控机制。需求使透镜可见性提升（主检查点百分位排名+0.050），但一个共享线性映射能从所有臂（含对照）解码该变量，为选择校正基线的6.4-9.0倍。定位到中深度窗口内的注意力聚集传输（浅层之上至少17倍），该窗口具有下方生存失败和上方破坏两条边界，在64层混合模型和62层稠密模型中位于相同分数深度。但读出器并非校准的使用量度：三个组分使其差异缩小至12%以内，而对答案的影响相差7.4倍。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型中不存在传统意义上的"工作空间"门控；中深度窗口内的注意力聚集是产生可读形式的机制，该过程具有需求特异性。然而读出度量本身并非使用量的可靠指示器，同一可见性变化可能对应相差近一个数量级的实际行为影响。

title: Certifying Compressed Language Models: An Audit and a Statistical Toolkit
comment: 109 pages, 3 figures, 20 tables. Artifacts and per-item outputs: doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21939143
summary: A fraction of a point of benchmark accuracy is the usual evidence that a compressed model is equivalent to its original. That quantity is least informative when two models are most alike: a net delta is what survives cancellation between opposing per-item changes, and cancellation is most complete in the regime equivalence claims occupy. Across an atlas of 1,707 paired model-by-task cells mined from public per-item evaluation dumps (1.3B-405B), churn runs roughly five times the net accuracy delta, and cells scoring identically to their baseline still disagree on individual items. In a preregistered audit of 17 equivalence claims from three registered frames (method papers, model cards, vendor documentation), 16 are eligible. None states a prospective numerical equivalence margin, and none releases task-matched per-item outputs, though 3 release outputs for other tasks only; 5 report too little to assess numerically, so a reader cannot check them at any sample size. We audit evidential sufficiency, not truth: no claim is called false. We supply the missing instrument: paired equivalence testing at a declared margin, with certification tables giving the items an evaluation needs, computed from disagreement observed under compression, not from independent-binomial variance. A controlled experiment pairs GPTQ and AWQ on byte-identical calibration samples across five seeds. Under the frozen eight-cell decision rule H3 is supported: changing the calibration draw was sufficient to reverse the observed method ordering in 5 of 8 confirmatory cells. The reporting standard we propose is five lines: declare a margin, run the paired test, report churn beside net delta, cite the sample size you met, release per-item outputs. It applies to any comparison between two models alike enough to be worth comparing. All per-item outputs, protocols and code are released.

AI.tldr: 本文指出压缩模型等效性宣称通常仅依据净准确率差值，但该指标在模型高度相似时信息量最低。通过1,707个模型-任务配对单元的分析，发现逐项翻转（churn）约为净准确率差的5倍。对17项预注册等效性宣称进行审计，16项合格但均未声明前瞻性数值裕度或发布匹配的逐项输出。作者提出配对等效性检验作为替代工具，并设计对照实验（GPTQ vs AWQ），在5个种子中8个确认单元格中5个支持H3假设：校准样本的变化足以反转方法排序。
AI.motivation: 当前压缩模型等效性验证依赖净准确率差值，而该指标在模型最相似时信息量最低。由于逐项变化在求和时相互抵消，净差值掩盖了大量个体层面的不一致，使得等效性宣称缺乏严格证据基础。
AI.method: 作者构建了包含1,707对模型-任务单元的预测图集，挖掘公开逐项评估数据（1.3B-405B），量化churn与净准确率差值的比率；对17项从三种注册框架（方法论文、模型卡、厂商文档）选取的等效性宣称进行预注册审计；提出在声明裕度下的配对等效性检验及认证表；并用对照实验在字节级一致的校准样本上对比GPTQ和AWQ，跨5个种子检验H3假设。
AI.result: churn约为净准确率差值的5倍；16项合格宣称中无一声明数值裕度，无一发布任务匹配的逐项输出（3项仅发布其他任务的输出），5项数值信息不足无法评估；对照实验中，5/8的确认性单元格支持H3，即更换校准样本足以反转方法排序。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出五行的报告标准：声明裕度、运行配对检验、在净差值旁报告churn、引用达到的样本量、发布逐项输出。该标准适用于任何两个足够相似值得比较的模型之间的比较。作者已发布所有逐项输出、协议和代码。

title: ReRef-3D: A Benchmark for Spatial Referring Expression-Guided 3D Scene Rearrangement
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to ACL Rolling Review (ARR)
summary: We introduce ReRef-3D, a benchmark for language-guided placement in 3D scenes. It contains 33,826 instructions across 998 CLEVR-derived scenes, spanning 16 placement families and direct, one-hop, and two-hop references. Each instruction must be resolved into a valid new placement position. Given that an instruction defines a region of acceptable placements rather than one coordinate, our evaluation inserts a prediction into the scene, recomputes relations, and tests relation satisfaction and physical validity. Each instruction also includes a verified naturalized rewrite. After fine-tuning, LLaVA-3D, 3D-LLM, and PlaceIt3D produce valid placements for 68.3%, 31.6%, and 22.4% of instructions, respectively. Across models, relation satisfaction surpasses physical validity, relations such as nearest and between are the most difficult, and phrasing has minimal effect on performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ReRef-3D，一个用于3D场景中语言引导放置任务的基准测试。它包含998个CLEVR衍生场景中的33,826条指令，涵盖16种放置类别和直接、一跳、两跳引用。每条指令需解析为有效的放置位置，评估时通过将预测位置插入场景、重新计算关系来检验关系满足性和物理有效性。评估发现LLaVA-3D表现最佳（68.3%），而关系满足性普遍优于物理有效性，nearest和between关系最难，措辞变体对性能影响很小。
AI.motivation: 现有的具身智能和3D视觉-语言模型在语言引导的3D物体放置任务上缺乏系统性的评测基准。此类任务要求模型理解自然语言指令中的空间关系（如"最近""之间"）并在3D场景中确定有效放置位置，现有基准要么范围有限，要么评估方法不充分（仅评估单一坐标而非区域约束）。
AI.method: 构建了ReRef-3D基准：（1）从CLEVR衍生出998个3D场景，生成33,826条放置指令；（2）覆盖16种放置关系族（placement families），包含直接引用、一跳引用和两跳引用三种复杂度级别；（3）每条指令定义了一个可接受放置区域而非单一坐标；（4）评估时将模型预测插入场景，重新计算空间关系并检验关系满足性和物理有效性；（5）每条指令附带经过验证的自然化改写（naturalized rewrite），以测试措辞对性能的影响。
AI.result: 在微调后，LLaVA-3D、3D-LLM和PlaceIt3D分别对68.3%、31.6%和22.4%的指令产生了有效放置。跨模型来看，关系满足性普遍高于物理有效性；nearest和between这类关系最难处理；指令措辞对模型性能的影响极小。
AI.conclusion: ReRef-3D揭示了当前3D视觉-语言模型在语言引导放置任务上的显著能力差距。关系满足性与物理有效性的差距表明模型在理解空间关系方面优于推理物理约束（如碰撞、支撑面）。最难的关系类型和最易的措辞鲁棒性为未来3D具身推理模型的改进提供了明确的方向。

title: DCA-MoE: Spatially Adaptive Cross-Layer Fusion and Density-Routed Experts for Crowd Counting
summary: Crowd counting must recover reliable local density under severe variations in perspective, head scale, occlusion, and background clutter. Although modern counting objectives provide strong spatial supervision, many multi-level decoders still use spatially invariant feature fusion and apply one receptive-field pattern to every location. We propose DCA-MoE, a framework that makes both decisions content dependent while retaining a frozen DINOv3 encoder. Spatially Adaptive Layer Fusion (SALF) predicts position-wise weights over four aligned backbone features, and Density-Routed Multi-Receptive-Field Experts (DR-MoE) assigns each location a soft mixture of local, mid-range, and large-context residual experts. An EBC-style head reconstructs block density, while DMCount supervision and an auxiliary routing-balance term train the decoder without updating the backbone. On the NWPU-Crowd validation split, the strongest paired configuration, based on DINOv3 ViT-L/16, obtains 31.7 MAE and 72.2 RMSE; the matched ViT-B/16 full model obtains a paired 32.2/75.9. Cross-dataset results remain mixed, and several component baselines currently report independently selected minima from a single seed. The evidence therefore supports the feasibility of spatially adaptive fusion and routing, while broader paired and multi-seed evaluation remains necessary for causal attribution.

AI.tldr: 提出DCA-MoE框架，通过空间自适应层融合（SALF）和密度路由多感受野专家（DR-MoE）实现内容依赖的密集人群计数，冻结DINOv3编码器，在NWPU-Crowd验证集上达到31.7 MAE/72.2 RMSE。
AI.motivation: 现有多层级解码器在人群计数中仍使用空间不变的特征融合和单一感受野模式，无法在透视变化、头部尺度差异、遮挡和背景杂波等严重变化下可靠恢复局部密度。作者希望让融合决策和感受野分配都随内容自适应变化，而非所有位置使用相同处理。
AI.method: 提出DCA-MoE框架，包含两个核心组件：1）空间自适应层融合（SALF），预测四层对齐骨干特征上逐位置权重；2）密度路由多感受野专家（DR-MoE），为每个位置分配局部、中程和大上下文残差专家的软混合。使用EBC风格的头部重建块密度，采用DMCount监督和辅助路由平衡项训练解码器，冻结DINOv3骨干。
AI.result: 基于DINOv3 ViT-L/16的最强配对配置在NWPU-Crowd验证集上获得31.7 MAE和72.2 RMSE；ViT-B/16完整模型获得32.2/75.9配对结果。跨数据集结果参差不齐，多个组件基线报告的是单种子下独立选择的最小值。
AI.conclusion: 证据支持空间自适应融合和路由的可行性，但需要进行更广泛的配对和多种子评估以实现因果归因。跨数据集泛化仍需进一步验证。

title: LLM-Based Hierarchical Coordinated Control with Continuation-Aware Policy Learning
summary: Coordinating multiple interacting units in complex engineering systems is challenging when system interactions are difficult to model, operational information is heterogeneous, and low-level actions must satisfy strict constraints. We propose an LLM-based hierarchical framework in which the LLM coordinates interacting units based on heterogeneous operational context, while task-specific controllers or optimizers generate executable and constraint-aware actions. We further introduce Continuation-Aware GRPO to capture the consequences of coordination decisions over subsequent control intervals. Rather than judging a decision only by its immediate outcome, the method also evaluates how the system evolves afterward under the current policy. We validate the framework on multi-ramp traffic control and virtual power plant (VPP) energy management, using simplified system models for training and more realistic simulators for evaluation. Across both tasks, the proposed method consistently outperforms direct task-specific control and optimization, end-to-end reinforcement learning, rule-based and RL-based hierarchical coordination, and prompting-only LLM coordinators, demonstrating the value of heterogeneous-context reasoning, hierarchical execution, and continuation-aware policy learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于LLM的分层协调框架，用于解决多交互单元复杂工程系统中的协调问题。该框架利用LLM基于异构操作上下文进行高层协调，由任务专用控制器/优化器生成满足约束的可执行动作，并提出Continuation-Aware GRPO算法捕捉协调决策对后续控制区间的影响。在多匝道交通控制和虚拟电厂能源管理两个任务上验证，该方法优于直接任务控制、端到端强化学习、规则/RL分层协调以及纯提示LLM协调等基线。
AI.motivation: 复杂工程系统中多个交互单元协调困难，体现在：系统交互难以建模、操作信息异构、底层动作需满足严格约束。现有方法（直接控制/优化、端到端RL、分层框架等）在应对异构上下文推理和约束感知执行方面存在不足，需要一种既能利用异构上下文进行高层协调、又能保证底层动作可执行且满足约束的框架。
AI.method: 1）提出LLM-based分层框架：LLM负责基于异构操作上下文协调各交互单元，任务专用控制器/优化器生成约束感知的可执行动作，实现高层推理与底层执行的解耦。2）提出Continuation-Aware GRPO：不同于仅根据即时结果评判决策，该方法还评估决策后系统在当前策略下后续控制区间的演化情况，以捕捉协调决策的远期后果并优化策略学习。
AI.result: 在多匝道交通控制和虚拟电厂能源管理两个任务中，采用简化系统模型训练、真实模拟器评估，所提方法一致优于直接任务专用控制/优化、端到端强化学习、规则与RL分层协调方法以及仅用提示的LLM协调器。
AI.conclusion: 异构上下文的推理能力、分层执行架构与续感知策略学习三者的结合能有效提升多交互单元复杂系统的协调性能，验证了LLM在该类系统中的实用价值。

title: Online Convex Optimization with Dueling Feedback
summary: We study online convex optimization with dueling (pairwise comparison) feedback, where the learner observes only a binary preference between two queried points. While dueling feedback is well understood in discrete or stochastic settings, the adversarial convex setting has remained unexplored. We propose a simple reduction that converts dueling feedback into approximate gradients, enabling the use of standard first-order methods. We show that regret guarantees transfer under this reduction, yielding the first results for this setting, including $\mathcal{O}(T^{3/4})$ static, adaptive, and dynamic regret. Under additional structure, we obtain improved rates of $\mathcal{O}(T^{2/3})$ for smooth objectives and $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T \log T})$ for strongly convex functions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了对抗性凸优化中的决斗（成对比较）反馈问题，提出了一种将决斗反馈转化为近似梯度的简单约简方法，从而能够使用标准的一阶优化方法，并首次为该设定取得了静态、自适应和动态遗憾保证。
AI.motivation: 决斗反馈在离散或随机设定中已被充分研究，但在对抗性凸优化设定中仍未探索。该工作旨在填补这一空白，建立决斗反馈与标准一阶方法之间的桥梁。
AI.method: 提出一种简单约简方法，将决斗（成对比较）反馈转换为近似梯度，使得标准一阶优化方法可直接应用。通过这种约简，证明遗憾保证可以迁移到决斗反馈设定中。
AI.result: 首次在该设定下取得结果：一般凸目标获得O(T^{3/4})的静态、自适应和动态遗憾；对光滑目标改进为O(T^{2/3})；对强凸函数获得O(√(T log T))的更优速率。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了决斗反馈可以通过简单约简有效适配于对抗性凸优化，并根据目标函数的结构特性（光滑性、强凸性）实现了逐步改善的遗憾界。

title: $R^3$-Bench: LLMs Struggle with Resource-Rational Reasoning under Shared Budgets
comment: Code is available at https://github.com/NineAbyss/R-3-Bench . The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/R-3-Bench/R-3-Bench
summary: In cognitive science, resource rationality asks how an agent should allocate limited computation to maximize expected value. Most reasoning and agent benchmarks use independent per-task budgets; existing shared-budget studies do not calibrate suite performance against the same model's demonstrated single-problem competence. We introduce $R^3$-Bench, which evaluates six-problem suites under shared budgets across mathematics, competitive programming, and abstract reasoning in tool-free and agentic settings. Matched single-problem response curves define an offline empirical oracle over observed successes. Across 72 main-table cells for six models, the oracle mean matches or exceeds the contest mean in all cells and is strictly higher in 71. Under moderate tool-free pressure, equal-allocation replay also exceeds contest performance for four of six models. Trajectory diagnostics reveal limited strategy updating and pressure-dependent failure patterns. In a three-model diagnostic under strong agentic pressure, at least one fixed scheduler exceeds the contest mean in six of nine cells, but no policy dominates across domains. These results expose a persistent gap between demonstrated competence and shared-budget realization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出R³-Bench基准，用于评估模型在共享预算下跨六题套件（数学、竞赛编程、抽象推理）的资源理性表现。通过匹配单题响应曲线构建离线经验预言机，在72个主表单元中预言机均值全部匹配或超过比赛均值（71个严格更高）。结果揭示了模型在共享预算下存在"已展示能力"与"预算分配实现"之间的持续差距。
AI.motivation: 现有推理与智能体基准大多采用独立每任务预算，而共享预算研究未将套件性能与同一模型在单问题上的已展示能力进行校准，导致无法准确评估资源理性（resource rationality）——即智能体应如何分配有限计算资源以最大化期望价值。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 提出R³-Bench基准，评估六题套件在共享预算下的表现，涵盖数学、竞赛编程和抽象推理，包含无工具（tool-free）与智能体（agentic）两种设置。通过匹配单题响应曲线定义离线经验预言机（offline empirical oracle）来基于观测到的成功结果进行预测；同时测试等分配回放（equal-allocation replay）和固定调度器（fixed scheduler）等策略，并对轨迹进行诊断分析。
AI.result: 在六个模型、72个主表单元中，预言机均值在所有单元中匹配或超过比赛均值，其中71个单元严格更高。在中等无工具压力下，四个模型的等分配回放也超过比赛表现。轨迹诊断显示策略更新有限且存在压力依赖性失败模式。在三模型强智能体压力诊断中，至少一个固定调度器在九个单元中的六个超过比赛均值，但没有策略在所有领域占优。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了一个持续存在的差距：模型在单问题上的已展示能力（demonstrated competence）与其在共享预算下的实现表现（shared-budget realization）之间不一致。这说明模型在资源分配方面缺乏理性，现有模型在预算调配与策略更新上仍有显著改进空间，也表明资源理性应成为评估智能体推理能力的重要维度。

title: Self-Supervised Topologically Invariant Manifold Learning for Railway Image Quality Assessment
summary: Existing blind image quality assessment (BIQA) methods typically rely on synthetic distortions and subjective annotations, limiting generalization in real-world domains. To address this, we propose a fully self-supervised BIQA framework based on topologically invariant manifold learning under boundary constraints, which constructs a stable quality reference without manual labels. The framework generates progressive background dilution scales via repeated random cropping around each target; exploiting the monotonic degradation of target information density across these scales, it establishes a self-constrained quality manifold. A linearized spatial moment projection eliminates geometric distortions from random cropping; then a monotonicity divergence filter prunes background-sensitive evaluators, isolating an elite pool \(\mathcal{M}_{\text{elite}}\). A robust M-estimator with a principal component stabilizer fuses the metrics into an asymptotically efficient pseudo-ground truth \(q_{\text{PGT}}\), contracting variance toward the Cramér-Rao lower bound. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that the elite evaluator pool, distilled from 11 baseline metrics, secures superior zero-shot transferability across standard synthetic and wild benchmarks (CSIQ, LIVEC, LIVE-2). Concurrently, deployments on the CQU Railway Rolling Stock Surveillance Dataset (2,797 images) yield a manifold cosine similarity \(>0.999\) and a 100.0\% survival rate under industrial extreme stresses, robustly validating its cross-paradigm decoupling and topological resilience.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于边界约束下拓扑不变流形学习的全自监督盲图像质量评估（BIQA）框架，无需人工标注即可构建稳定的质量参考，并在合成与真实世界基准以及工业铁路监控数据集上展现出优越的零样本迁移能力和拓扑鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有BIQA方法依赖合成失真和主观标注，导致其在真实世界领域的泛化能力受限。亟需一种无需人工标签、能够适应真实域分布的自监督质量评估方法。
AI.method: 该框架通过：(1) 随机裁剪生成渐进背景稀释尺度，利用目标信息密度单调递减建立自约束质量流形；(2) 线性化空间矩投影消除裁剪引起的几何失真；(3) 单调性发散过滤器剔除背景敏感评估器，获得精英评估器池；(4) 结合主成分稳定器的鲁棒M估计器融合指标，生成渐近高效伪地面真值，使方差收敛至Cramér-Rao下界。
AI.result: 从11个基线指标中蒸馏出的精英评估器池在CSIQ、LIVEC、LIVE-2等标准基准上取得优越的零样本迁移性能；在CQU铁路车辆监控数据集（2,797张图像）上达到流形余弦相似度>0.999，极端工业应力下存活率100%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过拓扑不变的流形学习实现了无需标注的自监督BIQA，交叉验证了跨范式的解耦能力和拓扑弹性，为真实世界图像质量评估提供了新的可行路径。

title: SCOPE: Score-Isolated Agentic Optimization for Video World Models
summary: Video world models are increasingly used as simulators for planning and embodied decision making, yet improving them at inference time introduces a subtle evaluation problem: prompts, samplers, verifiers, and selectors may evolve together, making it difficult to attribute gains or prevent held-out feedback from shaping the final policy. We introduce \scope (\emph{\scopefullname}), a framework for auditable inference-time adaptation of frozen video world models. \scope represents external controls as a typed state, updates this state only through bounded changes supported by development evidence, and freezes the resulting policy before held-out evaluation. On Physics-IQ benchmark, \scope improves over the exact frozen base by $+14.24$ (95\% CI $[+8.10,+21.23]$). Controlled ablations further identify gains from scene specification, sampling, and learned selection, while the margin over the strongest matched agentic baseline remains unresolved. Cross-backbone and prospective evaluations reveal a complementary result: useful inference-time updates exist, but their benefits do not transfer uniformly across models and settings. Together, these findings suggest that reliable inference-time adaptation requires not only better proposals, but also a principled mechanism for deciding which updates should become part of the deployed system. Code is available at https://github.com/YuhuaJiang2002/SCOPE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCOPE框架，用于对冻结视频世界模型进行可审计的推理时自适应，通过类型化状态和受限更新机制，在Physics-IQ基准上取得+14.24的提升，并揭示了推理时更新的收益在不同模型和设置间并不均匀转移。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型正越来越多地被用作规划和具身决策的模拟器，但在推理时对其进行改进会引入微妙的评估问题：提示词、采样器、验证器和选择器可能共同演化，使得难以归因增益来源，也难以防止留出反馈影响最终策略。需要一个框架来确保推理时自适应的可审计性。
AI.method: SCOPE将外部控制表示为类型化状态，仅通过有开发证据支持的受限变更来更新该状态，并在留出评估之前冻结最终策略。这种方法通过三个步骤实现：类型化状态表示外部控制、有界变更机制、以及评估前策略冻结。
AI.result: 在Physics-IQ基准上，SCOPE相比精确冻结基线提升+14.24（95%置信区间[+8.10,+21.23]）。受控消融实验识别出场景规范、采样和学习选择的收益，但与最强匹配的智能体基线相比的边际仍未解决。跨骨干和前瞻性评估表明推理时更新存在，但收益在不同模型和设置间不统一转移。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的推理时自适应不仅需要更好的提案，还需要一个原则性机制来决定哪些更新应成为部署系统的一部分。SCOPE框架为未来研究提供了一个可审计的基准和开发范式。

title: A Unified Mamba--MoE Surrogate for Closed-Loop Simulation and Measurement-Window Forecasting of Inverter Transients
summary: This paper proposes a Mamba surrogate model with mixture-of-experts (MoE) routing to represent the transient dynamics of inverter-based resources. A Mamba surrogate model is a predictive machine learning model built on the Mamba architecture. MoE routing uses a router network to assign data-dependent weights to specialized subnetworks (experts). The resulting Mamba--MoE surrogate can perform two tasks: (i) closed-loop simulation and (ii) measurement-window forecasting of inverter transients. A single Mamba backbone with task conditioning and expert routing serves both tasks, replacing two separate specialists. Task-matched objectives fit each prediction form, and an adaptive conformal layer provides prediction intervals for both tasks. For the considered grid-following inverter, the unified surrogate model remains in the same low-error regime as a Mamba specialist pair while using 13% fewer parameters. The prediction intervals achieve 94--96% empirical mean marginal coverage across the two tasks. For transient dynamics---that is, beyond the vicinity of an equilibrium point---our surrogate model with MoE routing yields lower errors across all outputs in both tasks compared to a shared Mamba backbone without expert routing. A controller hardware-in-the-loop simulation validates our results and shows that adapting only the shared output head with limited measured data reduces held-out forecasting error.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于Mamba架构与混合专家（MoE）路由的代理模型，用于逆变器资源暂态动力学建模，统一了闭环仿真与测量窗口预测两种任务，在参数更少的情况下达到与专用模型相当的性能，并通过自适应共形层提供可靠的预测区间。
AI.motivation: 逆变器暂态动力学建模对电力系统稳定性分析至关重要，但传统方法在暂态区域（远离平衡点）精度有限，且通常需要为不同预测任务分别训练专用模型，导致参数冗余和部署开销大。
AI.method: 采用Mamba架构作为共享主干，引入MoE路由网络为不同数据分配专家权重；通过任务条件化使单一主干同时支持闭环仿真与测量窗口预测；使用任务匹配损失函数适配两种预测形式，并叠加自适应共形层生成两任务的预测区间。
AI.result: 对于所考虑的跟随电网逆变器，统一代理模型与专用Mamba模型对相比保持同等低误差，但参数减少13%；两任务预测区间经验平均边缘覆盖率94-96%；在暂态场景下，MoE路由的代理模型在所有输出的两任务中误差均低于无专家路由的共享Mamba主干；控制器硬件在环仿真验证了仅用有限实测数据适配共享输出头即可降低留出集预测误差。
AI.conclusion: Mamba-MoE统一代理模型在减少参数与保持精度的同时有效处理逆变器暂态动力学，且具备可迁移的有限数据适配能力，为逆变器资源建模提供了一个高效统一的解决方案。

title: DuplexGen: Decoupling Content, Timing, and Acoustics for Synthetic Dialogue Speech
summary: Synthetic conversational speech has become an important resource for developing and evaluating conversational speech systems. However, existing dialogue synthesis pipelines typically generate dialogue content first and then insert interruptions, overlap, and backchannels using handcrafted markers or timing rules, making conversational timing prescribed rather than interaction-driven. We present DuplexGen, a dialogue synthesis framework that explicitly decouples content, timing, and acoustics. An LLM first generates the dialogue script, and then two full-duplex conversational models perform the script while listening to each other in real time. This allows conversational timing to emerge naturally while preserving the scripted content. Finally, a high-fidelity text-to-speech model re-renders the interaction without altering its timing. As a demonstration of the proposed framework, we construct a patient--clinician conversational speech corpus with construction-time annotations, including word timestamps, speaker activity, overlap regions, and interaction events. Experimental results show that the proposed framework produces conversational dynamics closer to real dialogue than conventional stitching-based synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DuplexGen，一种对话语音合成框架，将内容、时序与声学显式解耦，通过LLM生成脚本后由两个全双工对话模型实时互听执行，使对话时序自然涌现而非人为预设，最后由TTS重新渲染语音。实验表明该框架产生的对话动态比传统拼接式合成更接近真实对话。
AI.motivation: 现有对话语音合成流水线通常先生成对话内容，再用手工标记或时序规则插入打断、重叠和反馈语，导致对话时序是被规定而非交互驱动的，缺乏自然对话的动态特性。
AI.method: 框架分为三阶段：1) LLM生成对话脚本（内容层）；2) 两个全双工对话模型在互听状态下实时执行脚本，使对话时序（如重叠、打断、反馈语位置）自然涌现而同时保持脚本内容（时序层）；3) 高保真语音合成模型在不改变时序的前提下重新渲染语音（声学层）。
AI.result: 构建了带构造期标注（词级时间戳、说话人活动、重叠区域、交互事件）的患者-临床医生对话语音语料库。实验表明，相比传统拼接式合成方法，DuplexGen产生的对话动态更接近真实对话。
AI.conclusion: 将对话时序从预设规则中解放出来、让其在双工交互中自然涌现，是生成更真实对话语音的有效途径，为对话系统开发和评估提供了更高质量的合成资源。

title: PersonaDrive: Controllable Trajectory Prediction with Multi-Dimensional Driving Personas
summary: Although recent trajectory prediction and end-to-end autonomous driving methods improve robustness in urban environments, they still lack meaningful controllability. Existing benchmarks either provide no persona-conditioned annotations or support only a single urgency spectrum (i.e., emergency, normal, relaxed), which cannot distinguish personas that share the same urgency level but require different driving dynamics. To address this, we propose (i) the Persona-Conditioned Trajectory (PCT) dataset, which decomposes driving personas along two axes, Temporal Urgency and Ride Comfort, and combines three levels of each to form a grid of nine personas, each paired with natural-language descriptions and trajectories, and (ii) PersonaDrive, a framework that can learn driving personas from language and can generate persona-specific trajectories. PersonaDrive incorporates Persona-Conditioned Anchor Transform (PCAT), which hierarchically reshapes anchors along both axes, and Persona-Conditioned Multi-Modal Fusion (PCMF) for BEV-level persona fusion. Training is supervised by a Hierarchical Guide Loss enforcing axis-aligned physical orderings and an Axis-Decomposed Diversity Loss preventing diagonal mode collapse. Experimental results show that PersonaDrive consistently improves over the compared baselines across multi-dimensional scenarios. The code and PCT dataset are available at https://github.com/VisualAIKHU/PersonaDrive

AI.tldr: 本文提出PCT数据集与PersonaDrive框架，将驾驶风格按时间紧迫性和乘坐舒适性两个轴解构成9种人格，实现基于语言的可控轨迹预测。
AI.motivation: 现有轨迹预测和端到端自动驾驶方法虽在城市场景中鲁棒性提升，但缺乏有意义的可控性。已有基准要么缺少人格条件标注，要么仅支持单一紧迫性维度（紧急、正常、放松），无法区分具有相同紧迫级别但需要不同驾驶动力学的人格。
AI.method: 提出(i)PCT数据集，将驾驶人格沿时间紧迫性和乘坐舒适性两个轴分解，各取三级组合成9种人格网格，并配以自然语言描述和轨迹；(ii)PersonaDrive框架，包含Persona-Conditioned Anchor Transform (PCAT)沿两轴层次化重塑锚点，以及Persona-Conditioned Multi-Modal Fusion (PCMF)进行BEV级人格融合。训练由两个损失监督：Hierarchical Guide Loss（强制轴向物理排序）和Axis-Decomposed Diversity Loss（防止对角模式坍缩）。
AI.result: 实验结果表明PersonaDrive在多种情景下始终优于对比基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的双轴人格分解方法能有效支持语言驱动的可控轨迹预测，代码和PCT数据集已公开。

title: Andy: A Mathematical Agent for Rigorous Proof and Autonomous Research
comment: 14 pages, 3 figures. Research logs, reports, and simulation code are available at https://github.com/mowaiwaim/Andy
summary: Andy is an autonomous mathematical research agent that solves and verifies submitted problems, formulates new research problems, and constructs rigorous proofs. It separates proof generation from correctness evaluation and supports knowledge acquisition, targeted revision, and multistage verification. This paper illustrates the workflow using a published result on self-triggered impulsive consensus as a starting point. Andy formulates a global exponential leader-follower synchronization problem for delayed heterogeneous networks with switching communication topologies. The proposed hybrid control combines self-triggered impulses with execution delay and recovery-phase continuous feedback. After each delayed impulse, this feedback cancels the delayed error channel during a recovery window. Sufficient conditions for global exponential synchronization are established, and Zeno behavior is excluded for both the sampling and impulse sequences. A numerical example confirms the result. This case demonstrates Andy's ability to learn from existing results, formulate meaningful research problems, and develop and verify rigorous proofs.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个名为Andy的自主数学研究智能体，它能够解决和验证提交的问题、提出新的研究问题并构建严格证明。该论文以一个已发表的自触发脉冲一致性结果为基础，展示了Andy如何将问题推广到具有切换通信拓扑的延迟异构网络中的全局指数领导者-跟随者同步问题，并设计了一种结合自触发脉冲与恢复阶段连续反馈的混合控制策略，最终建立充分条件并排除Zeno行为。
AI.motivation: 传统数学研究依赖人工推导，效率低且容易出错。作者提出Andy这个自主研究智能体，旨在将证明生成与正确性验证分离，实现知识获取、定向修正和多阶段验证的自动化，从而加速数学发现和证明验证过程。
AI.method: Andy采用"证明生成与正确性评估分离"的架构设计，支持知识获取、定向修正和多阶段验证。具体研究流程为：以一个已发表的自触发脉冲一致性结果为起点，将问题推广为延迟异构网络在切换通信拓扑下的全局指数领导者-跟随者同步问题；提出结合自触发脉冲（含执行延迟）和恢复阶段连续反馈的混合控制策略，该反馈可在每次延迟脉冲后于恢复窗口内消除延迟误差通道；建立全局指数同步的充分条件，并排除采样序列和脉冲序列的Zeno行为。
AI.result: 成功建立了延迟异构网络在切换通信拓扑下全局指数领导者-跟随者同步的充分条件，并证明了采样序列与脉冲序列均不存在Zeno行为。数值示例验证了理论结果的正确性。该案例证明了Andy能够从现有成果中学习、提出有意义的研究问题，并开发和验证严格的数学证明。
AI.conclusion: Andy展示了作为自主数学研究智能体的能力：不仅能解决和验证已有问题，还能在既有研究基础上提出新的研究问题、设计创新控制方案并完成严格证明。这种将证明生成与验证分离的框架为数学研究的自动化提供了可行路径。

title: GATTA: Graph Active Learning with Test-Time Augmentation
summary: Test-time augmentation (TTA) has proven effective for improving model robustness and uncertainty estimation in computer vision, yet its application to graph-structured data remains largely unexplored. We introduce GATTA (Graph Active Learning with Test-Time Augmentation), a framework for enhancing active learning by aggregating predictions across multiple augmented views to produce more reliable uncertainty estimates. To address the challenge of label-preserving graph augmentations, GATTA incorporates a consistency-based filtering mechanism that discards augmented views yielding unreliable predictions. We systematically evaluate GATTA across multiple graph datasets, GNN architectures, and acquisition strategies. Our results show that simple uncertainty-based methods, such as Entropy and Least Confidence, benefit most from TTA, achieving performance competitive with more sophisticated and computationally expensive approaches. GATTA generalizes across architectures, outperforms model-side ensemble methods such as MC Dropout. We further show that GATTA scales efficiently with both ensemble size and graph size. Extensive analysis of augmentation types, strengths, and filtering strategies provides practical guidelines for effective deployment. Our findings demonstrate that augmenting simple methods with TTA offers a more efficient path to strong active learning performance than engineering complex acquisition functions, enabling practitioners to achieve competitive results with lower computational overhead and reduced implementation complexity.

AI.tldr: 提出GATTA框架，将测试时增强（TTA）引入图主动学习，通过聚合多个增强视图的预测来生成更可靠的不确定性估计，并采用一致性过滤机制丢弃不可靠的增强视图，使简单的不确定性方法（如熵和最小置信度）达到与复杂采集策略竞争的性能。
AI.motivation: TTA在计算机视觉中已被证明能有效提升模型鲁棒性和不确定性估计，但在图结构数据上的应用尚未被探索。现有的图主动学习方法通常依赖复杂且计算开销大的采集函数，而简单方法（如Entropy、Least Confidence）的性能有限。作者旨在探索能否通过TTA增强简单方法，以更低计算开销和实现复杂度获取更强的主动学习性能。
AI.method: GATTA框架包含两个核心组件：（1）对图中的节点进行标签保持的增强变换，生成多个增强视图并聚合其预测以产生更可靠的不确定性估计；（2）基于一致性（consistency）的过滤机制，丢弃产生不可靠预测的增强视图。在多个图数据集、多种GNN架构和多种采集策略下进行系统评估，并分析增强类型、增强强度和过滤策略的影响。
AI.result: 简单不确定性方法（Entropy和Least Confidence）从TTA中获益最大，达到与更复杂、计算更昂贵的方法相当的性能。GATTA在不同架构上均能泛化，优于MC Dropout等模型侧集成方法。GATTA在集成规模和图规模上均具有良好的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 用TTA增强简单方法比设计复杂采集函数提供了更高效的主动学习性能提升路径，使从业者能以更低计算开销和实现复杂度获得竞争力强的结果。对增强类型、强度和过滤策略的系统分析为实际部署提供了实用指导。

title: CAPO: Constraint-Aware Prompt Optimization for LLM Agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents that rely on system prompts to use tools and complete tasks. Such deployments impose distinct operational requirements, including appropriate tool use, concise prompts and solution paths, and compliance with safety and formatting policies. For many practitioners, however, assembling domain-specific supervised data to post-train models to meet these requirements is infeasible. We introduce CAPO (Constraint-Aware Prompt Optimization), a primal-dual method that combines pool-based rewrites with adaptive constraint weighting to optimize system prompts under explicit operational constraints. Across agentic benchmarks, CAPO more reliably reaches empirically feasible operating points while improving task performance. CAPO also generalizes beyond agentic settings, achieving strong results on assistant-style evaluations with output-format and safety/privacy constraints. We further introduce DCAPO (Dynamically Trained CAPO), which trains a feedback- and dual-conditioned rewriter with pool-based GRPO while keeping the task agent frozen. Across task agents of different sizes, DCAPO produces a feasible prompt in every evaluated domain and matches or improves the task accuracy achieved by the evaluated baselines. A surrogate analysis characterizes how finite-pool and discrete-rewrite errors enter the inexact primal-dual procedure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAPO（约束感知提示优化）及其动态训练版本DCAPO，用于在显式操作约束下优化系统提示。CAPO采用原始-对偶方法，结合池式重写与自适应约束加权；DCAPO则使用池式GRPO训练反馈与对偶条件化的重写器。实验表明两者在代理和助手场景中均能达成可行且高性能的提示。
AI.motivation: LLM作为代理部署时依赖系统提示来执行工具调用、完成任务，但需满足工具使用正确、提示简洁、符合安全与格式化策略等多重约束。然而许多从业者无法获取领域特定的监督数据来进行后训练，因此需要一种无需大规模监督数据的提示优化方法。
AI.method: CAPO采用原始-对偶优化框架：结合基于池的提示改写（pool-based rewrites）与自适应约束加权（adaptive constraint weighting），在显式操作约束下优化系统提示。在此基础上引入DCAPO，通过池式GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）训练一个反馈与对偶条件化的重写器（feedback- and dual-conditioned rewriter），同时保持任务代理（task agent）参数冻结。此外，作者通过替代性分析（surrogate analysis）刻画有限池与离散改写误差如何进入非精确的原始-对偶过程。
AI.result: 在多种代理基准上，CAPO比基线更可靠地达到经验可行的操作点，同时提升任务性能。DCAPO在多个不同规模的任务代理上，每个评估领域均产生可行提示，并在任务准确率上达到或超越所有评估基线。CAPO还泛化到非代理场景，在带输出格式和安全/隐私约束的助手风格评估上取得强结果。
AI.conclusion: CAPO和DCAPO为在操作约束下优化系统提示提供了一种无需领域监督数据的有效途径。原始-对偶框架能够可靠地在可行性与任务性能之间取得平衡，动态训练的DCAPO进一步提升了泛化性和部署友好性。替代性分析为理解有限池和离散改写误差的影响提供了理论视角。

title: UC-VLM: Consistency-Driven Learning for AI-Generated Image Detection with Vision-Language Large Models
summary: Vision-Language Large Models (VLLMs) are promising for AI-generated image (AIGI) detection because they can produce both a prediction and a natural-language output. However, most existing VLLM-based detectors primarily fine-tune the language side while giving limited attention to low-level visual forensic cues. They also often depend on manually crafted prompts or human-annotated rationales, which limits scalability.We present UC-VLM, a unified multi-stage framework for AIGI detection that relies solely on binary supervision. UC-VLM first identifies effective instruction variants automatically. It then reuses the same binary label within a multi-stage training framework: (i) a visual discrimination objective that strengthens sensitivity to non-semantic forensic cues, and (ii) a label-conditioned generation objective that uses the binary label to supervise textual outputs. This design turns weak binary supervision into a shared supervision signal for both the visual pathway and the language output. Our key novelty is a unified multi-stage binary-supervised framework that consistently reuses the same authenticity labels for visual adaptation and label-conditioned text generation, while leveraging automatically optimized instructions to reduce prompt sensitivity without requiring human-written rationales or hand-crafted prompts.Experiments show that UC-VLM achieves 96.1% average accuracy on GenImage, exceeding the strongest prior result by 4.6%, and obtains 69.6% / 77.9% accuracy on Chameleon under ProGAN / SDV1.4 training, surpassing the best baseline by 11.2% / 15.3%, respectively.

AI.tldr: UC-VLM是一个统一的多阶段框架，仅依赖二元监督标签进行AI生成图像检测。它自动识别有效指令变体，并通过视觉判别目标和标签条件生成目标两个阶段，将二元监督信号同时用于视觉通路和语言输出，避免了人工提示和人工标注的理性依据。在GenImage和Chameleon基准上均显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于VLLM的AIGI检测器主要微调语言端而忽视低层视觉取证线索，且依赖人工设计的提示词或人工标注的理由说明，限制了方法的可扩展性和提示敏感性。作者希望仅利用二元监督就能实现有效的AIGI检测，同时兼顾视觉取证线索和自然语言输出。
AI.method: UC-VLM采用统一的多阶段训练框架：（1）自动筛选有效的指令变体，避免人工设计提示词；（2）视觉判别目标：增强模型对非语义取证线索的敏感性；（3）标签条件生成目标：利用二元真实性标签监督文本输出。整个框架将弱二元监督信号复用为视觉通路和语言输出的共享监督信号，无需人工标注的理性说明。
AI.result: 在GenImage数据集上达到96.1%的平均准确率，比最强的先前结果高4.6%；在Chameleon数据集上，ProGAN训练情况下达到69.6%的准确率（比最佳基线高11.2%），SDV1.4训练情况下达到77.9%的准确率（比最佳基线高15.3%）。
AI.conclusion: UC-VLM证明二元弱监督信号在统一多阶段框架中可以同时驱动视觉取证能力提升和标签条件文本生成，无需人工提示或人工理性依据，实现了更强的检测性能和更好的可扩展性，为VLLM在AIGI检测中的应用提供了新的范式。

title: TAHB: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Text-Attributed Hypergraph Learning
summary: Hypergraphs effectively model higher-order groupwise relationships beyond pairwise interactions, while pretrained language models (PLMs) and large language models (LLMs) provide rich semantic understanding from textual attributes. However, research on combining language models with hypergraph learning remains limited due to the lack of public text-attributed hypergraph benchmarks. To address this limitation, we present TAHB (Text-Attributed Hypergraph Benchmark), the first public benchmark integrating hypergraph structures and raw textual attributes. TAHB contains 10 real-world datasets from four domains - e-commerce, academia, movies, and politics networks - enabling systematic evaluation of text-aware hypergraph representation learning. Experimental results show that TAHB preserves key structural properties of real-world hypergraphs and consistently reproduces performance tendencies observed in existing benchmarks. Furthermore, experiments under both LLM-as-Enhancer and LLM-as-Predictor settings demonstrate that LLM-enhanced textual semantics improve hypergraph learning performance, while structural and textual information jointly provide the best setting for LLM-based prediction. Our benchmark provides a foundation for future research at the intersection of hypergraph learning and language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TAHB（文本属性超图基准），这是首个将超图结构与原始文本属性整合的公开基准，包含来自电商、学术、电影和政治网络四个领域的10个真实世界数据集，用于系统评估文本感知的超图表示学习。
AI.motivation: 超图能有效建模超越成对交互的高阶组群关系，预训练语言模型和大语言模型能提供丰富的语义理解，但将语言模型与超图学习相结合的研究因缺乏公开的文本属性超图基准而受限。
AI.method: 构建包含10个真实数据集、覆盖四个领域的TAHB基准，分别评估其在结构属性保持和性能复现方面的能力，并在LLM-as-Enhancer和LLM-as-Predictor两种设置下进行实验验证。
AI.result: TAHB保持了真实超图的关键结构属性，并能够一致复现现有基准中的性能趋势；LLM增强的文本语义能提升超图学习性能，而结构信息与文本信息的联合使用能提供最好的LLM预测设置。
AI.conclusion: TAHB为超图学习与语言模型交叉领域的未来研究提供了基础，填补了文本属性超图基准缺失的空白。

title: EMASAM: a Computationally Efficient Sharpness-Aware Minimization via EMA-Guided Perturbations
comment: Accepted in ICPR2026. The project page can be accessed at https://www.vip.sc.eng.isct.ac.jp/proj/EMASAM
summary: Recent progress in optimization research has highlighted the sharpness of the loss landscape as a key factor in narrowing the generalization gap. Motivated by this insight, Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) was proposed as a training strategy that enhances generalization. Despite the promising performance, SAM suffers from its twice computational cost due to its core algorithm requiring an extra gradient computation during the perturbation step. To overcome this limitation, we introduce Exponential Moving Average Sharpness-Aware Minimization (EMASAM), a computationally efficient variant of SAM. EMASAM does not require the loss gradient in the perturbation step. Instead, EMASAM defines the perturbation direction based on the discrepancy between the main model and the EMA shadow model. This perturbation travels away from the stable average position toward the less stable area, acting as a softer yet cheaper alternative to SAM's worst-case scenario perturbation. Moreover, since EMASAM's perturbation does not rely on noisy mini-batch gradients, it mitigates the gradient-induced instability inherent in SAM. Hence, EMASAM eliminates the need for an extra backpropagation while also preserving the generalization ability of the SAM-style training. Several experiments have been performed and confirm the efficiency and robustness of our method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EMASAM，一种计算高效的Sharpness-Aware Minimization变体。它通过利用主模型与EMA影子模型之间的差异来定义扰动方向，替代SAM中需要额外梯度计算的扰动步骤，从而消除额外的反向传播开销，同时保留SAM风格的泛化能力，并通过避免噪声小批量梯度来缓解梯度不稳定问题。
AI.motivation: SAM虽能通过感知损失景观的锐度来提升泛化能力，但其核心算法在扰动步骤中需要额外的梯度计算，导致计算成本翻倍，限制了其在大规模任务中的实用性。
AI.method: EMASAM不使用损失梯度来定义扰动方向，而是基于主模型与EMA（指数移动平均）影子模型之间的差异来定义扰动方向。该扰动使模型远离稳定的平均位置、朝向较不稳定的区域移动，作为SAM最坏情况扰动的更柔和且更廉价的替代方案。同时，由于该扰动不依赖噪声小批量梯度，也减轻了SAM中固有的梯度诱导不稳定性。
AI.result: 多项实验证实了EMASAM的效率和鲁棒性，表明其在消除额外反向传播需求的同时，保持了SAM风格训练的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: EMASAM成功解决了SAM的计算开销问题，以EMA模型差异作为扰动方向，在保持泛化性能的同时实现了更低的计算成本和更高的稳定性。

title: Skill2Query: Exploiting Skill Structure to Generate Pseudo-Queries for Agent Skill Retrieval
summary: Pseudo-query generation can alleviate the supervision bottleneck for agent skill retrieval, but existing document-level approaches typically leave the rich internal relations among capabilities, parameters, and usage examples implicit. As a result, generated queries may be topically relevant to a skill while lacking capability grounding and parameter consistency, raising the question of whether explicitly exploiting a skill document's internal structure can produce more effective retrieval signals. We therefore propose Skill2Query, a framework that first parses a skill document into a Skill Knowledge Graph and then generates pseudo-queries through a three-stage process including style mimicking, query template generation, and parameter filling. The generated queries can be used for offline index augmentation, online query expansion, and retriever training. Four benchmarks (TheoremQA, LogicBench, ToolQA, and CHAMP) are used to evaluate Skill2Query with large-scale skill candidate pools across multiple downstream applications, including skill retrieval, retriever training, and end-to-end agent execution. Using nearly 30K skills across diverse domains, we generate 700K category-diverse pseudo-queries. Skill2Query consistently improves sparse, dense, and skill-routing retrieval, with an average Recall@1 gain of 6.70 percentage points across retrieval settings. Skill2Query-generated training data also achieves the best Recall@1 and nDCG@1 among the evaluated generation baselines. Further evaluations with multiple LLM backends demonstrate that improved skill retrieval translates into higher agent task success rates. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/MatZaharia/Skill2Query.

AI.tldr: Skill2Query是一个通过解析技能文档为技能知识图谱，再经风格模仿、查询模板生成和参数填充三阶段生成伪查询的框架，用于增强智能体技能检索。在四个基准和近3万技能上生成70万伪查询，平均Recall@1提升6.70个百分点，并显著提升了后续智能体任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有的文档级伪查询生成方法忽略了技能文档内部丰富的结构关系（如能力、参数、使用示例之间的关联），导致生成的查询虽然主题相关但缺乏能力基础支撑和参数一致性。作者质疑显式利用技能文档内部结构能否产生更有效的检索信号。
AI.method: Skill2Query框架首先将技能文档解析为技能知识图谱（Skill Knowledge Graph），然后通过三阶段流程生成伪查询：1) 风格模仿（style mimicking）、2) 查询模板生成（query template generation）、3) 参数填充（parameter filling）。生成的伪查询可用于离线索引增强、在线查询扩展和检索器训练三种下游应用。
AI.result: 在TheoremQA、LogicBench、ToolQA和CHAMP四个基准上，使用近30K技能和70万类别多样的伪查询进行评估。Skill2Query一致性地提升了稀疏检索、稠密检索和技能路由三种检索方式，平均Recall@1提升6.70个百分点。生成的训练数据在Recall@1和nDCG@1指标上优于其他生成基线。多个LLM后端评估显示改进的技能检索能转化为更高的智能体任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 显式利用技能文档的内部结构（通过知识图谱建模）可以生成更高质量的伪查询，从而显著提升技能检索性能，并最终提高智能体的任务执行成功率。代码和资源已开源。

title: CG-GLORE: A Conjugate Gradient-Based Global-Local Regularization Network for Sparse-View CT Reconstruction
summary: Sparse-view computed tomography (CT) reduces radiation dose by acquiring fewer projection views, but the resulting inverse problem is highly ill-posed and often produces severe streak artifacts. Existing deep reconstruction methods have achieved promising performance, yet many rely on first-order updates or large regularization networks, which can be less effective in ill-conditioned settings. We propose \textbf{CG-GLORE}, a compact deep unrolling framework inspired by second-order optimization for sparse-view CT reconstruction. Each unrolled stage uses a CG-solved linear system based on a structured Hessian surrogate: it retains the physics-induced curvature of the data-fidelity term while using an identity approximation for the learned regularization term. Thus, the method is second-order-inspired rather than an exact Newton method for the full learned objective. To model image priors, we design a Global-Local Regularization Network (GLORE), which combines convolutional local feature extraction with a Long-Range Dependency Representation module based on sparse patchification and Nyström attention. This design captures anatomical details and non-local dependencies while maintaining practical complexity. Experiments on AAPM and DeepLesion under multiple sparse-view and noise settings show that CG-GLORE achieves strong quantitative performance, stable convergence, lower noise power, and improved visual fidelity compared with representative reconstruction methods.

AI.tldr: CG-GLORE是一种紧凑的深度展开框架，受二阶优化启发用于稀疏视图CT重建。每个展开阶段通过共轭梯度法求解基于结构化Hessian近似的线性系统，保留数据保真项的物理曲率，而对学习的正则化项使用恒等近似。图像先验由GLORE网络建模，结合卷积局部特征提取和基于稀疏分块及Nyström注意力的长程依赖模块。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视图CT虽能降低辐射剂量，但逆问题高度病态，易产生严重条状伪影。现有深度重建方法多依赖一阶更新或大型正则化网络，在病态条件下效果欠佳，需要更高效的二阶优化启发式重建方法。
AI.method: 提出CG-GLORE深度展开框架：每阶段使用CG求解基于结构化Hessian替代的线性系统；设计GLORE正则化网络，结合卷积局部特征提取与Long-Range Dependency Representation模块（基于稀疏分块和Nyström注意力），在捕捉解剖细节和非局部依赖的同时保持实际复杂度。
AI.result: 在AAPM和DeepLesion数据集上、多种稀疏视图和噪声设置下进行实验，CG-GLORE相比代表性重建方法在定量指标、收敛稳定性、噪声功率和视觉保真度方面表现更优。
AI.conclusion: CG-GLORE证明了二阶启发式深度展开在病态稀疏视图CT重建中的有效性，通过紧凑设计实现了强定量性能与稳定收敛，兼顾视觉质量与计算复杂度。

title: GraphLoom: Reliability-Calibrated Graph Evidence Routing for Multimodal KG-RAG
summary: Multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems often rely on long unstructured contexts or aggressively expanded evidence graphs, which can introduce noisy evidence, weaken multi-hop reasoning, and increase unsupported generation. We present GraphLoom, a reliability-calibrated multimodal knowledge-graph RAG framework for compact and faithful evidence routing. Given a question and its associated multimodal input, GraphLoom constructs an instance-level multimodal knowledge graph from grounded scene descriptions, extracted relational triples, and external commonsense knowledge. Instead of injecting all retrieved evidence into the generator, GraphLoom performs reliability-aware subgraph retrieval with bounded expansion and selectively routes high-utility evidence through hierarchical graph memory slots and joint graph-sequence attention in a frozen language model. To improve robustness in complex reasoning settings, GraphLoom further combines interleaved retrieval with budgeted corrective retrieval, enabling adaptive multi-hop evidence refinement under noisy retrieval conditions. We evaluate GraphLoom on ScienceQA, MultiModalQA, and OK-VQA, including large distractor evidence pools that approximate noisy external knowledge retrieval. Experimental results show consistent gains in answer quality and evidence faithfulness over strong multimodal RAG, graph-retrieval, and open-source vision-language baselines, with improved retrieval quality on MultiModalQA and stable performance under noisy evidence pools. Additional analyses using MiniCheck-based verification, human evaluation, and latency profiling show that reliability-calibrated graph evidence routing provides an effective alternative to long-context multimodal evidence injection.

AI.tldr: GraphLoom是一个可靠性校准的多模态知识图谱RAG框架，通过构建实例级多模态知识图谱、有界扩展的可靠性感知子图检索、层次化图记忆槽和联合图-序列注意力机制，将高效用证据选择性路由到冻结语言模型中，在ScienceQA、MultiModalQA和OK-VQA上取得了优于强基线模型的答案质量和证据忠实度。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态RAG系统依赖长上下文非结构化证据或过度扩展的证据图，这两类方法都会引入噪声证据、削弱多跳推理能力并增加无支撑生成的风险。传统检索注入方式将所有证据直接送入生成器，缺乏对证据可靠性的甄别和紧凑路由机制，导致复杂推理场景下性能下降。
AI.method: GraphLoom包含四个核心组件：(1) 从接地场景描述、提取的关系三元组和外部常识知识构建实例级多模态知识图谱；(2) 可靠性感知的子图检索并限制扩展边界，避免噪声证据扩散；(3) 通过层次化图记忆槽和联合图-序列注意力机制，在冻结语言模型中选择性路由高效用证据；(4) 交错检索与预算受限的纠正性检索相结合，在含噪检索条件下实现自适应多跳证据精炼。
AI.result: 在ScienceQA、MultiModalQA和OK-VQA（含大型干扰证据池）上的实验表明，GraphLoom在答案质量和证据忠实度上一致优于强多模态RAG、图检索和开源视觉语言基线。具体表现为：MultiModalQA上检索质量提升、含噪证据池下性能稳定。MiniCheck验证、人工评估和延迟分析进一步证实了可靠性校准的图证据路由比长上下文多模态证据注入更有效。
AI.conclusion: GraphLoom证明可靠性校准的图证据路由（即有界子图检索+选择性证据注入）是多模态RAG中长上下文证据注入的有效替代方案，能够在控制噪声、保持多跳推理能力的同时提升生成质量与证据忠实度。

title: Global Federated Learning Strategies for Building Efficient Personalized Models
comment: Ph.D. dissertation, Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST), February 2026
summary: Federated learning (FL) is a practical framework that can train models on distributed user data while guaranteeing data privacy; however, due to heterogeneity in which each user has a different data distribution, problems frequently arise where both global and personalization performance deteriorate simultaneously. This dissertation presents methodologies for building efficient personalized models by identifying which strategies are effective in the global training stage and by showing how to preserve global knowledge while securing user-specific performance during local adaptation. First, we show that as data heterogeneity increases, the collapse of feature vectors is a more fundamental bottleneck than classifier weights, and propose a method that directly mitigates the discrepancy in representation magnitude between local and global models. Second, we analyze that a training approach that strengthens local alignment can induce forgetting of global knowledge (e.g., categories not observed locally), and propose a method that achieves both local alignment and global knowledge preservation by combining feature distillation based on the global model's feature vectors. Third, in federated personalized reward model learning with preference heterogeneity, we empirically verify the conventional belief that "increasing the number of global models yields better initialization," and we show that when sufficient local fine-tuning is allowed, a single global initialization can instead provide stronger personalization performance. This study redefines the role of global initialization under data and preference heterogeneity and provides practical training strategies that simultaneously satisfy global knowledge preservation and personalization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究联邦学习中的数据与偏好异构性问题，提出在全局训练阶段和局部适应阶段同时保持全局知识并提升个性化性能的方法：包括缓解特征向量坍缩、结合全局模型特征蒸馏实现局部对齐与知识保留、以及重新审视全局模型数量对个性化奖励模型学习的影响。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习中，用户的本地数据分布存在异构性，导致全局模型性能和个性化性能同时退化。现有方法未能系统性地识别全局训练阶段和局部适应阶段的关键瓶颈，也缺乏在数据异构和偏好异构下同时保持全局知识与个性化性能的有效策略。
AI.method: 本文包含三项核心技术贡献：(1) 指出数据异构程度增加时，特征向量的坍缩比分类器权重是更根本的瓶颈，并提出直接缓解局部与全局模型表示幅度差异的方法；(2) 分析发现强化局部对齐的训练方式会导致全局知识遗忘（如未在本地出现的类别），提出结合全局模型特征蒸馏的方法，同时实现局部对齐与全局知识保留；(3) 在联邦个性化奖励模型学习中，通过经验验证"更多全局模型带来更好初始化"的传统观念，发现当允许充分局部微调时，单一全局初始化反而提供更强的个性化性能。
AI.result: 实验验证了特征向量坍缩比分类器权重退化更具根本性；提出的特征蒸馏方法能同时保留全局知识并实现局部对齐；在偏好异构场景下颠覆了"全局模型越多越好"的传统认知，证明充分局部微调时单一全局初始化更优。
AI.conclusion: 本研究重新定义了数据与偏好异构下全局初始化的作用，提供了同时满足全局知识保留与个性化性能的实用训练策略，为联邦学习中的个性化建模提供了系统性方法论。

title: HyperSkill: Self-Evolving LLM Agents via Hypergraph-Structured Skill Memory
summary: As agentic tasks grow in complexity, LLM agents increasingly rely on experiential memory to reuse procedural knowledge across tasks. Effective memory design must jointly address what to store, how memory is structured and retrieved, and how memory evolves. Existing systems tackle each only partially: they store trajectories, insights, or workflows as isolated entries, discarding compositional relationships among subtasks and reusable skills; retrieve by flat embedding similarity that ignores relational signals; and maintain memory without leveraging its relational structure. We propose HyperSkill, a hypergraph-based memory framework that jointly improves all three. HyperSkill represents memory as a hypergraph with two node types, subtask steps and reusable skills, where each hyperedge links the subtasks and skills from a single trajectory. Dual-path retrieval queries both subtask and trajectory levels, ranking skills by co-occurrence across retrieved trajectories. Periodic structure-informed maintenance prunes low-utility nodes and merges redundant skills via quality-weighted propagation. Across xBench, GAIA, and WebWalkerQA with GPT-4o and Qwen3-30B-A3B, HyperSkill outperforms ten memory baselines, yielding gains of up to +11.51 on GAIA and +11.18 on WebWalkerQA.

AI.tldr: 提出HyperSkill，一个基于超图的内存框架，联合解决LLM智能体经验记忆中"存什么、如何结构化检索、如何演化"三个问题，通过超图建模子任务与可复用技能的关系、双路径检索和结构化维护，在多个基准上显著优于十个内存基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体经验记忆系统只部分解决了记忆设计问题：要么孤立存储轨迹、见解或工作流，丢弃了子任务间及可复用技能的组成关系；要么通过平面嵌入相似度检索，忽略关系信号；要么维护记忆时不利用其关系结构。需要一种同时改进存储、检索和维护三方面的记忆框架。
AI.method: HyperSkill将记忆表示为具有两类节点（子任务步骤和可复用技能）的超图，每条超边连接单个轨迹中的子任务和技能。采用双路径检索，同时查询子任务级和轨迹级，通过检索轨迹间的技能共现进行排序。周期性结构信息维护通过删除低效用节点和基于质量加权传播合并冗余技能来优化记忆。
AI.result: 在xBench、GAIA和WebWalkerQA基准上使用GPT-4o和Qwen3-30B-A3B进行实验，HyperSkill超越了十个记忆基线，在GAIA上提升达+11.51，在WebWalkerQA上提升达+11.18。
AI.conclusion: 通过超图结构同时建模子任务步骤与可复用技能的关系，结合双路径检索和结构感知维护，HyperSkill证明了联合优化记忆存储、检索和演化能有效提升智能体在多任务场景中的表现。

title: Robust structure from motion for aerial-ground images via detector-free feature matching and multi-view track refinement
summary: Integrated 3D reconstruction from aerial-ground images is essential for generating high-precision urban 3D models, yet severe variations in viewpoint, scale, and rotation make robust feature matching highly challenging. To address these limitations, this study introduces a rotation-robust detector-free matching network coupled with multi-view track refinement for incremental Structure from Motion (ISfM). The proposed workflow features four key modules. First, rotation-aware feature extraction replaces traditional convolutions with an Omnidirectional State Space Block (OSS Block) that selectively scans across eight symmetrical directions to model long-range spatial dependencies and synthesize rotation-invariant feature maps. Second, multi-scale attention transformation utilizes quadtree attention to build a hierarchical token pyramid that isolates high-association token regions and discards irrelevant areas, capturing long-range context with linear computational complexity. Third, bi-directional feature matching executes a symmetric coarse-to-fine matching scheme where coarse alignment computes dual-direction Softmax confidence matrices under mutual nearest neighbor constraints, and fine alignment uses a multi-layer perceptron to regress sub-pixel coordinate offsets. Finally, multi-view track refinement employs an integrated indexing structure to evaluate localized spatial proximity and link disjoint sub-tracks to the highest-confidence anchor point, ensuring stable feature repeatability across the ISfM pipeline. By using real aerial-ground datasets, experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method improves AUC at 5° pose error by 93.9% compared with LoFTR and achieves the highest precision in ISfM reconstruction, with the improved accuracy ranging from 27.6% to 32.7%. The proposed method provides a reliable solution for integrated 3D reconstruction of aerial-ground images.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合旋转鲁棒无检测器匹配网络与多视图轨迹细化的增量式运动恢复结构（ISfM）方法，用于航拍与地面影像的集成三维重建。通过旋转感知特征提取、多尺度注意力变换、双向特征匹配和多视图轨迹细化四个模块，有效解决了视角、尺度和旋转变化下的鲁棒特征匹配难题，在5°位姿误差AUC上较LoFTR提升93.9%，重建精度提升27.6%-32.7%。
AI.motivation: 航拍与地面影像的集成三维重建对高精度城市三维模型至关重要，但严重的视角、尺度和旋转变化使得鲁棒特征匹配极具挑战性，传统方法难以同时应对这些变化。
AI.method: 提出了一种旋转鲁棒的无检测器匹配网络耦合多视图轨迹细化的ISfM工作流，包含四个模块：(1) 旋转感知特征提取，使用全向状态空间块（OSS Block）在八个对称方向上选择性扫描，建模长距离空间依赖并合成旋转不变特征图；(2) 多尺度注意力变换，利用四叉树注意力构建层级token金字塔，隔离高关联token区域并丢弃无关区域，以线性计算复杂度捕获长距离上下文；(3) 双向特征匹配，执行对称的粗到细匹配方案，粗对齐在互最近邻约束下计算双向Softmax置信度矩阵，细对齐使用多层感知机回归亚像素坐标偏移；(4) 多视图轨迹细化，采用集成索引结构评估局部空间邻近性并将断开的子轨迹链接到最高置信度的锚点，确保ISfM管线中特征重复性的稳定。
AI.result: 在真实航拍-地面数据集上的实验表明，所提方法在5°位姿误差的AUC上较LoFTR提升93.9%，在ISfM重建中取得最高精度，精度提升范围为27.6%-32.7%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为航拍与地面影像的集成三维重建提供了可靠的解决方案。

title: LongDocBench: Benchmarking TOC Hierarchy and Contextual Relationship Recovery in Long Documents
summary: Parsing visual documents into machine-readable representations is fundamental to document intelligence. Existing benchmarks focus on page-level element recognition, reading order, formula recognition, and table structure. Long documents, however, also require document-level structure recovery. This includes reconstructing cross-page table-of-contents (TOC) hierarchies and identifying typed links from tables and figures to their captions, notes, and sources, often in one-to-many form. Because these structures are covered only partially or subsumed within broader parsing protocols, existing benchmarks cannot directly evaluate two key document-level tasks: \emph{Table-of-Contents Hierarchy Recovery} and \emph{Contextual Relationship Recovery}. To benchmark these two tasks, we introduce \textsc{LongDocBench}, comprising 85 real-world financial reports, textbooks, and academic papers spanning 2,582 pages, with up to 105 pages per document. It provides human-verified annotations for 3,937 heading nodes (mean node depth 3.55; maximum depth 9) and 3,258 contextual relationships annotated across 2,680 table and figure objects. We further evaluate both the downstream utility and recoverability of these structures. Long-document question-answering experiments show that human-verified TOC hierarchies and contextual relationships improve reasoning, with their combination providing complementary benefits. Meanwhile, representative document parsers remain limited on both recovery tasks despite strong page-level performance. To support further progress, we publicly release \textsc{LongDocBench} and its evaluation protocol and reproducible testbed for advancing document-level structure recovery in long documents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LongDocBench基准，用于评估长文档中两个关键的文档级结构恢复任务：目录层级恢复（Table-of-Contents Hierarchy Recovery）和上下文关系恢复（Contextual Relationship Recovery）。该基准包含85份真实世界的长文档（涵盖财报、教科书和学术论文，共2,582页），提供人工验证的3,937个标题节点和3,258个上下文关系标注。实验表明这些结构能提升长文档问答性能，但现有文档解析器在这两项任务上表现有限。
AI.motivation: 现有文档解析基准集中于页面级元素识别（如读取顺序、公式识别和表格结构），但长文档还需要文档级结构恢复，包括跨页目录层级重构以及从表格和图形到标题、注释和来源的（通常是一对多的）类型化链接。由于这些结构在现有解析协议中仅被部分覆盖或被包含在更宽泛的任务中，现有基准无法直接评估这两项关键的文档级任务。
AI.method: 构建LongDocBench基准：包含85份真实世界财务报告、教科书和学术论文，覆盖2,582页，单文档最多105页；提供人工验证的3,937个标题节点（平均深度3.55，最大深度9）和覆盖2,680个表格与图形对象的3,258个上下文关系标注；同时评估这两类结构的可恢复性和下游效用。
AI.result: 长文档问答实验表明，人工验证的目录层级和上下文关系能提升推理性能，且二者结合提供互补增益；然而，代表性文档解析器尽管在页面级任务上表现强劲，在两项文档级恢复任务上仍然表现有限。
AI.conclusion: 现有文档解析器在文档级结构恢复方面存在明显短板，需要新的基准和方法来推动进展。作者公开了LongDocBench及其评估协议和可复现测试平台，以支持长文档文档级结构恢复的进一步研究。

title: Probability-Preserving Transformer for the Time-Dependent Schrödinger Equation
summary: Solving the time-dependent Schrödinger equation (TDSE) via traditional numerical methods is computationally intensive. Transformer models offer a compelling alternative, but standard implementations rely on soft constraints that cannot rigorously guarantee probability conservation. Here, we introduce a Transformer architecture that enforces TDSE probability conservation as a hard constraint. The design intrinsically ensures unitarity across temporal evolution without requiring repeated retraining. Our empirical findings show that this hard-constraint approach is not only physically exact but also computationally superior to conventional soft-constraint methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将TDSE概率守恒作为硬约束的Transformer架构，通过内在设计确保时间演化过程中的酉性，无需重复训练，在物理精确性和计算效率上均优于传统软约束方法。
AI.motivation: 传统数值方法求解含时薛定谔方程（TDSE）计算成本高昂。虽然Transformer模型可作为替代方案，但标准实现依赖软约束，无法严格保证概率守恒，这限制了其在量子物理模拟中的应用可靠性。
AI.method: 提出一种将TDSE概率守恒编码为硬约束的Transformer架构。该设计从结构上内在确保时间演化过程中的酉性（unitarity），从而不需要反复重训练即可严格满足概率守恒条件。
AI.result: 实证结果表明，该硬约束方法不仅在物理上精确（严格保证概率守恒），而且在计算性能上优于传统的软约束方法。
AI.conclusion: 硬约束Transformer为TDSE求解提供了一种兼具物理严格性与计算效率的新范式，展示了在量子动力学模拟中引入物理约束到神经网络架构的内在优势。

title: QUMem: Personalized Memory for Query-Conditioned User-State Inference in LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use external memory systems to support personalization by drawing on long and evolving interaction histories, in which user preferences may be distributed across time, change with context, and conflict with earlier evidence. However, existing systems face three limitations: fixed-turn, fixed-token, or session-based boundaries can mix unrelated dialogue or split an event from its causes, decisions, and outcomes; storing multiple pieces of user information from the same interaction as a single memory binds together items that serve different functions and should be independently retrievable; and treating the current task as a single top-$k$ retrieval query can return fragments that are individually relevant but fail to jointly capture preference evolution, temporal validity, and contextual applicability. We introduce \textsc{QUMem}, a structured memory framework for query-conditioned user-state inference. \textsc{QUMem} first segments interaction histories into variable-length episodes according to semantic continuity, then decomposes each episode into independently retrievable factual, preference, and transferable insight memories while preserving temporal positions and source evidence. At inference time, three sequential agents identify task-specific information needs, plan multi-query retrieval over the typed memory stores, and jointly infer a temporally and contextually valid user state for downstream response generation. \textsc{QUMem} achieves state-of-the-art performance on both PersonaMem and KnowU-Bench, demonstrating the effectiveness of query-conditioned user-state inference for long-term personalization.

AI.tldr: QUMem是一个结构化的记忆框架，通过将交互历史按语义连续性分割为可变长片段、将每个片段分解为可独立检索的事实/偏好/可迁移洞察记忆，并在推理时通过三个顺序智能体进行查询条件化的用户状态推断，在PersonaMem和KnowU-Bench上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理的外部记忆系统存在三个限制：(1)固定轮次/固定token/基于会话的边界会混合无关对话或将事件与其起因、决策和结果分离；(2)将同一交互中的多条用户信息存为单一记忆，导致功能不同的条目被绑定在一起无法独立检索；(3)将当前任务视为单个top-k检索查询，返回的片段虽各自相关但无法联合捕捉偏好的演化、时间有效性和上下文适用性。
AI.method: QUMem包含两个阶段：(1) 记忆构建阶段：先将交互历史按语义连续性分割为可变长片段（episodes），再将每个片段分解为事实记忆（factual）、偏好记忆（preference）和可迁移洞察记忆（transferable insight）三类独立可检索的记忆，同时保留时间位置和来源证据；(2) 推理阶段：三个顺序协作的智能体——第一个识别任务特定的信息需求，第二个基于类型化记忆存储规划多查询检索，第三个联合推断时间上和上下文上有效的用户状态以用于下游响应生成。
AI.result: QUMem在PersonaMem和KnowU-Bench两个基准上都取得了最先进（state-of-the-art）的性能，验证了查询条件化用户状态推断对长期个性化的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将记忆组织为语义连贯的可变长片段并分解为功能独立的类型化记忆，同时结合查询条件化的多智能体推理，可以有效解决长期个性化中偏好分布、时间演化和上下文冲突等核心挑战，为LLM代理的外部记忆系统设计提供了新范式。

title: UAV Video Deblurring via Motion-Aware Diffusion: A Path to Robust Target Detection
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures. Published in the 2025 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2025)
summary: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) play a crucial role in various scenarios ranging from disaster response to traffic surveillance. However, aerial video footage often suffers from severe motion blur due to rapid flight maneuvers, vibrations, and camera panning, which can significantly degrade downstream tasks such as target detection. Our goal is to explore a computationally-efficient and effective video deblurring approach to enhance UAV target detection performance. To reduce computational cost, we first propose an Adaptive Latent Scale Selector that dynamically adjusts the latent space resolution according to the intensity of UAV motion, thus balancing detail preservation with inference efficiency. To ensure temporal consistency, we introduce a Multi-Frame Alignment and Learnable Gating module to warp and gate the preceding frames, allowing the model to fuse only relevant temporal information and suppress misaligned or uninformative features. Our method can effectively recover sharp details from the UAV video stream. Extensive experiments on real UAV benchmarks demonstrate that our method not only yields superior deblurring performance but also significantly boosts target detection accuracy, making it highly applicable to robust aerial vision tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种计算高效的无人机视频去模糊方法，通过自适应潜空间分辨率选择器动态调整计算开销，并结合多帧对齐与可学习门控机制增强时间一致性，以提升无人机视频去模糊效果和下游目标检测精度。
AI.motivation: 无人机视频常因快速飞行、振动和相机运动而产生严重运动模糊，严重影响目标检测等下游任务。现有去模糊方法通常计算代价高昂，难以满足无人机实时应用需求，因此需要一种计算高效且有效的视频去模糊方法。
AI.method: 提出两个核心模块：(1) 自适应潜空间尺度选择器（Adaptive Latent Scale Selector），根据无人机运动强度动态调整潜空间分辨率，在细节保留与推理效率之间取得平衡；(2) 多帧对齐与可学习门控模块（Multi-Frame Alignment and Learnable Gating），对前序帧进行扭曲对齐并通过可学习门控融合相关时间信息，抑制错位或无信息特征。
AI.result: 在真实无人机基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法不仅取得了优越的去模糊性能，还显著提升了目标检测精度，展示了在鲁棒航空视觉任务中的实用性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过自适应计算分配和高效时间信息融合，有效恢复了无人机视频中的清晰细节，在去模糊质量和目标检测性能方面均优于现有方法，适合部署于实时航空视觉场景。

title: Funnel of Thoughts: Efficient Test-Time Scaling via Early Voting and Rollout Pruning
summary: Large Reasoning Models produce diverse, sometimes inconsistent answers across repeated queries on the same problem, so multi-sample inference is a prerequisite for reliable deployment. Majority voting at k rollouts is the standard solution and the de facto accuracy target for this regime, but it is prohibitively expensive at the scale LRMs require. We introduce Funnel of Thoughts (FoT), an inference-time method that preserves the full 32-trajectory voted accuracy while halving its attention FLOPs, a 28.8% reduction in full-model inference cost. Across 115K reasoning trajectories from six LRMs, we find that unproductive trajectories often reveal themselves through repeated hesitation markers such as "Wait", "Actually", and "perhaps." These trajectories are less likely to reach the correct answer and consume disproportionate attention FLOPs, degenerating into no-answer loops in the worst case. Built on this training-free lexical signal, FoT identifies the vocabulary that captures these pathological patterns and prunes affected trajectories before completion, reducing online generation attention FLOPs by 56.1% and wall time by 37.6% without any additional model inference; the same signal transfers without retuning across held-out architectures and out-of-domain tasks.

AI.tldr: Funnel of Thoughts (FoT) 是一种推理时方法，通过词汇信号（如"Wait"、"Actually"等犹豫标记）识别并提前剪枝无效推理轨迹，在保持32条轨迹投票精度的同时，将注意力FLOPs减半，并将全模型推理成本降低28.8%。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型（LRMs）在重复查询同一问题时会产生多样甚至不一致的回答，因此多采样推理是可靠部署的前提。多数投票（multi-sample majority voting）虽为标准方案，但在LRM所需的规模下成本极高，需要更高效的推理时方法。
AI.method: FoT利用训练无关的词汇信号识别推理轨迹中的病态模式。具体而言，通过对115K条来自六个LRM的推理轨迹的分析，发现无效轨迹常通过重复的犹豫标记（如"Wait"、"Actually"、"perhaps"）展现出来。FoT识别这些捕获病理模式的词汇表，并在轨迹完成前进行剪枝，从而减少在线生成的注意力FLOPs和墙钟时间，且无需额外的模型推理。
AI.result: FoT在保持完整32条轨迹投票精度的同时，将注意力FLOPs减半（28.8%的全模型推理成本降低），在线生成注意力FLOPs减少56.1%，墙钟时间减少37.6%。该信号无需重新调整即可迁移到未见过的架构和域外任务。
AI.conclusion: 基于词汇犹豫标记的轨迹剪枝是一种高效、训练无关且可迁移的推理加速方法，能够在保持多数投票精度的前提下大幅降低LRM的推理成本，为大规模可靠部署提供了可行方案。

title: Decision-Driven Regularization: A Blended Model for Learning and Optimization
comment: 42 pages (including appendix), 7 figures in main, journal paper
summary: In contextual optimization, the decision-maker seeks optimal decisions to minimize a cost function, that varies based on observed features. This context is common in many business applications ranging from on-demand delivery and retail operations to portfolio optimization and inventory management. In this paper, we study the learning and optimization approach, which first learns how outcomes result from the features, and then selects optimal decisions based on these outcomes. We focus on the integrated learning and optimization literature, and identify that a lack of control for prediction accuracy can lead to overfitting and a loss of decision effectiveness against simple separate learning and optimization models. Instead, we propose a bi-objective formulation that balances prediction accuracy and cost minimization, termed decision-driven regularization. It also addresses ambiguity in the definition of the cost function via a surrogate that depends on a new hyperparameter. We additionally show that alternative perspectives for formulating the problem, namely robust optimization and regret minimization, lead to models that are closely related to our proposed model. As a consequence, our framework generalizes models such as SPO+. Our model is shown to be numerically superior to other benchmarks, such as OLS, Random Forest, XGBoost, SPO+, Perturbation Gradient, and Learning and Rank, in our synthetic studies.

AI.tldr: 本文针对上下文优化中的"学习-优化"一体化范式，指出缺乏对预测精度的控制会导致过拟合，使决策效果劣于简单的分离式"学习+优化"模型。为此提出双目标框架"决策驱动正则化"(decision-driven regularization)，在预测精度与成本最小化之间取得平衡，并通过一个替代成本函数引入新超参数来缓解成本函数定义的模糊性。研究表明该框架与鲁棒优化及遗憾最小化视角密切相关，并推广了SPO+等方法，在合成实验中优于OLS、随机森林、XGBoost、SPO+、Perturbation Gradient和Learning and Rank等基准。
AI.motivation: 现有集成式"学习与优化"(integrated learning and optimization)方法虽在决策端进行端到端训练，但因缺乏对预测精度的控制而容易过拟合，导致决策有效性反而低于简单的分离式方法。作者旨在解决这一缺陷，并处理成本函数定义不明确(ambiguity)的问题。
AI.method: 提出一个双目标优化公式，在预测精度与成本最小化之间进行权衡，称为"决策驱动正则化"。该方法通过一个依赖新超参数的代理(surrogate)成本函数来应对成本函数的模糊性；同时从鲁棒优化和遗憾最小化两个替代视角出发，证明所得模型与所提模型紧密相关，从而统一并推广了SPO+等现有方法。
AI.result: 在合成实验中，所提出的模型在决策效果上优于OLS、随机森林、XGBoost、SPO+、Perturbation Gradient以及Learning and Rank等基准方法。
AI.conclusion: 决策驱动正则化为学习与优化问题提供了一个兼顾预测准确性与决策性能的统一框架，既规避了过拟合风险，又通过泛化SPO+等模型形成更广泛的理论覆盖，并展现出数值上的优越性。

title: LENS: In-Context Search via Latent Evidence Exploration over Dynamic Raw Documents
summary:
LLM agents increasingly answer questions over dynamic raw-document collections, where files may change before preprocessing, and relevant evidence (spans, sections, pages, or tables) is query-dependent. Existing retrieval-augmented approaches pre-materialize evidence via fixed chunking, embeddings, or persistent indexes: effective for lookup, yet costly, stale-prone, and committed to a granularity before the query is known.
  We formulate in-context search as Budgeted Evidence Localization over a latent evidence space induced by dynamic raw documents and propose LENS (Latent Evidence Exploration and Search), an index-free framework. Instead of pre-materializing the evidence space, LENS maintains a query-conditioned belief over candidate units, iteratively selecting candidates via complementary lexical, local, and exploratory proposal policies, updating the belief via an LLM relevance oracle, and narrowing toward high-posterior regions under a controllable budget. Evidence is consolidated into compact, source-grounded regions of interest and compressed into self-organizing knowledge clusters reused across related queries.
  On a controlled 500-question evaluation with matched corpus snapshots, LENS reaches 62.4% exact match and 84.8% evidence recall vs. 65.2% exact match but 50.4% evidence recall for a ReAct-style baseline. Across scales, LENS gives the strongest supporting-fact localization and answer grounding. On a fixed 150-question fullwiki subset over the raw Wikipedia dump with zero indexing, LENS and ReAct are nearly tied in official answer quality (43.3% vs. 42.7% EM), with LENS grounding more answers in retrieved evidence (84.0% vs. 70.7%). A no-retrieval Closed-Book reference highlights the contribution of model memory. LENS is query-ready after corpus changes, needs no preprocessing or persistent index, and preserves source-grounded evidence localization throughout.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LENS（潜在证据探索与搜索），一个无需索引的框架，用于在动态原始文档集合上进行上下文内证据定位。LENS维护查询条件下的信念状态，通过互补的词汇、局部和探索性提议策略迭代选择候选单元，在可控预算下通过LLM相关性预言机更新信念，最终将证据压缩为可跨查询复用的自组织知识簇。在500问题对照评估中达到62.4%精确匹配和84.8%证据召回率。
AI.motivation: 现有的检索增强方法通过固定分块、嵌入或持久索引预先物化证据，这在静态场景下有效，但在动态原始文档集合中有三个关键缺陷：成本高昂（需持续重建索引）、容易过时（文件可能在预处理前变化）、以及在查询未知之前就提交到某个固定的粒度（跨度、节、页或表格）。这促使需要一种无需预处理、无需持久索引且能适应文档变化的索引无关框架。
AI.method: LENS将上下文内搜索形式化为"预算约束下的证据定位"问题，在动态原始文档诱导的潜在证据空间上工作。具体方法包括：(1) 维护一个查询条件下的信念状态，覆盖候选单元；(2) 通过互补的词汇策略（lexical）、局部策略（local）和探索策略（exploratory）迭代选择候选；(3) 使用LLM相关性预言机更新信念；(4) 在可控预算内收敛至高后验区域；(5) 将证据整合为紧凑、有源依据的兴趣区域，并压缩为自组织知识簇以在相关查询间复用。
AI.result: 在500个问题的受控评估中（匹配语料快照），LENS达到62.4%精确匹配和84.8%证据召回率，而ReAct风格基线为65.2%精确匹配但仅50.4%证据召回率。在150个问题的wiki子集上（零索引原则的原始Wikipedia转储），LENS和ReAct在官方答案质量上几乎持平（43.3% vs 42.7% EM），但LENS将更多答案基于检索到的证据（84.0% vs 70.7%）。无检索的Closed-Book参考突出了模型记忆的贡献。
AI.conclusion: LENS在文档变化后立即可查询，无需预处理或持久索引，同时在整个过程中保留基于源头的证据定位。它在答案质量上与基线相当或更优，同时在证据定位和答案接地方面显著更强，为动态文档环境下的检索增强生成提供了一种有前景的替代方案。

title: VGGT-Align: Bridging Local Reconstruction and Global Consistency for Long-Sequence 3D Reconstruction
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26). Code: https://github.com/WZ-CS/VGGT-Align
summary: Maintaining global geometric consistency is a central challenge in long-sequence 3D reconstruction, with scale drift being the most critical failure mode. In chunk-based inference pipelines, the scale degree of freedom in sequential Sim(3) alignment is left unconstrained, causing estimation errors to compound multiplicatively and distort global trajectories and point cloud geometry. We present a scale-consistency enhancement framework built on a key insight: in structured environments such as driving scenes, geometric quantities arising from environmental regularity remain inherently invariant across temporal segments, and discrepancies in their per-chunk measurements directly expose inter-chunk scale drift. We propose Scene Geometric Invariant Anchoring (SGIA), which extracts dominant geometric invariants from each chunk's predicted point cloud via coarse-to-fine robust estimation and exploits their cross-chunk consistency to establish scale constraints independent of point cloud registration, explicitly degenerating 7-DoF Sim(3) alignment into 6-DoF rigid-body transformation and severing chain-wise scale error propagation at its source. We further introduce a lightweight test-time adaptation strategy that fine-tunes only normalization-layer parameters via multi-objective self-supervision, progressively improving intra-chunk predictions along the sequence. Both modules are plug-and-play and require no offline retraining. Experiments on multiple long-sequence benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, reducing absolute trajectory error by up to 32% with significant gains in trajectory stability and reconstruction quality. Code: https://github.com/WZ-CS/VGGT-Align

AI.tldr: 本文提出SGIA（场景几何不变量锚定）框架，利用结构化环境中几何不变量在时间片段间的固有不变性来约束尺度一致性，将7-DoF Sim(3)对齐退化为6-DoF刚体变换，从而切断尺度漂移的链式传播；同时引入仅微调归一化层参数的轻量级测试时自适应策略，两个模块均为即插即用、无需离线重训，在多个长序列基准上将绝对轨迹误差降低最多32%。
AI.motivation: 长序列3D重建中，分块推理管线的尺度自由度在Sim(3)对齐中未受约束，导致估计误差乘法级累积，严重扭曲全局轨迹和点云几何。现有方法缺乏跨块尺度约束，亟需一种不依赖点云配准的尺度一致性增强方案。
AI.method: 提出两条核心机制：(1) SGIA从每个块的预测点云中通过粗到细的鲁棒估计提取主导几何不变量，利用跨块一致性建立独立于点云配准的尺度约束，将7-DoF Sim(3)对齐显式退化为6-DoF刚体变换；(2) 轻量级测试时自适应策略仅微调归一化层参数，通过多目标自监督沿序列逐步提升块内预测质量。
AI.result: 在多个长序列基准上达到最先进性能，绝对轨迹误差最高降低32%，轨迹稳定性和重建质量均显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用场景几何不变量作为跨块尺度锚点，可从源头切断尺度误差的链式传播，实现高效、免训练的尺度一致性增强，适用于驱动场景等结构化环境的长序列3D重建。

title: Evo-Harness: Context-to-Harness Skill Compilation for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Learning from experience is critical for developing capable, self-improving large language model (LLM) agents. Existing methods typically extract knowledge from accumulated trajectories via reflection, memory, rules, or skills. However, agents in realistic environments continuously encounter novel tasks, often offering only a one-shot opportunity to improve. These executions yield rich but highly noisy contexts, entangling broadly useful lessons with task-specific artifacts. Critically, prior works rarely validate their effectiveness on complex real-world tasks or isolate the underlying drivers of improvement. To address these gaps, we formulate online harness learning, where a frozen agent improves by continually updating a structured harness across sequential tasks. This formulation enables a systematic study of key self-improvement factors through our proposed Evo-Harness. At its core, context-to-harness skill compilation distills noisy, single-shot executions into reusable skill harnesses for cross-domain and topic-level adaptation. To demonstrate the efficacy of one-shot skill compilation, we evaluate across five realistic benchmarks (TerminalBench2, SWE-bench, CL-Bench, -bench, WebArena-Infinity). Our extensive analysis demonstrates the effectiveness of Evo-Harness and provides a principled understanding of how LLM agents can effectively learn on the fly. Our code is available at https://github.com/A-EVO-Lab/a-evolve/tree/release/evo-harness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Evo-Harness框架，将在线学习形式化为"冻结代理+结构化harness持续更新"的设置，通过上下文到harness的技能编译（context-to-harness skill compilation）从含噪的单次执行轨迹中蒸馏可复用的技能harness，在五个真实基准上验证了其在跨领域和主题级别的一次性技能学习效果，并系统分析了关键自改进因素。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理的知识提取方法（反思、记忆、规则、技能）在面对现实环境中不断涌现的新任务时，往往只有一次学习机会（one-shot），且执行轨迹包含大量噪声，难以区分普适经验与任务特定噪声。此外，先前工作很少在复杂真实任务上验证效果，也未隔离分析改进的驱动因素。
AI.method: 提出在线harness学习（online harness learning）形式化框架：冻结代理（frozen agent）通过跨连续任务持续更新结构化harness来改进。核心方法是上下文到harness的技能编译，从含噪的单次执行中蒸馏可复用的技能harness，支持跨领域和主题级别的适应性。
AI.result: 在五个真实基准（TerminalBench2、SWE-bench、CL-Bench、-bench、WebArena-Infinity）上验证了一次性技能编译的有效性，并通过广泛分析证明了Evo-Harness的效能，提供了对LLM代理在线学习机制的原则性理解。
AI.conclusion: Evo-Harness证明了在真实复杂环境中，LLM代理可以通过一次性技能编译有效地从经验中在线学习，并系统揭示了自改进的关键因素，为该领域提供了可复现的基准与深入的分析框架。

title: PureTD: Reinforcement Learning for Backgammon Money Games with No Evaluation-time Search
summary: We revisit Tesauro's TD-Gammon for backgammon money games in the setting of no evaluation-time search. Both checker play and cube action (use of the doubling cube) are learned from scratch via self-play reinforcement learning (RL), with minimal hand-coded logic and no expert features. In this setting, we demonstrate that pure self-play RL suffices to train models that reach near-state-of-the-art playing strength. Specifically, for cubeful money games, our search-free model evaluates faster and is substantially stronger than the open-source engines GNU Backgammon and Open Sage running a one-move (1-ply) look-ahead search.

AI.tldr: 本研究重新审视了Tesauro的TD-Gammon在无评估期搜索的后gammon货币游戏中的表现。通过纯自博弈强化学习从零训练棋步和加倍骰子决策，模型达到了接近最先进的水平，且比使用1-ply搜索的开源引擎GNU Backgammon和Open Sage更快更强。
AI.motivation: 重新评估纯自博弈强化学习在后gammon货币游戏中的能力边界，检验在无搜索和极少人工逻辑的条件下，TD-Gammon式方法能否达到接近最先进的水平，从而探索RL在不依赖专家特征和搜索的情况下能达到的强度。
AI.method: 采用纯自博弈强化学习（RL）从零开始训练，同时学习棋子走法（checker play）和加倍骰子行动（cube action）。不使用评估期搜索，仅使用最少量的人工编码逻辑，不使用专家特征。
AI.result: 在带加倍骰子的货币游戏中，这种无搜索模型评估速度更快，且显著强于使用1-ply前瞻搜索的开源引擎GNU Backgammon和Open Sage，达到了接近最先进水平的博弈强度。
AI.conclusion: 纯自博弈RL在后gammon货币游戏中无需搜索即可达到接近顶尖的水平，证明了强化学习方法在该领域的强大潜力，也为无搜索高性能决策系统提供了有力证据。

title: STAIR: Semantic-Temporal Automaton for Interpretable Reasoning in Temporal Question Answering
summary: By leveraging large-scale pretraining, LLMs can interpret diverse temporal expressions and question formulations without task-specific training. However, existing prompt-based neuro-symbolic systems continue to rely on LLMs for both semantic interpretation and exact temporal inference. Consequently, discrete decisions regarding intervals, time anchors, and ordered states remain vulnerable to probabilistic errors and difficult to verify. We present STAIR, a \textbf{S}emantic-\textbf{T}emporal \textbf{A}utomaton for \textbf{I}nterpretable \textbf{R}easoning. STAIR separates semantic interpretation from precise temporal inference: an answer-free LLM adapter maps complex question formulations to normalized temporal intents, while a deterministic temporal automaton with finite control and guarded transitions executes the corresponding policies over canonicalized evidence. Following a rule-first design, STAIR resolves standard questions without invoking an LLM and applies semantic adaptation only when the rule path fails to produce an executable intent. This approach reduces free-form reasoning, making temporal decisions verifiable and interpretable. Specifically, guarded execution supports precise point-time containment and before/after selection, while semantic adaptation handles non-exact intervals and time-anchored queries. Across the TimeQA-Easy, TimeQA-Hard, TempReason-L2, and TempReason-L3 datasets, STAIR consistently outperforms strong baselines in the TQA task using matched model settings, achieving average F1 improvements of 16.57\% and 3.10\% when utilizing the Qwen2.5-7B and GPT-4o-mini models, respectively. Furthermore, ablations and diagnostic analyses demonstrate that STAIR excels at handling both boundary-sensitive and order-sensitive queries, while its guarded execution and semantic adaptation ensure precise point-time reasoning and inexact intervals, respectively.

AI.tldr: STAIR是一种语义-时间自动机框架，将LLM的语义解释与确定性时间推理分离，通过"规则优先+语义适配"的设计实现可验证、可解释的时间问答推理，在多个TQA数据集上优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于提示的神经符号系统同时依赖LLM进行语义解释和精确时间推理，导致关于时间区间、时间锚点和有序状态的离散决策容易受到概率性错误影响且难以验证。作者希望将语义解释与精确时间推理解耦，使时间推理变得可验证和可解释。
AI.method: STAIR包含两个核心组件：(1) 一个与答案无关的LLM适配器，将复杂问题表述映射为归一化的时间意图；(2) 一个确定性时间自动机，具有有限控制和守卫生成转换，在规范化证据上执行对应策略。采用规则优先设计：标准问题无需调用LLM即可解决，仅在规则路径无法生成可执行意图时才应用语义适配。
AI.result: 在TimeQA-Easy、TimeQA-Hard、TempReason-L2和TempReason-L3四个数据集上，STAIR在TQA任务中始终优于强基线。使用Qwen2.5-7B时平均F1提升16.57%，使用GPT-4o-mini时平均F1提升3.10%。消融和诊断分析表明STAIR在处理边界敏感和顺序敏感查询方面表现出色。
AI.conclusion: STAIR通过分离语义解释与精确时间推理，减少了自由形式的推理，使时间决策可验证和可解释。其守卫生成执行支持精确的时间点包含和前后选择，而语义适配处理非精确区间和时间锚定查询，证明了该方法的有效性和泛化能力。

title: Boundary-Aligned Contribution Routing for Robust Optical--SAR Object Detection
summary: Optical imagery provides rich appearance cues, whereas synthetic aperture radar (SAR) offers observations that are less sensitive to illumination and weather, making optical--SAR fusion attractive for remote-sensing object detection. However, the presence of multiple modalities does not guarantee beneficial fusion: imperfect spatial, temporal, and semantic correspondence can make an otherwise intact stream conditionally harmful and induce negative cross-modal transfer. We handle this issue through a model-specific task-utility perspective and learn task-conditioned contribution routing using detection supervision alone. The proposed fusion-boundary-aligned routing regulates each modality's contribution before the first learned cross-modal feature-value mixing operation. For architectures with frequent shallow interaction, a Feature Router performs cross-conditioned, group-addressable modulation near the input; for dual-backbone architectures, a Dual-Statistic Semantic Router predicts stream-level contribution weights from modality-specific average and maximum statistics before late semantic fusion. The routers require no explicit utility supervision, quality labels, reconstruction, or distillation. Experiments on M4-SAR and SpaceNet6-OTD cover nominal full inputs, controlled correspondence shifts, missing modalities, and four nonzero modality-corruption scenarios. Across the reported clean-training controls, routing improves full-input $\text{mAP}_{50}$ by 0.5--5.9 points. Relative to the corresponding modality-dropout baselines, it raises missing-modality $\text{mAP}_{50}$ by 7.6--41.6 points and reduces the negative-transfer rate by up to 12.7 percentage points. Spearman correlations between the learned routing weights and model-specific leave-one-modality-out utility range from 0.45 to 0.66, supporting the task-utility interpretation of the routing coefficients.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于模型特定任务效用的路由机制，用于光学-SAR融合目标检测中的模态贡献调控，通过检测监督信号即可学习，无需额外效用监督或质量标签，在多数据集和多场景下显著提升检测性能并缓解负向跨模态迁移。
AI.motivation: 光学图像提供丰富的表观信息，而SAR对光照和天气不敏感，两者融合对遥感目标检测有吸引力。然而多模态融合并非必然有益：空间、时间和语义上的不完美对应可能使原本完好的模态流产生条件性危害，引发负向跨模态迁移。因此需要一种机制来动态调控各模态的贡献。
AI.method: （1）提出"融合边界对齐路由"（fusion-boundary-aligned routing），在每个首次跨模态特征值混合操作之前调节各模态的贡献；（2）针对频繁浅层交互的架构，设计Feature Router，在输入附近进行跨条件、组寻址的调制；（3）针对双骨干架构，设计Dual-Statistic Semantic Router，从模态特定的均值与最大统计量预测流级贡献权重，在晚期语义融合前生效；（4）路由仅依赖检测监督信号训练，无需显式效用监督、质量标签、重建或蒸馏。
