I evaluate MMS-1B-all with the Central Kurdish (ckb) adapter, used as released without adaptation, on 1,722 Garrusi questionnaire segments from five speakers (9,763 reference word tokens; 117.9 minutes). I use a common-reference design: the reference is folded once and fixed at 9,763 tokens, while only the hypothesis representation varies. The raw Arabic-script hypothesis scores 111.70% WER and 100.92% CER, with zero exact word matches. Latin transliteration gives 102.36% WER and 57.89% CER; folding it into the reference's reduced orthography gives 97.85% and 51.20%. Thus RAW-to-FOLDED reduces measured WER by 13.85 points and CER by 49.72 points; folding alone accounts for 4.51 and 6.69 points. Substantial error remains: 14.53% of reference tokens are exact matches, edits are substitution-dominated, and per-segment WER is higher for shorter segments. A Southern Kurdish fine-tuned system (aranemini/southern-kurdish-asr), scored under the same design, performs worse on every speaker (1,703 segments), with 109.56% WER and 55.85% CER. However, 12,330 output characters fall outside the folding table, so these rates must be recomputed against the corrected fixed reference. The MMS output also contains 613 unconverted or unmapped characters, showing that part of the residual error reflects scoring-pipeline limits rather than recognition alone. I will release the fixed reference and segment-level results, subject to source-corpus sharing terms, to support independent checking.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了一个库尔德语变体（Garrusi方言，使用拉丁文田野拼写法书写）的语音识别评估问题。核心难点在于：模型输出阿拉伯文字，而参考文本是拉丁文，直接评分会将书写系统差异误判为识别错误。作者提出"共同参考设计"（将参考固定为统一形式，仅变化假设的表示），评估MMS-1B-all模型在1,722个片段上的表现，发现原始阿拉伯文输出WER高达111.70%，拉丁音译后降至102.36%，折叠到参考简写系统后进一步降至97.85%，但仍存在大量残差错误。
AI.motivation: 当语音识别模型的输出脚本与参考转写不同（阿拉伯文vs拉丁文）时，直接评分会产生严重的测量偏差，将书写系统差异误计为识别错误。现有的联合归一化方法虽然能缓解问题，但会同时改变参考分词和评分分母，导致结果难以归因。因此需要一种评估设计，使参考保持固定，仅变化假设表示，从而分离"书写系统差异"与"真实识别错误"的贡献。
AI.method: 采用"共同参考设计"：参考文本被折叠并固定为9,763个token，仅改变假设的表示形式。评估了三种假设变体在MMS-1B-all（ckb适配器，未经微调）上的表现：(1) 原始阿拉伯文输出；(2) 拉丁音译；(3) 折叠到参考的简写正字法。同时使用相同设计比较了南方库尔德语微调系统（aranemini/southern-kurdish-asr），并检查了输出中超出折叠表的字符（unmapped characters）。
AI.result: 原始阿拉伯文假设WER为111.70%、CER为100.92%，无任何精确词匹配。拉丁音译后WER降至102.36%（-9.34点）、CER降至57.89%（-43.03点）；折叠到参考简写正字法后WER降至97.85%、CER降至51.20%。RAW-to-FOLDED总降幅为WER 13.85点、CER 49.72点。但只有14.53%的参考token被精确匹配，编辑操作以替换为主，短片段的WER更高。南方库尔德语系统表现更差（WER 109.56%、CER 55.85%），且12,330个输出字符超出折叠表，需重新计算。MMS输出中有613个未转换字符，表明部分残差误差源于评分管道限制。
AI.conclusion: 书写系统归一化对跨脚本ASR评估至关重要，共同参考设计能有效分离"表示层差异"与"识别层误差"。即使经过充分归一化，模型在该Garrusi数据上的残差错误仍然显著（WER 97.85%），说明该库尔德语变体的ASR性能远未达到可用水平。部分测得误差来自评分管道的字符映射不完整（613个字符），而非纯粹识别失败，因此需谨慎解读原始数字。作者将发布固定的参考及片段级结果以支持独立验证。

title: SAGE-OR: Semi-supervised Adaptive Scene Graph Generation for Operating Rooms
summary: Current surgical scene graph generation methods depend on dense multi-modal supervision and specialized hardware (synchronized RGB-D sensors, calibration rigs), making dataset construction expensive and restricting all existing benchmarks to simulated environments. We propose SAGE-OR, a feature-centric framework that replaces the traditional detect-then-reason paradigm with a decoupled representation-reasoning paradigm in which localization is derived from frozen foundation models, encoded implicitly in pre-computed features, and used without any localization supervision, while a lightweight graph transformer performs relational reasoning over cached features. We employ a semi-supervised formulation with general-purpose segmentation prompts to eliminate localization supervision while enabling unsupervised context augmentation through additional prompt-driven entities, such as hands, which are absent from annotations. General-purpose prompts are used to induce near-perfect recall, while precision is delegated to downstream attention-based reasoning, enabling simple adaptation to new entities via prompt-level modification. This design enables a lightweight 15M-parameter graph transformer that trains in 1.4 hours and runs relational inference at $\sim$1ms per frame with peak memory under 2GB, suitable for edge hardware used in the operating room; feature extraction runs offline as a separate caching stage (4.27s per frame). On the 4D-OR benchmark, the core model achieves 76% F1, matching the fully supervised 4D-OR baseline while eliminating all localization annotations, and unsupervised hand augmentation raises this to 86%, within 4 points of state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods requiring dense multi-modal supervision, providing a practical pathway for adaptation to new surgical settings without annotation other than relationship and class labels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAGE-OR，一种面向手术场景图生成的特征中心框架，用"解耦表征-推理"范式替代传统的"检测-推理"范式。该方法利用冻结的视觉基础模型隐式编码定位信息，无需任何定位监督，仅需关系与类别标签的半监督标注即可训练。轻量级图Transformer（15M参数）在1.4小时内完成训练，推理速度约1ms/帧，峰值内存低于2GB，适合手术室边缘硬件部署。
AI.motivation: 现有手术场景图生成方法依赖密集的多模态监督（同步RGB-D传感器、标定设备）和专用硬件，导致数据集构建成本高昂，且所有现有基准仅局限于模拟环境。这严重限制了该领域在真实手术场景中的落地应用。
AI.method: SAGE-OR采用特征中心范式：1）用冻结的基础模型预计算特征，隐式编码定位信息，彻底消除定位监督；2）采用半监督公式化方法，利用通用分割提示（general-purpose segmentation prompts）获得近完美的召回率，将精确性交给下游基于注意力的推理；3）通过提示驱动的无监督实体增强（如手）扩展上下文；4）轻量级图Transformer在缓存特征上进行关系推理。
AI.result: 在4D-OR基准上，核心模型达到76% F1，与全监督基线持平，同时消除所有定位标注；通过无监督手部增强将F1提升至86%，仅比需要密集多模态监督的SOTA方法低4个百分点。特征提取离线运行（4.27秒/帧），训练仅需1.4小时，推理约1ms/帧，峰值内存低于2GB。
AI.conclusion: SAGE-OR证明了手术场景图生成可以摆脱昂贵的定位监督和专用硬件，通过特征中心范式和提示驱动的半监督学习，在不牺牲性能的前提下显著降低数据标注和计算资源需求，为真实手术环境中的场景理解提供了实用路径。

title: ACTS-SQL: Agentic and Critic-Oriented Tree-Structured SQL Correctness with Large Language Models
summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) have been increasingly adopted in Text-to-SQL systems, yet SQL errors remain a major obstacle in real-world Text-to-SQL inference pipelines. Existing SQL correction approaches either rely on large-scale, high-quality training data with substantial overhead, or adopt single-path agentic workflows that are brittle to early mistakes and prone to error propagation.
  To develop a practical SQL correctness system for industrial scenarios, we present a training-free framework that formulates SQL correction as a plan-guided, tree-structured debugging process. By maintaining multiple correction strategies and enabling backtracking, the framework mitigates error accumulation during iterative refinement. We further integrate execution-based verification and clause-level diagnostic tools to support strategy pruning and precise error localization.
  We evaluate the system on the BIRD-Critic benchmark and observe consistent accuracy gains over strong LLM backbones and representative agent-based baselines, achieving a 9.42% improvement over the previous state-of-the-art method. The framework is also deployed in the Torch Log Service (TLS) of Volcano Engine to support an online Text-to-TLS API. In production, it improves execution accuracy from 36.77% to 53.61% on real user queries with a representative strong LLM backbone (GPT-5). These results demonstrate the effectiveness and stability of our approach in real-world deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个无需训练的SQL纠错框架，将SQL纠错建模为"计划引导的树状调试过程"，通过维护多种纠错策略和回溯机制来缓解错误累积，并结合执行验证和子句级诊断工具进行策略剪枝和精确错误定位。在BIRD-Critic基准上比SOTA提升9.42%，并在火山引擎的Torch Log Service中部署，将真实查询的执行准确率从36.77%提升至53.61%。
AI.motivation: LLM在Text-to-SQL系统中被广泛采用，但SQL错误仍是实际推理管线中的主要障碍。现有SQL纠错方法要么依赖大规模高质量训练数据（开销大），要么采用单路径agent工作流（脆弱且容易出现错误传播），难以适用于工业场景。
AI.method: 提出一个训练自由的框架，将SQL纠错形式化为计划引导的树状调试过程。维护多条纠错策略并支持回溯，缓解迭代精化中的错误累积；集成基于执行的验证和子句级诊断工具，支持策略剪枝与精确错误定位。
AI.result: 在BIRD-Critic基准上取得一致的准确率提升，较先前SOTA方法提升9.42%。在火山引擎Torch Log Service（TLS）生产环境中部署后，使用GPT-5作为基座模型将真实用户查询的执行准确率从36.77%提升至53.61%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在基准测试和真实生产环境中均表现出有效性和稳定性，证明无需训练数据即可实现实用的SQL纠错系统，适合工业场景部署。

title: SAPE: Sandwich Adapters for Parameter Efficiency in Large Language Model Fine-Tuning
summary: While Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) has substantially reduced the hardware cost of adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) by decreasing the number of trainable parameters, recent studies have sought to further improve PEFT through parameter sharing. However, these approaches either employ uniform parameter sharing across layers, which can delay convergence, or rely on dynamic masking strategies, which add computational overhead. The potential of sharing patterns inspired by the inherent hierarchical structure of Transformer architectures remains unexplored in PEFT. To address this gap, we introduce SAPE (Sandwich Adapters for Parameter Efficiency), a PEFT framework based on a sandwich-style hard weight-sharing topology. SAPE routes intermediate Transformer layers through balanced shared group adapters while strictly isolating the input embedding and final projection boundary transformations to prevent gradient interference. This design significantly reduces memory consumption while eliminating the computational overhead associated with dynamic parameter-sharing methods. Extensive evaluations across encoder-only and causal decoder architectures demonstrate that SAPE achieves state-of-the-art performance in low-parameter regimes. On natural language understanding, SAPE outperforms proPETL on RoBERTa-large while utilizing only 10% of the baseline's parameter budget. On natural language generation and world knowledge reasoning with LLaMA-3.2 (3B) under a strict ~0.6M parameter constraint, SAPE outperforms AdaLoRA, yielding absolute improvements of +4.85% on GSM8K and +3.11% on CommonsenseQA. Furthermore, through comprehensive topological ablations, we formalize an inherent capacity trade-off: while hard parameter sharing strongly regularizes semantic generalization, it slightly smooths the sharp layer-wise transformations required for rigid multi-step arithmetic reasoning.

AI.tldr: SAPE是一种基于三明治式硬权重共享拓扑的PEFT框架，通过将中间Transformer层路由到平衡的共享组适配器中，同时严格隔离输入嵌入和最终投影边界变换以防止梯度干扰，在极低参数预算下实现了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的PEFT参数共享方法要么采用跨层均匀共享导致收敛缓慢，要么依赖动态掩码策略引入额外计算开销。Transformer架构固有的层次结构所启发的共享模式在PEFT中尚未被探索，存在研究空白。
AI.method: SAPE采用三明治式（sandwich-style）硬权重共享拓扑：将中间Transformer层路由至多个平衡的共享组适配器，同时严格隔离输入嵌入层和最终投影层的边界变换以阻止梯度干扰。该方法消除了动态参数共享方法的计算开销，并显著降低内存消耗。
AI.result: 在编码器-only和因果解码器架构上均达到低参数场景的SOTA：在RoBERTa-large上NLU任务以仅10%参数预算超越proPETL；在LLaMA-3.2(3B)约0.6M参数约束下，GSM8K提升+4.85%、CommonsenseQA提升+3.11%，均优于AdaLoRA。
AI.conclusion: 通过全面的拓扑消融实验，作者形式化了一个固有的容量权衡：硬参数共享强烈正则化语义泛化，但会略微平滑刚性多步算术推理所需的尖锐层间变换。

title: Mint-Agent: Introducing Finance-Native Agentic Foundation Models
summary: Financial agents must do more than recall domain knowledge: they must be both reliable, executing precise operations over grounded evidence, and executive, sustaining long-horizon research whose conclusions remain auditable. We present Mint-Agent, a family of finance-native agentic models designed around these two scales of financial intelligence. Mint-Agent is built upon three pillars: data, harness, and algorithm. Our data engine constructs clean, specialized tasks for atomic financial capabilities and long-horizon agentic execution from real-world financial sources. MintHarness enables stable interaction with open-ended environments and maintains auditable evidence trails across extended research trajectories. Our training recipe combines SFT, critical-step OPD, and RLVR to develop separate financial reasoning and agentic execution experts, which are then unified through model merging and multi-teacher on-policy distillation into compact, general-purpose financial agents. This pipeline yields two flagship models, Mint-Cu (9B) and Mint-Ag (27B). Across professional financial benchmarks, our models demonstrate two defining strengths: (1) Reliability: Mint-Ag achieves 98.33% on RFC-Bench, surpassing GPT-5.6-Sol and Claude-Opus-4.8 by 3.66 and 3.00 points; and (2) Executability: Mint-Cu reaches 69.86% on FinSearchComp T2, outperforming Agents-A1-35B and Nex-N2-mini by 22.83 and 12.78 points, while Mint-Ag achieves 76.00% and 60.49% on FinanceAgentBench v1.1 and v2, respectively. These results establish a path toward trustworthy financial intelligence in which domain expertise, long-horizon execution, and auditable evidence are jointly engineered as a unified foundation for frontier agentic models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Mint-Agent，一个金融原生智能体模型家族，通过数据引擎、MintHarness强化学习环境和SFT+OPD+RLVR训练配方，构建了Mint-Cu（9B）和Mint-Ag（27B）两个旗舰模型，在专业金融基准上分别展现出卓越的可靠性和可执行性。
AI.motivation: 金融智能体不仅需要掌握领域知识，还必须具备两个核心能力：可靠性（在基于实证证据上执行精确操作）和执行力（维持长周期研究并保证结论可审计）。现有模型难以同时满足这两方面的要求，需要专门设计的金融原生智能体。
AI.method: Mint-Agent基于三大支柱构建：（1）数据引擎——从真实金融数据源构造原子金融能力和长周期智能体执行的干净任务；（2）MintHarness——支持开放环境的稳定交互并维护跨长研究轨迹的可审计证据链；（3）训练配方——结合SFT、关键步骤OPD和RLVR，分别训练金融推理与智能体执行专家，再通过模型合并和多方教师在线策略蒸馏统一为紧凑的通用金融智能体。
AI.result: 在专业金融基准上：Mint-Ag在RFC-Bench上达到98.33%，超越GPT-5.6-Sol和Claude-Opus-4.8分别3.66和3.00分（可靠性）；Mint-Cu在FinSearchComp T2上达到69.86%，超越Agents-A1-35B和Nex-N2-mini分别22.83和12.78分（可执行性）；Mint-Ag在FinanceAgentBench v1.1和v2上分别达到76.00%和60.49%。
AI.conclusion: Mint-Agent建立了通往可信金融智能的路径，将领域专业知识、长周期执行和可审计证据作为统一的基座进行联合工程化，为前沿智能体模型在金融领域落地提供了系统性方案。

title: TEA: Text Encoder Alignment for Robust Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Models
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models can be misused to generate harmful content through adversarial or paraphrased prompts that bypass built-in safety mechanisms. Existing concept erasure methods often suffer from limited robustness against adversarial prompts, degradation of benign generation quality, or reliance on inference-time interventions that introduce persistent computational overhead. To address these limitations, we formulate concept erasure as a domain alignment problem in the text representation space. We propose a lightweight Text Encoder Alignment framework (TEA) that fine-tunes only the text encoder while keeping the generative backbone fully frozen. Given concept--anchor prompt pairs, our method trains a discriminator to distinguish token-level representations of concept-containing prompts from those of safe anchor prompts, while updating the text encoder to make these representations indistinguishable. TEA introduces zero inference-time overhead and requires only a small number of fine-tuning steps, making it highly efficient to deploy at scale. Despite this efficiency, TEA achieves state-of-the-art erasure robustness against black-box and white-box adversarial attacks on Stable Diffusion v1.4, while preserving generation quality on benign prompts. Furthermore, TEA is model-agnostic and achieves the lowest attack success rate on Stable Diffusion v3.5, extending concept erasure to a Rectified Flow Transformer architecture with T5 conditioning where prior methods remain largely unexplored. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/alirezafarashah/TEA.git}{https://github.com/alirezafarashah/TEA.git}

AI.tldr: 本文提出TEA框架，将概念擦除建模为文本表示空间中的域对齐问题。通过仅微调文本编码器、保持生成骨干网络冻结，并使用判别器使概念提示与安全锚点提示的token级表示不可区分，实现零推理开销的概念擦除，在Stable Diffusion v1.4和v3.5上均达到最先进的对抗鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本到图像扩散模型概念擦除方法存在三个主要局限性：对对抗性提示的鲁棒性不足、会损害良性提示的生成质量、或依赖推理时干预导致持续的计算开销。目标是在保持生成质量的同时，实现高效且鲁棒的概念擦除。
AI.method: TEA仅微调文本编码器，冻结生成骨干网络。给定概念-锚点提示对，训练一个判别器区分包含概念的提示与安全锚点提示的token级表示，同时更新文本编码器使这两类表示不可区分，从而将概念擦除形式化为文本表示空间中的域对齐问题。
AI.result: TEA在Stable Diffusion v1.4上对黑盒和白盒对抗攻击均达到最先进的擦除鲁棒性，同时保持良性提示的生成质量；在Stable Diffusion v3.5上取得最低攻击成功率，将概念擦除扩展到基于T5条件的Rectified Flow Transformer架构。仅需少量微调步骤且零推理开销。
AI.conclusion: TEA通过轻量级文本编码器对齐实现概念擦除，兼具零推理开销、高对抗鲁棒性、模型无关性和可扩展部署能力，填补了在Rectified Flow Transformer架构上概念擦除研究的空白。

title: Constitutive Priors for Machine Intelligence: A Legitimacy Theory of the Artificial Physical World
comment: 55 pages, 3 figures, 75 references. Appendix A contains the semi-formal statements. First of three companion works; the two companions are in preparation
summary: Machine intelligence has conquered the symbolic world but stalled at the physical one. The stall is structural: physical AI faces a cold-start deadlock -- no intelligence without data, no data without deployed intelligence. Our thesis: the deadlock is real but unevenly distributed, and the exception has a name: the artificial physical world. Buildings, industrial facilities, and infrastructure are intentionally constituted and documented: designed artifacts ship with readable archives that precede and constitute their instances; here, norms are promulgated before instances, not averaged from them. Four contributions. (i) From a four-world ontology we derive a legitimacy criterion for constitutive prior frameworks: prior extraction is legitimate if and only if the object domain is intentionally constituted and has left a readable archive; the criterion is testable through direction of fit -- deviation from a constitutive norm is a violation in the world, not a revision of the model. (ii) We establish a layering lower bound: any such framework has at least four layers -- syntax, concept, knowledge, instance -- because four construction goals pair into mutually incompatible carriers. (iii) We register deployment claims across five industrial domains and a 32-class failure-mode vocabulary. (iv) We stake the framework on five falsifiable predictions, the central one checkable on the public engineering record: if it fails, the framework fails. Semi-formal arguments back these claims (Appendix A): a Gold-type boundary on rule coverage in archiveless worlds, a decidability result for failure reduction over closed concept layers, and a boundary theorem for certificate-anchored calculi. Large language models find an honored place here -- as readers of the archive, not as the archive. First of three companion works; the companions take up the questions deliberately left open.

AI.tldr: 本文提出物理人工智能陷入"冷启动死锁"这一结构性困境，但指出人造物理世界（建筑、工业设施、基础设施）因"有意构成且有可读档案"而例外，可作为合法先验知识来源，并给出四层框架与可证伪预测。
AI.motivation: 机器智能在符号世界取得突破，但在物理世界停滞。作者认为这种停滞是结构性的：物理AI面临"无智能则无数据、无数据则无智能"的冷启动死锁。然而作者提出，这种死锁的分布是不均匀的，人造物理世界（建筑、工业设施、基础设施）由于是有意构成且留有可读档案的领域，构成了例外——在这里规范先于实例被颁布，而非从实例中平均得出。
AI.method: 论文包含四项贡献：(i)从四世界本体论推导出"构成式先验框架"的合法性判据——只有当对象域是有意构成的且留有可读档案时，先验提取才合法，且可用"适配方向"检验（偏离构成规范是世界中的违规，而非模型的修正）；(ii)证明层级下界：任何此类框架至少包含语法、概念、知识、实例四层，因为四种构建目标配对为互不兼容的载体；(iii)在五个工业领域登记部署主张并给出32类故障模式词汇表；(iv)提出五个可证伪预测，核心预测可在公开工程纪录上检验，若失败则框架失败。另有三个半形式论证（附录A）：无档案世界中的Gold型规则覆盖边界、闭概念层上故障归约的可判定性、证书锚定演算的边界定理。LLM在此的定位是"档案的阅读者"，而非档案本身。
AI.result: 论文给出了四世界本体论下的合法性判据（方向适配测试）、四层框架的下界定理、五领域部署声明与32类故障模式词汇、以及五个可证伪预测（含可由公开工程纪录检验的核心预测）。另有三个半形式化辅助论证支撑主要主张。
AI.conclusion: 物理AI的冷启动死锁是真实但分布不均的；人工物理世界因其有意构成性和可读档案性，为突破死锁提供了合法先验来源。LLM在此框架中被定位为档案的读者。本文为三部曲的第一部，后续作品将处理本文有意留下的开放问题。

title: Does 1/2-Tsallis-INF Also Work Well for Best-Arm Identification?
summary: Regret minimization (RM) and best-arm identification (BAI) are two fundamental objectives in multi-armed bandits. Among regret-minimizing algorithms, $1/2$-Tsallis-INF is a canonical best-of-both-worlds FTRL algorithm: it achieves logarithmic pseudo-regret in stochastic bandits while retaining minimax-optimal regret in adversarial bandits, without knowing the environment in advance. This raises a natural question: can the same algorithm, without additional exploration, also identify the best arm reliably? We study this question in stochastic bandits by analyzing the failure probability $\operatorname{Err}_t$, defined as the probability that the empirical best arm determined by the cumulative importance-weighted loss estimates of 1/2-Tsallis-INF differs from the true optimal arm. The main difficulty is that, at the logarithmic-regret scale, suboptimal arms are sampled with probability heuristically of order $1/t$. Consequently, importance weighting causes the cumulative estimator to fluctuate on the same linear scale as its mean separation. To overcome this obstacle, guided by a diffusion toy model, we construct a Lyapunov function for the gap process between the estimated cumulative loss of the optimal arm and that of the best competing arm. This leads to polynomial upper bounds on $\operatorname{Err}_t$: for learning rate $η_t=α/\sqrt t$, $\operatorname{Err}_t$ decays at rate $t^{-2+α^2μ_{i_*}/4+ρ}$ for any $ρ>0$, where $μ_{i_*}$ denotes the mean loss of the true optimal arm. We also establish a lower bound $Ω(t^{-2-\varepsilon})$ for any $\varepsilon>0$, showing that the exponent $2$ is essentially tight.

AI.tldr: 本文研究1/2-Tsallis-INF算法在随机多臂老虎机问题中是否能在不需额外探索的情况下同时完成遗憾最小化（RM）和最优臂识别（BAI）。通过构造Lyapunov函数分析间隙过程，证明了该算法在采用学习率η_t=α/√t时，最优臂识别失败概率以t^{-2+α^2μ_{i_*}/4+ρ}的多项式速率衰减，并建立了Ω(t^{-2-ε})的下界，表明指数2本质上是紧的。
AI.motivation: 1/2-Tsallis-INF是经典的best-of-both-worlds FTRL算法，在随机和对抗性老虎机中均达到最优遗憾保证。但一个自然的问题是：该算法是否无需额外探索就能同时可靠地识别最优臂？此前的遗憾最小化分析并未回答这一问题，因此作者希望严格分析该算法的失败概率，填补RM与BAI之间理论联系的空白。
AI.method: 作者首先通过扩散玩具模型（diffusion toy model）揭示核心困难：在对数遗憾尺度下，次优臂被采样概率约为1/t，重要性加权导致累积估计器在线性尺度上波动，与均值间隔同阶。为克服此障碍，作者为最优臂与最佳竞争臂之间的累积损失估计间隙过程构造Lyapunov函数，进而导出失败概率Err_t的多项式上界；同时通过下界构造证明指数2的紧性。
AI.result: 对学习率η_t=α/√t，失败概率Err_t以速率t^{-2+α^2μ_{i_*}/4+ρ}衰减（任意ρ>0），其中μ_{i_*}为最优臂的均值损失。同时建立了下界Ω(t^{-2-ε})（任意ε>0），证明指数2本质上是紧的，即该算法的BAI失败概率不能优于t^{-2}量级。
AI.conclusion: 1/2-Tsallis-INF算法在无需额外探索的情况下，确实能以多项式速率（接近t^{-2}）可靠地识别最优臂，其失败概率指数2是本质紧的。这建立了RM与BAI目标在该算法下的统一理论保证，为理解FTRL类算法在双目标下的行为提供了新的解析工具（Lyapunov函数方法）。

title: Counting Documents Is Not Counting Text: Unit Bias in Web-PDF Corpus Statistics
summary: PDF corpora advertise their size in tokens but compute every rate they publish (coverage, OCR routing, re-fetch recovery, language mix) per document, and none decomposes its token total. The two units diverge sharply. On CC-MAIN-2021-31-PDF-UNTRUNCATED (7.9M web PDFs, 32.6B tokens), 3.02% of text-bearing documents hold half the tokens (Gini 0.807); documents over 50 pages are 5.00% of the corpus but 53.53% of its text. The PDFs produced by a TeX{} toolchain are 1.66% of documents and 4.05% of the text. The clearest casualty is Common Crawl's truncation cap: it affected 23.06% of documents and 63.08% of the text. Reconstructing the truncated files and extracting both versions, two widely used libraries recover 11.4% and 1.4% of that text; between 72% and 97% of affected documents yield nothing; roughly 55--62% of the corpus's text is lost. Under the 5 MiB cap adopted in March 2025, 30.19% of tokens would still be truncated, and recovery on those documents rises only from 3.3% to 13.2%. We recommend that corpus statistics be reported in both units: documents and tokens.

AI.tldr: 本文指出PDF语料库以token为单位宣传规模，但所有统计指标（覆盖率、OCR路由、重抓取恢复、语言混合）均按文档计算，导致两种单位严重脱节。作者对CC-MAIN-2021-31-PDF-UNTRUNCATED语料（790万PDF文档，326亿token）进行了详细分析，发现不同统计口径下结论差异巨大：3.02%的文档占据一半token，超过50页的文档仅占5.00%但贡献53.53%的文本，Common Crawl截断上限影响了23.06%的文档但波及63.08%的文本，且恢复率极低（仅3.3%-11.4%），即使采用2025年3月的5 MiB新上限仍有30.19%的token被截断。作者建议语料库统计应以文档和token两种单位同时报告。
AI.motivation: PDF语料库的科学报告存在统计口径不一致的问题：语料库以token数（如数十亿）宣传规模，但各项性能指标却按文档数计算。这种不一致导致研究结论可能严重偏差，尤其是在Common Crawl截断策略影响大量token文本的背景下，需要揭示两种单位之间的巨大差异并推动统计规范的改进。
AI.method: 作者对CC-MAIN-2021-31-PDF-UNTRUNCATED语料库（790万网页PDF，326亿token）进行系统分析，包括：计算文本承载文档的Gini系数与token分布；按页数、TeX工具链来源等维度对比文档数与token数占比；分析Common Crawl截断上限对文档和文本的不同影响；重建被截断文件并用两种广泛使用的PDF库提取，量化恢复率；评估2025年3月实施的5 MiB新上限对截断率和恢复率的影响。
AI.result: 3.02%的文本承载文档占据50%的token（Gini系数0.807）；超过50页的文档占5.00%但贡献53.53%的文本；TeX工具链生成的PDF占文档的1.66%和文本的4.05%。Common Crawl截断影响了23.06%的文档但覆盖63.08%的文本，两种PDF库仅能恢复11.4%和1.4%的被截断文本，72%-97%的受影响文档完全无法恢复，约55%-62%的语料文本最终丢失。即使采用5 MiB新上限，仍有30.19%的token会被截断，恢复率仅从3.3%上升到13.2%。
AI.conclusion: PDF语料库的文档数与token数严重脱节，按文档计算的统计指标会系统性低估截断等问题的严重性。建议所有语料库统计指标同时以文档和token两种单位报告，以提供更准确的语料库质量画像。

title: Feed-Forward Hierarchical Gaussian Diffusion for Extreme CT Reconstruction
summary: Reconstructing three-dimensional computed tomography (CT) from severely constrained projections is highly ill-posed. Sparse angular sampling, restricted angular coverage, and low photon counts can occur individually or jointly, obscuring global anatomy and local tissue detail. Many learned CT reconstruction methods are tailored to a single dominant degradation. Existing diffusion and Gaussian approaches commonly recover global structure and local detail within a shared representation. We propose HiGDiff, a feed-forward hierarchical Gaussian diffusion framework that decomposes reconstruction both spatially and from structure to detail. Physics-conditioned anatomical anchors and a foreground capacity field allocate learnable Gaussian primitives to informative regions. A structure diffusion stage first recovers global attenuation geometry, and its learned representation conditions a detail diffusion stage for residual boundaries and tissue transitions. The resulting Gaussian banks are rendered as attenuation fields and further refined by a gradient-isolated residual module. Experiments on three distinct CT benchmark datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art reconstruction performance across isolated, paired, and joint degradation settings, including improvements of 5.81 dB in macro-average peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and 0.113 in structural similarity index measure (SSIM) on the Low Dose CT Image and Projection Data (LDCT-PD) collection. Code and experimental configurations are openly available at https://github.com/Bean-Young/HiGDiff.

AI.tldr: HiGDiff是一个前馈层次化高斯扩散框架，用于从严重受限的投影数据（稀疏角度采样、受限角度覆盖和低光子计数）中进行三维CT重建。它通过空间分解和"从结构到细节"的层次化分解，利用物理条件化的解剖锚点和前景容量场分配可学习的高斯原语，先通过结构扩散阶段恢复全局衰减几何，再用其表征条件化细节扩散阶段恢复残余边界和组织过渡，最后通过梯度隔离残差模块细化。在三个CT基准数据集上实现了最先进的重建性能，包括在LDCT-PD数据集上PSNR提升5.81 dB、SSIM提升0.113。
AI.motivation: 从严重约束投影中重建三维CT是高度病态问题。稀疏角度采样、受限角度覆盖和低光子计数可单独或联合出现，干扰全局解剖结构和局部组织细节。现有学习方法通常针对单一主导退化类型设计，而扩散和高斯方法往往在共享表征中恢复全局结构和局部细节，缺乏层次化分解能力，无法同时处理多种联合退化场景。
AI.method: HiGDiff采用前馈层次化高斯扩散框架：(1) 在空间上将重建任务分解，并通过物理条件化的解剖锚点和前景容量场将可学习高斯原语分配到信息丰富区域；(2) 结构扩散阶段先恢复全局衰减几何结构；(3) 结构阶段学习到的表征作为条件，驱动细节扩散阶段恢复残余边界和组织过渡；(4) 生成的高斯库渲染为衰减场，由梯度隔离残差模块进一步细化。
AI.result: 在三个不同的CT基准数据集上，在孤立、配对和联合退化设置下均实现了最先进的重建性能。具体在LDCT-PD数据集上，宏平均PSNR提升5.81 dB，SSIM提升0.113。
AI.conclusion: HiGDiff通过空间和结构-细节的双重层次化解耦，有效解决了严重受限投影下CT重建的病态问题，在不同退化类型及组合场景下均表现出优于现有方法的鲁棒性和重建质量。代码已开源。

title: SkillCommit: Evolving Agent Skills through Behaviorally Validated Scope Expansion
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can continually improve without parameter updates by converting historical experience into reusable procedural knowledge. However, existing methods often consolidate experience based on semantic similarity or LLM judgments, which may merge superficially related but behaviorally incompatible strategies and thereby degrade performance. To address the issue, we propose SkillCommit, an online skill evolution framework that continuously transforms experience into a hierarchical library of reusable skills. Each new experience is initially preserved as an instance-specific patch, retaining the behavior validated in its local context. As related skills accumulate, SkillCommit abstracts those sharing a common behavioral mechanism into higher-level skills. Specifically, for each incoming skill, embedding-based retrieval first identifies candidate related skills. Cross-instance replay and an LLM-based mechanism check determine whether these skills transfer across cases and share a common underlying mechanism. Candidates that pass both checks are abstracted into a higher-level skill and committed only if it preserves the validated behavior of all constituent skills. Experiments on RuleArena, OpenExempt and KOR-Bench demonstrate that SkillCommit consistently improves agent performance across diverse domains. Moreover, the learned skills transfer across model scales and families, enabling cross-model experience transfer.

AI.tldr: SkillCommit是一个在线技能演化框架，将LLM代理的历史经验转化为分层可复用技能库。不同于基于语义相似性或LLM判断的经验整合方法，SkillCommit通过跨实例回放和机制检查来确保只有行为机制兼容的技能才会被抽象合并，从而保留已验证的行为。实验在RuleArena、OpenExempt和KOR-Bench上证明其持续提升代理性能，且技能可跨模型规模和家族迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有方法基于语义相似性或LLM判断来整合经验，可能将表面相关但在行为上不兼容的策略合并，导致代理性能下降。需要一种更严谨的方式来判断技能是否真正可迁移和可合并。
AI.method: SkillCommit将每个新经验先保存为实例特定的补丁（patch），保留本地上下文中已验证的行为。当相关技能积累到一定程度时，通过嵌入检索识别候选相关技能，然后通过跨实例回放和LLM机制检查两步验证来判断技能是否共享共同底层机制。只有通过检查的候选才会被抽象为更高级技能，并且仅在能保留所有组成技能已验证行为时才被提交。
AI.result: 在RuleArena、OpenExempt和KOR-Bench三个基准上，SkillCommit一致提升了代理性能。学到的技能可以跨模型规模和模型家族迁移，实现跨模型经验转移。
AI.conclusion: SkillCommit通过行为机制级别的严格验证而非表面语义相似性来判断技能可合并性，有效避免了不兼容策略的错误聚合，推动了LLM代理持续学习和跨模型经验共享。

title: D2-ScaleAgent: Dual-Dimensional Scaling for Long Document Understanding
summary: Multi-modal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a key technique for visually rich long document understanding. Existing multi-modal RAG methods are progressively advancing toward multi-agent systems: they first retrieve relevant pages based on a query, and then iteratively understand information within those pages. However, these methods typically rely on fixed workflows and lack the ability to dynamically scale computation at test time, often leading to insufficient evidence. To address this, we propose D2-ScaleAgent, an agentic framework that introduces a dual-dimensional scaling paradigm for retrieval and reasoning. The core of D2-ScaleAgent is a Verifier agent-driven dynamic routing loop based on the intrinsic difficulty of the query, centered around a continuously updated evidence bank that serves as the agent's dynamic working memory: when retrieval needs to be expanded, the agent routes outward (retrieval scaling), decomposing the query into attributes and performing parallel page retrieval, followed by adaptive pruning to ensure comprehensive evidence coverage. When fine-grained reasoning is required, the agent routes inward (reasoning scaling), dynamically selecting sub-agents with varying granularity and count to extract evidence from pages. Finally, D2-ScaleAgent achieves logical closure over the evidence chain. Extensive experiments demonstrate that D2-ScaleAgent is effective on long and visually rich document benchmarks like MMLongBench-Doc, LongDocURL, etc.

AI.tldr: 提出D2-ScaleAgent，一个面向多模态RAG的双维度缩放框架，通过验证器驱动的动态路由循环，在检索和推理两个维度上根据查询难度动态扩展计算量，以解决视觉丰富长文档理解中证据不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于多智能体的多模态RAG方法依赖固定工作流，缺乏在测试时动态扩展计算能力的能力，常常导致检索证据不足或推理粒度不够，无法有效处理视觉丰富的长文档理解任务。
AI.method: D2-ScaleAgent的核心是一个由Verifier智能体驱动的动态路由循环，其中心是一个持续更新的证据库，作为智能体的动态工作记忆。当需要扩展检索时，智能体向外路由（检索缩放），将查询分解为属性并执行并行页面检索，随后进行自适应剪枝以保证证据覆盖的全面性；当需要细粒度推理时，智能体向内路由（推理缩放），动态选择不同粒度和数量的子智能体从页面中提取证据。最终通过证据链达到逻辑闭环。
AI.result: 在MMLongBench-Doc、LongDocURL等长视觉丰富文档基准上进行了大量实验，验证了D2-ScaleAgent的有效性。
AI.conclusion: D2-ScaleAgent通过双维度缩放范式（检索缩放与推理缩放）实现了测试时动态计算分配，有效增强了多模态RAG在长文档理解中的证据获取与推理能力。

title: ENAF: A Multi-Exit Network with an Adaptive Patch Fusion for Large Image Super Resolution
summary: To accelerate single image super-resolution (SISR) networks on large images (2K-8K), many recent approaches decompose an image into small patches and dynamically determine an execution path according to its difficulty (referred to as a dynamic network). To quantify the hardness of a patch, they mainly rely on a handcrafted assessment score, e.g., edge, which weakly associates a patch's texture with the computational complexity of a SISR model. To address the problem, we introduce ENAF - a dynamic network for SISR with an adaptive patch fusion. Built on top of a backbone, ENAF incorporates multiple early exits (EEs) to tackle the over-parameterized SISR model. More importantly, ENAF plugs a tiny network that estimates PSNR to associate data texture with a computation cost at an EE. Based on the scores, ENAF effectively assigns image patches to an exit, enhancing the quality-complexity trade-off. Extensive experiments on common datasets with popular SISR backbones demonstrate the effectiveness of ENAF in various settings. The source code is provided in https://github.com/nmduonggg/ENAF

AI.tldr: ENAF是一个用于单图像超分辨率（SISR）的动态网络，通过自适应补丁融合和多个早期退出机制，利用轻量级网络预测PSNR分数来关联图像纹理与计算成本，从而提升质量-复杂度权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有动态SISR网络依赖手工设计的评估分数（如边缘）来衡量图像块的难度，但这类分数与SISR模型的计算复杂度关联较弱，无法准确指导执行路径的分配，导致质量-复杂度权衡不佳。
AI.method: ENAF构建于骨干网络之上，集成多个早期退出（EEs）以解决SISR模型过参数化问题；核心创新是嵌入一个微型网络来估计PSNR分数，将数据纹理与EE处的计算成本关联起来。基于这些分数，ENAF将图像块有效分配给不同的退出点，并采用自适应补丁融合机制。
AI.result: 在常见数据集和流行SISR骨干网络上进行了大量实验，结果表明ENAF在多种设置下有效，验证了其在质量-复杂度权衡方面的优越性。
AI.conclusion: ENAF通过PSNR估计网络替代手工设计的复杂度评估指标，实现了更优的图像块动态分配策略，显著改善了SISR动态网络的性能-效率权衡。

title: LongRCA Bench: Diagnosing Responsible Roles and Root Causes in Long-Horizon Agent Failures
comment: 17 pages, 5 figures. Yunfei Zhang and Boyu Feng contributed equally. Changhua Pei is the corresponding author
summary: When a long-horizon agent execution fails, outcome-level evaluation reveals the unsuccessful result but not where the decisive error entered the trajectory. Developers must then inspect the full execution to identify the responsible role and localize the earliest decisive root-cause step. Existing failure-attribution benchmarks largely focus on shorter traces, leaving diagnosis across hundreds of recorded steps underexplored. We introduce LongRCA Bench, comprising 1,140 failed trajectories across five domains without injected errors. It provides independently scored human labels for the responsible role and earliest decisive root-cause step. The median trajectory contains 145 steps, and the strongest baseline reaches only 13.2% exact root-step accuracy. We further present Root-Cause Trajectory Attribution (RCTA), a training-free method that retrieves candidate error steps from segment summaries and traces them to available earlier handoff instructions. Using the same backbone, benchmark instances, and scoring protocol, RCTA reaches 51.1% responsible-role accuracy and 24.1% exact root-step accuracy. These results highlight the need to evaluate responsible-role attribution and exact root-step localization as separate targets in long-trajectory failure diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LongRCA Bench，一个包含1,140条失败轨迹、涵盖五个领域的长期agent故障归因基准，并介绍无训练的RCTA方法，在角色归因和根因步骤定位上分别达到51.1%和24.1%的准确率，显著超越最强基线（13.2%精确根因步骤准确率）。
AI.motivation: 长期agent执行失败时，结果级评估只能显示失败结果，无法定位轨迹中决定性错误发生的位置。现有故障归因基准主要关注较短轨迹，对数百步记录的诊断研究不足，开发者需要人工检查完整执行来找到负责角色和最早根因步骤，效率低下且缺乏系统化评估工具。
AI.method: 作者构建了LongRCA Bench数据集，包含1,140条无注入错误的失败轨迹，覆盖五个领域，每个轨迹提供独立评分的负责角色标签和最早决定性根因步骤标签，轨迹中位数长度为145步。同时提出Root-Cause Trajectory Attribution (RCTA)方法，这是一种无训练方法，通过从片段摘要中检索候选错误步骤，并回溯到早期可用的交接指令来定位根因。
AI.result: 最强的基线方法在精确根因步骤上仅达到13.2%的准确率。RCTA方法在使用相同骨干模型、基准实例和评分协议的情况下，达到51.1%的负责角色准确率和24.1%的精确根因步骤准确率，均显著优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果强调在长期轨迹故障诊断中，应将负责角色归因和精确根因步骤定位作为两个独立目标进行评估。LongRCA Bench揭示了现有方法在长轨迹故障诊断上的巨大差距，RCTA证明了无训练方法在该任务上的可行性，为该领域提供了新的评估基准和研究方向。

title: Every Expert Counts: ExactMoE for Memory-Efficient W4A16 Inference
summary: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models reduce arithmetic by activating only a small subset of experts per token, yet deployment still requires storing and moving the full expert bank. We present ExactMoE, an inference design that applies symmetric group-128 four-bit weight quantization only to routed experts, stores those experts in kernel-native MARLIN form in pinned host memory, and executes all selected experts through a configurable GPU-resident slot cache and fused grouped MoE kernels. The router, attention, embeddings, normalization layers, and language-model head remain in BF16. "Exact" refers to complete expert availability and an unchanged top-k routing procedure: no expert is pruned, substituted, or forced to execute on the CPU. It does not imply numerical identity with the BF16 model. On OLMoE-1B-7B-0924-Instruct, evaluated on a single NVIDIA L4, a 16-slot configuration reduces peak reserved GPU memory from 14.168 to 1.836 GiB (87.04%) while retaining 81.85% of BF16 decode throughput. A fully resident 64-slot configuration reaches 31.923 tokens/s versus 21.662 tokens/s for BF16 while reserving 4.061 GiB. Across 12,450 zero-shot multiple-choice questions, ExactMoE obtains 70.3534% normalized accuracy versus 70.8996% for BF16, retaining 99.23% of the baseline accuracy. In a matched 16-token ablation, fused grouped execution is 1.97x as fast as a sequential W4 reference. These results identify a practical memory-transfer-throughput frontier for complete-expert MoE inference.

AI.tldr: ExactMoE是一种面向稀疏MoE大语言模型的推理设计，通过对路由专家应用对称4比特权重量化、以MARLIN格式存储在主机内存中，并结合GPU驻留槽缓存和融合分组MoE内核，在不剪枝/替换/CPU执行任何专家的前提下大幅降低显存占用，同时保持约99%的精度和可比的吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 稀疏MoE模型虽然每次仅激活少量专家，但部署时仍需存储和搬运全部专家权重的完整专家库，导致显存开销巨大，成为推理部署的瓶颈。
AI.method: 仅对路由专家应用对称组128大小的4比特权重量化；将量化后的专家以内核原生的MARLIN格式存储在钉扎主机内存中；通过可配置的GPU驻留槽缓存和融合分组MoE内核执行所有选中的专家；路由器、注意力、嵌入、归一化和语言模型头保持BF16精度。Exact含义为完整的专家可用性和不改变的top-k路由过程（不剪枝、不替换、不强制CPU执行），但不保证与BF16模型在数值上完全一致。
AI.result: 在OLMoE-1B-7B-0924-Instruct和单张NVIDIA L4上：16槽配置将峰值保留GPU显存从14.168降至1.836 GiB（降低87.04%），同时保留81.85%的BF16解码吞吐量；64槽全驻留配置达到31.923 tokens/s（高于BF16的21.662 tokens/s），保留4.061 GiB显存；在12,450道零样本多项选择题上，归一化准确率70.3534%对比BF16的70.8996%，保留99.23%基线准确率；在匹配的16个token消融中，融合分组执行比顺序W4参考快1.97倍。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果揭示了完整专家MoE推理中显存-吞吐权衡的实用边界（memory-transfer-throughput frontier），证明在保证专家完整可用性和路由不变的前提下，通过量化与调度优化可以获得显著的显存节省与性能提升。

title: When Context Misleads: Intent-Guided Decoding for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves large language models by grounding generation in external evidence, but it also introduces a source trust problem: retrieved context may be useful, irrelevant, or even misleading. Existing RAG systems often apply a fixed trust policy toward retrieved evidence, which can either over-trust incorrect context or underuse context when the user explicitly asks for context-following behavior. Therefore, we propose Intent-Guided Decoding (IGD), a framework that arbitrates between retrieved context and parametric memory according to user intent. IGD uses answer-level filtering and token-level correction to steer the final decoding trajectory between retrieved context and parametric memory. We evaluate IGD on three faithful QA benchmarks and three factual-conflict benchmarks across five LLMs, IGD substantially improves factual recovery, achieving gains of up to 65.4 percentage points on factual-conflict benchmarks over Direct RAG, while preserving or improving strict context-following behavior, this findings highlight the importance of balancing factuality and faithfulness in RAG.

AI.tldr: 提出Intent-Guided Decoding (IGD)框架，根据用户意图在检索上下文和参数记忆之间进行仲裁，解决RAG系统中的来源信任问题，在事实冲突基准上相较Direct RAG最高提升65.4个百分点，同时保持或改善严格上下文遵循行为。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统对检索证据采用固定信任策略，要么过度信任错误上下文，要么在用户明确要求遵循上下文时未充分利用上下文，缺乏根据用户意图动态权衡检索上下文与参数记忆的能力。
AI.method: 提出Intent-Guided Decoding (IGD)框架：通过答案级过滤（answer-level filtering）和词元级校正（token-level correction）来引导最终解码轨迹，在检索上下文与参数记忆之间进行仲裁，核心是根据用户意图动态调整两者权重。
AI.result: 在三个忠实问答基准和三个事实冲突基准上、跨五个LLM进行评估，相较Direct RAG在事实冲突基准上获得最高65.4个百分点的事实恢复提升，同时保持或改善严格上下文遵循行为。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明在RAG中平衡事实性（factuality）与忠实性（faithfulness）至关重要，IGD通过意图引导的解码方式有效实现了这一平衡。

title: Decomposing Whole Slide Image Report Generation with Graph-Constrained Multiple Instance Learning Workflows
comment: Accepted at the MICCAI 2026 REG Challenge
summary: Whole-slide image (WSI) report generation requires recognizing spatially distributed pathological features and organizing them into a coherent diagnostic narrative. Although direct vision-to-text models can yield fluent reports, they obscure the contributions and failure modes of visual recognition, structured reasoning, and language generation. We propose a decomposed framework in which frozen Virchow2 tile embeddings are aggregated by multiple-instance learning (MIL) classification heads that answer organ-specific diagnostic questions. An organ-conditioned graph constrains the assembly of these answers into a structured reasoning chain, which a language model realizes as a pathology report. On the REG2026 held-out set of 2,028 slides, the proposed workflow achieved a chain-Jaccard score of 0.702. Performance fell to 0.420 without graph-based chain construction, 0.398 when the organ-specific graphs were replaced by a single organ-agnostic graph, and 0.371 when the language model constructed the chain freely from MIL predictions. Using the same report generator, graph-structured chains improved the report score from 0.330 to 0.495. On 350 external TCGA WSIs spanning the seven REG organs without fine-tuning, the expected organ graph was selected in 64.0% of cases and ranked among the top three in 86.6%. Providing the correct organ graph increased agreement with coarse TCGA primary-diagnosis labels from 61.8% to 92.6%, identifying organ routing as a main bottleneck under domain shift. Overall, organ-conditioned, graph-constrained chain assembly improves structured reasoning and report generation while enabling stage-specific error localization.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种分解式全切片图像（WSI）报告生成框架：冻结的Virchow2 tile嵌入由多个多实例学习（MIL）分类头聚合，回答器官特异性诊断问题；器官条件图约束答案组装为结构化推理链，最终由语言模型生成病理报告。在REG2026测试集上链Jaccard得分0.702，外部TCGA数据上器官图路由准确率64.0%，正确器官图可将与TCGA初级诊断标签的一致性从61.8%提升至92.6%。
AI.motivation: 直接视觉到文本的模型虽然能生成流畅的报告，但掩盖了视觉识别、结构化推理和语言生成各阶段的贡献与失败模式。研究者希望通过分解框架，实现阶段级别的错误定位与可解释性。
AI.method: 1) 使用冻结的Virchow2 tile嵌入；2) 多个MIL分类头聚合嵌入以回答器官特异性诊断问题；3) 器官条件图约束答案组装为结构化推理链；4) 语言模型将推理链实现为病理报告。通过消融实验验证图结构、器官条件图、以及推理链组装方式的作用。
AI.result: REG2026测试集（2,028张切片）上链Jaccard得分为0.702；无图约束为0.420，单一器官无关图替代为0.398，LM自由构建链为0.371。图结构化链将报告得分从0.330提升至0.495。外部TCGA数据（350张WSI）无需微调，预期器官图选择率64.0%，前三位86.6%；提供正确器官图将粗粒度初级诊断标签一致性从61.8%提升至92.6%。
AI.conclusion: 器官条件、图约束的推理链组装可显著提升结构化推理与报告生成性能，同时支持阶段级错误定位；器官路由是域转移下的主要瓶颈。

title: Demographic Injection in Medical Language Models under Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Prompts
summary: Clinical-AI guidance increasingly recommends prompting language models to reason with attention to diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI). We measure a side effect that misrepresents patients: a one-sentence DEI prompt appended to a medical question leads models to add patient demographic attributes (race, socioeconomic status, sex) the question never stated, in effect rewriting who the patient is. We call this demographic injection. Across 47 models, four medical benchmarks, and 376,000 responses scored by a validated model-judge pipeline, a single DEI prompt raises the injection rate from 0.7% to 33.1% (47x) in all 47 of 47 models, attributable to the equity content rather than to added length (18x above a length-matched control; p=1.4x10^-14). Most added content is a general population statement that leaves the answer unchanged, but a smaller subset attaches an attribute to the specific patient or changes the selected option (0.25-2.4% of responses, 99.8% toward the incorrect option), where the invented demographic changes the answer the model recommends. Phrasing scales the effect from 14% to 56%. DEI prompts are just one example of a more general mechanism. Any instruction that nudges how a model reasons can make it add unrequested details, including details about the patient. Flagged outputs are treated as model errors under study, not clinical guidance.

AI.tldr: 向医学问答中附加一句DEI提示词会导致语言模型向患者"注入"未提及的人口统计属性（种族、社会经济地位、性别），将注入率从0.7%提升至33.1%（47倍），且在全部47个模型中一致出现；部分注入内容会改变模型推荐的答案选项，且99.8%朝向错误选项。
AI.motivation: 临床AI指南日益推荐在提示词中加入DEI（多样性、公平与包容）相关内容以引导模型推理，但作者想评估这一做法是否存在被忽视的副作用——即模型可能在问答过程中虚构患者的人口统计特征，从而扭曲对患者身份的认知并影响诊断建议的正确性。
AI.method: 在47个语言模型、4个医学基准测试集上开展大规模系统评估，共采集376,000条模型响应，使用经过验证的模型评判（model-judge）流水线对响应进行标注；通过对比DEI提示与长度匹配的对照提示，区分效应来源；并对提示措辞、注入内容类型及对最终答案选择的影响进行了细粒度分析。
AI.result: 单句DEI提示将人口统计属性注入率从0.7%提升至33.1%（47倍），在所有47个模型中一致出现；效应归因于DEI内容本身而非提示长度（比长度匹配对照组高18倍，p=1.4×10^-14）。大部分注入内容为一般性人群陈述且不改变答案，但0.25-2.4%的响应将属性绑定到具体患者或改变所选选项，其中99.8%朝向错误选项；提示措辞可使效应在14%到56%之间波动。
AI.conclusion: DEI提示词会导致模型系统性"重写患者身份"——注入问题中从未提及的人口统计属性，并在小但显著的子集中将答案引向错误选项。这揭示了更一般的机制：任何引导模型推理方式的指令都可能诱使其添加未经要求的细节，包括关于患者的细节。该现象被研究视为模型错误而非临床指南的缺陷。

title: Look Before You Lift: Visual and Quantitative Diagnostics for Topological Deep Learning
summary: Topological deep learning (TDL) methods rely on lifting raw data into higher-order discrete domains such as simplicial complexes, cell complexes, and hypergraphs. In practice, this lifting step is often treated as a black box: practitioners select a lifting and then tune architectures, with limited visibility into whether the induced higher-order connectivity is meaningful for the downstream task. To address this missing diagnostic layer, we propose a visualization technique called TopoExplorer that leverages the strictly augmented Hasse graph form of topological datasets for exploratory data analysis. For the first time, practitioners can easily visualize the incidence- and adjacency-based neighborhoods that define the lifted dataset, as well as read off key graph metrics that describe its structural and feature landscape. Via an extensive set of experiments across many datasets and liftings, we show that several of these metrics correlate with downstream model performance, suggesting they can help inform TDL preprocessing design. Our perspective reframes the TDL workflow from lift-train to lift-look-design-train, enabling more principled, interpretable, and efficient model development. TopoExplorer is hosted at https://topoexplorer.pagekite.me, and its source code is available at github.com/geometric-intelligence/topoexplorer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TopoExplorer，一种利用严格增广Hasse图形式可视化拓扑深度学习（TDL）中数据提升步骤的可视化技术，帮助从业者在训练前检查提升后的高阶连通性结构，并将TDL工作流从"提升-训练"重构为"提升-观察-设计-训练"。
AI.motivation: TDL方法在将原始数据提升为单纯复形、胞腔复形和超图等高阶离散域时，提升步骤常被视为黑盒操作，从业者无法直观判断所产生的高阶连通性对下游任务是否有意义，缺乏诊断层来指导预处理设计。
AI.method: 提出TopoExplorer可视化技术，利用拓扑数据集的严格增广Hasse图形式，首次使从业者能够可视化定义提升数据集的关联（incidence）和邻接（adjacency）邻居结构，并读取描述其结构与特征景观的关键图度量指标，通过大量数据集和多种提升方式的实验验证这些度量与下游模型性能的相关性。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和多种提升方式上的广泛实验中，多项图度量指标与下游模型性能存在相关性，表明这些度量能够帮助指导TDL预处理的架构设计，实现更可解释和高效的模型开发。
AI.conclusion: TopoExplorer将TDL工作流从传统的"提升-训练"重定义为"提升-观察-设计-训练"，使拓扑深度学习模型的开发更加有原则、可解释且高效，并提供了在线平台和开源代码供社区使用。

title: STAGE: Controlled Objective Admission for Multi-Preference LLM Alignment
summary: Multi-preference alignment is often framed as scalarization: combine reward dimensions, then optimize. This leaves a temporal decision underspecified: when should each preference dimension enter policy optimization? We propose \methodname, a stability-guided active-set controller for controlled objective admission. \methodname starts from a small active set, retains admitted objectives, and expands when reward-deviation gates indicate low recent deviation or a patience budget is exhausted. A probing phase estimates a hard-to-easy order, and adaptive weighting emphasizes underperforming active dimensions. Automatic evaluations with 15 training preferences and 16 held-out benchmark columns show that \methodname obtains higher averages than simultaneous scalarization and shared-budget adapted baselines. Component ablations and expansion dynamics further support cumulative retention, gated admission, and probing-derived ordering as useful design choices in this setting. These results position objective-entry timing as a concrete control variable in reward-vector RLHF.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于稳定性引导的自适应集合控制器，用于多偏好对齐中受控目标准入，通过在小规模激活集中开始训练、动态扩展目标并引入探针阶段估计难易顺序，从而将目标进入策略优化的时机作为可调控变量，在训练偏好和保留测试集上均优于同时标量化及共享预算的基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的多偏好对齐通常将问题简化为标量化（先组合奖励维度再优化），但这忽略了时间维度上的决策：每个偏好维度应在何时进入策略优化过程？这种时间层面的欠规范可能导致训练不稳定或偏好覆盖不佳。
AI.method: 提出\methodname，一个稳定性引导的自适应激活集控制器，包含三个关键机制：（1）从较小的激活集开始，保留已准入的目标，利用奖励偏差门控（reward-deviation gates）判断何时扩展，同时设有耐心预算（patience budget）兜底；（2）通过探针阶段（probing phase）估计偏好从难到易的顺序；（3）自适应权重机制侧重强调表现不佳的激活维度。
AI.result: 使用15个训练偏好和16个保留测试基准列进行自动评估，\methodname在平均值上优于同时标量化和共享预算适配基线。组件消融实验和扩展动态分析进一步验证了累积保留、门控准入和探针导出排序在该设定下均为有效的设计选择。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，目标进入策略优化的时机（objective-entry timing）可作为奖励向量RLHF中的一个具体可控变量，为多偏好对齐提供了新的控制维度。

title: A Multi-Annotator Study of Segmentation Noise and Uncertainty in Turbid Underwater Images
comment: accepted at ECCVW'26 - 2nd Workshop on Marine Vision
summary: Label uncertainty and annotator disagreement are common challenges in the field of computer vision, yet their study has largely been confined to the medical domain or to generic image-recognition datasets. Underwater datasets are particularly susceptible to these issues due to the need for domain expertise, degraded visibility conditions, and the inherent difficulty of establishing reliable ground truth in inaccessible environments. Despite these challenges, annotation uncertainty in underwater imagery remains largely unexplored. In this work, we present the first systematic multi-annotator study of segmentation in real underwater scenes, with over 100 participants, and across varying, controlled levels of turbidity. We show that underwater datasets face many of the same annotation challenges as other vision tasks, while turbidity introduces additional systematic errors. We further investigate the main factors driving label noise and explore ways to improve annotation quality in turbid underwater environments, including privileged information, individual effort and annotator ensembles. All (meta-) data collected in this study will be available on the project page: https://vap.aau.dk/tubcertainty

AI.tldr: 该论文首次对真实水下场景的分割标注进行了系统性多标注者研究（超过100名参与者，在不同受控浊度水平下），发现水下数据集面临与其他视觉任务类似的标注挑战，而浊度会引入额外的系统性误差。论文还探讨了标注噪声的主要驱动因素，并研究了利用特权信息、个体努力和标注者集成来提高浑浊水下环境标注质量的方法。
AI.motivation: 标签不确定性和标注者分歧是计算机视觉中的常见挑战，但相关研究主要集中在医学领域或通用图像识别数据集上。水下数据集因需要领域专业知识、能见度退化以及难以建立可靠真值等特点，尤其容易受到标注不确定性的影响，然而这一领域此前几乎未被探索。
AI.method: 作者开展了首个针对真实水下场景分割的多标注者系统研究，招募超过100名参与者在不同受控浊度水平下进行分割标注。研究系统分析了标注不确定性来源，并探索了三种改善标注质量的途径：特权信息（借用额外辅助信息）、个体努力（标注者的投入程度）以及标注者集成（多标注者组合策略）。
AI.result: 研究结果显示，水下数据集确实面临与其他视觉任务相似的标注挑战，同时浊度会引入额外的系统性标注误差。论文识别了驱动标签噪声的主要因素，并验证了特权信息、个体努力和标注者集成等方法在浑浊水下环境中提升标注质量的可行性。所有收集的数据和元数据将在项目页面上公开。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了水下场景标注不确定性研究的空白，表明浊度是水下图像标注噪声的重要系统性来源，并通过多种策略展示了改善浑浊环境下标注质量的可能性。同时，公开的数据集和元数据为后续研究提供了基础资源。

title: Towards Standardized Evaluation in Automated Domain Modeling: Introducing a Benchmark
summary: Domain modeling plays an essential role in domain-driven design, capturing essential entities and their relationships within a specific domain. Despite advancements in automated domain modeling, the absence of standardized benchmarks has hindered the comparative assessment of existing approaches. This paper introduces a benchmark designed to address this gap. The benchmark combines the 45-record Golden UML Modelset (Verbruggen et al., 2025) on Zenodo, as distributed by the Text2UML project of Calamo, Mecella, and Snoeck (Calamo et al., 2025), with the 8-record reference archive of Chen et al. (Chen et al., 2023a,b), enabling the evaluation of automated domain modeling approaches across different levels of complexity and scale. Given a natural language description, the task is to generate a corresponding domain model. For each description, a reference domain model is provided as ground truth. A metric is used to compare the generated domain model with the corresponding ground-truth model. To demonstrate the utility of the benchmark, we evaluate multiple automated domain modeling approaches, including heuristic rule-based methods and LLM-driven strategies. In accordance with the FAIR4RS recommendations (Chue Hong et al., 2022), the benchmark is provided as a research artifact to encourage reuse and support future research on automated domain modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个用于自动化领域建模评估的标准基准，整合了Golden UML Modelset和Chen等人参考档案共53条记录，提供自然语言描述到领域模型的生成任务及相应的ground-truth模型和评估指标，并作为符合FAIR4RS规范的研究工件发布。
AI.motivation: 尽管领域建模在领域驱动设计中至关重要，且自动化领域建模方法已有诸多进展，但缺乏标准化基准阻碍了不同方法的比较评估。作者旨在通过构建统一基准来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 基准整合了两个数据源：Zenodo上Text2UML项目分发的45条Golden UML Modelset，以及Chen等人（2023a,b）的8条参考档案。任务设定为：给定自然语言描述，生成对应领域模型；每条描述配有ground-truth参考模型，并通过指标比较生成模型与参考模型的相似度。为验证基准有效性，评估了包括启发式规则方法和LLM驱动策略在内的多种自动化建模方法。基准按照FAIR4RS建议作为研究工件发布。
AI.result: 该基准支持在不同复杂度和规模层面对自动化领域建模方法进行评估，并已通过多种方法（启发式规则法和LLM驱动策略）的评测证明了其实用性。
AI.conclusion: 该基准填补了自动化领域建模评估缺乏标准化基准的空白，以FAIR4RS兼容的研究工件形式发布，旨在鼓励复用并支持未来自动化领域建模的研究。

title: Towards a theory of inference-time alignment with unknown rewards
summary: Generative model alignment has received broad interest, and significant progress has been made in supervised fine-tuning and inference-time computation. Yet, alignment has remained poorly understood from a statistical learning perspective. We formulate inference-time alignment as a weak-to-strong learning problem, where a reference policy (weak learner) is assumed to be fairly good and the goal is to produce a strong learner that predicts a good response at test time with arbitrarily high probability. Our problem is formulated as learning from scratch --- everything is learned from data rather than assuming access to a good reward estimate, and thus differs from the existing inference-time alignment theory. Our model shares similarity to the recent work of arXiv:2510.15464, where for each prompt, there could be multiple good responses. Our definition of the alignment learnability follows the PAC learning principle. We introduce a novel combinatorial dimension of the reward class which we call the alignment dimension, and show that it completely characterizes the alignment learnability --- a reward class is alignment learnable if and only if its alignment dimension is finite. The core of our learning procedure works by invoking the ordinary one-inclusion graph algorithm to run a tournament over all pairs of label sets satisfying that neither is a subset of the other. We believe our results might shed light on establishing a complete theoretical understanding towards alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文从统计学习角度形式化推理时对齐问题为弱到强学习问题，提出了对齐维度（alignment dimension）这一组合维度，并证明它完全刻画了对齐可学习性（有限时有穷当且仅当可学习）。学习过程通过调用普通的一包含图算法在标签集对上进行锦标赛（tournament）实现。
AI.motivation: 生成模型对齐在监督微调和推理时计算方面取得了显著进展，但从统计学习视角看，对齐问题仍缺乏理解。现有推理时对齐理论假设可以获得好的奖励估计，而本文希望从零学习（一切从数据中学得），不假设可获取奖励估计，从而填补理论空白。
AI.method: 将推理时对齐形式化为弱到强学习问题：参考策略（弱学习器）假设已相当好，目标是产生一个强学习器，使其在测试时以任意高概率预测好的响应。问题建模为从数据中学习（learning from scratch），每个提示可能有多个好的响应。定义了对齐可学习性（遵循PAC学习原则），引入奖励类的对齐维度（alignment dimension），并证明其完全刻画对齐可学习性。核心学习过程是调用普通的一包含图算法在"彼此互不为子集"的标签集对之间运行锦标赛。
AI.result: 证明了对齐维度完全刻画了对齐可学习性：奖励类是对齐可学习的当且仅当其对应对齐维度有穷。这给出了对齐问题的完整统计刻画。
AI.conclusion: 该结果可能为建立对齐的完整理论理解提供基础，将生成模型对齐从经验层面推进到严格的统计学习理论层面。

title: Ask, Condition or Abstain: Reinforcement Learning for Missing-Premise Reasoning
summary: Answer-only reinforcement learning (RL) trains reasoning models to solve fully specified problems, but many realistic queries omit a premise needed for a unique answer. In this setting, the useful response is not always refusal: the model should ask for the missing premise, condition its answer on the unknown quantity, or abstain when no informative conditional response is available. We present \emph{Ask-Condition-Abstain Reinforcement Learning} (ACA-RL), a data-augmented RL framework for this setting. Its reasoning-graph-guided pipeline converts well-posed problems into missing-premise training instances with localized gap annotations; ACA-RL then trains on these instances with a structured reward over five observable response behaviors. We also introduce the \emph{Missing-Premise Benchmark} (MPB), a 274-instance human-verified benchmark spanning mathematical, logical, and real-world word problems. Across Qwen3 and Llama models, ACA-RL consistently improves on MPB while preserving competitive performance on well-posed reasoning tasks. Together with the released code, MPB, and training data, this work supports a new mission for NLP evaluation: measuring whether models can recognize when a task is underdetermined and handle uncertainty, not only whether they can answer fully specified questions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ACA-RL（Ask-Condition-Abstain强化学习）框架，用于训练推理模型在缺少前提条件的欠定问题中正确应对：询问缺失前提、基于未知量给出条件回答或弃权。同时引入人类验证的Missing-Premise Benchmark（MPB）基准，实验表明ACA-RL在Qwen3和Llama模型上持续提升MPB性能，同时保持完整推理任务上的竞争力。
AI.motivation: 传统答案式强化学习仅训练模型解决完全指定（well-posed）的问题，但现实查询中常缺少必要前提，导致问题欠定（underdetermined）。在此场景下，模型不应总是拒绝回答，而应学会询问缺失前提、给出条件性答案或在无法提供有意义回答时弃权。现有方法缺乏对此类行为的系统性训练与评估。
AI.method: ACA-RL采用推理图引导的数据增强流程：将良构问题转换为缺失前提的训练实例，并带有局部间隙标注。然后使用结构化奖励信号，对五种可观测响应行为进行训练，包括询问、条件回答、弃权等策略。同时构建MPB基准，包含274个人类验证的跨数学、逻辑及现实世界文字题实例。
AI.result: 在Qwen3和Llama系列模型上，ACA-RL在MPB基准上持续带来改进，同时在良构推理任务上保持有竞争力的性能。论文还发布了代码、MPB基准和训练数据。
AI.conclusion: ACA-RL证明可以通过数据增强的强化学习有效训练模型识别欠定问题并恰当处理不确定性。这项工作拓展了NLP评估的使命：不仅要衡量模型回答完全指定问题的能力，还应衡量其识别任务欠定性和处理不确定性的能力。

title: JoLT: Joint Latent Trajectories for Context-Guided High-Resolution Tiled Generation
comment: 25 pages, 10 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at the AI4VA Workshop at ECCV 2026. Project page: https://obvious-research.github.io/jolt/
summary: Although text-to-image generative models produce impressive results, they struggle to generate densely detailed, high-resolution (HR) images. Current literature addresses this issue with a low-to-high-resolution approach. First, a low-resolution (LR) image is generated. Then, an upsampled version is generated using the LR image as an additional cue. In this paper, we present Joint Latent Trajectories (JoLT). To generate an image, JoLT uses two streams that jointly denoise LR and HR latent images at each sampling step. The LR latent controls the overall layout, while the HR latent controls the details. We interconnect both branches to jointly integrate their information. We extensively validate our method, demonstrating its advantages over competing baselines. The resulting images are not only richly detailed but also visually pleasing, opening new avenues for artistic creation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Joint Latent Trajectories (JoLT)方法，通过双流并行去噪低分辨率和高分辨率潜变量来生成高清图像，在每一步采样中低分辨率潜变量控制整体布局、高分辨率潜变量控制细节，两分支互连融合信息，生成细节丰富且美观的高分辨率图像。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像生成模型虽能产生令人印象深刻的结果，但在生成细节密集的高分辨率图像方面存在困难。现有方法采用低到高分辨率的两阶段策略（先生成低分辨率图像，再以其为线索生成上采样版本），但这种方式无法在采样过程中充分联合优化两个分辨率层次的信息。
AI.method: JoLT采用双流架构，在每一步采样时同时去噪低分辨率（LR）和高分辨率（HR）的潜变量图像。LR潜变量负责控制整体布局，HR潜变量负责控制细节。两个分支之间建立互连，在每一步联合集成两个分辨率的互补信息，实现端到端的联合去噪过程。
AI.result: 通过大量实验验证，JoLT在生成图像质量上优于竞争基线方法，生成的图像不仅细节丰富，而且视觉上更令人愉悦，展现了在艺术创作方面的应用潜力。
AI.conclusion: JoLT通过联合潜变量轨迹的双流去噪策略，有效解决了高分辨率文本到图像生成中细节与布局兼顾的难题，为高分辨率图像生成和艺术创作开辟了新途径。

title: Decentralized Federated Learning for Heterogeneous Multi-Task Semantic Communication
comment: 17 pages, 9 figures, Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Communications
summary: Collaborative training in distributed semantic communication (DSC) networks typically relies on decentralized federated learning (DFL). However, pushing topology-agnostic aggregation into heterogeneous, multi-task environments creates a fundamental bottleneck: it drives negative transfer and overconsensus bias (OCB). This paper introduces a personalized DSC framework that cuts off this cross-task interference. At the node level, a policy-driven multi-path routing mechanism separates task-specific features from shared representations to preserve local fidelity. Across the network, we deploy a "communicationwhile- aggregation" protocol. It calibrates a column-stochastic consensus matrix using task affinities. This limits the system to absorbing complementary knowledge while actively blocking mismatched parameter updates. To bound the convergence, we derive a unified Lyapunov drift analysis. We reveal a strict Ushaped trade-off: deeper topological mixing reduces variance but amplifies structural OCB. Resolving this tension yields a closed-form expression for the optimal aggregation depth. We evaluate the proposed framework on NYU-v2, where the results reveal a clear trade-off between insufficient aggregation and excessive topological mixing. At the analytically derived optimal aggregation depth, our method achieves a 4.77% global relative improvement over the no-aggregation baseline and outperforms decentralized FedAvg, FedAMP, and heuristic max aggregation. We further evaluate the framework on Taskonomy and imperfect wireless links to examine the effects of network-size variation and wireless-link reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向分布式语义通信（DSC）网络的个性化联邦学习框架，通过列随机共识矩阵的拓扑感知校准与策略驱动的多路径路由机制，消除跨任务干扰（负迁移与过度共识偏差），并推导出最优聚合深度的闭式解。
AI.motivation: 现有的分布式语义通信网络依赖去中心化联邦学习（DFL）进行协同训练，但将拓扑无关的聚合策略应用于异构多任务环境会产生根本性瓶颈：导致负迁移（negative transfer）和过度共识偏差（OCB），从而损害局部任务保真度与全局性能。
AI.method: （1）节点层面：采用策略驱动的多路径路由机制，将任务特定特征与共享表示分离，保留局部保真度；（2）网络层面：部署"通信-聚合"协同协议，利用任务亲和度校准列随机共识矩阵，仅吸收互补知识并阻断失配参数更新；（3）理论层面：推导统一的Lyapunov漂移分析，揭示更深的拓扑混合降低方差但放大OCB的U形权衡，并解析求解最优聚合深度。
AI.result: 在NYU-v2数据集上，在解析所得最优聚合深度处，方法较无聚合基线实现4.77%的全局相对提升，并优于去中心化FedAvg、FedAMP及启发式最大聚合；在Taskonomy及不完美无线链路下进一步验证了网络规模变化与无线链路可靠性的影响。
AI.conclusion: 工作表明，深度拓扑混合并非越深越好，存在一个U形权衡的最优聚合深度；通过任务亲和度感知的共识矩阵校准与特征分离路由，可有效阻断异构多任务场景下的负面跨任务干扰，实现个性化与全局协作的平衡。

title: FAST-DeepONet: Factor-Augmented Branch Representations for High-Dimensional PDE Inputs in the Small-Sample Regime
summary: Deep operator networks can become statistically unstable when partial differential equation inputs are observed at thousands of strongly correlated sensors but only a small number of operator samples is available. We introduce FAST-DeepONet, a branch representation combining a fixed spectral path with a regularized projection of the orthogonal residual, in which the directional penalty acts on the effective residual map after each of its rows is normalized. On Navier--Stokes flow a plain DeepONet degrades from $0.0394$ to $0.1556$ mean relative $L_2$ error as the branch grows from $129$ to $8193$ coordinates, while FAST-DeepONet stays near $0.04$, so the sensor grid can be refined without a statistical penalty. Across independent test sets for Navier--Stokes flow, Darcy flow, and signed terminal wavefield prediction it lowers mean relative $L_2$ error by $4.7\%$ to $37.0\%$ with three to seven times fewer trainable parameters. A spectral-only branch sharing the same basis separates the two paths: the fixed spectral path carries the improvement on Navier--Stokes and Darcy, while terminal wave prediction requires the residual path together with its directional penalty. FAST-DeepONet targets coordinate-query architectures and trains on solution values alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FAST-DeepONet，一种用于深度算子网络的稳定分支表示方法，通过将固定谱路径与正则化的正交残差投影相结合，解决了当PDE输入在数千个强相关传感器上观测但仅有少量算子样本时的统计不稳定性问题。在Navier-Stokes流中，当分支坐标从129增至8193时，普通DeepONet误差从0.0394恶化到0.1556，而FAST-DeepONet保持在0.04附近，且参数量减少3至7倍，误差降低4.7%至37.0%。
AI.motivation: 深度算子网络在处理强相关传感器观测的PDE输入时，当传感器数量庞大（数千个）而算子样本数量有限时会产生统计不稳定性。随着分支网络坐标维度增加，普通DeepONet的性能显著退化，这限制了传感器网格细化的可能性。
AI.method: FAST-DeepONet采用一种新颖的分支表示结构，包含两部分：一是固定的谱路径，二是正交残差的正则化投影。其关键创新在于方向性惩罚作用在经过每行归一化的有效残差映射上，实现了对高维强相关输入的正则化处理。该方法面向坐标查询架构（coordinate-query architectures），仅使用解值进行训练。
AI.result: 在Navier-Stokes流上，普通DeepONet在分支坐标从129增长到8193时误差从0.0394退化至0.1556，而FAST-DeepONet保持在0.04左右。在Navier-Stokes流、Darcy流和符号终端波场预测三个独立测试集上，平均相对L2误差降低4.7%至37.0%，同时所需可训练参数减少3至7倍。消融实验表明，谱路径主导了Navier-Stokes和Darcy的改进，而终端波预测需要残差路径及其方向性惩罚。
AI.conclusion: FAST-DeepONet有效地解决了DeepONet在高维强相关传感器输入下的统计不稳定问题，使得传感器网格可以无统计代价地细化，同时减少参数需求并提高精度。该方法的固定谱路径与残差路径分离设计揭示了不同路径在不同问题中的差异化作用，为后续深度算子网络的正则化设计提供了新思路。

title: BabelSteering: Multilingual Safety Alignment via English Steering Vectors
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are deployed globally in high-stakes settings, yet most safety research and alignment efforts remain concentrated on English. Thus, users interacting with LLMs in other languages may encounter weaker safeguards despite relying on the same systems for similarly sensitive tasks. In this work, we investigate whether safety signals learned from a high-resource language, like English, can improve multilingual safety. We propose BabelSteering, an activation steering method that acts as a lightweight inference- time intervention, using refusal directions derived from English safety supervision to generalize across languages. Our evaluation includes eight languages and jointly measures refusal of harmful requests, over-refusal, and general task utility. The results show that BabelSteering increases the refusal of harmful requests across languages, with only a marginal to no reduction in task utility but with some increase in refusal of pseudo-harmful prompts. For example, for Gemma 7B, we see an average increase in the refusal of harmful prompts across languages of 11 percentage points (pp), with individual languages like Bengali seeing an increase of 17 pp, with no loss of utility on Global MMLU, while pseudo-harmful refusals increase by 13 pp on average. We also introduce a multilingual translation-and-evaluation pipeline to facilitate future work on cross-lingual safety interventions. Overall, our findings suggest that activation steering may provide a practical, low- cost mechanism for extending English-derived safety signals to other languages. Warning: this paper contains examples with unsafe content

AI.tldr: 本文提出BabelSteering，一种基于激活引导（activation steering）的轻量级推理时干预方法，利用从英语安全监督中推导出的拒答方向，将安全信号泛化到其他语言。实验覆盖八种语言，结果显示该方法能显著提升对有害请求的拒答率（如Gemma 7B平均提升11个百分点），同时几乎不损失任务实用性，但会略微增加对伪有害提示的过度拒答。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型安全研究和对齐工作主要集中在英语上，导致用户以其他语言交互时可能面临较弱的安全防护，尽管他们依赖相同的系统处理同样敏感的任务。研究者希望探索是否可以将从高资源语言（如英语）中学到的安全信号推广到多语言场景。
AI.method: 提出BabelSteering方法，这是一种激活引导技术，在推理时作为轻量级干预手段，利用从英语安全监督中推导出的拒绝方向（refusal directions），将其泛化到不同语言。同时引入了一个多语言翻译与评估流水线（multilingual translation-and-evaluation pipeline）。评估涵盖八种语言，联合衡量有害请求拒答率、过度拒答率以及通用任务实用性。
AI.result: BabelSteering在多种语言中均提升了有害请求的拒答率，对任务实用性几乎没有或只有微小降低，但伪有害提示的拒答率有所上升。以Gemma 7B为例，各语言有害提示拒答率平均提升11个百分点，其中孟加拉语提升达17个百分点，Global MMLU上无实用性损失，而伪有害拒答率平均增加13个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 激活引导可能提供一种实用、低成本的方式，将源自英语的安全信号扩展到其他语言，从而改善多语言场景下的大语言模型安全性。

title: CBX-Bench: A Human-Aligned MLLM Council for Benchmarking Concept Bottleneck Model Explanations
summary: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) are designed to make visual classification interpretable by expressing predictions through human-understandable concepts. Although interpretability is the central motivation for CBMs, they are still largely evaluated as predictive models by downstream classification accuracy, supplemented by isolated qualitative examples. This highlights a pressing need for quantitative measures, a challenge complicated by the infeasibility of ground-truth concept annotation at scale and the open nature of concept lists due to a lack of consensus. To fill this gap, we develop a multimodal large language model (MLLM) council that, given an image and its CBM explanation, produces an explanation quality score. To ground and validate the council, we first conduct a human study to establish a ground-truth reference for CBM explanation quality: for an image, annotators compare explanations from two of LF-CBM, VLG-CBM, and CBM-Suite and choose the more useful one, or mark them as equally good or equally bad, yielding 2700 judgments over 900 image-comparison items on CUB-200, ImageNet-100, and Places365. Against this human reference, our five-model council, consisting of open-weight MLLMs, recovers over 70% of strict human preference rankings, rising to 83% on items where human annotators unanimously agree. Building on this validated council, we introduce CBX-Bench, a public benchmark and leaderboard: authors of new CBMs can submit their model's explanations, and CBX-Bench scores them with the council and maintains dataset-level rankings of explanation quality. CBX-Bench thus provides a human-aligned, scalable evaluation of CBM explanations beyond accuracy and isolated qualitative examples. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/meric-karadag/cbx-bench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CBX-Bench，一个基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）评议会的人类对齐、可扩展的概念瓶颈模型（CBM）解释质量评估基准。通过人类研究建立2700个判断的地面真值参考，验证了五模型评议会能恢复超过70%的人类严格偏好排序（人类一致同意的项目上达83%），并在此基础上推出公开的基准排行榜。
AI.motivation: CBM的设计初衷是使视觉分类可解释，但其评估仍主要依赖下游分类准确率和孤立的定性示例。由于大规模概念标注的不可行性以及概念列表缺乏共识，亟需定量衡量CBM解释质量的指标，以弥补这一评估空白。
AI.method: 构建一个由五个开源权重的多模态大语言模型组成的评议会（council），对给定图像及其CBM解释生成质量评分。首先开展人类研究，在CUB-200、ImageNet-100和Places365三个数据集上，让标注者对比LF-CBM、VLG-CBM和CBM-Suite中任意两个模型的解释并判断更优、同等优或同等差，收集900个图像对比项共2700个判断作为地面真值参考，用于校准和验证评议会。
AI.result: 五模型评议会能恢复超过70%的人类严格偏好排序，在人类标注者一致同意的项目上恢复率提升至83%。基于此验证，建立CBX-Bench公开基准和排行榜，允许新CBM作者提交模型解释并获得评分和数据集级别的解释质量排名。
AI.conclusion: CBX-Bench提供了超越准确率和孤立定性示例的、与人类判断对齐的、可扩展的CBM解释质量评估方案，填补了CBM解释定量评估的空白。

title: VibeWorlding: Can Multimodal Agents Construct 3D Open Worlds End-to-End?
summary: Constructing an interactive 3D open world from a user query is important. However, existing methods are primarily evaluated on idealized, simple queries, making it difficult to systematically analyze and compare how multimodal agents understand user intent, use 3D tools, and reason over textual and visual 3D world information. To this end, we propose VibeWorlding, a unified framework for benchmarking and training vibe worlding agents: a multimodal agent that can autonomously infer user intent, plan scene layout, invoke 3D tools, and reflect on the multimodal feedback in a multi-turn agent-environment interaction process. To achieve this, we first build VWE-BENCH, a benchmark of 2,616 high-quality 3D assets, 323 human-annotated seed 3D worlds, and 6,828 reverse-synthesized multimodal user queries, split into verified queries with ground-truth and unverified queries with carefully designed rubrics. Moreover, we develop VibeWorlding-Gym, a joint multimodal RL post-training framework that integrates (1) a sandbox environment unifying asset retrieval, editing, and image rendering as MCP tools, and (2) a rubric-based verifier that combines physical feasibility and intent fulfillment verification, supporting both fair model evaluation and scalable multimodal RL reward service. Our experiments show that current frontier MLLMs are far from solving the vibe worlding agent task, with even GPT-5.5 and Qwen3.8-Max reaching below 60% success rate, and trace the bottleneck to precise 3D world editing. We further find that RL training can ease this weakness and enable open-source MLLMs to even surpass closed-source frontiers: our VibeWorlder-8B is comparable to frontier MLLMs, while our flagship VibeWorlder-30B-A3B attains the best overall Pass@1 among all evaluated models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VibeWorlding，一个用于基准测试和训练"氛围世界智能体"（vibe worlding agent）的统一框架。该智能体是多模态智能体，能够在多轮智能体-环境交互中自主推断用户意图、规划场景布局、调用3D工具并反思多模态反馈。框架包含VWE-BENCH基准（2,616个高质量3D资产，323个人工标注种子世界，6,828个反向合成的多模态用户查询）和VibeWorlding-Gym联合多模态RL后训练框架（集成沙盒环境和基于rubric的验证器）。实验表明当前前沿MLLM在该任务上成功率不足60%，而RL训练使开源模型超越闭源模型，VibeWorlder-30B-A3B取得最佳Pass@1。
AI.motivation: 现有的交互式3D开放世界构建方法主要在理想化、简单查询上进行评估，难以系统性地分析和比较多模态智能体在理解用户意图、使用3D工具以及基于文本和视觉3D世界信息进行推理方面的能力。作者希望构建一个统一框架来解决这一评估和训练缺口。
AI.method: 包含两大核心组件：(1) VWE-BENCH基准，包含大规模3D资产、人工标注的种子世界以及反向合成的多模态用户查询，分为带ground-truth的验证查询和带rubric的非验证查询；(2) VibeWorlding-Gym，一个联合多模态强化学习后训练框架，将资产检索、编辑和图像渲染集成为MCP工具构建沙盒环境，并采用结合物理可行性和意图满足验证的rubric-based验证器，支持公平模型评估和可扩展的多模态RL奖励服务。
AI.result: 实验表明当前前沿多模态大语言模型（包括GPT-5.5和Qwen3.8-Max）在该任务上成功率均低于60%，瓶颈在于精确的3D世界编辑能力。RL训练能显著缓解这一弱点，使开源模型超越闭源模型：VibeWorlder-8B与前沿MLLM相当，而VibeWorlder-30B-A3B在所有评估模型中取得最佳整体Pass@1。
AI.conclusion: VibeWorlding为"氛围世界智能体"这一新型多模态智能体任务提供了统一的基准测试和训练框架，证明当前MLLM在该复杂3D交互任务上仍存在显著差距，同时展示了RL后训练在提升开源模型3D编辑能力方面的巨大潜力。

title: Invariant Pretraining for Robust Code Representations
summary: Encoder-based code representation models remain widely deployed for discriminative tasks such as clone detection and code classification, where their small size and low inference cost are decisive. Their robustness, however, is fragile: under invariant programs, semantically equivalent code written in different syntactic forms, learned representations degrade substantially even though program behavior is unchanged. We present an empirical study of this robustness gap across four encoder baselines, two downstream tasks, and four datasets, together with a minimal code-only continued pretraining recipe that closes much of it. Our method, invariant pretraining (InvPT), applies semantic-preserving transformations to the corpus and combines masked language modeling with multi-positive supervised contrastive learning that treats all augmentations of the same source function as positives, mixing self-contrast pairs (same code, different masks) with invariant-contrast pairs (transformed code) for positives of varying difficulty. Unlike prior contrastive code encoders, InvPT does not require paired natural-language data. Across our evaluation, InvPT improves robustness on transformed test sets by up to 11 percentage points on clone detection and 19 on code classification while matching or improving standard accuracy, and our ablations isolate multi-positive invariant contrast as the main source of the gains. Our aim is not a new objective but a careful measurement of where encoder robustness breaks and how far a simple, code-only recipe can recover it.

AI.tldr: 本文研究表明基于编码器的代码表示模型在判别性任务上被广泛使用，但在语义等价但语法形式不同的程序上表现严重退化。作者提出了InvPT（不变预训练），一种仅使用代码的最小化持续预训练方法，通过语义保持变换结合掩码语言建模和多正样本监督对比学习，在不依赖自然语言配对数据的情况下，将变换测试集上的鲁棒性在克隆检测上提升最多11个百分点、在代码分类上提升19个百分点，同时保持或提升了标准准确率。
AI.motivation: 编码器式代码表示模型因其较小的体积和低推理成本在克隆检测、代码分类等判别任务中广泛部署，但其在不变程序（语义等价但句法形式不同的代码）上的表示会显著退化。现有对比式代码编码器大多依赖自然语言配对数据，而作者旨在探索仅使用代码本身、不依赖额外NL数据的情况下，能否通过一个简单的持续预训练方案弥补这一鲁棒性差距。
AI.method: InvPT对语料库施加语义保持的变换，并将掩码语言建模（MLM）与多正样本监督对比学习相结合。在该对比学习中，同一源函数的所有增广变体都被视为正样本，混合了两种难度不同的正样本对：自对比对（同一代码、不同掩码）和不变对比对（变换后的代码）。该方法不需要配对的自然语言数据。
AI.result: 在四个编码器基线、两个下游任务和四个数据集上的评估表明，InvPT在变换测试集上将克隆检测的鲁棒性提升最多11个百分点，代码分类提升最多19个百分点，同时匹配或提升了标准准确率。消融实验表明多正样本不变对比学习是主要贡献来源。
AI.conclusion: 作者的目的不是提出一个全新的目标函数，而是对编码器鲁棒性失效的位置进行仔细测量，并展示一个简单、仅依赖代码的预训练方案能在多大程度上恢复该鲁棒性，结果表明该配方能有效地弥合大部分鲁棒性差距。

title: Palmyra x6 Technical Report: An Agentic, Tool-Use Model Post-Trained via Anchored Supervised Fine-Tuning
summary: Palmyra x6 is a large language model optimized for use with enterprise-oriented agentic tasks. The model was built by post-training a Mixture-of-Experts base model with Anchored Supervised Fine-Tuning on a compact corpus of verified, synthetic tool-use trajectories, optimized with a Muon + Adam hybrid. The recipe is deliberately conservative and deliberately controlled: 626 trajectories, a single epoch, a low learning rate, and a KL anchor to the frozen base. The model shows substantial gains over the previous default model for Writer Agent, and compares favorably with several recent models on public benchmarks, scoring the highest on BFCL Core at $0.785$ and posts the highest six-benchmark mean of the cohort. Furthermore, the model has shown itself to be competitive or leading relative to comparators in our bias and safety evaluations.

AI.tldr: Palmyra x6 是一个面向企业级智能体任务的混合专家大语言模型，通过锚定监督微调在仅626条合成工具调用轨迹上训练，以Muon+Adam混合优化器优化，在BFCL Core基准上取得0.785的最高分，并在六基准平均分、偏差与安全性评估中均表现领先。
AI.motivation: 企业级智能体任务对大型语言模型提出了专门需求，作者旨在开发一个专门为智能体工具调用场景优化的大语言模型，同时探索一种保守、可控且高效的后训练方法，用极少量高质量数据获得显著的性能提升。
AI.method: 采用混合专家基础模型进行后训练；使用锚定监督微调（Anchored Supervised Fine-Tuning）在紧凑的626条已验证合成工具使用轨迹语料上训练；优化器为Muon + Adam混合方案；训练策略刻意保守且可控：仅单epoch、低学习率、并以冻结基础模型作为KL锚点。
AI.result: 在Writer Agent任务上相比之前的默认模型有显著提升；在公共基准上与近期多个模型相比表现优异，在BFCL Core上取得最高分0.785；在六个基准的平均分中位居队列最高；在偏差和安全性评估中相对比较对象具有竞争力或领先。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，通过保守、可控的微调配方和极少量高质量合成轨迹数据，即可在智能体工具调用场景中实现显著的性能提升，同时保持甚至改善偏差与安全性表现。

title: ArtLang: Structured Language-to-Kinematics Grounding for Articulated 3D Actuation
summary: Articulated-object reconstructions recover explicit geometry and kinematics, but their parts often remain semantically anonymous and must be controlled through part indices and numerical joint parameters. We present ArtLang, a framework for open-vocabulary language control of persistent reconstructed articulated assets. ArtLang represents an asset as a semantic-kinematic articulation graph and augments its surface with language features and graph-constrained motion. Open-vocabulary proposals are bound to reconstructed parts while allowing uncertain parts to remain unnamed. A typed parser converts a command into a directive graph containing referring expressions, actions, magnitudes, reference frames, and relations. We then solve a global graph-to-graph grounding problem that jointly reasons about semantic, spatial, relational, and kinematic compatibility, with support for null assignments and abstention under ambiguity. Accepted directives are converted into continuous joint targets within the observed motion range and executed through forward kinematics. Experiments on synthetic reconstructions, mesh-based assets, and real captures demonstrate reliable language grounding and continuous articulated control across repeated parts, spatial references, relational commands, and ambiguous instructions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ArtLang框架，实现开放词汇的自然语言控制持久重建的铰接式物体资产。通过语义-运动学结合图、语言特征和全局图到图的对齐，支持在重复部件、空间参考、关系命令和模糊指令下的可靠语言接地与连续铰接控制。
AI.motivation: 现有铰接式物体重建虽然能恢复几何和运动学信息，但其部件缺乏语义身份，只能通过部件索引和数值关节参数进行控制，缺乏直观的、基于自然语言的人机交互方式。
AI.method: ArtLang将资产表示为语义-运动学结合图（semantic-kinematic articulation graph），在表面增强语言特征和图的约束运动。通过类型化解析器将命令转换为包含指代表达式、动作、幅度、参考坐标系和关系的指令图，然后求解全局图到图（graph-to-graph）的接地问题，联合推理语义、空间、关系和运动学兼容性，支持空赋值和歧义下的弃权机制。接受后的指令转换为观测运动范围内的连续关节目标，通过正向运动学执行。
AI.result: 在合成重建、网格资产和真实捕捉数据上的实验表明，该方法在重复部件、空间参考、关系命令和模糊指令等场景下均能实现可靠的语言接地和连续铰接控制。
AI.conclusion: ArtLang通过语义-运动学结合图与全局图匹配策略，实现了对重建铰接式物体的开放词汇语言控制，有效解决了部件语义匿名化问题，并在多种资产类型上验证了其鲁棒性和实用价值。

title: $D^{2}R^{2}$: Discrete Diffusion with Regulation Reinforcement for Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction
summary: Predicting single-cell transcriptomic responses to genetic perturbations is central to functional genomics and virtual-cell modeling. Existing approaches, however, typically predict an entire expression profile as a whole, leaving the order in which individual gene responses are generated unmodeled. To address this problem, we introduce \textbf{$D^{2}R^{2}$} (\textbf{D}iscrete \textbf{D}iffusion with \textbf{R}egulation \textbf{R}einforcement), which reformulates perturbation prediction as regulation-guided gene-wise progressive generation. A Masked Discrete Diffusion Model represents expression as ordinal tokens and reconstructs a fully masked profile step by step, allowing generated gene responses to condition those that remain masked. A Regulatory Policy Module initializes the generation policy from a gene regulatory network inferred from control cells and adapts it to the perturbation and current partially generated state. Then, group-relative policy optimization refines only the ordering policy using final perturbation-effect agreement as reward. Across Norman19 and VCC-H1, $D^{2}R^{2}$ achieves the best performance on all five metrics on Norman19 and remains competitive on H1. Controlled ablations holding the generator and generation budget fixed show that biological-prior ordering improves over random ordering and is more reliable than uncertainty-based heuristics, whereas reversing the biological-prior ordering degrades every metric. Biological analyses further show that the refined policy prioritizes regulatory genes early while promoting perturbation-specific transcription factors and responsive genes. These results establish gene generation order as an effective, controllable, and biologically interpretable dimension of single-cell perturbation prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出D²R²框架，将单细胞转录组扰动预测从"整体预测表达谱"重构为"调控引导的基因逐次生成"任务，通过掩码离散扩散模型逐步重构表达谱，并利用调控策略模块与组相对策略优化来学习基因生成顺序，在Norman19和VCC-H1数据集上取得最佳或具有竞争力的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有单细胞扰动预测方法通常将整个表达谱作为一个整体进行预测，忽略了单个基因响应之间被生成的先后顺序关系，即基因生成顺序这一维度未被显式建模。作者认为基因表达之间存在内在调控层级，合理利用调控先验来安排生成顺序有望提升预测效果和可解释性。
AI.method: D²R²包含三个核心组件：(1) 掩码离散扩散模型，将表达量表示为有序token，从完全掩码状态逐步重构表达谱，使已生成的基因响应能够条件化影响尚未生成的基因；(2) 调控策略模块，从对照细胞推断基因调控网络作为初始生成策略，并根据扰动条件和当前部分生成状态进行自适应调整；(3) 组相对策略优化（Group-relative Policy Optimization），仅优化排序策略，以最终扰动效应一致性作为奖励信号。通过受控消融实验验证生物先验排序优于随机排序和不确定性启发式方法。
AI.result: 在Norman19数据集上，D²R²在所有五项指标上均取得最佳性能；在VCC-H1数据集上保持竞争力。消融实验表明生物先验排序优于随机排序及基于不确定性的启发式排序，反转生物先验排序会使所有指标退化。生物学分析显示，精炼后的策略优先生成调控基因，并促进扰动特异性转录因子和响应性基因的生成。
AI.conclusion: 基因生成顺序是单细胞扰动预测中一个有效、可控且具有生物学可解释性的新维度。D²R²通过将调控先验与策略优化相结合，不仅提升了预测性能，还赋予了生成过程生物学意义，为虚拟细胞建模提供了新的思路。

title: SAGA: Structure-Attended Generative Action Embedding Model that encodes Multi-Surface User Action Sequences
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures. Accepted to ACM RecSys 2026 Context-Aware Recommender Systems (CARS) workshop
summary: Prior embedding models for sequential recommendation typically operate within a homogeneous action space, limiting their ability to capture cross-surface behavioral signals spanning distinct behavioral domains. We present SAGA, a generative action embedding model that encodes multi-surface user interaction sequences across a Financial Service organization's ecosystems, from checkout, peer-to-peer (P2P) transactions, in-app engagement, email to account actions, into a unified user representation for downstream recommendation tasks. Central to SAGA is a per-field tokenization schema that decomposes each action event into multiple field-level tokens (e.g. product, interaction, surface), enabling field-level attention and per-field training objectives that fused single-token approaches cannot support. Through an offline ablation study on loss formulation, tokenization granularity and training data scope, we isolate the contribution of each design choice. A downstream model integrated with SAGA-generated user embeddings delivers the strongest overall click and conversion lift across diverse downstream touchpoints, compared to all ablated and alternative architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAGA，一种生成式动作嵌入模型，将金融科技组织生态系统中跨多个表面（结算、P2P交易、应用内互动、邮件、账户操作）的用户交互序列编码为统一用户表示，用于下游推荐任务。
