AI.motivation: 现有序列推荐嵌入模型通常在单一同质动作空间中操作，无法捕获跨越不同行为领域的跨表面行为信号，限制了对用户多维度行为的理解和下游推荐性能。
AI.method: SAGA采用逐字段（per-field）分词方案，将每个动作事件分解为多个字段级token（如产品、交互、表面），支持字段级注意力和逐字段训练目标，克服了单token方法无法支持的限制。通过离线消融实验分别评估损失函数设计、分词粒度和训练数据范围对模型性能的贡献。
AI.result: 集成SAGA生成用户嵌入的下游模型在不同下游触点上取得了最强的点击率和转化率提升，优于所有消融变体及备选架构。
AI.conclusion: 字段级分词与逐字段训练目标的结合是SAGA有效性的关键，统一的用户表示能够跨多种交互表面提供稳健的推荐性能增益。

title: When Do Explanations Help In-Context Learning? A Comparative Study of Natural Language Explanation Types and Faithfulness
summary: Natural language explanations (NLEs) are increasingly used as inputs, for example, as few-shot rationales that influence model behavior in in-context learning (ICL). However, it remains unclear how different types of NLEs compare in their effects on downstream model performance in explanation-augmented prompting. Therefore, we provide a comparative evaluation across six benchmarks and four instruction-tuned models, studying how NLE source (human-written when available, self-generated explanations, generated by an external LLM) and NLE selection (random vs faithfulness-based filtering) affect downstream utility of NLEs when used in ICL settings. Our extensive evaluation shows that, on classification-style benchmarks, adding NLEs to few-shot prompts often improves accuracy over few-shot prompting without explanations; among NLE sources, externally generated LLM-NLEs often provide strong downstream utility and remain competitive with human rationales where both are available, whereas self-NLEs are more sensitive to the selection strategy. On math reasoning, the effects are more model- and source-dependent. We further show that faithfulness-based selection of self-NLEs yields small average gains overall, but can improve or reduce performance depending on the metric, task, and model. Different faithfulness metrics can disagree substantially, affecting which self-NLE examples are selected and their downstream predictive utility. Robustness tests with randomly swapped and out-of-distribution rationales indicate partial robustness, suggesting that semantic alignment contributes to performance gains. Overall, our results provide insights for selecting and reporting explanations that influence model behavior in practical prompting pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文在6个基准和4个指令微调模型上系统性比较了不同类型的自然语言解释（NLE）在上下文学习（ICL）中作为少样本推理提示的影响，发现外部LLM生成的解释通常具有较强且稳定的下游效用，人类编写的解释在可用时仍具竞争力，而自生成解释对选择策略更敏感；基于忠实度的筛选在整体上仅带来小幅平均增益且因指标、任务和模型而异。
AI.motivation: 尽管自然语言解释（NLE）越来越多地被用作上下文学习中的少样本推理来影响模型行为，但不同类型的NLE（来源不同、选择策略不同）对下游模型性能的影响尚不清楚，缺乏系统性的比较评估。
AI.method: 在6个基准数据集和4个指令微调模型上进行大规模比较评估，从两个维度展开：（1）NLE来源：人类编写、自生成、外部LLM生成；（2）NLE选择：随机选择 vs 基于忠实度（faithfulness）的过滤。此外还进行了随机交换和分布外（OOD）推理的鲁棒性测试。
AI.result: 在分类类基准上，添加NLE通常能提升少样本提示的准确率；外部LLM生成的NLE在多数情况下提供强下游效用且与人类编写的解释竞争力相当；自生成NLE对选择策略更敏感。在数学推理任务上效果更依赖模型和来源。基于忠实度的自NLE选择平均带来小幅增益，但效果因指标、任务和模型而异；不同忠实度指标之间的分歧较大，影响所选示例及其预测效用。鲁棒性测试表明语义对齐对性能增益有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 研究为实际提示流水线中选择和报告影响模型行为的解释提供了实用见解：在分类任务中优先考虑外部LLM生成的NLE或人类解释，在自生成NLE场景下需谨慎选择忠实度指标，因为不同指标的选择效果差异显著。

title: HistReNeRF: Historic Image Relocalisation within Contemporary Neural Radiance Field Reconstructions
summary: Relocalising archival photographs within a contemporary scene model is challenging because historic and modern views can differ in photographic appearance, visible objects, and spatial layout. Therefore, we present HistReNeRF, a framework that estimates the 6-DoF pose of a historic photograph by matching adapted DINOv2 patch features to candidate rays sampled from a contemporary Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) reconstruction. The continuous representation of a NeRF provides a queryable scene interface from which candidate rays can be sampled and matched, enabling domain adaptation between historic photography and contemporary images directly in the feature representation used for localisation. We evaluate embedding-space-based domain adaptation against pixel-space methods on a new cross-temporal dataset comprising 10,545 contemporary street-level images and 230 archival photographs from three European landmarks. Embedding-space adaptation reduces translation and rotation errors by an average of 11% and 16%, respectively, across the three scenes. These results show that neural scene relocalisation provides a natural interface for feature-space adaptation, reducing cross-temporal appearance shift without modifying the query image. Code and dataset at https://github.com/ARTUROLab/HistReNeRF.

AI.tldr: HistReNeRF是一种框架，通过将适配后的DINOv2补丁特征与从当代NeRF重建中采样的候选射线匹配，估计历史照片的6-DoF位姿。在三个欧洲地标的跨时间数据集（10,545张当代图像和230张档案照片）上，嵌入空间域自适应相比像素空间方法平均降低平移误差11%和旋转误差16%。
AI.motivation: 历史档案照片在当代场景模型中的重新定位具有挑战性，因为历史与现代视图在摄影外观、可见物体和空间布局上存在显著差异。现有方法难以直接处理这种跨时间的外观域差异。
AI.method: HistReNeRF利用NeRF的连续场景表示作为可查询的接口，从当代重建中采样候选射线，并与历史照片中提取的适配DINOv2补丁特征进行匹配。直接在特征表示空间中进行域自适应，而非在像素空间处理。
AI.result: 在包含10,545张当代街景图像和230张来自三个欧洲地标的历史照片的新跨时间数据集上，嵌入空间域自适应相比像素空间方法平均降低了11%的平移误差和16%的旋转误差。
AI.conclusion: 神经场景重新定位为特征空间自适应提供了自然接口，能够有效减少跨时间外观偏移而无需修改查询图像本身。

title: ReasonCast: Agentic Demand Forecasting with Selective Semantic Reasoning
summary:
Demand forecasting increasingly requires combining two complementary sources of information: historical sales reveal recurring numerical dynamics, while future promotions, holidays, price changes, and platform interventions provide forward-looking knowledge. Existing text-enhanced forecasting methods often encode such context into generic representations and fuse it uniformly with time-series features, without explicitly distinguishing which semantic effects are forecast-relevant or how they should modify future dynamics.
  We introduce ReasonCast, a structured semantic intervention framework that translates event knowledge into forecast-specific operations. An agent examines the event context, the no-text forecast, and its uncertainty to determine whether textual reasoning is needed. Rather than injecting free-form text, ReasonCast represents event knowledge through structured fields describing event relevance, demand direction, temporal shape, amplitude, and peak intensity. These fields interact selectively with temporal components of a time-series foundation model. An additive path corrects local trends and temporal shapes, while a multiplicative path captures event-driven level shifts.
  ReasonCast introduces a forecast-grounded post-training curriculum. Schema SFT establishes semantic fields; semantic-field RL calibrates direction, shape, amplitude, and peak judgments; and forecast-utility RL evaluates semantic interventions through a frozen forecaster, aligning reasoning outputs with marginal forecast improvement. ReasonCast lowers WMAPE by 3.29, 1.25, and 0.47 percentage points on holiday-sensitive categories, mega-sale-sensitive categories, and M5 event windows, respectively. On stable-sales periods, indiscriminate semantic intervention increases WMAPE by 1.68 percentage points, whereas suppressing unnecessary intervention preserves the numerical backbone.

AI.tldr: ReasonCast是一个结构化语义干预框架，通过将事件知识转化为预测特定的操作字段（相关性、方向、时间形状、幅度、峰值强度），与时间序列基础模型的选择性组件交互（加法路径修正局部趋势，乘法路径捕捉水平偏移），并引入预测锚定的后训练课程（Schema SFT、语义场RL、预测效用RL），在多个敏感类别上降低WMAPE，同时通过抑制不必要干预保护稳定期性能。
AI.motivation: 现有文本增强预测方法将事件上下文编码为通用表示并与时间序列特征均匀融合，未能明确区分哪些语义效应与预测相关，也没有指定这些语义应如何修改未来的动态。这导致预测模型无法有效利用前瞻性事件知识（促销、节假日、价格变化、平台干预）。
AI.method: ReasonCast包含三个核心设计：(1) 一个智能体（agent）评估事件上下文、无文本预测及其不确定性，决定是否需要文本推理；(2) 将事件知识表示为结构化字段（相关性、需求方向、时间形状、幅度、峰值强度），这些字段选择性地与时间序列基础模型的时序组件交互，其中加法路径修正局部趋势和形状，乘法路径捕捉事件驱动的水平变化；(3) 引入预测锚定的后训练课程：Schema SFT建立语义字段，语义字段RL校准方向和形状判断，预测效用RL通过冻结预测器评估语义干预，将推理输出与边际预测改进对齐。
AI.result: 在节假日敏感类别上WMAPE降低3.29个百分点，在大促敏感类别上降低1.25个百分点，在M5事件窗口上降低0.47个百分点。在稳定销售期，无条件语义干预会使WMAPE增加1.68个百分点，而抑制不必要干预可保留数值骨干的性能。
AI.conclusion: ReasonCast通过结构化的语义干预而非自由文本注入，实现了事件知识对预测的精准、选择性修正。其"是否需要干预"的判断机制是关键——在需要时利用语义信息提升敏感期预测精度，在稳定期则抑制不必要的干预以避免干扰数值预测骨干。

title: Detecting Money Laundering in Rwandan Mobile Money: A Machine Learning Framework
summary: Mobile money has widened financial access across Sub-Saharan Africa and enlarged the surface for money-laundering and terrorism-financing (ML/TF) activity in ecosystems dominated by high-volume, low-value transactions. Rwanda is a case in point: several million active mobile-money users, telecom-led wallets on the MTN and Airtel networks, and a Financial Intelligence Centre (FIC) supervising transaction streams whose scale exceeds static rule-based monitoring. This paper develops and evaluates a transaction-monitoring framework aligned to the Rwandan AML/CFT regime under (i) extreme class imbalance (~0.1% prevalence), (ii) scarce and delayed labels, and (iii) bounded investigator capacity. Using SAML-D, a synthetic dataset of 9,504,852 transactions with 17 laundering typologies, we engineer account-centric behavioural features (rolling velocity, net-flow directionality, counterparty diversity, burstiness) and benchmark supervised classifiers (Logistic Regression, Random Forest, LightGBM), unsupervised anomaly detectors (Isolation Forest, Local Outlier Factor), a dense autoencoder, and a late-fusion meta-learner. Evaluation is operational: PR-AUC, recall at a calibrated ~90%-precision point, recall at top-K%, and alerts per 10,000. On the chronologically held-out test period, LightGBM attains PR-AUC = 0.0469, capturing 64 laundering cases at precision ~0.89 with 0.51 alerts per 10,000; the fusion stacker reaches PR-AUC = 0.0477 at precision ~0.91 and 0.46 alerts per 10,000, recovering 59 true positives. We map score bands to Rwanda-relevant analyst workflows and STR/SAR escalation, and outline a staged path from synthetic prototyping to real-data validation with the National Bank of Rwanda and FIC. The contribution is operational: a governance-aware pipeline and evaluation protocol calibrated to the constraints of an African mobile-money regulator, not a new algorithm.

AI.tldr: 本文面向卢旺达反洗钱/反恐融资（AML/CFT）监管场景，开发并评估了一个交易监控框架，应对极端类别不平衡（~0.1%正样本率）、标签稀缺延迟和调查人员能力受限三大约束。基于9,504,852笔交易的SAML-D合成数据集（含17种洗钱类型），构建账户中心行为特征并基准测试多种监督分类器、无监督异常检测器、自编码器及融合元学习器。在时间隔离测试集上，LightGBM达到PR-AUC 0.0469、~0.89精确率下捕获64个洗钱案例（0.51告警/万笔）；融合栈式模型达PR-AUC 0.0477、~0.91精确率、0.46告警/万笔并恢复59个真阳性。文章贡献在于运营层面：面向非洲移动货币监管约束的治理感知流水线与评估协议。
AI.motivation: 移动货币在撒哈拉以南非洲扩大了金融可及性，但也扩大了洗钱和恐怖主义融资（ML/TF）风险面，形成高量低值交易主导的生态系统。卢旺达作为典型案例，拥有数百万活跃移动货币用户，其交易规模已超出静态规则监控能力，亟需适应极端类别不平衡、标签稀缺延迟和调查能力有限等现实约束的AML/CFT交易监控方案。
AI.method: 使用SAML-D合成数据集（9,504,852笔交易、17种洗钱类型学），工程化账户中心行为特征（滚动速度、净流向、对手方多样性、突发性）；基准测试五种模型：监督分类器（Logistic Regression、Random Forest、LightGBM）、无监督异常检测器（Isolation Forest、Local Outlier Factor）、密集自编码器及晚期融合元学习器；采用运营导向评估指标：PR-AUC、校准~90%精确率点的召回率、top-K%召回率及每万笔告警数；在时间隔离的保留测试集上验证，并将评分带映射到卢旺达分析师工作流和STR/SAR升级流程。
AI.result: 在时间隔离测试集上，LightGBM达到PR-AUC=0.0469，在精确率~0.89下捕获64个洗钱案例，告警率0.51/万笔；融合栈式模型达到PR-AUC=0.0477，精确率~0.91，告警率0.46/万笔，恢复59个真阳性。两种模型均实现低告警率下的高精确率，满足运营约束。
AI.conclusion: 本文的贡献是运营性的而非算法创新：提供了一个治理感知的交易监控流水线和面向非洲移动货币监管者约束校准的评估协议，并勾勒了从合成原型到与卢旺达国家银行和FIC进行真实数据验证的分阶段路径。

title: Toward Better Assessment of LLMs' Performance in Clinical Error Detection
comment: Accepted at Machine Learning for Healthcare (MLHC) 2026; to appear in Proceedings of Machine Learning Research (PMLR), Vol. 340
summary: Automated detection of errors in clinical documentation is a promising application of large language models (LLMs), yet decisions to deploy such models rest on benchmarks that evaluate each clinical note in isolation. Error-detection benchmarks are typically constructed by injecting errors into notes, such that each erroneous note has a natural counterpart. Aggregate discriminative metrics (e.g., balanced accuracy or F1) do not exploit this structure. We show that this omission is consequential. In particular, evaluating 15 diverse LLMs on 4 standardized clinical error-detection test sets across 3 languages, we find that 13 of 15 models fall below the level of random pairwise discrimination, even while achieving F1 scores that standard practice would read as moderate. We also observe that the underlying bias patterns differ across languages: the same model can default to "no error" on one language and over-flag errors on another. To diagnose where discrimination breaks down, we further introduce a procedure to score the evidence models cite in their outputs. We find that while models consistently locate error-relevant content, they fail to produce the corresponding correct verdict on the clean counterpart. Finally, we show that F1 and pairwise accuracy are driven in opposite directions by the same underlying bias, so that ranking models by F1 may systematically promote the weakest discriminators. For safety-critical clinical NLP applications, we advocate for supplementing aggregate metrics with paired evaluations in benchmark reporting. Code and analysis scripts are available at https://github.com/healthylaife/paired-clinical-eval.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了临床文档错误检测基准评估中的一个关键缺陷：传统聚合判别指标（如F1）未利用配对数据结构（错误注记与其干净版本成对出现）。通过对15个LLM在3种语言的4个标准测试集上的评估，发现13/15的模型在配对判别上低于随机水平，尽管F1分数看似中等。作者提出用配对评估补充聚合指标，并引入证据评分程序诊断判别失败的原因。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在临床文档错误自动检测中的应用前景广阔，但部署决策依赖的基准仅单独评估每份临床笔记，未利用"错误注记有对应干净版本"这一配对结构。作者证明这一遗漏有严重后果：仅用F1等聚合指标会误导模型选择，甚至可能系统性推广判别能力最差的模型，这对安全关键的临床NLP应用构成风险。
AI.method: 该研究在3种语言的4个标准化临床错误检测测试集上评估了15个多样化LLM。核心方法包括：(1) 引入配对判别评估（而非仅聚合指标），要求模型区分错误注记与其干净对应版本；(2) 开发证据评分程序，量化模型输出中引用证据的质量；(3) 分析跨语言的偏差模式差异；(4) 检验F1与配对准确率之间的关系。
AI.result: 主要发现：13/15的模型在随机配对判别水平以下，即便F1分数在标准实践中被视为中等；偏差模式因语言而异（同一模型可在一种语言默认"无错误"而在另一种语言过度标记错误）；模型能一致定位错误相关内容，但在干净对应版本上无法给出正确的"无错误"判定；F1和配对准确率受相同偏差驱动但方向相反，导致按F1排序可能系统性偏爱最差的判别器。
AI.conclusion: 对于安全关键的临床NLP应用，建议在基准报告中以配对评估补充聚合指标，以避免基于误导性F1分数做出危险的部署决策。代码和分析脚本已公开。

title: NumerosityVLM: A Cognitively Inspired Benchmark for Interpreting Numerosity Representations in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong performance on high-level multimodal tasks, yet numerosity perception, a cognitive ability that emerges in human infants before language acquisition, remains poorly understood in current models, as existing counting benchmarks entangle numerosity with correlated visual factors. We introduce a cognitively inspired diagnostic benchmark, NumerosityVLM, comprising 10,800 synthetic images across six controlled conditions. The benchmark orthogonally manipulates object size, spatial arrangement, and numerosity, while progressively ablating texture, shape, and color. Evaluating seven VLMs in a zero-shot setting, multi-factor analysis reveals that model architecture explains the largest proportion of performance variance (partial $ω^{2}=0.325$), far exceeding visual conditions. Layer-wise probing further shows that linearly separable numerosity signals consistently emerge at early stages of the vision encoder, while performance differences across evaluated models are primarily associated with the language model component. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/fuy3/NumerosityVLM-Benchmark, and https://huggingface.co/datasets/fuy3/NumerosityVLM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NumerosityVLM基准，一个基于认知启发的诊断性基准，包含10,800张合成图像，在六个受控条件下正交操纵物体大小、空间排列和数量，同时逐步消融纹理、形状和颜色。通过评估七个VLM的零样本表现，发现模型架构是性能差异的最大解释因素（偏ω²=0.325），远超视觉条件；逐层探针实验表明可线性分离的数量信号在视觉编码器早期阶段稳定出现，而模型间性能差异主要与语言模型组件相关。
AI.motivation: 人类婴儿在语言习得之前就具备数量感知这一认知能力，但现有视觉-语言模型（VLM）的数量感知能力尚未被充分理解，因为现有的计数基准将数量与相关的视觉因素（如物体大小、空间排列等）纠缠在一起，无法准确评估模型真正的数量感知能力。
AI.method: 构建NumerosityVLM基准：包含10,800张合成图像，设置六个受控条件，正交操纵物体大小、空间排列和数量三个因素，并逐步消融纹理、形状和颜色。在七个VLM上进行零样本评估，采用多因素分析（partial omega-squared）量化各因素对性能方差的贡献比例，并通过逐层探针（layer-wise probing）分析数量信号在模型内部表征中的出现位置和可分离性。
AI.result: 模型架构解释了最大比例的性能方差（偏ω²=0.325），远超过视觉条件的影响；逐层探针显示数量信号在视觉编码器的早期阶段就已线性可分离，而不同模型间的性能差异主要归因于语言模型组件。
AI.conclusion: 数量感知能力在VLM中受架构选择影响远大于视觉输入条件，且该能力的瓶颈主要在语言模型部分而非视觉编码器，这为理解VLM数量感知机制和针对性改进模型架构提供了重要启示。

title: Divergent-Convergent Reasoning: Scaling Test-Time Compute through Structured Solution Synthesis
summary: Test-time compute can substantially improve Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning performance, yet how and when additional compute helps remains poorly understood. We study Divergent-Convergent Reasoning (DCR), a simple two-phase primitive consisting of an exploration phase that generates multiple candidate solutions followed by a convergent reconciliation phase. We present three core results. First, we show that even a single reconciliation step can reliably amplify correct minority reports: across datasets, DCR often recovers the correct answer when correct exploration outputs are in the minority, a regime where majority voting fails. Second, we introduce recursive DCR, an autoregressive reconciliation system that iteratively analyzes disagreements and allocates additional test-time compute. Recursive DCR achieves higher accuracy than fixed-compute baselines-reaching 93.3% on AIME 2024 and 92.0% on AIME 2025-while using roughly 27% less compute on average, demonstrating that attentive resource allocation is superior to uniform scaling. Third, we analyze disagreement among exploration outputs via a simple, training-free dispersion metric. Dispersion reveals a structured relationship between disagreement and test-time gains: in regimes where DCR is effective, higher disagreement among exploration outputs is associated with larger accuracy improvements from reconciliation. Together, these results show that disagreement, often viewed as noise, can be systematically exploited to improve test-time reasoning and reveal emerging scaling laws for agentic LLM systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发散-收敛推理（DCR）这一两阶段测试时计算扩展范式，证明了单次收敛步骤即可放大正确少数派输出，并提出了递归DCR实现自适应计算分配，在AIME 2024/2025上分别达93.3%和92.0%准确率且平均节省27%计算量。同时引入无需训练的离散度指标揭示分歧与测试时收益的结构化关系。
AI.motivation: 测试时计算能显著提升LLM推理性能，但额外计算如何以及何时起作用仍缺乏深入理解。现有方法如多数投票在正确输出仅占少数时失效，需要探索更有效的利用多样性和分歧的策略。
AI.method: 提出发散-收敛推理（DCR）两阶段基本原语：探索阶段生成多个候选解，随后进行收敛调和。在此基础上引入递归DCR，通过自回归方式迭代分析分歧并分配额外测试时计算。同时提出免训练的离散度（dispersion）度量指标来分析探索输出的分歧程度。
AI.result: 三个核心发现：（1）单次调和步骤即可在多数投票失败的正确少数派输出场景下恢复正确答案；（2）递归DCR在AIME 2024达93.3%、AIME 2025达92.0%，相比固定计算基线平均节省约27%计算量；（3）离散度指标揭示分歧度与调和带来的准确率提升之间存在正相关关系。
AI.conclusion: 分歧不应被视为噪声而可被系统性利用以提升测试时推理性能，这揭示了智能体LLM系统的新兴扩展规律，表明注意力式资源分配优于均匀扩展。

title: Not All Attention Is Equal: A Quantitative Survey of the EEI Trade-off
comment: 53 pages, 8 figures, 16 tables. Code and analysis artifacts: https://github.com/Nixon-H/not-all-attention-is-equal
summary: Attention mechanisms have driven machine learning for a decade, from neural machine translation to language models that do general-purpose reasoning. This survey covers four connected threads: their formulation for sequence-to-sequence tasks, adaptation to computer vision, efficiency innovations that address the quadratic bottleneck, and advances in interpretability. We define three criteria: efficiency, expressiveness, and interpretability, and compare twenty-one methods using an EEI scoring framework. Scores come from a single rater with an assumed +/-1-point perturbation range. A deterministic Monte Carlo analysis with 200,000 samples shows that, under this perturbation model, rank changes of more than one position occur in 67-70% of samples on average. A rank-matched null model reproduces a similar stability profile, so the results support coarse tier-level comparisons rather than fine-grained rankings. The survey traces attention from Bahdanau-Luong alignment through the Transformer and into vision architectures. It reviews fixed and learned sparse attention, linear attention, IO-aware exact algorithms including FlashAttention, and state-space alternatives including Mamba. It also covers induction heads, superposition, and the attention-SSM duality. We further provide a structured narrative review, a benchmark synthesis with cross-study caveats, a five-problem research gap analysis, and a 2015-2026 evolution timeline. We conclude by framing attention research as an expansion of the efficiency-expressiveness-interpretability frontier and identifying future directions including unified efficiency benchmarks, learned routing for hybrid architectures, length generalization, and scalable mechanistic interpretability.

AI.tldr: 本文档是一篇关于注意力机制（Attention Mechanisms）的综合性综述，追踪其从序列到序列任务、计算机视觉适配、效率创新到可解释性四条主线的发展脉络，并提出效率-表达力-可解释性（EEI）三准则框架，对21种方法进行评分比较，通过确定性蒙特卡洛分析（20万样本）揭示了细粒度排序的不稳定性，支持粗粒度层级比较。
AI.motivation: 注意力机制在过去十年推动了机器学习的重大进步，从神经机器翻译到通用推理语言模型。然而，该领域方法众多、发展迅速，缺乏一个统一的框架来系统梳理其发展脉络、比较不同方法的优劣，并为未来研究方向提供指引。
AI.method: 采用EEI评分框架（效率、表达力、可解释性三个准则），由单一评分者对21种方法进行打分，并假设±1分的扰动范围。通过200,000个样本的确定性蒙特卡洛分析评估排序稳定性，并使用排序匹配的空模型进行对比验证。此外，提供结构化叙事综述、基准测试综合、研究缺口分析和2015-2026年演化时间线。
AI.result: 在扰动模型下，超过一个位次的排序变化在67-70%的样本中平均发生；排序匹配的空模型复现了相似的稳定性特征，表明精细粒度排序不可靠，但层级级（tier-level）比较是稳健的。综述覆盖了Bahdanau-Luong对齐、Transformer、视觉架构、稀疏注意力、线性注意力、FlashAttention等IO感知精确算法、Mamba等状态空间替代方案，以及归纳头、叠加和注意力-SSM对偶性等主题。
AI.conclusion: 将注意力研究界定为效率-表达力-可解释性前沿的扩张，并指出未来方向：统一效率基准、混合架构中的学习路由、长度泛化以及可扩展的机制可解释性。

title: Every Coin Has Two Sides: On the Dual Nature of Generalization in On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers teacher capabilities by supervising trajectories sampled from the student's own policy, yet its generalization behavior remains poorly understood, as most studies evaluate OPD on a single domain and on benchmarks close to the training data. We present a controlled study that varies one generalization factor at a time, from in-domain distribution shifts to cross-domain transfer and the multi-teacher setting. We find that OPD transfers a teacher's reasoning behavior rather than its answers to particular problems: training difficulty barely matters, and even problems the teacher never solves are useful. Transfer depends strongly on the origin relationship between teacher and student: same-origin pairs bring the student close to the teacher across languages, reasoning horizons, and even other domains, whereas cross-origin pairs mostly fit the trained distribution. This broad reach is a double-edged sword: since routing prompts to domain experts cannot confine each teacher's influence, combining them yields a mixture-dependent seesaw among their capabilities. These results clarify when OPD generalizes and offer a useful perspective for diagnosing multi-teacher OPD.

AI.tldr: 本文对同策略蒸馏（OPD）的泛化行为进行了受控研究，系统性地逐一变化泛化因素（域内分布偏移、跨域迁移、多教师设置），发现OPD迁移的是教师的推理行为而非特定问题的答案，且迁移效果强烈依赖于教师与学生的来源关系，多教师组合会产生能力跷跷板效应。
AI.motivation: 尽管OPD已广泛用于从教师策略中蒸馏能力，但其泛化行为仍缺乏系统理解——现有研究多局限于单一领域和接近训练数据的基准上评估，无法揭示OPD在不同泛化场景下的真实表现。
AI.method: 采用受控实验方法，每次仅变化一个泛化因素进行对比研究，涵盖三类场景：域内分布偏移、跨域迁移以及多教师设置，系统性地考察OPD的泛化特性。
AI.result: 研究发现：（1）OPD迁移教师推理行为而非特定问题答案，训练难度影响甚微，教师从未解出的问题仍有用；（2）迁移效果取决于教师与学生的来源关系，同源对在跨语言、推理深度乃至跨领域上都使学牛接近教师，跨源对则主要拟合训练分布；（3）多教师组合产生依赖混合比例的"跷跷板"效应，因为路由提示无法限制各教师的影响范围。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果厘清了OPD何时能够泛化的条件，并为诊断多教师OPD场景提供了有用的分析视角。

title: Spatially-Grounded Flow Matching: Structured Source Distributions for Image Generation
summary: Current flow matching models learn to transport the source i.i.d. Gaussian noise into the target distribution of natural images, yet this source distribution carries no notion of spatial structure. Images however are fundamentally local since nearby pixels are strongly correlated. By sampling the noise independently, we hypothesize that models are implicitly encouraged to exploit less noisy neighbors as context during training, partially bypassing the need to properly learn the true local structure of images. The source distribution, in other words, works against the inductive bias of the image domain. To ameliorate this design discrepancy, we propose StructFlow which encodes spatial locality directly into the source by having the pixels within a small region share a common noise component. This structured source produces transport paths that are geometrically aligned with image regions - enabling properties that generic flow matching struggles to provide: fine-grained local editing that naturally respects boundaries, robust structure preservation, and smooth semantic interpolation between images. We show that these benefits also extend to large pre-trained models, demonstrating that StructFlow can even be incorporated through a lightweight post-training phase. Comprehensive experiments on multiple datasets, in unconditional, class and text-conditioned regimes, using different diffusion transformer architectures confirm that StructFlow not only offers competitive image generation quality, but also significantly improves localized controllable re-synthesis.

AI.tldr: StructFlow通过在源噪声中引入空间局部性（使小区域内像素共享同一噪声分量）来改进流匹配模型，使传输路径与图像区域几何对齐，从而在保持生成质量的同时显著提升局部可控编辑、结构保持和语义插值能力，且可通过轻量后训练阶段集成到大型预训练模型中。
AI.motivation: 现有的流匹配模型从独立同分布的高斯噪声源向自然图像目标分布传输，但该源分布缺乏空间结构概念。由于图像本质上是局部的（邻近像素强相关），独立采样方式隐式鼓励模型利用噪声较少的邻居作为上下文，从而部分绕过真正学习图像局部结构的需求，这与图像域的归纳偏置相悖。
AI.method: StructFlow将空间局部性直接编码进源分布：使小区域内的像素共享公共噪声分量，从而构造出具有空间结构的源分布。这种方法使传输路径与图像区域几何对齐，并可通过轻量后训练阶段集成到大型预训练模型（如扩散Transformer架构）中。在无条件、类别条件和文本条件等多种设定下进行验证。
AI.result: 在多个数据集、多种设定（无条件、类别条件、文本条件）及不同扩散Transformer架构上的综合实验表明，StructFlow不仅提供具有竞争力的图像生成质量，还显著改善了局部可控重合成能力，包括自然尊重边界的细粒度局部编辑、稳健的结构保持以及平滑的语义插值。
AI.conclusion: 通过将空间局部性注入源分布，StructFlow弥补了流匹配模型与图像域归纳偏置之间的设计差距，在保持生成质量的同时赋予模型更强的局部可控性与结构一致性，且该改进可迁移至大型预训练模型。

title: Understanding Cognition-Induced Risks in Agentic AI Systems
comment: This paper has been accepted by IEEE Intelligent Systems, which can be accessed at https://doi.ieeecomputersociety.org/10.1109/MIS.2026.3721766. The DOI is 10.1109/MIS.2026.3721766
summary: Frontier agentic systems powered by large language models (LLMs) exhibit human-like patterns of cognition. As these systems become deeply integrated across different domains, their cognitive engagement raises critical concerns for human society that remain insufficiently studied. To address this gap, we systematically analyze risks induced by expanding cognitive capabilities, following a three-level framework defined by their cognitive scope, from physical cognition to social cognition, and finally to self-referential cognition. We study their potential risks to human agency, autonomy, and control capability, corresponding to each cognitive level. We finally propose strategies to mitigate these risks and enhance the controllability of agentic AI systems, ensuring their long-term safe development.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地分析了基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体系统在认知能力扩展过程中引发的一系列风险，通过一个从物理认知、社会认知到自我指涉认知的三层框架来界定这些风险的认知范围，并分别探讨了它们对人类能动性、自主性和控制能力的潜在威胁，最终提出缓解策略以增强这类系统的可控性。
AI.motivation: 前沿的LLM智能体系统展现出类似人类的认知模式，并正被深度整合到各个领域，但其认知参与对人类社会的潜在风险尚未得到充分研究。作者旨在弥补这一研究缺口。
AI.method: 采用一个三层次的系统分析框架：从物理认知（physical cognition）到社会认知（social cognition），再到自我指涉认知（self-referential cognition），逐一分析每层认知能力扩展所对应的风险，并针对人类能动性（agency）、自主性（autonomy）和控制能力（control capability）三个维度进行风险评估。
AI.result: 该文识别出与每一层认知能力相对应的风险类型，并提出了一系列缓解策略，以增强agentic AI系统的可控性并保障其长期安全发展。具体风险细节需要查看论文全文。
AI.conclusion: 通过系统的三层认知风险框架分析，作者强调需要主动管理LLM智能体系统日益增长的认知能力，提出相应的风险缓解策略，以在充分发挥其潜力的同时确保其长期安全可控的发展。

title: High-Dimensional Nonparametric Change-Point Detection via Low-Rank Degree-Three Density Projection
summary: Distributional changes can be invisible to means and covariances yet appear in skewness, asymmetric interactions, or other third-order structure. We develop a nonparametric change-point method that retains every degree-at-most-three coefficient of a density while avoiding direct density estimation. For observations in $[-1,1]^d$, we construct a symmetric order-three Legendre feature tensor $H_3(X)\in\Sym^3(\R^{d+1})$ such that $A(f)=\E_fH_3(X)$ is an exact isometric encoding of the degree-three density projection: $\|A(f)-A(g)\|_{\F}=\|P_3(f-g)\|_{L^2}$. Instead, fixed tensor contractions are degree-three polynomial chaoses with $ψ_{2/3}$ tails. The two terms have the characteristic order-three tensor scaling and match the powers in sharp concentration results for simple random tensors. For a coordinate-orthogonal specialization, the bound improves to $\sqrt{\log d}$ and enables a prefix-sum implementation in hundreds of dimensions. We derive the exact population tent shape and localization margin, introduce a seeded shortest-interval algorithm with a padded local recentering step, and prove exact recovery by induction: null recursive segments remain inactive, every undetected change retains a balanced isolating interval, and the shortest active seed contains exactly one change before recentering. A two-way cross-fitted scalar refinement attains $O_{\Pp}(κ^{-2})$ localization in the small-jump regime, matching a Le Cam lower bound on a pure cubic family whose degree-two projection jump is exactly zero. Reproducible experiments at $d\in\{20,50,100,200\}$ and a three-change $d=100$ sequence demonstrate the intended high-dimensional regime without materializing a $(d+1)^3$ tensor.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种非参数变点检测方法，通过构造对称三阶Legendre特征张量H_3(X)实现对密度三阶投影的精确等距编码（不直接估计密度），并利用三阶多项式混沌的ψ_{2/3}尾界与三阶张量缩放特性，结合seeded shortest-interval算法和双向交叉拟合标量细化步骤，达到O_P(κ^{-2})的局部化精度（与Le Cam下界匹配），适用于高维（d≤200）场景。
AI.motivation: 传统变点检测通常依赖于均值和协方差的变化，但现实中许多分布变化体现在偏度、非对称交互或更高阶结构中，这些变化对均值和协方差不可见。作者希望开发一种无需直接密度估计、能够捕获分布三阶结构的非参数变点检测方法，以应对高维场景下的分布变化检测需求。
AI.method: (1) 构造对称三阶Legendre特征张量H_3(X)∈Sym^3(R^{d+1})，使得A(f)=E_f H_3(X)成为密度三阶投影P_3(f)的精确等距编码；(2) 利用固定张量收缩作为三阶多项式混沌，建立ψ_{2/3}尾界；(3) 对于坐标正交特化情形，将界改进为√log d并支持前缀和实现；(4) 推导精确的总体帐篷形状（tent shape）和局部化边界；(5) 设计seeded shortest-interval算法，包含padded local recentering步骤；(6) 通过归纳法证明精确恢复：空递归段保持非活跃、未检测变化保留平衡隔离区间、最短活跃种子在recentering前恰好包含一个变化；(7) 采用双向交叉拟合标量细化达到O_P(κ^{-2})局部化精度。
AI.result: 该方法无需物化(d+1)^3维张量即可在高维（d∈{20,50,100,200}）下运行，实现三阶结构变化的精确检测。在小跳跃区域达到O_P(κ^{-2})局部化精度，与一个纯三次族上的Le Cam下界精确匹配（该族的二阶投影跳跃恰好为零）。在d=100的三变化序列实验中展现了预期的高维性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了基于三阶张量特征的非参数变点检测框架，在不直接估计密度的情况下实现三阶结构变化的精确检测，理论上的局部化精度达到信息论下界，并通过高效实现支持高维场景。

title: PCA-guided Activation Scaling for Monotonic Bidirectional Control over LLM Sycophancy
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit sycophancy, a tendency to agree with user beliefs regardless of factual accuracy. This can reinforce misconceptions, but eliminating it entirely risks over-correction against valid opinions. Effective control must therefore both reduce and increase sycophancy with predictable and gradual effect. Yet, existing methods fail to ensure a bidirectional and monotonic relationship between steering strength and behavioral outcome across models and datasets. We introduce PCA-guided Activation Scaling (PAS), an activation steering framework that decomposes residual stream activations into a PCA-identified sycophancy-honesty subspace and an orthogonal residual, then applies distinct scaling exponents to achieve monotonic, bidirectional control. Across three LLMs and three datasets, PAS achieves strong monotonicity (Spearman $ρ$ = +0.92) and an average shift of 15.4% per direction, compared with 8.7% for the baselines. Ablation studies confirm that the decomposition, asymmetric exponents, and layer selection are each essential for maintaining monotonic control. The data and code are available at https://github.com/Bellafc/PCS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PCA引导的激活缩放（PAS）框架，通过将残差流激活分解为PCA识别的谄媚-诚实子空间和正交残差，并应用非对称缩放指数，实现对LLM谄媚行为的双向、单调可控调节。在三个LLM和三个数据集上，PAS实现了强单调性（Spearman ρ=+0.92）和每方向平均15.4%的行为偏移，优于基线方法的8.7%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM存在谄媚倾向（sycophancy），即无论事实准确性如何都会迎合用户信念。消除这一倾向可能过度矫正有效观点，因此需要既能减少又能增加谄媚行为、且效果可预测且渐进的精细控制。然而现有方法无法在跨模型和数据集上保证行为结果与调控强度之间的双向、单调关系。
AI.method: PAS框架将残差流激活分解为PCA识别的谄媚-诚实子空间和正交残差两部分，对这两个部分施加不同的缩放指数，以实现单调且双向的行为控制。这种方法允许在减少谄媚（增加诚实）和增加谄媚之间进行连续且可预测的调节。
AI.result: 在三个LLM和三个数据集上的实验中，PAS实现了强单调性（Spearman ρ=+0.92），每方向平均行为偏移达15.4%，而基线的平均偏移仅为8.7%。消融研究表明，分解方法、非对称指数和层选择对维持单调控制都至关重要。
AI.conclusion: PAS作为一种激活引导框架，能够实现对LLM谄媚行为的双向、单调且渐进的精细控制，克服了现有方法的局限性，为LLM行为可控调节提供了更有效的技术方案。

title: AlignJEPA: Predictive Vision-Language Alignment for Remote Sensing Foundation Models
summary: Remote sensing (RS) foundation models provide transferable Earth observation representations across sensors, resolutions, and geographies, yet most remain weakly aligned with natural language, limiting natural-language archive search, image-text retrieval, and question-conditioned analysis. We propose AlignJEPA, a JEPA-inspired predictive vision-language alignment framework for remote sensing foundation models. AlignJEPA uses a pretrained AnySat visual encoder and a RemoteCLIP text encoder while training only a lightweight predictive alignment network. Instead of relying on global image--text contrastive alignment alone, the framework predicts remote-sensing text embeddings from masked visual foundation-model tokens. Its mask-aware multi-scale predictive aligner aggregates visible tokens at fine, regional, and global scales, jointly models them with a cross-scale Transformer, and projects the resulting representation into the text space using learned query pooling. Training combines semantic prediction with bidirectional contrastive retrieval. We train and evaluate AlignJEPA on BigEarthNet.txt for natural-language Sentinel retrieval, evaluate cross-dataset adaptation on RSICD, and use RSVQA only as a closed-set representation probe. AlignJEPA provides a parameter-efficient route for aligning Earth observation foundation models with language.

AI.tldr: AlignJEPA是一个基于JEPA思想的多模态视觉-语言对齐框架，用于遥感基础模型与自然语言的弱对齐问题。它利用预训练的AnySat视觉编码器和RemoteCLIP文本编码器，仅训练轻量级预测对齐网络，通过掩码视觉令牌预测遥感文本嵌入，并在多尺度上实现语义预测与双向对比检索的联合训练。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感基础模型虽在不同传感器、分辨率和地理区域上具有可迁移的地观测表示，但大多数与自然语言的弱对齐限制了诸如自然语言档案检索、图像-文本检索和基于问题条件的分析等应用。传统全局图像-文本对比对齐方法不足以解决这一瓶颈。
AI.method: AlignJEPA采用JEPA启发的预测式视觉-语言对齐框架：使用预训练的AnySat视觉编码器和RemoteCLIP文本编码器，仅训练一个轻量级预测对齐网络。该网络的掩码感知多尺度预测对齐器在细粒度、区域和全局三种尺度上聚合可见令牌，通过跨尺度Transformer联合建模，并使用学习查询池化将表示投影到文本空间。训练过程结合语义预测与双向对比检索。
AI.result: 在BigEarthNet.txt上训练和评估用于自然语言Sentinel检索，在RSICD上进行跨数据集适配评估，并使用RSVQA作为闭集表示探针。AlignJEPA提供了一条参数高效的将地观测基础模型与语言对齐的途径。
AI.conclusion: AlignJEPA验证了通过轻量级预测对齐网络即可实现遥感基础模型与自然语言的有效对齐，无需微调大型视觉或文本编码器，为构建多模态遥感理解系统提供了一条参数高效的解决方案。

title: Physiological World Models for Human State Transitions
summary: Continuous multimodal sensing now allows human physiology to be observed throughout daily life rather than only during occasional clinical visits. However, most health artificial intelligence systems are designed to recognize current states, estimate risks or analyse individual biomarkers. They do not directly model how physiological states change in response to real-world events, behaviours, contexts and interventions. Here we propose the Physiological World Model (PWM), an event-conditioned framework for learning these changes at the level of the whole person. We introduce the HumanState Transition Token, a structured, quality-scored unit that connects the physiological state before an event with the event or action, relevant context and intervention information, the physiological trajectory after the event, observed outcomes and data quality. We describe four capability levels, from state representation to bounded intervention planning, together with four data acquisition and validation protocols. We also propose six benchmark tasks covering HumanState representation, forecasting across multiple timescales, individualized response prediction, simulation of alternative interventions, bounded planning and reliability under distribution shift. Together, this framework provides a practical path towards personalized health management, behavioural intervention design and clinician-supervised decision support, while clearly separating prediction from causal inference and making uncertainty, safety, governance and limits of use explicit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出生理世界模型（PWM），一个基于事件条件的学习框架，用于建模生理状态如何响应真实世界事件、行为、情境和干预而变化。框架引入HumanState Transition Token作为结构化、质量评分的单位，连接事件前后的生理状态与上下文信息，并定义了四个能力层级、四种数据采集验证协议及六个基准任务。
AI.motivation: 现有健康人工智能系统主要识别当前状态、估计风险或分析单个生物标志物，缺乏直接建模生理状态如何随真实世界事件、行为、情境和干预动态变化的能力，需要一种能够理解全人层面状态转变的新框架。
AI.method: 提出PWM框架，核心包含：1) HumanState Transition Token——结构化的质量评分单位，连接事件前生理状态、事件/行为、上下文与干预信息、事件后生理轨迹、观察结果及数据质量；2) 四个能力层级（从状态表征到有界干预规划）；3) 四种数据采集与验证协议；4) 六个基准任务（HumanState表征、多时间尺度预测、个体化反应预测、替代干预模拟、有界规划及分布偏移下的可靠性）。
AI.result: 该框架提供了实现个性化健康管理、行为干预设计和临床医生监督决策支持的实用路径，同时明确区分了预测与因果推断，并明确阐述了不确定性、安全性、治理和使用限制。
AI.conclusion: PWM为连续多模态生理感知时代提供了系统的状态转变学习范式，将预测从因果推断中剥离，为健康AI的负责任部署奠定了基础。

title: Population Structure Analysis of an Inbred Population using Quantitative Shape Phenotyping from Stereo Retinal Photographs
summary: The population structure of an inbred population of 781 people on Norfolk Island in the Pacific, 318 of which are descendants of the original Mutineers of the Bounty, is analyzed phenotypically using shape from stereo retinal fundus photographs. Three-dimensional optic nerve head (ONH) shape is reconstructed from stereo pairs by a multi-scale stereo matching algorithm. Using deep neural network, the shape of ONH, which is under genetic control, is decomposed into a set of hierarchical features through self-taught learning. Features captured at different levels are selected according to their discriminant power in identifying the two populations. The prediction accuracy is evaluated with stratified cross validation. Given the selected feature set, individuals are grouped into k hierarchical clusters and cluster membership fractions are determined for k=2,3,4,5,6,7. Population structure analysis on the basis of phenotypes through image analysis allows heritability and linkage analysis, including founder effects from English and Polynesian ancestors, potentially leading to new genetic risk factors for glaucoma and other ONH-related eye diseases.

AI.tldr: 本文通过立体视网膜眼底照片重建三维视神经乳头（ONH）形状，利用深度神经网络进行自学习特征分解，对Norfolk Island近交人群（781人，其中318人为Bounty号叛变者后裔）进行基于表型的群体结构分析，并通过分层聚类实现人群分类，为青光眼等ONH相关眼病的遗传风险因素发现奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 传统群体结构分析主要基于基因型数据，而本文旨在探索仅通过表型（三维ONH形状）结合图像分析技术来推断群体遗传结构，从而为遗传力分析、连锁分析和发现青光眼等眼病的新遗传风险因素提供新途径。
AI.method: 1) 利用多尺度立体匹配算法从立体眼底照片重建三维ONH形状；2) 使用深度神经网络通过自学习将ONH形状分解为层次化特征；3) 依据判别力选择不同层次的特征以区分两个人群；4) 使用分层交叉验证评估预测精度；5) 对选定特征集的个体进行k=2至7的层次聚类，确定聚类成员比例。
AI.result: 文章报告了通过所选择的特征集成功实现人群预测的分层交叉验证评估，并在k=2到7的不同聚类层级下确定了群体聚类成员比例，验证了基于表型图像分析进行群体结构划分的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 基于表型的图像分析方法能够有效揭示近交人群的群体结构，支持后续的遗传力与连锁分析，包括来自英国和波利尼西亚祖先的奠基者效应研究，有望发现青光眼及其他ONH相关眼病的新的遗传风险因素。

title: Does the LM Head Create a Harmful Gradient Bottleneck? A Causal Test
summary: The language-model head maps a hidden state of width D to a vocabulary of size V, so its transpose can return at most D independent directions to the Transformer. Godey and Artzi argue that this severe projection is a harmful optimization bottleneck. We separate the geometry from the causal claim. Our backward-only intervention keeps the ordinary logits and the exact LM-head parameter update while reducing only the rank of the gradient sent into the Transformer. Across five paired seeds on byte-level and BPE-8192 WikiText-2 models, reducing backward rank increases validation loss. An equally ranked factorized forward head, however, increases loss substantially more. At half rank in the larger model, the backward-only loss increase is 0.0586 (95% CI [0.0167, 0.1005]), while the factorized forward head increases loss by 0.1795 ([0.1547, 0.2042]). The vocabulary-space residual also contributes to the ordinary LM-head update, and removing that contribution is harmful. Additional controls show that repeated-token failures are confounded by the number of independently sampled symbols, that adding never-target output classes does not impair learning, and that projection diagnostics do not reliably predict progress in our runs. Tested auxiliary feedback routes do not beat tuned backpropagation. These results confirm strong geometric compression but do not establish that it is a harmful optimization bottleneck.

AI.tldr: 本文通过"仅反向干预"实验分离了几何压缩与因果主张：将LM头的梯度秩降低到D，保持了普通logits和精确的LM头参数更新，结果发现降低反向秩会增加验证损失，但影响远小于同秩因子化前向头。作者确认了强大的几何压缩存在，但未能证明其是有害的优化瓶颈。
AI.motivation: Godey和Artzi提出语言模型头（width D → vocab V，V远大于D）的转置最多只能返回D个独立方向，这种严重的投影是有害的优化瓶颈。作者旨在严格检验这一因果主张，通过将几何事实与因果主张分离，设计精确的对照实验来测试LM头的低秩投影是否真的损害训练。
AI.method: 采用"backward-only intervention"方法：保持普通logits和精确的LM头参数更新不变，仅将发送回Transformer的梯度秩降低到D。对比基线包括：同秩因子化前向头、移除词汇空间残差对LM头更新的贡献、重复token失败混淆检验、添加非目标输出类别、投影诊断预测能力检验以及辅助反馈路径。实验在字节级和BPE-8192 WikiText-2模型上使用五对种子进行。
AI.result: 降低反向秩增加验证损失，但在更大模型中半秩时仅增加0.0586（95% CI [0.0167, 0.1005]），而同秩因子化前向头增加0.1795（[0.1547, 0.2042]），损失显著更大。词汇空间残差对LM头更新有贡献，移除有害。重复token失败与独立采样符号数量混淆；添加非目标类别不影响学习；投影诊断不可靠预测进展；辅助反馈路径不如调优的反向传播。
AI.conclusion: 结果确认LM头存在强几何压缩，但其作为有害优化瓶颈的因果主张未被证实。LM头优化瓶颈的实际危害远小于先前的因果断言，反向传播通过低秩梯度就能有效工作，而前向因子化造成的损害更大。

title: GLaQ: Grounding Latent Queries in Visual Evidence for Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Chain-of-thought reasoning has substantially improved the problem-solving capabilities of multimodal large language models. Fine-grained visual evidence, however, remains difficult to preserve and reuse across text-based reasoning steps. To address this limitation, tool-augmented thinking-with-images methods maintain visual access externally by revisiting or manipulating the image, but require predefined tools and additional inference-time processing. As an internal alternative, continuous visual latent reasoning retains intermediate computation in hidden states. However, its prevailing autoregressive construction makes each latent state depend on its predecessors, so later states may repeat information already present in the latent sequence rather than capture complementary visual details. We introduce GLaQ, a grounded latent-query framework that replaces sequential latent rollout with a fixed set of context-conditioned queries grounded in the original visual tokens. The grounded queries are reinjected for answer generation, providing direct and coordinated access to source visual evidence. We train GLaQ with localized-view supervision followed by reinforcement learning under task-level rewards. Across five benchmarks for fine-grained visual understanding and perception, GLaQ-7B gains 5.99--9.66\% over its base model and leads all compared visual latent methods, suggesting that direct query-to-image grounding can recover localized evidence from the full image without external visual operations or autoregressive latent rollouts.

AI.tldr: GLaQ 提出一种基于grounded latent-query的框架，用固定数量的上下文条件查询取代自回归式潜变量推理，使查询直接锚定原始视觉token，从而在不依赖外部工具或自回归潜变量展开的情况下保留并利用细粒度视觉证据，在5个基准上显著超越基线模型。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型虽然通过思维链推理大幅提升了问题解决能力，但细粒度视觉证据难以在基于文本的推理步骤中被保留和复用。现有的工具增强方法需要预定义工具和额外推理开销，而连续视觉潜变量推理的自回归结构使后续状态可能重复已有信息而非补充互补的视觉细节。
AI.method: GLaQ 用一组固定的上下文条件查询（grounded queries）替代顺序的潜变量rollout，这些查询直接锚定原始视觉token。训练分两个阶段：先用局部视图监督（localized-view supervision）训练，再用任务级奖励进行强化学习微调。查询在答案生成阶段被重新注入，提供对源视觉证据的直接且协调的访问。
AI.result: 在5个细粒度视觉理解与感知基准上，GLaQ-7B相对其基础模型提升5.99%~9.66%，并优于所有对比的视觉潜变量方法，证明直接查询-图像锚定能从完整图像中恢复局部证据，无需外部视觉操作或自回归潜变量展开。
AI.conclusion: GLaQ表明，通过将潜变量推理从自回归序列改为固定查询直接锚定原始视觉token，可以实现更高效且更有效的细粒度视觉证据保留与重用，为多模态推理中的视觉信息处理提供了新的内部方案。

title: MoE Router-Guided Clustering for Heterogeneous Federated Instruction Tuning
summary: Federated instruction fine-tuning enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to adapt to decentralized, privacy-sensitive data without requiring data sharing. Recent Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs are particularly attractive for federated learning because their sparse activation reduces computation and communication while scaling model capacity. However, existing federated MoE methods primarily focus on parameter aggregation and personalization, overlooking the routing behavior of MoE models as a source of information for client collaboration. Under heterogeneous instruction distributions, indiscriminate aggregation can lead to negative transfer, highlighting the need to identify which clients should collaborate during federated optimization. We propose ClientMorpher, a routing-aware, personalized federated instruction fine-tuning framework that leverages routing signatures from pretrained MoE models to organize client collaboration prior to aggregation. We investigate two complementary clustering strategies: ClientMorpher-C, which directly clusters clients using expert activation profiles, and ClientMorpher-E, which first clusters experts based on their cross-client usage signatures and then derives client collaboration groups. We evaluate ClientMorpher for federated instruction fine-tuning on the Databricks Dolly-15K dataset, using pathological and Dirichlet-based heterogeneous client distributions across multiple instruction-following tasks. Experimental results show that routing-aware collaboration consistently improves personalized performance compared to conventional federated averaging and local training, while maintaining the same communication cost. Furthermore, our study shows that client-centric and expert-centric clustering provides an effective and scalable approach for personalized federated instruction fine-tuning of sparse MoE LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出ClientMorpher，一种利用预训练MoE专家路由签名来组织客户端协作的个性化联邦指令微调框架，通过客户端中心（ClientMorpher-C）和专家中心（ClientMorpher-E）两种聚类策略，在异构指令分布下实现个性化的联邦MoE指令微调。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦MoE方法主要关注参数聚合和个性化，忽视了路由行为作为客户端协作信息来源的价值。在异构指令分布下，无差别聚合会导致负迁移，因此需要识别哪些客户端应该协作。
AI.method: 提出两种互补的聚类策略：ClientMorpher-C直接使用专家激活分布对客户端进行聚类；ClientMorpher-E先基于跨客户端使用签名对专家聚类，再推导出客户端协作组。该方法在聚合之前利用路由签名组织客户端协作，通信成本与联邦平均相同。
AI.result: 在Databricks Dolly-15K数据集上，使用病态和Dirichlet异构客户端分布，在多个指令跟随任务上验证。路由感知的协作相比传统联邦平均和本地训练一致地提升了个性化性能，同时保持相同通信成本。
AI.conclusion: 路由感知的聚类（客户端中心和专家中心）为稀疏MoE LLM的个性化联邦指令微调提供了一种有效且可扩展的方法。

title: Optimal Lower Bounds for Networked Information Aggregation
summary:
The problem of networked information aggregation, studied in Kearns et al. (2026), involves a group of learners situated on the vertices of a directed acyclic graph $G$, each learning a linear predictor $\widehat Y$ for a fixed random variable $Y$ given access to a local feature, as well as the predictors learnt by its parents. Learning proceeds iteratively, with learners ordered according to a topological sort of $G$. The main quantity of interest is the error incurred by the current learner, constrained to this flow of information, with respect to the best linear predictor using all the features seen so far. When the studied error is the MSE, i.e., $\mathbb{E} (\widehat Y - Y)^2$, Kearns et al. (2026) show that the error is at most $O(1/\sqrt{D})$ along a path of length $D$. They also obtain a hard instance where the MSE is lower bounded by $Ω(1/D)$, leaving the correct order open. In this work, we resolve this central open problem, and obtain a family of worst case problem instances with a MSE lower bound of $Ω(1/\sqrt{D})$.
  By exploiting invariances in the structure of the learnt predictors, our analysis generalizes to all convex loss functions $\ell(\widehat Y, Y)$ satisfying regularity conditions which include strong convexity in a ball around the origin, and that the ideal predictor minimizing the population loss is positively correlated with the label. We show that networked information aggregation on a gaussian instance in our worst case family incurs an $\ell$-error lower bounded by $Ω(1/\sqrt{D})$ with respect to this ideal predictor. We demonstrate that a variety of common losses satisfy these regularity conditions. In particular, the logistic loss satisfies them, and hence our analysis also closes the gap between the upper and lower bounds in Bateni et al. (2026).

AI.tldr: 本文解决了Kearns等人(2026)提出的网络化信息聚合问题中的中心开放问题，构造了一族最坏情况实例，证明沿长度为D的路径的MSE下界为Ω(1/√D)，从而将上界(O(1/√D))与下界(此前为Ω(1/D))之间的差距完全闭合。此外，作者利用学习器预测结构的对称不变性，将分析推广到满足一定正则条件（包括在原点附近强凸、理想预测器与标签正相关）的所有凸损失函数，证明在同一高斯最坏实例族上ℓ-误差同样有Ω(1/√D)的下界，并由此闭合了Bateni等人(2026)在logistic损失下的上下界差距。
AI.motivation: Kearns等人(2026)提出了有向无环图上的网络化信息聚合问题，即在图拓扑序下依次学习线性预测器，其目标是最小化当前学习器相对于"使用所有已见特征的最优线性预测器"的误差。他们证明了沿长度D路径的MSE上界为O(1/√D)，但仅能给出Ω(1/D)的下界，正确的收敛阶数未知。解决这一开放问题对于理解信息在网络化学习中传播的效率具有重要意义。
AI.method: 作者通过构造一族高斯最坏情况实例，利用学习器预测结构的对称不变性（invariance），证明在长度D的路径上MSE下界为Ω(1/√D)，从而将MSE的上下界完全闭合。在此基础上，作者进一步推广分析框架：对于满足正则条件的凸损失函数ℓ(Ŷ,Y)——包括在原点附近强凸、以及最小化总体损失的理想预测器与标签正相关——证明同一高斯实例族上ℓ-误差同样存在Ω(1/√D)的下界。文中还验证了多种常见损失（包括logistic损失）满足这些条件。
AI.result: 作者成功构造了一族最坏情况问题实例，使得网络化信息聚合的MSE下界达到Ω(1/√D)，与已知的O(1/√D)上界匹配，完全解决了该开放问题。同时，通过利用预测器结构的对称不变性，将下界结果推广到了所有满足正则条件的凸损失函数，特别地证明了logistic损失满足条件，从而也闭合了Bateni等人(2026)在logistic损失上的上下界差距。
AI.conclusion: 本文完全解决了网络化信息聚合在MSE意义下的收敛阶数问题，确认真实收敛率为Θ(1/√D)，并将结论推广到了更广泛的凸损失函数类。这一结果提升了我们对信息在有向无环图上逐层传播时效率损失的理解，并为该方向未来的研究提供了紧致的理论基准。

title: Semantic Bandits: In-Context Exploration-Exploitation is Biased by Semantic Priors
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as decision-making agents in settings that require sophisticated environmental exploration. However, existing work has raised questions about how LLMs actually balance exploration and exploitation. Unlike classical agents, LLM agents engage with tasks through natural language, exposing them to semantic information with no formal counterpart in the task structure. We introduce the semantic bandit, an extension of the multi-armed bandit setting that explicitly considers the textual labels assigned to actions, and use it to study how semantic priors --- inductive biases arising from associations between language and expected reward learned during pre-training, shape LLM exploration behaviour. We find that semantically informative action labels reduce exploration in favour of exploitation, improving performance when aligned with the reward structure and severely degrading it when misaligned. We further find that negative rewards trigger substantially more exploration than equivalent positive rewards, consistent with an expected-scale bias induced by reward conventions common in pre-training data. Overall, we argue that the use of language to define the environment and rewards introduces unavoidable biases derived from the fact that the model is trained on word co-occurence, with implications for the reliability and robustness of LLM agents in real-world decision-making settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"语义老虎机"（semantic bandit）框架，扩展了多臂老虎机设置以显式考虑动作的文本标签，研究大型语言模型（LLM）在探索-利用权衡中的语义先验偏差。研究发现语义信息丰富的动作标签会减少探索、偏向利用，当与奖励结构一致时提升性能，不一致时严重损害性能；同时负奖励相比等量正奖励会触发更多探索，这与预训练数据中奖励惯例导致的期望尺度偏差一致。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地被部署为需要复杂环境探索的决策智能体，但现有工作尚未充分回答LLM如何真正平衡探索与利用。与传统智能体不同，LLM通过自然语言与环境交互，暴露于任务结构中无正式对应物的语义信息，这可能引入预训练阶段习得的语言-奖励关联带来的归纳偏置，影响其探索行为。因此需要系统地研究这些语义先验如何塑造LLM的探索行为。
AI.method: 作者引入"语义老虎机"（semantic bandit），这是多臂老虎机设置的扩展，显式考虑分配给每个动作的文本标签。通过操纵动作标签的语义信息性与奖励结构的对齐/不对齐关系，并对比正负奖励条件，系统地测量LLM在探索与利用之间的权衡行为，以隔离语义先验的影响。
AI.result: （1）语义信息丰富的动作标签显著减少探索、增加利用；当标签与奖励结构对齐时性能提升，但当标签与奖励结构不对齐时性能严重下降。（2）负奖励比等量正奖励触发显著更多的探索行为，反映了预训练数据中奖励惯例带来的期望尺度偏差。（3）整体表明语言定义环境和奖励的方式会引入源于词共现训练目标的不可避免偏差。
AI.conclusion: LLM的探索行为受其预训练阶段学到的语义先验显著影响，语言作为环境定义和奖励信号传播媒介会引入固有偏差。这挑战了LLM作为决策智能体的可靠性，表明在真实决策场景中需要谨慎评估语义信息与奖励结构的一致性，并考虑这些偏差对LLM智能体鲁棒性的影响。

title: Efficient Audio-Visual Generation via Synchrony-Aware Cross-Modal Sparse Attention
summary: Recent audio-visual generation models can synthesize synchronized video and sound in a unified diffusion process, but their inference cost remains high because long video token sequences require repeated attention computation across denoising steps.A variety of acceleration techniques have been developed for video generation models, including low-bit quantization, attention sparsification, and feature caching.However, since these methods are originally designed for video generation, directly applying them to audio-visual models overlooks the interactions between the audio and video branches and may therefore disrupt audio-video synchronization.We present a synchronization-aware acceleration framework for efficient audio-visual generation.Our key observation is that bidirectional audio-video cross-attention reveals structured interactions between the two branches, with high responses often concentrated on a few sound-related visual and temporal regions.Guided by this interaction pattern, we introduce a protected sparse attention strategy that preserves high-fidelity computation for synchronization-critical tokens while sparsifying redundant attention interactions.By explicitly accounting for cross-modal dependence during acceleration, our method improves inference efficiency while keeping video quality, audio quality, and audio-video synchronization.

AI.tldr: 提出一个面向音频-视频联合生成模型的同步感知加速框架，利用双向跨模态注意力中结构化交互模式，通过保护式稀疏注意力策略在加速推理的同时维持音视频同步质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的音频-视频统一生成模型推理成本高，因为长视频token序列需要在去噪步骤中反复进行注意力计算。虽然已有针对视频生成模型的加速技术（低比特量化、注意力稀疏化、特征缓存），但这些方法是为纯视频生成设计的，直接应用到音频-视觉模型会忽视音频和视频分支间的交互，从而破坏音视频同步。
AI.method: 关键观察是双向音频-视频交叉注意力揭示了两个分支间的结构化交互，高响应往往集中在少数与声音相关的视觉和时间区域。基于这一交互模式，提出保护式稀疏注意力策略：对同步关键token保留高保真计算，同时稀疏化冗余的注意力交互。该策略显式考虑跨模态依赖关系来实现加速。
AI.result: 该方法在提升推理效率的同时，保持了视频质量、音频质量以及音视频同步性。
AI.conclusion: 通过在加速过程中显式考虑跨模态依赖关系，实现了高效的音频-视觉联合生成，证明关注模态间交互的加速方法比通用加速技术更有效。

title: Physics-informed VAE-EVT for Tail Aware Radio Map Prediction
comment: Accepted at the IEEE Global Communications Conference (GLOBECOM) 2026, Macau, China
summary: Ultra-reliable low-latency communication (URLLC) requires precise identification of spatial regions where the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) falls below an outage threshold. In this context, an outage refers to instances in which SNR falls below a specified threshold, which, for URLLC, can be as stringent as the 0.1% quantile of the SNR distribution. Traditional generative radio map models tend to focus on reconstructing average signal levels, often overlooking the low SNR that is crucial for accurate outage prediction. To address this limitation, we introduce a physics- and tail-informed VAE-EVT (variational autoencoder-extreme value theory) framework that distinctly models both the bulk and tail distribution of SNR. Our approach begins with a physics-informed preprocessing stage that extracts deterministic features, including line-of-sight, shadowing, and distance, from the scene geometry. A dual-latent encoder then captures the bulk SNR using a Gaussian mixture and the tail using a generalized Pareto distribution (GPD). By employing a modified variational objective, the model is trained to jointly supervise both regimes, ensuring focused attention on extreme fading events. Evaluated on the RadioMapSeer dataset, our method achieves an SNR RMSE of 4.83 dB in the outage region defined by the low threshold of 0.1% SNR quantile. This significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art GAN-based model, which records an SNR RMSE of 21.90 dB, with the performance gap widening as the outage threshold becomes more stringent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种物理与尾部信息融合的VAE-EVT框架，通过双潜变量分别建模SNR的主体分布和尾部（极端低SNR事件），实现对URLLC场景下0.1%分位点级别的中断区域高精度预测，在RadioMapSeer数据集上显著优于现有GAN方法。
AI.motivation: URLLC需要精确识别SNR低于中断阈值的空间区域，其中断阈值可严格至SNR分布的0.1%分位数。传统生成式无线电地图模型侧重于重建平均信号水平，往往忽略了对准确中断预测至关重要的低SNR（尾部）区域，导致极端衰落事件预测精度不足。
AI.method: 提出物理与尾部信息驱动的VAE-EVT框架：(1)物理信息预处理阶段从场景几何中提取确定性特征（视距、阴影、距离）；(2)双潜变量编码器分别用高斯混合模型建模SNR主体分布、用广义帕累托分布（GPD）建模尾部分布；(3)采用修正的变分目标函数联合监督两个分布区域，使模型聚焦于极端衰落事件。
AI.result: 在RadioMapSeer数据集上，该方法在0.1% SNR分位数定义的中断区域达到4.83 dB的SNR RMSE，显著优于基于GAN的SOTA模型（21.90 dB），且中断阈值越严格，性能优势越明显。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式区分并联合建模SNR的主体与尾部分布，VAE-EVT框架能够实现对极端低SNR事件的精确捕捉，有效解决传统无线电地图模型在URLLC中断预测中的尾部失效问题。

title: Measuring Structured Predictability in Neural Training Dynamics: A Cross-Regime Study
summary: Modern deep networks are trained through long update trajectories, yet their temporal organization remains less systematically characterized than architectures, losses, or optimizers. We study short-horizon predictability as a measure of temporal redundancy: where, when, and under which training conditions recent updates contain information about near-future parameter motion. We combine three complementary probe families, displacement-direction, subspace-residual, and predictor-based probes, with convention-aware, null-calibrated group-level readouts, and apply them to multi-pass vision training on CIFAR and public Pythia pretraining checkpoints. Across both regimes, vector-like tensors such as normalization parameters and biases (auxiliary parameters) exhibit simpler short-horizon dynamics than matrix-like feature-transforming weights (bulk parameters), whose predictable behavior concentrates in localized, time-varying pockets. Agreement within and across probe families, and with independent trajectory diagnostics, indicates that these measurements capture intrinsic trajectory structure, while probe differences distinguish complementary forms of temporal organization. Controlled CIFAR comparisons further show that architecture and training recipe systematically modulate the measured structure. A Pythia-70M case study further exposes a sequence of role-, depth-, and scale-dependent events, including bulk ESA falling below the random sign-agreement level and the emergence and redistribution of predictable qkv pockets across layers. These results position short-horizon predictability as a retrospective, parameter-resolved diagnostic of training dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出短视界可预测性作为衡量训练轨迹时间冗余度的诊断工具，通过三类互补探针（位移方向、子空间残差、基于预测器）结合约定感知和零校准的群组级读数，在CIFAR多遍视觉训练和Pythia预训练检查点上研究参数运动的可预测结构。发现向量型辅助参数（归一化参数和偏置）的短视界动力学比矩阵型主体权重更简单，主体权重的可预测行为集中在局部时变口袋中，并通过Pythia-70M案例暴露了角色、深度和尺度依赖的训练事件序列。
AI.motivation: 现代深度网络通过长时间更新轨迹训练，但其时间组织特性远不如架构、损失函数或优化器那样被系统地表征。作者希望建立一种能度量训练轨迹时间冗余度的方法，回答"在哪里、何时以及在何种训练条件下，近期更新包含关于近未来参数运动的信息"这一问题。
AI.method: 结合三种互补探针家族（位移方向探针、子空间残差探针和基于预测器的探针），采用约定感知（convention-aware）和零校准（null-calibrated）的群组级读数，应用于CIFAR多遍视觉训练和公共Pythia预训练检查点。通过探针家族内部及跨家族的一致性验证测量有效性，并在CIFAR上进行受控对照实验系统调制架构和训练方案。
AI.result: 两种训练体制均显示：向量型张量（归一化参数、偏置等辅助参数）表现出比矩阵型特征变换权重（主体权重）更简单的短视界动力学；主体权重的可预测行为集中在局部且时变的口袋中。探针家族内部及跨家族的一致性表明测量捕获了内在轨迹结构。CIFAR对照实验显示架构和训练方案系统性地调制测量结构。Pythia-70M案例研究揭示了系列角色、深度和尺度依赖的事件，包括主体ESA跌破随机符号一致水平，以及可预测qkv口袋在层间的出现和重新分布。
AI.conclusion: 短视界可预测性可作为一种回顾性的、参数分辨的训练动力学诊断工具，能够揭示训练轨迹中精细的时间组织结构和参数级差异，为理解和诊断深度网络训练过程提供新的视角。

title: ClawGym II: Exploring Black-Box RL on Agent Harness
summary: Agent harnesses have substantially improved performance on long-horizon tasks by coordinating agent interactions with the environment. However, reinforcement learning through complex harnesses remains largely unexplored, as scaling such training to long-horizon agent tasks introduces fundamental challenges. In this work, we present a unified black-box RL framework for stable and scalable optimization of general agents through complex harnesses. Concretely, we first build a sandbox-based execution infrastructure that isolates task environments and harnesses within temporary sandboxes for large-scale concurrent rollouts. We then decouple policy optimization from opaque harness execution and place a serving proxy at the model boundary to capture model calls. To reconstruct multi-turn trajectories and improve training efficiency, we organize the captured calls into prefix trees and further adapt both critic-based PPO and critic-free GRPO to optimize over the recovered tree structure. Meanwhile, we maintain training-inference consistency throughout the optimization process. Finally, we introduce mix-harness training, allowing a single model to be jointly optimized by heterogeneous harnesses. With Qwen3-30A3B, black-box RL improves Pass@1 on ClawGym-Bench by 9.98 and 14.81 points through OpenClaw and Claude Code, respectively, while remaining stable over 200-400 optimization steps. Moreover, the framework yields consistent gains on more challenging tasks such as JobBench and OfficeQA. Overall, our framework enables effective, stable, and scalable optimization of general agents through black-box harnesses, supporting unified training across heterogeneous execution systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的黑盒强化学习框架（Black-box RL），用于通过复杂的agent harness（代理执行框架）对通用智能体进行稳定、可扩展的优化。框架包含沙箱执行基础设施、代理边界模型调用捕获、前缀树多轮轨迹重建、PPO/GRPO自适应优化以及混合harness联合训练等核心组件，在ClawGym-Bench、JobBench和OfficeQA等任务上取得了显著提升。
AI.motivation: Agent harness虽已显著提升长时程任务的性能，但通过复杂harness进行强化学习仍未被充分探索。将强化学习扩展到长时程agent任务面临根本性挑战，缺乏一个稳定且可扩展的统一优化框架。
AI.method: 1) 构建基于沙箱的执行基础设施，将任务环境和harness隔离在临时沙箱中支持大规模并发rollout；2) 将策略优化与不透明的harness执行解耦，在模型边界放置代理服务器捕获模型调用；3) 将捕获的调用组织为前缀树以重建多轮轨迹并提升训练效率；4) 分别适配critic-based PPO和critic-free GRPO在恢复的树结构上进行优化；5) 维持训练-推理一致性；6) 引入混合harness训练（mix-harness training），使单个模型被异构harness联合优化。
AI.result: 使用Qwen3-30A3B模型，黑盒RL通过OpenClaw和Claude Code在ClawGym-Bench上分别将Pass@1提升了9.98和14.81个点，并在200-400个优化步骤中保持稳定；在JobBench和OfficeQA等更具挑战性的任务上也有持续增益。
AI.conclusion: 该框架实现了通过黑盒harness对通用agent进行有效、稳定和可扩展的优化，并支持跨异构执行系统的统一训练。

title: EA-LiteUNet: An Edge-Adaptive and Resource-Efficient U-Net for Boundary-Sensitive Dermoscopic Image Segmentation
summary: Accurate boundary delineation remains a persistent challenge in dermoscopic image segmentation because of blurred lesion margins, heterogeneous textures, and complex background artifacts. From a signal-processing perspective, lesion boundaries represent high-frequency components that are highly susceptible to aliasing, noise amplification, and information loss. Consequently, repeated downsampling and feature transformations in conventional convolutional architectures often lead to severely degraded boundary representations. To address these limitations, we propose EA-LiteUNet, an edge-adaptive and computationally efficient U-Net variant specifically designed for boundary-sensitive medical image segmentation. The architecture integrates three core mechanisms: (1) boundary-aware representation learning to suppress aliasing and preserve high-frequency structural details; (2) attention-guided feature modulation to selectively enhance boundary-relevant responses across multi-scale features; and (3) a resource-adaptive inference strategy to dynamically balance segmentation accuracy and computational efficiency. Extensive evaluations across three public dermoscopic datasets demonstrate that EA-LiteUNet consistently achieves superior boundary precision. Specifically, on the ISIC 2018 dataset, the method significantly reduces the 95% Hausdorff Distance (HD95) to 12.89 pixels while maintaining a robust Dice score of 92.08%. Notably, this strong performance is achieved with an ultralightweight configuration of merely 0.29M parameters and 1.17 GFLOPs. Ablation studies further validate the complementary effects of these components, confirming their contribution to enhanced boundary fidelity and stable optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EA-LiteUNet，一种边缘自适应的轻量级U-Net变体，专门用于解决皮肤镜图像分割中边界不清晰的问题。该架构通过边界感知表示学习、注意力引导特征调制和资源自适应推理三个核心机制，在ISIC 2018数据集上将HD95降至12.89像素、Dice达到92.08%，且仅需0.29M参数和1.17 GFLOPs计算量。
AI.motivation: 皮肤镜图像分割中，病变边界因模糊边缘、异质纹理和复杂背景伪影而难以精确描绘。从信号处理角度看，边界属于高频成分，易受混叠、噪声放大和信息丢失影响；传统卷积架构的反复下采样和特征变换会导致边界表征严重退化。因此需要一种能保留高频边界信息且计算高效的网络架构。
AI.method: EA-LiteUNet整合了三个核心机制：(1)边界感知表示学习，用于抑制混叠并保留高频结构细节；(2)注意力引导特征调制，在多尺度特征上有选择性地增强边界相关响应；(3)资源自适应推理策略，动态平衡分割精度与计算效率。
AI.result: 在三个公开皮肤镜数据集上的广泛评估表明EA-LiteUNet持续获得优越的边界精度。在ISIC 2018上，HD95显著降至12.89像素，Dice达到92.08%；同时仅需0.29M参数和1.17 GFLOPs计算量。消融实验验证了各组件的互补效应，确认了其在边界保真度和训练稳定性上的贡献。
AI.conclusion: EA-LiteUNet通过边界感知设计和超轻量级配置，在保持高分割精度的同时显著提升了边界保真度，验证了面向高频信息保留的架构设计在医学图像分割中的有效性，为资源受限场景下的精确边界分割提供了可行方案。

title: The Benchmark Trap: Structures of Power and Injustice in AI Evaluations
comment: to appear in the proceedings of AIES 2026
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) benchmarks are not neutral tools of evaluation but socio-technical artefacts that shape competition, power, and research priorities within AI. Benchmarks standardise the assessment of systems and facilitate the creation of leaderboards that reward state-of-the-art performance with prestige, citations, trust, and institutional influence. As the costs of developing competitive AI systems rise, these rewards increasingly concentrate among powerful, industry-funded labs. This paper situates these concerns within Iris Marion Young's theories of oppression and structural injustice. It argues that current benchmarking practices may perpetuate systematic harms affecting various actors in AI research, aligning with four of Young's "faces of oppression". Benchmarking culture is further framed as a source of structural injustice, as these harms emerge from normalised, individually defensible practices and network effects, even without explicit wrongdoing. By reinforcing existing power structures and narrowing possible research trajectories, benchmarking may in fact prevent the field from advancing in epistemically robust and socially beneficial ways.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Iris Marion Young的压迫与结构性不公正理论，论证AI基准测试并非中立的评估工具，而是塑造竞争、权力与研究优先级的 socio-technical 人工制品，可能延续系统性伤害并强化权力集中。
AI.motivation: 揭示AI基准测试的隐蔽权力维度——其并非价值中立，而是通过标准化评估和排行榜奖励机制，将声望、引用和机构影响力集中于少数产业资助的实验室，从而可能加剧结构性不公。
AI.method: 采用批判理论分析框架，将AI基准测试实践与Young的五个"压迫面相"中的四个进行对照映射，并通过结构性不公正的理论视角解释这些伤害如何从正常化、个体层面看似合理的实践中涌现。
AI.result: 识别出基准测试文化可能符合Young理论中的四个压迫面相；论证这些系统性伤害源于网络效应和规范化实践，即使不存在明确的不当行为仍构成结构性不公正。
AI.conclusion: 基准测试通过强化既有权力结构并收窄可能的研究路径，阻碍了AI领域在认识论上更稳健、社会效益上更有益的方向发展，需重新审视基准测试的设计与治理。

title: QSMP: finding representative time series subsequences through Quick Shift+Matrix Profile
comment: Accepted for publication in the 2026 IEEE International Workshop on Machine Learning for Signal Processing (MLSP)
summary: Finding representative waveforms in long time series has scientific and practical value in many domains, as it enables summarization and visualization of large time series datasets, and downstream tasks like classification and forecasting. We present here QSMP, a method to find representative waveforms in long time series through a density-guided clustering of time series subsequences. Our method makes a novel connection between Quick Shift, a mode-seeking algorithm, and the Matrix Profile, a time series similarity-search data structure, to adapt Quick Shift to the clustering of subsequences in long time series, with a space complexity that is superior to the state-of-the-art method. Our experiments on synthetic and real datasets show that QSMP can be a valuable tool to summarize and visualize long time series by finding representative waveforms.

AI.tldr: QSMP是一种通过密度引导聚类来查找长时间序列中代表性波形的方法，它创新性地结合了Quick Shift模式搜索算法与Matrix Profile相似性搜索数据结构，在空间复杂度上优于现有最先进方法，并在合成和真实数据集上验证了其作为时间序列摘要与可视化工具的有效性。
AI.motivation: 在长时间序列中查找代表性波形具有科学和实用价值，可用于大规模时间序列数据集的摘要、可视化以及分类、预测等下游任务，因此需要一种高效的方法来从子序列中发现代表性模式。
AI.method: QSMP通过密度引导的聚类方法来处理长时间序列，其核心创新在于将Quick Shift（一种模式搜索算法）与Matrix Profile（一种时间序列相似性搜索数据结构）建立新颖的联系，从而将Quick Shift适配到长时间序列子序列的聚类场景中，同时实现了优于现有最先进方法的空间复杂度。
AI.result: 在合成数据集和真实数据集上的实验表明，QSMP能够有效地通过查找代表性波形来对长时间序列进行摘要和可视化，证明了其作为一种实用工具的价值。
AI.conclusion: QSMP在长时间序列代表性波形发现方面表现出色，兼具较好的空间效率和实用的聚类效果，可以作为时间序列摘要与可视化的有价值的工具。

title: Model Hypnosis: Strong control of AI via additive subliminal effects
summary: We demonstrate that AI models are broadly susceptible to a phenomenon we call model hypnosis, in which individually weak and seemingly irrelevant cues in the prompt can be systematically combined to strongly control model behavior. Model hypnosis occurs across model families and scales, including in frontier reasoning models, and hypnotic prompts can transfer between models. Because the model is controlled by inconspicuous textual choices, such as paraphrases and typos, model hypnosis presents new challenges and avenues for AI safety, and is a major hurdle for AI interpretability.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了AI模型普遍存在的一种被称为"模型催眠"（model hypnosis）的现象：单个看似微弱且无关的提示线索可以被系统性组合，从而强烈控制模型行为。该现象跨越不同模型家族和规模，包括前沿推理模型，且催眠提示可在模型间转移。
AI.motivation: AI模型的行为控制通常被认为需要明确且强大的指令或复杂的越狱攻击。然而，作者发现即使是微小、看似无关的文本线索（如措辞变化或拼写错误）也能被系统性组合以支配模型行为，这对AI安全与可解释性构成重大挑战，亟需引起关注和研究。
AI.method: 作者通过对多种AI模型家族和规模（包括前沿推理模型）进行系统性实验，验证了"模型催眠"现象的存在及其普遍性，并测试了催眠提示在不同模型之间的可迁移性。
AI.result: 实验表明模型催眠在多种模型家族和规模上均普遍存在，甚至影响前沿推理模型；催眠提示能够在不同模型之间成功转移。这种控制由不显眼的文本选择（如改写、拼写错误）实现。
AI.conclusion: 模型催眠为AI安全引入了新的挑战和潜在研究途径，同时构成AI可解释性的重大障碍。理解并应对这一现象对于构建更安全、更可解释的AI系统至关重要。

title: CrossView: Can Vision-Language Models Reason Across Cameras?
summary: Video understanding benchmarks have long centered on single-camera settings, where modern multi-modal language models achieve strong performance across image and video tasks. Yet, the real world runs on multi-camera networks: autonomous vehicles, security systems, and robots all gather data across many simultaneous views. We argue that this is not simply "more" of the single-camera problem; it is fundamentally different. Multi-camera reasoning requires handling context that scales with the number of views, resolving occlusions visible from only a subset of cameras, judging which views matter, and integrating evidence across perspectives that may overlap or diverge. Current models struggle with exactly these challenges, yet no benchmark systematically targets them. We introduce CrossView, a multi-camera video question-answering benchmark spanning autonomous driving, security surveillance, egocentric/exocentric video, and robotics. Evaluation of proprietary models, such as GPT-5.2, and open-source models, like Qwen3-VL, reveals consistently low accuracy, with open-source models trailing by a wide margin. Performance scales strongly with a model's ability to jointly process multiple viewpoints, positioning CrossView as a rigorous benchmark for multi-camera video. We open-source our code and dataset at https://utaustin-swarmlab.github.io/CrossView.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CrossView，一个跨多个实际场景（自动驾驶、安防监控、第一/第三视角、机器人）的多摄像头视频问答基准，系统性地评估多模态语言模型在处理多视角推理（遮挡消解、视角相关性判断、跨视角证据整合）方面的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视频理解基准多局限于单摄像头设置，而现实世界（自动驾驶、安防、机器人）依赖多摄像头网络。多摄像头推理不是单摄像头问题的简单扩展，它涉及随视角数增长的上下文、仅部分视角可见的遮挡、视角重要性判断以及跨视角证据整合等独特挑战，但缺乏系统性评测基准。
AI.method: 构建CrossView基准，覆盖自动驾驶、安防监控、第一/第三视角视频和机器人四个领域；对GPT-5.2等专有模型和Qwen3-VL等开源模型进行多摄像头视频问答评测。
AI.result: 所有被测模型在多摄像头视频问答上准确率均很低，开源模型与专有模型差距显著；模型性能与其联合处理多视角的能力强相关。
AI.conclusion: CrossView为多摄像头视频理解提供了严格的评测基准，揭示了现有模型在该任务上的不足，为后续多视角推理研究指明方向。

title: A concentration result for multilayer feedforward neural networks
summary: We consider for an arbitrary fixed $ρ$ and for each positive integer $n$ a multilayer feedforward artificial neural network with $ρ$ layers, $n$ neurons in the first layer (the input layer) and only one neuron, the output neuron, in the last layer. Very roughly formulated, the main result is that if the distribution of weights of connections from a layer to the next are, for all large $n$, approximated well by a fixed continuous (but otherwise arbitrary) curve which does not depend on $n$, and if the values of the $n$ input neurons are independently and identically distributed with a continuous probability density function, then there is a number $ψ$ such that for all $\varepsilon > 0$ the probability that the value of the output neuron is in $[ψ- \varepsilon, ψ+ \varepsilon]$ tends to 1 as $n$ tends to infinity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多层前馈人工神经网络的输出收敛性。对于固定层数ρ、输入层含n个神经元且输出层含单个神经元的网络，当各层间连接权重的分布（对所有大的n）能被某一固定的连续曲线良好逼近，且输入神经元值独立同分布且具有连续概率密度函数时，输出神经元的取值将以概率趋于某个常数ψ。
AI.motivation: 理解大规模前馈神经网络在权重分布趋于稳定且输入随机时的输出行为，探究其输出是否具有确定性极限，从而为神经网络的统计特性和可预测性提供理论基础。
AI.method: 针对固定层数ρ的多层前馈网络，假设层间权重分布由一致的连续曲线近似，输入值独立同分布且具有连续概率密度。通过概率分析证明，输出神经元的值在任意小邻域[ψ−ε, ψ+ε]内的概率随n趋于无穷而趋近于1。
AI.result: 存在一个常数ψ，使得对任意ε>0，当n→∞时，输出神经元取值落在[ψ−ε, ψ+ε]内的概率趋于1，即输出在概率意义下收敛到确定值ψ。
AI.conclusion: 在权重分布稳定且输入为连续独立同分布随机变量的条件下，大规模多层前馈神经网络的输出几乎确定性地收敛到一个常数，表明此类网络在大规模极限下表现出可预测的确定性行为。

title: PERO: Efficient Robust Post-Training Foundation Models for Encrypted Traffic Classification
summary: Encrypted traffic classification is vital for network security, yet real-world deployments are inherently sensitive to rare but high-loss errors such as misclassification of malicious traffic. The encrypted traffic foundation model, as a promising general-purpose technique, can achieve impressive overall performance. However, employing standard objectives such as empirical risk minimization often overlooks high-risk tail events, and commonly used performance metrics hardly reflect robustness limitations in risk-sensitive scenarios. Directly applying robust optimization objectives, such as conditional value-at-risk, to post-training is computationally prohibitive for large models, as identifying high-loss samples exhausts substantial computation. To this end, we propose Pre-Evaluation Robust Optimization (PERO), an efficient robust post-training framework for encrypted traffic foundation models. PERO employs a lightweight proxy to estimate sample-wise risk and selects a subset of high-risk samples to update the foundation model, decoupling risk estimation from expensive large-model optimization. Extensive experiments on typical encrypted traffic datasets show that PERO achieves competitive or superior robustness and average performance compared to outstanding robust post-training methods, while significantly reducing computational and memory costs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PERO（Pre-Evaluation Robust Optimization），一种针对加密流量基础模型的高效鲁棒后训练框架。通过轻量代理模型估计样本风险并选择高风险子集进行更新，将风险估计与大模型优化解耦，在保持鲁棒性和平均性能的同时显著降低计算和内存成本。
AI.motivation: 加密流量分类对网络安全至关重要，但真实部署中罕见但高损失的错误（如恶意流量误分类）具有高敏感性。现有加密流量基础模型虽能取得优秀的整体性能，但标准的经验风险最小化目标容易忽视高风险尾部事件，常用性能指标难以反映风险敏感场景下的鲁棒性局限。直接在后训练中应用条件风险价值（CVaR）等鲁棒优化目标对于大规模模型计算代价极高，因为识别高损失样本需要大量计算。
AI.method: PERO框架包含三个关键要素：(1) 使用轻量代理模型估计样本级风险，避免在大模型上直接计算；(2) 基于代理模型的风险估计选择高风险样本子集；(3) 仅用该高风险子集更新基础模型，实现风险估计与昂贵的大模型优化解耦，从而大幅降低计算和内存开销。
AI.result: 在典型加密流量数据集上的大量实验表明，PERO在鲁棒性和平均性能方面均可与优秀的鲁棒后训练方法相媲美甚至更优，同时显著降低了计算和内存成本。
AI.conclusion: PERO为加密流量基础模型提供了一种高效、可扩展的鲁棒后训练方案，有效解决了风险敏感场景下鲁棒优化的计算瓶颈，在保证安全关键性能的同时实现了成本效益的显著提升。

title: Towards Computational Provenance: Carrying Causal-State Evidence in Generated Text
summary: A language model's output does not by itself provide verifiable evidence about the internal computation that produced it. We study computational provenance: whether generated text can carry detectable evidence of which causally relevant internal state occurred. We test a bounded form of this idea in two controlled architectures: a modular feed-forward neural network and a transformer-based model. Both architectures are trained on the same arithmetic task with a mandatory pathway through two discrete intermediate states, allowing different internal paths to produce the same answer. We deliberately switch between these paths, authenticate the state actually used, and let that verified state determine a subtle statistical pattern in the generated text that can later be detected. The feed-forward and transformer systems each passed all 128 matched pairs in both their public and separately sealed protected end-to-end evaluations, with the detector recovering the signal associated with the authenticated internal state. The required causal computation also reproduced across five independently trained feed-forward models and three independently trained transformers. In a separate answer-only transformer experiment, our linear probes did not recover a naturally learned intermediate state. These results provide a controlled proof of concept that information about a verified, causally relevant internal state can be preserved in generated text even when the answer is unchanged.

AI.tldr: 本文通过两种受控架构（模块化前馈神经网络和Transformer）证明：经过验证的、因果相关的内部状态信息可以以微妙的统计模式编码到生成文本中，即使最终答案不变，检测器仍能可靠地恢复该信号，实现计算溯源。
AI.motivation: 语言模型的输出本身无法提供关于其内部计算的直接可验证证据。作者希望探索"计算溯源"（computational provenance）的概念，即生成的文本是否能携带可检测的、关于哪个因果相关内部状态实际发生了的证据。这是关于AI系统可解释性和可验证性的基础问题。
AI.method: 在两种受控架构（模块化前馈神经网络和Transformer）上，训练它们完成同一算术任务，并强制经过两个离散中间状态的通路，使得不同内部路径可产生相同答案。实验设计上，研究者有意在不同路径之间切换，对实际使用的状态进行认证（authenticate），并让该已验证状态决定生成文本中一个微妙的统计模式，后续可由检测器恢复。评估包含公开端到端评测和独立密封的保护性端到端评测。
AI.result: 前馈网络和Transformer系统在公开与密封保护评测中均通过全部128组匹配对，检测器成功恢复与已验证内部状态关联的信号。该因果计算在5个独立训练的前馈模型和3个独立训练的Transformer上均可复现。在单独的仅答案（answer-only）Transformer实验中，线性探针未能恢复自然学习到的中间状态。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一个受控的概念验证，表明即使最终答案不变，关于已验证的因果相关内部状态的信息也可以保留在生成文本中。但补充实验也显示，自然学习（非有意设计）的中间状态可能难以通过线性探针恢复，说明该能力的实现需要特定的设计条件。

title: RigidBench: Evaluating Rigid-Body Physics in Video Generation Models
comment: 30 pages, including appendices. Code: https://github.com/swarnim-j/RigidBench. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21649156
summary: Video models are increasingly used to predict what happens next in a scene, yet the metrics commonly used to compare their outputs say little about whether the predicted objects move correctly. Motion, geometry, identity, background stability, and visual similarity can fail independently, but whole-frame scores often mix these errors together. We introduce RigidBench, a simulator-grounded benchmark that compares a generated continuation with a reference rollout from the same initial frame and motion description. Its five rigid-body tasks vary objects, materials, viewpoints, and indoor and outdoor scenes, with per-frame masks, depth, 6-DoF trajectories, and contacts available for scoring. We evaluate eight models on the same 100 examples with ten measurements that keep these aspects separate. The resulting rankings depend strongly on what is measured: no model leads on all ten, and across model means, higher SSIM accompanies larger 3D trajectory error (r = 0.89). RigidBench also includes 5,000 training videos with exact simulator state, which we use to fine-tune and analyze Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B. Full fine-tuning reduces 3D trajectory error by about 20% with almost no change in SSIM, while teacher-forced probes and targeted interventions show that object position is represented throughout Wan's diffusion transformer and used by its denoising computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RigidBench——一个基于模拟器的刚性物体视频预测基准，将生成视频的评测分解为运动、几何、身份、背景稳定性、视觉相似性等多个独立维度。作者评估了8个模型在100个样例上的10项指标，发现排名强烈依赖于评测维度，且SSIM与3D轨迹误差呈显著正相关(r=0.89)。此外，RigidBench提供5000个带精确模拟器状态的训练视频，作者用其对Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B进行全量微调，将3D轨迹误差降低约20%而SSIM几乎不变，并通过教师强制探测和目标干预实验揭示物体位置贯穿Wan的扩散Transformer并被去噪计算使用。
AI.motivation: 现有视频预测模型评测指标（如全帧评分）无法区分运动、几何、身份、背景稳定性、视觉相似性等不同维度的错误，导致模型对比结果无法揭示物体运动是否正确。各维度可独立失效，但全局评分将这些错误混在一起，缺乏能够解耦这些方面的评测基准。
AI.method: 基于模拟器构建RigidBench基准：(1)设计5类刚体任务，覆盖不同物体、材料、视点和室内外场景；(2)提供逐帧掩码、深度、6-DoF轨迹和接触信息用于细粒度评分；(3)在同一初始帧和运动描述下，将生成延续与参考滚动作比较；(4)提出10项分别保持各个维度的测量指标；(5)包含5000个带精确模拟器状态的训练视频，用于微调Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B并进行机制分析。
AI.result: 8个模型在100个样例的10项指标上排名强烈依赖于评测维度，没有模型在所有指标上领先；跨模型均值中，SSIM越高伴随更大的3D轨迹误差(r=0.89)。对Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B全量微调将3D轨迹误差降低约20%，SSIM几乎无变化；教师强制探测和定向干预实验表明物体位置在Wan的扩散Transformer各层中均有表征，且被去噪计算所利用。
AI.conclusion: 视频预测模型的评测需要解耦不同质量维度，单一全局评分会掩盖运动准确性的不足；模型在视觉相似性上的表现与3D运动准确性之间存在系统性权衡；通过模拟器数据微调可显著提升物理运动准确性而不损失视觉质量；Wan扩散Transformer中的物体位置信息被去噪过程有效利用。

title: Incoherent by Design? On the Moral Self-Consistency of LLMs
comment: 88 pages; pages 16 to 88 are the appendix
summary: LLMs are increasingly used in morally sensitive contexts, yet it is unclear whether they apply ethical principles consistently across situations. A model that can state a moral principle may still violate it when the same scenario is rephrased or reframed. This inconsistency is a problem for any system whose outputs are used to inform moral decisions. If generative systems exhibit internal inconsistency, then the epistemic integrity of AI-mediated systems becomes uncertain. To study this concern, we investigate the stability of moral reasoning in LLMs within a controlled prompting framework across three major philosophical schools of thought: deontology, utilitarianism, and virtue ethics. We construct sets of morally equivalent scenarios in which the underlying situation is held constant while the framing varies to reflect different ethical stances and stylistic perturbations. We then evaluate responses from multiple models, including GPT, Mistral, and Llama. To assess consistency, we convert model outputs into structured logical statements and identify contradictions across responses generated within the same school of thought. Our results reveal substantial inconsistency with contradiction rates reaching up to 78% across scenarios. These findings point to a broader phenomenon of epistemic instability in generative AI wherein models fail to reliably maintain coherence with respect to their own prior outputs. This kind of instability carries real consequences. As generative systems influence how people form beliefs, judge actions, and absorb values, their inconsistencies can shape human reasoning and decision-making as well. Moreover, if a system cannot consistently represent its own normative commitments, then value alignment becomes a moving target rather than a well-defined objective. Thus, we argue that demonstrating internal incoherence is a necessary precursor to AI alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文通过控制提示框架，系统评估了大型语言模型（GPT、Mistral、Llama）在三种主要道德哲学流派（义务论、功利主义、美德伦理）下的道德推理稳定性，发现模型在道德等价场景中表现出高达78%的矛盾率，揭示了大模型存在严重的内部不一致性，并对AI对齐和人类道德决策产生深远影响。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地被用于道德敏感场景，但尚不清楚它们是否能在不同情境下保持一致地应用伦理原则。一个能陈述道德原则的模型在场景改写或重新框架化后可能违反该原则。这种不一致性会影响任何用于道德决策的系统输出，且如果生成系统表现出内部不一致性，AI中介系统的认知完整性将变得不确定。因此，需要系统研究LLM道德推理的稳定性。
AI.method: 研究者构建了道德等价场景集，即在保持底层情境不变的前提下改变框架以反映不同伦理立场和风格扰动。选择三种主要哲学流派：义务论、功利主义和美德伦理。对GPT、Mistral和Llama等多个模型进行提示评估，并将模型输出转换为结构化逻辑陈述，检测同一哲学流派内多次响应中的矛盾。通过矛盾率衡量道德推理的一致性。
AI.result: 研究发现模型在道德推理中表现出显著的不一致性，同一流派内的矛盾率高达78%。这表明大语言模型无法可靠地维持与其自身先前输出的一致性，即使面对道德等价的情境，模型也会产生相互矛盾的判断。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型的道德推理存在根本性的认知不稳定，这种不一致性会影响人类信念形成、行为判断和价值吸收。由于模型无法一致地表达自身规范性承诺，价值对齐成为一个移动目标而非明确目标。因此，证明内部不连贯性是AI对齐的必要前提。

title: UniFed-VLM: Federated Instruction Tuning for Vision-Language Models with Multiple Heterogeneity
summary:
