Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in multimodal understanding and generation. However, fine-tuning of VLMs typically relies on centralized data, which raises privacy concerns in certain domains (e.g. healthcare). Federated Learning (FL) provides a natural solution by enabling model training without sharing raw data. However, applying FL to VLM instruction tuning is highly challenging. VLMs have substantial parameter scales, and in real-world scenarios, clients exhibit significant heterogeneity in tasks, modalities, and model architectures.
  Existing methods mainly focus on simplified settings and are unable to handle such multi-dimensional heterogeneous scenarios. In this work, we study federated instruction tuning under joint heterogeneity in tasks, modalities, and model architectures.
  We propose UniFed-VLM, a unified federated instruction tuning framework for VLMs that addresses multiple types of heterogeneity. It consists of two key components: 1) Federated Compensated Subspace Aggregation (FedCSA), which performs subspace-aligned aggregation of parameter-efficient adapters with dynamic weighting and compensation to mitigate heterogeneity-induced conflicts; 2) Two-stage Collaborative Distillation (TCoD), which enables effective knowledge transfer across heterogeneous models via a Mutual Distillation Adapter (MDA) and a mixture-of-experts-based distillation strategy. We conduct experiments on multiple benchmark datasets, and the results show that UniFed-VLM achieves stronger average performance across diverse tasks compared with existing FL methods. The source code is available at: https://github.com/wangpengyu2004/UniFed-VLM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UniFed-VLM，一个统一的联邦指令微调框架，用于在任务、模态和模型架构三重异质性并存的场景下对视觉-语言模型进行联邦指令微调。
AI.motivation: VLM微调依赖集中式数据，在医疗等场景存在隐私问题；FL虽能解决隐私问题，但VLM参数量大且真实场景中客户端在任务、模态和模型架构上高度异构，现有方法仅处理简化设置，无法应对多维异构场景。
AI.method: UniFed-VLM包含两个核心组件：1) 联邦补偿子空间聚合(FedCSA)，通过对参数高效适配器进行子空间对齐聚合，并采用动态加权和补偿机制来缓解异构性引起的冲突；2) 两阶段协作蒸馏(TCoD)，通过互蒸馏适配器(MDA)和基于混合专家(MoE)的蒸馏策略实现异构模型间的有效知识迁移。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，UniFed-VLM在多样任务上的平均性能优于现有联邦学习方法。
AI.conclusion: UniFed-VLM有效解决了VLM联邦指令微调中任务、模态和模型架构三重异构带来的挑战，为分布式隐私保护的VLM微调提供了统一解决方案。

title: Catching Hallucinated Citations in Video-LLM Question Answering: A Self-Verification Pipeline and Verifier Ablation Study
summary: Video question answering systems built on vision-language models often produce timestamped claims with high confidence even when unsupported by the cited frame. This deceptive hallucination arises because timestamps imply grounding without ensuring correctness, increasing user trust but not accuracy. We introduce a pipeline that closes this loop. A retrieval-augmented language model drafts answers with per-claim timestamp citations, and each cited frame is independently re-examined before being shown to the user. We compare against a plain baseline and ablate three verification designs, evaluated on both Apple Silicon (MLX) and Google Colab (HF Transformers, CUDA). Directly asking the vision model whether a frame supports a claim fails completely (0% catch rate on 40 claims) due to sycophancy. Blind re-captioning plus a general LLM judge improves results but is unstable, oscillating between 0% and 100% flagged depending on prompt phrasing. Replacing that judge with a small natural language inference model yields a stable, interpretable verifier that catches 79% of fabricated claims on adversarial false-premise questions while leaving true claims untouched. We release the full pipeline, evaluation harness, and implementations for both Apple Silicon and Colab. Code is available at https://github.com/yogesh-iitj/grounded-video-qa.

AI.tldr: 本文针对视频问答系统中视觉语言模型产生的"欺骗性幻觉"（时间戳引用暗示接地但缺乏正确性验证）问题，提出了一种闭环管线：先用检索增强语言模型生成带逐声明时间戳引用的答案，再对每个被引用的帧进行独立验证。对比了三种验证设计，发现直接询问视觉模型会因谄媚效应完全失败（0%捕获率），盲重生成配通用LLM判断器不稳定（0-100%波动），而用小规模自然语言推理模型作为判断器则稳定可解释，能捕获79%的伪造声明且不误伤真实声明。
AI.motivation: 视频问答系统基于视觉语言模型生成带时间戳的声明，但经常在缺乏帧支持的情况下高置信度输出。时间戳的引用会暗示了"接地性"从而提高用户信任，却并未保证正确性。这种欺骗性幻觉亟待解决。
AI.method: 提出一个两级管线：(1) 检索增强语言模型（RAG）生成带逐声明时间戳引用的答案；(2) 每个被引用的帧在展示给用户前被独立重新审查。对比一个普通基线和三种验证设计变体：直接向视觉模型询问帧是否支持声明、盲重生成加通用LLM判断器、盲重生成加小型NLI模型判断器。评估在Apple Silicon（MLX）和Google Colab（HF Transformers, CUDA）两平台上进行。
AI.result: 直接询问视觉模型因谄媚效应完全失败（40条声明0%捕获率）；盲重生成+通用LLM判断器不稳定，随提示措辞在0%到100%之间振荡；盲重生成+小型NLI模型作为判断器表现稳定且可解释，在对抗性虚假前提问题上捕获79%的伪造声明，同时不误伤真实声明。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了用小型NLI模型替代通用LLM判断器可以稳定且准确地检测视频问答中的伪造时间戳声明，为构建可信的视频问答系统提供了有效方案。整套管线、评估框架及两个平台（Apple Silicon和Colab）的实现均已开源。

title: UC-PSRO: Utility-Conditioned Policy-Space Response Oracles with a Communication-Dropout Curriculum for Game-Theoretic Course-of-Action Generation in Adversarial Swarms
summary: We study generating game-theoretically optimized Courses of Action (COAs) for a Blue UAS swarm against an adaptive Red adversary in a communication-degraded environment, motivated by (but not derived from) a public U.S. Air Force SBIR solicitation. We propose UC-PSRO (Utility-Conditioned Policy-Space Response Oracles with a Communication-Dropout Curriculum), combining three mechanisms: (i) PSRO self-play, so Blue and Red policies train as approximate best responses to each other rather than one side against a fixed scripted opponent; (ii) FiLM conditioning of the Blue policy on a Commander's-Intent weight vector, sampled from a Dirichlet distribution during training, so one trained policy is re-steerable at execution time without retraining; and (iii) a curriculum annealing communication-graph edge dropout during training, so the swarm learns decentralized, peer-to-peer fallback instead of depending on full connectivity. We evaluate on a synthetic, unclassified stand-in for the solicitation's maritime scenario, with 5 seeds at N=25 Blue agents and a scalability sweep to N=200. We find a genuine trade-off, not a uniform win: the communication-dropout curriculum alone gives the strongest, most robust mission-completion rates of any learned method, improving counter-intuitively as denial increases (35% to 62% success as dropout rises from 0 to 0.75); adding utility-conditioning and PSRO self-play substantially slows convergence within a fixed budget, and we find no reliable exploitability advantage for self-play over a fixed-opponent policy, both statistically indistinguishable from a small, near-zero gap. We report this honestly as a convergence cost not yet offset by a demonstrated robustness benefit, rather than overstating one method as dominant, and provide a fully vectorized, open environment training at N=200 agents in single-digit milliseconds per step on a single consumer GPU.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UC-PSRO（带通信丢包课程的效用条件化策略空间响应预言机），用于在通信退化环境下生成对抗自适应红方的蓝方UAS蜂群行动方案。采用PSRO自博弈、基于FiLM的指挥官意图效用条件化、以及通信图边丢包课程三种机制。实验发现：丢包课程单独使用效果最优且随干扰增大性能反升（35%→62%），而效用条件化和自博弈会增加收敛成本且无明显鲁棒性优势，作者如实报告了这一权衡而非夸大某一方法。
AI.motivation: 通信退化环境下蓝方无人机蜂群需要对抗自适应对手生成博弈论最优的行动方案，而现有方法通常让一方对抗固定脚本对手，缺乏对抗性与适应性。
AI.method: 提出UC-PSRO框架，包含三个机制：(i) PSRO自博弈使蓝红双方策略互为近似最优响应；(ii) 在蓝方策略上通过FiLM对指挥官意图权重向量（训练时从Dirichlet分布采样）进行条件化，使单个策略可在执行时重新定向而无需重训；(iii) 训练时以课程方式退火通信图边的丢包率，让蜂群学会去中心化的对等回退策略。在合成海事场景上评估，N=25×5种子并扩展至N=200。
AI.result: 通信丢包课程单独使用取得最强且最鲁棒的使命完成率，且随丢包率从0增至0.75成功率反升（35%→62%）；加入效用条件化和PSRO自博弈显著拖慢固定预算内的收敛速度，自博弈相对固定对手策略无可探测的可利用性优势（差距接近零且统计不显著）。环境高度向量化，单消费级GPU上N=200时每步仅需个位数毫秒。
AI.conclusion: 结论是存在真实的权衡而非任一方法全面占优：丢包课程带来的鲁棒性收益尚未抵消效用条件化和自博弈带来的收敛成本，作者如实报告了这一发现而非过度宣称某个方法的优越性。

title: Guaranteed Adaptive Modality Acquisition: When the Policy Chooses Its Own Calibration Group
comment: 23 pages, 4 figures, 14 tables. Includes appendix with full proofs and additional experiments
summary: A multimodal system may begin inference holding only some of its inputs and may acquire the rest at a cost. With adaptive acquisition, the policy determines which inputs are ultimately observed, so we state the guarantee conditional on that terminal input pattern. Conditional calibration normally assumes the grouping map is fixed independently of the calibration sample, which policy-induced grouping does not satisfy. We characterize when pattern-conditional guarantees remain valid and give two finite-sample constructions: threshold-free routing with calibration applied at the terminal pattern, and simultaneous certification of complete policy-pattern pairs, which lets calibration data select the deployed policy. A counterexample shows that a guarantee proved for a calibration-independent grouping map need not transfer once the policy makes the terminal group calibration-dependent. We call the resulting method RouteCert. On a clinical electrocardiogram task with a staged, cost-ordered lead protocol, the certified policy answers 71.2% of held-out patients at an observed 7.4% disagreement with the cardiologist's diagnosis at 48.8% of the prespecified ordinal cost of acquiring every stage, and all three acquisition stages carry their own certificate. On masked multimodal benchmarks, certifying pointwise at each terminal pattern holds observed worst-pattern selective risk, measured against the full-information reference decision rather than the true label, at 0.034 where a pooled design reaches 0.145 against a 0.10 cap, at a comparable answered fraction (0.350 vs 0.342); under the budget-matched simultaneous comparison the answered fraction falls to 0.305.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RouteCert方法，解决多模态系统中自适应输入获取（adaptive acquisition）条件下的条件校准（conditional calibration）保证问题。在策略（policy）决定哪些输入被观测的情况下，传统的分组映射固定假设不再成立。论文刻画了模式条件保证仍然有效的条件，并给出两种有限样本构造方法，在临床心电图任务和多模态基准上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 多模态系统可能仅持有部分输入就开始推理，其余输入可以付费获取。在自适应获取中，策略决定最终观测哪些输入，这导致终端输入模式（terminal input pattern）是由策略依赖校准样本选择的。传统的条件校准假设分组映射独立于校准样本，而策略诱导的分组映射不满足该假设，因此需要刻画模式条件保证成立的条件，并设计有效的有限样本校准方法。
AI.method: RouteCert包含两种有限样本构造：(1) 无阈值路由（threshold-free routing），在终端模式上直接应用校准；(2) 对完整的策略-模式对（policy-pattern pairs）进行同时认证，使校准数据可以用于选择部署的策略。文中还通过反例证明，为校准无关分组映射证明的保证在策略使终端分组变为校准依赖后不再成立。此外，采用了选择性风险（selective risk）的衡量方式，参考完全信息决策（full-information reference decision）而非真实标签。
AI.result: 在临床心电图任务中（分阶段、成本有序的导联协议），认证策略在48.8%的规定序数成本下回答了71.2%的留出患者，与心脏病专家诊断的观测不一致率为7.4%，所有三个采集阶段均带有各自的证书。在多模态基准上，逐终端模式的逐点认证在0.10上限下达到了0.034的最差模式选择性风险，而池化（pooled）设计仅为0.145；回答比例相近（0.350 vs 0.342），在预算匹配的同时比较下回答比例降至0.305。
AI.conclusion: RouteCert为自适应获取场景下的多模态系统提供了一种有效的有限样本条件校准框架。它明确揭示了传统条件校准保证在策略诱导分组下的失效问题，并给出了可行的替代构造。实验表明该方法在临床任务和通用多模态基准上均能维持严格的风险控制，同时保持较高的回答覆盖率。

title: PoseAdapter: Dual-Stream 2.5D Controllable Image Generation for Complex Multi-Object Scenes
summary: While Text-to-Image (T2I) diffusion models have achieved remarkable success, precise spatial and orientational control in multi-object scenes remains a persistent challenge. Existing methods either rely on computationally expensive dense 3D maps or suffer from severe attribute leakage and "cut-and-paste" artifacts. To address these limitations, we propose PoseAdapter, a lightweight framework for high-fidelity 2.5D controllable image generation. Instead of dense spatial maps, it establishes precise spatial-angular anchors using an efficient condition layout: individual object captions, 2D bounding boxes, and 3D angles. To resolve the generative trade-off between strict instance isolation and global coherence, we introduce a Context-Aware Dual-Stream Representation. By injecting local object tokens and relation-enriched scene tokens into the visual stream of modern MM-DiT architectures via parallel masked and unmasked pathways, PoseAdapter eliminates attribute leakage while preserving natural inter-object relationships and scene-level coherence. To support this paradigm, we construct OrientLayout, a high-quality dataset featuring standardized 2.5D annotations and instance-level decoupled semantics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PoseAdapter outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in spatial accuracy, orientational precision, and multi-object visual fidelity. Code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/cyf23/PoseAdapter.

AI.tldr: PoseAdapter是一个轻量级框架，通过对象字幕、2D边界框和3D角度的高效条件布局实现2.5D可控图像生成，并引入上下文感知双流表示（Context-Aware Dual-Stream Representation）解决属性泄漏与全局一致性的权衡问题，配套构建OrientLayout数据集，在空间精度、方向精度和多对象视觉保真度上超越SOTA基线。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I扩散模型在多对象场景的空间和方向控制上存在挑战：现有方法要么依赖计算昂贵的密集3D图，要么面临严重的属性泄漏和"剪切粘贴"伪影问题，缺乏轻量且高保真的2.5D控制方案。
AI.method: 提出PoseAdapter轻量级框架，核心创新包括：(1) 采用高效条件布局（对象字幕+2D边界框+3D角度）代替密集空间图；(2) 提出Context-Aware Dual-Stream Representation，通过并行掩码/非掩码路径将局部对象token和关系增强的场景token注入MM-DiT架构的视觉流，同时保证实例隔离与全局一致性；(3) 构建OrientLayout高质量数据集，包含标准化2.5D标注和实例级解耦语义。
AI.result: 大量实验表明PoseAdapter在空间精度、方向精度和多对象视觉保真度上均优于现有SOTA基线方法。
AI.conclusion: PoseAdapter通过轻量化的条件布局与双流表示机制，有效解决了多对象可控生成中属性泄漏与全局相干性的矛盾，为高保真2.5D图像生成提供了高效方案，并公开了代码与数据集。

title: FedPA-LoRA: Product-Aligned Framework for Mitigating Aggregation and Initialization Errors in Heterogeneous Federated LoRA
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient federated fine-tuning of large language models, but its factorized parameterization creates a tension between accurate aggregation of local updates and continuity of locally optimized factors. Factor-wise aggregation incurs aggregation mismatch but better preserves factor continuity, whereas product-space reconstruction reduces this mismatch at the cost of greater factor-level initialization mismatch from newly reconstructed factors. We propose FedPA-LoRA, a product-aligned federated LoRA framework that jointly addresses these limitations and provably converges under both homogeneous and heterogeneous client ranks. Each client preserves its local factors across communication rounds and aligns its product toward a rank-specific global reference, maintaining local optimization continuity while promoting global consistency under data heterogeneity. The server aggregates heterogeneous-rank updates in the common product space and efficiently reconstructs a rank-constrained global adapter without forming the dense aggregate. This design supports client-specific computation and communication budgets. Experiments on natural language understanding and generation tasks show that FedPA-LoRA consistently outperforms representative baselines across varying levels of data heterogeneity and homogeneous- and heterogeneous-rank settings, with up to a $6.82$ percentage-point improvement in average GLUE accuracy under heterogeneous client ranks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FedPA-LoRA，一种面向联邦学习场景的产品对齐低秩适配（LoRA）框架，通过让每个客户端在通信轮次间保留本地因子并将乘积对齐到秩特定的全局参考，同时在共同乘积空间中聚合异构秩更新，解决了因子聚合不匹配与因子连续性之间的权衡问题，并在同构和异构客户端秩设置下均证明收敛。实验显示在GLUE任务上最高提升6.82个百分点。
AI.motivation: LoRA的因子化参数化在联邦微调中存在内在矛盾：按因子聚合（factor-wise aggregation）会造成聚合不匹配，但能更好地保持因子连续性；而乘积空间重建虽能减少聚合不匹配，却因重建新因子而带来更大的因子级初始化不匹配。现有方法无法同时解决这两个问题。
AI.method: FedPA-LoRA的核心设计包括：(1)每个客户端在通信轮次间保留其本地因子（保持局部优化连续性），并将乘积对齐到秩特定的全局参考（促进数据异构下的全局一致性）；(2)服务器在共同乘积空间中聚合异构秩的更新，并高效重建秩约束的全局适配器，无需形成稠密聚合；(3)支持客户端特定的计算与通信预算，且在异构客户端秩下仍能证明收敛。
AI.result: 在自然语言理解和生成任务上的实验表明，FedPA-LoRA在不同数据异构程度以及同构/异构秩设置下均一致优于代表性基线，在异构客户端秩设置下平均GLUE准确率最高提升6.82个百分点。
AI.conclusion: FedPA-LoRA通过产品对齐策略有效调和了联邦LoRA中聚合准确性与因子连续性之间的张力，为异构客户端秩和异构数据的联邦微调提供了高效且理论上可收敛的解决方案。

title: Spectral Saliency for Machine Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning (MU) aims to remove the influence of specific training data while preserving model utility. As the name suggests, MU can be viewed as the inverse of learning, using gradient-based updates to reduce the influence of a forget-set by counteracting the previously learned behavior. Recently, Muon, a gradient descent variant, has been introduced. Muon applies spectral magnitude normalization to encourage exploration of rare directions and demonstrates promising performance. Inspired by Muon, we adopt the spectral view for unlearning and propose Spectral Saliency Unlearning (SSU). SSU thresholds weak singular components and updates only those directions supported by a confident unlearning signal. We further provide theoretical justification for this thresholding approach from the perspective of the forgetting-retention trade-off. Experiments across image classifiers, diffusion models, and LLMs demonstrate SSU's effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SSU（Spectral Saliency Unlearning）方法，受Muon优化器的谱视角启发，通过阈值化弱奇异分量并仅沿置信未学习信号支持的方向更新模型，实现机器未学习。理论证明该阈值方法在遗忘-保留权衡上的优势，并在图像分类器、扩散模型和LLM上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 机器未学习旨在移除特定训练数据的影响同时保持模型效用。传统梯度更新方法效率较低，而近期Muon优化器通过谱幅度归一化鼓励探索稀有方向展现出潜力。本文借用谱视角，希望更精准地定位与遗忘集相关的参数方向，实现更高效的未学习。
AI.method: SSU采用谱分解（奇异值分解）分析梯度/参数的谱结构，阈值化弱的奇异分量（即低置信度方向），仅沿那些由置信未学习信号支持的强方向更新模型参数。同时提供理论分析，证明该阈值策略在遗忘-保留权衡中的优势。
AI.result: 在图像分类器、扩散模型和大型语言模型（LLM）上进行实验，结果表明SSU在机器未学习中显著优于现有方法，能有效遗忘目标数据的同时保留模型的整体效用。
AI.conclusion: 从谱视角出发的SSU方法为机器未学习提供了新的高效范式，阈值化弱奇异分量既能增强遗忘效果又能保护模型保留能力，理论分析与实验共同验证了该方法的可行性与普适性。

title: AlloEgo-VLM: Disambiguating Allocentric and Egocentric Reference Frames in Vision-Language Models
comment: 28 pages, 9 figures. Project page and code available at https://github.com/CKL9001/AlloEgo-VLM
summary: This study investigates the challenge of ambiguity faced by Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in understanding spatial semantics. Spatial cognition, shaped by cognitive psychology, spatial science, and cultural context, often assigns directionality to objects. However, natural language descriptions of spatial relations frequently omit explicit reference frames, leading to semantic ambiguity and potentially serious errors for embodied AI robots. Existing VLMs, due to insufficient training on reference frames and object orientations, often produce inconsistent responses. To address this issue, we construct a new dataset, AlloEgo-View, comprising (image, query, view-specific answer) triplets that capture key object relations from both allocentric and egocentric perspectives. The view-specific descriptions follow a structured spatial representation that annotate detailed scene descriptions, reference and target objects, their orientations, reference frames, and view types. Building on AlloEgo-View, we develop AlloEgo-VLM, a framework to disambiguate allocentric and egocentric reference frames, even under ambiguous queries, and to be easily integrated into existing VLMs via supervised fine-tuning. Furthermore, we deploy our framework onto an embodied robotic platform within NVIDIA Isaac Sim to validate its real-world feasibility in open-ended object searching tasks. Experiments highlight the limitations of current VLMs in handling view-specific queries and demonstrate the strong disambiguation ability of AlloEgo-VLM.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究视觉语言模型（VLM）在空间语义理解中面临的歧义问题，构建了AlloEgo-View数据集并开发AlloEgo-VLM框架，用于消解异我中心（allocentric）与自我中心（egocentric）参考框架的歧义，并在NVIDIA Isaac Sim仿真环境中进行了具身机器人验证。
AI.motivation: 自然语言中描述空间关系时常省略明确的参考框架，导致语义歧义，现有VLM因缺乏参考框架和物体方向性的训练而产生不一致的响应，这对具身AI机器人在开放世界中的空间理解和导航可能造成严重错误。
AI.method: 构建了AlloEgo-View数据集，包含（图像、查询、视角特定回答）三元组，从异我中心和自我中心两个视角捕获关键物体关系；采用结构化的空间表示对场景描述、参考/目标物体、物体方向、参考框架和视角类型进行详细标注。在此基础上开发AlloEgo-VLM框架，通过监督微调（SFT）将消歧能力集成到现有VLM中，并在NVIDIA Isaac Sim仿真环境中部署到具身机器人平台进行验证。
AI.result: 实验揭示了现有VLM在处理视角特定查询时的局限性，并展示了AlloEgo-VLM在参考框架消歧方面的显著能力，且在开放目标搜索任务中验证了其实世界可行性。
AI.conclusion: AlloEgo-VLM能够有效消解VLM在空间语义理解中的异我中心/自我中心参考框架歧义，即使面对歧义查询也能做出一致响应，且可便捷地通过微调集成到现有VLM中，为具身AI机器人的空间认知提供了可靠支持。

title: Grounding Healthcare LLMs in a Causal Knowledge Graph: Framework, Metrics, and a Cardiovascular Pilot
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed for healthcare decision support, but their evaluations still reward single-answer accuracy rather than reasoning about interventions, mechanisms, harms, evidence, and uncertainty. We propose a reproducible, graph-centered evaluation framework for intervention-oriented LLM behavior in healthcare and stress-test it in a cardiovascular pilot. The framework has four components: (i) a domain causal knowledge graph in which assertions are first-class, provenance-preserving nodes with stable identifiers; (ii) a scenario-conditioned subgraph extraction step that, given any clinical scenario, retrieves the relevant reified-assertion subgraph; (iii) four controlled grounding conditions that vary how the retrieved subgraph is composed into the model's context (ungrounded C1, knowledge-graph C2, causal-graph C3, integrated C4); and (iv) an automated scoring pipeline, anchored on assertion identifiers, that computes intervention accuracy, and other evaluation measures on a single pass. To test the framework, we built a category-balanced scenario generator across eight reasoning failure modes and instantiated it on a cardiovascular graph. The metric panel discriminates conditions along interpretable, non-redundant axes: C4 obtains the strongest causal edge F1 (0.838), adverse-effect F1 (0.833), evidence accuracy (0.738), and unsupported claim rate (0.114), while C1 obtains the highest raw intervention accuracy (0.948) with no measurable causal or evidential grounding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可复现的、以图为中心的医疗干预导向LLM评估框架，包含因果知识图谱、场景条件化子图提取、四种受控接地条件及自动化评分流水线，并在心血管领域试点验证。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在医疗决策支持中的评估仍以单一答案准确性为核心，缺乏对干预方案、作用机制、伤害风险、证据基础及不确定性等关键维度的推理能力评估，无法真实反映临床场景下的行为质量。
AI.method: 框架由四部分组成：(i)领域因果知识图谱，断言作为一等公民节点并保留来源；(ii)场景条件化的子图提取；(iii)四种受控接地条件（C1未接地、C2知识图谱、C3因果图、C4集成）；(iv)基于断言标识符的自动化评分流水线，一次推理计算干预准确性及多项评估指标。同时构建了跨八种推理失败模式的类别平衡场景生成器。
AI.result: C4条件在因果边F1（0.838）、不良效应F1（0.833）、证据准确性（0.738）和未支持断言率（0.114）上表现最佳；C1条件虽取得最高原始干预准确率（0.948），但缺乏因果与证据接地。指标面板能沿可解释、非冗余的维度区分各条件。
AI.conclusion: 该图中心评估框架能有效区分LLM在不同接地条件下的干预推理行为，证明准确率之外的因果推理与证据支撑维度对医疗LLM评估至关重要。

title: Amortised Post-Hoc Explanation with Exact Preservation for Dynamic Graph Anomaly Detectors
summary: Anomaly detection in dynamic graphs underpins financial fraud analysis, intrusion detection, and platform integrity, where automated decisions require human-interpretable justifications. StrGNN, the strongest performer in recent benchmarks, produces no explanation: when an edge is flagged, the analyst receives only a score. Explanation metrics are undefined for StrGNN because no attribution vector exists. This paper closes that gap. We present X-StrGNN, a post-hoc explanation layer that wraps a trained, frozen StrGNN and emits, for every flagged edge, dual attributions: a structural attribution identifying which contextual interactions in the enclosing subgraph drove the decision, and a temporal attribution identifying which historical snapshot carried the signal. Both attributions are multiplicative masks identically one in the unexplained pass, so the layer is an exact pass-through: detection is preserved to machine precision, verified rather than asserted (Delta AUC = 0.0000, Delta AP = 0.0000, Delta P@100 = 0.0000). Attribution costs 0.66 ms per edge, making explanation of an entire alarm list feasible. We conduct the first controlled design study of attribution strategies for this architecture, comparing gradient attribution, per-instance mask optimisation, and amortised parameterisation under one protocol, one budget, and three seeds. X-StrGNN attains the highest stability (0.913) at 268x lower cost than per-instance optimisation, and its temporal attribution (1.601 against a measured random floor of 0.973) is separably better than its ablated control, while per-instance optimisation - the most expensive strategy - falls below that floor. Code, protocol, and per-seed measurements are released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 X-StrGNN，一个包裹在冻结 StrGNN 之上的事后解释层，为每条被标记的边同时输出结构归因（标识子图中驱动决策的上下文交互）和时间归因（标识携带信号的历史快照）。由于两个归因均为乘法掩码且在未解释通道上恒等于1，该层是精确的直通层，检测性能以机器精度保留（Delta AUC/AP/P@100 均为 0.0000）。归因成本为每条边 0.66 ms，并在统一的协议、预算和种子设置下进行了首次受控设计研究，X-StrGNN 在 268 倍更低的成本下达到最高稳定性（0.913），其时间归因显著优于消融对照。
AI.motivation: 动态图异常检测（如金融欺诈分析、入侵检测、平台完整性）需要自动化决策同时具备人类可解释的论证。StrGNN 虽在近期基准测试中表现最强，但完全不产生解释——当边被标记时，分析师仅收到一个分数，且由于不存在归因向量，解释指标对 StrGNN 而言是未定义的。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: X-StrGNN 作为事后解释层，包裹一个已训练并冻结的 StrGNN，为每条被标记边提供双重归因：结构归因识别包围子图内驱动决策的上下文交互，时间归因识别携带信号的历史快照。两者均为乘法掩码，在未解释通道上恒等于1，因此该层是精确直通层。作者在统一协议、统一预算、三种随机种子下，对三种归因策略（梯度归因、逐实例掩码优化、摊销参数化）进行了首次受控设计研究。
AI.result: 检测保留以机器精度验证而非断言：Delta AUC = 0.0000，Delta AP = 0.0000，Delta P@100 = 0.0000。归因成本为每条边 0.66 ms。X-StrGNN 以 268 倍更低的成本达到最高稳定性（0.913），其时间归因得分 1.601（随机下限实测为 0.973）显著优于消融对照，而最昂贵的逐实例优化策略反而低于该随机下限。
AI.conclusion: X-StrGNN 在保持 StrGNN 检测性能无损的前提下，首次为该架构提供可解释的双重归因（结构与时间），且以远低于逐实例优化的成本取得更高稳定性和可分离的归因质量。代码、协议及逐种子测量均已开源，为后续该架构上的解释研究提供了受控基准。

title: EgoGazeLite: On-Device Egocentric Gaze Prediction for Token-Efficient Multimodal LLM Video Input
comment: 16 pages. Accepted at the WearableAI Workshop, ECCV 2026 (Archival Track)
summary: The use of multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) for egocentric video understanding with wearable devices is constrained by the token budget. Memory and compute cost scale with the number of visual tokens, and high-resolution video quickly becomes expensive to transmit and process at scale. Prior work (GazeLLM) addresses this by cropping the video around the camera wearer's gaze. This reduces the number of visual tokens by about tenfold while maintaining or improving the quality of full-resolution descriptions. However, this compression strategy depends on dedicated eye-tracking hardware, which is unavailable on consumer smart glasses. Building a software-only substitute poses a joint constraint: the predictor must be accurate enough to preserve downstream description quality, yet light enough to run on-device, within the power and compute budget of a smartphone. We address this with EgoGazeLite, a lightweight dual-process gaze predictor for egocentric video. Across two MLLMs, three automated metrics, and two LLM judges, predicted-gaze crops show no significant difference from ground-truth-gaze crops. Equivalence is confirmed in all ten cases. EgoGazeLite achieves this at 15.7M parameters, 6.71 GFLOPs, and runs the full gaze-and-crop pipeline end-to-end in real time (21.6 ms/frame) on consumer accelerator hardware. Together, these results remove the need for eye-tracking hardware for token-efficient, gaze-conditioned egocentric video understanding with MLLMs.

AI.tldr: EgoGazeLite是一个轻量级双过程视线预测器，用于可穿戴设备的自我中心视频理解。它通过软件预测视线替代专用眼动追踪硬件，实现视频裁剪压缩视觉token（约10倍），仅需15.7M参数和6.71 GFLOPs，在消费级加速硬件上以21.6ms/帧实时运行，且预测视线与真实视线的裁剪在多项评估中无显著差异。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在可穿戴设备上进行自我中心视频理解受token预算限制，主要受视觉token数量影响。先前工作GazeLLM通过眼动追踪硬件裁剪视频大幅减少token，但消费级智能眼镜缺乏专用眼动硬件，因此需要构建软件替代方案，既要准确以保持下游描述质量，又要足够轻量以在智能手机上运行。
AI.method: 提出EgoGazeLite，一个轻量级双过程（dual-process）视线预测器，用于自我中心视频的视线估计。系统在设备端运行完整的视线预测与视频裁剪管线，将预测的视线位置用于裁剪视频帧，从而减少输入MLLM的视觉token数量。
AI.result: 在两个MLLM、三个自动化指标和两个LLM评判者下，预测视线裁剪与真实视线裁剪无显著差异，十个评估场景全部确认等价性。模型仅15.7M参数、6.71 GFLOPs，在消费级加速硬件上全管线端到端实时运行（21.6ms/帧）。
AI.conclusion: EgoGazeLite消除了MLLM自我中心视频理解中眼动追踪硬件的依赖，实现了token高效、视线条件化的视频理解，同时保证输出质量与使用真实眼动数据的方案相当。

title: Agentic-SQL Revisited: Autonomy-Based Taxonomy and Empirical Benchmark Analysis for LLM Text-to-SQL
summary: LLM-based Text-to-SQL progress is reported across heterogeneous benchmarks, backbones, and inference protocols, making cross-system comparison fragile. We reframe the field as a leaderboard aggregation: we collect the metrics authors themselves report and organize them along an inference-autonomy axis spanning constrained, in-context, iterative, agentic, and reasoning-internalized generation, with traceable provenance for every cell. To anchor the aggregation empirically, we run a focused case study on Spider, comparing 8B open-source backbones with and without chain-of-thought (CoT) supervision against few-shot DeepSeek~V3 and GLM-4 baselines. Four patterns emerge: Spider gains transfer unevenly to BIRD and Spider~2.0; autonomy buys robustness at non-trivial cost; reasoning internalization sits between answer-only decoding and externally orchestrated agents; and CoT gains concentrate on Hard and Extra-Hard queries. We release a Python harness mirroring the autonomy axis so that future methods can be added directly to the leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 本文重新构建LLM文本到SQL领域的评估方式，将其视为排行榜聚合问题，沿"推理自主性"轴（从受限生成到推理内化）组织作者自报指标，并通过Spider数据集上的案例研究（对比8B开源模型与闭源基线）揭示四个关键模式，同时发布Python工具支持未来方法直接加入排行榜。
AI.motivation: LLM-based Text-to-SQL的进展跨越异构的基准、骨干网络和推理协议进行报告，导致跨系统对比变得脆弱不可靠，缺乏统一的评估框架来公平比较不同方法。
AI.method: 1) 将领域重新框定为排行榜聚合问题，收集作者自报指标并沿推理自主性轴（受限生成、上下文内生成、迭代生成、智能体生成、推理内化生成）组织，每个单元格有可追溯的来源记录。2) 在Spider上开展聚焦案例研究，对比8B开源骨干（有/无CoT监督）与少样本DeepSeek V3和GLM-4基线。3) 发布镜像自主性轴的Python harness，允许未来方法直接加入排行榜。
AI.result: 四个关键模式：Spider上的提升向BIRD和Spider 2.0的迁移不均衡；自主性虽带来鲁棒性但代价不菲；推理内化处于仅解码答案与外部编排智能体之间；CoT提升集中在Hard和Extra-Hard难度的查询上。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了一个可追溯、可扩展的Text-to-SQL评估框架，通过自主性轴聚合指标，使跨系统比较更可靠，并揭示推理自主性与性能/鲁棒性之间的权衡关系。

title: SchurQuant: Groupwise Discrete Optimization for Layer-Wise LLM Quantization
summary: Weight-only post-training quantization (PTQ) enables the deployment of large language models under tight memory budgets, but accuracy often collapses at 2-3 bits. Existing backpropagation-free PTQ optimizers have two limitations: group decisions ignore the correction that the remaining continuous suffix can absorb, and discrete refinements typically keep the affine quantization grid fixed. We introduce SCHUROPT, which analytically eliminates the suffix's optimal continuous response, yielding an exact groupwise quadratic with Schur-complement curvature. It then alternates closed-form row-wise scale/zero-point refitting with coordinate descent over integer codes. With the GPTQ objective fixed, SCHUROPT improves mean zero-shot accuracy on 2-bit Qwen3-4B by 11.88 percentage points (pp). At higher precision, however, tighter reconstruction does not consistently improve end-model metrics. SCHURQUANT therefore combines SCHUROPT with quantized-prefix teacher reconstruction, reference-weight regularization, residual-add targets, and teacher-decision token weighting. Across eight Llama and Qwen models, SCHURQUANT achieves the highest mean zero-shot accuracy among the evaluated backpropagation free PTQ baselines, outperforming the strongest baseline by 9.65 pp at 2 bits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCHUROPT和SCHURQUANT两种免反向传播的后训练量化（PTQ）方法。SCHUROPT通过解析消除后缀最优连续响应，利用Schur补得到精确的分组二次优化目标，交替执行逐行尺度/零点重拟合与整数码坐标下降。SCHURQUANT在SCHUROPT基础上结合量化前缀教师重建、参考权重正则化、残差加法目标及教师决策令牌加权，在八个Llama和Qwen模型上实现2比特最高平均零样本准确率，超越最强基线9.65个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有免反向传播PTQ优化器存在两个局限：分组决策忽略了连续后缀可吸收的校正能力；离散精修通常保持仿射量化网格固定不变。在2-3比特低比特设置下，现有方法的精度容易崩溃。
AI.method: SCHUROPT首先解析地消除后缀的最优连续响应，得到具有Schur补曲率的精确分组二次目标；然后交替执行闭式逐行尺度/零点重拟合与整数码的坐标下降。SCHURQUANT在此基础上进一步引入量化前缀教师重建、参考权重正则化、残差加法目标以及教师决策令牌加权等多种策略。
AI.result: 在固定GPTQ目标下，SCHUROPT在2比特Qwen3-4B上将平均零样本准确率提升11.88个百分点。SCHURQUANT在八个Llama和Qwen模型上取得所评估免反向传播PTQ基线中的最高平均零样本准确率，2比特下超越最强基线9.65个百分点。
AI.conclusion: SCHUROPT在低比特量化下有效提升重建精度，但更高精度下更紧的重建并不总能一致改善端模型指标；因此SCHURQUANT通过结合多种训练策略，在端模型准确率上取得最优效果。

title: Hierarchical Adaptive Feature Refinement Network for VHR Remote Sensing Image Segmentation
comment: 17 pages, 11 figures, 11 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing (TGRS). Code and model weights are available at https://github.com/anticipate218/HAFRNet
summary: Semantic segmentation of very-high-resolution (VHR) remote sensing imagery increasingly benefits from strong pretrained hierarchical encoders, yet exploiting their multi-stage representations remains difficult. Nearby regions demand different balances between fine detail and semantic context, aggressive task-specific transformations perturb useful pretrained features, and conventional semantic supervision provides limited structural guidance. We present HAFR-Net, a progressive refinement framework that adaptively organizes and conservatively refines hierarchical representations instead of replacing them with a monolithic decoder transformation. Heterogeneity-Guided Stage-Adaptive Fusion (HG-SAF) predicts dense stage weights conditioned on local feature variation. A Frequency-Residual Adapter (FRA) then injects frequency information through a bounded, zero-initialized residual branch that keeps the fused representation as its reference. A Confusion-Aware Tri-Prior Decoder (CATP) finally regularizes the prediction with boundary, objectness, and training-derived class-relation cues. Under a matched Swin-B training and single-scale inference protocol, HAFR-Net attains 84.12%, 87.86%, 55.17%, and 67.70% mIoU on ISPRS Vaihingen, ISPRS Potsdam, LoveDA, and OpenEarthMap, improving the matched UPerNet baseline by 0.55, 0.95, 1.55, and 1.84 percentage points, respectively. Controlled analyses further show consistent spatial reweighting beyond content-only routing, improved boundary and thin-structure accuracy over matched spatial and spectral alternatives, and reduced confusion on pre-declared class pairs.

AI.tldr: HAFR-Net是一个针对超高分辨率遥感影像语义分割的渐进式精化框架，通过异构引导的阶段自适应融合（HG-SAF）、频率残差适配器（FRA）和混淆感知三先验解码器（CATP）来组织并保守精化层级表征。在Swin-B骨干和单尺度推理下，在ISPRS Vaihingen、ISPRS Potsdam、LoveDA和OpenEarthMap上分别达到84.12%、87.86%、55.17%和67.70%的mIoU，较匹配的UPerNet基线提升0.55~1.84个百分点。
AI.motivation: 预训练层级编码器的多阶段表征利用困难：不同区域需要不同的细节与语义平衡，激进的任务特定变换会破坏预训练特征，且常规语义监督缺乏结构引导。现有方法多采用单一整体解码器变换，无法自适应地组织层级特征。
AI.method: HAFR-Net由三个模块组成：(1) HG-SAF（异构引导阶段自适应融合）根据局部特征变化预测稠密阶段权重，实现空间自适应的多阶段特征融合；(2) FRA（频率残差适配器）通过有界、零初始化的残差分支注入频率信息，以融合表征为参考进行保守精化；(3) CATP（混淆感知三先验解码器）利用边界、目标性和训练导出的类别关系先验来正则化预测。
AI.result: 在Swin-B匹配训练和单尺度推理协议下，HAFR-Net在ISPRS Vaihingen、ISPRS Potsdam、LoveDA和OpenEarthMap上分别取得84.12%、87.86%、55.17%和67.70%的mIoU，较匹配的UPerNet基线分别提升0.55、0.95、1.55和1.84个百分点。消融实验证实了空间重加权优于纯内容路由、边界和细薄结构精度优于匹配的空间及光谱对比方法，且能降低预声明类别对的混淆。
AI.conclusion: HAFR-Net通过渐进式精化和保守性适配，有效解决了VHR遥感语义分割中层级表征利用不足的问题，在多个基准数据集上稳定超越匹配的强基线，验证了空间自适应阶段融合与多先验正则化的有效性。

title: TwinGridShield: Consequence-Aware Runtime Authorization for LLM Grid-Agent Actions
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables and accepted in North American Power Symposium 2026
summary: Large language model (LLM)-assisted energy-management tools can translate natural-language context into structured grid commands, but syntactic validity does not imply physical admissibility. This paper presents TwinGridShield, a model-independent runtime authorization layer that evaluates each proposed action in a deterministic network twin before release. The prototype checks connectivity, branch-flow, generator, and load-shedding invariants and records each decision in a hash-chained log. A controlled IEEE 14-bus study evaluates single-step switching, redispatch, and load-shedding actions using DC power flow and experimentally assigned branch ratings. In the matched-model experiment, a stochastic proposal source configured to select an unsafe action with probability p=0.84 produced 421 unsafe proposals in 500 attacked-condition trials, a realized rate of 84.2%. This value characterizes the configured surrogate and is not an empirical measurement of LLM prompt-injection susceptibility. TwinGridShield produced 0 unsafe releases in those 500 trials. Because action labeling and authorization used the same DC model, system state, branch ratings, and encoded constraints, this result verifies conformance of the implementation to its encoded authorization predicate rather than safety under model error. The principal robustness evaluation therefore introduces model mismatch. Unsafe acceptance reached 5.63% under bounded +20% and -20% per-bus load-measurement error and 30.09% when actual branch ratings were 20% below modeled ratings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TwinGridShield，一个模型无关的运行时授权层，在确定性网络孪生中评估LLM辅助能源管理工具提出的每个动作（切换、再调度、甩负荷），通过IEEE 14节点测试验证其在匹配模型下实现100%拦截不安全动作，但在存在模型失配（负载测量误差、支路额定值偏差）时安全性能显著下降。
AI.motivation: LLM辅助能源管理工具能将自然语言上下文转化为结构化的电网指令，但语法正确性并不等同于物理可行性。需要一种机制在指令下发前验证其物理可接受性，防止不安全动作进入实际电网。
AI.method: 提出TwinGridShield，一个模型无关的运行时授权层。它在确定性网络孪生中评估每个提议动作，检查连通性、支路潮流、发电机和甩负荷不变量，并在哈希链日志中记录每个决策。在IEEE 14节点系统上用DC潮流和实验分配的支路额定值进行受控研究，评估单步切换、再调度和甩负荷动作。
AI.result: 在匹配模型实验中，随机提议源在500次攻击条件下产生421个不安全提议（84.2%），TwinGridShield拦截了全部500个不安全释放（0个不安全释放）。在模型失配实验中，±20%负载测量误差下不安全接受率达5.63%；实际支路额定值比建模低20%时，不安全接受率达30.09%。
AI.conclusion: TwinGridShield在模型完全匹配时能完美执行其授权谓词，验证了实现与编码约束的一致性。然而，模型失配会显著削弱其安全保证，表明该方法的有效性高度依赖于模型的准确性，不能消除模型误差带来的安全风险。

title: GraniKV: Asymmetric Granularity KV-Cache Paging for Multi-Agent Systems with Long Shared Prefix
summary:
Production paged-serving engines apply uniform paging granularity to the KV cache, even though the two regions of a multi-agent workload have opposite storage requirements: a long shared prefix demands contiguity, while the per-request suffix demands fine-grained allocation.
  We present \textbf{GraniKV}, a KV-cache layer that allocates the shared prefix in a contiguous HOT pool and the suffix in a token-level COLD pool, combined with a per-step dispatcher which selects the appropriate backend among dual backends for each regime (compute-, memory-, or communication-bound). To the best of our knowledge, GraniKV is the first system to apply asymmetric paging granularity to the KV cache of a production paged-serving engine.
  At $L_p{=}16$\,K shared tokens GraniKV reaches $\mathbf{2.16\times}$, $\mathbf{1.98\times}$, and $\mathbf{1.57\times}$ output-token throughput over the production baseline on Llama-3.1-8B/TP=1, Qwen-2.5-14B/TP=2, and Qwen-2.5-32B/TP=4. The gain decomposes: cascade attention integration contributes the majority at saturation; the asymmetric storage layer adds $1.05$--$1.15\times$ end-to-end while being what makes the batched-GEMM prefix backend possible at all. Under heterogeneous multi-agent serving with \emph{distinct} prompts of different lengths, the attribution inverts: GraniKV sustains $\mathbf{1.95\times}$ while batch-global cascade collapses to parity --- the storage layer alone carries the win in the regime that motivates the paper.

AI.tldr: GraniKV提出了一种对KV缓存采用非对称分页粒度的系统：将共享前缀分配到连续内存的HOT池（利于批量GEMM前缀计算），将每个请求后缀分配到token级细粒度的COLD池，并配有逐步骤调度器在计算/内存/通信密集型双后端之间选择。在共享前缀场景下相对生产基线实现最高2.16倍输出吞吐，在异构多代理场景下（不同长度提示词）实现1.95倍吞吐。
AI.motivation: 生产级分页服务引擎对KV缓存采用统一的分页粒度，但多代理工作负载的两个KV缓存区域存在相反的存储需求：共享前缀需要连续性以支持批量GEMM计算，而每请求后缀需要细粒度分配以应对多样化的请求生命周期。统一粒度无法同时满足这两个需求，导致性能瓶颈。
AI.method: GraniKV设计了一个KV缓存层，将共享前缀分配在连续内存的HOT池中，将后缀分配在token级粒度的COLD池中，并通过逐步骤(per-step)调度器在计算、内存或通信密集型等双后端之间恰当地选择后端来服务每个阶段。
AI.result: 在L_p=16K共享token下，GraniKV在Llama-3.1-8B/TP=1、Qwen-2.5-14B/TP=2和Qwen-2.5-32B/TP=4上分别达到2.16倍、1.98倍和1.57倍的输出token吞吐。级联注意力集成在饱和状态下贡献了主要增益；非对称存储层带来1.05-1.15倍的端到端提升，且是实现批量GEMM前缀后端的先决条件。在异构多代理场景下（不同长度提示词），GraniKV保持1.95倍吞吐，而批量全局级联下降到持平，存储层单独承担了增益。
AI.conclusion: GraniKV是第一个对生产分页服务引擎的KV缓存采用非对称分页粒度的系统，验证了异构存储布局能够同时优化前缀和后缀两类工作负载。在共享前缀场景下级联注意力带来主要增益，但在论文核心动机——异构多代理场景中，非对称存储层独立支撑起了性能优势，表明存储层的架构创新本身具有独立价值。

title: Gaussian-JEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning for 3D Gaussian Splats
comment: Joint-embedding predictive representation learning for 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) represents 3D content with anisotropic primitives that jointly encode geometry and appearance. Fixed-budget encoders consume sampled observations of Gaussian assets, so the same object may be observed through different primitive realizations. Existing self-supervised methods mainly reconstruct masked Gaussian attributes, tying supervision to one sampled realization and requiring an input-space decoder. Latent prediction offers an alternative, but its application to Gaussian tokens requires targets that accommodate coupled attributes and heterogeneous spatial support. We introduce Gaussian-JEPA, which predicts representations of held-out Gaussian token blocks from visible context. An online encoder processes the context, while a shared exponential-moving-average encoder supplies stop-gradient features for multi-scale targets. Complementary target projections and feature-space grounding provide latent supervision without reconstructing Gaussian attributes. We evaluate the features under Gaussian resampling, partial observations, and renderable shape completion, together with transfer to part segmentation and object classification. Compared with matched reconstruction pretraining, Gaussian-JEPA is more consistent across resampled inputs, retains more instance information under partial observations, and provides stronger frozen features for Gaussian completion. These results support latent prediction as an effective objective for reusable 3D Gaussian representations. Code is on the project page (https://amazingren.github.io/Gaussian-JEPA/).

AI.tldr: Gaussian-JEPA是基于联合嵌入预测架构的自监督学习方法，用于从3D高斯资产中学习可复用且与实例采样无关的表征。它通过在线编码器处理可见上下文，利用EMA编码器提供多尺度目标特征，在特征空间进行潜在预测，而不重建高斯属性，在重采样一致性、部分观测下的实例信息保留以及高斯形状补全方面优于重构式预训练方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于3DGS的自监督方法主要依赖掩码高斯属性重构，将监督信号绑定在单一采样实现上且需要输入空间解码器，导致特征缺乏跨采样鲁棒性。虽然潜在预测是替代方案，但高斯token的耦合属性与异构空间支持使其难以直接应用，因此需要设计适合高斯特征空间的潜在预测目标。
AI.method: 提出Gaussian-JEPA框架：一个在线编码器处理可见的Gaussian token块，一个共享的EMA编码器为多尺度目标提供stop-gradient特征。通过互补的目标投影和特征空间grounding提供潜在监督信号，避免在高斯属性空间进行重构。整个流程不依赖输入空间解码器，直接在特征空间学习表征。
AI.result: 在Gaussian重采样、部分观测和可渲染形状补全等任务中评估，相比匹配的重构式预训练：(1)在重采样输入下特征一致性更强；(2)部分观测下保留更多实例信息；(3)冻结特征在高斯补全任务上表现更优。此外特征可迁移到部件分割和目标分类任务。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明特征空间的潜在预测目标能够有效学习3D Gausssian的可复用表征，且优于重构式预训练范式，为面向Gaussian资产的表示学习提供了新的有效框架。

title: Visible Reasoning and Indirect Prompt-Injection Monitorability Across English, Tamil, and Tanglish
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures. Code, frozen protocols, raw artifacts, and analysis are available at https://github.com/Madhumasa84/MATS-multilingual-reasoning-monitorability
summary: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a potentially useful safety signal, but its reliability across languages and behavioral settings remains uncertain. In a small case study of eight manually verified synthetic scenarios, one model, one annotator, and one deterministic generation seed, I study API-visible reasoning during indirect prompt injection in Sarvam-105B across English, Tamil, and Tanglish. A four scenario pilot found 5/12 injected attack successes without reasoning and 1/11 with reasoning. A preregistered four-scenario follow-up reversed that direction, finding 2/12 attacks without reasoning and 3/12 with reasoning. With only four scenarios per phase, this design cannot distinguish a real reasoning-mode effect from prompt-specific variation or sampling noise. Across 20 non-empty injected-thinking traces, all 17 benign-correct outputs stated an intent to ignore the injection, while all three attack successes stated an intent to follow it. These descriptive observations provide a reproducible case study of behaviorally informative visible reasoning when it is available; they do not establish that reasoning mode improves safety, that visible reasoning is mechanistically faithful, or that the findings generalize beyond this configuration.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个8个手动验证的合成场景小案例研究，考察了Sarvam-105B模型在三种语言（英语、泰米尔语、Tanglish）下，推理模式中API可见的思维链对间接提示注入攻击的安全性影响。实验发现推理模式的效应方向在两个阶段间不一致（5/12 vs 1/11；2/12 vs 3/12），无法在统计上区分真实效应与提示特定变异或采样噪声。所有17个良性输出都表达了忽略注入的意图，而所有3个攻击成功输出都表达了遵循注入的意图，说明可见推理在可用时具有行为信息性，但研究不建立推理模式改善安全性的因果关系。
AI.motivation: 思维链监控被视为潜在的安全信号，但其跨语言和行为了环境的可靠性尚不确定。作者希望通过在多种语言环境下研究API可见推理在提示注入防御中的表现，探索推理模式是否能作为安全监控的有效指标。
AI.method: 采用小型案例研究方法：使用一个模型（Sarvam-105B）、一个标注者和一个确定性生成种子，在8个手动验证的合成场景中，针对间接提示注入攻击，比较英语、泰米尔语和Tanglish三种语言下有/无推理模式的表现。第一阶段为四个场景的试点（5/12次无推理攻击成功 vs 1/11次有推理成功），第二阶段为预先注册的四个场景跟进（2/12 vs 3/12），并分析了20条非空注入思维链轨迹。
AI.result: 两个阶段的推理模式效应方向相反：试点阶段显示推理减少攻击成功率（1/11 vs 5/12），但后续阶段显示推理反而使攻击成功率略高（3/12 vs 2/12）。在20条非空推理轨迹中，17个良性正确输出均表达忽略注入的意图，3个攻击成功输出均表达遵循注入的意图，说明思维链内容与行为结果高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 推理模式中可见的思维链在可用时能提供行为信息性的安全信号（推理内容与输出行为一致），但研究由于每阶段仅四个场景的极低样本量，无法确认推理模式对安全性的因果效应。结论不主张推理模式改善安全性，不认为可见推理在机制上是忠实的，也不将发现推广到该配置之外。

title: Quantum Models with Multi-Stage Training for Compositional Concept Generalization
summary: Compositional Concept Generalization (CoCoGen), the ability to systematically recombine learned primitives in novel contexts, is a key challenge for multimodal learning. In this work, we provide a solution using a compositional model of meaning that separates nouns from relations and uses tensors and variational quantum circuits to train them on data. This model enables us to employ a multi stage training paradigm, one that first learns object representations from single-object image-caption pairs, then subsequently transfers these to the relational stage where object parameters are frozen and optimisation is only applied to relational components. This design explicitly enforces compositional factorisation at the circuit, ensuring that relations are learned as transformations over stable primitives. The training paradigm is tested on the CLEVR dataset developed specificially for CoCoGen. For text, we work with vector representations of nouns and higher order tensor representations of relations using a set of different ansatz. For images, we work with quantum encodings of image embeddings dervied from Open AI's Vision Language tool CLIP and contrast amplitude encoding, which preserves the original embedding geometry, with angle encoding, which introduces nonlinear feature transformations. Our results show that multi-staged training combined with structured encodings significantly improves out of distribution relational generalisation, while using orders of magnitude fewer trainable parameters than classical baselines. We find that performance gains arise from the interaction between representation and encoding, with nonlinear quantum encodings enhancing the separability of compositional structure. These findings demonstrate that structured quantum representations and staged learning provide an effective framework for compositional generalisation in multimodal quantum machine learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种利用张量和变分量子电路实现组合概念泛化（CoCoGen）的多模态学习方法，通过多阶段训练（先学名词对象表征，再冻结对象参数学习关系），在CLEVR数据集上显著提升了分布外关系泛化能力，且参数量远少于经典基线。
AI.motivation: 组合概念泛化（CoCoGen）——即在新情境中系统性地重组已学原语的能力——是多模态学习中的关键挑战。现有方法在关系型组合泛化任务上表现不足，需要一种能显式分离名词与关系、并在表示层面强制执行组合因子化的方案。
AI.method: 采用组合意义模型，将名词与关系分离：文本侧用向量表示名词、高阶张量表示关系，图像侧使用CLIP图像嵌入的量子编码（对比幅度编码保留原始嵌入几何结构，角度编码引入非线性特征变换）；结合变分量子电路作为关系变换结构。训练采用多阶段范式：第一阶段从单对象图像-标题对学习对象表示，第二阶段冻结对象参数，仅优化关系组件，从而在电路层面显式强制组合因子化。
AI.result: 在专为CoCoGen设计的CLEVR数据集上，多阶段训练结合结构化编码显著改善了分布外关系泛化性能；所提方法使用的可训练参数量比经典基线少数个数量级；性能增益源于表示与编码之间的交互，非线性量子编码增强了组合结构的可分离性。
AI.conclusion: 结构化量子表示与阶段化学习为多模态量子机器学习中的组合泛化提供了有效框架，表明表示形式与训练策略的协同设计是提升CoCoGen能力的关键。

title: Scalable Black-Box Model Attribution for Images
summary: The rapid proliferation of generative models raises the model attribution problem: given only an image, can we determine which model produced it? Existing methods have grown as elaborate as the generators they target, on the as- sumption that a more sophisticated model demands a more sophisticated attributor. We show it does not. RPA (Raw- Patch Attribution) attributes images in the strictest black- box setting with a lightweight CNN. Despite its simplicity, it attributes more models at higher accuracy than prior work, reaching 98.0% on 25-class DRAGON and 92.9% on 27- class OpenFake; it is data-efficient and runs at a cost inde- pendent of the number of candidate models; and it stays ro- bust to the compression, blur, and resizing images undergo in the wild. Training for closed-set attribution yields a ver- satile feature extractor: the same representation recovers model lineage without supervision, flags and groups unseen generators, and admits new models through few-shot adap- tation rather than retraining.

AI.tldr: RPA（Raw-Patch Attribution）是一种轻量级CNN方法，在最严格的黑盒设置下进行生成模型归属，以98.0%（25类DRAGON）和92.9%（27类OpenFake）的准确率超越了此前更复杂的方法，且数据高效、计算成本与候选模型数量无关，对压缩、模糊和缩放鲁棒。其闭集训练得到的表征还能无监督恢复模型谱系、标记未知生成器，并支持少样本适配新模型。
AI.motivation: 生成模型的快速普及带来了模型归属问题：仅凭一张图像，能否判断它是由哪个模型生成的？现有方法的复杂度随目标生成器而水涨船高，基于的假设是更复杂的模型需要更复杂的归属器。论文旨在挑战这一假设，证明一个简单方法即可解决该问题。
AI.method: 提出RPA（Raw-Patch Attribution）方法，采用轻量级CNN，在严格黑盒设置下（仅给定图像，不访问生成模型内部）提取原始图像块特征进行模型归属。训练采用闭集分类目标，但在推理时该表征可迁移用于无监督谱系恢复、未知生成器检测与分组，以及通过少样本适配纳入新模型。
AI.result: 在25类DRAGON数据集上达到98.0%准确率，在27类OpenFake上达到92.9%，均优于先前更复杂的方法。方法数据效率高，运行成本与候选模型数量无关，且对图像压缩、模糊和缩放保持鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 模型归属并不需要与其目标生成器同等复杂的方法。简单的轻量级CNN（RPA）在黑盒设定下即可实现更优的性能，并且其闭集训练的表征具有通用性，能支持无监督谱系恢复、未知模型检测和少样本扩展，为模型归属提供了一个简洁高效的范式。

title: Large Language Model Assisted Operational Monitoring for Battery Energy Storage System Integrated Power Distribution Networks
summary: Battery energy storage systems (BESS) are increasingly used in distribution networks for voltage regulation and demand response, which increases the volume and complexity of operational telemetry available to grid operators. This paper presents an AI-enabled monitoring framework that connects a large language model (LLM) interface with a structured telemetry database for BESS-integrated distribution system analysis. Operator questions are submitted in natural language and translated into validated SQL queries using predefined database schema information and approved KPI views. Retrieved measurements, including bus voltages, state of charge, active power, and reactive power, are evaluated against engineering constraints for voltage limits, BESS operation, and demand response tracking. The framework is validated using hardware-in-the-loop co-simulation data from a BESS-equipped distribution feeder operating under reactive power-based voltage control and price-driven demand response. Case studies show that the framework generates valid database queries, identifies repeated voltage violations, detects reactive power overshoot, and evaluates active-power tracking performance. The results show that LLM-assisted monitoring can connect structured grid telemetry with automated engineering assessment for BESS operation analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种AI赋能的人工智能监控框架，通过将大语言模型接口与结构化遥测数据库连接，实现对电池储能系统（BESS）配电馈线的自动化工程分析。该框架可将自然语言操作员问题转换为经过验证的SQL查询，并在硬件在环协同仿真数据上验证了其检测电压违规、无功功率过冲和有功功率跟踪性能的能力。
AI.motivation: 电池储能系统在配电网中的广泛应用（电压调节和需求响应）导致电网运营商可利用的运行遥测数据在数量和复杂性上大幅增加，传统的监控手段难以高效处理和分析这些海量结构化数据，需要一个能够自动化连接数据检索与工程评估的监控框架。
AI.method: 提出一个AI赋能的监控框架，核心是将大语言模型（LLM）接口与结构化遥测数据库连接。操作员以自然语言提交问题，框架利用预定义的数据库模式信息和已批准的KPI视图将问题翻译为经过验证的SQL查询。检索到的测量数据（母线电压、荷电状态、有功功率和无功功率）再根据工程约束（电压限制、BESS运行、需求响应跟踪）进行评估。框架通过硬件在环（HIL）协同仿真数据验证，该数据来自配备BESS的配电馈线，运行在无功功率电压控制和价格驱动需求响应下。
AI.result: 案例研究表明该框架能够生成有效的数据库查询、识别重复的电压越限事件、检测无功功率过冲，并评估有功功率跟踪性能。验证结果表明LLM辅助监控能够将结构化电网遥测数据与自动化工程评估有效地连接起来。
AI.conclusion: LLM辅助监控框架能够将结构化电网遥测数据与自动化工程评估有效连接，为BESS运行分析提供了一种新的智能化手段，验证了其在配电系统监控中的可行性和有效性。

title: FluxBin: Flexible LUT-based Ultra-low-bit LLM Inference by Algorithm-Kernel Synergy
summary: While binary quantization theoretically promises extreme compression and acceleration for Large Language Models (LLMs), existing research often overlooks the necessity of specialized hardware kernels, thus failing to unleash the full acceleration potential due to persistent reliance on expensive floating-point arithmetic or runtime dequantization overheads. To bridge this gap, we propose FluxBin (\textbf{F}lexible \textbf{L}UT-based \textbf{U}ltra-low-bit e\textbf{X}ecution with \textbf{Bin}ary bases), an algorithm-kernel co-design that synergizes post-training quantization with a highly optimized CUDA kernel. Algorithmically, we introduce Decoupled Row-Column Binary Decomposition to enhance representational capacity while maintaining hardware efficiency, complemented by a Hessian-guided saliency-aware hybrid bases that preserve critical information. At the kernel level, we implement a Lookup Table Building Approach with Scale Fusion to reduce floating-point arithmetic, featuring a Virtual Columnar Mapping that transforms irregular, sparse, and salient matrices into dense execution. Extensive evaluations demonstrate FluxBin achieves up to $5.92\times$ speedup and $10.19\times$ energy savings across diverse model architectures, delivering comparable accuracy to heavily fine-tuned methods. This effectively enables the deployment of 70B-scale models on one single A100 GPU with a $4\times$ memory reduction. Code is available at https://github.com/nicyyyy/FluxBin.

AI.tldr: FluxBin是一个算法-内核协同设计的框架，通过解耦行列二进制分解和基于查找表的CUDA内核，在无需专用硬件的情况下实现LLM的极端量化压缩与加速，达到5.92倍加速、10.19倍能耗节省，支持70B模型在单张A100上部署。
AI.motivation: 现有的二进制量化研究虽然理论上承诺极致的压缩和加速，但往往忽视了专用硬件内核的必要性，导致仍依赖昂贵的浮点运算或运行时反量化开销，无法释放全部的加速潜力。
AI.method: FluxBin采用算法-内核协同设计：算法层面提出解耦行列二进制分解（Decoupled Row-Column Binary Decomposition）以增强表示能力并保持硬件效率，辅以Hessian引导的显著性感知混合基来保留关键信息；内核层面实现基于查找表的构建方法和尺度融合以减少浮点运算，并引入虚拟列映射将不规则、稀疏和显著性矩阵转化为稠密执行。
AI.result: 在多种模型架构上，FluxBin实现了最高5.92倍加速和10.19倍能耗节省，精度与深度微调方法相当，并可在单张A100 GPU上以4倍内存缩减部署70B规模模型。
AI.conclusion: FluxBin通过算法与CUDA内核的协同设计，有效弥合了二进制量化的理论潜力与实际加速之间的鸿沟，使超大规模模型的低比特部署成为现实。

title: Implementation of a Metacognition Framework for Self-Awareness and Self-Regulation in Ensembles of LLMs
comment: 5 pages, 5 figures. Charles Courchaine and Ricky J. Sethi contributed equally. Demo and code: https://research.sethi.org/metacognition/
summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) are notorious for struggling with assessing their own uncertainty, detecting knowledge conflicts, or recognizing when problems exceed their expertise; such limitations inevitably undermine reliability and trust in LLMs. In this paper, we present the first implementation of a metacognitive framework for ensembles of LLMs that addresses these challenges through explicit monitoring and control mechanisms.
  Our system computes a Metacognitive State Vector (MSV) quantifying self-awareness for monitoring across five dimensions derived from cognitive psychology: Emotional Response, Correctness Evaluation, Experiential Match, Conflicting Information, and Problem Importance. MSV values also provide self-regulation for control, automatically switching between System 1 (fast, single- or multi-node) and System 2 (deliberative, multi-node) processing based on query complexity. For System 2 execution, graph-theoretic algorithms control the assignment of specialized roles (Domain Expert, Critic, Evaluator, Synthesizer, and Generalist) to ensemble nodes according to their MSV-quantified metacognitive states.
  Our implementation allows users to explore how different query types trigger distinct processing modes. The Proof-of-Concept (PoC) demo showcases the framework with illustrative examples showing appropriate System 1/System 2 routing and helps visualize the metacognitive process via real-time radar charts and decision indicators. This PoC implementation demonstrates the feasibility of creating a framework for metacognitive self-awareness and self-regulation in LLM systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个面向LLM集成系统的元认知框架，通过计算元认知状态向量（MSV）实现自我监控与自我调节，自动在System 1（快速单/多节点）和System 2（深思多节点）之间路由查询，并根据MSV值分配专家角色（领域专家、评论家、评估者、综合者、通才）到集成节点，最终通过概念验证演示验证了框架的可行性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在评估自身不确定性、检测知识冲突或识别问题超出自身专业范围方面存在显著不足，这严重损害了LLM系统的可靠性和可信度。现有研究缺乏系统性的元认知框架来解决这些问题。
AI.method: 1) 构建元认知状态向量（MSV），从认知心理学的五个维度（情绪反应、正确性评估、经验匹配、冲突信息、问题重要性）量化自我意识；2) 利用MSV实现自我调节，根据查询复杂度自动在System 1（快思考）和System 2（慢思考）之间切换；3) 在System 2执行时，使用图论算法根据节点MSV状态分配专业角色（领域专家、评论家、评估者、综合者、通才）到集成节点；4) 提供概念验证（PoC）演示，包含实时雷达图和决策指示器可视化元认知过程。
AI.result: 概念验证演示展示了不同查询类型如何触发不同的处理模式，并通过示例说明了合适的System 1/System 2路由选择。PoC证明了在LLM系统中构建元认知自我意识和自我调节框架的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过显式的监控和控制机制，为LLM集成系统提供了一种新的元认知框架实现方案，能够帮助LLM更可靠地评估自身不确定性和处理复杂查询，为未来构建更具自我意识、更可信赖的LLM系统奠定了基础。

title: Benchmarking Quantum Machine Learning for Power-System Attack Detection: Evaluation Choices Decide the Outcome Before the Models Do
comment: 18 pages, 8 figures, 18 tables. Code, configs, and seeded pipelines: https://github.com/rzn-git/quantum_grid_attack_detection_benchmark
summary: Machine-learning detectors for power-system cyberattacks are themselves attack surfaces, and quantum machine learning has been proposed for them. We benchmark fidelity-kernel SVMs and variational classifiers against six tuned classical models on public power-system attack data (Mississippi State/ORNL), across white-box, transfer, decision-based black-box, and poisoning attacks. Our headline finding is methodological: the benchmark's answers are set by the evaluator's choices before the models. Eight choices -- six in the evaluation protocol, two in the tuning the benchmark itself runs -- each reversed or moved a conclusion at fixed models. The largest is the split: the row-level protocol scores 0.905 macro-F1 where holding whole source files out leaves 0.594, and in the capped matched-dimensionality regime the quantum arm sits within noise of chance with the classical arm 0.024 above it. A fidelity kernel looks most robust until attacked directly (retention 0.886 to 0.064); a mis-fitted surrogate manufactures a 10x asymmetry; an unseeded black-box attack moves 75% between restarts. A positive control explains the accuracy null: the labels, not the pipeline. We give the control that catches each choice and release the seeded benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文以方法论为重心：在电力系统网络攻击检测中，基准测试的结论在很大程度上由评估者的预设选择决定（而非模型本身）。作者对保真度核SVM与变分分类器等量子机器学习模型，以及六个经典模型，在公开电力系统攻击数据集上进行了白盒、迁移、决策黑盒与投毒攻击的系统评测，发现八项评估协议与调参选择均能翻转结论。
AI.motivation: 量子机器学习被提议用于电力系统网络攻击检测，但这类检测器本身也是攻击面。作者希望严格审视QML在真实攻击场景中的鲁棒性，并揭示基准测试本身在评估设计层面可能引入的偏差。
AI.method: 在Mississippi State/ORNL公共电力系统攻击数据集上，对保真度核SVM和变分分类器与六个调优经典模型进行对比基准测试。实验覆盖白盒攻击、迁移攻击、决策黑盒攻击与投毒攻击，并通过系统性改变八项评估选择（其中六项在评估协议、两项在基准本身调参）来检验结论的稳定性。
AI.result: 八项评估选择均能在固定模型下翻转或移动结论。最大影响来自数据划分方式：按行级划分得到0.905宏F1，而按源文件整体留出仅0.594；在受限匹配维度下，量子模型接近随机水平，经典模型仅高出0.024。保真度核看似最鲁棒，但被直接攻击后保留率从0.886跌至0.064；误配的替代模型制造了10倍不对称性；无种子的黑盒攻击在多次重启间移动达75%。正向对照表明准确率零结果源自标签而非流水线。
AI.conclusion: 基准测试的结论在模型比较之前便已由评估者的选择决定；应通过正向对照来捕捉每种评估选择。作者给出了相应控制方法，并发布了带种子的基准以支持可复现评估。

title: BASeg: Boundary-Aware Remote Sensing Segmentation with Structural Penalties
summary: Semantic segmentation is a core computer vision task in the remote sensing field, accelerating advancements in ur- ban development, agriculture, ecology, water resources, and environmental monitoring. However, recent methods usually struggle to capture fine-grained object features and bound- ary details. Besides, current widely used datasets often lack city morphology diversity and segmentation on generative im- ages remains largely unexplored. To address these issues, we propose a Mahalanobis-Angle Boundary Loss (MABL) that explicitly enhances boundary and shape consistency. MABL jointly models structural importance and boundary orientation through Mahalanobis distance-based weighting and angle- aware penalty. It can be readily integrated into diverse seg- mentation architectures and consistently improves their accu- racy. Built upon MABL, we introduce BASeg, a boundary- aware remote sensing segmentation framework with Struc- tural Penalties. BASeg integrates a Global Visual State Space module (GSM) with a Cross-Feature Fusion module (CFM) to capture both long-range contextual dependencies and fine- grained local details. Additionally, we establish a global 10- city benchmark dataset (GCD-25k) to facilitate accurate build- ing and road segmentation. Extensive experiments on four remote-sensing benchmarks demonstrate that BASeg consis- tently outperforms existing methods, achieving up to a 2.8% improvement in mIoU while producing more accurate object boundary segmentation across diverse scenes. Moreover, integrating MABL into multiple existing segmentation archi- tectures consistently improves performance across datasets, demonstrating its robustness and broad applicability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Mahalanobis-Angle Boundary Loss (MABL)边界损失函数和BASeg边界感知遥感语义分割框架，并构建了全球10城市基准数据集GCD-25k，在四个遥感基准上最高提升2.8% mIoU。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感语义分割方法难以捕捉细粒度物体特征和边界细节；当前广泛使用的数据集缺乏城市形态多样性；生成图像上的分割任务尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 1) 提出MABL损失函数，通过Mahalanobis距离加权和角度感知惩罚显式增强边界与形状一致性；2) 构建BASeg框架，集成Global Visual State Space模块(GSM)和Cross-Feature Fusion模块(CFM)，分别捕获长距离上下文依赖和细粒度局部细节；3) 建立全球10城市基准数据集GCD-25k用于建筑与道路分割。
AI.result: 在四个遥感基准数据集上，BASeg一致优于现有方法，mIoU最高提升2.8%；MABL可无缝集成到多种现有分割架构中并持续提升性能，验证了其鲁棒性和广泛适用性。
AI.conclusion: MABL与BASeg有效解决了遥感语义分割中边界细节不足的问题，具备良好的通用性和可扩展性，同时GCD-25k数据集填补了城市形态多样性方面的空白。

title: A survey of AI-generated voices and their detection
summary: The ability of artificial intelligence (AI) models to generate highly realistic human voices has advanced rapidly. These technologies power accessibility tools, virtual assistants and creative applications, but they also enable harmful uses, including impersonation, fraud and disinformation. Recent incidents of voice cloning scams targeting businesses and political leaders underscore the urgent need for robust safeguards. Unlike image and video deepfakes, the detection of synthetic voices poses unique challenges due to the complexity of phonetics, prosody and auditory perception. This survey offers a comprehensive overview of AI voice generation and detection methods, encompassing both the technical foundations and the latest state-of-the-art advances. This study also identifies key open challenges, benchmark resources and future directions to make this survey useful for future researchers.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了AI语音生成与检测两大方向的技术基础与最新进展，涵盖技术原理、开放挑战、基准资源及未来研究方向，旨在为语音深度伪造防护领域的研究者提供系统参考。
AI.motivation: AI生成高逼真人声的技术发展迅速，一方面支撑无障碍工具、虚拟助手等有益应用，另一方面也带来冒充、欺诈和虚假信息等安全隐患。近期针对企业和政治领袖的语音克隆诈骗事件频发，突显了建立可靠防护机制的紧迫性。与图像和视频深度伪造不同，语音伪造检测因音系学、韵律学和听觉感知的复杂性而面临独特挑战，亟需系统性梳理与总结。
AI.method: 本文采用综述式研究方法，系统性地对AI语音生成与检测方法进行全面梳理，涵盖技术基础（包括语音合成、声音克隆等生成技术及相应的检测技术）与最新前沿进展，同时归纳了开放挑战、基准评测资源以及未来研究方向。
AI.result: 文章提供了AI语音生成与检测方法的综合性概览，识别出该领域的关键开放问题、可用的基准数据集与评测资源，并指出了未来研究的潜在方向。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为语音深度伪造检测领域的研究者提供了系统性的参考资料，既涵盖了生成端与检测端的技术全貌，又明确了当前面临的挑战和未来的研究路线图，对推动语音安全防护技术发展具有重要参考价值。

title: In Defense of OCTA: The Reconstruction-Utility Gap in OCT-to-OCTA Synthesis
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at OMIA 2026 (13th Ophthalmic Medical Image Analysis Workshop, MICCAI 2026). This is the pre-peer-review submitted version; the camera-ready revises the characterization of the capillary failure
summary: Optical coherence tomography angiography (OCTA) images retinal blood flow, giving capillary-perfusion and foveal-avascular-zone biomarkers that grade diabetic-retinopathy ischemia. Because OCTA hardware is less common than structural OCT, recent work synthesizes it from OCT, reporting strong reconstruction (3D PSNR > 31 dB, SSIM > 0.9). We ask not whether the synthetic image looks similar, but whether it supports the measurements OCTA is acquired for. A frozen real-OCTA segmenter, applied as a probe to two synthesizers (XOCT, TransPro), shows downstream Dice falling with structural fineness: large vessels survive (0.862 -> 0.831) while the fine capillary network collapses (0.798 -> 0.635, five times the large-vessel loss; paired Wilcoxon p < 1e-3), TransPro worse throughout. A matched-blur control shows this detail is fabricated, not blurred. Retrained on a private Spectralis dataset, neither synthesizer reproduces the neovascular lesion (qualitative, n=3). Reconstruction fidelity is not clinical utility; we establish downstream-task fidelity as the evaluation OCT-to-OCTA synthesis needs.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑OCT到OCTA合成图像仅用重建保真度（PSNR/SSIM）评估的充分性，提出应以下游任务保真度（即合成图像能否支持OCTA实际测量的临床指标）作为评估标准。实验表明，即使合成图像在结构上高度相似，其精细毛细血管网络在下游分割任务中仍大幅退化（Dice从0.798降至0.635），且无法复现新生血管病灶，证明重建相似度并不等于临床实用性。
AI.motivation: 现有的OCT-to-OCTA合成方法以3D PSNR（>31 dB）和SSIM（>0.9）等结构相似性指标衡量成功，但这些指标无法反映合成图像在真实临床场景中是否支持原本要进行的测量。作者质疑：合成图像看起来相似，是否真的能支撑OCTA所获取的临床测量（如毛细血管灌注和中心凹无血管区生物标志物）？
AI.method: 采用"下游任务探针"方法：将训练好的真实OCTA分割器作为冻结探针，应用于两个合成器（XOCT和TransPro）的输出。对比大血管与精细毛细血管网络的分割性能，并进行匹配模糊对照实验以区分"细节是合成还是模糊"。此外在私有Spectralis数据集上重训合成器，定性评估其能否复现新生血管病变（n=3）。
AI.result: 下游Dice分数随结构精细度下降而恶化：大血管从0.862降至0.831（损失较小），而精细毛细血管网络从0.798降至0.635（损失是大血管的五倍，配对Wilcoxon检验p<1e-3）；TransPro在所有指标上均更差。匹配模糊对照实验表明该细节损失是"伪造"而非"模糊"导致。在Spectralis私有数据集上，两种合成器均无法复现新生血管病变（定性结果，n=3）。
AI.conclusion: 重建保真度并不等于临床效用。作者确立了下游任务保真度作为OCT-to-OCTA合成评估的新标准，强调合成图像必须能够支持其产生目的所对应的临床测量，而非仅仅与真实图像在像素层面相似。

title: Counterfactual Sensitivity Is Not Repairability: Auditing Replay Probes for Video Evidence
summary: Tool-using video agents retrieve visual evidence before answering, but the final answer is not forced to depend on what was retrieved. The natural black box test is counterfactual: destroy the semantic content of the frames the agent retrieved and check whether the answer changes, against a matched sham that re-executes the identical pipeline on those same frames. We introduce CARVE, a black-box counterfactual probe that compares answer changes under matched SHAM and DESTROY replays. Across three independent k=3 runs on a frozen VideoExplorer-style agent, DESTROY changes the answer 29.3 percentage points more often than SHAM, yielding a large and reproducible aggregate effect. Question-level scores are less stable, and increasing the replay budget from k=3 to k=10 reduces ties but weakens the original zero-threshold routing policy. At k=3, CARVE selects 538 of 1,258 LVBench questions and improves accuracy by 3.26 points, with higher fallback yield than most matched random subsets. The score shows only a weak association with annotated temporal coverage, so CARVE is best understood as a routing signal rather than a direct grounding classifier. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/CARVE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CARVE，一种黑盒反事实探针，用于评估工具型视频智能体是否真正依赖检索到的视觉证据。通过对比在相同帧上执行相同流程（SHAM）与破坏语义内容（DESTROY）两种重放下答案的变化差异，揭示检索证据的实际利用程度。
AI.motivation: 工具型视频智能体在回答前会检索视觉证据，但最终答案并未被强制依赖于检索结果。现有的评估方法无法直接判断证据是否被真正利用，需要一个黑盒方式来检验检索证据对答案的真实影响。
AI.method: 引入CARVE（Counterfactual black-box probe）：采用匹配的反事实测试设计，包含SHAM（对相同帧重放相同流程，作为对照）和DESTROY（破坏检索帧的语义内容）两种重放，比较两种情况下答案的变化率差异，以量化智能体对检索证据的依赖程度。
AI.result: 在冻结的VideoExplorer风格智能体上进行3次独立k=3实验，DESTROY相比SHAM的答案变化率高出29.3个百分点，产生显著且可复现的聚合效应。问题级分数稳定性较差；将重放预算从k=3增至k=10减少平局但减弱零阈值路由策略。在k=3下，CARVE从1,258个LVBench问题中选出538个，准确率提升3.26点，回退产出率高于大多数随机匹配子集。
AI.conclusion: CARVE分数与标注的时间覆盖度仅有弱关联，因此应将其理解为一种路由信号而非直接的接地分类器。CARVE可有效识别智能体依赖检索证据的问题，但不可作为验证回答是否真实着地的绝对标准。

title: Does the Proof Prove It That Way? Faithful Formalization of Elements Proofs
summary: In formal verification, both the autoformalization of statements and automated proof search have been studied extensively. While automated proof search can produce a formal proof that compiles, the generated proof does not necessarily reflect how the natural-language argument arrives at its conclusion--a property we refer to as faithfulness. With faithfully formalized proofs, one can check the reasoning behind a human- or AI-written argument, and assist mathematicians in formalizing their proof sketches. However, it is particularly challenging due to misalignment of formal proof tactics and natural language reasoning. In this work, we rigorously describe a set of five necessary conditions a faithful formal proof must satisfy, and introduce Pistis, an agentic, oracle-guided proof search that produces formal Lean proofs that satisfy them. At its core is a novel faithfulness-preserving divide-and-conquer search, which we name OrderDecompose, that tracks citation dependencies and blocks unfaithful shortcuts, paired with a refutation search, that surfaces gaps and errors in the natural language proof source. OrderDecompose completes proofs that baselines cannot close even within a 12-hour budget, and its artifacts compile over 33$\times$ as fast as prior work's. We apply Pistis on the first three books of Euclid's Elements, producing high-quality artifacts containing faithful formal proofs. Under a blinded human study and an LLM-as-a-judge protocol on rigorous rubrics, Pistis-generated proofs are favored over prior works--2.89$\times$ and 5.2$\times$ as often by human reviewers and the LLM judge, respectively. It further uncovers gaps in Euclid's proofs and their translation, and can accept or refute natural language proofs written by humans or AI, demonstrating that faithful formalization is useful as a proof-checking tool.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Pistis框架，通过OrderDecompose算法实现保真（faithful）的形式化证明，即形式化证明逻辑与自然语言论证过程一致。在欧几里得《几何原本》前三个书上验证，生成的人工产物比先前工作快33倍以上编译，且被人类审稿人和LLM裁判分别以2.89倍和5.2倍的频率偏好。
AI.motivation: 现有的自动证明搜索虽然可以生成可编译的形式化证明，但生成的证明不一定忠实反映自然语言论证的推理过程（即faithfulness缺失）。缺乏保真性使得形式化证明难以用于检查人类或AI撰写论证的推理正确性，也无法帮助数学家将其证明草图形式化。
AI.method: 1) 严格定义了保真形式化证明必须满足的五个必要条件。2) 提出Pistis，一个基于agent的、oracle引导的证明搜索框架。3) 核心创新为OrderDecompose，一种保真保持的分治搜索算法，追踪引用依赖并阻止不忠实的捷径。4) 辅以反证搜索（refutation search），用于揭示自然语言证明中的漏洞和错误。
AI.result: OrderDecompose能完成基线方法在12小时预算内无法关闭的证明，生成的产物编译速度快33倍以上。在欧几里得《几何原本》前三本书上，Pistis生成的保真形式化证明在盲人研究和LLM-as-a-judge协议下分别以2.89倍和5.2倍的频率被偏好于先前工作。此外，Pistis还发现了欧几里得证明及其翻译中的漏洞，并能接受或否定人类或AI编写的自然语言证明。
AI.conclusion: 保真形式化证明（faithful formalization）不仅是可行的，而且作为一种证明检查工具具有实用价值。Pistis证明了将自然语言论证的逻辑结构与形式化证明对齐是可能的，能够发现原始证明中的缺陷，并作为人类或AI证明的验证器。

title: Sparse Prototype Code Underlies Classification and Prediction Across Modalities
summary: Neural representations have become a central tool for studying the internal mechanisms of modern AI models, yet their complex high-dimensional structure makes them difficult to interpret. We show that classification tasks give rise to a universal representational geometry, shared across state-of-the-art models in vision, audio, and language processing. The key structure is that within-class variability is not random in representation space. Instead, its classifier-relevant component has strong and structured correlations with the class's own centroid and with the centroids of its competing classes. Building on this observation, we derive an analytical mean-field theory governed mainly by the variability along true-class and rival-class centroid coordinates, together with a global renormalization of the class radius that compensates for the non-Gaussian statistics of real representations. The theory accurately predicts classification accuracy across architectures and modalities. The relevant geometric quantities improve systematically with model scale, mirroring the observed gains in accuracy. A striking feature of the theory is its sparsity: accurate prediction requires only a small set of centroid coordinates associated with the true class and its strongest rivals - connecting our framework to sparse-feature extraction approaches such as sparse autoencoders. Together, these results provide a parsimonious predictive theory of neural representations and suggest that classification in deep networks is governed by a sparse, centroid-aligned structure embedded within the full high-dimensional representation space.

AI.tldr: 本文发现分类任务在视觉、音频和语言处理的最先进模型中产生一种普遍的表征几何结构：类内可变性并非随机分布，其分类器相关成分与类质心及竞争类质心之间存在强且结构化的相关性。基于此提出一个平均场解析理论，仅需极少的质心坐标即可精确预测跨架构和跨模态的分类准确率，并随模型规模提升而改善。
AI.motivation: 神经表征是现代AI模型内部分析的核心工具，但其高维复杂结构难以解释。现有方法缺乏对深度学习分类机制的统一、可解析的预测性理论，作者希望从表征几何角度揭示分类决策的底层结构，提供一个简洁而通用的理论框架。
AI.method: 作者首先实证观察发现类内变异的方向性（非随机），其分类器相关成分与真实类质心及竞争类质心存在结构化相关。基于此构建解析的平均场理论，主要由沿真实类与竞争类质心坐标方向的可变性（方差）以及一个补偿真实表征非高斯统计的全局类别半径重整化参数来控制。该理论以稀疏方式仅利用少数最强竞争类的质心坐标，与稀疏自编码器的稀疏特征提取相联系。
AI.result: 理论在多个架构（视觉、音频、语言处理）上准确预测分类准确率；相关的几何量随模型规模扩大而系统性改善，与准确率提升趋势一致。理论的稀疏性特点表明只需真实类及最强竞争类的少量质心坐标即可获得精确预测。
AI.conclusion: 分类任务中的深度网络由一种稀疏的、质心对齐的结构所支配，该结构嵌入在高维表征空间中。该框架为神经表征提供了简洁的预测性理论，并架起了与稀疏特征提取方法（如稀疏自编码器）之间的桥梁。

title: Training-Free Long-Term Multi-Object Tracking for Sports Video Analytics
summary: Long-term multi-object tracking in sports remains challenging due to frequent occlusions, rapid camera motion, and repeated player reappearances. We introduce McByte++, a training-free tracking-by-detection framework that integrates lightweight mask propagation, conditional camera motion compensation, and online re-identification within a unified pipeline. Compared to its predecessor, McByte++ substantially improves runtime efficiency while enhancing identity preservation. On SoccerNet-tracking and SportsMOT benchmarks, McByte++ achieves up to +3.0 HOTA and +6.1 IDF1 improvements over the original McByte in the online setting, with further gains when combined with offline global association. Replacing heavy segmentation components and optimizing motion modeling yields up to an order-of-magnitude speed increase. All results are obtained without detector retraining or dataset-specific tuning. Code will be made available at https://github.com/tstanczyk95/McBytePlusPlus.

AI.tldr: McByte++ 是一个无需训练的跟踪-检测框架，通过轻量级掩码传播、条件相机运动补偿和在线重识别，在 SoccerNet-tracking 和 SportsMOT 基准上相较 McByte 实现了显著的 HOTA/IDF1 提升和数量级的运行速度提升，且无需重新训练检测器或针对数据集调参。
AI.motivation: 体育场景中的长期多目标跟踪面临频繁遮挡、快速相机运动和运动员反复再现等挑战，现有方法（包括前身 McByte）在身份保持和运行效率方面仍有不足。
AI.method: 提出 McByte++，一个统一流水线内的训练免费（training-free）跟踪-检测框架，整合三大组件：1）轻量级掩码传播替代重型分割组件，2）条件相机运动补偿优化运动建模，3）在线重识别用于身份保持。
AI.result: 在 SoccerNet-tracking 和 SportsMOT 基准上，在线设置下相较原版 McByte 实现最高 +3.0 HOTA 和 +6.1 IDF1 的提升，结合离线全局关联可获得更大增益；运行速度提升最高达一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 通过替换重型分割组件并优化运动建模，McByte++ 在显著提升效率的同时增强了身份保留能力，且所有结果均无需检测器重训练或数据集特定调参，证明了该框架的通用性和实用性。

title: OTel: Building Domain-Specialized Telecom LLM Foundations for Intelligent Networks
comment: Accepted at the ACM AI Leadership Summit, Breakthrough Impact Highlights Track, 2026
summary: Frontier AI models have advanced rapidly, but they still struggle with telecom-specific tasks. We present Open Telco (OTel), an open telecom AI resource with derived datasets for retrieval, reranking, instruction tuning, and safety/abstention, plus 30 full-parameter post-trained baselines across embedding, reranking, and language models. The community has already engaged substantially with the resource: as of May 3, 2026, the released models have been downloaded over 16 million times, and the project has received 157+ pieces of media coverage worldwide. Building on prior open telecom datasets and benchmarks, OTel provides documented telecom data sources, held-out evaluation partitions, trained embedding models, rerankers, context-grounded LLMs, and safety/abstention data in one unified resource. OTel post-training improves performance across all three model families: embedding retrieval reaches 93.5% NDCG@10, reranking reaches 0.952 MRR@10, and language-model correctness reaches 88.2%. We release OTel as a reproducible starting point and invite the community to expand the data, improve embedding and reranking models, and build stronger context-grounded telecom LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Open Telco (OTel)，一个开放的电信AI资源，包含检索、重排序、指令微调和安全/弃权等派生数据集，以及30个全参数后训练的嵌入、重排序和语言模型基线。模型已下载超1600万次，获得157+媒体覆盖。后训练在三个模型族中均提升性能：嵌入检索NDCG@10达93.5%，重排序MRR@10达0.952，语言模型正确率88.2%。
AI.motivation: 前沿AI模型发展迅速，但在电信领域特定任务上仍然表现不佳，缺乏统一的开放电信AI资源。
AI.method: 构建OTel开放电信AI资源，包含文档化数据源、留出评估分区、训练嵌入模型、重排序器、上下文接地LLM及安全/弃权数据，并发布30个全参数后训练的基线模型（涵盖嵌入、重排序和语言模型三大类）。
AI.result: 所有三个模型族在后训练后均获得性能提升：嵌入检索达到93.5% NDCG@10，重排序达到0.952 MRR@10，语言模型正确率达到88.2%。资源获得广泛社区参与，模型下载量超1600万次，媒体覆盖157+次。
AI.conclusion: OTel作为可复现的电信AI起点发布，邀请社区扩展数据、改进嵌入和重排序模型，并构建更强的上下文接地电信LLM。

title: Generalised Transportability via Causal Abstractions
summary: Transporting a causal conclusion from a source study population to a target one is a fundamental problem in causal inference. The theory of transportability provides a criterion for when this is possible: given experimental data from the source and observational data from the target, it determines whether a target query is identifiable and does so completely; i.e. if the query can be transported, the criterion finds the exact formula. However, it works one query at a time and returns an expression rather than the value itself. It is also silent in two practically important regimes: when the query is not transportable and when no target data exist at all. To tackle both, we take a model-level perspective grounded in Causal Abstraction theory. Source and target share variables, graph, and interventions, differing only at a known set of mechanisms, which makes transportability a special case of same-level abstraction. Thus, instead of asking whether one query transports, we ask whether a single map aligns the source and target across their interventional behaviour. We characterise when such a map exists in both the Markovian and semi-Markovian settings; when it does, every target query transports at once. Our main contribution lies in the approximate case. When no exact map exists, the best approximate one still yields certified query intervals, recasting abstraction error as a quantitative notion of approximate transportability. We formulate model-level transport as distributionally robust optimisation over mechanism and environment perturbations of the unseen target and derive certificates for both challenging regimes: bounds for non-transportable queries, and guarantees under target-agnostic settings. We evaluate our framework on synthetic Markovian and semi-Markovian benchmarks and a real ecological dataset, and we show that the certified intervals bracket the true interventional query.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于因果抽象理论的模型级传输框架，将经典运输性（transportability）推广为统一映射对齐源域与目标域的介入行为，并扩展至近似场景，通过分布鲁棒优化为非可传输查询无目标数据的情况提供有保证的查询区间。
AI.motivation: 经典的因果传输性理论只能逐查询判定可识别性，且给出的是表达式而非数值；同时在查询不可传输或无目标数据时完全失效。作者希望通过模型级视角同时解决这两个实际场景中的关键限制。
AI.method: 将传输问题视为因果抽象中同层映射的特殊情形，在马尔可夫与半马尔可夫设定下刻画精确映射存在的条件；当精确映射不存在时，将模型级传输形式化为对机制与环境扰动的分布鲁棒优化，为非可传输查询导出置信区间，并为无目标数据情形提供保证。
AI.result: 在合成马尔可夫/半马尔可夫基准和一个真实生态数据集上验证，所提出的置信区间能够覆盖真实的介入查询值，表明框架在不传输与无目标数据的两个困难场景下均有效。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将近似传输问题重新定义为定量化的近似可传输性，通过统一的模型级框架同时解决查询不可传输和目标数据缺失两大挑战，为因果结论在异构环境间的迁移提供了更一般的理论保证。

title: Automated Fetal Brain MRI Biometry in Healthy and Pathological Cases
comment: Accepted at the PIPPI Workshop of MICCAI 2026
summary: Automated biometric analysis of fetal brain MRI enables reproducible, observer-independent quantitative assessment, yet existing methods are often restricted to few measurements or evaluated only on healthy cases. We assemble and evaluate an automated biometric analysis pipeline that localizes 22 anatomical landmarks on NeSVoR-reconstructed 3D volumes and derives 11 clinically relevant measurements spanning supratentorial, ventricular, cerebellar, and midline structures. We compare two landmark localization models, H3DE-Net and SCN, on a heterogeneous cohort of 122 acquisitions (both healthy controls and range pathologies). Localization accuracy was assessed with a linear mixed-effects model, agreement with normative growth trajectories with calibrated centile charts, and diagnostic utility with a decision tree classifying VM severity. H3DE-Net achieved significantly lower localization error than SCN across all landmarks (mean 1.36 mm vs. 3.58 mm in HC and 1.90 mm vs. 4.13 mm in PC; p < 0.001), and outperformed a GA-based regression baseline in 7 of 11 measurements. H3DE-Net measurements yielded higher classification AUC in every diagnostic group, with the clearest advantage in separating healthy controls from VM. Decision tree thresholds for ventricular width fell near the clinical 10 mm and 15 mm cut-offs used to define and grade VM.

AI.tldr: 本文构建并评估了一套自动化胎儿脑MRI生物特征分析流程，在NeSVoR重建的3D体数据上定位22个解剖标志点，推导11项临床相关测量指标。在122例异质性队列（含健康对照和多种病理）中，H3DE-Net相比SCN在标志点定位精度和诊断效能上均显著更优。
AI.motivation: 胎儿脑MRI的自动化生物特征分析可实现可重复、观察者独立的定量评估，但现有方法通常局限于少数测量指标或仅在健康病例上评估，缺乏在异质性临床队列中的系统性验证。
AI.method: 搭建自动化生物特征分析pipeline：在NeSVoR重建的3D体数据上定位22个解剖标志点，推导11项涵盖幕上、脑室、小脑及中线结构的临床测量指标。在122例异质性队列（含健康对照和多种病理）中比较H3DE-Net和SCN两种标志点定位模型，采用线性混合效应模型评估定位精度，用校准百分位图验证与正常生长轨迹的一致性，并用决策树分类脑室增大（VM）严重程度评估诊断效用。
AI.result: H3DE-Net在所有标志点上的定位误差显著低于SCN（健康组均值1.36mm vs 3.58mm，病理组1.90mm vs 4.13mm，p<0.001）；在11项测量中有7项优于基于胎龄（GA）的回归基线。H3DE-Net在所有诊断组中分类AUC更高，在区分健康对照与VM方面优势最明显。决策树对脑室宽度的阈值接近临床定义的10mm和15mm界值。
AI.conclusion: H3DE-Net在异质性胎儿队列中表现更优，所推导的测量指标具备临床诊断价值，且决策树自动识别的阈值与临床标准吻合，验证了该自动化pipeline在临床实践中的可用性和可靠性。

title: Measuring Reward Hacking and Reasoning-Answer Decoupling Under Position-Confounded Optimization
comment: Accepted at the AI Measurement Science Workshop, COLM 2026
summary: When a reward is correct on every training example yet consistent with more than one goal, a model can acquire an unintended one, a failure known as goal misgeneralization. Endpoint accuracy on the training distribution cannot tell the two apart, because solving the task and exploiting a surface feature can satisfy the reward equally well. We treat this as a measurement problem: what does a benchmark score measure once a model has been optimized against a correct but confounded signal? We train language models with GRPO on multiple-choice math problems where the correct answer is always option A, then evaluate on an unseen test set with unbiased answer positions. Across Qwen2.5, Llama 3.x and Gemma-3 models, biased training often drives option-A rates above 0.90 in smaller models and collapses unbiased accuracy toward chance, so accuracy stops measuring math ability and instead measures an answer-position policy. We further find reasoning-answer decoupling: capable models generate reasoning that reaches the correct numeric answer while still selecting A. We track this with numeric extraction and an LLM judge (GPT-4.1-mini; Qwen2.5-3B decoupling rate is about 0.66). The broken construct generalizes beyond the training domain: biased models inflate A-rates on out-of-domain MMLU and value-laden prompts. Continued training on unbiased data reverses the in-domain shift unevenly and only partially reverses the out-of-domain one, so a model can appear restored on its training distribution while remaining biased on unseen inputs. Reasoning-answer decoupling rate, together with answer distributions and out-of-domain behavior, separates capability loss from a learned, transferable shortcut.
