Way out 1: using a bounded context window, we can floor a model's next-token probabilities, making its risk finite exactly when the data-generating distribution has finite expected sequence length---a new, statistical rationale for a choice that was made on computational grounds, though the assumption it substitutes is itself beyond the reach of any test. Way out 2: reporting the risk only when it falls below a threshold fixed in advance restores consistency, at no cost to what model selection actually requires---but we need to recognize that the goal of estimation is revised.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，语言模型常用的每token交叉熵风险（即缩放定律拟合所依据的指标）无法被一致估计。其根本原因是拓扑事实：在所有可能的世界状态下，有限风险与无限风险在任意近处交错，导致不存在任何估计器在所有状态下一致。文中提出两种各有代价的解决途径：有界上下文窗口对下一个token概率设下限，或仅在风险低于预先阈值时报出。
AI.motivation: 语言模型的比较与缩放定律都建立在每token交叉熵风险这一核心统计量之上，但该量能否被一致估计从未被严格审视。若该估计不具一致性，则据此进行的模型比较与缩放定律拟合在统计层面缺乏保障。
AI.method: 作者以"可能的世界状态"（数据生成分布+最终训练出的模型的组合）为基准定义一致性。通过拓扑论证表明有限风险与无限风险在状态空间中互相稠密，进而证明不存在一致估计器；并在有界期望序列长度与全支撑模型限制下进一步讨论不一致性；最后提出两条出路并分析其代价。
AI.result: 每个token的交叉熵风险无法被任何估计器一致估计，即使在限制期望序列长度和有界上下文窗口的设定下依然如此；不一致状态在受限设定中甚至稠密。两条出路：一是用有界上下文窗口对下一个token概率设下限（使风险有限恰等于数据生成分布期望序列长度有限），二是仅当风险低于预先阈值时才报告（恢复一致性但实质上修改了估计目标）。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型风险估计的一致性是根本不可能的，需要接受修订估计目标或引入不可检验假设的代价。这提示我们，对缩放定律和模型比较所依赖的指标需重新评估其统计基础。

title: KV-Rescue: Recovering Reasoning Language Model KV Eviction Loss via Stepwise Interleaving
summary: KV-cache eviction caps the memory cost of long reasoning traces but is inherently lossy because the model decodes from a partial view of its history. Under aggressive budgets, this not only lowers accuracy but can also cause runaway degeneration, where the model produces incoherent or repetitive tokens until reaching the length limit. We characterize much of this loss as an information gapf caused by missing context, rather than a capability gap caused by limited model capacity. An evicted 7B model and a full-context 1.5B model make complementary errors, and an oracle choice between their answers recovers 79% of the accuracy gap to the full-KV 7B model. Based on this observation, we propose KV-Rescue, a training-free inference framework that bridges the information gap introduced by KV eviction using a lightweight full-context helper. KV-Rescue interleaves reasoning steps from the two models into a shared trajectory. An online detector uses entropy and compressibility to terminate the generation of incoherent or repetitive base-model candidates early. Across five math benchmarks with Qwen2.5-Math 7B and 72B, KV-Rescue recovers an average of 87% of the accuracy lost to eviction at eviction budget B=64. A decode-cost analysis further shows that preventing runaway degeneration cuts base-model token generation by 43% on average.

AI.tldr: KV-Rescue 是一个免训练的推理框架，通过轻量级全上下文辅助模型弥合KV缓存驱逐造成的信息损失。它交错两个模型的推理步骤，并用在线检测器提前终止退化生成，在5个数学基准上恢复了87%的因驱逐损失的准确率，并减少了43%的无效token生成。
AI.motivation: KV缓存驱逐虽能降低长推理轨迹的内存成本，但本质上是有损的——模型只能基于部分历史进行解码。在激进的内存预算下，这不仅降低准确率，还会导致失控退化（产生不连贯或重复token直至长度上限）。作者发现这种损失主要源于信息缺口（丢失上下文）而非能力缺口（模型容量有限），因此可以通过补充上下文来缓解。
AI.method: 提出KV-Rescue框架：(1) 利用一个轻量级全上下文辅助模型（如1.5B）与被驱逐的主模型（如7B）交错推理步骤，共享推理轨迹；(2) 用在线检测器基于熵和可压缩性指标，提前终止主模型中不连贯或重复的候选生成；(3) 由于逐出的7B模型和全上下文的1.5B模型错误具有互补性，通过oracle选择可恢复79%与全KV 7B模型的准确率差距。
AI.result: 在5个数学基准（Qwen2.5-Math 7B和72B）上，KV-Rescue在驱逐预算B=64时平均恢复87%的准确率损失；解码成本分析显示，阻止失控退化使基础模型的token生成平均减少43%。
AI.conclusion: KV驱逐导致的性能下降主要由信息缺口而非模型能力不足造成，通过轻量级全上下文辅助模型弥合该缺口是一种训练免费且高效的方法，既能恢复大部分准确率，又能节省解码成本。

title: RoofGS: Roofline-Guided End-to-End Acceleration of 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables real-time novel-view synthesis but remains limited on GPUs at high resolutions. Through a stage-wise Roofline characterization, we identify two distinct hardware bottlenecks: global memory traffic dominates the front end, whereas instruction throughput limits rasterization. Guided by this analysis, we develop RoofGS, a rendering framework that applies bottleneck-specific optimizations rather than generic kernel acceleration. For the memory-bound front end, we design a resolution-adaptive quantized depth sorting key that compresses each key to 32 bits. For the compute-bound rasterizer, we introduce a range-aware bit-level fast exponential approximation tailored to the bounded exponent range after opacity culling, with a derived per-pixel error bound. These two core techniques are complemented by additional optimizations (kernel fusion, compact attribute storage, culling, dual-pixel evaluation) that additionally reduce memory traffic and improve instruction-level parallelism. Experiments show that RoofGS achieves a 10.1$\times$ end-to-end speedup over 3DGS at 4K on an RTX 4090, increasing throughput from 61 to 616 FPS, with only a 0.028 dB PSNR loss.

AI.tldr: RoofGS是一种基于Roofline硬件瓶颈分析的3D高斯泼溅渲染框架，通过针对性优化（32位量化深度排序键和范围感知的快速指数近似）在RTX 4090上实现4K分辨率下10.1倍端到端加速（61→616 FPS），仅损失0.028 dB PSNR。
AI.motivation: 3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）虽能实现实时新视角合成，但在高分辨率GPU上性能受限。现有工作多采用通用内核加速策略，未针对不同渲染阶段的硬件瓶颈进行差异化优化。
AI.method: 通过分段Roofline分析识别两个不同硬件瓶颈：前端受全局内存带宽限制，光栅化受指令吞吐量限制。据此设计：(1) 面向内存瓶颈的分辨率自适应量化深度排序键，将每个排序键压缩至32位；(2) 面向计算瓶颈的范围感知位级快速指数近似，利用不透明度剔除后受限的指数范围，并给出逐像素误差上界。另辅以内核融合、紧凑属性存储、剔除和双像素评估等优化。
AI.result: 在RTX 4090上，4K分辨率下相对3DGS取得10.1倍端到端加速，吞吐量从61 FPS提升至616 FPS，仅损失0.028 dB PSNR。
AI.conclusion: 针对具体硬件瓶颈进行定制化优化而非通用加速，能够在保持重建质量几乎不变的前提下大幅提升3DGS渲染性能，验证了瓶颈感知设计方法的有效性。

title: TRACE: Trajectory Aware Reasoning for Multi-Turn Adversarial Conversation Evaluation
summary: Multi-turn jailbreak attacks have emerged as a critical safety threat to LLMs, as harmful objectives are decomposed across a sequence of apparently benign turns to bypass guardrails. Existing defenses lack the reasoning capacity to identify evolving manipulation patterns, often trading helpfulness for safety by over-refusing benign requests related to sensitive topics. We introduce Trace, a multi-turn defense with trajectory-aware structured reasoning. Before generating each response, the model identifies manipulation cues from the trajectory, evaluates both the benign and adversarial interpretations of user intent, assigns a jailbreak score, and commits to an action: Allow, Caution, or Decline. We curate 4k multi-turn adversarial conversations from five attack frameworks, pair them with 2.4k benign dialogs, and 600 sensitive-but-benign conversations. We train Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with SFT and GRPO under a multi-component reward that jointly optimizes helpfulness on benign prompts and robustness against jailbreak attempts. Across seven multi-turn attack benchmarks, Trace attains an average attack success rate (ASR) of 14.5% against 31.4% for the strongest baseline and 74.9% for the undefended target, while significantly raising the attacker effort required per successful jailbreak. Trace also balances usability and safety, achieving a 93.3% average compliance on over-refusal benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出了Trace，一种针对多轮越狱攻击的防御框架，通过轨迹感知的结构化推理来识别操纵模式，并在生成回复前评估恶意意图并做出Allow/Caution/Decline三级决策，在提升安全性的同时保持较高的良性请求遵从率。
AI.motivation: 多轮越狱攻击通过将有害目标分解到一系列看似良性的对话轮次中来绕过LLM的安全护栏，而现有防御缺乏足够的推理能力来识别这种逐步演化的操纵模式，且往往以过度拒绝良性请求为代价来换取安全性。
AI.method: Trace方法包括：(1)在每轮回复前进行轨迹感知的结构化推理，包括识别操纵线索、评估良性/对抗性双重意图解释、计算越狱分数并决定Allow/Caution/Decline动作；(2)构建包含4k多轮对抗对话、2.4k良性对话和600敏感但良性对话的训练集；(3)使用SFT和GRPO训练Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，采用多组件奖励函数在良性提示的有用性和越狱鲁棒性之间进行联合优化。
AI.result: 在七个多轮攻击基准上，Trace将平均攻击成功率（ASR）降至14.5%，而最强基线为31.4%，未防御目标为74.9%；同时显著提高了每次成功越狱所需的攻击者努力。在过度拒绝基准上达到93.3%的平均遵从率，在安全性和可用性之间取得了良好平衡。
AI.conclusion: Trace通过显式的轨迹级推理机制有效防御多轮越狱攻击，避免了传统防御中过度拒绝的问题，在显著降低攻击成功率的同时保持了高水平的良性请求遵从性，验证了结构化推理在多轮安全防御中的有效性。

title: A Pre-Specified Construction-Confirmation Test of Operation-Level Causal Transfer Across Finite Isomorphic Symbolic Domains
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, and 4 ancillary CSV files
summary: Behavioral accuracy, linear decodability, and successful activation interventions do not by themselves show that a model carries an operation-level structure from one symbolic domain to another. We ask a narrower question in finite isomorphic state spaces: if the hidden-state difference between two operations is estimated separately for each source input, does adding that difference to a mapped recipient input move the model toward the corresponding recipient answer? The design compares this input-specific intervention with wrong-operation, norm-matched random, and no-op controls, and separates candidate construction from an independently isolated confirmation split. On a frozen Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct model at layers 20--21, one route--domain--operation candidate from a family pre-specified and frozen before confirmation access, transparent | integer_mod16--letters16 | successor->predecessor, passed both PyVene splits; its confirmation intersection--union p-value was 0.000198 and its 36-family Holm-adjusted p-value was 0.006943. A subsequent NNsight 0.7.0 experiment, pre-specified and frozen before its confirmation access, tested only this selected prompt route, without candidate or layer reselection. It reproduced all 12 confirmation effect estimates, confidence intervals, and exact sign-flip p-values numerically; its 36-family Holm-adjusted p-value was 0.007141. The result is therefore limited to one prompt route and one candidate, replicated across two intervention implementations on one model revision and one layer interval. It does not establish cross-model generalization, full-family backend independence, domain-general transfer, or algebraic invariance.

AI.tldr: 本文证明在冻结的Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct模型上，隐藏状态差的按输入注入干预在特定符号域（整数mod16到字母16）的成功转换操作（后继→前驱）中产生了统计显著且可复现的效果，但结论被严格限定为单一提示路径、单一候选，不主张泛化性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究常用行为准确率、线性可解码性或激活干预成功来推断模型具备跨符号域的"运算级结构"，但作者认为这些证据不足以证明模型真的携带了一种从符号域A到符号域B的操作结构。提出一个更窄、更严谨的检验问题，以避免过度推断。
AI.method: 在有限同构状态空间中，对每个源输入分别估计两个操作之间的隐藏状态差，将其加到映射后的目标输入上，观察是否将模型推向对应的目标答案。设计包含错误操作、范数匹配随机向量和无效（no-op）对照。候选构建与确认评估分离：先以冻结的预定义候选族构建假设，再在独立确认分割上测试。主实验在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct第20-21层进行，随后用NNsight 0.7.0独立复现该单一候选的12个效果估计。
AI.result: 唯一通过两个PyVenne分割检验的候选是透明化的整数mod16到字母16映射下的"后继→前驱"操作，确认交集-并集p值为0.000198，经36族Holm校正后为0.006943。NNsight复现实验完全复现了12个确认效果估计、置信区间和精确符号翻转p值，Holm校正p值为0.007141。
AI.conclusion: 该结果严格限定为一个提示路径、一个候选操作，在同一模型版本、同一层区间上经两种干预实现重复验证。研究不声称跨模型泛化、完整后端独立性、跨域一般性转移或代数不变性，强调结论范围极小且审慎。

title: Schema-Agnostic Graph Reasoning Agent for Hybrid Knowledge Graphs
summary: Tool-calling LLM agents navigate unfamiliar codebases with a handful of generic primitives for listing, reading and searching files (ls, cat, grep). A knowledge graph admits the same interface: listing neighbours, reading node content and searching descriptions are the same operations on a different substrate. Building on this correspondence, we present GRA, a Graph Reasoning Agent that explores hybrid knowledge graphs, whose nodes are either textual concepts or relational tables, with seven generic tools, discovering everything domain-specific at run time. On UFK-M (Unified Factory Knowledge Model), an industrial benchmark of 258 analytical questions whose gold answers are produced by executing validated SQL programs, GRA beats a full-context agent by 5.1 pp (88.4% vs. 83.3%), while reading under a third of its input tokens. A graph-free control shows the gain comes chiefly from selective agentic access rather than graph topology, and that the effect depends on a model able to drive tools reliably. Seeing less, the agent answers better: selective navigation over a structured substrate beats exhaustive context.

AI.tldr: GRA是一个图推理智能体，利用工具调用型LLM智能体与知识图谱在接口上的同构性，通过七个通用工具探察混合知识图谱（节点为文本概念或关系表）来回答工业分析问题。在UFK-M基准上，GRA以88.4%准确率超过全上下文智能体的83.3%，同时仅读取其三分之一的输入token，表明选择性智能体访问优于穷举上下文。
AI.motivation: 工具调用的LLM智能体在陌生代码库中仅依靠少数通用原语（如ls、cat、grep）即可导航，而知识图谱在接口上与之同构——列出邻居、读取节点内容、搜索描述本质上是同一组操作。这种对应关系启发了一种统一的探察范式，无需为每个领域定制工具，而是让智能体在运行时发现一切领域特定信息。
AI.method: GRA构建混合知识图谱，节点既可以是文本概念也可以是关系表，通过七个通用工具进行导航。这些工具模仿文件系统原语（相当于ls、cat、grep的图版本），让智能体在运行时自主决定探索路径，本质上是将代码库导航的代理优势迁移到结构化知识推理中。
AI.result: 在UFK-M工业基准（包含258个分析问题，黄金答案由已验证SQL程序执行产生）上，GRA以88.4%准确率超过全上下文智能体的83.3%（提升5.1个百分点），同时仅读取不到三分之一的输入token。图无关对照组表明增益主要来自选择性智能体访问而非图谱拓扑本身，且效果依赖于模型可靠驱动工具的能力。
AI.conclusion: "看得更少，答得更好"——在结构化基板上进行选择性导航优于穷举式上下文。GRA证明了将代码导航的智能体范式推广到知识图谱的有效性，但其增益的根本来源是选择性访问策略，而非图结构本身，这依赖于具备可靠工具调用能力的底层模型。

title: ChainSpace: A Chained-Reasoning Paradigm for Spatial Intelligence
summary: Spatial intelligence requires foundation models to maintain coherent spatial state across interactions with the physical world. However, existing data-centric approaches typically treat spatial reasoning as independent question-answer instances, enabling shortcut-based answering and providing limited supervision for persistent spatial understanding. To address this, we introduce ChainSpace, a chained-reasoning paradigm that structures spatial reasoning as a state-preserving multi-round process. In this paradigm, spatial questions are organized into logically constrained and jointly consistent chains, where later questions depend on spatial constraints established in earlier rounds. Following this principle, we instantiate ChainSpace-Bench, a manually annotated real-world multi-round benchmark with a Chain-Aware Metric, and ChainSpace-Pipeline, a simulator-based chain-structured supervision generation framework for spatial intelligence training. Experiments show that ChainSpace-Bench exposes chain-level failures that are not captured by isolated question accuracy. Additionally, with a relatively small amount of simulator-generated chained data, models trained by ChainSpace-Pipeline achieve the best performance among open-source models on ChainSpace-Bench and transfer competitively to multiple external spatial intelligence benchmarks. These results establish ChainSpace as an effective paradigm for more faithful evaluation and more data-efficient learning of spatial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ChainSpace，一种链式推理范式，将空间推理组织为状态保持的多轮过程，并配套构建了ChainSpace-Bench基准和ChainSpace-Pipeline训练框架，证明其能更忠实地评估和更高效地学习空间智能。
AI.motivation: 现有数据驱动方法将空间推理视为独立的问答实例，导致模型可通过捷径答题，缺乏对持续性空间理解的监督。
AI.method: 提出ChainSpace链式推理范式，将空间问题组织为逻辑约束且联合一致的链式结构，后续问题依赖先前轮次建立的空间约束。在此基础上构建手动标注的多轮基准ChainSpace-Bench及链感知评估指标，并开发基于仿真器的链式监督数据生成框架ChainSpace-Pipeline用于空间智能训练。
AI.result: ChainSpace-Bench能够揭示单轮问题准确率无法捕捉的链级失败；使用少量仿真生成链式数据训练的模型在ChainSpace-Bench上达到开源模型最优表现，并能在多个外部空间智能基准上良好迁移。
AI.conclusion: ChainSpace作为空间智能更忠实的评估范式和数据高效的训练范式是有效的，为空间智能的基础模型提供了新的研究方向。

title: VARM-Bench: Benchmarking Verifiable Structured Reasoning in Chinese Abusive Speech Moderation
summary: The widespread circulation of abusive online content has increased the need for reliable moderation of Chinese social-media text. Existing Chinese benchmarks support label classification, fine-grained toxicity categorization, and target-aware extraction, but do not provide a unified representation for deterministically verifying the stated basis of a moderation decision. We introduce VARM-Bench, a benchmark for field-anchored chain-of-thought rationales in Chinese abusive-speech moderation. Each instance contains a concise natural-language rationale with explicit anchors for six decisions: target, target type, target explicitness, author stance, harmfulness label, and fine-grained category. Our deterministic protocol evaluates field correctness, target alignment, output validity, complete-record agreement, and hidden record errors conditioned on correct final decisions, without relying on an LLM judge. Under a common structured-output protocol, we evaluate language models across multiple model families using zero-shot prompting, taxonomy guidance, and structured CoT supervision, and analyze lexical-cue sensitivity and field-level errors. Results show that strong label-level performance can conceal substantial errors in complete moderation records. VARM-Bench provides an auditable and reproducible benchmark for evaluating verifiable moderation rationales in Chinese abusive-speech moderation.

AI.tldr: VARM-Bench 是一个用于中文辱骂性言论审核的基准测试，提供基于字段锚定的链式推理（CoT）理由，通过确定性协议评估审核决策的完整性和可验证性，而非依赖LLM裁判。
AI.motivation: 现有中文辱骂性言论基准支持标签分类、细粒度毒性分类和目标提取，但缺乏统一的表示来确定性验证审核决策的依据。在线辱骂内容广泛传播，需要更可靠、可审计的中文社交媒体文本审核。
AI.method: VARM-Bench 每个实例包含简洁的自然语言推理理由，锚定六个决策字段：目标、目标类型、目标显式性、作者立场、伤害标签和细粒度类别。采用确定性协议评估字段正确性、目标对齐、输出有效性、完整记录一致性和隐藏记录错误，不依赖LLM裁判。在结构化输出协议下，评估多个模型家族在零样本提示、分类法引导和结构化CoT监督下的表现，并分析词汇线索敏感性和字段级错误。
AI.result: 结果表明，强的标签级性能可能掩盖完整审核记录中的实质性错误。即在简单的标签分类上表现良好的模型，在完整的审核记录（多字段）上可能存在隐藏的严重错误。
AI.conclusion: VARM-Bench 提供了一个可审计、可复现的基准，用于评估中文辱骂性言论审核中可验证的审核理由，弥补了现有基准在确定性验证审核决策依据方面的空白。

title: KOALA: Koopman Operator Learning for WiFi-Based Anticipatory Hum
summary: WiFi Channel State Information (CSI) has emerged as a privacy-preserving alternative to cameras for human pose estimation. However, existing approaches treat pose inference as an instantaneous regression problem and do not model temporal dynamics, making future motion prediction infeasible. Naively applying vision-based prediction methods compounds the estimation noise already present in CSI-derived poses, as autoregressive rollouts amplify errors at every step. We propose KOALA, the framework for human motion prediction directly from WiFi CSI, by lifting noisy CSI-derived pose sequences into a learned Koopman latent space where nonlinear dynamics become linear, enabling multi-horizon prediction via simple matrix-vector products without autoregressive iteration or error accumulation. A residual CSI-conditioned operator resolves the identity attractor problem inherent from Koopman formulations, and an anchor-delta prediction head eliminates the degenerate shortcut of copying the current pose across all horizons. To regularise the lifting and operator jointly, we introduce a Koopman Anchored Latent (KAL) loss that operates in the temporal-encoder feature space, enforcing dynamical consistency across prediction horizons without requiring contrastive, spectral, or auxiliary losses. Experiments on MM-Fi and WiPose show that KOALA achieves robust, consistent performance across both short- and long-term prediction horizons, outperforming all baselines by a substantial margin.

AI.tldr: KOALA是一个直接从WiFi CSI进行人体运动预测的框架，通过将噪声CSI-derived姿态序列提升到学习到的Koopman潜空间，将非线性动力学线性化，实现无需自回归迭代的多时域预测，在MM-Fi和WiPose数据集上显著超越所有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于WiFi CSI的人体姿态估计方法将姿态推断视为瞬时回归问题，未建模时序动态，无法实现未来运动预测。而简单地应用基于视觉的预测方法会放大CSI姿态中固有的估计噪声，因为自回归展开会在每一步累积误差。因此需要一种直接从WiFi CSI进行运动预测的框架。
AI.method: KOALA框架包含几个关键组件：(1) 将噪声CSI-derived姿态序列提升到学习到的Koopman潜空间，使非线性动态变为线性，通过简单的矩阵-向量乘积实现多时域预测，避免自回归迭代；(2) 引入残差CSI条件算子解决Koopman公式固有的恒等吸引子问题；(3) 提出anchor-delta预测头消除直接复制当前姿态的退化捷径；(4) 提出Koopman Anchored Latent (KAL)损失，在时间编码器特征空间中联合正则化提升和算子，强制预测时域间的动态一致性，无需对比损失、谱损失或辅助损失。
AI.result: 在MM-Fi和WiPose两个数据集上的实验表明，KOALA在短时域和长时域预测中都实现了鲁棒且一致的性能，大幅超越了所有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: KOALA通过将WiFi CSI姿态序列映射到Koopman潜空间并利用线性动态算子进行多时域预测，有效解决了CSI姿态噪声放大和误差累积的问题，为基于WiFi的隐私保护运动预测提供了一种新的范式。

title: Beyond Visual CoT: Internalized Visual Thinking for Proactive Video Reasoning
summary: Multimodal large language models increasingly use visual chain-of-thought (Visual CoT) to reason about spatial, temporal, and embodied environments. By generating intermediate reasoning images, Visual CoT provides an intuitive mechanism for visual foresight but introduces substantial inference overhead, which is particularly problematic for proactive video reasoning. We ask whether models can learn to think visually during training while reasoning directly at inference. We introduce Internalized Visual Thinking (IVT), a post-training framework that jointly optimizes textual prediction and next-embedding prediction over unlabeled videos. Given a partially observed video, IVT predicts latent representations of future frames together with the target textual answer, encouraging the model to capture motion, object transitions, interactions, and latent intent. At inference, IVT generates the answer directly without synthesizing or re-encoding future frames. We conduct controlled studies across target representations, decoder designs, prediction horizons, data mixtures, training curricula, and predictive objectives. IVT improves over direct-answer fine-tuning on all six evaluation settings while retaining the same inference pathway. Compared with explicit Visual CoT, IVT achieves comparable or better performance and reduces average end-to-end latency by more than 5x. Together, our findings suggest that explicit pixel-space generation at inference time, as used in visual chain-of-thought, may not be necessary for effective proactive video reasoning. Predictive world modeling can be internalized during training to produce multimodal reasoners that are both more accurate and substantially more efficient.

AI.tldr: 本文提出内部化视觉思维（IVT）框架，通过在训练阶段让多模态大语言模型预测未来视频帧的潜在表示，使模型在推理时无需生成中间图像即可直接输出答案。IVT在全部六个评测场景中优于直接答案微调，相比显式Visual CoT性能相当或更优，同时端到端延迟降低超过5倍。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型常使用视觉链式思维（Visual CoT）通过生成中间推理图像来增强视觉推理能力，但这引入了大量推理开销，尤其在需要主动视频推理的场景中问题突出。作者质疑推理阶段显式像素级生成是否必要，希望模型能在训练阶段内部化视觉思维，推理时直接得出答案。
AI.method: IVT是一种后训练框架，联合优化文本预测与下一嵌入预测。在训练时，给定部分观测的视频，IVT同时预测未来帧的潜在表示和目标文本答案，迫使模型捕捉运动、物体转换、交互和潜在意图。推理时，IVT直接生成答案，无需合成或重新编码未来帧。作者在目标表示、解码器设计、预测视界、数据混合、训练课程和预测目标等多个维度进行了受控实验。
AI.result: IVT在所有六个评测设置上均优于直接答案微调，且保持相同的推理路径。与显式Visual CoT相比，IVT实现了相当或更好的性能，并将平均端到端延迟降低了超过5倍。
AI.conclusion: 显式像素空间生成（如Visual CoT所用的方式）在推理阶段对于有效的主动视频推理可能并非必要。预测性世界模型可以在训练阶段被内部化，从而产生既更准确又显著更高效的多模态推理模型。

title: Emergent 3D Instance Segmentation from Self-Supervised Point Transformers
summary: Unsupervised 3D instance segmentation of outdoor LiDAR scans has traditionally relied on handcrafted geometric priors such as density-based clustering, motion cues, or projected 2D detections. In this work, we investigate whether a frozen, self-supervised point transformer already contains the structural information required to isolate object instances without any handcrafted geometric prior. Using this transformer purely as a feature extractor, we probe its internal representations across the SemanticKITTI, nuScenes, and Waymo Perception datasets. Our analysis yields four core insights: (1) the instance signal concentrates in the attention queries and keys rather than in the values or final output features; (2) output features semantically collapse, merging adjacent same-class objects that the queries and keys keep distinct; (3) this instance signal is bimodal in depth, strongest at the shallowest and deepest encoder stages; and (4) this signal is driven predominantly by the rotary position encoding (RoPE), whose removal collapses its advantage. We put these findings into our method TokenGraph3D, a training-free segmenter that groups points via connected components on a key-similarity graph, using neither density-based clustering nor proximity priors. Under identical prior-free conditions, we substantially outperform output-feature baselines, making the emergent 3D instance structure visible.

AI.tldr: 本文探索冻结的自监督点云Transformer是否天然蕴含3D实例分割所需的语义结构，无需任何手工几何先验（如密度聚类、运动线索或2D检测）。通过探测其在SemanticKITTI、nuScenes和Waymo上的内部表征，发现实例信号集中在注意力查询/键中而非值或输出特征中，且主要由旋转位置编码驱动。基于此提出训练-free的分割器TokenGraph3D，在键相似度图上做连通分量分组，显著优于输出特征基线。
AI.motivation: 传统无监督3D实例分割依赖人工设计的几何先验（如密度聚类、运动线索、2D检测投影），这些方法受限于场景和参数调优。作者想验证一个假设：自监督预训练的点云Transformer是否已经隐式编码了对象实例结构，从而可以完全摆脱手工几何先验来实现实例分割。
AI.method: 使用冻结的自监督点云Transformer作为纯特征提取器，在多个数据集上系统探测其内部表征，分析注意力各分量（查询、键、值）及不同编码器层的实例信号分布。基于四个核心发现，提出TokenGraph3D——一种无训练的分割器，通过在键相似度图上进行连通分量分组来聚拢点云实例，不依赖密度聚类或邻近度先验。
AI.result: 四项核心发现：（1）实例信号集中于注意力查询和键中，而非值或最终输出特征；（2）输出特征存在语义坍塌，会合并相邻同类对象而查询/键保持可区分；（3）实例信号随深度呈双模态分布，在最浅和最深编码器阶段最强；（4）该信号主要由旋转位置编码（RoPE）驱动，移除后优势消失。在无先验条件下，TokenGraph3D显著超越基于输出特征的基线。
AI.conclusion: 自监督点云Transformer的内部注意力结构（尤其是键和RoPE）本身已蕴含可用于3D实例分割的丰富结构信息，无需任何手工几何先验即可实现有竞争力的实例分割，揭示了Transformer隐式实例表征的可利用性。

title: Bias-Corrected Ceilings of Emotion Predictability from Human Label Variation Based on Instance-Level Fano Bounds
summary: Emotion recognition from text keeps improving on benchmarks, yet whether an accuracy ceiling has been reached is seldom asked with discipline. Our aim is not to pin this ceiling to a single number, but to quantify how far it depends on finite annotation, estimator choice, annotation noise, and the evaluation protocol, and thereby to discipline how confidently saturation can be claimed. We propose Bias-corrected Affective Ceiling Estimation (BACE), an analysis framework that estimates a bias-corrected ceiling, separates irreducible from reducible error, and disciplines the resulting claims. An anchored Dirichlet-mixture empirical Bayes estimator, bracketed between plug-in and NSB, recovers the human-consensus distribution; an annotator split, a noise deconvolution, and a fixed claim gate then attribute error without circularity. Methodologically, unconstrained point estimates place reachability anywhere from 0.38 to 1.03, so saturation cannot be decided by any single estimator. Substantively, the only assertion passing the claim gate is that at least about 33% of a representative classifier's error on GoEmotions is irreducible, with the same pattern recurring on offensiveness and irony.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种偏差校正的情感上限估计框架（BACE），用于严谨地量化文本情感识别在多大程度上受限于标注规模、估计器选择、标注噪声和评估协议，从而规范"已达饱和"的判断标准。关键发现是，零约束点估计的可达上限在0.38到1.03之间波动，无法由单一估计器决定；经过严格声明门控后，唯一成立的结论是在GoEmotions上代表性分类器至少约33%的错误不可约，该模式在冒犯性和讽刺数据上同样复现。
AI.motivation: 情感识别基准性能不断提升，但很少被严谨地追问其准确率是否已达到天花板。作者希望不是把天花板固定为单一数值，而是量化该上限对有限标注、估计器选择、标注噪声和评估协议的依赖程度，从而规范"饱和"论断的可信度。
AI.method: 提出BACE（偏差校正情感上限估计）分析框架：采用锚定Dirichlet混合经验贝叶斯估计器（介于plug-in与NSB之间）恢复人类共识分布；通过注释者划分、噪声去卷积和固定声明门控来归属误差，避免循环论证。
AI.result: 方法学上，无约束点估计将可达性置于0.38到1.03之间，表明任何单一估计器都无法决定饱和状态。实质性上，通过声明门控的唯一断言是：GoEmotions上代表性分类器至少约33%的错误是不可约的，且该模式在冒犯性和讽刺数据集上同样成立。
AI.conclusion: 饱和度不能依赖单一估计器草率判定，必须整合标注噪声、估计偏差与评估协议进行偏差校正后的推断；不可约误差的稳健估计才是判断模型性能天花板的关键依据。

title: Second-Moment Memory in Coordinatewise Adam
summary: Adam retains a moving average of past squared gradients in its denominator, but the optimization cost of this memory is not well understood. We show that second-moment memory can itself suppress progress toward the optimum even under finite-variance stochastic gradients. For a simple two-point oracle, the expected positive normalized update is $O(M_2^{-1/2})$ after an initialization transient, where $M_2=(1-β_2)^{-1}$ is the second-moment memory length. We convert this directional bound, under the stated memory and stepsize scaling, into an average-stationarity lower bound of the same order on a smooth convex problem with normalized gap, smoothness, and variance. Long second-moment memory can slow optimization even when the gradient noise has finite variance.

AI.tldr: Adam算法中二阶矩记忆（分母中的过去平方梯度移动平均）即使在前向方差有限的随机梯度条件下，也可能本身抑制向最优解的收敛进度。通过一个简单的两点Oracle分析，论文证明了期望正向归一化更新量在初始化瞬态后为$O(M_2^{-1/2})$，其中$M_2=(1-\beta_2)^{-1}$为二阶矩记忆长度，进而推导出平滑凸问题上的平均平稳性下界。
AI.motivation: Adam是广泛使用的优化算法，但其二阶矩（分母中的过去平方梯度移动平均）所引入的记忆效应带来的优化代价尚未被充分理解。现有分析多关注Adam在噪声梯度下的行为，但未清楚揭示二阶矩记忆本身如何影响收敛速度。本文旨在理论化地阐明这一机制。
AI.method: 论文采用理论分析的方法：(1) 构造一个简单的两点Oracle模型来隔离二阶矩记忆的影响；(2) 推导初始化瞬态后期望正向归一化更新量的上界$O(M_2^{-1/2})$；(3) 在给定的记忆长度和步长缩放条件下，将该方向性界转化为平滑凸问题上相同阶的平均平稳性下界，其中问题满足归一化间隙、光滑性和方差条件。
AI.result: 证明了即使在随机梯度具有有限方差的情况下，较长的二阶矩记忆（即较大的$M_2=(1-\beta_2)^{-1}$）也会减慢优化过程。具体地，在两点Oracle下期望正向归一化更新量为$O(M_2^{-1/2})$，且这一方向性界可转化为平滑凸问题上同阶的平均平稳性下界。
AI.conclusion: 二阶矩记忆本身是Adam优化收敛的潜在瓶颈，即便梯度噪声具有有限方差，过长的二阶矩记忆也会显著抑制优化进度。这为理解和调整Adam等自适应方法中$\beta_2$超参数的设置提供了新的理论依据。

title: The Limits of Binding in Dual Encoders
summary: Dual-encoder models such as CLIP score an image-caption pair by a single inner product of two independently computed unit vectors, and fail at binding, often scoring near chance when asked to distinguish "a red car and a blue dog" from "a blue car and a red dog". We give a mathematical account of when this failure is necessary and when it is contingent. Working within the ideal-encoder framework proposed by Kang et al., we first show the relevant axioms are satisfiable, so every impossibility must enter through an added, checkable hypothesis. We then prove three such obstructions. Depth: for recursive role-binding codes the swap margin obeys an exact law $m(D) = 2b^{-D}$ in the nesting depth D, with a finite-dimension version holding up to one explicitly flagged concentration estimate; the resolvable depth grows only logarithmically in the dimension and is single-digit at CLIP scale, the nesting depth of ordinary language. Objective: architecture-free throttle theorems showing that the contrastive objective's entire reward for binding is bounded by the rate at which training contrasts a caption against its own swap, a rate that vanishes at web scale, and that exactly reversed binding costs only that rate times the mean binding margin; both are verified in simulation. Geometry: a tight smoothness-binding frontier: the closer the two swap-related captions must embed to a shared paraphrase anchor, the smaller the binding margin can be, with an exact constant. Measuring its text-only diagnostic across 18 deployed text encoders, every model sits at roughly 25-35% of its ceiling, and the induced per-item ceiling tracks SugarCrepe's subset difficulty at r = 0.99. Binding failure in deployed dual encoders is thus not a dimension or smoothness limit today, but an incentive and code-structure limit, with a proved depth ceiling that remains once those are fixed.

AI.tldr: 本文从数学上解释了CLIP等双编码器模型在"绑定"任务上的失败：通过理想编码器框架，证明了深度、目标和几何三方面的结构性障碍，指出当前部署模型的绑定失败并非维度或平滑度限制，而是激励与编码结构的限制。
AI.motivation: CLIP等双编码器模型使用两个独立计算的单位向量的内积来评分图像-文本对，在区分"红色汽车和蓝色狗"与"蓝色汽车和红色狗"这类需要绑定属性到对象的任务上几乎等于随机猜测。作者希望从数学上严格分析这种失败何时是必然的、何时是偶然的，从而揭示其根本原因。
AI.method: 在Kang等人提出的理想编码器框架内，首先证明相关公理可满足（表明没有不可逾越的不可能性），然后通过添加可检查的假设证明三类障碍：(1) 深度障碍——推导出递归角色绑定编码的交换边际满足精确律m(D)=2b^{-D}，可解深度随维度仅对数增长，在CLIP规模上仅为个位数；(2) 目标障碍——不依赖架构的节流定理，证明对比目标的绑定奖励受限于训练对比自身交换的频率，该频率在网络规模下趋近于零；(3) 几何障碍——证明平滑度与绑定边际之间的紧密前沿，并用文本诊断在18个部署的文本编码器上测量。
AI.result: 证明了深度、目标和几何三类结构性障碍；18个部署文本编码器的诊断显示每个模型仅处于其天花板的25-35%，逐项天花板与SugarCrepe子集难度相关系数达r=0.99。因此绑定失败并非维度或平滑度限制，而是激励和编码结构限制，且深度上限在修复这些限制后仍然存在。
AI.conclusion: 双编码器在绑定任务上的失败本质上源于对比学习的激励结构和编码的递归结构限制，而非计算资源或表示维度不足。当前部署模型在可达到的绑定性能上远未达到天花板（仅25-35%），印证了激励层面的瓶颈；但即使修复激励和编码结构问题，深度上仍存在理论上的对数增长上限。

title: PWLR: Pairwise Witness Local Rejection for Boundary-Aware Out-of-Distribution Detection
summary: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection remains challenging for image classifiers, especially when near-OOD samples lie close to in-distribution (ID) class boundaries. Recent vision-language detectors improve OOD detection through class semantics, local prompting, or LLM-generated outlier concepts, but seldom use language as explicit boundary evidence between confusing ID classes. We propose Pairwise Witness Local Rejection (PWLR), which uses an MLLM offline to describe visible local cues that favor one ID class over a specific rival class. These cue phrases are then screened with ID-only data under a frozen vision-language backbone, so that only reliable local verifiers are kept. At inference, PWLR first retains a small set of globally plausible classes, then checks whether any of them is locally supported against its most relevant rivals, and finally combines this pairwise local evidence with the global class score through calibration. Experiments on ImageNet-100 far-OOD, cleaner/challenging OOD and near-OOD benchmarks show that PWLR consistently improves strong vision-language baselines across multiple backbones. Source code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PWLR方法，利用多模态大语言模型离线生成成对的局部判别线索，以区分易混淆的分布内类别，从而提升视觉-语言模型在近分布外检测上的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉-语言OOD检测方法虽然利用了类别语义、局部提示或LLM生成的异常概念，但很少将语言作为易混淆类别之间的显式边界证据。当近OOD样本靠近ID类别边界时，仅依赖全局类别分数难以有效区分。
AI.method: PWLR方法包含三个步骤：(1) 使用MLLM离线生成描述支持某个ID类别对抗特定竞争类别的可见局部线索短语；(2) 在冻结的视觉-语言骨干网络下，仅用ID数据筛选这些线索，保留可靠的局部验证器；(3) 推理时先保留全局可能性高的类别集合，再检查其中是否有类别在局部证据上得到其最强竞争类别的支持，最后通过校准将局部成对证据与全局类别分数结合。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-100远OOD、清洁/挑战性OOD和近OOD基准上的实验表明，PWLR在多个骨干网络上持续改进了强视觉-语言基线方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: 将语言作为成对类别间的显式边界证据，能够有效提升视觉-语言模型在近OOD场景下的检测能力，代码将开源。

title: Rotation-Invariant Multi-IMU Activity Recognition under Independent Per-Location Orientation Shifts
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. ACM International Symposium on Wearable Computing (ISWC) 2026
summary: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) with self-administered wearables, such as at-home rehabilitation and exercise monitoring, often requires reattaching inertial measurement units (IMUs) across sessions. In multi-IMU settings, this can induce independent orientation offsets across body locations, a deployment shift that conventional scalar HAR models do not structurally handle. Existing remedies rely on rotation augmentation, whose robustness depends on sampled transformations, or calibration and orientationnormalization pipelines requiring additional reference-frame assumptions or explicit procedures. We present Truly Rotation-Invariant HAR (TRI-HAR), a rotation-invariant framework that makes robustness to independent per-location IMU orientation offsets a structural model property. TRI-HAR reshapes accelerometer and gyroscope streams into triaxial vectors, applies a shared SO(3)-equivariant backbone and invariant projection to each IMU location, and fuses the resulting invariant features for activity classification. Across four multi-IMU benchmarks, TRI-HAR preserves macro-F1 under fixed independent per-location SO(3) rotations and outperforms rotation-augmented baselines under this target shift without requiring rotational augmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRI-HAR，一种真正旋转不变的人体活动识别框架，通过SO(3)-等变骨干网络和不变投影，在结构上保证对不同身体位置IMU独立方向偏移的鲁棒性，无需旋转增强即可在四个多IMU基准上保持宏F1并超越增强基线。
AI.motivation: 在居家康复和运动监测等多IMU可穿戴场景中，跨会话重新佩戴IMU会产生独立于各身体位置的朝向偏移，这属于部署分布偏移。传统标量HAR模型无法在结构上处理此类偏移，现有的旋转增强方法依赖于采样变换的鲁棒性，而标定和朝向归一化方法则需要额外的参考系假设或显式流程。
AI.method: TRI-HAR将加速度计和陀螺仪流重塑为三轴向量，对每个IMU位置应用共享的SO(3)-等变骨干网络和不变投影，融合所得的不变特征进行活动分类。该框架将旋转不变性设计为模型的结构属性，而非依赖数据增强。
AI.result: 在四个多IMU基准数据集上，TRI-HAR在固定独立每个位置SO(3)旋转下保持宏F1，无需旋转增强即可在目标偏移下优于旋转增强的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将旋转不变性构建为模型的结构特性，TRI-HAR从根本上解决了多IMU佩戴重附着引起的部署偏移问题，为实用的居家康复等自管理可穿戴应用提供了更可靠、无需额外标定流程的解决方案。

title: Self-Supervised Auxiliary Task Discovery for Stable Reinforcement Learning in Stock Trading
summary: Reinforcement learning has gained increasing attention as a data-driven approach for stock trading. However, learning a policy that is both profitable and stable remains challenging due to non-stationary market behaviour and noisy reward signals. Auxiliary tasks are often used to improve representation learning and stabilize training, yet they are usually designed manually and depend heavily on prior assumptions about targets and prediction horizons. Such fixed designs may not remain suitable across changing market regimes. In this work, we propose a self-supervised framework that automatically discovers auxiliary tasks to support reinforcement learning for stock trading. The auxiliary tasks are formulated as General Value Functions so that their predictions enrich the learned state representation and assist policy optimization. The framework consists of two networks. The main network learns the trading policy along with the auxiliary predictions, while the secondary network generates the definitions of auxiliary tasks through learned cumulants and discount factors. These tasks are updated using a meta gradient mechanism that accounts for their long-term impact on trading performance and improves training stability. We evaluate the proposed approach across four major equity indices: DJI, FTSE, Sensex, and TAIEX. The empirical results demonstrate that automatically discovered auxiliary tasks lead to more robust learning and improved trading performance compared to existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个自监督框架，通过元梯度机制自动发现辅助任务（以General Value Functions形式定义）来支持股票交易的强化学习，在四个主要股指上验证了其相对现有基线的更优表现。
AI.motivation: 强化学习用于股票交易面临市场非平稳性和奖励信号噪声的挑战，现有辅助任务依赖人工设计，需要预先假设目标和预测时域，难以适应多变的市场环境，缺乏自适应能力。
AI.method: 提出自监督框架，包含两个网络：主网络学习交易策略和辅助预测；副网络通过学习累积量（cumulants）和折扣因子（discount factors）自动生成辅助任务定义（General Value Functions）。辅助任务通过元梯度机制更新，考虑其对交易表现的长期影响并提升训练稳定性。
AI.result: 在DJI、FTSE、Sensex和TAIEX四个主要股指上进行评估，实验表明自动发现的辅助任务相比现有基线带来更稳健的学习过程和更优的交易表现。
AI.conclusion: 自动发现辅助任务能够克服人工设计辅助任务在非平稳市场中的局限性，有效增强状态表征并辅助策略优化，是实现稳健且盈利的交易策略的有效途径。

title: Prior Audit-Repair Context Shifts LLM Verifier Thresholds Toward Leniency
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Code and analysis artefacts: https://github.com/parsa-mz/crtitxer
summary: Automated checking pipelines increasingly place one language model as the checker and another (or the same one) as the fixer. We ask whether that wiring changes what the checker reports. Measuring false alarms on human-verified-correct ProcessBench traces with the present task held byte-identical, we find that a completed audit -> repair episode already in the model's context lowers false alarms in 15 of 15 model x wording combinations, by 2.8 to 11.5 percentage points against a length-matched non-audit control, a 9 to 25% reduction relative to that control. The direction contradicts what the accumulated-message literature predicts: an episode whose audit reported an error lowers false alarms further still, at all five wordings on the model where that manipulation lands cleanly, though a negativity asymmetry predicts more flagging. Decomposing the episode finds repair content and audit verdict complementary: different components carry the effect on different model families. Signal-detection analysis locates the change in the threshold rather than in discrimination -- the criterion moves in 15 of 15 combinations and survives correction in 13 while d' survives in none, though the d' test is half as sensitive by construction -- and a hand audit of 50 false alarms finds 82% simply wrong, so at this operating point the shift need not be harmful. With reasoning enabled the effect keeps its relative size on both models tested, and the threshold reading holds there too.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自动化检查流水线中，上下文中包含完成的"审计→修复"回环是否改变检查器（语言模型）的误报率。在ProcessBench人工验证正确的轨迹上，发现该回环在15/15的模型×措辞组合中降低误报2.8-11.5个百分点（相对控制组降低9-25%），方向与累积消息文献预测相反；效应由修复内容和审计结论共同贡献；信号检测分析显示变化在于判定阈值而非辨别能力。
AI.motivation: 自动化检查流水线越来越普遍地采用一个语言模型作为检查者、另一个（或同一个）作为修复者。需要理解这种"接线"方式是否以及如何改变检查器报告的误报率，特别是与现有理论（累积消息文献、消极性不对称）的预测相悖时应如何解释。
AI.method: 在ProcessBench人工验证正确的轨迹上，保持当前任务逐字节一致，测量误报。对比已完成审计→修复回环在上下文中 vs 长度匹配的非审计控制组。在15种模型×措辞组合中测试；分解回环为修复内容和审计结论以检验各自贡献；使用信号检测分析（d'与criterion）定位变化来源；进行50个误报的人工审计；并在推理启用条件下复测。
AI.result: 审计→修复回环在上下文中降低了15/15组合的误报，降幅2.8-11.5个百分点（相对控制降9-25%）。在审计报告错误的回环中误报进一步降低（在所测模型的全部5种措辞上一致），与消极性不对称预测相反。修复内容和审计结论互补：不同模型族由不同组件承载效应。信号检测显示15/15的criterion移动且13个在校正后存活，而d'无一存活（但d'检验灵敏度仅其一半）。50个误报的人工审计中82%为根本性错误。推理启用后效应相对大小保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 上下文中的审计→修复回环系统地降低了检查器的误报率，这一效应是稳定且广泛可复现的（跨模型和措辞），其机制在于调整判定阈值而非提升辨别力。由于大部分误报本质上是单纯错误且运行点下该阈值移动未必有害，这为设计自动化检查流水线的回环结构提供了实证依据。

title: From Generation to Matching: A Development Report on Personalized Chinese Handwriting
summary: This paper documents a frozen engineering project on personalized Chinese handwriting. The project started from approximately 200 real handwriting images from one user, covering 197 unique Chinese characters, and was initially formulated as few-shot generation of unseen characters. A sequence of canonical-centered personalization routes repeatedly exposed the same conflict: increasing structural pressure made outputs more canonical, while increasing personalization could damage identity-defining strokes. The project was therefore reset around real-human character equivalence classes. A multi-writer CASIA candidate pool showed that a USER-compatible realization often already existed among valid human samples. The task consequently changed from synthesis to character-wise matching, followed by cross-writer composition into a virtual writer. The frozen system uses real-ink features, character-specific human population percentiles, top-20 candidate pruning, and greedy hardest-first whole-row selection. On the covered target set, all 197 USER characters had real-human candidates, and the 100-character evaluation subset was covered 100/100. Knowncharacter held-out comparisons included a row judged visually almost indistinguishable from genuine USER handwriting. A 60- episode stability audit placed every episode in a predefined A-like machine-proxy region, but these were not independent human A-level judgments. The final evidence supports stable practical B-level quality, with many outputs approaching A-level under the USER-defined criterion. The report records why generation became unnecessary for this case without claiming unrestricted or universal handwriting synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文记录了一个已冻结的中文手写个性化工程项目的完整历程。该项目从单用户约200张真实手写图片（覆盖197个独特汉字）出发，最初目标是未见字符的少样本生成。在反复经历"结构规整度"与"个性化保留度"之间的冲突后，项目转向以真实人类字符等价类为核心的匹配路线，最终放弃合成，改用"字符级匹配+跨书写者组合虚拟书写者"方案，实现稳定B级、接近A级的实用质量。
AI.motivation: 作者希望通过少量真实手写样本实现个性化中文手写合成。然而在工程推进过程中发现，加大结构性约束会牺牲个性化笔迹特征，个性化则可能破坏笔画本质，两者存在不可调和的矛盾。这一反复冲突促使作者重新审视问题：与其合成无法两全的字符，不如在真实人类书写样本中寻找与用户等价的有效实现，从而彻底绕开合成难题。
AI.method: 项目经过"重置"后，将任务从"合成未见字符"改为"逐字符匹配+跨书写者虚拟书写者组合"。具体流程为：构建多书写者CASIA候选池，利用真实墨迹特征（real-ink features）、字符特定的人群百分位（population percentiles）、前20名候选剪枝（top-20 candidate pruning），以及贪婪的"最难优先整行选择"（greedy hardest-first whole-row selection）策略，在候选池中为用户每个字符挑选最兼容的真实人类样本。
AI.result: 在目标覆盖集上，所有197个用户字符均找到真实人类候选；100字符评估子集覆盖率达100/100。已知字符的留出比较中，有一行被评价为与用户真实手写几乎无法区分。60次稳定性审计中，每次输出均落入预定义的类A机器代理区域，但这些并非独立人类A级判定。最终证据支持稳定的实用B级质量，且多数输出在用户定义标准下接近A级。
AI.conclusion: 本文结论是：对于本案例，生成式方案是不必要的——通过真实人类候选池的匹配与组合即可达到实用质量。作者同时明确声明：这并不声称具有无限制或普遍适用的手写合成能力，仅是对特定用户、特定字符集场景的一种工程性解决方案的记录。

title: Argumentation for Common Ground: Finding Zones of Possible Agreement between Individuals in Conflict
summary: How can common ground between societies in conflict be identified when citizens' acceptability of peace agreements is shaped by contested narratives? Such acceptability is mediated not only by the clauses that agreements include or exclude, but crucially by citizens' subjective reasoning concerning agreements' clauses. In this paper, we leverage computational argumentation to introduce a novel approach to identifying mutually acceptable agreements among individuals in conflict, i.e. a Zone of Possible Agreement (ZOPA). First, we introduce a quantitative bipolar argumentation framework tailored to represent each side's reasoning about peace agreements. We then show how merging these frameworks can enable negotiators to identify peace agreements that are mutually acceptable. To evaluate our approach under conditions of real-world relevance, we focus on the Palestinian-Israeli conflict, where long-standing policy, practitioner and public interest underscores the demand for methods capable of analysing polarised public reasoning. We show how our framework identifies a ZOPA through theoretical analysis and preliminary experiments using survey data from both existing work and retrieved by a large language model. The results illustrate how argumentation can empower negotiators and conflict-resolution teams in mapping feasible ZOPAs grounded in citizens' reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于计算辩论（computational argumentation）的新方法，通过构建定量双极论辩框架（quantitative bipolar argumentation framework）来表征冲突双方公民对和平协议的推理，从而识别双方均可接受的协议区间（ZOPA）。方法在巴以冲突的民调数据和大语言模型生成的数据上进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 冲突社会中的公民对和平协议的接受度受制于相互竞争的叙事影响，这不仅取决于协议条款本身，还取决于公民对条款的主观推理方式。现有方法缺乏系统性地识别双方相互可接受协议（ZOPA）的技术手段，亟需一种能够基于公民推理来映射可行协议区间的新方法。
AI.method: 首先引入一个定量的双极论辩框架，用于表示冲突各方的推理结构；然后展示如何通过合并这些框架使谈判者能够识别双方相互可接受的和平协议。该框架结合了定量分析和双极论辩逻辑，并通过对理论分析及基于既有调查数据和大型语言模型生成数据的初步实验进行验证。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提出的框架能够有效地识别巴以冲突语境下的ZOPA，证明论辩方法能够帮助谈判者和冲突解决团队基于公民推理映射出可行的相互可接受协议区间。
AI.conclusion: 计算论辩技术为冲突解决提供了新的工具，使谈判者能够在高度极化、叙事对立的公共推理环境中识别双方真正可接受的协议空间，具有较强的现实应用价值。

title: Geometry of Forgetting: Representation Flux in Continual Learning
summary: Catastrophic forgetting remains a fundamental obstacle to continual learning, where neural networks lose previously acquired knowledge while learning new tasks. Existing methods primarily mitigate forgetting through parameter regularization or experience replay, while the representation-space dynamics associated with forgetting remain less understood. We investigate latent representation evolution during sequential learning and introduce representation flux, a geometric measure of sample-level representation displacement across training. We show that representation flux is strongly associated with catastrophic forgetting across multiple benchmarks, with temporal analyses indicating that elevated flux can precede subsequent performance degradation. Representation displacement is also associated with confidence degradation, while complementary geometric properties provide additional information about sample-level forgetting. Motivated by these observations, we propose FlowLess-R, a representation-space regularization method that constrains replay representations relative to stored references while allowing continued learning. FlowLess-R is architecture-agnostic and integrates into replay-based methods through a representation-matching term. Experiments on SplitMNIST, SplitFashionMNIST, SplitCIFAR10, and SplitTinyImageNet show improved final average accuracy and reduced forgetting with ER, DER++, and ER-ACE. Our results identify representation flux as an informative geometric marker of forgetting and show that stabilizing latent representations provides a simple strategy for mitigating catastrophic forgetting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出表征通量（representation flux）这一几何度量来衡量连续学习中样本级表征位移，并发现它与灾难性遗忘高度相关。基于此，提出FlowLess-R，一种架构无关的表征空间正则化方法，通过在回放时约束表征与存储参考保持一致，在多个基准和三种回放方法上提升了平均准确率并减少了遗忘。
AI.motivation: 灾难性遗忘是持续学习的核心障碍，现有方法主要通过参数正则化或经验回放来缓解，但对遗忘相关的表征空间动力学理解不足。作者希望从表征层面揭示遗忘的几何机制，并据此设计更有效的缓解策略。
AI.method: 1）提出表征通量（representation flux）作为样本级表征位移的几何度量；2）通过时序分析验证通量与遗忘、置信度下降的关联；3）提出FlowLess-R，在回放时增加表征匹配项，约束回放表征与存储参考保持稳定，同时允许继续学习，架构无关且易于集成到ER、DER++、ER-ACE等回放方法中。
AI.result: 在SplitMNIST、SplitFashionMNIST、SplitCIFAR10和SplitTinyImageNet上，FlowLess-R在ER、DER++和ER-ACE三种回放方法上均提升了最终平均准确率并减少了遗忘。表征通量被验证为遗忘的信息性几何标记，且高通量可作为性能下降的前兆信号。
AI.conclusion: 表征通量是衡量灾难性遗忘的有效几何指标，稳定潜在表征（而非仅限制参数或回放样本）是缓解遗忘的一种简单而有效的策略，为持续学习提供了新的表征空间视角。

title: Deep Thought Alignment: Trajectory-Level Latent Distillation for Video Reasoning
summary: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) for video reasoning have long been hindered by the high computational cost of processing vast amounts of visual information. This dilemma motivates the transfer of the reasoning capabilities of large models to smaller, more efficient ones. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) offers a promising solution by matching output-token distributions along student-generated trajectories. However, video reasoning often depends on evidence accumulated across multiple frames. In this context, output-level supervision only captures information expressed through token predictions and does not directly constrain the latent representations formed during reasoning. To address this limitation, we propose Latent-OPD, which augments OPD with trajectory-level latent distillation. Specifically, our method focuses on the position at the end of each trajectory, where hidden states effectively summarize the accumulated visual evidence and reasoning context. Furthermore, we introduce a progressive teacher-lookahead strategy, which aligns middle-to-late student layers with increasingly deeper teacher layers. Experiments on six video reasoning benchmarks show that Latent-OPD consistently outperforms output-only OPD. Notably, the improvements are particularly pronounced in scenarios with limited frames, long videos, or tasks requiring complex evidence aggregation. These results establish Latent-OPD as a highly effective approach to frame-efficient video reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出Latent-OPD方法，通过轨迹级潜在蒸馏增强输出层面的On-Policy Distillation，将大模型中基于多帧证据的视频推理能力迁移到小模型，在六个视频推理基准上一致超越仅输出层的OPD。
AI.motivation: 视频推理中的大语言模型（LMM）面临处理海量视觉信息的高计算成本问题，因此需要将大模型的推理能力蒸馏到更小更高效的模型中。然而，视频推理依赖于跨多帧累积的证据，输出级别的监督（OPD）只能捕获通过token预测表达的信息，无法直接约束推理过程中形成的潜在表示，这是一个关键局限。
AI.method: 提出Latent-OPD方法，包含两个核心组件：(1) 轨迹级潜在蒸馏——聚焦于每个轨迹末端位置，利用隐藏状态有效总结累积的视觉证据和推理上下文；(2) 渐进式教师前瞻策略——将学生模型的中层到后期层与教师模型逐渐加深的层进行对齐。
AI.result: 在六个视频推理基准上，Latent-OPD一致优于仅输出级别的OPD。改进在有限帧数、长视频或需要复杂证据聚合的任务中尤为显著，确立了其在帧高效视频推理中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Latent-OPD通过在轨迹末端进行潜在蒸馏并配合渐进式教师前瞻对齐策略，有效弥补了输出级蒸馏在视频推理中的不足，为帧高效视频推理提供了高度有效的解决方案。

title: FlowDance: Music-Driven Dance Video Generation with Parallel Pose and RGB Streams
summary: Music-driven dance video synthesis aims to animate a reference person according to a given music clip. The task is challenging because it requires a model to jointly learn music-to-motion correspondence, identity-preserving human animation, temporal coherence, and visually realistic video generation. We present FlowDance, a music-driven dance video generation framework that integrates explicit motion modeling with reference-preserving visual synthesis through parallel pose and RGB streams. We further introduce timestep-aware pose injection to adapt structural guidance across denoising steps and persistent identity injection to preserve the reference appearance over long video. To support this task, we further build a popularity-curated, high-resolution in-the-wild dance video dataset with synchronized music, RGB videos, 3D body motion, camera parameters, and projected 2D pose annotations. Extensive experiments show that FlowDance achieves strong performance in both dance motion generation and music-driven dance video synthesis.

AI.tldr: FlowDance是一个音乐驱动的舞蹈视频生成框架，通过并行姿态流和RGB流集成显式动作建模与参考保持的视觉合成，并引入时间步感知的姿态注入和持久身份注入，同时构建了一个高分辨率真实舞蹈视频数据集，在舞蹈动作生成和舞蹈视频合成上均表现出色。
AI.motivation: 音乐驱动的舞蹈视频合成任务具有挑战性，需要模型同时学习音乐-动作对应关系、身份保持的人物动画、时间连贯性和视觉逼真的视频生成。现有方法难以同时满足这些要求。
AI.method: FlowDance采用并行姿态流和RGB流架构，将显式动作建模与参考保持的视觉合成相集成。引入时间步感知的姿态注入机制，根据去噪步数自适应调整结构引导强度；引入持久身份注入机制以在长视频中保持参考人物外观。同时构建了包含音乐、RGB视频、3D人体运动、相机参数和2D姿态标注的高分辨率真实舞蹈数据集。
AI.result: 大量实验表明FlowDance在舞蹈动作生成和音乐驱动的舞蹈视频合成两个任务上均取得了强性能表现。
AI.conclusion: FlowDance通过并行双流架构和创新的姿态/身份注入机制，有效解决了音乐驱动舞蹈视频合成中的多模态对应、身份保持和时间连贯性等核心难题，为该领域提供了新的解决方案和数据资源。

title: A Responsible Artificial Intelligence Framework for Groundwater Modeling
summary: The rapid development and widespread application of artificial intelligence (AI) have sparked intense discussions on how to deploy responsible AI systems in a manner aligned with human values and ethical standards. Compared to fields like healthcare, energy, or finance, the application of AI in groundwater is relatively limited, and research on responsible AI is even more scarce. Taking the middle reaches of the Heihe River Basin as the study area, this paper proposes six Responsible AI principles: transparency, technical robustness, privacy governance, fairness, accountability, and sustainability. LSTM and Transformer time-series models are developed using multi-source hydrometeorological data, and validated via post-hoc interpretability, Monte Carlo simulation, and scenario analysis. The results show that Transformer outperforms LSTM in accuracy, robustness, and interpretability, demonstrating the operability and practical value of Responsible AI principles in groundwater prediction to support sustainable water management under climate change and human activities.

AI.tldr: 本文以黑河流域中游为研究区，提出了六项负责任人工智能原则（透明性、技术稳健性、隐私治理、公平性、问责制、可持续性），并开发LSTM和Transformer时序模型用于地下水预测，通过事后可解释性、蒙特卡洛模拟和情景分析验证，结果表明Transformer在准确性、稳健性和可解释性上均优于LSTM，证明了负责任AI原则在地下水预测中的可操作性和实用价值。
AI.motivation: AI技术快速发展引发了对负责任AI部署的广泛讨论，但与医疗、能源、金融等领域相比，地下水领域的AI应用相对有限，负责任AI研究更是匮乏，亟需探索如何在该领域落地负责任AI原则以支持可持续水资源管理。
AI.method: 以黑河流域中游为研究区，提出六项负责任AI原则；利用多源水文气象数据构建LSTM和Transformer时序预测模型；通过事后可解释性分析、蒙特卡洛模拟和情景分析三种方式对模型进行验证与评估。
AI.result: Transformer模型在准确性、稳健性和可解释性方面均优于LSTM模型，证实了负责任AI原则在地下水预测领域中的可操作性和实际价值。
AI.conclusion: 负责任AI原则可以在地下水预测中有效落地，Transformer模型的优越性能为气候变化和人类活动背景下的可持续水资源管理提供了有力支撑。

title: TransfHAR: Self-Supervised Wrist Representations for On-Demand Activity Recognition
summary: Fine-grained wrist activity recognition can support applications such as procedural step guidance and context-aware assistance, yet acquiring labeled data for every new task, user, and activity granularity remains a bottleneck. We present TransfHAR, a self-supervised wrist IMU framework for on-demand, fine-grained activity recognition by learning transferable motion priors from global, unlabeled activities. We show that self-supervised pretraining on coarse wrist IMU activities (e.g., sitting, walking, exercise) learns motion structure rich enough to transfer to fine-grained manipulative, gestural, and procedural activities (e.g., snapping, stirring, waving) that are absent from pretraining. We implement TransfHAR as a real-time smartwatch application that lets users define and expand their own activity set for personalized recognition from only a few demonstrations. Across three offline cross-dataset evaluations, TransfHAR matches or exceeds fully supervised baselines that use complete label sets with equal or additional sensor channels, by 6.2 balanced-accuracy points on average. In an in-lab study with 10 participants each performing seven novel wrist activities, TransfHAR reaches 86.7% balanced accuracy across participants with five examples per class and 90.4% when updated from a single one-minute recording per class. These results indicate that broad self-supervised wrist pretraining provides an effective foundation for on-demand fine-grained activity recognition.

AI.tldr: TransfHAR是一个基于自监督预训练的腕部IMU细粒度活动识别框架，通过从大规模未标注的粗粒度活动中学习可迁移的运动先验，实现仅需少量演示即可按需识别细粒度操作、手势和程序性活动。跨数据集评估中平均超出全监督基线6.2个平衡准确率点，在10人7种新颖活动的实验室研究中达到86.7%-90.4%的平衡准确率。
AI.motivation: 细粒度腕部活动识别可支持程序步骤引导和上下文感知辅助等应用，但为每个新任务、新用户和新活动粒度获取标注数据是瓶颈。现有方法依赖完整标注集，难以支持按需、个性化的活动定义。
AI.method: TransfHAR采用自监督预训练策略：首先在粗粒度腕部IMU活动（如坐、走、运动）上进行自监督预训练，学习丰富的运动结构先验；然后将其迁移到预训练中未出现的细粒度操作、手势和程序性活动（如点击、搅拌、挥手）。系统实现为实时智能手表应用，允许用户定义和扩展自己的活动集，仅需少量演示即可实现个性化识别。
AI.result: 在三项离线跨数据集评估中，TransfHAR平均超过使用完整标签集且传感器通道相等或更多的全监督基线6.2个平衡准确率点。在10名参与者各执行7种新颖腕部活动的实验室研究中，每类仅5个示例时达到86.7%的跨参与者平衡准确率，使用每类单条一分钟录制更新后可达90.4%。
AI.conclusion: 广泛的腕部自监督预训练为按需的细粒度活动识别提供了有效基础，展示了从粗粒度活动学到的运动先验可以很好地迁移到细粒度活动，为个性化、数据高效的可穿戴活动识别提供了可行的技术路径。

title: Matched Outcomes, Divergent Gaze: How Foveated MLLMs Search Compared to Humans
comment: Paper accepted at 3rd HCV workshop at ECCV 2026. 12 pages main text, 16 pages supp
summary: Human visual search is serial: the fovea must land on a candidate to confirm it, and those landings form a scanpath. Whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs), given the same foveated input, search as humans do bears on their use as models of human vision and on attention-alignment scores. We compare three general-purpose MLLMs with human eye-movement scanpaths on goal-directed search (COCO-Search18), driving each model fixation by fixation through an identical, human-matched foveated view and assessing it along three axes: the decision of target presence, the efficiency of reaching the target, and the gaze process itself. The axes dissociate. On the decision and on target acquisition the models match or exceed humans, detecting present targets near ceiling and reaching them on the first saccade more often than people do. The gaze process is not human. Under the human-matched condition, all three share one signature: low-entropy, large-amplitude, self-consistent scanpaths that agree with themselves far more closely than two humans agree with each other. That is consistent with a single-pass, non-serial architecture rather than a limit of acuity. Matched retinal input reproduces where humans look but not how the looking unfolds in time, and no degradation regime recovers human-like search at human-like success. The gap sits on a process axis that answer-alignment and saliency metrics do not measure. Because they miss it, such metrics cannot certify human-like vision, and zero-shot models suit outcome and spatial questions but not temporal, process-level ones.

AI.tldr: 本文将三种通用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）与人类在目标导向搜索任务中的眼动扫描路径进行对比，通过逐注视点驱动模型通过相同的人类匹配中心凹视觉输入，从目标存在决策、到达目标的效率、注视过程三个轴评估。结果发现模型在决策和获取目标方面达到或超过人类，但注视过程与人类显著不同：模型产生低熵、大振幅、高度自洽的扫描路径，比两个人类之间的一致性还高。这表明模型采用单遍非串行架构而非人类串行视觉搜索，且任何退化处理都无法恢复类人搜索行为，现有度量无法捕捉这一过程层面的差异。
AI.motivation: 人类视觉搜索是串行的，需要中央凹依次落在候选目标上进行确认。研究关注多模态大语言模型在相同中心凹输入下是否会像人类一样搜索，这关系到模型作为人类视觉模型的可靠性以及注意力对齐评分工具的有效性。
AI.method: 在COCO-Search18数据集上，将三种通用MLLM与人类眼动扫描路径对比。方法上逐注视点驱动每个模型通过完全相同的人类匹配中心凹视图，并从三个独立轴评估：目标存在性决策、到达目标的效率、以及注视过程本身的特征（熵、振幅、自洽性）。
AI.result: 三个轴表现出相互分离的结果。在决策和目标获取上，模型达到或超过人类水平，目标检测接近上限，且比人类更常在第一次扫视就到达目标。但在注视过程上，三种模型共享同一特征：低熵、大振幅、自洽的扫描路径，模型自身重复的一致性远超两个不同人类之间的一致性。匹配的视网膜输入能复现人类看哪里，但不能复现看的动态时间过程。
AI.conclusion: 模型在过程层面（temporal、process-level）与人类存在本质差异，该差异源于单遍非串行架构而非视敏度限制。现有答案对齐度量与显著性度量无法捕捉这一过程层面缺口，因此不能作为类人视觉的认证指标。零样本模型适用于结果性和空间性问题，但不适用于时间性、过程层面的问题。

title: MITE-Net: SWaP-Optimized 4K Video Tiny Target Perception for Embodied Edge SAR
summary: Real-time tiny target perception in high-resolution imagery is critical for embodied Search-and-Rescue (SAR) missions. However, strict Size, Weight, and Power (SWaP) constraints on edge devices like UAVs create a bottleneck: traditional image downsampling causes severe feature loss, while slice-based processing incurs prohibitive latency. To address this gap, this paper introduces a comprehensive framework encompassing a novel architecture, specialized datasets, and hardware-level benchmarks. First, we propose MITE-Net, a SWaP-optimized cascaded architecture, which couples a bio-inspired, learning-free Tiny Target Motion-Based Region Proposal Network (TTM-RPN) with a sub-0.14M-parameter R-CNN-like head. Second, to standardize 4K tiny target evaluation, we construct the SAR-Tiny Datasets by relabeling two challenging UAV datasets: SeaDroneSee-Tiny (dynamic maritime scenes, tiny targets predominantly of 64-256 pixels ) and UAVID-Tiny (cluttered urban scenes, extremely tiny targets, less than 64 pixels). Third, we benchmark against state-of-the-art YOLO models on an edge device, NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier, where MITE-Net directly processes 4K maritime imagery, achieving a 100\% search success rate at 30.33 FPS. Consuming merely 3.19 W (9.51 FPS/W), MITE-Net vastly outperforms YOLO baselines in target recall and energy efficiency. Conversely, UAVID-Tiny evaluations expose a compound structural limitation: the learning-free bionic front-end struggles against urban backgrounds, while the ultra-lightweight head lacks representational capacity for complex features. Ultimately, this work delivers an efficient onboard perception paradigm and a rigorous baseline guiding future end-to-end SAR architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MITE-Net框架，用于边缘设备（如无人机）上高分辨率图像中的实时微小目标感知与搜救任务。该框架包含生物启发的无学习区域提案网络（TTM-RPN）和亚0.14M参数RCNN头，并构建了SAR-Tiny标准数据集（SeaDroneSee-Tiny和UAVID-Tiny）。在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier上，MITE-Net以30.33 FPS处理4K海事图像，达到100%搜索成功率，功耗仅3.19W（9.51 FPS/W），显著优于YOLO基线；但在UAVID-Tiny复杂城市场景中暴露了结构瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备（如UAV）在SWaP约束下进行实时高分辨率微小目标感知面临瓶颈：传统下采样导致特征严重丢失，而切片式处理引入不可接受的延迟。现有方法无法在严格资源限制下同时满足实时性、高召回率和能效要求，亟需一种专为嵌入式搜救场景设计的轻量级高效感知方案。
AI.method: 提出MITE-Net级联架构，由两部分组成：(1) TTM-RPN，一种生物启发的、无学习的基于运动的目标区域提案网络，利用运动线索快速定位微小目标候选区域；(2) 亚0.14M参数的R-CNN风格检测头，在提案区域上进行精细分类与回归。同时构建SAR-Tiny数据集（重新标注SeaDroneSee-Tiny和UAVID-Tiny），并在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier上进行硬件级基准测试。
AI.result: 在4K海事图像上，MITE-Net达到30.33 FPS和100%搜索成功率，功耗仅3.19W（9.51 FPS/W），在目标召回率和能效上大幅超越YOLO基线。但在UAVID-Tiny（极端微小目标、杂乱城市场景）上暴露了复合结构局限：无学习仿生前端难以应对城市背景干扰，超轻量头部缺乏复杂特征的表征能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种高效的机载感知范式和严格的基准，验证了基于运动线索的轻量级级联架构在嵌入海事搜救场景中的可行性，同时指出了在复杂城市场景下的结构局限，为未来端到端SAR架构的改进指明了方向。

title: THESIS-MoE: Trainable Hierarchical Extraction and SteerIng of Sycophancy in Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Sycophancy, the tendency of a language model to change its answer to match a user's stated belief, is a common alignment failure. Existing activation steering methods typically apply a single contrastive direction uniformly throughout the model, which is an unconditional intervention that alters activations even when no sycophantic behavior is present, trading knowledge retention for behavioral correction. In Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, prior work further suggests that behavior is encoded within expert computations rather than routing decisions alone, making precise behavioral steering particularly challenging. In this work, we introduce a shared contrastive signal, built from matched prompts with and without a stated belief, that identifies where sycophancy lives across the MoE hierarchy and drives interventions that act only where the behavior is present. We formulate localization as a causal search over a granularity ladder of MoE blocks, experts, attention blocks, and heads, and compare unconditional subtraction against two conditional alternatives: an analytic projection-based subtraction and a learned per-token gate that steers the model away from sycophancy while keeping its weights frozen. We evaluate on three MoE models measuring sycophancy alongside general knowledge and reasoning benchmarks. Our conditional interventions removed up to 90\% of the belief-induced sycophancy. Our results demonstrate that sycophancy resides in identifiable computational subcircuits and can be selectively steered while maintaining a favorable removal-retention trade-off.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)语言模型的精细化激活干预方法，通过构建共享对比信号来定位并选择性削弱模型中的阿谀奉承（sycophancy）行为，在去除最多90%信念诱导的阿谀奉承的同时，保持知识保留与行为纠正之间的良好权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的激活引导方法通常在整个模型中施加单一对比方向，这是一种无条件干预，即使不存在阿谀奉承行为也会改变激活，导致知识保留与行为纠正之间的权衡不佳。此外，在MoE模型中，行为编码在专家计算中而非仅路由决策中，使得精确的行为引导更具挑战性。
AI.method: 作者引入共享对比信号（基于有无陈述信念的匹配提示对构建），用于在MoE层级中定位阿谀奉承所在位置。定位过程是在MoE块、专家、注意力块和注意力头的粒度阶梯上进行因果搜索。干预策略对比了三种方式：无条件减法、基于解析投影的条件减法、以及学习得到的逐token门控（保持权重冻结，仅引导模型远离阿谀奉承）。
AI.result: 在三个MoE模型上的实验表明，条件干预方法去除了多达90%的信念诱导阿谀奉承行为，同时在通用知识和推理基准上保持良好的表现，验证了阿谀奉承驻留在可识别的计算子电路中，且可以被选择性引导。
AI.conclusion: 阿谀奉承行为驻留在模型中可识别的计算子电路中，通过条件干预可以在去除该行为的同时维持有利的去除-保留权衡，优于传统无条件激活引导方法。

title: Feasible and Novel Synthetic Population Generation with Tabular and Sequential Travel Attributes
summary: Synthetic populations are critical inputs for activity-based travel demand models, yet generating realistic populations from limited survey data remains challenging. Small samples miss valid attribute combinations, known as sampling zeros, and generative models may also produce infeasible structural zeros. Moreover, realistic synthetic populations must capture both static socio-demographic attributes and sequential travel behaviour, such as trip chains. This paper proposes a regularized two-stage generative framework to address these challenges, where regularization refers to additional loss terms that guide the generator toward broader valid coverage and fewer infeasible samples. In Stage 1, a Wasserstein GAN with gradient penalty is augmented with three regularization terms, IGP, LDR, and CLAP, to improve feasibility, diversity, and novelty in tabular population synthesis. In Stage 2, Transformer and LSTM-Attention models generate sequential travel attributes, including departure time, trip purpose, and travel mode, conditioned on the synthesized tabular profiles. We also introduce novelty and count-aware metrics to evaluate whether valid unseen combinations are recovered and generated in realistic proportions. Results show that regularized models outperform the vanilla WGAN-GP across feasibility, diversity, and novelty. Regularization increases feasibility by 2.1 to 3.7 percentage points and novelty by 6.6 to 10.0 percentage points, improving sampling-zero recovery without sacrificing feasibility. The F1 score improves by 6.3 to 8.6 percentage points. For sequential attributes, LSTM-Attention best matches the trip-length distribution, while Transformer achieves higher overall sequential F1, 90.6\% versus 89.1\%. Cross-stage validation confirms strong consistency between generated mobility status and generated trip chains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个正则化的两阶段生成框架，用于合成活动出行需求模型所需的合成人群：第一阶段用带有三种正则化项（IGP、LDR、CLAP）的WGAN-GP生成表格化人口属性，第二阶段用Transformer和LSTM-Attention模型生成顺序出行行为（出发时间、出行目的、出行方式）。实验表明正则化模型在可行性、多样性和新颖性上均优于基线WGAN-GP，有效恢复了采样零点。
AI.motivation: 从有限的调查数据生成真实合成人群面临两大挑战：小样本导致采样零点（有效属性组合缺失），以及生成模型可能产生不可行的结构零点。此外，真实合成人群需同时捕捉静态人口属性与顺序出行行为（如出行链）。现有方法难以同时解决上述问题，需要既能提升覆盖率又不牺牲可行性的生成框架。
AI.method: 两阶段生成框架。第一阶段：以WGAN-GP为基础，新增三种正则化损失项——IGP（改进梯度惩罚）、LDR（局部多样性保持）和CLAP（条件标签对抗）——提升表格数据生成的可行性、多样性和新颖性。第二阶段：分别使用Transformer和LSTM-Attention模型，以合成的表格化人口档案为条件，生成出发时间、出行目的和出行模式等顺序出行属性。此外引入新颖性和计数感知指标评估有效未见组合的恢复与合理比例生成。
AI.result: 正则化模型在可行性、多样性和新颖性上均优于普通WGAN-GP。正则化使可行性提升2.1至3.7个百分点，新颖性提升6.6至10.0个百分点，在提升采样零点恢复的同时不牺牲可行性；F1分数提升6.3至8.6个百分点。顺序属性方面，LSTM-Attention在匹配出行长度分布上最优，而Transformer在整体顺序F1上更高（90.6%对89.1%）。跨阶段验证表明生成的出行状态与出行链之间具有强一致性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的正则化两阶段框架有效解决了活动出行模型中合成人群生成的采样零点和不可行样本问题，在保持可行性的同时显著恢复了有效未见的属性组合，并为出行链的生成提供了可靠方案。该框架为出行需求建模中的合成人群生成提供了新的思路和评估标准。

title: Reconstruction: A Blind Benchmark for Recovering Research Ideas from Pre-Publication Bibliographies
summary: Can a language model recover the true research idea of a published paper when given only that paper's pre-publication bibliography? We introduce Reconstruction, a blind idea-recovery benchmark that withholds the seed paper and all contemporaneous or future literature, and asks models to propose hypotheses that an independent large language model judge matches against the held-out ground-truth idea. A strict anti-leakage protocol-temporal citation cutoff, anonymous reference IDs, and frozen per-paper bibliographies, which prevents prompt-time leakage of the seed idea. Across six scientific domains and 643 evaluated papers, seven frontier models achieve only modest Match rates (approx. 3-15%). We then evaluate a reference-only multi-agent (top 4) pipeline that combines cross-model review with a Swiss tournament over aligned hypothesis slots, without external web search. Cross-model review plus tournament selection raises Match rates to approx. 23-42% across all six domains, which is an observed approx. 2.4x lift over the best single-model baseline. This draft reports the protocol, anti-leakage design, and current results as an arXiv timestamp.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Reconstruction基准，仅基于论文发表前的参考文献来恢复论文的真实研究思想，通过严格的反泄漏协议防止信息泄漏，并展示了多智能体流水线（跨模型评审+瑞士锦标赛）相比单模型可将匹配率提升约2.4倍（从3-15%提升至23-42%）。
AI.motivation: 探索语言模型能否仅凭论文发表前的参考文献推断出论文的真实研究思想，同时建立一个无泄漏的盲想法恢复基准，以严谨评估模型的科学推理与联想能力。
AI.method: 提出Reconstruction基准：隐藏种子论文及所有同期或未来文献，仅提供匿名化参考文献ID（按时间截断），要求模型提出假设，再由独立的LLM裁判与真实隐藏思想进行匹配。采用严格防泄漏协议（时间引用截断、匿名参考文献ID、冻结每篇论文的参考文献列表）。在评估阶段，测试7个前沿模型的单模型表现，并设计了一个仅基于参考文献的多智能体流水线（集成前4个模型），结合跨模型评审与瑞士锦标赛机制对对齐的假设槽位进行选择，不依赖外部网络搜索。
AI.result: 在6个科学领域、643篇论文上，7个前沿模型的单一匹配率仅为约3-15%。多智能体流水线（跨模型评审+瑞士锦标赛选择）将匹配率提升至约23-42%，相比最佳单模型基线实现了约2.4倍的提升。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了Reconstruction基准的协议、防泄漏设计与当前结果，作为arXiv时间戳发布。表明了参考文献驱动的假设推理虽对单模型极具挑战，但通过多智能体协作与锦标赛选择机制可以显著提升恢复研究思想的能力。

title: CardiacMamba: Fair and Robust RGB-RF Fusion for Remote Heart Rate Estimation via State Space Modeling
summary: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables non-contact heart rate (HR) monitoring from facial videos, but RGB-only methods are vulnerable to illumination changes, motion artifacts, and skin-tone-dependent optical reflectance. We propose CardiacMamba, a fair and robust RGB-RF fusion framework that integrates optical facial cues and radio-frequency cardiac motion cues through state space modeling. CardiacMamba introduces a Temporal Difference Mamba Module (TDMM) to enhance subtle RF temporal variations, a bidirectional SSM-based interaction mechanism to align heterogeneous RGB-RF dynamics, and a Channel-wise Fast Fourier Transform (CFFT) module for channel-domain spectral refinement. On the EquiPleth dataset, CardiacMamba achieves state-of-the-art performance with 0.96 bpm MAE, 3.06 bpm RMSE, and 0.97 Pearson correlation, while reducing the observed light-dark skin-tone MAE gap to 0.26 bpm and maintaining robustness under RGB degradation and RF-missing conditions

AI.tldr: 提出CardiacMamba，一个通过状态空间建模融合RGB光学面部线索和射频心脏运动线索的公平且鲁棒的rPPG心率监测框架，在EquiPleth数据集上达到SOTA性能（MAE 0.96 bpm），并将肤色MAE差距降至0.26 bpm。
AI.motivation: RGB-only的rPPG方法易受光照变化、运动伪影和肤色相关的光学反射差异影响，导致心率监测不公平且鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: CardiacMamba包含三个核心模块：Temporal Difference Mamba Module (TDMM)增强细微的RF时序变化；基于双向SSM的交互机制对齐异质的RGB-RF动态；Channel-wise Fast Fourier Transform (CFFT)模块进行通道域频谱细化。
AI.result: 在EquiPleth数据集上达到0.96 bpm MAE、3.06 bpm RMSE和0.97 Pearson相关系数；将深浅肤色间的MAE差距降至0.26 bpm；在RGB退化及RF缺失条件下保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: RGB-RF融合结合状态空间建模能够有效提升rPPG心率监测的准确性和公平性，验证了多模态融合在克服单一RGB方法局限上的优势。

title: Large Models for Small Devices: Recent Advances and Empirical Analysis of Edge AI Deployment
comment: Parts of this work were presented at the IEEE Consumer Communications & Networking Conference (CCNC), Las Vegas, NV, USA, January 2026
summary: Running large AI models on resource-constrained edge devices requires model compression to reduce model size and computation. What compresses well, however, need not deploy well. We survey dozens of recent works that report compression results on real hardware and extract practical deployment guidelines from them. Following these guidelines, we deploy compact language and image models on GPU, CPU, and Raspberry Pi platforms across question answering and image segmentation. No single technique wins across tasks. For question answering, Qwen3.5 0.8B reaches 93.85 SQuAD F1 and 92 EM under Q5_K_M GGUF quantization, while structured pruning at the same precision costs 16 F1 at a 1% ratio. For segmentation, the ranking reverses: default quantization leaves parameters and MACs unchanged, whereas pruning cuts model size by nearly 80% at near-constant mIoU. Pruning can even inflate the deployed artifact by 21-49% by breaking k-quant super-block alignment; combined with longer, less format-compliant outputs, this raises Raspberry Pi latency up to 3.4x. Compression can also manufacture the appearance of competence rather than destroy it visibly: one LoRA-recovered variant stays fully parseable and holds 71% strict BoolQ accuracy while sending 97 of 100 predictions to a single class, at 52.6% balanced accuracy. We explain these effects through neural-flow graph analysis and prefill-decode-level latency decomposition, and condense them into task-specific deployment research directions. The right technique depends on the task, the model, and the hardware. Our experiment code and artifacts are open-sourced at https://github.com/Arnavvvkumar/deployment

AI.tldr: 本论文系统调研了数十篇在真实硬件上报告压缩结果的近期工作，提取实用部署指南，并在GPU、CPU和树莓派平台上针对问答和图像分割任务部署了紧凑的语言和图像模型。研究发现没有单一压缩技术在所有任务中占优：问答任务中GGUF量化优于结构化剪枝，而分割任务中剪枝优于量化（减小近80%模型大小且保持mIoU几乎不变）。论文还揭示了压缩可能产生"看似胜任实则失效"的假象（如LoRA恢复变体将97/100预测发送到单一类别），并通过神经流图分析和延迟分解解释这些现象。
AI.motivation: 在资源受限的边缘设备上运行大型AI模型需要模型压缩以减少模型大小和计算量，但"压缩效果好"并不等于"部署效果好"。现有工作缺乏从真实硬件部署角度出发的系统性比较和实用指导，导致从业者难以选择适合特定任务、模型和硬件的压缩方案。
AI.method: 论文采用以下方法：(1)系统调研数十篇在真实硬件上报告压缩结果的近期工作并提取部署指南；(2)在GPU、CPU和树莓派平台上系统性部署紧凑的语言模型和图像模型，对比不同压缩技术（GGUF量化、结构化剪枝、LoRA恢复等）在问答和图像分割两个任务上的表现；(3)通过神经流图（neural-flow graph）分析和prefill-decode级别的延迟分解来解释压缩对部署的影响机制。
AI.result: 问答任务中，Qwen3.5 0.8B在Q5_K_M GGUF量化下达到93.85 SQuAD F1和92 EM，而相同精度的结构化剪枝在1%比例下损失16个F1点。分割任务中排序反转：默认量化不改变参数和MACs，而剪枝将模型大小削减近80%且mIoU几乎不变。剪枝还可能因破坏k-quant超块对齐使部署产物增大21-49%，结合更大的输出导致树莓派延迟最高增加3.4倍。此外，LoRA恢复变体保持完全可解析且达到71%严格BoolQ准确率，但实际上将97/100预测发送到单一类别（平衡准确率仅52.6%），说明压缩可能制造"表面胜任"的假象。
AI.conclusion: 不存在适用于所有场景的通用最佳压缩技术：正确的技术选择取决于任务类型、模型架构和硬件平台。论文为不同任务给出针对性的部署研究方向，并将实验代码和产物开源。

title: Policy Iteration with Human Feedback: Bringing Post-Training RL to In-context Learning
summary:
Generative pretraining established reusable task representations; later work on language-based task conditioning and in-context learning showed that a fixed model could adapt its behavior from instructions and demonstrations. Policy Iteration with Human Feedback (PIHF) builds on this development and the recurrent evaluate-and-improve structure of generalized policy iteration. PIHF uses a pretrained language model as its execution substrate and moves persistent revision to a versioned natural-language policy and tool set. A language-model critic and clinical expert review complete-panel reasoning and tool-use trajectories to localize recurrent failures and form candidate revisions; the expert may reinterpret the evidence and retains authority over admission and rollback, while Recall@1 and Recall@5 validate outcomes after candidate execution.
  Across cumulative ablations and ultra-rare-disease benchmarks, a PIHF-derived policy improved Recall@1 in one proprietary executor and three open-weight executors spanning 3 to 49 billion active parameters. Gains were 32.7 percentage points for GPT-5.4 and 31.1 points for Qwen3.6-35B, a difference of 1.7 points. These results support the feasibility of using pretrained language models as fixed-weight execution substrates for expert-guided policy development in rare-disease diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出策略迭代与人类反馈（PIHF）方法，利用预训练语言模型作为固定权重执行基底，通过版本化的自然语言策略和工具集进行持续修订，并以临床专家审核和Recall指标验证，在超罕见病诊断基准上显著提升Recall@1性能。
AI.motivation: 先前工作表明预训练语言模型可通过指令和演示适应行为，但如何在罕见病诊断等高风险领域利用固定模型进行专家引导的策略持续改进仍缺乏系统方法。PIHF旨在结合策略迭代的评估-改进循环结构与人类反馈，实现可验证的策略演进。
AI.method: PIHF采用预训练语言模型作为执行基底，将持久性修订存储为版本化的自然语言策略和工具集。语言模型批评者与临床专家共同审查完整的推理轨迹和工具使用路径，定位反复出现的失败模式并形成候选修订方案；专家可重新解释证据并掌握修订的采纳与回滚权。最终通过Recall@1和Recall@5在候选执行后进行验证。
AI.result: 在超罕见病基准上，PIHF派生策略在1个专有执行器和3个开源执行器（参数规模3B至49B）上均提升Recall@1。GPT-5.4提升32.7个百分点，Qwen3.6-35B提升31.1个百分点，两者相差1.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将预训练语言模型作为固定权重执行基底，结合专家引导的策略开发在罕见病诊断中是可行的，为高风险领域的策略持续改进提供了有效范式。

title: Adaptive Mixing of Policies from Searching and Policies from Learning
summary: Background: Distillation of training targets generated thru search/planning has proven useful in reinforcement learning, but search can take exceedingly long. Objectives: Rather than perform search to the same depth every time (typically at a fixed period of steps), reduce the search depth proportionally to the quality of the policy network priors. Methods: We describe Flexer, an architecture that, for each step, mixes the policy from a neural network and the policy from Monte Carlo tree search. The mixing factor favors the MCTS policy as the policy imitation error of the network and the environment models' variance increases. Results: Flexer outperforms a version of AlphaZero (and DQN and ADP) for some experiments on three toy symbolic problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Flexer架构，该架构根据策略网络先验质量动态调整每个时间步的搜索深度：当策略网络模仿误差和env模型方差增大时，更偏向于依赖MCTS策略，而非固定深度搜索。实验表明Flexer在三个玩具符号问题上优于AlphaZero、DQN和ADP的某些版本。
AI.motivation: 通过搜索/规划生成的训练目标蒸馏在强化学习中已被证明有效，但固定深度的搜索可能耗时过长。现有方法在每个固定步骤周期执行相同深度的搜索，缺乏对策略网络先验质量的适应性，导致计算效率低下。
AI.method: 提出了Flexer架构：(1) 在每个时间步将神经网络策略与蒙特卡洛树搜索(MCTS)策略进行混合；(2) 混合系数动态调整，当网络的策略模仿误差和环境中模型的方差增大时，权重更倾向于MCTS策略，从而减少对低质量先验的依赖并降低搜索深度。
AI.result: Flexer在三个玩具符号问题上，相对于AlphaZero、DQN和ADP的某些版本取得了更好的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: 通过根据策略网络先验质量自适应调整搜索深度，可以有效减少搜索计算开销，同时保持甚至提升强化学习性能，说明固定深度搜索并非最优策略。

title: Layers Matter: Why Continual Learning Regularization Should Be Layer-Adaptive
summary: Continual learning regularizers like EWC fight forgetting by penalizing changes from previous-task parameters with per-parameter importance, typically diagonal Fisher values. Per-parameter looks more flexible than per-layer, but each layer's diagonal Fisher is a weak summary of its actual curvature, missing the top-eigenvalue information that controls forgetting. Adversarial bit-flip attacks and Hessian-spectrum studies show that this missing per-layer sensitivity spans orders of magnitude in neural networks. Under a block-diagonal Hessian assumption, the layer-level analogue of EWC's existing diagonal assumption, we prove three things. Forgetting decomposes as a sum of per-layer terms weighted by each layer's top Hessian eigenvalue. Diagonal-Fisher weights cannot recover this eigenvalue. For instance, two layers with identical Fisher averages can have top eigenvalues differing by a factor as large as the layer width. For the same level of forgetting, uniform regularization loses new-task performance by an amount scaling with the layer condition number. Our theoretical analysis leads to a simple recipe: protect early layers strongly, let deeper layers move. We apply this recipe to EWC and SLCA and show clear improvements in average performance and forgetting metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了持续学习正则化方法（如EWC）中按参数（对角Fisher）分配重要性权重的局限性，证明在块对角Hessian假设下，遗忘可分解为各层按其最大Hessian特征值加权的项之和，而对角Fisher权重无法捕获该特征值信息。作者提出"强保护浅层、放开深层"的简单策略，并将其应用于EWC和SLCA，在平均性能和遗忘指标上均取得明显提升。
AI.motivation: EWC等持续学习正则化通过按参数重要性（通常为对角Fisher）惩罚偏离旧任务参数来对抗遗忘。按参数权重视觉上比按层更灵活，但每层的内积Fisher对角只是该层真实曲率的弱近似，缺失了控制遗忘的顶部特征值信息。对抗性位翻转攻击和Hessian谱研究表明，这种缺失的逐层灵敏度在神经网络中跨越多个数量级，因此需要从理论上揭示并修正这一缺陷。
AI.method: 在块对角Hessian假设下（即EWC现有对角假设的逐层推广），作者证明了三个结论：(1) 遗忘可分解为各层项之和，每一项由该层顶部Hessian特征值加权；(2) 对角Fisher权重无法恢复这一特征值——两个具有相同Fisher均值的层，其顶部特征值差异可达层宽度量级；(3) 在相同遗忘水平下，统一正则化导致的新任务性能损失随层条件数缩放。基于这些分析，提出"强保护早期（浅）层、允许深层移动"的简单配方，并将其应用于EWC和SLCA。
AI.result: 将提出的分层保护策略应用于EWC和SLCA后，在平均性能和遗忘指标上均取得明显改进，验证了理论分析的实践有效性。
AI.conclusion: 持续学习正则化的按参数重要性假设（对角Fisher）在块对角Hessian设定下在数学上无法准确建模遗忘，正确的做法应基于逐层顶部Hessian特征值分配保护强度，且简单策略——浅层强保护、深层放开——即可带来显著性能提升。

title: Proteus: Incremental Memory Activation for Long-Context Sequence Modeling
summary: The quadratic cost of attention-based sequence models for long contexts has motivated a growing line of research on memory-based models that can compress context into a compact state. However, most existing memory models expose a static memory throughout the entire sequence. Because early tokens face no compression pressure, they occupy too many degrees of freedom and "pollute" the memory state, leaving little capacity for later context and increasing interference between what is stored and what arrives next. We study a new paradigm of incremental memory activation, where the effective capacity of memory is progressively expanded as the context grows. Imposing an early bottleneck forces the model to compress history more effectively, while unlocking fresh capacity over time reduces interference and improves retention of later context. We instantiate this paradigm in Proteus, a straightforward mechanism that can be incorporated into a broad class of neural memory architectures at no additional cost. We apply Proteus to state-of-the-art models, including SWLA, Comba, Titans, and Hope-Attention, and observe consistent improvements on standard language modeling and reasoning, as well as on long-context retrieval and understanding, with gains that grow at longer context lengths. Overall, our results show that static memory is suboptimal and that scheduling effective capacity is a simple and broadly applicable tool for sequence modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出增量内存激活范式Proteus，通过随上下文增长逐步扩展内存容量，早期瓶颈强制模型更有效地压缩历史，同时随时间解锁新容量以减少干扰，适用于多种神经内存架构且零额外成本。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于注意力的序列模型在处理长上下文时面临二次方计算成本，促使了基于内存的压缩模型研究。然而现有内存模型在整个序列中使用静态内存，早期token没有压缩压力，占用过多自由度导致内存状态被"污染"，留下很少容量给后续上下文，并增加存储与新到达信息之间的干扰。
AI.method: 提出增量内存激活（incremental memory activation）新范式，内存的有效容量随上下文增长逐步扩展。通过早期瓶颈强制模型更有效地压缩历史，随后逐步解锁新容量以减少干扰并改善后期上下文的记忆。将该机制实例化为Proteus，可无缝集成到广泛的神经内存架构中且无额外成本，并应用于SWLA、Comba、Titans和Hope-Attention等先进模型。
AI.result: Proteus在标准语言建模、推理以及长上下文检索和理解任务上保持一致改进，且增益随上下文长度增加而增长。
AI.conclusion: 静态内存是次优的，调度有效容量是一种简单且广泛适用的序列建模工具。

title: CLARA: Clip-Level Multimodal Alignment with VLM-Derived Rationales for Hateful Video Detection
summary: Hateful video detection has become increasingly important with the rapid growth of video-centric social media platforms, given the serious risks that hate speech poses to both individual well-being and social cohesion. Compared with text or static multimodal content, hateful video detection remains underexplored and significantly more challenging, as hateful meaning often arises from complex interactions among multimodal cues, including speech, audio, and visual content. Moreover, such signals are often brief, implicit, and temporally dependent, making them difficult to capture using conventional video-level representations. In this work, we propose CLARA, a clip-level multimodal framework for hateful video detection. Instead of treating a video as a single instance, CLARA models it as a sequence of fine-grained clips, enabling more precise capture of temporally localized hateful signals. We introduce a Mixture-of-Experts clip encoder for adaptive multimodal alignment, a local-global segment contrastive objective to jointly model short-term cues and long-range temporal dependencies, and VLM-derived rationales integrated via a gated Transformer to provide high-level semantic guidance. Extensive experiments on three hateful video datasets demonstrate that CLARA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Further ablation studies and parameter analyses validate the effectiveness of each component.

AI.tldr: 提出CLARA，一种基于clip级别的多模态框架用于仇恨视频检测，将视频建模为细粒度片段序列，通过MoE剪辑编码器、局部-全局对比学习和VLM推理门控Transformer，在三个数据集上超越SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 视频社交平台快速增长使仇恨视频检测日益重要，但相比文本或静态多模态内容，仇恨视频检测仍未被充分探索且更具挑战性。仇恨语义常源于语音、音频和视觉等多模态线索间的复杂交互，且这些信号通常短暂、隐晦、具有时间依赖性，传统视频级表示难以捕捉。
