AI.method: 提出CLARA框架，包括三个核心组件：(1) 基于Mixture-of-Experts的clip编码器实现自适应多模态对齐；(2) 局部-全局片段对比学习目标联合建模短期线索与长程时间依赖；(3) 通过门控Transformer集成VLM-derived推理，提供高层语义指导。
AI.result: 在三个仇恨视频数据集上的大量实验表明，CLARA持续优于现有最优方法；进一步消融研究和参数分析验证了每个组件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: CLARA通过clip级别的细粒度建模有效解决了仇恨视频中多模态信号短暂、隐晦和时间依赖的难题，为仇恨视频检测提供了更精确的框架，并在多个数据集上验证了其优越性。

title: HyMem: Hierarchical Context Management for Long-Horizon Agents via Information Isolation
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents often perform poorly on complex, long-horizon tasks because their context becomes increasingly cluttered over time. As interactions accumulate, detailed execution traces and intermediate outputs dominate the context, making it difficult for the model to retain and use high-level planning information. Most existing methods address this issue through compression or retrieval applied to a single, flat context, which does not clearly separate different types of context information and often leads to degraded reasoning. To address this challenge, we propose HyMem, a hierarchical framework that explicitly separates the agent's context into distinct functional layers. HyMem organizes context by function to separate high-level planning from execution and complex analysis. Its isolated reasoning module handles complex subtasks without adding intermediate reasoning traces to the persistent planning context, while its memory management module preserves task progress across context refreshes through structured summaries. These components reduce redundant context accumulation, retain task-critical information, and support coherent long-horizon reasoning within a limited context window. Experiments on GAIA and Browsecomp-plus show that, with DeepSeek-V4, HyMem achieves average Pass@1 scores of 66.7% and 61.3%, outperforming the strongest baseline by 6.1 and 4.7 percentage points, respectively. Further analysis indicates that HyMem effectively controls the growth of the reasoning context, allowing the model to maintain focus and accuracy across complex, long-horizon tasks.

AI.tldr: HyMem提出了一种层次化上下文管理框架，将智能体的上下文按功能分离为高层规划、执行和复杂分析等不同层级，通过隔离推理模块和内存管理模块减少冗余上下文累积，在GAIA和Browsecomp-plus基准上分别达到66.7%和61.3%的Pass@1准确率，超越最强基线6.1和4.7个百分点。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在处理复杂长时任务时表现不佳，因为随着交互累积，详细执行轨迹和中间输出不断涌入上下文，导致模型难以保留和使用高层规划信息。现有方法多采用压缩或检索处理单一扁平上下文，未能清晰区分不同类型的信息，常常导致推理退化。
AI.method: HyMem采用层次化框架，将智能体上下文按功能显式分离：高层规划、执行和复杂分析各自独立；隔离的推理模块处理复杂子任务而不将中间推理痕迹注入持久规划上下文；内存管理模块通过结构化摘要跨上下文刷新保留任务进度信息。
AI.result: 基于DeepSeek-V4，HyMem在GAIA和Browsecomp-plus上分别取得66.7%和61.3%的平均Pass@1成绩，超越最强基线6.1和4.7个百分点。进一步分析表明HyMem有效控制推理上下文的增长，使模型在复杂长时任务中保持专注和准确性。
AI.conclusion: HyMem通过显式分离不同类型的上下文信息，有效减少冗余上下文累积并保留任务关键信息，在有限上下文窗口内支持连贯的长时程推理，为长时程LLM智能体提供了有效的上下文管理解决方案。

title: Information Geometry of Message Passing
summary: We show that the natural-gradient stationary condition of variational inference has an edge-local form on a Forney-style factor graph. We start from the Bethe free energy and constrain a selected edge marginal to an exponential family. At a stationary point, the natural parameter of that edge equals the sum of two projected messages, one from each incident factor. Each projected message is the natural-gradient projection of the exact belief-propagation log-message at the current receiving marginal, or equivalently, the gradient of its expectation in the so-called mean coordinates. We call the resulting scheme natural-gradient message passing (NGMP). The rule is local; each edge may carry its own exponential family, and the message a factor sends depends on the marginal that receives it. Compared with variational message passing, NGMP keeps the part of the exact message that the receiving family can represent instead of averaging the factor under the neighboring beliefs. The two coincide when the uncertainty on the edges entering a non-conjugate factor vanishes, and NGMP is more accurate when that uncertainty persists, for example, along a partially observed latent chain or when parameters are filtered through successive data batches. Experiments on Poisson smoothing, heteroskedastic regression, and hourly ETTh forecasting confirm this and show that the gain appears mainly in uncertainty calibration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自然梯度消息传递（NGMP），证明在Forney式因子图上，变分推断的自然梯度平稳条件具有边局部形式：在平稳点处，每条边的自然参数等于两个来自相邻因子投影消息之和，每个投影消息是精确BP对数消息在接收边际上的自然梯度投影。NGMP在非共轭因素存在时比变分消息传递更准确，尤其在不确定性校准方面。
AI.motivation: 变分消息传递（VMP）在处理非共轭因子时，通过对相邻信念求平均来简化消息，这会丢失接收方指数族无法表达但实际存在的不确定性信息。作者希望设计一种保留精确消息中接收族可表达部分的消息传递方案，同时保持局部性和计算效率。
AI.method: 从Bethe自由能出发，将选定边边际约束到指数族。在平稳点推导出自然参数的边局部形式：每条边的自然参数等于两个因子投影消息之和。每个投影消息定义为精确信念传播对数消息在当前接收边际处的自然梯度投影（等价于其在均值坐标下期望的梯度）。由此提出NGMP规则：各边可携带独立指数族，因子发送的消息依赖于接收该消息的边际。
AI.result: 在泊松平滑、异方差回归和每小时ETTh时间序列预测实验中，NGMP相比VMP在不确定性校准方面表现更好，特别是在边存在持续不确定性的场景（如部分观测的潜在链、参数经连续数据批次滤波）下优势明显。当非共轭因子输入边不确定性消失时，NGMP与VMP重合。
AI.conclusion: NGMP为变分推断提供了一种更精确的边局部自然梯度消息传递框架，弥合了精确信念传播投影与VMP平均化之间信息保留的差距，在不确定性校准上具有显著优势，同时保持与VMP相当的计算复杂度和局部性。

title: Comprehensive Benchmarking of Deep Learning Architectures for Lung Cancer Histopathology
summary: Lung cancer remains the leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, while histopathological diagnosis is often affected by inter-observer variability and the substantial workload associated with manual slide examination. Although deep learning has shown considerable potential in computational pathology, comprehensive benchmarks that integrate tissue classification and region segmentation within a unified analytical framework remain limited. This study presents a two-stage deep learning framework for multi-class tissue classification and pixel-level histopathological region segmentation, accompanied by a systematic comparison of state-of-the-art architectures at each stage. For tissue classification, six models, a custom convolutional neural network, VGG16, DenseNet, MobileNetV3, a custom Vision Transformer, and YOLO11, are evaluated on a combined dataset of 39,000 images derived from LC25000 and LungHist700. The models distinguish between adenocarcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, and normal lung tissue. YOLO11 achieves the best classification performance, with an accuracy of 98.38%, a five-fold cross-validation accuracy of 98.21 +/- 0.35%, and a macro F1-score of 0.98. For region segmentation, U-Net, ResNet-encoder U-Net, DeepLabV3+, and YOLO11-seg are evaluated using the GlaS gland segmentation benchmark. DeepLabV3+ obtains the highest Intersection over Union of 0.80 and a Dice score of 0.89, while YOLO11-seg achieves a comparable Intersection over Union of 0.79 using approximately 14x fewer parameters. The best-performing classification and segmentation models are subsequently integrated into an end-to-end framework, providing an accurate, computationally efficient, and reproducible baseline for automated histopathological image analysis.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一个两阶段深度学习框架，用于肺癌组织的多类别分类和像素级区域分割。在组织分类阶段，对6种模型（自定义CNN、VGG16、DenseNet、MobileNetV3、自定义ViT和YOLO11）在39,000张图像上进行评估，YOLO11以98.38%的准确率表现最佳。在区域分割阶段，对U-Net、ResNet编码器U-Net、DeepLabV3+和YOLO11-seg进行对比，DeepLabV3+取得最优IoU（0.80），而YOLO11-seg以约14倍更少的参数达到可比性能。最优模型被整合为端到端框架，为自动化组织病理图像分析提供准确且计算高效的基线。
AI.motivation: 肺癌是全球癌症相关死亡率最高的癌症类型，而组织病理学诊断常受观察者间差异和手动阅片巨大工作量的影响。尽管深度学习在计算病理学中展现出潜力，但将组织分类和区域分割整合到统一分析框架中的综合基准仍然有限，因此需要构建这样的框架并系统比较各阶段的最先进架构。
AI.method: 采用两阶段深度学习框架：(1) 组织分类阶段，在由LC25000和LungHist700组成、共39,000张图像的结合数据集上评估6种模型（自定义CNN、VGG16、DenseNet、MobileNetV3、自定义ViT、YOLO11），区分腺癌、鳞状细胞癌和正常肺组织；(2) 区域分割阶段，在GlaS腺体分割基准上评估U-Net、ResNet编码器U-Net、DeepLabV3+和YOLO11-seg。最后将最优分类和分割模型整合为端到端框架。
AI.result: YOLO11在分类任务中表现最佳，准确率98.38%，五折交叉验证准确率98.21±0.35%，宏F1分数0.98。分割任务中DeepLabV3+取得最高IoU（0.80）和Dice分数（0.89），YOLO11-seg以约14倍更少的参数达到可比的IoU（0.79）。
AI.conclusion: 将YOLO11分类器与DeepLabV3+（或参数效率更优的YOLO11-seg）分割模型整合而成的端到端框架，为自动化组织病理图像分析提供了准确、计算高效且可复现的基线，有助于缓解病理诊断中的人工负担和观察者间差异问题。

title: PLeDO: Pain Level Detection for Osteoarthritis from EMR Data
summary: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a progressive chronic joint disease resulting in a breakdown of articular cartilage and bone when damaged joint tissues are not able to normally repair themselves. The aim of this pilot research study is to understand the pain severity for OA from patients' primary care Electronic Medical Records (EMR), both from the structured medical data and the unstructured chart note data using information extraction, natural language processing and machine learning techniques. We propose SPaDe, a Synonym-based Pain level Detection tool to categorize patients into having mild or moderate-to-severe pain to understand diagnosis and treatment methods based on only the pain related expressions in the unstructured chart note. Expressions are subjective, objective, and influenced by cultural background and demography which poses a difficult challenge. Therefore, we improve the model by incorporating the medication information from the structured EMR data and pain scale related information from the chart note to propose an integrated pain level detection tool for OA called PLeDO. With the help of human labeled gold standard data, we demonstrate that both SPaDe and PLeDO can detect mild and moderate-to-severe pain from the EMR data to analyze and potentially improve the quality of care in primary care setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPaDe和PLeDO两种工具，分别从电子病历（EMR）中的非结构化病历笔记和结构化医疗数据中提取疼痛相关信息，利用自然语言处理、信息抽取和机器学习技术，将骨关节炎（OA）患者的疼痛程度分类为轻度或中重度，以辅助初诊医疗中的诊断和治疗决策。
AI.motivation: 骨关节炎是进行性慢性关节疾病，患者疼痛信息散落在电子病历的结构化数据和非结构化病历笔记中，而主观、客观疼痛表达受文化背景和人口统计学因素影响，识别疼痛严重程度存在困难。研究旨在利用EMR数据自动化检测OA患者的疼痛等级，以改善初级诊疗中的护理质量。
AI.method: 提出SPaDe（基于同义词的疼痛等级检测工具），仅利用病历笔记中的疼痛相关表达进行分类；在此基础上结合结构化EMR中的用药信息和病历中的疼痛量表信息，提出集成型的PLeDO工具。使用人工标注的金标准数据进行评估。
AI.result: 在人工标注的金标准数据上，SPaDe和PLeDO均能有效检测出轻度与中重度疼痛，验证了从EMR数据中分析OA患者疼痛严重程度的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明利用EMR中结构化与非结构化数据的结合可以有效检测OA患者的疼痛程度，为初级诊疗环境中分析并潜在提升护理质量提供支持。

title: ReliaGate: Reliability Routing for Low-Stakes Wearable Stress Prediction
comment: Accepted at WellComp 2026, held with UbiComp/ISWC 2026. 7 pages, 4 tables, and 1 figure. To appear in UbiComp Companion '26. ACM DOI: 10.1145/3798063.3841770
summary: We study when a wearable stress system should surface a prediction rather than change it. In low-stakes reflection and summary settings, aggregate accuracy is insufficient because withholding can reduce error while leaving some people with little or no information. We formulate fixed-label reliability routing: after a locked classifier emits a protocol-defined stress/non-stress label, a post-hoc gate surfaces that unchanged label or withholds it as unavailable. ReliaGate assembles established confidence, signal-quality/trust, agreement, train-standardized atypicality, and train-fitted geometry cues into a post-hoc correctness score. We evaluate four wearable datasets using subject-disjoint folds, validation-selected routing, paired held-out-subject intervals, and pooled and per-subject analyses. WESAD point estimates favored ReliaGate, UBFC-Phys primary coverage/risk intervals favored ReliaGate, and E4 checks were mixed. ReliaGate provides an operational framework for studying surfaced-label error, output availability, and accepted-output distribution across subjects, without revising labels or providing clinical or finite-sample risk guarantees.

AI.tldr: 本文研究可穿戴压力系统何时应"展示"预测而非"修改"预测，提出固定标签可靠性路由框架。在已锁定分类器输出压力/非压力标签后，由后置门控(ReliaGate)决定是否展示该未修改标签或将其隐藏为"不可用"。ReliaGate综合置信度、信号质量/信任度、一致性、训练标准化非典型性及训练拟合几何特征等线索构成事后正确性评分。在四个可穿戴数据集上采用主体不相交折、验证集选择路由、配对保留主体区间及池化/逐主体分析进行评估，结果在多数数据集上优于基线。
AI.motivation: 在低风险反思和总结场景中，聚合准确性不足以衡量可穿戴压力系统的表现，因为隐藏预测虽能降低整体错误率，却可能导致部分用户几乎得不到任何信息。因此需要研究何时应展示预测而非修改预测，以平衡输出误差与信息可用性。
AI.method: 提出固定标签可靠性路由框架：锁定分类器按其预定义协议输出压力/非压力标签后，一个后置门控(ReliaGate)决定展示该未修改标签或将其标记为不可用。ReliaGate将置信度、信号质量/信任、预测一致性、训练标准化非典型性、训练拟合几何特征等多种线索组合为事后正确性评分，指导路由决策。
AI.result: 在WESAD、UBFC-Phys和E4四个可穿戴数据集上的评估中：WESAD点估计支持ReliaGate，UBFC-Phys主要覆盖率/风险区间支持ReliaGate，而E4校验结果表现不一。总体而言ReliaGate提供了一个可操作的研究框架。
AI.conclusion: ReliaGate为研究可穿戴压力系统中的表面标签错误、输出可用性及不同主体间已接受输出的分布提供了可操作框架。其核心思路是"不修改标签，只决定展示与否"，不提供临床或有限样本风险保证，适用于低风险反思/总结场景。

title: BagShift: Measuring How Patch Selection Changes the Evidence Seen by Whole-Slide MIL
summary: Whole-slide multiple-instance learning (MIL) observes only the patches admitted by its selector. Deployment can alter this selector through compute limits, tissue masking, or regional workflows, even when the patch count is unchanged. We introduce BagShift, a paired protocol that changes the selector for the same case while holding its features and predictor fixed, thereby isolating selector response from case mix. With equal 128-patch budgets, sampling across the tissue or concentrating around one coordinate exposes markedly different evidence: on PANDA, the two views reduce quadratic weighted kappa by 1.57 and 17.96 points, respectively (QWK reported on the $\times100$ scale). On CAMELYON16, lesion annotations withheld from model development show that localized views retain tumor in only 10.0\% of micrometastatic observations, and matched exposure does not consistently recover the loss. The same fixed-count stressor produces a much smaller response on external lung subtyping, although differences in relative coverage make cross-task severity descriptive. When repeated localized observations are available, unioning their patches before one nonlinear MIL pass improves PANDA QWK by 7.87 points over averaging regional predictions. Patch count specifies computation, not observed evidence; deployment evaluations should report both what a selector preserves and how repeated observations are aggregated.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BagShift配对协议，通过仅改变全切片多实例学习（MIL）中的补丁选择器而保持特征和预测器不变，隔离选择器响应与病例组合的影响。实验表明在固定补丁预算下，采样策略的变化会显著改变模型观察到的证据并导致性能大幅波动（如PANDA上QWK分别下降1.57和17.96点），而外部肺部亚型任务中该影响较小，说明补丁数量决定的是计算量而非观察到的证据。
AI.motivation: 现有MIL方法忽略了部署时选择器可能变化（如计算限制、组织掩膜或区域工作流）对模型性能的影响。即使补丁数量不变，选择器改变也会改变模型观察到的内容，但缺乏一个能隔离选择器效应与病例混合效应的评估框架，使得部署评估难以归因性能变化来源。
AI.method: 提出BagShift配对协议：对同一病例仅改变补丁选择器，同时保持特征提取器和预测器固定，从而将选择器响应与病例混合分离。实验设计包括：在PANDA（前列腺癌）和CAMELYON16（乳腺癌转移）上进行不同采样策略对比（全组织采样vs局部集中采样），在固定128个补丁预算下评估性能差异；对Camelyon16使用训练时隐匿的病灶标注评估局部视图保留肿瘤的能力；并探索多次局部观察时通过拼接补丁再经过一次非线性MIL聚合与直接平均区域预测的效果差异。
AI.result: 在PANDA上，两种视图分别导致QWK下降1.57和17.96点（×100尺度）；CAMELYON16中，局部视图仅在10.0%的微转移观察中保留肿瘤，且匹配暴露无法一致恢复损失；外部肺部亚型任务中响应较小，但相对覆盖率差异使跨任务严重程度具有描述性；在多次局部观察可重复时，拼接补丁后进行一次非线性MIL相比平均区域预测，在PANDA上QWK提升7.87点。
AI.conclusion: 补丁数量决定的是计算预算而非观察到的证据，部署评估应同时报告选择器保留了什么以及重复观察如何聚合。BagShift为量化选择器漂移效应提供了配对评估框架，揭示了采样策略对MIL性能的显著影响。

title: Toward AI-Friendly Cartography: Understanding How Color Design Influences Foundation Model Spatial Reasoning on Sequential Choropleth Maps
summary: Foundation models (FMs) increasingly support multimodal and geospatial reasoning, yet it remains unclear whether cartographic principles designed for human perception are equally effective for machines. Focusing on sequential choropleth maps, we examine how hue palette, color ordering, and lightness contrast influence FM spatial reasoning. We construct a controlled benchmark of 5,760 maps and 28,800 questions spanning Attribute Identify, Spatial Recognition, Compare, Rank, and Pattern Delineate, and evaluate 21 open-source and proprietary multimodal FMs. Results show that hue choice has limited and inconsistent effects, whereas disrupting sequential color ordering substantially reduces performance, especially for comparison and ranking. Reduced lightness contrast also consistently impairs reasoning, while increasing contrast beyond sufficient separability provides only marginal gains. LoRA fine-tuning improves overall accuracy but preserves these relative sensitivities. Additional factorial experiments further indicate that errors arise from color-and-legend decoding, spatial reasoning, and the integration of thematic attributes with spatial structure. These findings show that conventional sequential ordering and sufficient contrast remain important for machine map understanding and provide empirical guidance for AI-friendly cartographic design.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建5,760张顺序色级统计地图和28,800个问题的受控基准，系统评估了色相调色板、颜色排序和明度对比度对多模态基础模型空间推理能力的影响，发现颜色排序被打乱和明度对比度降低会显著损害模型表现，而色相选择影响有限且不稳定，同时LoRA微调虽提升整体准确率但保留这些相对敏感性。
AI.motivation: 基础模型日益支持多模态和地理空间推理，但针对人类感知设计的制图原则是否对机器同样有效尚不明确。作者希望系统检验传统制图学原则对机器地图理解的有效性，为面向AI友好的制图设计提供实证指导。
AI.method: 构建包含5,760张地图和28,800个问题的受控基准，覆盖属性识别、空间识别、比较、排序和模式勾画五类任务；操纵三个制图变量（色相调色板、颜色排序、明度对比度）；评估21个开源和专有多模态基础模型，并辅以LoRA微调对比实验及额外析因实验。
AI.result: 色相选择对模型表现影响有限且不一致；打乱顺序颜色排序会显著降低表现（尤其对比较和排序任务）；降低明度对比度持续损害推理能力，而过度增加对比度边际收益有限；LoRA微调提升整体准确率但保留相对敏感性；错误来源涉及颜色-图例解码、空间推理以及主题属性与空间结构的整合。
AI.conclusion: 传统的顺序颜色排序和足够的明度对比度对机器地图理解仍然重要，研究为AI友好的制图设计提供了实证依据，表明人类感知设计原则与机器地图推理之间存在部分一致但非完全重叠的规律。

title: Beat the Counter First: A Baseline for Temporal-Graph Anomaly Detectors
summary: Progress in streaming, edge-level graph anomaly detection (GAD) has been marked by increasingly elaborate architectures, from count-min-sketch chi square tests to memory-augmented attention networks. Yet the empirical gains attributable to this added complexity have not been systematically evaluated. We propose SimpleCount, a reference with no parameter fitting that selects one scalar feature per dataset from a fixed pool of counts, recencies, first-occurrence indicators, and count-derived transforms. We compare SimpleCount with two temporal-graph detector models and an IsoForest control fitted to the complete feature vector across five public datasets and one synthetic dataset. SimpleCount matches or exceeds SLADE on three of six datasets and exceeds IsoForest on all six. We report paired statistical tests and five-seed SLADE evaluations. SLADE requires 23 to 133x more wall-clock time than SimpleCount. On Synth-Triangle and an additional Synth-Quad probe, pre-event structural scores recover the planted signal at AUC up to 0.955, while all evaluated detector models remain near random. The benefit of complexity is dataset-dependent, and every claimed gain should be reported against a strong one-feature reference together with its compute cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SimpleCount：一种无需参数拟合的边缘级图异常检测基准方法，仅从固定计数特征池中选取单个标量特征。在与SLADE和IsoForest的对比中，SimpleCount在6个数据集中的3个上匹配或超越SLADE，并在全部6个数据集上超越IsoForest，同时计算开销远低于SLADE（23-133倍）。实验还发现，在特定合成数据集中，简单的前事件结构分数能以AUC高达0.955恢复已植入的信号，而所有复杂检测模型均接近随机。研究结论强调：复杂模型的收益取决于数据集，任何声称的增益都应对照强单特征基准并报告计算成本。
AI.motivation: 流式/边缘级图异常检测（GAD）领域不断堆砌复杂架构（从count-min-sketch卡方检验到记忆增强注意力网络），但新增复杂度带来的经验性增益从未被系统评估。作者质疑这种"复杂度迷信"，主张通过强基准对比来量化复杂模型的实际收益。
AI.method: 提出SimpleCount基准方法：零参数拟合，从固定池（计数、新近度、首现指示符及计数衍生变换）中为每个数据集选取一个标量特征。在5个公开数据集和1个合成数据集上，与两种时序图检测器模型（含SLADE）及拟合完整特征向量的IsoForest对照模型进行比较，并执行配对统计检验和五种子SLADE评估。
AI.result: SimpleCount在6个数据集中的3个上匹配或超越SLADE，并在全部6个数据集上超越IsoForest；SLADE耗时是SimpleCount的23-133倍。在Synth-Triangle及额外Synth-Quad探针数据上，前事件结构分数能以高达0.955的AUC恢复植入信号，而所有被评估的检测模型均接近随机。
AI.conclusion: 复杂模型的增益是数据集依赖的（dataset-dependent），并非普适。作者呼吁：任何声称的GAD模型增益都应对照强单特征基准（one-feature reference）报告，同时披露计算成本。

title: CM-MAE: A Physics-Guided Cross-Modal Self-Supervised Learning Framework for Vision-Wireless Applications
summary: Synchronized camera and wireless measurements observe the same scene through different physical channels. The central difficulty is that a representation learned in one deployment can fail when viewpoint, traffic, illumination, and propagation geometry change. This paper presents CM-MAE, a self-supervised vision--wireless pretraining framework for cross-scenario representation transfer. The evaluated real-data model uses only RGB frames and the measured 64-beam received-power vector available in DeepSense 6G; it does not use ray-traced paths, calibrated depth, or beam-index labels during pretraining. Its central pretraining term is a \emph{soft contrastive alignment loss}. Instead of making the synchronized image--wireless pair the only positive pair, this loss builds a target distribution from similarities between measured beam-power profiles, so nonidentical samples with similar directional responses are not forced apart as false negatives. A masked joint decoder provides the complementary local objective by reconstructing hidden visual patches and wireless angular clusters under modality dropout. After pretraining, a differential-rate fine-tuning rule lets a new fusion head adapt quickly while the encoders move slowly. Under a sequence-disjoint DeepSense 6G protocol, adding the soft alignment loss improves a matched linear-probe transfer average from 24.88\% to 29.49\%. Mild fusion fine-tuning reaches 77.38\% Top-1 accuracy on unseen Scenarios 6--8, and optional transductive normalization adaptation reaches 78.69\%. Since the fusion setting uses the contemporaneous 64-beam power vector at inference, these results should be read as representation-transfer diagnostics, not as proactive beam-prediction or reduced-sweeping claims.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CM-MAE，一个自监督的视觉-无线跨模态预训练框架，用于跨场景表示迁移。其核心是软对比对齐损失（soft contrastive alignment loss），通过基于波束功率探测相似度构建目标分布而非仅依赖同步图像-无线对，配合带模态丢包的掩码联合解码器进行局部重建。在DeepSense 6G数据集上，软对齐损失将匹配线性探测迁移平均准确率从24.88%提升至29.49%，融合微调在未见场景6-8上达到77.38% Top-1准确率，转导归一化后可达78.69%。
AI.motivation: 同步摄像头与无线测量通过不同物理通道观测同一场景，但单一部署中学到的表示在视点、交通、光照和传播几何变化时容易失效。因此亟需一种能够在不同场景间实现表示迁移的自监督预训练框架。
AI.method: CM-MAE采用两个核心模块：(1) 软对比对齐损失——不将同步图像-无线对作为唯一正样本对，而是根据测量的波束功率剖面相似度构建目标分布，避免将具有相似方向响应的非相同样本强行分离为假负样本；(2) 带模态丢包的掩码联合解码器——通过重建隐藏的视觉块和无线角度簇提供互补的局部目标。预训练仅使用RGB帧和64波束接收功率向量，不依赖射线追踪路径、标定深度或波束索引标签。微调阶段采用差分速率规则，使新的融合头快速适应而编码器缓慢更新。
AI.result: 在序列不相交的DeepSense 6G协议下，软对齐损失将匹配线性探测迁移平均准确率从24.88%提高到29.49%；轻度融合微调在未见场景6-8上达到77.38% Top-1准确率，可选的转导归一化适应进一步提升至78.69%。
AI.conclusion: CM-MAE验证了软对比对齐结合掩码重建的自监督策略能有效实现视觉-无线跨场景表示迁移。由于推理时融合设置仍使用同时刻的64波束功率向量，实验结果是表示迁移诊断指标，而非主动波束预测或减少波束扫描的宣称。

title: A Banach-Space Theory of Markovian Halpern Iteration for Non-Expansive Maps
summary: We study stochastic approximation of fixed points of a non-expansive operator when the oracle samples originate from a continuing Markovian trajectory. A direct block-minibatch implementation of Halpern iteration attains an expected last-iterate residual of order $O(\log N/N)$, but accrues a substantive complexity of $\tilde O(ε^{-5})$ Markovian samples. We therefore introduce a variance-reduced Markovian PAGE-Halpern method whose refresh and same-state difference blocks are analyzed through the Poisson equation. In Hilbert spaces, the cocoercivity of $I-T$ results in an $O(ε^{-3})$ sample complexity. Our main result extends this construction to a general finite-dimensional Banach space. A displacement-level Halpern bound replaces the Hilbert-space potential and yields $\tilde O(ε^{-3})$ sample complexity in the original non-expansiveness norm. We also establish a high-probability guarantee with the same leading accuracy dependence by measuring the estimator in an auxiliary smooth norm. Non-smooth sup and block-sup geometries are covered through norm smoothing.

AI.tldr: 研究在马尔可夫轨迹持续采样下，非扩张算子不动点的随机近似问题。提出方差缩减的马尔可夫PAGE-Halpern方法，利用Poisson方程分析刷新块和同状态差分块，在Hilbert空间中获得O(ε^{-3})样本复杂度，并通过位移级Halpern界将该结果推广到一般有限维Banach空间，同时建立高概率保证。
AI.motivation: 直接块小批量实现Halpern迭代虽然能达到O(log N/N)的期望末次残差，但需要O~(ε^{-5})的马尔可夫样本复杂度，成本过高。需要设计方差缩减方法来降低样本复杂度。
AI.method: 引入方差缩减的马尔可夫PAGE-Halpern方法，其刷新块（refresh block）和同状态差分块（same-state difference block）通过Poisson方程分析。利用I-T的余强性（cocoercivity）处理Hilbert空间；在一般有限维Banach空间中，用位移级Halpern界替代Hilbert空间势函数；通过辅助光滑范数度量估计量以建立高概率保证，并借助范数平滑处理非光滑sup和块sup几何。
AI.result: 在Hilbert空间中达到O(ε^{-3})样本复杂度；在一般有限维Banach空间（原始非扩张范数下）达到O~(ε^{-3})样本复杂度；高概率保证具有相同的领先精度依赖；覆盖了非光滑sup和块sup几何。
AI.conclusion: 提出的方差缩减马尔可夫PAGE-Halpern方法显著降低了样本复杂度（从O~(ε^{-5})降至O(ε^{-3})），并成功将理论从Hilbert空间推广到一般Banach空间，同时提供高概率保证和更广泛的几何覆盖。

title: A Plug-and-Play 2D Motion Interface for Real-World Motion Language Models
comment: Accepted to HCMIW at ECCV 2026 (Oral Presentation). Code and demo: https://github.com/irajisamurai/2D-Motion-Interface
summary:
Motion Language Models (MoLMs) typically understand human motions by tokenizing 3D motion and processing the resulting tokens using a language model. However, obtaining accurate 3D motions from monocular videos is challenging, limiting their real-world applicability. To address this issue, we introduce a plug-and-play 2D Motion Interface that enables 3D-pretrained MoLMs to accept 2D motion inputs without modifying or fine-tuning the original models.
  Experiments on public datasets show that our method achieves performance comparable to 3D motion inputs across multiple MoLMs and outperforms training MoLMs from scratch on 2D motions. We further construct a monocular real-world video motion evaluation dataset and introduce a real-video adapter, demonstrating the usefulness of 2D motions over 3D motions under the evaluated monocular pose-estimation setting. These results suggest that 2D motion provides a practical interface for deploying MoLMs in real-world motion understanding settings. Code is available at https://github.com/irajisamurai/2D-Motion-Interface.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种即插即用的2D运动接口，使得基于3D预训练的Motion Language Models (MoLMs)能够直接接受2D运动输入，无需修改或微调原始模型，从而规避了从单目视频获取精确3D运动的困难，提升MoLMs在实际应用中的可用性。
AI.motivation: MoLMs通常需要将3D运动token化后再输入语言模型处理，但现实中从单目视频准确获取3D运动非常困难，严重限制了MoLMs在真实世界场景中的部署与应用。
AI.method: 提出一个即插即用的2D运动接口（2D Motion Interface），将2D运动输入映射到3D预训练MoLMs可理解的空间，无需修改或微调原模型；同时引入一个真实视频适配器（real-video adapter）以适配单目真实视频中的运动数据。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上，该方法在多个MoLMs上达到了与3D运动输入相当的性能，且优于直接从2D运动从头训练MoLMs的效果。另外构建了单目真实视频运动评估数据集，在单目姿态估计设定下验证了2D运动相比3D运动的实用优势。
AI.conclusion: 2D运动为MoLMs在真实世界运动理解场景中的部署提供了一种实际可行的接口，能够在不牺牲性能的前提下克服3D运动获取困难的瓶颈。

title: Intent-Driven Situation Tracking for User-Centric Multi-Turn Agents
summary: User-centric multi-turn agents must act on an evolving task situation shaped by changing user intents, accumulated tool-grounded facts, missing information, and execution constraints. Existing context-management methods improve the use of past interaction history, but rarely maintain an explicit situation state that separates grounded facts from task-state judgments. As a result, agents often need to infer fine-grained attributes, task dependencies, and constraint satisfaction implicitly from dialogue traces. We propose Intent-Driven Situation States (IDSS), a training-free framework that maintains an explicit situation state alongside the dialogue. IDSS parses tool returns into provenance-aware entities and attributes, tracks user intents, required variables, constraints, and execution status, and propagates new facts to task constraints to update action executability. This allows agents to avoid infeasible actions, advance dependent goals, and reuse relevant information without repeatedly searching raw history. Experiments on three interactive benchmarks across eight LLMs show that IDSS improves task completion, preference elicitation, and interaction efficiency, with clear gains on tasks involving multi-entity coordination, evolving user constraints, and constraint-aware replanning. Ablations and error analyses show that these improvements come from the interaction between fact persistence, intent-centered state tracking, and constraint modeling. These results suggest that explicit situation tracking offers an effective alternative to history-centric context management for reliable user-centric multi-turn agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IDSS（Intent-Driven Situation States），一个无需训练的框架，通过显式维护情景状态（包含来源感知的实体/属性、用户意图、必要变量、约束和执行状态）来增强多轮用户中心智能体的上下文管理能力，在三个交互基准和八个LLM上的实验表明其能提升任务完成率、偏好获取和交互效率。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文管理方法侧重于更好地利用历史交互记录，但很少维护一个显式的情景状态来区分已确认事实与任务状态判断。这导致智能体往往需要从对话痕迹中隐式推断细粒度属性、任务依赖和约束满足情况，容易产生不可行动作、无法推进依赖目标、重复搜索历史等问题。
AI.method: IDSS是一个训练无关的框架，在对话之外维护显式的情景状态。具体地：1）将工具返回结果解析为具有来源感知（provenance-aware）的实体和属性；2）跟踪用户意图、所需变量、约束及执行状态；3）将新获得的事实传播到任务约束中，更新动作可执行性。通过这一机制，智能体可以避免不可行动作、推进依赖目标，并无需反复搜索原始历史即可复用相关信息。
AI.result: 在三个交互基准和八个LLM上的实验表明，IDSS在任务完成、偏好获取和交互效率方面均有提升，特别是在涉及多实体协调、动态用户约束和约束感知重规划的任务上优势明显。消融实验和错误分析证实，改进来源于事实持久化、意图中心的状态跟踪和约束建模之间的相互作用。
AI.conclusion: 显式情景跟踪是历史中心上下文管理的有效替代方案，可为可靠的用户中心多轮智能体提供更强的支撑。

title: Spatial Temporal Synergy: Balancing Change and Invariance in Text Driven 3D Human Motion Editing
summary: Text-driven human motion editing aims to modify existing motion sequences according to natural language instructions while maintaining the structural consistency of the original motion. Existing diffusion-based approaches struggle to balance text-responsive "change" and inertial "invariance". They often rely on coarse spatial constraints and rigid uniform time assumptions, leading to spatial motion distortions and the destruction of intrinsic physical rhythms during variable-length editing. To handle these challenges, we propose Change and Invariance Motion Editing (CIME), a unified framework that comprehensively decouples change and invariance into spatial pose and temporal rhythm dimensions. For spatial poses, our method integrates an omni-supervised positive-negative learning mechanism comprising hierarchical retrospective feature supervision, subtle motion preservation, and triplet-based semantic alignment. For temporal rhythms, we introduce the Riemannian Non-uniform Integral Manifold Mapping (RNIMM) module, which achieves high-fidelity reproduction of physical beats in the edited text via kinematics-aware non-uniform timestamps. Extensive experiments on the MotionFix and STANCE Adjustment datasets demonstrate that CIME achieves state-of-the-art performance in editing alignment and structural fidelity, validating the effectiveness of our unified architecture. Our source codes and models have been released at: github.com/ZhenwuShi/CIME.git

AI.tldr: CIME是一个统一的文本驱动人体运动编辑框架，通过将"变化"与"不变性"在空间姿态和时间节奏两个维度上进行解耦，结合全监督正负学习机制和黎曼非均匀积分流形映射模块，在MotionFix和STANCE Adjustment数据集上取得了最先进的编辑对齐和结构保真性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于扩散模型的文本驱动人体运动编辑方法难以平衡文本响应的"变化"与原有运动的"不变性"。它们依赖于粗糙的空间约束和刚性的均匀时间假设，导致空间运动扭曲以及在变长编辑中破坏固有的物理节奏。
AI.method: CIME框架从两个维度综合解耦变化与不变性：(1) 空间姿态维度：采用全监督正负学习机制，包含层次化回顾性特征监督、细微运动保持和三元组语义对齐；(2) 时间节奏维度：引入黎曼非均匀积分流形映射(RNIMM)模块，通过运动学感知的非均匀时间戳实现编辑文本中物理节拍的高保真再现。
AI.result: 在MotionFix和STANCE Adjustment两个数据集上的大量实验表明，CIME在编辑对齐和结构保真方面达到了最先进的性能，验证了统一架构的有效性。源代码和模型已公开发布。
AI.conclusion: CIME通过空间与时间两个维度的解耦式设计，有效解决了文本驱动运动编辑中"变化"与"不变性"之间的权衡问题，为变长编辑场景下的物理节奏保持提供了一种新的解决方案。

title: Broken Symmetry in LLM Refusal: Answer Release Is More Local Than Refusal Restoration
summary: When a language model refuses to answer a prompt, it is unclear whether the correct answer is erased from its internal representations, or merely suppressed at the output layer. We investigate this mechanism using a controlled withhold setting, which yields perfectly matched answering and refusal trajectories for bidirectional activation patching. We uncover a causal asymmetry in intervention locality under matched causal interventions, which we term broken symmetry. Even when a model generates a clean refusal, the correct answer remains linearly recoverable from its hidden states. Furthermore, releasing this withheld answer is a highly local operation, requiring only a single-position patch. Conversely, the reverse operation is not equally local: reimposing suppression requires broader interventions across multiple positions, and assembling a coherent refusal sequence is more difficult still. We further demonstrate that while an average answer-to-refusal displacement vector marks the geometric difference between these states, it fails to act as a reliable, reversible linear control toggle between behaviours. Taken together, our findings show that refusal does not function as a simple symmetric switch. For safety and auditing, this implies that probe recoverability can overestimate true behavioural control, and locating refusal-relevant directions does not reliably grant the ability to steer a model from answering to coherent refusal.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过受控保留（withhold）设置揭示了语言模型拒绝行为的因果不对称性：模型即使生成干净的拒绝回答，正确答案仍可从其隐藏状态中线性恢复；释放被抑制的答案只需单个位置的激活修补（高度局部），而重新施加抑制则需要多个位置的更广泛干预。这一发现表明拒绝行为并非简单的对称开关，探针可恢复性可能高估真实的行为控制能力。
AI.motivation: 当语言模型拒绝回答某个提示时，无法确定正确回答是从内部表征中被擦除，还是仅在被输出层抑制。理解这一机制对于模型安全审计和可解释性研究至关重要，但目前缺乏对拒绝行为内部机制的系统性因果分析。
AI.method: 采用受控保留设置，构建"回答"与"拒绝"两条完全匹配的轨迹，通过双向激活修补（bidirectional activation patching）进行因果干预，分析干预的局部性（locality）差异，并引入均值位移向量（average displacement vector）检验其作为对称线性控制开关的有效性。
AI.result: 发现三个关键结果：（1）即使模型产生干净的拒绝，正确答案仍可从隐藏状态中线性恢复；（2）释放被抑制的答案只需单位置修补（高度局部操作），而重新施加抑制需要跨多个位置的更广干预，构建连贯拒绝序列更难；（3）平均答案到拒绝的位移向量虽然标记了两状态的几何差异，但不能作为可靠、可逆的线性行为控制开关。
AI.conclusion: 拒绝机制并非简单的对称开关。对安全审计而言，探针可恢复性可能高估真实的行为控制能力；找到拒绝相关方向并不能可靠地赋予从回答到连贯拒绝的操控能力。这为解释模型对齐机制提供了重要启示。

title: Fiber Fingerprints of Hidden Learning-State Dynamics
comment: 30 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. Ancillary files include figure-reproducibility code and frozen plot-level data
summary: A learning system can occupy execution states that are indistinguishable under every declared present-behavior readout yet respond differently to future training. We formalize this through fiber fingerprints: controlled future-learning response laws restricted to present-behavior equivalence classes. Prefix-compatible finite probes induce a predictive quotient functor, a Nerode-type minimal recursively sufficient representation, and a canonical set-level predictive fiber without assuming smoothness, reversibility, finite rank, or a manifold. Under an explicit finite-dimensional Hilbert realization, response decomposes into visible, visible-mode-reuse, and irreducible-new sectors; a history-reachability bridge retains only distinctions generated by natural training histories. Conditional mechanism results then identify a graph-Hodge chronology decomposition, a regular switching class with root-mean-square scale $\sqrt{p}η^{3/2}$ and finite-scale corrections, and an exact Adam moment section whose immediate adaptive field is constant while common future gradients can reveal hidden moment differences. Frozen Transformer--LoRA--AdamW studies with Qwen2.5-7B and Mistral-7B-v0.3 support a local action backbone, longer-horizon first-return non-closure, and fresh visible-relative completion with output-range reuse and a low-rank irreducible sector. Stronger claims remain bounded by preregistered negative or mixed results: re-anchored transport is unresolved above its measurement floor; the strict finite-grid Hodge--$3/2$ conjunction is unmet despite prospective contraction; Qwen accessibility is not established in the frozen raw moment chart; and Mistral revelation is future-context dependent rather than bank invariant. Within these support-, scale-, metric-, and context-resolved boundaries, present behavior is not a sufficient statistic for declared future learning.

AI.tldr: 本文通过"纤维指纹"（fiber fingerprints）形式化证明了学习系统可处于所有声明行为读出一致、但对未来训练响应不同的状态。在无光滑性、可逆性、有限秩或流形假设下，构建了Nerode型最小递归充分表示；在有限维Hilbert实现下将响应分解为可见、可见模式复用和不可约新三个扇区。实验（Qwen2.5-7B和Mistral-7B-v0.3的Frozen Transformer-LoRA-AdamW）支持局部动作骨架与低秩不可约扇区等主张，但若干更强声明受限于预注册的负面或混合结果。结论：在支持、尺度、度量和上下文边界内，当前行为不足以作为未来学习声明的充分统计量。
AI.motivation: 核心动机是揭示学习系统中一个深层问题：当前可观察行为完全一致的系统可能在训练后产生分歧，即"当前行为不足以预测未来学习"。已有的等价类/可观测性理论通常假设光滑性、流形结构或有限秩等条件，本文希望在极弱假设下建立严格的数学框架（Nerode型最小表示），并进一步在实际大语言模型微调（LoRA/AdamW）场景中验证这些理论预测。
AI.method: 理论层面：(1) 引入纤维指纹概念，将未来学习响应律限制在当前行为等价类上；(2) 通过前缀兼容有限探针构造预测商函子和Nerode型最小递归充分表示；(3) 在有限维Hilbert实现下将响应分解为可见/可见模式复用/不可约新三扇区；(4) 建立图-Hodge时间分解、正则切换类（RMS尺度√p·η^{3/2}）及Adam矩截面理论。实验层面：在Qwen2.5-7B和Mistral-7B-v0.3上冻结Transformer，仅训练LoRA适配器并使用AdamW优化器，检验上述理论的实证预测。
AI.result: 实验结果支持以下主张：局部动作骨架的存在性、更长视界首次返回的非闭包性、新鲜可见相对补全（含输出范围复用与低秩不可约扇区）。但更强声明受边界限制：重新锚定的输运在其测量下限之上未获解析；严格有限网格Hodge-3/2合取未达成（尽管存在预期收缩）；Qwen在冻结原始矩图中未建立可及性；Mistral的揭示依赖未来上下文而非银行不变量。
AI.conclusion: 本文在严格限定的支持、尺度、度量和上下文边界内得出核心结论：当前呈现行为不是声明未来学习的充分统计量。这一结论具有理论与实证的双重基础——理论上通过纤维指纹和Nerode型表示严格证明，实证上由两个7B级模型的冻结微调实验提供局部验证，同时诚实地报告了与更强声明相悖的负面与混合结果。

title: Depth-guided Multi-view Exposure Bracketing for HDR Robot Vision
summary: Achieving reliable single-shot high dynamic range (HDR) imaging under extreme illumination conditions remains a long-standing challenge, yet no comprehensive benchmark exist for evaluating HDR perception in multi-sensor robotic systems. To fill this gap, we introduce a large-scale dataset collected via a custom robotic vision platform and an iPhone 13 Pro: 121 real-world scenes spanning modest and ultra-high dynamic range conditions, alongside 20 synthetic video sequences from the CARLA simulator. As a reference pipeline for this dataset, we propose Depth-guided Multi-view Exposure Bracketing (DMEB), a single-shot HDR method that distributes drastically different exposures across multi-view low-bit-depth cameras and fuses them via depth-guided confidence-aware fusion. Evaluations on our dataset show that DMEB establishes a strong reference point and highlight the promise of this sensor configuration for robust HDR perception in diverse multi-camera and depth sensor system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个面向多传感器机器人系统的高动态范围（HDR）感知基准数据集，包含121个真实场景和20个CARLA合成视频序列，并提出了深度引导多视角曝光包围（DMEB）方法作为参考基线。
AI.motivation: 极端光照条件下的可靠单次曝光HDR成像仍是一个长期挑战，但现有研究缺乏针对多传感器机器人系统的HDR感知综合基准。
AI.method: 构建了基于定制机器人视觉平台和iPhone 13 Pro的大规模数据集（121个真实场景+20个CARLA合成序列），并提出DMEB方法：将差异极大的曝光分配到多视角低比特深度相机上，通过深度引导的置信度感知融合实现单次HDR成像。
AI.result: 在数据集上的评估表明，DMEB建立了强有力的参考基准，验证了这种多相机+深度传感器配置在多样化HDR感知场景中的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集和DMEB方法为多传感器机器人系统的HDR感知研究提供了首个综合基准和可靠的参考管线。

title: Operator-Theoretic Generalization Bounds for Multitask Deep Learning
summary: We develop operator-theoretic generalization bounds for deep multi-output function classes by representing network layers as Koopman composition operators on vector-valued reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces. In vector-valued Sobolev RKHSs, we derive Rademacher complexity bounds for invertible and width-expanding injective architectures. The estimates separate the output-coupling contribution, represented by the trace of the task matrix, from the layerwise operator norms, Sobolev symbol ratios, determinant factors, and restriction constants generated by the linear maps. We then analyze a distinct one-dimensional Brownian/Cameron--Martin regime. Using the exact anchored derivative-norm characterization of the vector-valued Brownian RKHS, we obtain layerwise bounds for domain-preserving scalar linear maps and anchored diffeomorphic activations; the corresponding factors scale as $|W_l|^{1/2}$ and $\|σ_l'\|_\infty^{1/2}$, respectively, and do not involve Sobolev smoothness exponents. Because the Sobolev and Brownian results concern different hypothesis spaces, neither is asserted to dominate the other uniformly. We additionally formulate shared operator learning across tasks, prove a finite-rank representer theorem, derive the exact finite-dimensional problem for squared loss, and establish a target-transfer bound when the learned operator is obtained independently of the target sample. Synthetic and MNIST studies examine stabilized Sobolev-inspired and Brownian-inspired complexity proxies; these empirical proxies are not evaluations of the proved bounds for rank-deficient architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文为深度多输出函数类开发了基于算子理论的泛化界，将网络层表示为向量值再生核希尔伯特空间上的Koopman复合算子。在Sobolev空间得到Rademacher复杂度界，在Brownian/Cameron-Martin域得到逐层界，并涉及算子共享学习、有限秩表示定理及目标迁移约束。
AI.motivation: 现有深度网络泛化界往往依赖于标量假设空间或难以处理多输出结构的复杂度度量，缺乏统一的算子理论框架来同时捕捉输出耦合、逐层算子范数等多维度影响因素。
AI.method: 将网络层建模为向量值RKHS上的Koopman复合算子；在向量值Sobolev RKHS中推导Rademacher复杂度界（分解输出耦合迹、层算子范数、Sobolev符号比、行列式因子与限制常数）；在Brownian/Cameron-Martin域利用精确锚定导数范数特征推导逐层界（因子分别为|W_l|^{1/2}和||σ_l'||_∞^{1/2}）；推导有限秩表示定理、平方损失下的精确有限维问题及目标迁移界。
AI.result: 获得了两个不同假设空间（Sobolev与Brownian）下的复杂度界，二者互不支配；建立了算子共享学习的表示定理与目标迁移界；在MNIST和合成数据上检验了Sobolev与Brownian启发的复杂度代理指标（但代理并非对秩亏架构所证边界求值）。
AI.conclusion: 算子理论框架为多输出深度网络的泛化分析提供了新的视角，能够将结构复杂的深度网络复杂度分解为可解释的算子层贡献；Sobolev与Brownian两种框架针对不同假设空间各有适用场景，实验验证显示其复杂度代理具有稳定性和实用性。

title: Multi-scale Decomposed Convolution Refinement Network for Visible-Infrared Person Re-Identification
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures. Accepted for publication in the LNCS proceedings of ICONIP 2026
summary: Visible-infrared person re-identification (VI-ReID) suffers from cross-modal discrepancies and limited discriminative capabilities, leading to suboptimal recognition performance. Current approaches exhibit limitations in semantic mining, cross-modal fusion and feature constraints. To tackle these challenges, we propose MDCRNet, a Multi-scale Decomposed Convolution Refinement Network that enhances cross-modal feature learning and discriminative metric learning. Specifically, we introduce a Hierarchical Learning Module (HLM) containing four Hierarchical Decomposed Convolution Attention (HDCA) modules, each equipped with lightweight channel attention and multi-scale spatial perception blocks to capture multi-scale spatial dependencies. Moreover, we develop a Joint Discriminative Metric Loss (JDML) incorporating a novel Granularity Discriminative Loss (GDL) that simultaneously optimizes intra-identity compactness and inter-identity separability across modalities. Extensive experiments on SYSU-MM01 and RegDB datasets demonstrate that MDCRNet achieves state-of-the-art performance on both benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/Kevin-zms/MDCRNet.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MDCRNet（多尺度分解卷积精化网络）来应对可见光-红外行人重识别（VI-ReID）中的跨模态差异和判别能力不足问题，通过引入层级学习模块（HLM）和联合判别度量损失（JDML）增强跨模态特征学习与判别度量学习，在SYSU-MM01和RegDB数据集上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: VI-ReID面临跨模态差异和有限的判别能力导致识别性能欠佳的问题，现有方法在语义挖掘、跨模态融合和特征约束方面存在局限，亟需更有效的解决方法。
AI.method: 提出MDCRNet，包含两部分核心设计：（1）层级学习模块（HLM），由四个层级分解卷积注意力（HDCA）模块组成，每个模块配备轻量级通道注意力和多尺度空间感知块以捕获多尺度空间依赖；（2）联合判别度量损失（JDML），其中引入新颖的粒度判别损失（GDL），同时优化跨模态的类内紧凑性和类间可分离性。
AI.result: 在SYSU-MM01和RegDB两个公开基准数据集上的大量实验表明，MDCRNet在两个基准上均取得了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: MDCRNet通过多尺度分解卷积精化网络有效解决了VI-ReID的跨模态差异和判别能力不足问题，验证了层级特征学习与联合判别度量学习在跨模态行人重识别任务中的有效性。

title: Pricing the Risk of Runtime Compression: Anytime-Valid Admission and a Served-Output Law for Compressed Serving State
comment: 29 pages (20 pages main text plus appendices), 8 figures, 10 tables. Companion paper: "What to Protect When You Quantize a Mixture of Experts", submitted concurrently. Lean 4 development (228 exported theorems, no sorry) and all artifacts released
summary: Runtime compression of serving state trades quality for capacity with no priced guarantee: systems adapt precision on load signals with no soundness statement, and certified approaches budget request-level risk by a union bound over a pre-declared event count. We show the union budget exhausts on every long request in a production serving stack (100% of requests), and replace it with an anytime-valid, physically accounted ledger whose bound holds at every one of 352,333 admission calls on live traffic and which, in a pre-registered held-out confirmatory round, halves the exact-fallback rate at matched risk (0.30 -> 0.14) -- coverage is bought at a price the account states. We then price the remaining distance from the certified witness to what a user experiences: a machine-checked design law (TV <= tanh(a_q w_thr)) turns the served-TV target into a threshold knob, and a three-layer audit of its instantiation -- an operator-norm query envelope measured 1.5x from tight, a measured-ellipsoid replacement for the Cauchy-Schwarz ball that buys nothing (0.89x, held-out sound), and the gate's operating point (~700x) -- localizes the entire 1064x gap to the operating point, a price the law now states rather than an unknown. A priced bound is worth nothing on a request one has not seen, so the third link is the quantifier: exchangeable extrapolation across 80 serving histories replaces binary conformal prediction's vacuous certificates with order-statistic bounds that discriminate (0.41 against 0.51 calibration risk). All probabilistic kernels are Lean 4-checked (228 exported theorems, no sorry); which object deserves this machinery at all is settled empirically in a companion paper that adjudicates -- and rejects -- the natural alternative of certifying routing. What ships is an account: risk you can spend, a gap you can read off a law, and a bound that survives the request you have not seen.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套"记账式"（accounting-based）的运行时压缩认证框架，用 anytime-valid 的物理记账代替传统 union bound 的无界风险预算，在真实生产流量上通过 352,333 次准入调用检验，并将精确回退率减半（0.30→0.14），同时通过 Lean 4 机器校验和三层审计将整个 1064 倍的理论-实践差距精确定位到门限操作点。
AI.motivation: 现有的运行时压缩（如精度自适应）在负载信号驱动下牺牲质量换取容量，但没有定价保障；而有认证的方法通过 union bound 在预先声明的事件数量上分配请求级风险，这种预算在任何长请求上都会耗尽（在真实生产栈中 100% 的请求如此），因此缺乏可随任意时刻持续的可靠性保证。
AI.method: 1）用 anytime-valid、物理记账的 ledger 替换 union bound 预算，使界在每次准入调用时都成立；2）引入机器校验的设计定律 TV ≤ tanh(a_q·w_thr)，将服务的 TV 目标转化为阈值旋钮；3）执行三层审计：算子范数查询包络（实测距紧界 1.5x）、实测椭球替代 Cauchy-Schwarz 球（0.89x，无收益）、门操作点（约 700x），从而定位全部 1064 倍差距；4）用可交换外推替代二元共形预测的空洞证书，在 80 条服务历史上得到可区分的序统计量界；5）所有概率内核经 Lean 4 校验（228 条导出定理，无 sorry）。
AI.result: 在 352,333 次真实流量准入调用上界始终成立；预注册的留出确认轮中，在匹配风险下精确回退率从 0.30 降至 0.14；算法规格审计将 1064 倍总差距局部化为门操作点；可交换外推的次序统计量界在 0.41 vs 0.51 标定风险上具有判别力。
AI.conclusion: 交付的不是一个黑盒系统，而是一份"账本"：风险可花费（可预算）、差距可从定律读出（可解释）、界对未见过的请求依然成立（可推广）。同时，配套论文从实证上裁定并否定了为路由做认证这一替代方案。

title: Toward Optimal Second-Order Path-Length Guarantee for Adversarial Multi-Armed Bandits
summary: We study second-order path-length regret in adversarial $K$-armed bandits against oblivious loss sequences. Bubeck et al. [2019] designed an algorithm that achieves $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(K+\sqrt{KQ_{\infty,1}})$ regret, where $Q_{\infty,1}$ is the first-order path length, and left open whether $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\text{poly}(K)\sqrt{1+Q_{\infty,2}})$ regret is achievable under bandit feedback, where $Q_{\infty,2}$ is the second-order path length. Somewhat surprisingly, we resolve this question positively by showing that with a more involved analysis, the exact same algorithm of Bubeck et al. [2019] achieves $\mathcal{O}\left(K\log(KT)+\sqrt{K\log(KT)\bigl(1+Q_{\infty,2}\bigr)}\right)$ expected regret when $Q_{\infty,2}$ is known, where $T$ is the horizon. This matches the $Ω(\sqrt{KQ_{\infty,2}})$ lower bound up to logarithmic factors and additive terms. We further remove the knowledge of $Q_{\infty,2}$ using an adaptive restart scheme whose path-length estimator has uniformly bounded increments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究对抗性K臂老虎机中关于遗忘损失序列的二阶路径长度遗憾。作者证明Bubeck等人[2019]的原始算法在更深入的分析下即可达到𝒪(K log(KT)+√(K log(KT)(1+Q∞,2)))的期望遗憾，解决了二阶路径长度上界是否可达的开放问题，并通过自适应重启方案去除了对Q∞,2的预先了解。
AI.motivation: Bubeck等人[2019]设计了在对抗性K臂老虎机中达到一阶路径长度遗憾𝒪̃(K+√(KQ∞,1))的算法，但遗留了一个开放问题：在bandit反馈下是否能够达到关于二阶路径长度Q∞,2的𝒪̃(poly(K)√(1+Q∞,2))遗憾界。二阶路径长度是对损失序列更精细的刻画，能够捕捉损失变化的速度，因此解决这一问题是理论上的自然推进。
AI.method: 作者首先证明Bubeck等人[2019]的同一算法在更精细的分析下即可达到关于二阶路径长度的遗憾界，无需修改算法本身。关键在于对算法分析中路径长度项的重新界定，利用二阶变差捕捉损失变化的二次累积。随后，针对Q∞,2未知的情况，提出了一种自适应重启（adaptive restart）方案，其路径长度估计器具有一致有界增量，从而在不需要预知Q∞,2的情况下维持相同的遗憾保证。
AI.result: 当Q∞,2已知时，算法达到𝒪(K log(KT)+√(K log(KT)(1+Q∞,2)))期望遗憾，与Ω(√(KQ∞,2))下界在对数因子和加性项内相匹配。当Q∞,2未知时，通过自适应重启方案同样达到该遗憾界，无需预知二阶路径长度。
AI.conclusion: 本文出人意料地正面解决了Bubeck等人的开放问题：不仅证明了二阶路径长度遗憾界可在bandit反馈下实现，而且实现它的正是原算法本身，只需要更深入的分析。这展示了原始算法在路径长度刻画上超越一阶的适应性，并填补了该方向的理论空白。

title: TR-GS: High-Fidelity Sparse-View CT Volumetric Rendering via t-Distribution Gaussian Splatting and Ray-Confidence Modeling
summary: High-fidelity 3D medical visualization supports applications such as clinical assessment and surgical planning. Sparse-view computed tomography (CT) can reduce projection requirements and associated radiation exposure, but limited observations may introduce structural artifacts and reconstruction uncertainty. Although 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides an efficient explicit representation for volumetric rendering, existing CT methods based on standard Gaussian primitives may be sensitive to unreliable observations under sparse-view acquisition. We present TR-GS, a Gaussian-splatting framework for sparse view CT volumetric rendering. TR-GS replaces standard Gaussian primitives with projectable Student's t-distribution primitives and introduces a ray-confidence model that regulates their degrees of freedom according to local ray observability. Confidence-guided 3D wavelet regularization is further used to balance high-frequency detail preservation and noise suppression. This work is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets show that TR-GS improves over representative baselines in most evaluated settings and remains competitive in the remaining cases. The resulting volumetric representations may support downstream medical multimedia applications, including XR-based visualization and interactive clinical rendering.

AI.tldr: TR-GS是一个基于高斯溅射（3DGS）的稀疏视图CT体积渲染框架，用可投影的学生t分布代替标准高斯原语，引入射线置信度模型和置信度引导的3D小波正则化，在合成及真实数据集上优于多数基线方法。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视图CT虽可减少投影次数和辐射暴露，但有限观测会导致结构伪影和重建不确定性。现有基于标准高斯原语的CT方法在稀疏采集下对不可靠观测敏感，需要更鲁棒的体积渲染方案。
AI.method: TR-GS包含三个核心设计：（1）用可投影的学生t分布原语替代标准高斯原语；（2）引入射线置信度模型，根据局部射线可观测性调节原语的自由度；（3）使用置信度引导的3D小波正则化，在高频细节保留与噪声抑制之间取得平衡。
AI.result: 在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，TR-GS在大多数评估设置下优于代表性基线方法，在其余情况下保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: TR-GS生成的体积表示可支持下游医学多媒体应用，如XR可视化和交互式临床渲染。

title: RLCascadeRouter: Quality-Estimator-Free Cascade Routing via Reinforcement Learning
summary: The growing ecosystem of large language models (LLMs) offers huge potential to optimize performance-cost trade-offs. However, their heterogeneous capabilities and inference costs make efficiently routing queries a significant challenge. Existing paradigms are inflexible: one-shot routers commit before observing responses, whereas conventional cascades stop adaptively but follow a fixed model order. Cascade routing removes both restrictions by reconsidering whether to stop or invoke another model after each response. Current methods use a predict-then-optimize pipeline estimating response quality and future model utility. However, prediction loss for quality or utility is not equivalent to routing-decision loss. A lower prediction error does not necessarily yield a better action; a small boundary-crossing error can reverse a ``stop'' or model-selection decision. Therefore, we propose RLCascadeRouter, a quality-estimator-free framework that formulates cascade routing as a Markov decision process with actions comprising ``stop'' and model selection. It uses trajectory returns and advantages to directly optimize the performance-cost objective. Its Cascade Policy Network models candidate complementarity for model selection and remaining-action value for stopping, eliminating independent post-hoc response-quality estimators. Evaluated across ten LLMRouterBench benchmarks with thirteen LLMs, RLCascadeRouter outperforms strong baselines and achieves superior performance-cost trade-offs. It incorporates unseen models without retraining, and ablation studies validate both policy components.

AI.tldr: 提出RLCascadeRouter框架，将LLM级联路由建模为马尔可夫决策过程，通过强化学习直接优化性能-成本目标，无需独立的质量估计器，在十个基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM路由方法存在不足：一次性路由器在观察到响应前就做决定，而传统级联方法虽能自适应停止但遵循固定模型顺序。当前预测-优化流程中，质量或效用的预测损失不等同于路由决策损失，较低预测误差不一定带来更优决策，边界处的微小错误可能反转停止或选模型的决定。
AI.method: 将级联路由形式化为一个马尔可夫决策过程，动作空间包含"停止"和模型选择两类。利用轨迹回报和优势函数直接优化性能-成本目标。提出Cascade Policy Network，该网络同时建模候选模型互补性（用于模型选择）和剩余动作价值（用于停止决策），从而消除对独立的、事后响应质量估计器的依赖。
AI.result: 在十个LLMRouterBench基准和十三个LLM上评估，RLCascadeRouter优于强基线方法，实现更优的性能-成本权衡。它能够在不重新训练的情况下纳入未见过的模型，消融研究验证了两个策略组件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将级联路由视为马尔可夫决策过程并直接优化路由决策目标（而非预测质量），RLCascadeRouter实现了更优的性能-成本平衡，同时具备良好的泛化能力（可纳入未见模型）和模块化组件设计。

title: Retrieval-guided Twin Fusion with Similarity-aware Contrast for Molecule-Text Alignment
summary: This paper studies the problem of molecule-text alignment, which aims to project molecules and their textual descriptions into a joint latent space for downstream tasks including molecule search and molecular property prediction. Previous approaches typically combine graph structure mining with contrastive learning to enhance joint representation learning. However, they typically neglect fine-grained semantic relationships between substructures and texts, leading to suboptimal performance on downstream tasks. Towards this end, we propose a novel approach named Retrieval-guided Twin Fusion with Similarity-aware Contrast (RISEN) for molecule-text alignment. The core idea of RISEN is to construct a latent twin molecule for each substructure with cross-modal retrieval for semantic enhancement. In particular, for each substructure query, we retrieve relevant textual descriptions and sample several molecules that share similar descriptions of substructures. Then, we aggregate their representations via attention pooling for a twin latent representation, which would be further fused with the original substructure for representation enrichment. In addition, we measure the similarity across substructures and texts, which would further guide cross-modal contrastive learning with soft thresholding. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets validate the superiority of the proposed RISEN in comparison with existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RISEN方法，通过跨模态检索构建潜孪生分子，结合相似度感知对比学习，实现分子-文本细粒度对齐，在多个下游任务上超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有分子-文本对齐方法通常结合图结构挖掘和对比学习，但忽略了子结构与文本之间的细粒度语义关系，导致下游任务性能次优。
AI.method: RISEN的核心包括：(1) 对每个子结构查询，通过跨模态检索获取相关文本描述，并采样共享相似描述的子结构分子；(2) 通过注意力池化聚合这些表示，构建孪生潜表示并与原始子结构融合进行表示增强；(3) 计算子结构与文本间的相似度，并通过软阈值指导跨模态对比学习。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验验证了RISEN相比现有基线方法的优越性。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入检索引导的孪生融合机制和相似度感知对比学习，RISEN有效增强了分子-文本对齐中的细粒度语义关系建模，提升了下游任务性能。

title: SafeGesture: Evaluating Fine-Grained Hand Gesture Understanding in Vision-Language Models through Scenario-Conditioned Safety Interpretation
comment: 14 pages, 22 tables, 2 figures. Code and benchmark resources available at https://github.com/The-Responsible-AI-Initiative/SafeGesture
summary: Open-weight and frontier vision-language models (VLMs) perform well on general image understanding, but their ability to interpret fine-grained hand gestures in safety-critical operational contexts remains largely unexamined. We introduce SafeGesture, a benchmark that evaluates whether a model can infer scenario-appropriate safety actions from hand gestures. It pairs six HaGRID gestures with eight operational scenarios for 4,800 items and evaluates Qwen2.5-VL-7B, LLaVA-NeXT-7B, InternVL2-8B, Phi-3.5-Vision, and GPT-4o. Results reveal a perception-reasoning decoupling: GPT-4o achieves 98.4% gesture accuracy but 53.3% safety accuracy, while Qwen2.5-VL reaches 84.9% and 39.5%, yielding gaps of 45.0 and 45.4 percentage points. Four of five models rarely or never use the uncertainty label, and failure directions differ substantially across models. Accuracy also obscures label bias: a scenario-majority policy with no visual input reaches 58.3%, above every evaluated model, while only GPT-4o exceeds this prior under macro-F1. Visual input improves safety accuracy by 11.2 to 30.2 percentage points, but providing the ground-truth gesture as text improves performance by only 0.4 to 3.2 points, and no model exceeds 56.2%. These results indicate that the main bottleneck is scenario-conditioned safety reasoning rather than gesture recognition.

AI.tldr: 本文引入SafeGesture基准，系统评估视觉语言模型在安全关键场景下从手部手势推断安全操作的能力。研究发现模型存在"感知-推理解耦"：手势识别准确率很高（如GPT-4o达98.4%），但安全推理准确率显著低下（GPT-4o仅53.3%），所有模型均未超过56.2%，甚至低于无需视觉输入的场景多数策略（58.3%）。主要瓶颈在于场景条件下的安全推理，而非手势识别。
AI.motivation: 尽管开源和前沿视觉语言模型在通用图像理解上表现良好，但它们对安全关键操作场景中细粒度手势的解读能力尚未得到系统检验，缺乏相关基准来评估这一重要能力。
AI.method: 将HaGRID数据集中的六种手势与八种操作场景配对，构建4,800条测试样本的安全基准SafeGesture；评估五个模型（Qwen2.5-VL-7B、LLaVA-NeXT-7B、InternVL2-8B、Phi-3.5-Vision、GPT-4o）的手势识别准确率和安全推理准确率；进行消融实验，包括无视觉输入的多数策略、提供真实手势文本等对照组。
AI.result: GPT-4o手势准确率98.4%但安全准确率仅53.3%；Qwen2.5-VL分别为84.9%和39.5%，两者差距分别为45.0和45.4个百分点。五个模型中有四个很少或从不使用不确定性标签。无视觉输入的场景多数策略达到58.3%，超过所有被测模型；视觉输入使安全准确率提升11.2-30.2个百分点，但提供真实手势文本仅提升0.4-3.2个百分点，所有模型安全准确率均未超过56.2%。
AI.conclusion: 当前视觉语言模型在安全关键场景下的核心瓶颈是场景条件下的安全推理能力，而非手势识别能力。模型对场景多数先验存在标签偏置，且无法有效利用视觉信息进行安全场景推理，这表明需要专门提升场景条件推理能力的模型设计与训练方法。

title: The Authority Resolution Framework: A Five-Domain Ontology for Governing Who and What Decides, at Scale
summary:
As AI systems become increasingly capable of autonomous action, determining whether an agent is technically capable of performing an action is insufficient: the system must also determine whether the action is authorised in its context.
  This paper introduces the Authority Resolution Framework (ARF), a five-domain ontology for representing and resolving authority across organisational roles and informal influence, business concepts, codified processes, machine-readable permissions and executable systems, and external real-world context. ARF defines the Authority Relation (AR) as a cross-domain primitive binding an actor, action, object, bounded context, justification chain, and a calibration measure termed the DNA-Coefficient, which captures divergence between documented authority structures and authority as practiced.
  The framework provides a machine-interpretable representation of authority provenance and scope, with JSON-LD representations and knowledge-graph query patterns for authority resolution. ARF is designed to support AI agents in determining the provenance, scope and contextual validity of authority before executing consequential actions. The framework positions authority resolution as a knowledge-representation and reasoning problem at the intersection of ontology engineering, semantic AI, agentic AI and AI governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了权威解析框架（ARF），一个五领域本体，用于表示和解析AI智能体在组织环境中的行动授权。ARF通过跨领域原语"权威关系"（AR）连接行动者、行动、对象、受限上下文、理由链和DNA系数（衡量文档化权威与实际实践之间的偏差），并提供JSON-LD表示和知识图谱查询模式，支持AI智能体在执行关键行动前验证权威来源、范围和情境有效性。
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统自主行动能力增强，判断"技术上能否执行"已不足以确保行动合理，系统还必须判断"该行动在当前情境下是否被授权"。现有研究缺乏一种机器可解释、跨领域统一的权威表示与解析机制，这成为自主智能体在组织环境中安全执行关键行动的核心瓶颈。
AI.method: ARF包含五个领域：组织角色与非正式影响力、业务概念、编码化流程、机器可读权限与可执行系统、外部现实世界情境。框架定义了跨领域原语"权威关系"（AR），由行动者、行动、对象、受限上下文、理由链和DNA系数六个要素构成。DNA系数用于量化文档化权威结构与实际实践中权威执行之间的偏差。框架提供JSON-LD格式的机器可解释表示，以及用于权威解析的知识图谱查询模式，将权威解析定位为知识表示与推理问题。
AI.result: ARF提供了一个完整的本体框架，能够以机器可解释的方式表示权威的来源（provenance）、范围（scope）和情境有效性（contextual validity），并通过JSON-LD和知识图谱查询模式实现权威解析的可操作化部署，覆盖从组织层级到外部现实情境的五个领域。
AI.conclusion: 权威解析应被视为本体工程、语义AI、智能体AI和AI治理交叉领域的知识表示与推理问题。ARF为AI智能体提供了一种系统化的手段，在执行关键行动前验证权威的合法性，从而弥合技术能力与授权判断之间的鸿沟。

title: Breaking the Compression Barrier: Cross-Architecture Compression Boundary Learning via Reverse Regrowth
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Code available at https://github.com/EnumaCaliber/BRIDGE
summary: Model compression is critical for deploying networks on resource-constrained edge devices. While pruning-based methods can significantly reduce model size, they often suffer from abrupt performance collapse beyond a sparsity thresh-old, making it difficult to identify the feasible compression limit of the model. To address this challenge, we propose a boundary-Learning reverse regrowth framework, BRIDGE, that reformulates compression as a constructive boundary-search problem. Unlike forward pruning, our method first drives the model to an extremely sparse state to expose the collapse region, and then selectively regenerates the critical structure to restore performance. The proposed framework employs a hierarchical regeneration strategy, including coarse-grained layer selection and fine-grained regeneration parameter selection, to accurately identify which parameters require recovery. Experiments show that our method can recover models from the brink of collapse on both CNNs and Transformer architectures, demonstrating its architecture in-dependence. BRIDGE achieves a performance improvement of up to 1.49% in unstructured pruning and up to 4.77% in structured pruning. These results demonstrate that reverse regeneration can effectively extend the compression limit while maintaining stable performance. The source code is available at https://github.com/EnumaCaliber/BRIDGE.

AI.tldr: 提出BRIDGE框架，将模型压缩重新定义为构造性边界搜索问题——先将模型驱动到极度稀疏状态以暴露崩溃区域，再通过分层再生策略选择性恢复关键结构，从而找到并扩展模型的可行压缩极限。
AI.motivation: 剪枝类压缩方法在超过某个稀疏度阈值后会发生性能突然崩溃，导致难以确定模型的可行压缩极限。现有前向剪枝方法无法有效处理这一问题。
AI.method: 提出BRIDGE反向再生框架：1) 先正向将模型压缩至极稀疏状态以暴露崩溃区域；2) 通过分层再生策略（粗粒度层选择+细粒度再生参数选择）选择性恢复关键结构以恢复性能，从而找到压缩边界。
AI.result: 在CNN和Transformer架构上均能有效恢复濒临崩溃的模型；非结构化剪枝最高提升1.49%，结构化剪枝最高提升4.77%，且具有架构无关性。
AI.conclusion: 反向再生策略可以有效扩展压缩极限并保持稳定性能，为模型压缩提供了一种新的构造性边界搜索范式。

title: Representation Is Not Enough: Body-Localized Thermal Evidence for Contactless Stress and Craving Sensing in Opioid Use Disorder
summary: Removing wearables from physiological monitoring also removes their supervision: the signal indicating where and when a stress response occurred. Contactless stress sensing therefore becomes a weakly supervised evidence-localization problem, where a clip-level label must be traced to the body regions and moments that produced it. We address this with FABLE-Therm, a weakly supervised architecture that preserves localized evidence across body regions, time, and encoder-specific representations until the final decision. FABLE-Therm fuses frozen foundation-model encoders at the embedding level, with theory explaining why localized fusion can outperform feature concatenation and prediction averaging. We study this problem in opioid use disorder (OUD), where stress is a major relapse trigger and sustained wearable use can be difficult during early recovery. Using fixed thermal video, FABLE-Therm achieves 0.938 AUROC on held-out participants, and its learned representation transfers to self-reported craving, providing, to our knowledge, the first evidence that craving can be recovered from contactless thermal video. Localized evidence also enables participant-level analysis of deployment failure. We find that improving representation alone is insufficient for equitable deployment: additional data from the underserved group would recover only about half of the cohort gap, while the remainder reflects person-to-person heterogeneity. This modality-agnostic decomposition applies to models with identifiable subpopulations. Together with the first cohort-structured contactless thermal OUD benchmark, our results show that preserving localized evidence supports both accurate sensing and principled analysis of who a model fails and why.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FABLE-Therm，一种弱监督接触式热像应激感知架构，在保持局部证据（身体区域、时间、编码器表征）直至最终决策的前提下，通过冻结基础模型编码器的嵌入级融合实现应激定位与预测。在阿片类药物使用障碍（OUD）基准上达到0.938 AUROC，并首次证明可从接触式热视频恢复自我报告的渴求感。此外，通过局部证据支持参与者级别的部署失败分析，揭示了仅改进表征不足以实现公平部署的核心洞见。
AI.motivation: 移除可穿戴设备后，生理监测也失去了其监督信号——即应激反应发生的位置和时间。这使得接触式应激感知成为一个弱监督证据定位问题：需要将剪贴级标签回溯到产生该标签的身体区域和时刻。作者旨在保留局部证据以支持准确感知和原则化的失败分析。
AI.method: FABLE-Therm采用弱监督架构，在最终决策前保持跨身体区域、时间及编码器特定表征的局部证据。具体而言，它在嵌入层面融合冻结的基础模型编码器，并从理论上证明局部化融合优于特征拼接和预测平均。研究场景为阿片类药物使用障碍（OUD），使用固定热像视频进行训练与评估。
AI.result: 在留出参与者测试中达到0.938 AUROC；学习到的表征可迁移至自我报告的渴求感，首次证明可从接触式热视频恢复渴求。参与者级失败分析显示，仅改进表征不足以实现公平部署——从服务不足群体补充数据仅能恢复约一半的队列差距，其余差距反映个体间异质性。该分解对具有可识别子群体的模型是模态无关的。
AI.conclusion: 保持局部证据同时支持准确的应激感知和清晰的分析模型失败对象及原因的能力。论文同时贡献了首个面向队列结构的接触式热像OUD基准，表明局部证据保留是准确感知与公平性分析的关键统一原则。

title: RagGAD: Rationale-Aware Conditional Gaussian Mixture Normalizing Flow for Unsupervised Graph Anomaly Detection
summary: Graph anomaly detection aims to identify nodes that deviate from normal behavioral patterns within graphs. However, existing methods largely rely on the homophily assumption, which makes it difficult to distinguish spurious affinities and to capture the diverse behaviors of normal nodes,limiting their robustness in complex real-world scenarios. To address this problem, we propose RagGAD, an unsupervised graph anomaly detection framework based on rationale-aware conditional Gaussian mixture normalizing flow. RagGAD introduces an adaptive rationale disentangler to disentangle stable rationales from spurious correlations within node interrelationships, and further decomposes stable rationales into robust and fragile components. The learned rationales capture underlying interaction patterns that characterize normal behaviors under varying conditions, while anomalies emerge as deviations associated with unstable or spurious correlations. To model the intricate distributions of normal and abnormal nodes, RagGAD integrates rationale-non-rationale Gaussian mixture modeling with a robust-fragile rationale mixture learning strategy. By mitigating spurious homophilic correlations and embracing the heterogeneity of normal patterns, RagGAD identifies anomalies as low-density regions within a structure-aware distribution space. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that RagGAD outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: RagGAD是一个基于理性感知的条件高斯混合归一化流的无监督图异常检测框架，通过自适应理性解缠器将节点间关系中的稳定理性与虚假相关性分离，并将稳定理性进一步分解为鲁棒和脆弱组件，从而缓解同质性假设的局限，在多个基准数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有图异常检测方法过度依赖同质性假设，难以区分虚假关联并捕捉正常节点的多样化行为，在复杂现实场景中鲁棒性受限。
AI.method: 提出RagGAD框架，包含三个核心组件：(1)自适应理性解缠器，将稳定理性从虚假相关性中分离，并将稳定理性分解为鲁棒和脆弱组件；(2)理性-非理性高斯混合建模，结合鲁棒-脆弱理性混合学习策略来建模正常与异常节点的复杂分布；(3)通过将异常识别为结构感知分布空间中的低密度区域来完成检测。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，RagGAD在性能上优于最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过缓解虚假同质相关性并接纳正常模式的异质性，RagGAD有效提升了图异常检测在复杂现实场景下的准确性和鲁棒性。

title: TISC: A Text-Driven Image Semantic Communication System for Faithful Reconstruction
summary: Generative image semantic communication converts an image into a text description and then performs text-to-image reconstruction at the receiver via diffusion-based generative models. This paradigm has attracted broad attention due to its extremely low bandwidth cost. However, existing methods still face two critical bottlenecks across image-to-text (I2T) semantic extraction at the transmitter and text-to-image (T2I) semantic reconstruction at the receiver: (i) semantic loss and distortion in I2T, where holistic image descriptions may omit fine-grained object attributes and spatial-position information, causing the generated text to deviate from the original image semantics; and (ii) insufficient semantic faithfulness in T2I, where even with the same semantically faithful text description, different initial noise settings may lead diffusion-based reconstruction to produce images with different levels of semantic consistency with the original image. These issues jointly limit the semantic faithfulness of image reconstruction. To address them, we propose TISC, a text-driven image semantic communication framework tailored for faithful reconstruction. TISC incorporates two key designs: (1) Tree-Structured Attribute Semantic Extraction (TSASE), which decomposes semantic extraction into global scene, background, and object-level attribute descriptions, covering spatial position, shape/pose, color, material, and other physical attributes for each detected object; and (2) an Initial Noise Optimization (INO) mechanism, which selects an initial noise seed at the transmitter according to a comprehensive similarity score that jointly considers visual and semantic consistency. Experiments on multiple datasets show that TSASE improves object-position recovery and semantic description faithfulness, while the INO parameter study supports the adopted configuration for noise selection.

AI.tldr: 提出TISC框架，通过树状结构属性语义提取（TSASE）和初始噪声优化（INO）机制解决生成式图像语义通信中I2T语义损失与T2I语义保真度不足两大瓶颈，实现高保真图像重建。
AI.motivation: 生成式图像语义通信利用文本描述和扩散模型在接收端重建图像，带宽开销极低。但现有方法存在两个关键问题：(i) I2T阶段整体描述容易遗漏细粒度物体属性和空间位置信息；(ii) T2I阶段即使文本语义一致，不同初始噪声也会导致重建图像与原图的语义一致性出现波动。这两点共同限制了图像重建的语义保真度。
AI.method: 提出TISC框架，包含两个核心设计：(1) 树状结构属性语义提取（TSASE），将语义提取分解为全局场景、背景和物体级属性描述三个层级，覆盖每个检测物体的空间位置、形状/姿态、颜色、材质等物理属性；(2) 初始噪声优化（INO）机制，在发射端根据综合相似度得分（联合考虑视觉一致性和语义一致性）选择最优的初始噪声种子。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明：TSASE改善了物体位置恢复效果和语义描述保真度；INO参数研究验证了所采用的噪声选择配置的有效性。
AI.conclusion: TISC通过结构化的语义提取和噪声优化双重机制，有效提升了文本驱动图像语义通信中的重建语义保真度。

title: RAGas: Retrieval-Augmented Gas Optimization for Smart Contracts with Continuous Knowledge Integration
summary: Ethereum is now integral to mission-critical sectors, including finance, healthcare, and supply chain management. Execution fees, commonly referred to as Gas, scale with the computational complexity of their functions. Smart contracts on Ethereum incur execution fees, known as Gas, which increase with computational complexity. Thus, optimizing Gas-intensive code while preserving functional equivalence significantly lowers deployment costs. No existing system continuously exploits evolving Gas usage patterns. We systematically analyze syntactic and semantic constructs that drive excessive Gas use. This yields six high-level categories covering twelve fine-grained antipatterns underpinning a curated knowledge base. We operationalize these insights with RAGas, a three-stage retrieval-augmented generation framework that uses a large language model to pinpoint and automatically fix Gas inefficiencies. Experiments on deployed contracts demonstrate that RAGas reduces Gas usage by up to 11% and achieves high precision and recall in detecting code snippets exhibiting Gas wastage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RAGas，一个基于检索增强生成的三阶段框架，通过系统分析以太坊智能合约中导致Gas消耗过高的语法和语义构造，识别出6大类共12种细粒度反模式，并利用大语言模型自动定位和修复Gas低效代码，在部署合约上实现了最高11%的Gas消耗降低。
AI.motivation: 以太坊已成为金融、医疗、供应链等关键领域的基础设施，智能合约的执行费用（Gas）随计算复杂度增加而增长，优化Gas密集型代码同时保持功能等价可以显著降低部署成本。然而，现有系统无法持续利用不断演化的Gas使用模式，缺乏系统性方法来识别和修复Gas低效问题。
AI.method: 首先系统分析导致Gas过度消耗的语法和语义构造，提炼出6大类共12种细粒度反模式并构建知识库；在此基础上提出RAGas框架，这是一个三阶段检索增强生成系统，利用大语言模型精确定位Gas低效代码片段并自动生成修复方案。
AI.result: 在已部署的智能合约上进行的实验表明，RAGas最高可将Gas消耗降低11%，并且在检测存在Gas浪费的代码片段时实现了较高的精确率和召回率。
AI.conclusion: RAGas通过结合反模式知识库与检索增强生成技术，能够有效且准确地识别并自动修复智能合约中的Gas低效问题，为降低以太坊合约部署和执行成本提供了可行方案。

title: Group ICA 2.0: Closing the Gap Between Subjects and Group Latent Decomposition with Copula-Linked Group ICA (CoLiG-ICA)
summary: Group Independent Component Analysis (gICA) is widely used to decompose high-dimensional functional MRI data into interpretable brain networks. However, conventional gICA primarily identifies components shared across subjects. This group-level assumption can limit the recovery of networks present only in individuals or subject subsets, reducing sensitivity to intersubject heterogeneity in clinical neuroimaging datasets. We introduce Copula-Linked Group ICA (CoLiG-ICA), an algorithm in the Group ICA 2.0 framework that jointly estimates template-linked, cohort-only, and subject-only brain networks within a unified model. CoLiG-ICA combines ICA-based spatial decomposition, copula-based dependence modeling, and deep learning optimization to preserve the consistency and interpretability of template-constrained ICA while enabling free components beyond the reference networks. By linking subject decompositions to shared templates and jointly estimating cohort-only and subject-only sources, CoLiG-ICA represents individual variability not captured by conventional group priors. We evaluate CoLiG-ICA using resting-state fMRI data from the UCLA-CNP dataset and compare it with conventional constrained ICA in estimating template-linked components, discovering additional free components, improving component independence, and capturing subject-level variability beyond the shared group prior. Compared with MOO-ICAR, CoLiG-ICA showed significantly lower intercomponent spatial dependence, indicating improved subject-level component independence, and significantly reduced motion-related variance in the template-linked components. Additionally, in a schizophrenia-only group analysis, CoLiG-ICA identified three additional resting-state networks beyond the 53 template-linked NeuroMark components: one sensorimotor and two visual networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoLiG-ICA算法，在Group ICA 2.0框架下联合估计模板关联、队列专属和个体专属脑网络，通过ICA空间分解、copula依赖建模和深度学习优化，克服传统gICA只能识别共享组级成分的限制，并在UCLA-CNP静息态fMRI数据上验证其优于传统约束ICA和MOO-ICAR的性能。
AI.motivation: 传统组独立成分分析（gICA）主要识别受试者间共享的脑网络成分，这一组级假设限制了仅存在于个体或受试者子集中的网络恢复能力，降低了对临床神经影像数据中受试者间异质性的敏感度。需要一种能在统一模型中同时估计模板关联、队列专属和个体专属网络的算法。
AI.method: CoLiG-ICA在Group ICA 2.0框架下结合三种技术：ICA基的空间分解、copula基的依赖建模以及深度学习优化。该算法将受试者分解与共享模板链接，同时联合估计队列专属成分和个体专属成分，保留模板约束ICA的一致性和可解释性，同时允许参考网络之外的自由成分。
AI.result: 在UCLA-CNP静息态fMRI数据上与MOO-ICAR相比，CoLiG-ICA展现出显著更低的成分间空间依赖性，表明个体级成分独立性改善；模板关联成分中运动相关方差显著降低。在精神分裂症组分析中，CoLiG-ICA在53个模板关联NeuroMark成分之外识别出3个额外静息态网络（1个感觉运动网络和2个视觉网络）。
AI.conclusion: CoLiG-ICA能有效捕获传统组先验未涵盖的个体变异性，在保持模板关联成分一致性和可解释性的同时，发现额外的自由成分，提升成分独立性并减少运动伪影影响，具有临床神经影像数据分析的应用潜力。

title: Beyond Similarity Matching: Structured Reasoning for Open-Vocabulary Referring Segmentation in 3DGS
summary: Open-vocabulary referring segmentation in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) requires a neural model to select Gaussian primitives according to free-form language expressions. Existing 3DGS-based methods usually rely on global text-region similarity, which is weak for queries involving attributes, reference objects, spatial relations, and fine-grained parts. This often causes target-reference confusion, granularity mismatch, part-whole leakage, and relation violations. We propose QAGaussian, a query-adaptive neural reasoning framework for language-guided Gaussian primitive selection. QAGaussian first learns query-conditioned multi-scale Gaussian slots as differentiable candidates whose receptive fields are shaped by the input expression. It then builds a relation-aware slot graph with language-conditioned edge weighting to propagate target-reference, attribute, part-whole, and contextual evidence. A granularity-adaptive router softly combines region-level, object-level, part-level, attribute-aware, and relation-aware mask branches, followed by relation-constrained refinement for spatial, part-whole, attribute, and geometric consistency. QAGaussian is pretrained only on Mosaic3D-5.6M for Gaussian-text alignment and evaluated on independent benchmarks without target-dataset fine-tuning. It achieves 47.2 Avg. mIoU and 63.2 Avg. F1, outperforming the strongest 3DGS referring baseline by 2.7 mIoU points and 2.9 F1 points. It also improves Part-mIoU from 38.6 to 43.4, Rel-mIoU from 44.4 to 50.8, and reduces target-reference confusion from 10.8 to 7.4. These results demonstrate that query-conditioned slot learning, relation-aware graph reasoning, and adaptive routing provide an effective neural modeling strategy for open-vocabulary referring segmentation in 3DGS. The code is available at https://github.com/zqeslwyz/QAGaussian.

AI.tldr: QAGaussian是一个查询自适应的神经推理框架，用于3D高斯泼溅中的开放词汇指代分割，通过查询条件多尺度高斯槽学习、关系感知槽图推理和粒度自适应路由，在无需目标数据集微调的情况下超越了现有最强的3DGS指代分割基线。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS指代分割方法依赖全局文本-区域相似度，对于涉及属性、参照物、空间关系和细粒度部件的查询能力较弱，导致目标-参照混淆、粒度不匹配、部分-整体泄漏和关系违反等问题。
AI.method: QAGaussian包含三个核心模块：(1) 查询条件下的多尺度高斯槽学习，形成可微候选，其感受野由输入表达塑造；(2) 关系感知槽图，通过语言条件边权重传播目标-参照、属性、部分-整体和上下文证据；(3) 粒度自适应路由器，软组合区域级、对象级、部件级、属性感知和关系感知掩码分支，并进行关系约束的细化以保持空间、部分-整体、属性和几何一致性。
AI.result: 在独立基准上，QAGaussian达到47.2 Avg. mIoU和63.2 Avg. F1，超过最强3DGS指代基线2.7 mIoU和2.9 F1。Part-mIoU从38.6提升到43.4，Rel-mIoU从44.4提升到50.8，目标-参照混淆从10.8降低到7.4。
AI.conclusion: 查询条件槽学习、关系感知图推理和自适应路由为3DGS中的开放词汇指代分割提供了有效的神经建模策略，验证了该框架在不依赖目标数据集微调情况下的泛化能力。

title: AdROD: HyperNetwork-based Adversarially Robust Object Detection for Autonomous Driving
summary: Camera-based object detectors are vulnerable to physical adversarial attacks designed to suppress detections. While adversarial training and input purification offer some protection, they often overfit to specific attack distributions and fail on adaptive adversaries. This paper presents AdROD, an embedded, stochastic ensemble defense software designed for autonomous driving. AdROD employs {\em low-rank HyperNetworks}, which require only 1.6\% of the parameter footprint of standard HyperNetworks, to generate diverse detectors at a per-frame rate, making it impractical for attackers to obtain the deployed detectors in time. To further improve adversarial robustness, AdROD incorporates a novel \emph{functional diversity} mechanism, which couples stochastic weight updates with unique input-space transformations. We design two serving modes of AdROD that strike different trade-offs between robustness and runtime overhead: AdROD-I, a continuous protection mode for maximum resilience that leverages inter-detector disagreement to recover compromised detections, and AdROD-II, an on-demand mode triggered by kinematic discontinuities in object tracking. Through comprehensive evaluation with synthetic benchmarks, physically deployed adversarial patches, and end-to-end safety tests in the OpenCDA co-simulator, AdROD outperforms five baseline defenses and exhibits superior generalizability compared with the evaluated adversarial-training baselines, while maintaining real-time performance for safely stopping the vehicle at a stop sign instrumented with adversarial patches.

AI.tldr: AdROD是一种面向自动驾驶的嵌入式随机集成防御软件，利用低秩HyperNetwork生成多样化的检测器，结合功能多样性机制和两种服务模式（连续保护AdROD-I与按需触发AdROD-II），在多项实验中超越五种基线防御方法，实现实时性能下的对抗鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 基于摄像头的目标检测器容易受到物理对抗攻击的威胁，现有的对抗训练和输入净化方法往往过拟合特定攻击分布，难以应对自适应攻击者。
AI.method: AdROD采用低秩HyperNetwork（仅需标准HyperNetwork 1.6%的参数）逐帧生成多样化的检测器，使攻击者难以实时获取部署的模型；引入功能多样性机制，将随机权重更新与独特的输入空间变换耦合；设计两种服务模式：AdROD-I（连续保护，利用检测器间不一致性恢复被攻击的检测结果）和AdROD-II（按需触发，由目标跟踪中的运动学不连续触发）。
AI.result: 通过合成基准、物理部署的对抗补丁以及OpenCDA协同仿真器中的端到端安全测试，AdROD在五种基线防御方法中表现最优，相比对抗训练基线具有更好的泛化能力，并能在带有对抗补丁的停车标志场景下保持实时性能以安全停车。
AI.conclusion: AdROD通过随机集成与功能多样性的结合，在鲁棒性与运行时开销之间提供了灵活可调的权衡，验证了该方法在真实物理场景中的有效性与实用性。

title: Nexus: Structured Synergy for Efficient Text-to-Image Generation using Rectified Flow Model
summary: Diffusion and flow matching models have made significant progress in text-to-image generation, yet high computation, quadratic complexity, and large memory footprint hinder high-resolution synthesis and edge deployment. We propose Nexus, which integrates sparse architecture, linear complexity, and low-bit quantization. It combines MoE feed-forward layers, gated DeltaNet attention, and per-expert low-bit training to reduce computation and memory. Their joint optimization allows Nexus to achieve generation quality comparable to mainstream models such as SDXL and SD3 while delivering markedly higher inference efficiency. Experiments on COCO and LAION validate its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 提出Nexus框架，将稀疏MoE架构、线性复杂度门控DeltaNet注意力与低位量化（每专家低位训练）三者联合优化，在保持与SDXL/SD3相当生成质量的同时，显著提升文本到图像推理效率并降低计算与内存开销。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型和流匹配模型在文本到图像生成中取得显著进展，但高计算量、二次复杂度和大内存占用阻碍了高分辨率生成和边缘端部署。需要一种同时降低计算与内存、又保持生成质量的高效方案。
AI.method: Nexus集成三大组件：(1)MoE前馈层实现稀疏激活，减少计算量；(2)门控DeltaNet注意力替代标准注意力，实现线性复杂度；(3)每专家低位训练（low-bit quantization），降低内存占用。三者联合优化以协同提升效率同时保持生成质量。
AI.result: 在COCO和LAION数据集上的实验表明，Nexus在生成质量上与SDXL、SD3等主流模型相当，同时实现显著更高的推理效率，验证了稀疏结构、线性复杂度和低位量化联合设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Nexus证明了稀疏架构、线性复杂度和低位量化可以通过联合优化在扩散模型中协同工作，实现效率与质量的兼顾，为高分辨率文本到图像生成和边缘端部署提供了一条可行路径。

title: Dear Algo: A Precision-First Agentic Intent Layer for Unified Search and Recommendation
summary:
Search and recommendation serve a shared discovery objective but encode intent differently. We study this boundary through Dear Algo on Threads, a deployed product where open-ended requests such as \emph{more NBA news} or \emph{less politics} steer subsequent feed recommendations rather than return a one-shot result list. Its agentic intent layer compiles explicit, inferred, negative, and compound intent into a grounded executable plan, then invokes conventional retrieval and optional semantic or multimodal reranking. The layer shares an intent-to-retrieval contract without requiring one model or serving path across search-like and recommendation-like modes.
  We evaluate Dear Algo under a precision-first objective. In a blinded audit of 300 public request-item pairs (296 evaluable), a strict categorical LLM-as-a-judge gate achieved 94.4\% exact-Relevant precision [88.8\%, 98.9\%]. Across 72 normalized request clusters, the full configuration produced 7.73 judge-qualified candidates per 20 slots versus 6.61 for an LLM-derived-query baseline, a gain of 1.11 [0.12, 2.12]. In a candidate-randomized serving-path study restricted to the reranker path's first 72 eligible hours, the user-weighted judge-Irrelevant share among judged admissions was 2.80\% versus 4.78\% off (-1.97 points [-3.02, -0.94]), while Exact-Relevant share was 2.24 points higher [0.08, 4.41].
  Together, these studies show how explicit natural-language intent can be carried into feed recommendation under a precision-first evaluation framework

AI.tldr: 本文介绍Threads平台上的Dear Algo系统，通过智能体意图层将开放式自然语言请求（如"更多NBA新闻"）转化为可执行的检索计划，并用于引导后续信息流推荐。在精度优先的评估框架下，该系统在300个公开请求-条目对的盲审中达到94.4%精确相关精度，并在多个对比研究中显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 搜索和推荐虽然共享发现目标，但在意图编码方式上存在根本差异。传统推荐系统难以处理用户明确表达的开放式请求（如"更多NBA"或"减少政治内容"），本文旨在弥合这一鸿沟，探索如何将显式自然语言意图持续引导到信息流推荐中，而非仅返回一次性结果列表。
AI.method: 该系统的核心是"agentic intent layer"（智能体意图层），它能够将显式、推断性、否定性和复合意图编译为可执行的计划，然后调用传统的检索模块，并可选地进行语义或多模态重排序。该层通过意图到检索的契约（intent-to-retrieval contract）实现，无需在搜索式与推荐式模式间共享单一模型或服务路径。评估采用精度优先框架，包括LLM-as-a-judge严格分类门控、对照实验和随机化服务路径研究。
AI.result: 在300个公开请求-条目对中（296个可评估），严格分类LLM判定门控达到94.4%精确相关精度[88.8%, 98.9%]。在72个归一化请求簇中，完整配置每20个槽位产生7.73个判定合格候选，比LLM派生查询基线高1.11个[0.12, 2.12]。在随机化服务路径研究中，用户加权的不相关内容占比为2.80%（基线为4.78%，降低1.97个百分点），精确相关内容占比高出2.24个百分点[0.08, 4.41]。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，显式自然语言意图可以被有效引入信息流推荐系统，并在精度优先的评估框架下取得显著优势。Deer Algo通过智能体意图层架构，在不依赖统一模型或服务路径的前提下，成功实现了搜索式与推荐式模式的融合。

title: NICE: Scale-Stable Perturbations for Graph Neural Network Explanations via Noise Corruption
