Motivated by this observation, this paper proposes for the first time a novel skeleton detection paradigm where depth images serve as the dominant modality and RGB images act as the auxiliary, and accordingly presents a model DDSkel (short for Depth-Dominant Skeleton Detection) under this paradigm. DDSkel employs an asymmetric encoder design to fuse RGB information into depth features, with the RGB modality branch having only 12% the parameters of the depth modality branch. DDSkel has a simple structure without intricate designs. Nevertheless, with only 36% of the trainable parameters of the current best method, DDSkel outperforms all state-of-the-art approaches on SymPASCAL, the most challenging dataset with a large volume of complex images.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出以深度图像为主导模态、RGB图像为辅助模态的骨架检测新范式，并据此设计了模型DDSkel。该模型采用非对称编码器结构融合RGB信息到深度特征中，RGB分支参数仅为深度分支的12%。在最具挑战性的SymPASCAL数据集上，DDSkel仅用当前最佳方法36%的可训练参数，即在性能上超越了所有现有最先进方法。
AI.motivation: 现有自然场景骨架检测方法均以RGB图像为唯一输入，在处理复杂内容图像时性能显著下降。作者观察到深度图像对颜色和纹理不敏感，能提供清晰的区域轮廓和区域间空间关系，可自然缓解复杂场景下骨架检测的困难，由此提出以深度为主导的新检测范式。
AI.method: 提出DDSkel模型，采用非对称编码器设计，将RGB信息融合到深度特征中。RGB模态分支的参数规模仅为深度模态分支的12%，且模型整体结构简洁，不含复杂设计。
AI.result: 在最具挑战性、包含大量复杂图像的SymPASCAL数据集上，DDSkel以当前最佳方法36%的可训练参数量，超越了所有现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 深度主导、RGB辅助的骨架检测范式是可行且高效的，DDSkel以更轻量的参数实现了更强的性能，为骨架检测领域提供了新的研究思路。

title: DriveCache: Action-Aware Caching for Driving World Model Inference
summary: Driving video generation models support autonomous-driving development by predicting controllable future scenes for simulation, planning evaluation, and offline data generation. Diffusion-based driving generators repeatedly evaluate large backbones across denoising steps, which limits generation throughput. Existing diffusion acceleration methods reduce this cost, but general-purpose designs omit driving signals available before generation, such as ego speed and planned trajectories. Experiments across driving motions show that cache tolerance varies with ego translation and rotation, denoising progress, and consecutive reuse length. We propose DriveCache, a training-free, action-aware controller that uses planned motion to allocate reuse across scenes and dynamic programming to place it across denoising steps under a calibrated response budget. A causal drift check refreshes features and replans the remaining schedule when generation departs from calibration. Across three generator configurations, DriveCache improves the overall fidelity-efficiency trade-off over evaluated cache methods. Our code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: DriveCache 是一个面向自动驾驶视频生成模型的免训练、动作感知缓存控制器。它利用规划的运动信息（如自车速度与规划轨迹）在场景间分配缓存，并通过动态规划在去噪步骤间分配缓存预算，以在驱动信号约束下加速扩散模型生成，同时保持生成质量。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶视频生成对仿真、规划评估和离线数据生成至关重要，但基于扩散的生成器需反复评估大型骨干网络，吞吐量受限。现有扩散加速方法未利用生成前即可获得的驾驶信号（如自车速度和规划轨迹），导致加速效率不理想。实验表明缓存容忍度随自车平移、旋转、去噪进度及缓存复用长度变化，需要一个利用这些先验信号的加速策略。
AI.method: DriveCache 包含三个核心组件：(1) 动作感知分配器，利用规划的运动信息在场景间分配缓存资源；(2) 动态规划调度器，在设定的响应预算下优化去噪步骤间的缓存放置；(3) 因果漂移检查机制，当生成结果偏离标定状态时刷新特征并重新规划剩余调度方案。整个方法免训练，不依赖额外训练开销。
AI.result: 在三种生成器配置下，DriveCache 相比已有的缓存方法在整体保真度-效率权衡上取得了更优的表现，验证了利用驾驶先验信号进行动作感知缓存控制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: DriveCache 证明了在扩散驱动的自动驾驶视频生成中，利用规划轨迹等驾驶先验信号来指导缓存分配与调度，可以在免训练的前提下显著改善生成保真度与效率的权衡，为自动驾驶视频生成加速提供了一条有效且实用的技术路线。

title: Advancing Open and Reproducible Relational Learning: RelArena-$α$, TabPFN-Rel and RPI
summary:
This first release of Prior Labs in relational learning shows our continued commitment to open science. We open-source three pieces of software that we expect to accelerate research in the field towards meaningful real-world impact. We aim to steer further development based on feedback from, and in collaboration with, the community. Given the early stage of development, our $α$-release targets researchers and early-adopting practitioners. Over the past years, a variety of datasets and tasks for relational learning have emerged, but the community has not converged on a reliable, reproducible way to compare different methods on these tasks. Our $α$-release, RelArena-$α$, provides a unified framework for running and comparing baselines on RelBench v1 by standardizing data loading, evaluation protocols, tuning regimes, and support for systems with custom tuning, inspired by established tabular benchmarks such as TabArena. We plan to work with the research community to further develop RelArena-$α$ into a catalyst for progress in the relational learning community. We release the initial version of TabPFN-Rel, a purpose-built relational harness for TabPFN-3. Currently ranked first among models on RelArena-$α$, TabPFN-Rel makes key improvements upon RDBLearn. Beyond its ranking, TabPFN-Rel serves as a strong baseline, adding to the growing evidence that flattening a relational database into a single table remains competitive with specialized relational architectures on real-world tasks.
  To facilitate adoption of relational learning methods in research and industry, we release an initial $α$-version of our Relational Predictive Interface, RPI, an open-source, model-agnostic interface that enables early adopters to easily define problems on new databases and apply any model implemented in RelArena-$α$, including TabPFN-Rel, to these problems.

AI.tldr: 本论文是Prior Labs在关系学习领域的首个α版本发布，开源了三个软件组件：RelArena-α（统一的关系学习基准评测框架）、TabPFN-Rel（专门的关系学习模型，目前在RelArena-α上排名第一）、以及RPI（关系预测接口，便于研究者在新数据库上定义问题并应用模型）。
AI.motivation: 关系学习领域虽然涌现了大量数据集和任务，但社区尚未就不同方法之间可靠、可复现的比较方式达成共识。此外，关系学习方法在研究和产业界的采用缺乏统一的接口和基准框架。作者希望通过开源发布加速该领域研究，推动有意义的实际应用，并与社区协作进一步发展工具。
AI.method: 作者发布了三件开源软件：(1) RelArena-α，一个统一基准框架，标准化RelBench v1上的数据加载、评估协议、调参体制，并支持自定义调参系统（受TabArena等表格基准启发）；(2) TabPFN-Rel，一个专门为TabPFN-3构建的关系学习框架，在RDBLearn基础上做出关键改进，目前在该基准上排名第一；(3) RPI，一个开源且模型无关的关系预测接口，使早期采用者能够方便地在新的数据库上定义问题并应用RelArena-α中的任意模型。
AI.result: TabPFN-Rel目前在RelArena-α上排名第一，并作为强基线，进一步证明将关系数据库展平为单表在真实任务上仍然与专门的关系架构具有竞争力。三个开源组件的发布为关系学习社区提供了统一基准、强基线和便捷接口。
AI.conclusion: 作者致力于开放科学，希望通过社区反馈和协作进一步将RelArena-α发展为关系学习社区进步的催化剂。该α版本主要面向研究人员和早期采用者，后续将根据社区反馈持续迭代。

title: Adaptive Post-Processing Drives Instance-Level Detection in Stroke Lesion Segmentation
summary: Instance-level lesion detection has been an increasingly larger focal point in medical image segmentation besides the more standard voxel-level overlap. Still, most pipelines are trained and post-processed for voxel overlap alone. In particular, the mismatch is most pronounced for small lesions, where a near-miss prediction---substantial overlap that falls just short of the instance-matching threshold---scores the same as a complete miss. In our ISLES'26 submission, we found that closing this gap mattered far more in post-processing than in architecture design. Our Volume-Conditioned Adaptive Post-Processing (VCAP) scheme adjusts component-size thresholds to each case's predicted lesion burden, improving Lesion-F1 by 0.032 (unbiased cross-fold estimate)---approximately 6 times larger than any architectural change we tested. A resolution-aware attention architecture (Viola2Plus), designed for small-lesion segmentation, shows why the distinction matters: it left small-lesion Dice unchanged but raised small-lesion detection rate by 3.7\%, a real effect voxel-overlap metrics alone would have missed. Under 5-fold cross-validation on the 1,453-case training set, our post-processed two-architecture ensemble achieves Dice 0.651 and Lesion-F1 0.614, versus 0.644 and 0.573 for the unprocessed single-model baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文来自ISLES'26参赛工作，核心发现是：在实例级病灶检测任务中，后处理对性能的提升远大于架构设计。作者提出基于体积条件的自适应后处理方案（VCAP），根据每个病例预测的病灶负荷动态调整组件大小阈值，使Lesion-F1提升0.032，约为任何架构改动效果的6倍。同时提出分辨率感知注意力架构Viola2Plus，虽未改善小病灶Dice但将小病灶检测率提升3.7%。在1,453例训练集上5折交叉验证中，后处理后的双架构集成达到Dice 0.651和Lesion-F1 0.614。
AI.motivation: 现有的医学图像分割流程大多仅针对体素级重叠指标进行训练和优化，而实例级病灶检测（如Lesion-F1）日益重要。尤其对于小病灶，预测与真实病灶有较大重叠但未达到实例匹配阈值时，其得分与完全漏检相同，导致体素指标与实例指标严重不匹配。作者希望探究用后处理缩小这一差距是否比改进架构更有效。
AI.method: 1) 提出Volume-Conditioned Adaptive Post-Processing (VCAP)方案：根据每个病例预测的病灶总体积动态调整连通域大小阈值；2) 设计分辨率感知注意力架构Viola2Plus，针对小病灶分割优化；3) 采用5折交叉验证，在1,453例训练集上比较单模型基线、双架构集成及后处理前后的Dice与Lesion-F1指标。
AI.result: VCAP使Lesion-F1提升0.032（无偏交叉折叠估计），是任何架构改动效果（约0.05量级）的6倍。Viola2Plus虽未改变小病灶Dice，但小病灶检测率提高3.7%。后处理后双架构集成在5折交叉验证中达到Dice 0.651和Lesion-F1 0.614，显著优于未处理单模型基线的0.644和0.573。
AI.conclusion: 在实例级病灶检测任务中，后处理阶段的体素-实例指标对齐比架构设计更能有效提升性能。体积条件自适应后处理（VCAP）是大幅提升Lesion-F1的关键手段，而仅依赖体素重叠指标会低估某些架构（如Viola2Plus）对检测率的真实贡献，凸显了统一体素级与实例级评估的重要性。

title: What Does Context Compression Cost an Agent? Interaction Costs Unrevealed by Task-Completion Metrics
summary:
Task completion is the standard metric for evaluating context compression, yet it is incomplete: compression can increase an agent's interaction cost by forcing it to reacquire dropped state while leaving completion statistically unchanged.
  We introduce a controlled runtime measurement protocol for reacquisition cost in a bounded-horizon tool-using agent. The agent acts in a deterministic planning environment under a fixed 24-turn horizon. We vary compression severity, compare a dropping operator with a fact-preserving operator, restore dropped state through controlled oracle interventions, and decompose tool calls into retrieval and execution. We evaluate three models across two task regimes.
  Retrieval calls increase in all six model-regime comparisons and account for almost all added interaction; five of six remain significant after Holm correction. At the prespecified 5x comparison point, completion changes are not significant in any cell. DeepSeek shows a significant completion drop only at 10x compression. GPT-5.5 is the clearest case: completion changes from 80% to 85% (p = 1.0) while retrieval increases from 21.0 to 63.9 calls (p = .002).
  Retention interventions further separate state quantity, state type, and content validity. Random selection is comparable to an offline hindsight oracle, while replacing retained D-state with semantically irrelevant content increases retrieval by 57% (p < .001) without a significant completion change. In a second environment, ALFWorld, sliding compression produces no retrieval surge, showing that the reacquisition signature is environment-dependent rather than intrinsic to shortening context.
  Overall, compression can impose hidden interaction costs when execution-relevant state becomes absent and must be reacquired, while completion alone may not expose those costs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种受控运行时测量协议，用于量化上下文压缩对工具型智能体产生的"重新获取成本"。研究发现，压缩虽然可能不改变任务完成率，但会显著增加检索类工具调用次数（六个模型-任务组合全部增加，五个在Holm校正后显著），且该现象具有环境依赖性（在ALFWorld中不出现）。压缩可能隐藏交互成本，而任务完成率本身无法暴露这些成本。
AI.motivation: 传统上以任务完成率作为评估上下文压缩的唯一标准，但该指标不完整：压缩虽然可能在统计上不改变完成率，却会迫使智能体重新获取被丢弃的状态信息，从而增加交互成本（如额外的工具调用）。这种隐藏成本无法通过完成率指标捕捉。
AI.method: 在固定24轮（turn）的确定性规划环境中，引入受控运行时测量协议。具体做法包括：变化压缩强度；对比"丢弃型"压缩算子与"保留事实型"压缩算子；通过受控的oracle干预恢复被丢弃的状态；将工具调用分解为检索（retrieval）与执行（execution）两类。评估三种模型在两个任务场景下的表现，并在预设的5倍压缩比较点进行统计检验（含Holm校正）。
AI.result: 检索调用在全部六个模型-任务比较中均增加，且几乎解释了全部新增交互；其中五个在Holm校正后仍显著。在5倍压缩点，完成率变化在任何单元格中均不显著。DeepSeek仅在10倍压缩时出现显著完成率下降；GPT-5.5是最明显案例：完成率从80%变为85%（p=1.0），而检索调用从21.0增至63.9（p=0.002）。保留策略干预进一步分离了状态数量、状态类型与内容有效性：随机选择与离线事后oracle相当，而将保留的D态替换为语义无关内容使检索增加57%（p<0.001）且完成率无显著变化。在ALFWorld环境中，滑动压缩未产生检索激增，表明重新获取特征取决于环境而非缩短上下文本身。
AI.conclusion: 当执行相关的状态被压缩移除而必须重新获取时，压缩会带来隐藏的交互成本；单纯的任务完成率指标无法暴露这些成本。评估上下文压缩时，应同时考虑交互成本维度（如检索调用次数），且该效应具有环境依赖性，需要针对具体环境进行评估。

title: Transfer Learning of Keystroke Dynamics for Cross-Device User Authentication
summary: Keystroke dynamics (typing patterns) can be used as a behavioural biometric modality for user authentication, with applications such as fraud prevention. While the modality has been shown to work well for single device authentication, its application to cross-device scenarios is more challenging. Dynamics learned on one device (eg., phone) may not be directly applicable to authentication on a secondary device with a different form factor (eg., tablet) due to changes in typing patterns that can lead to distribution drifts. To address this, we propose a cross-device user authentication system based on inductive transfer learning, where keystroke dynamics learned on one device are adapted to a secondary device. The adapted data is then combined with necessarily limited training data for the secondary device, which is used to robustly train a binary classifier. Furthermore, an extended set of keystroke features is used to better capture discriminative dynamics. Experiments on the BBMAS dataset show that proposed system achieves an equal error rate of 14.2% for the cross-device scenario, surpassing state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于归纳迁移学习的跨设备击键动力学用户认证系统，将在一台设备上学习到的击键动力学特征适应到另一台设备，并与副设备有限的训练数据结合，通过扩展特征集和二元分类器实现鲁棒认证。在BBMAS数据集上达到14.2%的等错误率，超越现有最先进方法。
AI.motivation: 击键动力学作为行为生物特征在单设备认证中表现良好，但跨设备场景面临挑战——不同设备形态（如手机vs平板）会导致打字模式发生变化，产生分布漂移，使得在一台设备上学习到的动力学特征无法直接应用于另一台设备。
AI.method: 提出基于归纳迁移学习的跨设备认证系统：1) 将源设备上学习到的击键动力学通过归纳迁移学习适应到目标设备；2) 将适应后的数据与目标设备上有限的训练数据相结合；3) 使用扩展的击键特征集以更好地捕捉判别性动力学特征；4) 基于结合后的数据训练稳健的二元分类器。
AI.result: 在BBMAS数据集上的跨设备场景实验中，该系统达到14.2%的等错误率（EER），优于现有的最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 归纳迁移学习能有效缓解跨设备击键动力学的分布漂移问题，结合扩展特征集和有限目标设备数据，可实现超越现有方法的跨设备用户认证性能。

title: Synthetic Data Augmentation for Satellite-Based Analysis of Battle-Damaged Agricultural Fields in Ukraine
summary: Monitoring war-induced damage to agricultural land in Ukraine is important for understanding threats to food security, environmental stability, and post-war recovery. However, the development of computer-vision systems for satellite-based damage analysis is limited by the scarcity of labeled imagery, especially for damaged agricultural fields. This work investigates synthetic data augmentation as a method for improving classification under limited and imbalanced training data. We train class-conditional Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) and Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) architectures on real satellite images and use them to generate additional bombed and not-bombed agricultural-field samples. The generated images are used only for training augmentation, while all downstream evaluation is performed on an exclusively real test set. A Vision Transformer classifier is trained under multiple real and synthetic data configurations to measure the practical utility of each generative approach. The best configuration, based on balanced DDPM augmentation, improves accuracy from 84\% to 88\%, balanced accuracy from 67\% to 81\%, macro F1 from 65\% to 78\%, and recall for the underrepresented not-bombed class from 41\% to 69\%. These results demonstrate the potential of synthetic satellite imagery for data-scarce geospatial applications in war-affected regions.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨在标记数据稀缺且类别不平衡的条件下,使用GAN和DDPM等生成模型合成卫星图像来增强训练数据,以提高战时乌克兰农业用地受损分类的准确性。基于平衡DDPM增强的最佳配置将准确率从84%提升至88%,平衡准确率从67%提升至81%,宏F1从65%提升至78%,少数类别(未受损农田)的召回率从41%大幅提升至69%。
AI.motivation: 监测乌克兰战争中农业用地受损情况对粮食安全、环境稳定和战后恢复至关重要。然而,面向卫星图像分析的计算机视觉系统受限于标记数据稀缺,尤其是受损农田的标注数据严重不足,这阻碍了相关分类模型的开发和应用。
AI.method: 采用类条件GAN和DDPM两种生成架构在真实卫星图像上训练,生成额外的人为轰炸和未轰炸农田样本。生成图像仅用于训练数据增强,所有下游评估均在完全真实的测试集上进行。使用Vision Transformer分类器在多种真实与合成数据配置下进行训练,以衡量每种生成方法的实际效用。
AI.result: 基于平衡DDPM增强的最佳配置显著提升分类性能:准确率从84%提升至88%,平衡准确率从67%提升至81%,宏F1从65%提升至78%,未受损类别的召回率从41%提升至69%。
AI.conclusion: 合成卫星图像生成在数据稀缺的战区地理空间应用中展现出巨大潜力,验证了基于生成模型的数据增强策略能有效缓解标注数据不足和类别不平衡问题,为战时农业监测提供了可行的技术路径。

title: AstronOS: A Unified Execution Model and Runtime for Long-Horizon Agentic Systems
comment: 23 pages, 2 figures, 13 tables. Zhenhang Nie and Gui Zheng contributed equally; Gui Zheng and Bin Zhang are corresponding authors
summary: Agentic systems often organize execution and state around a single conversation, model invocation, or agent instance, even when real work spans many calls and stages. We introduce a unified execution model that maintains a work item's persistent identity and versioned authoritative state across calls. Each step receives input scoped to a specific state version and new material; a result advances state only after validation and recording. We implement selected paths of this model in AstronOS using Cases, Tasks, and Scenario Packs across central and local execution. We compare five complete strategies for carrying an established software-version update plan into a fresh model session: rereading original materials, replaying full history, deterministic text summary, deterministic JSON, and the AstronOS runtime-mediated handoff. Ten controlled tasks are run under all five strategies with three repetitions, yielding 150 included executions. On the single-stage reference family, strategies perform similarly. In the primary three-stage A-C batch, AstronOS passes the frozen scorer in 14 of 15 executions, compared with 0 of 15 for rereading and 2 of 15 for full-history replay; later non-interleaved summary and JSON batches each pass 0 of 15. AstronOS has lower attempt-accounted model-token cost per passing execution, while requiring more execution-window time per attempt. These results associate the complete AstronOS condition with higher end-to-end pass rates across fresh sessions in this benchmark, at a measurable time cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种统一执行模型，维护工作项的持久身份和版本化权威状态，跨越多次调用与阶段。作者在AstronOS系统中通过Cases、Tasks和Scenario Packs实现了该模型的部分路径，并在150次受控执行中对比了五种将既有软件版本更新计划带入新模型会话的策略。结果显示AstronOS运行时介导的交接在三阶段基准中达到14/15的通过率，显著优于重读原文（0/15）与全历史重放（2/15），但以更长的执行窗口时间为代价。
AI.motivation: 现有Agent系统常将执行和状态组织在单一对话、模型调用或Agent实例中，但实际工作往往跨越多轮调用和多个阶段。这种结构导致状态难以在会话间持久化与版本化，阻碍了跨会话的连续工作交接和可靠执行。
AI.method: 提出统一执行模型，核心为：每个工作项保持持久身份与版本化权威状态；每一步接收限定到特定状态版本和新增材料的输入；结果仅在验证与记录后推进状态。在AstronOS系统中通过Cases、Tasks和Scenario Packs实现该模型的选定路径，覆盖集中与本地执行。对比五种策略：重读原始材料、重放完整历史、确定性文本摘要、确定性JSON、AstronOS运行时介导交接；在10个受控任务上各执行3次，共150次执行。
AI.result: 单阶段参考任务族上五种策略表现相似；但在主要的三阶段A-C批次中，AstronOS在15次执行中通过14次冻结评分器，而重读策略0/15、全历史重放2/15；后续非交错摘要和JSON批次均为0/15。AstronOS每次通过执行的平均模型token成本更低，但每次尝试需要更长的执行窗口时间。
AI.conclusion: 完整的AstronOS条件在该基准中与更高的跨新会话端到端通过率相关，但代价是可测量的时间成本增加。该结果表明，统一的、版本化的运行时介导状态交接相较于传统重放或摘要方式，能更好地维持跨会话复杂软件更新任务的一致性。

title: Task-Anchored Representation Shaping for Pre-Trained Model-Based Continual Learning
summary: Pre-trained models (PTMs) provide a strong foundation for continual learning by offering stable representations that facilitate lightweight adaptation to new tasks. However, adapting well to each task does not ensure reliable inference over all learned tasks. Since task boundaries are often artificial and semantically entangled, an input from an unknown task can remain ambiguous even with strong PTM features, making cross-task prediction a key bottleneck. We propose Task-Anchored Inference Latent Shaping (TAILS), a lightweight post-PTM module that can be integrated into diverse continual learners and optimized through a decoupled step. TAILS uses fixed task anchors as persistent references to accumulated knowledge. It interprets each sample's feature representation relative to these references, then composes relevant evidence across tasks into latent recall. Rather than selecting a task-specific path or adjusting classifier outputs, TAILS uses latent recall to directly correct the feature representation before prediction. It therefore resolves cross-task ambiguity at the representation level, while leaving the original PTM, method-specific modules, and classifier unchanged. Extensive experiments across multiple PTM-based continual learning paradigms show that TAILS can improve classification and task-inference performance with modest parameter overhead and negligible inference cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TAILS，一种轻量级后PTM模块，通过固定任务锚点作为持久参考，将样本特征表征相对于这些锚点进行解读，并跨任务组合相关证据形成潜在召回，在表征层面直接修正特征以解决跨任务预测中的语义模糊问题，适用于多种持续学习范式。
AI.motivation: 预训练模型（PTMs）为持续学习提供了稳定的表征基础，但仅对每个任务适应良好并不能确保对所有已学任务的可靠推理。由于任务边界通常是人为设定且语义上相互纠缠的，即使使用强大的PTM特征，来自未知任务的输入仍可能产生歧义，导致跨任务预测成为关键瓶颈。
AI.method: TAILS是一种轻量级后PTM模块，通过解耦步骤集成到不同的持续学习器中优化。它使用固定任务锚点作为已积累知识的持久参考，将每个样本的特征表征相对于这些锚点进行解读，然后跨任务组合相关证据形成潜在召回（latent recall）。与选择任务特定路径或调整分类器输出不同，TAILS在预测前直接利用潜在召回修正特征表征，在表征层面解决跨任务歧义，同时保持原始PTM、方法特定模块和分类器不变。
AI.result: 在多种基于PTM的持续学习范式上进行了大量实验，TAILS以适度的参数开销和可忽略的推理成本，提升了分类性能和任务推断性能。
AI.conclusion: TAILS通过在表征层面修正特征而非选择任务路径或调整分类器输出，有效解决了持续学习中跨任务预测的语义歧义问题，且具有良好的通用性（可集成到多种持续学习器）和高效率（参数开销小、推理成本低）。

title: Self-Routed Tensor Adapters for Parameter-Efficient Universal Visual Adaptation
summary: Universal visual representations require adaptation mechanisms that adapt across heterogeneous domains without fragmenting knowledge into domain-specific modules. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning adapts frozen visual foundation models efficiently, but standard low-rank adapters use a fixed subspace for all inputs, which can be restrictive when domains differ in style, background, and semantic context. MoE-based adapters improve specialization through multiple expert pathways, but often rely on external routers and large expert banks, adding parameters and separating routing from adaptation. We propose \textbf{Self-Routed Tensor Adapters}, a compact framework for multi-domain visual adaptation. SRTA projects each input into a low-rank space, computes routing weights from this representation using a learnable domain matrix, and uses these weights to blend slices of a shared Tucker core. This produces a sample-specific adaptation matrix without an external gating network, allowing shared visual factors to be reused while supporting domain-aware specialization. To strengthen pathway learning, we introduce a progressive depth-weighted routing objective that supervises routing decisions across adapter layers. Across five heterogeneous multi-domain visual classification benchmarks, SRTA achieves competitive or slightly stronger average accuracy than MoE-style PEFT baselines while using substantially fewer trainable parameters. At rank 64, SRTA uses 2.77M parameters in the 4-domain setting compared with 9.52M for MoLoRA, and 3.00M in the 6-domain setting compared with 14.31M. Overall, SRTA offers an effective accuracy-parameter trade-off for adapting visual foundation models toward universal multi-domain representations. \href{https://github.com/surajyadav-research/SRTA}{GitHub}

AI.tldr: 提出Self-Routed Tensor Adapters (SRTA)，一种紧凑的多域视觉适配框架。SRTA通过将输入投影到低维空间，利用可学习域矩阵计算路由权重，并以此混合共享Tucker核的切片来生成样本特定的适配矩阵，无需外部门控网络。同时引入渐进式深度加权路由目标来监督各适配层的路由决策。在五个异构多域视觉分类基准上，SRTA以显著更少的可训练参数取得与MoE风格PEFT基线相当或更优的平均精度。
AI.motivation: 通用视觉表征需要能够在异构域之间适配而不把知识碎片化为域特定模块。参数高效微调存在两个问题：标准低秩适配器对所有输入使用固定子空间，在域间风格、背景和语义差异大时受限；MoE风格适配器虽通过多专家路径提升特化，但依赖外部路由器和大规模专家库，增加参数并割裂了路由与适配过程。
AI.method: SRTA将每个输入投影到低秩空间，使用可学习的域矩阵从该表征计算路由权重，然后用这些权重混合共享Tucker核的切片，从而生成样本特定的适配矩阵，无需外部门控网络，共享视觉因子可被复用同时支持域感知特化。此外提出渐进式深度加权路由目标来跨适配层监督路由决策。
AI.result: 在五个异构多域视觉分类基准上，SRTA取得与MoE风格PEFT基线相当或略优的平均精度，同时大幅减少可训练参数。rank=64时，4域设置用2.77M参数（对比MoLoRA的9.52M），6域设置用3.00M参数（对比MoLoRA的14.31M）。
AI.conclusion: SRTA在精度与参数之间提供了有效的权衡，为将视觉基础模型适配为通用多域表征提供了一种紧凑且有效的方案。

title: Think Inside the Chunk: RegulaRAG for Regulation-Compliant Scenario Generation using LLMs: A Case Study of UN Regulation No. 152
summary: Generating regulation-compliant test scenarios is essential for validating safety-critical automotive systems, yet Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle to ground outputs in long, hierarchical standards. We present RegulaRAG, a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline that couples SmartChunking, reference-aware enrichment of paragraphs and tables via graph traversal, with Smart Retrieve & Rerank over these enriched units. To test our system, we evaluate on a manually curated dataset covering all scenarios in UN Regulation No. 152 (AEBS). Our study comprises: (i) a three-step progressive search that identifies near-optimal retrieval parameters without exhaustive grid search; (ii) head-to-head comparisons against five baseline RAG systems; and (iii) a robustness stress test that scales the source corpus with distractor content. Outputs are evaluated using a customized penalized scoring metric. Across all experiments, RegulaRAG achieves the highest average Meta-Score (82.99), outperforming the next-best system by 43% (NoRAG: 57.94), while operating at 14k-25k tokens per query versus up to 500k for graphcentric baselines. It maintains strong performance, remaining stable even as the number of regulatory sources grows, whereas competing RAG systems degrade sharply in both quality and robustness.

AI.tldr: RegulaRAG是一个面向安全关键汽车系统的检索增强生成(RAG)管道，通过SmartChunking结合图遍历进行引用感知的段落与表格增强，以及Smart Retrieve & Rerank策略，在UN R152 (AEBS)法规场景数据集上达到82.99的Meta-Score，比最优基线系统高出43%，并以14k-25k token/query的低成本保持稳健性能。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型(LLMs)在生成符合法规的测试场景时，难以将输出锚定在冗长且层次化的标准文档中。现有RAG系统在处理长而复杂的法规文本时存在检索质量差、成本高、鲁棒性不足等问题，需要一种能够有效处理和检索层次化法规文档的方法。
AI.method: RegulaRAG由两个核心组件构成：(1) SmartChunking：通过图遍历对段落和表格进行引用感知的富化处理；(2) Smart Retrieve & Rerank：对富化后的单元进行智能检索与重排序。研究采用三步渐进式搜索确定近最优检索参数，与五个基线RAG系统进行对比，并通过扩展干扰内容进行鲁棒性压力测试。
AI.result: RegulaRAG在所有实验中取得最高平均Meta-Score (82.99)，比次优系统NoRAG (57.94)高出43%；查询token成本为14k-25k，远低于图中心基线的最高500k；随着法规源数量增加，RegulaRAG保持稳定性能，而竞争系统在质量和鲁棒性上均显著下降。
AI.conclusion: RegulaRAG通过引用感知的文档富化与智能检索重排，有效解决了LLM在长层次化法规文档中生成合规测试场景的难题，在性能、成本和鲁棒性方面均优于现有RAG基线方法。

title: OceanDepths: A Global Dataset of Paired Subsurface and Surface Ocean Observations
summary: Despite comprising over 70\% of its surface, the world's oceans are critically underobserved compared to the land surface or the atmosphere.Understanding the global ocean requires jointly observing its surface and subsurface structure, yet no standardized, high-resolution dataset couples satellite surface fields to co-located \emph{in situ} depth profiles in an AI-ready format.Existing resources either consist of model-reconstructed gridded products rather than observations, cover only a single variable or basin, or operate at resolutions too coarse for mesoscale dynamics.We introduce \textsc{OceanDepths}, the first open, global, regridded AI-ready dataset that pairs satellite-derived sea surface temperature (SST), sea surface salinity (SSS), and sea surface height (SSH) L4 products with co-located EN4 subsurface temperature and salinity profiles, complemented by matched GLORYS12 ocean reanalysis data to support comparisons or multi-stage learning.The dataset spans 2000--2024 at \SI{0.1}{\degree}$\times$\SI{0.1}{\degree} spatial resolution and at weekly temporal resolution, covering the entire globe's sea surface and with over 9.5 million paired profiles interpolated to 50 standardized depth levels.We provide a configurable system to split the globe in equally sized spatial patches.The 4D multivariate structure, high resolution, long temporal extent, and extreme sparsity of subsurface observations (${\sim}$0.01\% per depth level) make \textsc{OceanDepths}a challenging testbed for novel AI methods.We demonstrate subsurface state reconstruction as an example task with simple baseline models, but also envision \textsc{OceanDepths}to support the development of observation-based forecast methods and other related tasks.\added{Available at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ESA-philab/OceanDepths.}

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了OceanDepths，这是首个开放、全球、重网格化的AI就绪数据集，将卫星海表温度、盐度和海面高度L4产品与EN4次表层温度和盐度剖面配对，辅以GLORYS12再分析数据，覆盖2000-2024年，空间分辨率0.1°×0.1°，时间分辨率周，包含超过950万个配对剖面（插值到50个标准深度层），为次表层状态重建等AI任务提供具有挑战性的测试平台。
AI.motivation: 全球海洋占地球表面70%以上，但观测严重不足。理解全球海洋需要同时观测其表层和次表层结构，然而目前缺乏将卫星表层场与实地深度剖面配对的标准化的、高分辨率的、AI就绪格式数据集。现有资源要么是基于模型重建的网格化产品而非观测数据，要么只覆盖单一变量或海盆，要么分辨率太粗无法捕捉中尺度动力学。
AI.method: OceanDepths将卫星衍生的SST、SSS和SSH L4产品与配对的EN4次表层温度和盐度剖面相结合，并匹配GLORYS12海洋再分析数据以支持对比或多阶段学习。数据集覆盖2000-2024年，空间分辨率0.1°×0.1°，时间分辨率为周，全球海面全覆盖，含超过950万个配对剖面插值到50个标准化深度层。提供可配置的系统将全球划分为等大小的空间区块。
AI.result: 该数据集呈现4D多变量结构、高分辨率、长时间跨度及次表层观测的极度稀疏性（每深度层约0.01%覆盖率），使其成为新型AI方法具有挑战性的测试平台。作者以次表层状态重建作为示例任务，使用简单基线模型进行了演示。
AI.conclusion: OceanDepths作为首个开放、全球、AI就绪的卫星-实地配对海洋数据集，为开发基于观测的预测方法及其他相关海洋AI任务提供了新资源。数据集可在Hugging Face上公开获取。

title: Joint Flow Matching Enables Continuous Dose-Conditioned Cell Morphing
summary: Generative modeling has shown increasing promise for predicting cellular perturbation effects under chemical compound treatments. Existing approaches either model perturbation as a distribution-to-distribution mapping without explicit concentration handling, or treat concentration as a discrete class label, precluding continuous dose control. We introduce a joint flow matching approach that simultaneously models cell latents and drug concentration via a dual-timestep formulation, enabling dose-conditioned single-cell morphing through the invertibility of flow matching. The joint formulation induces a monotonic dose-response geometry in latent space and additionally supports concentration estimation from cell morphology. As proof of concept, we further demonstrate generalization to an unseen dose held out during training. Empirically, our method achieves competitive or improved per-concentration metrics on two compounds compared with representative baselines, while enabling capabilities structurally unavailable to discrete-class methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种联合流匹配方法，通过双时间步公式同时建模细胞潜变量和药物浓度，实现剂量条件下的单细胞形态变形，并支持连续的剂量控制与浓度估计。
AI.motivation: 现有生成模型预测细胞扰动效应时，要么建模为分布到分布的映射但缺乏显式浓度处理，要么将浓度视为离散类别标签，无法实现连续的剂量控制。
AI.method: 引入联合流匹配方法，通过双时间步公式同时建模细胞潜变量和药物浓度，利用流匹配的可逆性实现剂量条件下的单细胞形态变形，并利用联合公式诱导潜空间中的单调剂量-反应几何结构，同时支持从细胞形态估计浓度。
AI.result: 在两种化合物上，与代表性基线相比，每个浓度的指标达到有竞争力或更优的表现，并展示了对训练中未见的剂量的泛化能力，以及离散类别方法在结构上无法实现的功能。
AI.conclusion: 联合流匹配方法通过连续的剂量控制实现了更好的细胞扰动预测，拓展了离散类别方法无法覆盖的应用场景。

title: A Policy Algebra for Trust-Preserving Agentic AI Execution
summary: Large language model-based agentic frameworks primarily optimize capability: whether an agent can reason, retrieve information, call tools, delegate work, and complete a goal. Enterprise execution requires a stronger property. A successful result is not reliable if it was produced through unauthorized data access, widened delegated authority, unapproved side effects, unrecoverable budget consumption, or incomplete evidence. This paper defines reliable capability as a path property: an agent is reliably capable only when it completes a task through action events that remain admissible under identity, profile, tool, data, memory, budget, artifact, approval, and audit constraints. We propose a policy algebra that defines the reliability envelope within which agent capability may be exercised. Security profiles and runtime obligations compose through joins, intersections, budget narrowing, approval inheritance, and evidence accumulation; the resulting composition is both trust-preserving and the least restrictive state satisfying all governing inputs. The algebra also propagates restrictions across multi-agent calls and introduces cost-aware artifact materialization, which redirects open-ended execution toward a recoverable outcome as budget exposure grows. The evaluation is interpreted as a reliability-capability trade-off rather than a capability benchmark: the policy-algebra runtime intervenes on 94.8% of policy-violating events while retaining an 86.9% task-completion rate, eliminates the observed profile-monotonicity and zero-artifact-exhaustion violations, and increases audit completeness to 98.6%. The method provides researchers and practitioners with formal correctness conditions, executable decision semantics, and trace evidence for building agents that are not only capable, but reliably capable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"可靠能力"这一路径属性概念，并引入策略代数（policy algebra）来定义代理能力可行使的可靠性边界（reliability envelope），通过身份、资料、工具、数据、内存、预算、工件、审批和审计等约束的组合来保证代理完成任务的每个动作事件都合规。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型代理框架主要优化能力（是否能推理、检索信息、调用工具、委派任务、完成目标），但企业级执行需要更强的属性：即结果可靠。不可靠的结果包括未经授权的数据访问、扩张的委派权限、未经批准的副作用、不可恢复的预算消耗以及不完整的证据。因此需要将"可靠能力"定义为路径属性，确保任务完成过程中的每个动作事件都满足各类约束。
AI.method: 提出策略代数（policy algebra），定义能力可行使的可靠性包络线（reliability envelope）。安全配置文件和运行时义务通过连接（joins）、交集（intersections）、预算收窄（budget narrowing）、审批继承（approval inheritance）和证据累积（evidence accumulation）进行组合，形成的组合既保持信任传递，又是满足所有治理输入的最小限制状态。代数还支持跨多代理调用的限制传播，并引入成本感知的工件物化（cost-aware artifact materialization），在预算暴露增长时将开放式执行引导至可恢复的结果。
AI.result: 策略代数运行时干预了94.8%的违反策略事件，同时保持86.9%的任务完成率；消除了观察到的配置单调性和零工件耗尽违规；将审计完整性提升至98.6%。评估被解释为可靠性-能力权衡而非纯粹的能指标。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为研究人员和从业者提供了形式化的正确性条件、可执行的决策语义和可追踪的证据，用于构建不仅有能力而且可靠有能力的代理系统。

title: Coverage-Maximizing Multinomial Subset Routing under Operational Constraints
summary:
We introduce Multinomial Subset Routing (MSR), a new online routing framework over $K$ experts in which the learner keeps a multinomial routing policy instead of a deterministic subset of experts. At each round, the learner samples $M$ experts i.i.d. from the multinomial policy, and the resulting set of distinct sampled experts forms the routed subset.
  The reward depends only on the best-performing expert(s) in the routed subset. This reward structure arises naturally in routing across specialized models but is not captured by standard combinatorial bandits or subset-selection methods, which optimize deterministic subsets and typically assume additive rewards. We require the selection to satisfy several long-term, two-sided operational constraints under bandit feedback, observing only the winner's reward each round. We propose OMD-Approachability, combining online mirror descent with Blackwell's Approachability, and prove it achieves $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ regret in both reward and constraint violation. We ground the framework in practical application domains and validate it empirically on a real-world crowdsourcing dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的在线路由框架——多项子集路由（MSR），学习者维护一个K个专家的多项分布路由策略，每轮从中独立抽样M个专家形成路由子集，奖励仅取决于子集中最优专家。在仅观察获胜者奖励的bandit反馈下，作者提出结合在线镜像下降与Blackwell可逼近性的OMD-Approachability算法，证明在奖励和约束违例方面均达到O(1/√T)的遗憾界，并在真实众包数据集上进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 在跨专门模型路由等实际场景中，路由子集的奖励仅取决于子集中表现最好的专家，这种奖励结构与标准组合bandit或子集选择方法假设的加性奖励不同，且现有方法主要优化确定性子集，无法捕捉这一特性。同时，路由决策还需满足多个长期、双向的操作约束，在仅观察获胜者奖励的bandit反馈下，这些挑战尚未被现有方法解决。
AI.method: 提出MSR框架：学习者维护K个专家上的多项分布策略，每轮从中i.i.d.抽样M个专家，去重后形成路由子集。提出OMD-Approachability算法，将在线镜像下降（OMD）与Blackwell可逼近性相结合，同时处理奖励优化与多约束满足，在bandit反馈下仅观察获胜者奖励。
AI.result: 理论上证明了OMD-Approachability在奖励遗憾和约束违例两方面均达到O(1/√T)的界；在实际众包数据集上进行了经验验证。
AI.conclusion: MSR框架成功将基于最优专家的路由奖励结构与在线学习结合，OMD-Approachability在理论上保证了次线性遗憾和约束满足，并在实际数据上有效，填补了标准组合bandit方法在最优奖励结构与操作约束并存场景下的空白。

title: Contrastive Energy Fields for Inference-Time Procedure Planning in Instructional Videos
comment: To appear at GCPR 2026 (oral paper). Project page: https://visinf.github.io/cefito
summary: Procedure planning seeks to estimate a sequence of actions to transition from an observed initial state to a given goal state. Current procedure planning approaches directly predict action sequences from latent representations using feed-forward neural networks or diffusion-based inference. These paradigms treat every action as plausible, lacking the ability to enforce task-specific logical constraints that render certain actions irrelevant or not plausible. We propose CEFITO, a procedure planning approach that learns a predictor to express an action-conditioned representation space. Based on this representation space, we formulate procedure planning as a task-constrained optimization problem. Unlike prior methods, CEFITO explicitly reasons over the action space by omitting irrelevant actions during inference-time planning. This reformulation enables effective procedure planning and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on two established procedure planning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出CEFITO，一种过程规划方法，通过学习动作条件化的表示空间，将过程规划形式化为任务约束优化问题，在推理时显式省略不相关动作，在两个基准数据集上达到最先进精度。
AI.motivation: 现有过程规划方法（如前馈神经网络或基于扩散的推理）直接从潜在表示预测动作序列，将每个动作都视为可行的，缺乏强制任务特定逻辑约束的能力，无法排除不相关或不可行的动作。
AI.method: CEFITO学习一个预测器表达动作条件化的表示空间，基于该表示空间将过程规划形式化为任务约束优化问题。与先前方法不同，CEFITO在推理时通过省略不相关动作来显式地推理动作空间。
AI.result: 在两个既定的过程规划基准数据集上达到最先进的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 将过程规划重新表述为任务约束优化问题，通过显式地在动作空间上进行推理（省略不相关动作），可以有效提升过程规划的准确性。

title: Reasoning-supported Robustness Validation of Automotive E/E Components
comment: Published in: 2017 IEEE 11th International Conference on Semantic Computing (ICSC)
summary: This paper presents an ontology-supported approach to tackle the complexity of the Robustness Validation (RV) process of automotive electrical/electronic (E/E) components. The approach uses formalized knowledge from the RV process and stress, operating, and load profiles, so-called Mission Profiles (MPs). In contrast to the error-prone industrially established manual procedure, we show how component characteristics are formalized in OWL in order to form the foundation of an efficient automated analysis selection and decision support during the RV process. The proposed approach is based on the idea of mapping MPs to an OWL representation so to allow to perform semantic queries against MP data to improve their integration into the RV process. The resulting ontology-supported application framework has been applied to an industrial use-case from automotive power electronics. We present experimental results showing that the RV process can be significantly improved in terms of reduced design time and increased exhaustiveness by automating the analyses selection step and the provisioning of all the relevant data to be used.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于本体的方法，将汽车电子/电气（E/E）组件的鲁棒性验证（RV）过程中的知识与任务剖面（MPs）形式化，以支持自动化分析选择和决策，减少设计时间并提高验证的全面性。
AI.motivation: 汽车E/E组件的鲁棒性验证过程复杂且高度依赖人工，现有工业流程容易出错。任务剖面数据（MPs）的集成和分析选择缺乏系统性，需要一种高效、自动化的方法来改进该过程。
AI.method: 作者首先将RV过程中的组件特性、应力/操作/负载剖面（即任务剖面MPs）用OWL本体进行形式化建模；然后将MPs映射到OWL表示，使得可以通过语义查询对MP数据进行操作；基于此构建了一个本体支持的应用程序框架，用于自动化分析选择和数据提供。
AI.result: 该方法被应用于一个汽车电力电子的工业用例。实验结果表明，通过自动化分析选择步骤和提供所有相关数据，RV过程在设计时间上显著缩短，验证的全面性（exhaustiveness）得到提升。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的本体支持框架能够有效改善汽车E/E组件鲁棒性验证过程的效率和可靠性，相比传统手工流程具有明显优势，为自动化RV决策支持提供了可行的技术路线。

title: FETERS: Few-Shot Early Time-Series Classification via Effective Ratio Selection
summary: Early time-series classification (ETSC) aims to make accurate predictions from partially observed time series as early as possible. Although various stopping mechanisms and feature learning strategies have been developed for ETSC, most existing methods assume access to sufficient labeled training data, which may be unrealistic in applications with limited annotation. Under limited supervision, learning an additional sample-level stopping module and extracting effective classification features can both become challenging. In this paper, we propose FETERS, a few-shot ETSC framework that selects a dataset-level stopping ratio through class-wise leave-one-out (LOO) evaluation on the support set and uses a penalty-based reward function to manage the accuracy-earliness trade-off, thereby avoiding the need to train an additional stopping module. FETERS further combines Rocket-based features with frozen Chronos representations for classification. Extensive experiments on 69 public datasets spanning 14 domains show that FETERS achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in the 5-shot setting, with the highest average harmonic mean (HM) and the best HM on 38 datasets, while outperforming the current SOTA method on 44 datasets. FETERS also remains competitive in the full-shot setting, demonstrating its effectiveness in managing the accuracy-earliness trade-off.

AI.tldr: FETERS是一个面向少样本场景的早期时间序列分类框架，通过数据集级别的留一法评估选择停止比率，结合Rocket特征与冻结的Chronos表征进行分类，在69个公共数据集上实现了5-shot设置下的SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有早期时间序列分类（ETSC）方法大多假设有充足的标注训练数据，但在标注资源受限的实际应用中，训练额外的样本级停止模块和提取有效分类特征都变得困难，因此亟需一个能在少样本条件下有效管理精度与及时性权衡的ETSC框架。
AI.method: FETERS提出三个关键技术：(1) 通过支持集上的类别级留一法（LOO）评估选择数据集级别的停止比率，避免了训练额外的停止模块；(2) 采用基于惩罚的奖励函数来管理精度-及时性权衡；(3) 将Rocket特征与冻结的Chronos时间序列表征相结合用于分类。
AI.result: 在覆盖14个领域的69个公共数据集上进行的大量实验表明，FETERS在5-shot设置下达到SOTA性能，平均调和均值（HM）最高，并在38个数据集上取得最佳HM，在44个数据集上超越当前SOTA方法；在全监督设置下也保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: FETERS有效解决了少样本条件下的早期时间序列分类问题，通过数据集级停止策略替代样本级停止模块，在低标注资源下仍能取得优异的精度-及时性权衡表现。

title: Shared-Structure 4D Spectral Gaussian Representation for Sparse-View Spectral CT Reconstruction
summary: Sparse-view spectral computed tomography (CT) reconstructs energy-resolved attenuation volumes from limited projection views, requiring simultaneous handling of angular undersampling and spectral coupling. We propose a SharedStructure 4D Spectral Gaussian Representation (4D-SG) that learns shared Gaussian geometry from full spectrum structural projections and uses a Gaussian-wise Spectral Density Curve Network (GSC-Net) to predict Gaussian raw density transformations. This factorization separates shared spatial structure from spectral attenuation variation, avoids independent channel geometry optimization, and establishes a continuous 4D-SG representation from discrete spectral measurements for unobserved spectral channel queries. Experiments on six synthesized, simulated projection, and real projection datasets with 50 views demonstrate the best average performance. Compared with the strongest Gaussian baseline, 4D-SG improves PSNR from 35.56 dB to 36.61 dB, increases SSIM from 0.909 to 0.914, and reduces LPIPS from 0.208 to 0.194, demonstrating its effectiveness for sparse-view spectral CT reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出一种共享结构的4D光谱高斯表示（4D-SG），通过共享高斯几何与高斯级光谱密度曲线网络（GSC-Net）分离空间结构与光谱衰减变化，实现稀疏视角光谱CT重建，在50视角的六个数据集上达到最优平均性能。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角光谱CT重建面临角度欠采样与光谱耦合两大挑战，现有方法通常需要独立优化各光谱通道的几何结构，导致计算开销大且无法充分利用跨通道的共享空间结构信息。
AI.method: 提出4D-SG表示方法：从全光谱结构投影中学习共享高斯几何，并利用高斯级光谱密度曲线网络（GSC-Net）预测高斯原始密度变换，从而实现离散光谱测量中的连续4D-SG表示，支持未观测光谱通道的查询。
AI.result: 在六个（合成、模拟投影、真实投影）50视角数据集上达到最佳平均性能；相比最强高斯基线，PSNR从35.56 dB提升至36.61 dB，SSIM从0.909提升至0.914，LPIPS从0.208降低至0.194。
AI.conclusion: 通过分解共享空间结构与光谱衰减变化的因子化设计，有效避免了独立通道几何优化，验证了4D-SG在稀疏视角光谱CT重建中的有效性与优越性。

title: ParaTempo: Efficient Parallel Reasoning via Temporal Confidence
comment: Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/ScottZhang812/ParaTempo
summary: Parallel reasoning improves the accuracy and robustness of large reasoning models by exploring multiple solution paths, but its computational cost grows with reasoning depth and branch count. Existing methods for managing these parallel paths typically rely on final-answer consensus, local token confidence, or isolated intermediate probes. However, these signals are often delayed, weakly tied to actual reasoning progress, or too noisy for dynamic, branch-level control. To address these limitations, we introduce ParaTempo, a training-free asynchronous parallel reasoning framework. ParaTempo is driven by temporal confidence, a branch-local measure of answer-space convergence. Each branch is periodically probed for a tentative answer probability distribution, and temporal confidence quantifies how sharply the recent intermediate probes concentrate on a dominant answer. Once sufficient evidence has accumulated, ParaTempo drives its entire control process from this single signal: low-confidence branches are pruned, branches that persistently commit to their dominant answer are retired early, freed computation is reallocated by forking new branches, and generation stops globally once the confidence-weighted vote concentrates. Without requiring synchronization among reasoning trajectories, ParaTempo adaptively allocates computation based on branch-level convergence. Experiments on challenging mathematical and scientific reasoning benchmarks show that ParaTempo reduces average latency by 21.8-32.2% and total token usage by 18.1-30.3% while maintaining competitive accuracy. Moreover, temporal confidence exhibits stronger temporal stability and predictive power for future branch convergence than token-level and instantaneous signals.

AI.tldr: ParaTempo是一个无需训练的异步并行推理框架，利用"时间置信度"（时间置信度）这一分支局部度量来动态管理并行推理路径，通过剪枝低置信度分支、提前退出持久提交分支、分叉新分支来重新分配计算资源，在保持竞争性准确率的同时将平均延迟降低21.8-32.2%、总token使用量降低18.1-30.3%。
AI.motivation: 并行推理虽能通过探索多条解路径提升准确率和鲁棒性，但计算成本随推理深度和分支数量增长。现有的并行路径管理方法依赖于最终答案共识、局部token置信度或孤立的中间探针，这些信号往往具有延迟性、与实际推理进展关联弱或噪声过大，难以实现动态的分支级控制。
AI.method: ParaTempo由时间置信度驱动，该度量衡量分支在答案空间中的收敛程度。每个分支被周期性探针检测暂定答案概率分布，时间置信度量化近期中间探针在主导答案上的聚集尖锐程度。整个控制流程由这一单一信号驱动：低置信度分支被剪枝，持续提交主导答案的分支提前退出，释放的计算通过分叉新分支重新分配，全局生成在置信度加权投票集中时停止。整个过程无需推理轨迹间同步。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的数学和科学推理基准上，ParaTempo将平均延迟降低21.8-32.2%，总token使用量降低18.1-30.3%，同时保持竞争性准确率。此外，时间置信度在时间稳定性和对未来分支收敛的预测能力方面优于token级和瞬时信号。
AI.conclusion: ParaTempo证明了基于时间置信度的异步分支级动态计算分配是管理并行推理的有效策略，相比传统的共识、token置信度或瞬时信号，时间置信度提供了更可靠、更具预测力的控制信号，在不牺牲准确率的前提下显著提升了推理效率。

title: SoftModel: A Neural Model That Grows Its Own Topology -- Governed Structural Growth for Continual In-Service Learning
summary: Today, a neural system is almost always used in two phases -- trained, then deployed -- and in that regime it freezes twice: training ends, and the topology itself was never a degree of freedom. We take the opposite premise as an axiom -- total plasticity: no part of a model, including its structure, is ever frozen -- and derive the governance a lifelong learner then requires. The design's target regime is continual, in-service learning: a long-lived model on a non-stationary stream, whose stability comes from governance rather than immobility and whose capacity follows demand. The result is a growable soft model: an algebra of structural operators (width, hierarchy, composition, input interface, grown cycles, attention heads), each exact at application, budgeted, and audited, with adoption decided solely by a held-out reality gate that treats parametric and structural change uniformly. A complete from-scratch system realizes the whole account; its factory surface is operated end-to-end by a production LLM. Two conclusions follow from the axiom by construction: stability under lifelong change becomes an audit property of the lifecycle, and structure that follows demand removes the silent cap a fixed topology places on later capability where the capacity floor binds. A third is measured: in the worlds where this was measured, the marginal value of new capacity was unobservable before adoption, so workable growth governance took its ex-post form. The same governance extends to evaluative signals, and the core method is evaluated on standard continual-learning benchmarks, where governed growth preserves the ability to keep learning along long task sequences. A pre-registered experimental program adjudicates the mechanism and value claims on the tested problems and reports its failures at full prominence; the map -- positive and negative -- is the contribution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"完全可塑性"原则——模型结构本身永不被冻结——并据此推导出终身学习所需的治理机制，实现为一种可增长的软模型，通过结构算子（宽度、层级、组合、输入接口、成长环、注意力头）在应用时精确、预算化且可审计地调整结构，由留出真实门（reality gate）统一裁决参数与结构变更。系统从头完整实现，由生产级LLM端到端操作。核心结论：终身变化下的稳定性成为生命周期的一种审计属性；结构随需求增长消除了固定拓扑对后续能力的静默上限；增长治理必须采用事后（ex-post）形式，因为新容量的边际价值在采纳前不可观测。方法在标准持续学习基准上评估，治理式增长保持长任务序列上的持续学习能力，并通过预注册实验公开失败案例。
AI.motivation: 传统神经网络范式是"训练—部署"两阶段，模型冻结两次：训练结束即冻结，且拓扑结构本身从来不是自由度。作者将此视为根本局限：对长寿命、非平稳数据流上的持续在役学习系统而言，稳定性不应来自静止（immobility），而应来自治理（governance），容量应随需求变化。因此，作者以"完全可塑性"（total plasticity）为公理，探讨终身学习者所需的治理结构。
AI.method: 以完全可塑性为公理推导治理设计，实现"可增长的软模型"：定义一套结构算子代数（宽度扩展、层级调整、组合、输入接口、成长循环、注意力头增删），每个算子具有精确性（exact at application）、预算化（budgeted）和可审计性（audited）。结构变更与参数变更由统一的"留出真实门"（held-out reality gate）裁决，以经验证据而非先验假设决定是否采纳。系统从头完整构建，其工厂表面（factory surface）由生产级LLM端到端操作。治理框架同样延伸到评估信号本身。
AI.result: 三个结论：(1) 稳定性成为生命周期的一种审计属性（由构造推出）；(2) 结构随需求增长消除了固定拓扑在容量地板约束下对后续能力的静默上限；(3) 实验测量显示，新容量的边际价值在采纳前不可观测，因此可行的增长治理必然采取事后（ex-post）形式。在标准持续学习基准上，治理式增长保持长任务序列上的持续学习能力。预注册实验全面裁决机制与价值主张，并将失败案例以完整可见度报告。
AI.conclusion: 本文的贡献不在单一正面结果，而是完整的"地图"——包含正负两方面发现。完全可塑性与治理式增长重新定义了终身学习的稳定性来源（从静止到审计），并揭示了增长治理在信息经济学上的根本限制（容量价值事前不可观测，须事后评估），为该方向确立了方法论框架与公开失败的实验规范。

title: Sterilizable Scene Graph Generation for Operating Rooms
summary: Scene graph generation from surgical video enables a holistic and structured understanding of surgical scenes by modeling objects and their semantic relationships. Despite recent advances, state-of-the-art approaches rely on large, parameter-heavy deep learning models that are impractical for deployment in the operating room (OR) due to hardware footprint, hygiene constraints, latency, and data privacy concerns. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first scene graph generation method built on NCAs and the first NCA framework capable of learning structured representations. We introduce SG-NCA, a lightweight scene graph generation framework based on Neural Cellular Automata (NCA), designed for inference in fanless devices critical for OR hygiene protocols. SG-NCA is the first scene graph generation combining NCA-based multiclass segmentation for efficient object detection and feature extraction with a lightweight relation predictor. We evaluate SG-NCA on videos of cataract surgery and cholecystectomy, demonstrating performance comparable to established baselines while requiring 55x fewer parameters. We showcase deployment on fanless edge devices better suited for the OR and demonstrate downstream applications such as surgical video captioning, highlighting SG-NCA's potential for affordable, privacy-preserving, and OR-ready intraoperative scene understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SG-NCA，一种基于神经细胞自动机（NCA）的轻量级手术视频场景图生成框架，首次将NCA用于结构化表示学习。相比现有SOTA方法，SG-NCA在白内障手术和胆囊切除手术视频上达到相当性能，同时参数量减少55倍，并成功部署于无风扇边缘设备（符合手术室卫生要求），支持手术视频字幕生成等下游应用。
AI.motivation: 现有手术场景图生成方法依赖大规模、参数沉重的深度学习模型，由于硬件占用、卫生限制、延迟和数据隐私等问题难以在实际手术室（OR）中部署。需要一个轻量化、可在无风扇边缘设备上运行且保护隐私的解决方案。
AI.method: SG-NCA框架由两部分组成：(1) 基于NCA的多类分割模块，用于高效目标检测和特征提取；(2) 轻量级关系预测器用于生成语义关系。这是首个基于NCA的场景图生成方法，也是首个能够学习结构化表示的NCA框架。
AI.result: 在白内障手术和胆囊切除手术视频数据集上，SG-NCA达到了与既有基准方法相当的性能，同时参数量减少55倍。成功展示了在无风扇边缘设备上的部署，以及手术视频字幕生成等下游应用。
AI.conclusion: SG-NCA证明了轻量级NCA架构能够在保持与大规模模型可比性能的同时，实现手术室可部署性（隐私保护、低延迟、符合卫生要求），为经济实惠且手术室就绪的术中场景理解提供了新路径。

title: Drive, Pack, Fly: The Travelling Thief Problem with Drone
summary: In collection operations, accumulating payload progressively slows the vehicle, imposing a cumulative penalty on routing efficiency. An onboard drone can offset this penalty by retrieving outlying items, thereby shortening the makespan and increasing operational profit. However, travel time remains load-dependent, and each item collected by the ground vehicle shifts the arrival times that govern the drone's launch and rendezvous points. This paper introduces the Travelling Thief Problem with Drone (TTP-D), which maximises the collected profit, net of a time-based rental cost, by jointly optimising item selection, vehicle routing, and flight synchronisation. We formulate a mixed-integer linear program that solves small instances to optimality, and develop both metaheuristics and an attention-based Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) policy for larger instances. We further propose a learner-initialised hybrid solver, in which the DRL policy constructs an initial solution that a short annealing run subsequently refines. On two benchmark sets, this hybrid recovers most of the metaheuristic baseline's quality at a fraction of its computational budget, although the largest instances still require the baseline at its full budget. Finally, a sensitivity analysis reveals that the rental ratio is the primary driver of profitability, whereas the fleet parameters affect profit only at the margin.

AI.tldr: 本文提出旅行窃贼问题-无人机变体（TTP-D），联合优化物品选择、车辆路径与飞行同步，以最大化净收益（收集利润减去基于时间的租赁成本）。采用MILP精确求解小规模实例，并提出元启发式与基于注意力机制的深度强化学习（DRL）策略处理大规模实例，同时提出学习者初始化的混合求解器。
AI.motivation: 在收集作业中，地面车辆随着负载累积而逐渐减速，对路径效率产生累积惩罚；机上无人机可通过回收外围物品来抵消这一惩罚，从而缩短完工时间并提高运营利润。然而，行驶时间仍与负载相关，且地面车辆收集每件物品都会改变控制无人机发射与会合点的到达时间，使得问题具有高度耦合性与动态性，需要联合优化。
AI.method: 1) 构建混合整数线性规划（MILP）精确求解小规模实例；2) 开发元启发式算法和基于注意力机制的深度强化学习（DRL）策略求解大规模实例；3) 提出学习者初始化的混合求解器，先用DRL策略构造初始解，再用短时退火（annealing）进行精炼。
AI.result: 在两个基准集上，混合求解器以元启发式基线的一小部分计算预算恢复了其大部分解质量；但最大规模实例仍需完整预算的基线算法。敏感性分析表明，租赁比率是盈利能力的主要驱动因素，而车队参数仅对利润产生边际影响。
AI.conclusion: TTP-D将旅行窃贼问题与无人机调度相结合，为收集运营中的负载依赖型路径规划与无人机协同提供了联合优化框架。混合学习者初始化策略在解质量与计算效率之间取得了良好平衡，且租赁比率为成本结构中的关键杠杆。

title: TRACE-CASH: Trial-History-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Configuration Exploration in Time-Series CASH
summary: Combined algorithm selection and hyperparameter optimization (CASH) searches a conditional space in which the selected model determines which hyperparameters are active. In time-series forecasting, temporal choices, chronological validation, and costly evaluations further complicate this search. Controlled comparisons of heterogeneous search methods under a shared time-series CASH (TS-CASH) evaluation protocol remain limited. Within this setting, we study TRACECASH, a task-local hybrid sequential optimizer combining grouped actor-critic candidate generation with fixed rules for model coverage, validation-guided exploitation, and exploration after stalled progress. A model actor proposes an initial forecasting model; three model-conditioned actors generate temporal, architectural, and training actions; and a modelspecific decoder constructs the configuration ultimately evaluated. We compare TRACE-CASH with six alternatives spanning random, Bayesian, evolutionary, multi-objective, and language-model-assisted search across 41 dataset-frequency task variants. TRACE-CASH has the lowest mean rank on both MASE and WQL. Descriptively, it also has the lowest window-averaged test-MASE rank in the predefined full and late windows. These results support the complete TRACECASH procedure as competitive among the evaluated methods.

AI.tldr: 本文研究时间序列预测中的联合算法选择与超参数优化（TS-CASH）问题，提出了TRACE-CASH——一种任务局部混合顺序优化器，结合分组actor-critic候选生成与固定规则，在41个数据集-频率任务变体上与六种基线方法（随机、贝叶斯、进化、多目标、语言模型辅助搜索）对比，TRACE-CASH在MASE和WQL上均取得最低平均排名。
AI.motivation: CASH搜索的是条件空间——所选模型决定了哪些超参数处于激活状态。在时间序列预测中，时间选择、时序验证和昂贵的评估进一步使搜索复杂化。然而在统一的时间序列CASH（TS-CASH）评估协议下，对异构搜索方法进行受控比较的研究仍然有限，缺乏系统的对比验证。
AI.method: 提出TRACE-CASH，一种任务局部混合顺序优化器。其核心架构为：一个模型actor提出初始预测模型；三个模型条件actor分别生成时间（temporal）、架构（architectural）和训练（training）行动；一个模型特定解码器构造最终评估的配置。此外结合固定规则实现模型覆盖、验证引导的利用以及停滞后的探索。
AI.result: 在41个数据集-频率任务变体上，TRACE-CASH与六种替代方案（随机、贝叶斯、进化、多目标、语言模型辅助搜索）对比，在MASE和WQL两个指标上均取得最低平均排名。描述性分析还显示，在预定义的全窗口和晚窗口中，TRACE-CASH具有最低的窗口平均测试MASE排名。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果支持完整的TRACE-CASH流程在所评估的方法中具有竞争力，表明任务局部分组actor-critic生成结合固定规则的方法在TS-CASH问题上是一种有效的解决方案。

title: RISE: Roadside Infrastructure Sequence Understanding across 3D Tracking and Structured Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: We present RISE (Roadside Infrastructure Sequence Understanding and Evaluation), a framework spanning metric 3D tracking and structured vision-language reasoning in roadside sequences. For metric tracking, our image-only method combines SAM3 video identities with calibration-guided mask agreement for multi-view identity association, recovering persistent 3D tracks without LiDAR or task-specific 3D training. Its calibration-conditioned geometry allows the procedure to be instantiated at different calibrated multi-camera intersections without layout-specific retraining. On 20 human-reviewed clips from six intersections, the generated tracks achieve 66.9 MOTA within the defined multi-view evaluation scope. For structured vision-language reasoning, a human-reviewed MLLM pipeline mines high-value clips and uses a constrained full-context Oracle to construct bbox-grounded predictive QA without exposing future evidence to evaluated models. The resulting RISE-VQA dataset contains 33,910 QA pairs from 557 clips across 16 intersections and 61 roadside views. Its intersection-held-out RISE-Bench evaluates semantic choices, coordinates, future boxes, and interaction sets with deterministic task-specific metrics. Experiments show consistent benefits from domain adaptation and generally from temporal context, while revealing persistent challenges in spatial grounding, future localization, and interaction reasoning.

AI.tldr: RISE是一个面向路侧（路口）序列的框架，涵盖度量3D跟踪和结构化视觉-语言推理两大任务。在度量跟踪方面，采用纯图像方法结合SAM3视频身份标识与校准引导的掩码一致性实现多视角身份关联，无需LiDAR或特定3D训练即可恢复持久3D轨迹，并在6个路口的20个剪辑中达到66.9 MOTA。在视觉-语言推理方面，构建了RISE-VQA数据集（557个剪辑、16个路口、61个路侧视角、33,910对QA），以及交叉路口留出的RISE-Bench评测基准，实验显示域自适应和时间上下文的收益，同时揭示了空间定位、未来定位和交互推理方面的持续挑战。
AI.motivation: 路侧（非车载）感知场景在自动驾驶和智能交通中日益重要，但现有工作缺乏将度量3D跟踪与结构化视觉-语言推理统一起来的框架。主流方法过度依赖LiDAR或任务特定的3D训练，且缺少用于跨路口泛化的评测基准和高质量的预测性视觉问答数据集。
AI.method: 1) 度量3D跟踪：采用纯图像方法，将SAM3视频身份标识与校准引导的掩码一致性结合，进行多视角身份关联，利用校准条件几何实现跨路口无需重训练的迁移。2) 视觉-语言推理：通过人类审核的MLLM流水线挖掘高价值剪辑，使用受限全上下文Oracle构建带边界框锚定的预测性QA数据（RISE-VQA），并设计交叉路口留出的RISE-Bench评测基准，涵盖语义选择、坐标、未来框和交互集合四类确定性指标。
AI.result: 在6个路口的20个人工审核剪辑上，生成的3D轨迹达到66.9 MOTA（多视图评测范围内）。RISE-VQA包含33,910对QA，覆盖16个路口、61个路侧视图；RISE-Bench实验表明域自适应和时间上下文带来一致性收益，但空间定位、未来定位和交互推理仍具有挑战性。
AI.conclusion: RISE验证了纯图像校准感知在路侧多相机场景实现度量3D跟踪的可行性，并提供了首个大规模结构化路侧预测性VQA基准。当前空间与未来定位以及交互推理仍存在显著短板，为后续研究指明方向。

title: Evolving Executable Pipeline Programs for AutoML with Language Models
summary: Automated machine learning (AutoML) systems search for pipelines within a space of preprocessing operators, learners, and hyper-parameters specified in advance: they can select and tune known components, but cannot produce structure outside that space. We present LACE, an AutoML framework that instead searches over complete executable pipeline programs: an evolutionary loop maintains a population of scikit-learn-compatible Python classes, and a large language model acts as the variation operator. To our knowledge, LACE is the first to formulate general tabular pipeline AutoML this way, evaluated on standardized OpenML tasks under a leakage-controlled protocol that withholds dataset identity from the generator. Because every candidate is ordinary Python, the returned pipeline and the search that produced it can be inspected and edited directly, rather than only through a framework's model objects. On 68 OpenML classification tasks, LACE with GPT-5.4-mini significantly outperforms auto-sklearn, H2O, and a fixed XGBoost baseline, with no detectable difference against AutoGluon, the strongest search-based system evaluated, while covering the full benchmark. Newer tabular foundation models are more accurate on the subset of tasks they support, but apply a fixed pretrained predictor rather than returning an editable task-specific program. LACE's contribution is therefore not raw accuracy but a search space defined by code: complete coverage, pipelines practitioners can reuse directly, and a component set extended by editing the prompt rather than the framework.

AI.tldr: LACE是一个新的AutoML框架，通过进化循环维护scikit-learn兼容Python类的种群，并以大语言模型作为变异算子，直接在完整可执行pipeline程序的代码空间中搜索，而非在预定义的组件空间中搜索。在68个OpenML分类任务上显著优于auto-sklearn、H2O和固定XGBoost基线，与AutoGluon无显著差异，核心贡献在于用代码定义搜索空间。
AI.motivation: 传统AutoML系统只能在预先指定的算子、学习器和超参数空间内进行选择和调优，无法产生超出该空间的结构。这限制了AutoML发现新颖pipeline架构的能力，因此需要一种能够搜索完整可执行pipeline程序的方法。
AI.method: LACE采用进化搜索框架：维护一个scikit-learn兼容Python类组成的种群，使用大语言模型作为变异算子生成新的pipeline程序。采用泄漏控制的评估协议，对生成器隐藏数据集身份。每个候选都是一个普通Python程序，因此pipeline和搜索过程都可直接检查和编辑。
AI.result: 在68个OpenML分类任务上，LACE搭配GPT-5.4-mini显著优于auto-sklearn、H2O和固定XGBoost基线，与AutoGluon无显著差异。虽然更新的表格基础模型在支持的任务子集上更准确，但LACE覆盖完整基准测试且返回可编辑的任务特定程序。
AI.conclusion: LACE的贡献不在于原始精度，而在于以代码定义的搜索空间：实现完整覆盖、提供可直接复用的pipeline，并通过编辑提示而非修改框架来扩展组件集。这代表了AutoML范式的转变——从固定组件空间搜索转向开放式程序空间搜索。

title: Remote-Sensing City Layout Extraction with MLLM
comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Accepted to IEEE APGARSS 2026
summary: Remote-sensing systems usually describe urban content with detection boxes, semantic masks, or vector boundaries. Such outputs locate classes and support image-plane scoring, yet they do not by themselves constitute an executable layout that retains object identities, typed relations, topology, and regeneration rules. Code-as-City instead casts urban-layout extraction from a single top-down image as constrained code generation with a multimodal large language model (MLLM). An image model first produces an aligned five-class semantic layout prior. Three ordered MLLM passes use the image and this prior to recover roads, land-cover regions and relations, and buildings. Deterministic normalization converts the accumulated records into a city graph and a restricted layout program. Executing the program creates a renderable 3D city layout and an orthographic semantic projection over shared geometry. The projection admits pixel-level comparison with remote-sensing masks, while named objects, relations, and editing operations remain available for synchronized regeneration of both views. Evaluated on the 100 scenes of CityLayout-100, the complete framework obtains 41.1% mean intersection-over-union and 48.3% global intersection-over-union. This result provides quantitative evidence that visual observations can be translated into inspectable, editable city code with coupled planar and 3D outputs.

AI.tldr: 提出Code-as-City框架，将单张俯视遥感图像的城市布局提取转化为基于多模态大语言模型的约束代码生成任务，通过三阶段MLLM推理恢复道路、土地覆盖和建筑，最终生成可渲染的3D城市布局及可同步编辑的平面语义投影。在CityLayout-100数据集上获得41.1% mIoU和48.3% GIoU。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感系统输出检测框、语义掩码或矢量边界，仅能定位类别并支持图像平面评分，但不能构成保留对象身份、类型化关系、拓扑结构和再生规则的可执行布局，缺乏可编辑、可再生的城市布局表达。
AI.method: (1) 图像模型首先生成对齐的五类语义布局先验；(2) 三个有序的MLLM传递利用图像与先验依次恢复道路、土地覆盖区域及其关系、建筑；(3) 确定性归一化将累积记录转换为城市图和受限布局程序；(4) 执行程序生成可渲染的3D城市布局以及共享几何上的正交语义投影；(5) 投影可与遥感掩码进行像素级比较，同时具名对象、关系和编辑操作支持两个视图的同步再生成。
AI.result: 在CityLayout-100数据集的100个场景上，完整框架获得41.1%的平均交并比(mIoU)和48.3%的全局交并比(GIoU)。
AI.conclusion: 定量结果证明视觉观察可以被转化为可检查、可编辑的城市代码，并耦合生成平面与3D输出，为遥感城市理解提供了超越像素级分割的可执行布局表达范式。

title: Time to Reason: Scalable Neurosymbolic Learning for LTLf via Fuzzy Semantics
summary: Neurosymbolic (NeSy) Artificial Intelligence aims to integrate Deep Learning (DL) architectures with symbolic reasoning. While initial NeSy approaches have targeted mainly symbolic reasoning in propositional and first-order logics, recent works have started to address the construction of neurosymbolic frameworks for Temporal Logics, and in particular for LTLf. These approaches have established temporal NeSy as a promising research direction, laying the foundations for learning under temporal constraints. Nonetheless, they leave many questions unanswered. From a theoretical perspective, several differentiable semantics for interpreting LTLf have been proposed but have not yet been formally and systematically defined within a unified framework. Moreover, existing approaches commonly rely on automata to represent temporal knowledge, resulting in limited scalability. Motivated by this research gap, this paper provides the following contributions: (i) formally defining different fuzzy semantics for LTLf, and systematically analysing theoretical properties regarding equivalences and dualities of temporal operators; (ii) showing how these semantics can be directly integrated within a novel NeSy framework, called DiffLTLf, enabling flexible and scalable learning without relying on the usage of automata; and (iii) introducing a novel evaluation protocol of increased complexity of learning tasks w.r.t. existing benchmarks. Our results show that the choice of fuzzy semantics has a significant impact on predictive performance. Moreover, DiffLTLf achieves performance on par with, and sometimes superior to, state-of-the-art probabilistic approaches while substantially improving scalability. Taken together, these results establish direct fuzzy interpretations as a competitive and scalable alternative to existing temporal NeSy frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DiffLTLf，一种无需自动机的神经符号（NeSy）框架，通过正式定义LTLf的多种模糊语义并系统分析其理论性质，实现了在时间约束下的灵活、可扩展学习，性能与最先进的概率方法相当甚至更优。
AI.motivation: 现有神经符号AI虽已开始涉足LTLf时间逻辑，但缺乏对不同可微语义的统一形式化框架，且依赖自动机表示时间知识导致可扩展性受限。本文旨在填补这一理论空白并解决可扩展性瓶颈。
AI.method: (i) 形式化定义LTLf的不同模糊语义，系统分析时间算子在等价性和对偶性方面的理论性质；(ii) 将这些语义直接集成到新的NeSy框架DiffLTLf中，实现无自动机的灵活可扩展学习；(iii) 引入比现有基准复杂度更高的新评估协议。
AI.result: 模糊语义的选择对预测性能有显著影响；DiffLTLf在性能上与最先进概率方法持平且有时更优，同时大幅提升了可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 直接模糊解释可作为现有时间神经符号框架的竞争性且可扩展的替代方案。

title: PertMind: Eliciting Emergent Biological Reasoning in LLM via Reinforcement Learning on Cellular Perturbation Data
comment: Project page: https://shapsider.github.io/PertMind/ Code: https://github.com/shapsider/PertMind Model: https://huggingface.co/tzcfly/PertMind
summary: Large language models can describe mechanisms, yet scalable post-training still depends on costly, manually curated biological reasoning traces. Here we show that cellular perturbation atlases can instead become reinforcement-learning environments, where measured gene responses provide computable rewards for biological reasoning. We introduce PertMind, which combines trusted-trajectory supervised initialization with gene-, pathway-, and format-level reinforcement signals. Trained only on forward perturbation-response prediction, PertMind improved response inference in unseen cellular contexts while retaining general language capabilities. It also transferred without task-specific post-training to reverse perturbation identification, double-perturbation reasoning, phenotypic-screen prioritization, and biological-process interpretation. PertMind further generated biological profiles that supported competitive gene, cell, and donor representations across multiscale downstream tasks. These results support the hypothesis that reinforcement on experimental endpoints can concentrate reusable biological strategies already accessible to pretrained models. More broadly, perturbation-derived reinforcement learning offers a scalable route for transforming expanding experimental atlases into training environments for general-purpose biological reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PertMind框架，将细胞扰动图谱转化为强化学习环境，利用基因响应作为可计算奖励来训练大语言模型的生物推理能力，在未进行任务特定微调的情况下即可迁移到多种下游生物任务。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能够描述生物机制，但可扩展的后训练仍然依赖于昂贵且需要人工精心标注的生物推理轨迹。现有方法缺乏自动化的可扩展奖励信号来训练模型的生物推理能力。
AI.method: PertMind结合了可信轨迹的监督初始化与基因层面、通路层面及格式层面的强化学习信号。模型仅在前向扰动-响应预测任务上进行训练，利用实验测量的基因响应作为计算奖励。
AI.result: PertMind在未见过的细胞情境中提升了响应推断能力，同时保留了通用语言能力。它还无需任务特定后训练即可迁移到逆向扰动识别、双重扰动推理、表型筛选优先级排序和生物过程解释等任务。此外，生成的生物图谱支持多尺度下游任务中的基因、细胞和供体表示。
AI.conclusion: 该研究支持一个假设：对实验终点进行强化学习可以集中预训练模型中已存在的可复用生物策略。基于扰动的强化学习为将不断扩展的实验图谱转化为通用生物推理的训练环境提供了一条可扩展路径。

title: HiFi-BRep: High-Fidelity Latent Representation for Robust B-Rep Generation
summary: Boundary representation (B-Rep) generation is a fundamental task in computer-aided design, yet the direct synthesis of high-fidelity and structurally valid B-Reps remains a major challenge. Existing deep generative methods suffer from two forms of brittleness: representation brittleness, caused by padding noise and feature contamination in the latent space, and generation brittleness, stemming from sequential error propagation and a train-inference mismatch due to non-differentiable validity enforcement. We propose HiFi-BRep, a novel framework that addresses these limitations through two synergistic contributions. First, a topology-aware encoder constructs a high-fidelity latent representation by eliminating padding via learnable queries and preventing feature contamination with topology-guided attention. Second, a single-stage decoder jointly predicts geometry and topology in parallel, embedding core manifold constraints as a differentiable learning objective. This design ensures mutual guidance between geometry and topology while avoiding cascaded errors. Extensive experiments show that HiFi-BRep significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both structural validity and geometric fidelity, providing a robust solution for high-quality B-Rep synthesis. Code and models are publicly available at https://github.com/1nnoh/HiFi-BRep.

AI.tldr: HiFi-BRep是一个用于计算机辅助设计（CAD）中边界表示（B-Rep）生成的新框架，通过拓扑感知编码器和单阶段解码器分别解决"表示脆弱性"（padding噪声和潜在空间特征污染）和"生成脆弱性"（序列错误传播和训练-推理不匹配）两大问题，在结构有效性和几何保真度上均显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: B-Rep生成是CAD领域的基础任务，但直接合成高保真且结构有效的B-Rep仍是一大挑战。现有深度生成方法存在两种脆弱性：一是表示脆弱性，由padding噪声和潜在空间中的特征污染引起；二是生成脆弱性，源于顺序错误传播以及因不可微的有效性约束导致的训练-推理不匹配。
AI.method: HiFi-BRep框架包含两个协同贡献：（1）拓扑感知编码器：通过可学习查询消除padding，利用拓扑引导注意力防止特征污染，构建高保真的潜在表示；（2）单阶段解码器：并行联合预测几何和拓扑，将核心流形约束嵌入为可微学习目标，实现几何与拓扑之间的相互引导，同时避免级联错误。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，HiFi-BRep在结构有效性和几何保真度两方面均显著优于现有最先进方法，为高质量B-Rep合成提供了鲁棒解决方案。
AI.conclusion: HiFi-BRep通过从编码器和解码器两端同时缓解生成B-Rep的脆弱性问题，验证了拓扑感知编码与并行解码策略的有效性，为CAD中高保真B-Rep生成提供了实用且稳健的解决方案。

title: HaReCAP: Habitual-action Grounding for Recursive Large Language Model Agents
summary: Long-horizon embodied tasks require LLM agents to iteratively decompose high-level goals, revise plans in response to environmental feedback, and ground leaf-level subgoals into valid executable actions. Recursive context-management methods such as ReCAP improve planning stability through multi-level task decomposition and parent-node refinement, but still repeatedly invoke the LLM at leaf nodes to ground atomic subtasks into exact valid actions. We refer to this final grounding step as last-mile grounding redundancy, which accumulates into substantial LLM-call and token overhead during long-horizon execution. To mitigate this issue, we propose HaReCAP (Habitual-action Grounded ReCAP), a low-intrusion leaf grounding extension for ReCAP. HaReCAP extracts frequent leaf decisions from successful trajectories and compiles them offline into auditable and abstainable one-step leaf-reflex rules. At runtime, it skips the leaf LLM call only when a rule can uniquely determine a legal action in the current valid-action set; otherwise, it falls back to the original ReCAP. This design avoids repeatedly carrying the full recursive context into the LLM for routine leaf action grounding, while preserving the original recursive control flow. We evaluate HaReCAP on Robotouille and ALFWorld with Qwen3.5-27B as the main model. On tasks solved by both ReCAP and HaReCAP, HaReCAP reduces token consumption by 14.67%, 17.93%, and 20.08% on Robotouille synchronous, Robotouille asynchronous, and ALFWorld, respectively. The results show that HaReCAP can serve as a low-intrusion extension to ReCAP-style recursive context-management frameworks, reducing last-mile grounding redundancy across environments and models on commonly successful trajectories.

AI.tldr: HaReCAP是一种面向ReCAP框架的低侵入式扩展方法，通过离线编译频繁叶级决策为"一步叶级反射规则"，在运行时跳过部分叶节点LLM调用，从而减少长时程具身任务中的"最后一步落地冗余"，在Robotouille和ALFWorld上分别减少14.67%-20.08%的token消耗。
AI.motivation: 长时程具身任务中，ReCAP等递归上下文管理方法虽然通过多级任务分解和父节点细化提升了规划稳定性，但在叶节点反复调用LLM将原子子目标落地为有效动作，这种"最后一步落地冗余"在长时程执行中累积为大量LLM调用和token开销，亟需缓解。
AI.method: HaReCAP从成功轨迹中提取频繁叶级决策，离线编译为可审计、可放弃（abstainable）的一步叶级反射规则。运行时仅在规则能唯一确定当前有效动作集中的合法动作时才跳过叶级LLM调用，否则回退到原始ReCAP。该设计保留了ReCAP的递归控制流，避免在常规叶级动作落地时反复携带完整递归上下文进入LLM。
AI.result: 在Robotouille同步、Robotouille异步和ALFWorld三个场景中分别将token消耗降低14.67%、17.93%和20.08%（以Qwen3.5-27B为主模型，基于ReCAP和HaReCAP均成功解决的任务评估）。
AI.conclusion: HaReCAP可以作为ReCAP风格递归上下文管理框架的低侵入式扩展，在常见成功轨迹上有效减少最后一步落地冗余，跨环境和模型均表现出良好泛化性。

title: Localized TabICLv2: Scaling Tabular In-Context Learning through k-NN
comment: Accepted at the 2nd ICML Workshop on Foundation Models for Structured Data (FMSD), ICML 2026
summary: Foundational models for tabular data have made significant progress in recent years, with TabICLv2 reporting state-of-the-art performance on several tabular classification tasks. However, full-context tabular ICL still suffers from attention cost that grows with the training-context size, which limits its ability to handle large datasets efficiently. Localized TabICLv2 introduces a method that reduces the inference cost of TabICLv2 by retrieving only the k nearest training neighbours for each test point, measured by similarity in the model's Stage 2 row-representation space, rather than using the full training context. This requires no architectural changes, and we show that accuracy retention can be improved through additional Stage 2 and Stage 3 fine-tuning. On TabArena classification tasks, the fine-tuned localized model retains 98.64% of Full TabICLv2 accuracy and it achieves a median 2.18$\times$ speedup in batch inference, and reaches approximately 249$\times$ median speedup in the single-query serving setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Localized TabICLv2，通过仅检索每个测试点在Stage 2行表示空间中k个最近邻训练样本，而非使用完整训练上下文，来降低TabICLv2表格数据上下文学习（ICL）的推理成本。无需架构改动，通过额外的Stage 2和Stage 3微调可提升精度保持率，在TabArena分类任务上保留了Full TabICLv2的98.64%精度，批推理中位数加速2.18倍，单查询服务场景中位数加速约249倍。
AI.motivation: 全上下文表格数据上下文学习存在注意力计算成本随训练上下文规模增长的问题，限制了其在大型数据集上的高效处理能力。需要一种不改变架构且能显著降低推理成本的方法。
AI.method: Localized TabICLv2通过基于Stage 2行表示空间中的相似度，为每个测试点仅检索k个最近邻训练邻居作为上下文，替代完整训练上下文。无需任何架构改动，并可通过额外的Stage 2和Stage 3阶段微调来提升精度保留率。
AI.result: 在TabArena分类任务上，微调后的局部化模型保留了Full TabICLv2的98.64%精度；批推理场景下实现2.18倍中位数加速；单查询服务场景下实现约249倍中位数加速。
AI.conclusion: Localized TabICLv2通过最近邻检索策略有效解决了全文表格ICL的推理效率瓶颈，在几乎不损失精度的情况下实现了显著加速，尤其在单查询部署场景中收益巨大。

title: Towards Real-Time and Adaptable LiDAR Scene Completion
comment: Accepted at ECCVW 2026, 14 pages, 4 figures. Code is available at https://github.com/AzharSindhi/RapidLiDAR
summary: LiDAR scene completion is a key component of 3D perception in autonomous driving, where the scene must be completed in real time to be usable in downstream tasks. Existing approaches typically follow an initialize-and-refine paradigm, in which a coarse initialization of the scene is first constructed, then refined into complete 3D geometry. Generative models are slower because they iteratively refine random Gaussian noise into the scene, while non-generative methods perturb the partial scene with a fixed noise scale, which limits coverage of large gaps and occluded regions and requires manual recalibration for each new sensor configuration. We present RapidLiDAR, a LiDAR scene completion method that treats the initialization itself as a learned, data-driven component. We propose an adaptive initialization module that predicts a spatially varying displacement for each partial input point, expanding the partial observations into a coarse scene initialization adapted to the local geometry, without requiring manual noise tuning. To refine this coarse initialization into a complete and coherent scene, we additionally propose a multi-scale reconstruction module that further refines point positions by querying multi-scale 3D voxel and 2D BEV feature maps constructed from the input scan. By replacing point-neighborhood operators such as farthest point sampling and $k$-nearest neighbor search with voxel- and BEV-based feature extraction, our architecture is faster and can handle different input resolutions by design. Experiments on SemanticKITTI and KITTI-360 show that our method achieves completion performance on par with the state of the art while completing a full scene in 0.1 seconds, which is 2.3 times faster than the fastest prior method. This matches the 10 Hz acquisition rate of typical automotive LiDAR sensors, taking a step toward real-time LiDAR scene completion.

AI.tldr: RapidLiDAR是一种新的LiDAR场景补全方法，将场景初始化本身作为可学习的数据驱动组件，通过自适应初始化模块预测每个部分输入点的空间变化位移，并结合多尺度体素和BEV特征重建模块，在保持与最先进方法相当的性能的同时，实现0.1秒完成的推理速度，比最快现有方法快2.3倍，首次匹配10Hz汽车LiDAR采集速率。
AI.motivation: 现有LiDAR场景补全方法遵循"初始化-细化"范式，但存在两个核心问题：(1)生成式方法通过迭代细化随机高斯噪声生成场景，速度较慢；(2)非生成式方法使用固定噪声尺度扰动部分场景，限制了大型间隙和遮挡区域的覆盖率，且需要针对每种传感器配置手动重新校准噪声参数。
AI.method: 论文提出RapidLiDAR，包含两个关键模块：(1)自适应初始化模块：预测每个部分输入点的空间变化位移，将部分观测扩展为适应局部几何的粗场景初始化，无需手动噪声调参；(2)多尺度重建模块：通过查询输入扫描构建的多尺度3D体素和2D BEV特征图，进一步细化点位置，完成场景补全。架构用体素和BEV特征提取替代最远点采样和k近邻搜索等逐点邻域操作，从而提升速度并天然支持不同输入分辨率。
AI.result: 在SemanticKITTI和KITTI-360数据集上的实验表明，RapidLiDAR在补全性能上与最先进方法相当，同时整个场景补全仅需0.1秒，比最快的先前方法快2.3倍，匹配典型汽车LiDAR传感器的10Hz采集速率。
AI.conclusion: RapidLiDAR通过将初始化学习化，解决了固定噪声尺度带来的覆盖局限和手动校准问题，并在不牺牲性能的情况下实现了实时LiDAR场景补全，向满足自动驾驶下游任务的实时3D感知需求迈出了一步。

title: JailbreakSkill: Scaling Automated Red-Teaming with Reusable and Ever-Evolving Skills
summary: Automated red-teaming has produced a growing collection of attack strategies, yet they typically remain scattered across prompts and workflows, making them difficult to systematically integrate, reuse, and improve at scale. We introduce \textsc{JailbreakSkill}, a skill-centric framework for scaling automated red-teaming through reusable and continuously evolving attack capabilities. \textsc{JailbreakSkill} packages existing attack strategies into modular, agent-ready skills that can be directly reused and adaptively selected across tasks and target models. Beyond reuse, it closes the loop between attacking and learning: attack experience is used to diagnose, refine, combine, and discover new skills, which are added back to an ever-growing skill library. This evolution lifts macro-average ASR by 17.5 percentage points on AdvBench and 13.4 points on HarmBench, including a 48.6-point gain against GPT-5.4 on AdvBench, while yielding novel attack strategies such as reframing a direct request as an unfinished document-completion task. Several evolved skills also generalize to unseen prompts and target models without further adaptation. Our code is available at https://github.com/BattleWen/JailbreakSkill.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 JailbreakSkill，一个以技能为中心的自动化红队框架，将现有攻击策略打包为模块化、智能体可用的技能，并形成"攻击-学习"闭环，使技能库持续演进，在 AdvBench 和 HarmBench 上分别提升宏平均攻击成功率 17.5 和 13.4 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化红队攻击策略分散在大量提示词和工作流中，缺乏系统性集成、复用和规模化改进的机制。
AI.method: 将攻击策略封装为模块化、智能体可用的技能库；通过攻击经验对技能进行诊断、细化、组合与发现，形成持续演进的闭环系统。
AI.result: 宏平均攻击成功率在 AdvBench 上提升 17.5 个百分点，在 HarmBench 上提升 13.4 个百分点；针对 GPT-5.4 在 AdvBench 上提升 48.6 个百分点；发现新攻击策略（如将直接请求重构为未完成文档补全任务）；部分演化技能可泛化到未见过的提示和目标模型。
AI.conclusion: 技能中心化框架能够实现红队攻击能力的系统化复用与持续进化，显著提升攻击成功率并带来可迁移的新策略。

title: MLLM-Guided Semantic Correction for Text-to-Video Generation
summary: Recent advances in diffusion models and Transformer architectures have led to significant progress in text-to-video generation. However, these models often suffer from semantic errors such as missing objects, incorrect attributes, or mismatched actions. Although some semantic correction methods perform optimization before sampling or refinement after sampling, how to detect and correct semantic deviations during the video generation process remains underexplored. In this paper, we introduce a training-free, interpretable mid-generation correction framework that integrates multimodal large language model (MLLM) feedback directly into the diffusion sampling loop. Our framework achieves diffusion trajectory correction by injecting semantic evaluation signals during video synthesis, enabling the model to optimize the generated content through continuous self-reflection. We propose two key modules: a Semantic Assessment Supervisor that generates intermediate preview frames for semantic evaluations and deviation diagnostics, and a Semantic Modification Assistant that corrects semantic drift during inference via a controllable latent trajectory intervention. Our method improves semantic alignment, visual fidelity, and temporal consistency without modifying model parameters. We validate the effectiveness of our approach through extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个无需训练、可解释的生成中途修正框架（mid-generation correction framework），将多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的反馈直接集成到扩散采样循环中，在视频生成过程中实时检测并纠正语义偏差（如缺失对象、属性错误、动作不匹配），通过持续的自我反思优化生成内容，无需修改模型参数即可提升语义对齐、视觉保真度和时间一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本到视频生成模型虽然取得了显著进展，但在生成过程中常出现语义错误（如缺失对象、属性错误、动作不匹配）。已有的语义修正方法要么在采样前进行优化，要么在采样后进行精炼，但如何在视频生成过程中实时检测和纠正语义偏差仍未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 提出两个核心模块：(1) 语义评估监督器（Semantic Assessment Supervisor），生成中间预览帧用于语义评估和偏差诊断；(2) 语义修改助手（Semantic Modification Assistant），在推理过程中通过可控的潜在轨迹干预来纠正语义漂移。整个框架通过将MLLM的语义评估信号注入扩散采样过程，实现扩散轨迹修正。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上进行的大量实验验证了方法的有效性，在语义对齐、视觉保真度和时间一致性方面均取得提升，且无需修改模型参数。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了扩散模型视频生成过程中语义偏差实时检测与纠正的研究空白，提供了一种无需训练的、可解释的生成中途修正方案，为提升文本到视频生成的语义准确性和质量提供了新的思路。

title: Offline Reinforcement Learning for Hemodynamic Management of Sepsis in the ICU: a MIMIC-IV Study with Dual Off-Policy Evaluation
summary: The dosing of intravenous fluids and vasopressors in sepsis is a sequential decision made under uncertainty and guided largely by clinical judgment, which makes it a natural target for reinforcement learning from historical care. Because a learned policy cannot be trialed on patients, its value must be estimated off-policy, and such estimates can be fragile and optimistic. This work advances the reliable evaluation of sepsis treatment policies by combining off-policy estimation, reliability diagnostics, and clinician-agreement analyses in a transparent validation framework. We modeled fluid and vasopressor dosing on a cohort of 36,872 septic ICU stays drawn from the MIMIC-IV critical-care database, as a discretized Markov decision process with 1,000 states and 25 actions, defined by a five-by-five grid of fluid and vasopressor levels and solved by policy iteration. The clinicians' behavior policy was estimated with a random forest, which mitigated the collapse of the Effective Sample Size (ESS 50.1 against 4.0 with smoothed counts) that otherwise destabilizes the importance-sampling estimate. The learned policy was evaluated with two estimators, weighted importance sampling (WIS) and fitted Q evaluation (FQE), with the ESS and clinician agreement as reliability checks. An empirical variable selection found that the composition of the state matters more than its size. Both estimators place the learned policy above the clinicians' return (WIS 50.8 and FQE 46.8 against 38.2, ESS 50.1), yet it departs only modestly from observed practice (total variation 0.18), favoring less intravenous fluid.
