These retrospective single-center off-policy results support the learned policy as a clinically plausible refinement of observed practice and motivate its further evaluation as a discordance-based clinical decision-support approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个透明的验证框架，将离策略估计、可靠性诊断和临床医生一致性分析相结合，用于评估败血症液体与血管加压药给药策略。基于MIMIC-IV中36,872例脓毒性ICU住院数据，将问题建模为1,000状态×25动作的离散MDP，通过策略迭代求解，并使用WIS和FQE两种估计器进行评估，结果表明学习策略优于临床实践但仅适度偏离，倾向于减少静脉输液，支持其作为临床可行且合理的治疗策略细化方案。
AI.motivation: 败血症中静脉输液和血管加压药的给药是一个在不确定性下基于临床判断的序贯决策，是强化学习的自然应用目标。然而学习得到的策略无法直接在患者身上试验，必须通过离策略估计来评估其价值，而这种估计可能脆弱且乐观，因此需要可靠的评估方法。
AI.method: 将败血症液体和血管加压药给药建模为离散马尔可夫决策过程（5×5网格=25个动作，1,000个状态），使用策略迭代求解。用随机森林估计临床医生的行为策略（有效样本量ESS从4.0提升至50.1，避免了平滑计数估计导致的重要性抽样崩溃）。采用两种离策略估计器（加权重要性抽样WIS和拟合Q评估FQE）进行评估，以ESS和临床医生一致性作为可靠性检查，并进行经验变量选择来研究状态组成的影响。
AI.result: 两种估计器均将学习策略的回报置于临床实践之上（WIS 50.8和FQE 46.8，对比临床38.2，ESS为50.1），但学习策略与观察到的实践仅适度偏离（总变差0.18），倾向于减少静脉输液。经验变量选择发现状态组成比状态大小对策略质量影响更大。
AI.conclusion: 回顾性单中心离策略结果支持学习策略作为对观察实践的临床合理细化方案，并激励其作为基于不一致性的临床决策支持方法进行进一步评估。

title: Pallas: A Proactive KV Cache Migration Framework for LLM Inference in AI-RAN
summary:
AI-RAN brings large language model (LLM) serving close to mobile users, but cellular handover can separate an active request from its inference state: the user attaches to a target base station (gNB) while the large and growing key-value (KV) cache remains at the source. Retaining inference at the source preserves service continuity but persistently increases inter-token latency (ITL), whereas recovering the state at the target restores serving locality but requires KV-cache transfer, recomputation, or a combination of both only after handover, directly prolonging service interruption time (SIT).
  This work presents Pallas, a \textit{proactive} KV-cache migration framework that prepares the inference state at the predicted target before handover, in parallel with ongoing source-side inference and token delivery. At the preparation trigger, Pallas partitions the token sequence into a stable historical prefix and an evolving suffix. The target reconstructs the prefix through local prefill, while the source streams the KV blocks generated for the suffix. At handover, the target assembles both portions into an up-to-date KV cache and resumes decoding locally, leaving only unfinished preparation to contribute to SIT. An online scheduler selects the \textit{prefetching window}, which determines how early preparation begins before handover, based on mobility predictions and runtime telemetry. Across three LLMs and $100$--$500~\mathrm{Mbps}$ inter-gNB links, our vLLM-based prototype reduces average SIT by factors of $2.28$--$89.68$ over target-side recovery approaches and lowers average ITL by $16.0\%$--$50.0\%$ compared with source-side forwarding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Pallas，一种主动式KV缓存迁移框架，在移动用户切换基站之前，就在预测的目标基站上预准备推理状态（将token序列分为历史前缀和后缀：目标端本地预填充前缀，源端流式传输后缀的KV块），从而大幅减少服务中断时间（SIT）并降低跨token延迟（ITL）。
AI.motivation: AI-RAN将LLM服务部署在移动网络边缘，但蜂窝切换（handover）会导致用户已切换到目标基站，而正在增长的KV缓存仍留在源基站。若在源端继续推理则ITL持续增大，若在目标端恢复状态则需要KV缓存传输或重计算，两者都发生在切换之后，直接延长SIT。现有方法无法同时兼顾服务连续性与服务局部性。
AI.method: Pallas采用主动式（proactive）KV缓存迁移策略：1) 在切换前根据预测确定目标基站并触发准备；2) 将token序列划分为稳定的历史前缀和动态演化的后缀，目标基站通过本地prefill重建前缀，源基站持续流式传输后缀生成的KV块；3) 切换时目标基站将两部分组装成最新KV缓存并本地恢复解码；4) 在线调度器基于移动性预测和运行时遥测选择预取窗口（prefetching window），决定准备工作提前多少开始。
AI.result: 在三种LLM和100-500 Mbps的gNB间链路上，基于vLLM的原型系统相比目标端恢复方法将平均SIT降低2.28-89.68倍，相比源端转发将平均ITL降低16.0%-50.0%。
AI.conclusion: Pallas通过将KV缓存迁移从切换后的被动恢复转变为切换前的主动准备，实现了服务连续性（低SIT）与服务局部性（低ITL）的双赢。

title: Large language models as synthetic clinical experts to inform longitudinal rare-disease modeling
summary: Due to the limited amount of information, modeling longitudinal rare-disease data can benefit from integrating clinical knowledge. Yet, elicitation of expert knowledge and formalization for model fitting is challenging, in particular due to limited time of clinical experts. To nevertheless make domain knowledge accessible during model fitting, we use large language models (LLMs) as synthetic clinical experts to supervise a variational-autoencoder-based approach that learns low-dimensional latent summaries of visit-level observations. Specifically, LLMs are queried offline on textual descriptions of patient observations to obtain judgments, e.g., the suspected clinical category. To improve the variational autoencoder fit, we train a differentiable surrogate model on these judgments and augment the loss function to encourage reconstructions that preserve the clinical-label distribution of their corresponding input profile. In an application to longitudinal motor-function assessments from children with spinal muscular atrophy, we map visit-level clinical profiles to low-dimensional representations that are linked by a multivariate mixed-effects model. The synthetic expert loss discourages reconstructions that remain numerically close in data space but alter the clinical interpretation of the reconstructed motor function profile, such as by crossing a disease-type boundary. We thus reduced disagreement between original and reconstructed SMA type labels from about 11 to 7 percent. Furthermore, informing the latent representation by the synthetic expert improved prediction of motor function milestones compared with unsupervised latent representations and a data-level baseline. These results suggest that incorporating LLMs into model fitting can make clinical knowledge available to representation learning and improve clinical faithfulness for longitudinal rare-disease data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用大语言模型（LLMs）作为合成临床专家，通过可微代理模型将临床判断注入变分自编码器（VAE）的损失函数中，以学习纵向罕见病数据的低维潜在表征。在脊髓性肌萎缩症（SMA）的运动功能数据上，该方法将原始与重建SMA分型标签的不一致率从约11%降至7%，并相比无监督潜在表征和数据级基线更好地预测了运动功能里程碑。
AI.motivation: 纵向罕见病数据因信息量有限，建模时需整合临床知识，但临床专家时间有限，专家知识的获取和形式化用于模型拟合极具挑战。作者希望在不依赖临床专家深度参与的情况下，将领域知识引入表示学习过程。
AI.method: 该方法利用LLMs作为合成临床专家，离线查询患者观察的文本描述以获得临床判断（如疑似临床类别）。随后训练一个可微的代理模型来拟合这些判断，并将其纳入VAE的损失函数，以鼓励重建结果保留输入临床档案的临床标签分布。在应用中，将就诊层面的临床档案映射到低维表征，并由多元混合效应模型关联，构建合成专家损失以防止重建在数值上接近但改变临床解释（如跨越疾病亚型边界）。
AI.result: 在儿童SMA纵向运动功能评估数据上，原始与重建SMA分型标签的不一致率从约11%降至7%；同时，由合成专家指导的潜在表征在预测运动功能里程碑方面优于无监督潜在表征和数据级基线。
AI.conclusion: 将LLMs纳入模型拟合过程可以使临床知识有效用于表示学习，提升纵向罕见病数据的临床保真度，为在临床专家时间受限条件下整合领域知识提供了一条可行路径。

title: FLEET: Token-Based Feature Extraction for Event Camera-based Reinforcement Learning
summary: Event cameras generate asynchronous, high-frequency data streams offering spatially sparse information at lower latency than traditional cameras.In principle, these properties should be ideal for the design of control policies.However, reinforcement learning research in this field remains limited as existing approaches fail to fully exploit the sensor's properties.CNN-based methods negate the sensors benefits by aggregating events into sparse grids. This couples compute cost to sensor resolution and blurs the temporal information. Meanwhile, existing generative baselines rely on the availability of trajectory data to pretrain the model. We propose FLEET (Feature Learning from Events via Efficient Tokenization), a feature extractor that processes event sequences directly. Leveraging random Fourier features and cross-attention, our architecture compresses variable streams into fixed-size latent representations. This decouples inference cost of the feature extractor's backbone from the sensor's resolution, enabling end-to-end learning without auxiliary losses. We validate FLEET on a new, high-throughput benchmark. The results demonstrate that our sequence-based approach surpasses SOTA performance and exhibits superior robustness to variations in observation frequencies.

AI.tldr: 提出FLEET，一种直接处理事件相机异步数据流的特征提取器，利用随机傅里叶特征和交叉注意力将可变长度的事件序列压缩为固定大小的潜在表示，解耦推理成本与传感器分辨率，无需辅助损失即可端到端学习，并在新基准上超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 事件相机产生异步、高频、空间稀疏的数据流，理论上非常适合控制策略设计，但现有强化学习方法未能充分利用传感器特性：CNN方法将事件聚合为稀疏网格，导致计算成本与传感器分辨率耦合且模糊时间信息；生成式基线依赖轨迹数据预训练。因此需要一种直接处理事件序列、解耦计算成本与分辨率、无需预训练的特征提取方法。
AI.method: 提出FLEET架构，直接处理事件序列：利用随机傅里叶特征对事件进行编码，通过交叉注意力机制将可变长度的事件流压缩为固定大小的潜在表示。该设计解耦了特征提取器骨干网络的推理成本与传感器分辨率，支持无需辅助损失的端到端学习。
AI.result: 在新建的高吞吐量基准上验证FLEET，结果表明序列化方法超越SOTA性能，并对观测频率的变化展现出优越的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: FLEET证明了直接处理事件序列而非聚合到网格的方法能够更充分利用事件相机的优势，实现更好的性能和更强的鲁棒性，为事件相机上的强化学习提供了更有效的特征提取方案。

title: DeepInsight II: One Trace from Benchmark to Robot
summary: Across a Physical AI stack, evaluation maturity is inversely aligned with deployment risk: foundation models enjoy mature, standardized harnesses, while the embodied layers on which deployment actually turns remain fragmented across benchmark-specific simulators, embodiments, and interfaces. The first DeepInsight report (v1) unified evaluation across this stack behind three abstractions---task, resource, and result---but its quantitative evidence centered on the foundation-model layer; navigation and manipulation (System 1) and whole-body control (System 0) remained simulation case studies, and physical execution was outside its empirical scope. DeepInsight II keeps that substrate fixed and quantifies the embodied half. First, it reproduces released-checkpoint references across two navigation and four manipulation benchmarks under their native protocols. Second, MotionBench places four released whole-body controllers under one workload and metric contract, then carries a qualified within-family cohort from parallel simulation to matched real-robot trials in which simulated and physical rollouts share a parent trace identity while retaining execution-domain-specific records, making the sim-to-real gap a native reduction rather than a reconciliation across toolchains. Third, a composed System 2--1--0 study extends trace localization into five evidence-grounded handoff labels, each mapped to a concrete repair action, with a measured repairability criterion and physical episodes testing the same attribution under hardware-observable state. The contribution is therefore not a new evaluation architecture, but empirical continuity from benchmark execution to matched robot evidence and repair-oriented diagnosis.

AI.tldr: DeepInsight II在保持与v1相同评估架构（task/resource/result三大抽象）的前提下，将定量实证从基础模型层扩展到具身层：复现了2个导航和4个操作基准的已发布检查点参考；引入MotionBench统一4个全身控制器的负载与指标契约，并在仿真与真实机器人之间建立父子轨迹对应的匹配试验；以及一个System 2-1-0组合研究，将轨迹定位扩展为五种有证据支撑的交接标签，每种映射到具体修复动作。其贡献不是新的评估架构，而是从基准执行到匹配机器人证据与修复导向诊断的实证连续性。
AI.motivation: 在物理AI技术栈中，评估成熟度与部署风险呈反向关系：基础模型层已有成熟标准化测试框架，而真正决定部署成败的具身层（导航/操作/全身控制）却因仿真器、具身形态和接口碎片化而缺乏统一评估。DeepInsight v1虽统一了评估抽象，但其定量证据集中在基础模型层，具身层的导航与操作（System 1）和全身控制（System 0）仅停留在仿真案例研究，物理执行完全不在实证范围内，存在明显的评估缺口。
AI.method: 三条实证路线：（1）在原生协议下复现两个导航和四个操作基准的已发布检查点参考；（2）MotionBench将四个已发布全身控制器置于统一负载和度量契约下，并将合格的同族队列从并行仿真推进到匹配真实机器人试验，仿真与物理回放共享父轨迹身份但保留各自执行域特定记录，使sim-to-real差距成为原生归约而非跨工具链的对齐；（3）组合式System 2-1-0研究将轨迹定位扩展为五种有证据支持的交接标签，每种映射到具体修复动作，具备可测量的可修复性标准，并在硬件可观测状态下用物理情节测试相同的归属判定。
AI.result: 论文提供的是实证连续性而非新架构：从基准执行、匹配机器人证据到修复导向诊断的完整链条。通过父子轨迹身份设计，使仿真与物理回放之间的差距测量成为原生的领域归约过程，避免了异构工具链的兼容性难题；交接标签附带可测量可修复性标准和物理验证，实现了从诊断到修复的闭环。具体量化结果虽未在摘要中列出，但从方法论上确立了具身层评估的统一实证路径。
AI.conclusion: DeepInsight II的核心贡献在于将评估体系从基础模型层向具身层延伸，在不改变v1评估架构的前提下，提供了从基准执行到真实机器人证据再到修复导向诊断的完整实证连续性，弥合了仿真与物理执行之间的评估断层，使技术栈中部署风险最高的部分获得了可量化、可归因、可修复的评估支撑。

title: When Tool-Backed Skill Retrieval Fails: Source-Style Collapse in Executable Capability Retrieval
summary: Large-scale agents increasingly rely on retrieval to access external capabilities. We study this retrieval gate in structured tools and APIs, a measurable class of tool-backed executable skills that must be surfaced before an agent can plan, incorporate, or act. In this setting the retrieval layer can silently fail even when the capability corpus is fixed: on ToolRet, a retriever fine-tuned on one source-specific slice collapses on another source-specific slice of the same benchmark, with FT-1100 despite its higher lexical overlap with the gold tools. We call this failure mode source-style collapse. Query-side TF-IDF fingerprints flag source styles on which the fine-tuned retriever is likely to fail better than semantic or length-based proxies, giving a cheap signal for mismatch over a fixed tool corpus. We propose ToolScout, a source-aware routing method that uses this signal as a routing guard: on the mixed 4,996-query stream, TF-IDF-based routing raises coverage from 22.3% to 86.1%, and across five collapsed sources 20 matched examples raise the coverage-weighted global top-1 proxy from 1.3% to 53.9%. The same failure and routing behaviors persist when tools are rerendered as executable skill cards, which rules out raw API-schema format as the sole cause.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大规模智能体中工具/API检索层的"源风格崩溃"失败模式：检索器在某个数据源上微调后，在相同基准的另一数据源切片上性能骤降。作者提出TF-IDF查询指纹作为廉价信号来检测不匹配，并设计了源感知路由方法ToolScout，将4,996条混合查询流的覆盖率从22.3%提升到86.1%，加权全局top-1指标从1.3%提升到53.9%。
AI.motivation: 大规模智能体依赖检索来获取外部工具和API能力，但检索层可能在不改变工具语料库的情况下静默失败。现有研究缺乏对结构化工具/API检索中这类失败模式的系统理解和应对机制。
AI.method: 1) 通过ToolRet基准揭示"源风格崩溃"失败模式——在同一基准的不同源切片上，微调检索器性能骤降；2) 提出查询侧TF-IDF指纹作为检测源风格不匹配的廉价信号，优于语义或长度代理指标；3) 提出ToolScout源感知路由方法，利用TF-IDF信号作为路由防护；4) 验证了将工具重渲染为可执行技能卡后失败和路由行为仍然存在，排除原始API schema格式为唯一原因。
AI.result: 在4,996条混合查询流上，TF-IDF路由将覆盖率从22.3%提升到86.1%；在五个崩溃源上，仅需20个匹配示例即可将覆盖率加权的全局top-1代理指标从1.3%提升到53.9%。工具重新渲染为技能卡后，失败和路由行为保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 工具检索层存在与数据源风格相关的系统性失败模式，可通过TF-IDF等廉价查询侧信号进行检测和路由缓解。该发现验证了源感知路由在固定工具语料库场景下的有效性，并表明问题根源超越API schema格式层面。

title: Automatic Cephalometric Landmark Localization on CBCT-Derived Digitally Reconstructed Radiographs for Skeletal Malocclusion Classification
comment: Accepted for presentation at the ODIN 2026 Workshop, held in conjunction with MICCAI 2026
summary: Manual cephalometric landmark annotation is important for craniofacial assessment but is labor-intensive and difficult to scale. We introduce CephViT, a Vision Transformer-based model for automated 2D lateral cephalometric landmark localization, and evaluate its use in downstream skeletal malocclusion classification. CephViT was trained and benchmarked on a public lateral cephalogram dataset, achieving a mean radial error of 1.28 +/- 1.42 mm and a successful detection rate of 92.0% at 3.0 mm. Because the private evaluation cohort consisted of 3D CBCT scans, lateral cephalogram-like digitally reconstructed radiographs (DRRs) were generated from each volume and used as 2D inputs to the landmark localization model. Landmark coordinates were normalized into a common coordinate frame, and skeletal malocclusion classification was performed using landmarks shared between the reference and DRR-based pipelines. Classification performance using DRR-localized landmarks was comparable to that obtained using manually annotated reference landmarks, with accuracies of 70.0% and 68.3%, respectively. These results support the feasibility of automated cephalometric analysis on CBCT-derived DRRs for skeletal malocclusion assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CephViT，一种基于Vision Transformer的二维侧位头影测量标志点自动定位模型，并在公开数据集上实现了1.28±1.42 mm的平均径向误差和92.0%的成功检测率（3.0 mm阈值）。通过对CBCT扫描生成数字重建放射影像（DRRs）作为输入，CephViT在下游骨骼性错颌分类任务中取得了与人工标注相当的准确率（70.0% vs 68.3%），验证了基于CBCT派生DRRs的自动化头影测量分析可行性。
AI.motivation: 手动侧位头影测量标志点标注对颅面评估至关重要，但劳动密集且难以规模化。现有方法缺乏针对标志点定位及下游临床任务（如骨骼性错颌分类）的自动化评估，需要一种高效且可扩展的方案。
AI.method: 采用Vision Transformer架构构建CephViT模型，在公开侧位头影数据集上训练与基准测试。由于私有评估队列为3D CBCT扫描，研究者从每个体积生成侧位头影样式的DRRs作为2D输入；标志点坐标归一化到公共坐标系，并使用参考流程与DRR流程共享的标志点进行骨骼性错颌分类。
AI.result: CephViT在公开数据集上平均径向误差为1.28±1.42 mm，3.0 mm阈值下成功检测率达92.0%。在私有DRR队列上，DRR定位标志点与人工参考标志点分类准确率分别为70.0%和68.3%，性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明基于CBCT派生DRRs的自动化头影测量分析在骨骼性错颌评估中具有可行性，CephViT可作为临床自动化分析的有效工具。

title: CUBICS: Situation-aware performance estimation for safety-relevant ML components
comment: To be published in the proceedings for the 37th International Symposium on Software Reliability Engineering (ISSRE 2026)
summary: Machine learning (ML) is a key technology driving innovation today, but ensuring ML safety remains a major challenge for safety-related applications. A promising idea is to build proven-in-use arguments from field data, e.g. by running ML components (MLCs) in shadow mode or within safety envelopes so that their outputs can be monitored as 'safe probes' without affecting safety. These probes can then be used to build a statistical argument about field performance in a Bayesian way. However, many Bayesian field-data approaches in safety engineering model failures as a simple Bernoulli (or binomial) process with a single global failure probability and i.i.d. trials, which is rarely adequate for MLCs whose performance depends strongly on context. Statistical evidence is also about coverage of relevant situations, including edge cases, and building a single integrated statistical model for the entire system is usually not feasible. To address these challenges, this paper introduces CUBICS, a context-modular framework for per-component, situation-aware performance estimation of safety-relevant ML components. CUBICS partitions the operational design domain into situations and, for each safety-relevant component, defines a set of situation-specific assumptions and probabilistic guarantees that are represented and updated in a Bayesian manner using Subjective Logic (SL). By combining these guarantees with beliefs about how often each situation occurs, CUBICS derives an overall risk estimate for each component without requiring a monolithic system-level statistical model, and thus provides a building block for modular, field-data based safety assurance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CUBICS框架，一种面向安全相关机器学习组件的上下文模块化性能估计方法。CUBICS将运行设计域划分为情景，利用主观逻辑以贝叶斯方式表示和更新每个组件的情景特定假设与概率保证，并结合情景发生频率信念推导组件级整体风险估计，避免构建单一集成系统统计模型的不可行性。
AI.motivation: 机器学习安全性对安全关键应用至关重要，基于现场数据构建proven-in-use论证是有前途的方向（如影子模式或安全包中的应用）。但现有贝叶斯现场数据方法通常将失效建模为单一全局失效概率的伯努利/二项过程，忽略MLC性能对上下文的强依赖性；统计证据还须覆盖相关情景（含边缘情况），且构建整个系统的单一集成统计模型通常不可行。
AI.method: CUBICS框架将运行设计域(ODD)划分为不同情景；对每个安全相关组件定义一组情景特定的假设和概率保证；使用主观逻辑(Subjective Logic)以贝叶斯方式表示和更新这些保证；结合各情景发生频率的信念，为每个组件推导整体风险估计，而非构建系统级整体统计模型。
AI.result: CUBICS无需单一系统级统计模型即可为每个组件提供整体风险估计，实现了模块化的、基于现场数据的安全保证构建块，避免了传统伯努利模型的过度简化。
AI.conclusion: CUBICS为安全相关ML组件提供了一种模块化、情景感知的现场数据驱动性能估计方法，可作为模块化、基于现场数据的安全保证的基础组件。

title: One Residual with Three Reuses: A Wristband Front End for Gesture Sensing
comment: 3 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Design study: results are from four public corpora; measured silicon power and on-body capture are out of scope and deferred to follow-on hardware work
summary: Continuous wrist-worn hand sensing for gesture interfaces and motor symptom monitoring needs an always-on front end that fits inside a coin-cell power budget while pairing a micro-electro-mechanical-systems (MEMS) inertial measurement unit (IMU) with a 60 GHz frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) radar to stay robust under occlusion and on-body drift. We present a design study of such a wristband front end in which classifier wake-up gating, mmWave versus IMU routing, and innovation-based EKF measurement reweighting share a single on-chip residual generator. The shared generator occupies 14.4 KB of program memory and 278 B of state and runs at 110K multiply-accumulates (MACs) per frame on an Ambiq Apollo4 Blue Plus class edge microcontroller unit (MCU). Across four public sensor data corpora (IPN Hand, SHREC 2021, MiliPoint 60 GHz FMCW radar, EAT-Radar) the front end reaches detection probability $P_D = 0.72/0.80$ at a 1% false-alarm rate, sustains a 47% classifier invocation energy reduction at 90% gesture detection recall, and lowers pose tracking root-mean-square error by $4.6\times$ under measurement bias drift relative to an adaptive Kalman with $R$-inflation baseline. Measured silicon power and on-body capture are deferred to follow-on hardware; the contribution here is a design study.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种腕戴式传感前端的设计研究，将IMU与60GHz FMCW雷达配对，通过一个共享的片上残差生成器同时实现分类器唤醒门控、毫米波与IMU路由选择以及基于新息的EKF测量重加权，以适应硬币电池供电预算并保证遮挡和漂移下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 连续腕戴式手势界面和运动症状监测需要一个始终在线的传感前端，该前端必须在硬币电池功耗预算内工作，同时将MEMS IMU与60GHz FMCW雷达配对，以在遮挡和身体漂移条件下保持鲁棒性。传统方案难以同时满足低功耗、多模态融合和鲁棒性需求。
AI.method: 采用设计研究方法，将三项核心功能（分类器唤醒门控、mmWave与IMU的路由选择、基于新息的EKF测量重加权）统一整合到单个片上残差生成器中。该生成器占用14.4KB程序存储器和278B状态，在Ambiq Apollo4 Blue Plus级边缘MCU上以每帧110K次乘累加运行。通过共享的残差生成器实现多模态传感协同与高效的资源利用。
AI.result: 在四个公开数据集（IPN Hand、SHREC 2021、MiliPoint 60GHz FMCW雷达、EAT-Radar）上，该前端在1%误报率下达到P_D=0.72/0.80的检测概率；在90%手势检测召回率下实现47%的分类器调用能耗降低；相比自适应Kalman的R-inflation基线，在测量偏置漂移下将姿态跟踪均方根误差降低4.6倍。硅基功耗测量和实测腕部数据采集留待后续硬件工作。
AI.conclusion: 该设计研究表明，通过共享残差生成器架构可以有效整合多模态传感前端的关键功能，在满足边缘MCU有限资源约束的同时提升检测性能、降低能耗并增强对漂移的鲁棒性。作为设计研究，其贡献在于架构与算法的协同设计，而非具体的硅片或实测数据验证。

title: Probabilistic Circuits as Reasoning Machines in Artificial Intelligence (Part I)
summary:
This cumulative habilitation thesis studies probabilistic circuits (PCs) as a powerful and tractable framework for reasoning and learning under uncertainty in artificial intelligence (AI). It first advocates for probability as a core language for AI, emphasizing its connections to logic and information theory; the conceptual simplicity of probabilistic reasoning---based primarily on the sum and product rules; the parallels between probabilistic inference and human cognition; and the role of probability in optimal decision making. However, probability also faces significant computational challenges, as probabilistic inference is NP-hard in almost all probabilistic models. PCs address these challenges through structural constraints that ensure exact computation of a wide range of inference queries in polynomial time, such as marginals, conditionals, most probable explanations, expectations, and more advanced inference tasks. This thesis synthesizes a decade of research across foundations, algorithmic developments, and empirical validation of PCs. Key contributions highlighted in this work are foundational theory of PCs, Bayesian approaches for learning PCs, scalable implementations and integration with deep learning, hybrid models that combine PCs with intractable models, and connections with symbolic machine learning paradigms.
  This is the first part of my Habilitation Thesis. The second part is omitted, as it comprises the cumulative part of the thesis and has been published at various venues (see Chapter 5).

AI.tldr: 该论文是作者的教授资格论文（Habilitation Thesis）第一部分，系统总结了概率电路（Probabilistic Circuits, PCs）作为AI中不确定性推理与学习的可处理框架的研究成果，涵盖十年间在理论基础、算法开发与实证验证方面的工作。
AI.motivation: 概率推理在AI中具有核心地位（与逻辑、信息论相关，概念简洁，与认知科学一致，且支撑最优决策），但几乎在所有概率模型中，概率推断都是NP-hard问题，计算上具有根本性困难。因此需要一种结构化的模型家族，在保持表达力的同时确保推理的可处理性。
AI.method: 通过结构性约束设计概率电路，使得边际、条件、最大可能解释、期望等各类推理查询都能在多项式时间内精确计算。论文综合了PCs的基础理论、贝叶斯学习方法、可扩展实现与深度学习集成、与不可处理模型的混合架构，以及与符号机器学习范式的连接。
AI.result: 总结了在概率电路领域十年的系统性研究成果，涵盖基础理论、算法发展（贝叶斯学习、可扩展实现）、与深度学习的集成、混合模型构建以及与符号机器学习的交叉融合。
AI.conclusion: 概率电路通过结构化约束成功解决了概率推理的计算瓶颈，为AI中的不确定性推理与学习提供了一个兼具表达力与可处理性的统一框架，是连接概率论、逻辑与深度学习的桥梁。

title: Learning Generalizable Reconstruction of High-Dimensional Neural Dynamics
summary: Accurate reconstruction of long-duration neural recordings is challenging because local field potentials (LFPs) are high-resolution, multichannel, transient, and variable across subjects. We present PCA-DMD, a scalable operator-theoretic framework that segments LFP recordings into overlapping windows, projects them into a compact PCA space, learns linear Koopman evolution in the latent space, and reconstructs continuous signals through inverse projection and overlap-add aggregation. On 200,000-sample hippocampal recordings, PCA-DMD outperformed Classical DMD, SpDMD, MrDMD, and HODMD, achieving KLD=0.0761 and HD=0.0847. In all-pair cross-subject zero-shot generalization at 300,000 samples, correlations were 0.9504-0.9800, with HD=0.0010-0.0072 and KLD=0.0005-0.0022, without target-subject fine-tuning. Out-of-sample temporal prediction showed close one-step agreement on temporally held-out LFP segments across the unseen interval and multiple channels. Scalability analysis from 400,000 to 900,000 samples showed stable zero-shot reconstruction, with mean correlation remaining about 0.965-0.968 while computational cost increased predictably. External validation on an independent 93-channel Allen Neuropixels recording yielded mean and median channel-wise correlations of 0.7427 and 0.7990, respectively. Koopman spectral and mode analyses revealed dominant eigenvalues concentrated near the unit circle. PCA-DMD therefore provides an interpretable, generalizable, and computationally scalable framework for reconstructing high-dimensional neural dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出PCA-DMD，一种可扩展的算子理论框架，将LFP记录分割为重叠窗口、投影到紧凑的PCA空间、学习潜在空间中的线性Koopman演化，并通过逆投影和重叠相加聚合重建连续信号。在多项指标上优于现有DMD变体，展现出跨受试者零样本泛化能力和计算可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 长时程神经记录的重建面临挑战，因为局部场电位（LFP）具有高分辨率、多通道、瞬变性和跨受试者差异性。现有方法（如Classical DMD、SpDMD、MrDMD、HODMD）在准确性或可扩展性上存在不足，需要一种既能准确重建又能跨受试者泛化的可扩展框架。
AI.method: PCA-DMD框架包含四个关键步骤：(1) 将LFP记录分割为重叠窗口；(2) 投影到紧凑的PCA空间以降低维度；(3) 在潜在空间中学习线性Koopman演化算子；(4) 通过逆投影和重叠相加聚合重建连续信号。该框架结合了PCA的降维能力和Koopman算子理论的线性动力系统建模优势。
AI.result: 在200,000样本的海马体记录上，PCA-DMD优于Classical DMD、SpDMD、MrDMD和HODMD，达到KLD=0.0761和HD=0.0847。在300,000样本的全对跨受试者零样本泛化测试中，相关性为0.9504-0.9800。外部验证在93通道Allen Neuropixels记录上获得平均通道相关性0.7427。从400,000到900,000样本的可扩展性分析显示平均相关性稳定在0.965-0.968。Koopman谱分析显示主特征值集中在单位圆附近。
AI.conclusion: PCA-DMD提供了一个可解释、可泛化且计算可扩展的框架，用于重建高维神经动力学。它在准确性、跨受试者零样本泛化能力和计算可扩展性方面均表现出色，并具有可解释的Koopman谱结构。

title: SQuad: Sub-Quadratic Attention Distillation for Efficient Video Generation
summary: Video Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) spend most of their compute inside the Self-Attention operation, whose cost grows quadratically, $\mathcal{O}(n^2)$, with the number of latent tokens $n$. For the task of video generation, the token count is large, so this term dominates runtime and memory, and thereby caps the resolution and duration we can generate. Linear $\mathcal{O}(n)$ and low-rank $\mathcal{O}(nk)$ surrogates of Self-Attention trade the full softmax $QK^T$ for cheaper kernels, but rarely recover the original's expressivity, leaving a stubborn quality gap. Motivated by this, we propose SQuad, a Sub-Quadratic Attention Distillation framework that achieves a complexity of $\mathcal{O}(n\sqrt{n})$ in the resulting distilled Attention, naturally balancing the efficiency v/s expressivity trade-off. Instead of training our own Video DiT from scratch, which is prohibitively expensive, we fit a pretrained full softmax Self-Attention DiT into our proposed SQuad-Attention one by distilling the former in two stages: Flow-Matching Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), followed by improved Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD2) which additionally makes the sampling more efficient. On the Wan~2.2 5B text-to-video model, SQuAD matches the quadratic teacher on VBench ($83.20$ v/s $83.08$) while cutting the per-step per-block attention FLOPs by $\sim$$67\times$ and attention latency by $\sim$$11\times$, and end-to-end DiT latency by 2$\times$, all while also generating a video in only $6$ Neural Functional Evaluations (NFEs) instead of the default $100$.

AI.tldr: SQuad提出了一种次二次注意力蒸馏框架，通过将预训练的完整softmax自注意力Video DiT蒸馏为SQuad-Attention版本，实现了O(n√n)的注意力复杂度，在Wan 2.2 5B模型上匹配教师模型的VBench得分（83.20 vs 83.08），同时将每步每块注意力FLOPs降低约67倍，注意力延迟降低约11倍，端到端DiT延迟降低2倍，并将推理步数从100 NFE缩减到仅6 NFE。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散Transformer（DiT）的计算开销主要由自注意力操作主导，其复杂度随token数量n呈二次方增长（O(n²)）。现有的线性O(n)和低秩O(nk)注意力替代方案虽能降低复杂度，但难以恢复原始softmax注意力的表达能力，存在顽固的质量差距。因此需要在效率与表达能力之间找到更好的平衡。
AI.method: 提出SQuad（Sub-Quadratic Attention Distillation）框架，采用两个阶段的蒸馏策略：首先进行Flow-Matching监督微调（SFT），随后使用改进的分布匹配蒸馏（DMD2）进一步提升采样效率。该方法不是从头训练模型，而是将预训练的全softmax自注意力DiT拟合到SQuad-Attention架构中，实现O(n√n)的次二次复杂度。
AI.result: 在Wan 2.2 5B文本到视频模型上，SQuad在VBench指标上与二次复杂度的教师模型持平（83.20 vs 83.08），同时实现约67倍的每步每块注意力FLOPs削减、约11倍的注意力延迟降低以及2倍的端到端DiT延迟降低，推论步数从100 NFE减少到仅6 NFE。
AI.conclusion: SQuad通过蒸馏框架在注意力效率和表达能力之间实现了自然的平衡，在几乎不损失生成质量的前提下大幅降低了视频生成的计算成本和推理延迟，同时通过减少采样步数进一步提升了整体效率。

title: Physics of Agents: Statistical Mechanics Predicts Collective Behavior of AI Agents
summary: AI agents increasingly operate as part of interacting systems rather than in isolation. As agents exchange information and jointly make decisions, their interactions can improve collective reasoning but may also produce herding, polarization, or amplify shared biases. Understanding and predicting these collective dynamics is therefore important for designing effective and aligned multi-agent systems. Here, we study over 10,000 communities of language-model agents that repeatedly exchange messages and revise their opinions across objective mathematics questions and subjective political statements. Despite substantial diversity in possible behavior, the individual and group dynamics can be represented by three characteristic regimes: indifference, polarization, and consensus. AI agents start indifferent and build conviction as they interact. On objective questions, communication improves collective accuracy, while on subjective questions it often drifts group opinions toward the right in the political spectrum. We explain these observations with a statistical-mechanics formalism in which agents stochastically favor lower social pressure. Given only initial opinions, our model predicts individual trajectories, outperforms all standard baselines, generalizes to unseen community graphs, and reproduces the observed group archetype distributions. Our fitted model parameters reveal the mechanics underlying our key observations: i) communities operate below the critical social temperature, which explains conviction buildup; ii) attractive ties outweigh repulsive ones, which favors consensus; and iii) agents holding the correct answer exert the strongest pull, which drives truth-seeking. Overall, our results demonstrate that collective behavior of AI agents, like that of other complex systems, follows compact and predictive dynamical laws.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了超过10,000个语言模型代理社区中的集体动态行为，发现其行为可分为冷漠、极化和共识三种特征状态，并提出一个统计力学模型（代理随机偏好较低社会压力）来预测个体轨迹，该模型超越所有标准基线，能泛化到未见图结构。模型参数揭示了三个关键机制：社区处于临界社会温度以下（导致信念积累）、吸引力联系强于排斥力（有利于共识）、持正确答案的代理影响力最强（驱动求真）。
AI.motivation: AI代理越来越多地在交互系统中运作而非孤立存在，其交互可能改善集体推理，但也可能导致羊群效应、极化或加剧共享偏见。理解并预测这些集体动态对于设计有效且对齐的多代理系统至关重要。
AI.method: 构建超过10,000个语言模型代理社区，让代理在客观数学问题和主观政治陈述上反复交换消息并修订意见。引入统计力学形式主义，模型中代理随机偏好较低社会压力。基于初始意见预测个体轨迹，并拟合模型参数以解释观测到的集体行为模式。
AI.result: 个体和群体动态可用冷漠、极化和共识三种特征状态表示。客观问题上沟通改善集体准确性，主观问题上意见常向政治光谱右端漂移。模型预测个体轨迹超越所有标准基线，泛化到未见图表，并重现观测到的群体原型分布。拟合参数揭示了三个机制：社区在临界社会温度以下运作（信念积累）、吸引性联系主导（利于共识）、正确回答的代理引力最强（求真驱动）。
AI.conclusion: AI代理的集体行为与其他复杂系统一样，遵循紧凑且可预测的动力学定律。通过统计力学框架可以精确刻画多代理社区的集体动态，为设计有效的对齐的多代理系统提供了理论工具和定量基础。

title: Variational Outlier-Robust Gaussian Process Regression with Generative Modeling
summary: Outliers can substantially distort Gaussian process regression (GPR) due to its conventional Gaussian observation likelihood, leading to inaccurate model learning and prediction. To address this limitation, this article introduces a generative GPR model that captures observation-specific contamination and adaptively mitigates the influence of outliers. Subsequently, a variational generalized expectation-maximization procedure is used to learn the latent variables and GPR model parameters. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets under different contamination settings demonstrate that the proposed method remains competitive with-and in several cases outperforms-robust GPR baselines in prediction accuracy. Moreover, the proposed method shares the cubic computational scaling of the compared GPR methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种生成式高斯过程回归（GPR）模型，通过捕捉观测特定的污染信息并自适应减轻异常值的影响，结合变分广义期望最大化算法学习潜在变量和模型参数，在预测精度上与现有鲁棒GPR方法相当或更优，同时保持三次方的计算复杂度。
AI.motivation: 传统GPR采用高斯观测似然，对异常值高度敏感，异常值会显著扭曲模型学习和预测结果，需要一种能够自适应缓解异常值影响的鲁棒GPR方法。
AI.method: 提出一个生成式GPR模型，显式建模观测特定的污染（contamination），从而自适应地减轻异常值的影响；采用变分广义期望最大化（variational generalized expectation-maximization）程序来学习潜在变量和GPR模型参数。
AI.result: 在多种污染设置下的合成数据集和真实数据集实验中，所提方法在预测精度上与鲁棒GPR基线方法相当，且在多种情况下优于这些基线；同时与所比较的GPR方法共享相同的三次方（O(N^3)）计算复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效地增强了GPR对异常值的鲁棒性，在保证计算效率（保持立方缩放）的同时实现了具有竞争力的预测精度，为鲁棒GPR提供了一个有前景的新框架。

title: Ultra: Unsupervised Cross-Task Optimization for Reliable Restoration Segmentation Collaboration under Adverse Weather
summary: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Adverse Weather Semantic Segmentation (UDA-ASS) aims to transfer semantic knowledge from labeled normal-weather images to unlabeled adverse environments. Existing approaches implicitly assume that restoration and segmentation provide mutually beneficial guidance. However, under severe degradation and without target-domain supervision, the validity of cross-task optimization directions becomes fundamentally unidentifiable, leading to hallucination-driven error propagation. In this work, we propose a novel Unsupervised Restoration-Segmentation Collaborative Learning Framework (Ultra), which reframes cross-task interaction as direction selection under uncertainty and causal effect estimation, enabling reliable collaboration through candidate direction generation and intervention-based filtering. In detail, we propose CTDN and CMIL. The former exploits complementary visual structures and semantic information to generate candidate optimization directions and performs cooperative direction selection between restoration and segmentation. The latter reformulates cross-task information transfer from correlation-based propagation into causal effect assessment, suppressing hallucination propagation. Extensive experiments on three widely used UDA-ASS benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art segmentation performance. Beyond segmentation, our framework achieves better unsupervised restoration results than existing UDA-ASS restoration methods and generalizes to unsupervised restoration and object detection collaboration tasks. Code and models will be available at https://github.com/Wang-Shiqin/Ultra.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Ultra框架，针对UDA-ASS任务中的跨任务协同问题，将跨任务交互重构为不确定性下的方向选择和因果效应估计，通过CTDN生成候选优化方向并进行协作选择，通过CMIL将信息传递从相关性传播转变为因果效应评估，在三个基准上取得SOTA分割性能并超越现有恢复方法的无监督恢复结果。
AI.motivation: 现有UDA-ASS方法隐式假设恢复和分割任务能提供相互有益指导，但在严重退化且无目标域监督的情况下，跨任务优化方向的有效性从根本上不可辨识，导致幻觉驱动的错误传播。
AI.method: 提出Ultra框架：(1) CTDN利用互补的视觉结构和语义信息生成候选优化方向，并在恢复与分割之间进行协作方向选择；(2) CMIL将跨任务信息传递从基于相关性的传播重构为因果效应评估，抑制幻觉传播。
AI.result: 在三个广泛使用的UDA-ASS基准上取得最优分割性能；无监督恢复结果优于现有UDA-ASS恢复方法；泛化到无监督恢复与目标检测协作任务。
AI.conclusion: 通过方向选择与因果效应估计的重新设计，Ultra有效解决了UDA-ASS中跨任务协作的不可辨识问题，实现了恢复与分割的可靠协同，并在多种任务上展现良好泛化能力。

title: CACSurv: Concordance-Aligned Comparative Learning with Large Language Models for Cancer Survival Prediction
summary: Cancer survival prediction supports treatment planning, risk stratification, and follow-up management. Existing methods use structured clinical variables, whole-slide images, genomic profiles, or multimodal inputs, while patient reports remain underexplored. We study report-centric survival prediction using reports that organize pathological, clinical, and molecular evidence. Large language models (LLMs) can reason over such reports, but case-wise time regression introduces two mismatches. First, a formulation mismatch arises because survival evaluation depends on ordering comparable patients, whereas independent time predictions do not enforce ranking consistency. Second, a supervision mismatch arises because a censored patient's observed time indicates survival beyond that point and cannot serve as an exact regression target, although it still implies orderings relative to patients who died earlier. To address these mismatches, we propose CACSurv, a Concordance-Aligned Comparative framework for report-centric survival prediction. CACSurv reformulates survival modeling as mini-cohort comparative reasoning, where an LLM predicts relative prognostic orderings. We introduce concordance-aligned rewards derived from comparable relations under right censoring, enabling censored outcomes to provide ranking supervision without exact event-time targets. At inference, Monte Carlo Reference Aggregation compares each patient with sampled references and aggregates positions into a cohort-level ranking. We establish TCGA-SurvReport, a benchmark covering six TCGA cancer cohorts. CACSurv achieves the highest C-index on all six cohorts and an average C-index of 0.722, outperforming the strongest published survival model by 6.5 percentage points and the strongest LLM time-regression baseline by 4.2 percentage points. Our code, models, and dataset will be available at https://github.com/xmed-lab/CACSurv.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CACSurv，一个用于报告为中心的癌症生存预测的Concordance-Aligned Comparative框架。它利用大型语言模型对病理、临床和分子证据组成的患者报告进行推理，将生存建模重新表述为迷你队列比较推理，通过一致性对齐奖励解决公式不匹配和监督不匹配问题。在六个TCGA癌种队列上平均C-index达0.722，全面超越现有最强生存模型和LLM时间回归基线。
AI.motivation: 现有癌症生存预测方法主要关注结构化临床变量、全切片图像、基因组图谱或多模态输入，而患者报告（包含病理、临床和分子证据）尚未被充分探索。此外，LLM在逐个案例上进行时间回归存在两个关键不匹配：一是公式不匹配——生存评估依赖可比患者的排序，而独立时间预测不保证排序一致性；二是监督不匹配——右删失患者的观测时间仅表示存活超过该时间点，不能作为精确回归目标。
AI.method: CACSurv包括三个核心组件：(1) 将生存建模重新表述为迷你队列比较推理，让LLM预测相对预后排序而非绝对时间；(2) 引入一致性对齐奖励，从右删失下的可比关系中派生监督信号，使删失结果无需精确事件时间即可提供排序监督；(3) 在推理阶段采用蒙特卡洛参考聚合，将每个患者与采样参考进行比较并聚合位置形成队列级排序。
AI.result: 作者构建了覆盖六个TCGA癌症队列的TCGA-SurvReport基准。CACSurv在所有六个队列上均取得最高C-Index，平均C-index为0.722，相比最强已发表生存模型高6.5个百分点，相比最强LLM时间回归基线高4.2个百分点。
AI.conclusion: CACSurv验证了报告为中心的生存预测范式的有效性，通过比较推理和一致性对齐奖励，成功解决了LLM应用于生存预测时的公式不匹配和监督不匹配问题，为利用患者报告进行癌症生存预测提供了新思路。代码、模型和数据集将公开。

title: Hoeffding adaptive splitting trees for data stream classification with concept drift and ensemble learning
summary: Ensembles of decision trees are well-established methods for data stream classification. In ensemble learning, Hoeffding Trees are widely adopted as base learners, performing periodic split attempts according to the Hoeffding bound. Recent studies, however, indicate that this standard splitting mechanism lacks adaptability, while adaptive trees that trigger splits in response to performance degradation have achieved superior results. In this paper, we identify limitations in the use of adaptive-splitting decision trees as ensemble base learners, showing that change detectors often fail to promote sufficient diversity within ensembles. To address this issue, we propose two novel decision tree models, termed Hoeffding Adaptive Splitting Trees. These models combine the periodic splitting strategy of Hoeffding Trees, which fosters ensemble diversity, with adaptive splitting mechanisms that employ change detection algorithms to identify performance decay and determine split points. Experimental results demonstrate that Hoeffding Adaptive Splitting Trees enhance ensemble performance and achieve state-of-the-art results across a comprehensive evaluation, including benchmark comparisons, computational cost analysis, and concept drift adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种新型决策树模型（Hoeffding Adaptive Splitting Trees），结合Hoeffding树的周期性分裂策略与自适应分裂机制，解决集成学习中自适应决策树多样性不足的问题，并在基准比较、计算成本分析和概念漂移适应方面达到最先进水平。
AI.motivation: 标准的Hoeffding树分裂机制缺乏适应性，而自适应树虽然在性能下降时触发分裂表现出更优效果，但作为集成基学习器时，变化检测器往往无法促进足够的集成多样性，这是现有方法的局限性。
AI.method: 提出两种基于Hoeffding自适应分裂树的新型决策树模型。该模型将Hoeffding树的周期性分裂策略（用于促进集成多样性）与自适应分裂机制（利用变化检测算法识别性能衰减并确定分裂点）相结合。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提出的Hoeffding自适应分裂树能够提升集成性能，在基准比较、计算成本分析和概念漂移适应性等全面评估中达到最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: 将周期性分裂与自适应分裂相结合的双重策略，既保留了Hoeffding树促进集成多样性的优势，又引入了自适应树对概念漂移的响应能力，为数据流分类集成学习提供了一种更优的基学习器设计。

title: Towards Zero-Shot Domain Generalization for ID Cards Presentation Attack Detection
summary:
Presentation-Attack Detection (PAD) for national ID cards is limited by the lack of publicly available genuine samples, making it difficult for systems to generalize across countries. This paper introduces two main innovations: (1) a Prototypical Network head using an EfficientNet-V2-b0 backbone that requires only four genuine samples per class to create reliable prototypes; and (2) an episodic training regime that keeps PAD classes fixed while varying the card domain, allowing the network to learn universal attack cues.
  Evaluated on a large multi-country dataset and the public DLC-2021 benchmark, this method achieves an average Equal Error Rate of around 9\%, outperforming conventional softmax and CLIP zero-shot baselines even with data from a single source country. This approach provides accurate, privacy-preserving PAD while minimizing data collection, facilitating scalable cross-jurisdictional remote onboarding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向国家ID卡的演示攻击检测（PAD）方法，通过原型网络头（基于EfficientNet-V2-b0）仅需每类4个真实样本即可构建可靠原型，并结合情景训练机制学习通用攻击线索，在DLC-2021基准上实现约9%的平均等错误率，优于softmax和CLIP零样本基线。
AI.motivation: 国家ID卡的演示攻击检测受限于缺乏公开可用的真实样本，导致系统难以在不同国家间泛化。现有方法需要大量真实数据，而真实ID样本的获取涉及隐私和采集成本问题，限制了跨司法管辖区的远程接入场景。
AI.method: 两个核心创新：(1) 原型网络头——采用EfficientNet-V2-b0作为骨干网络，每类仅需4个真实样本即可创建可靠的原型表示；(2) 情景训练机制——保持PAD类别固定而改变卡片域，使网络学习通用的攻击线索而非特定国家的特征。
AI.result: 在大型多国家数据集和公开的DLC-2021基准上进行评估，平均等错误率（EER）约为9%，显著优于传统的softmax基线和CLIP零样本基线，即使在仅使用单一来源国数据的情况下也表现出更优性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法的优势在于：在最小化数据采集的前提下提供准确且隐私保护的PAD能力，仅需极少真实样本即可实现跨国家的泛化，支持可扩展的跨司法管辖区远程接入场景。

title: Cost Scales with Change, Not Corpus Size: Incrementally Maintaining an Evolving Semantic Substrate
comment: 5 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Accepted and presented at the 2026 International Electronics Symposium (IES), Yogyakarta, Indonesia, August 1-3, 2026 (IEEE technically co-sponsored). Authors' accepted version
summary: Retrieval-augmented and agentic question-answering systems increasingly re-derive the meaning of a corpus at query time. Put plainly, instead of re-deriving what a corpus means on every question, the work is done once when a document arrives and is thereafter merely consulted -- a compiler, not an interpreter, of meaning. An alternative is to compile that meaning once, at ingest time, into a compact, queryable semantic substrate and maintain it as the corpus evolves. The central objection is maintenance cost: rebuilding a truncated singular value decomposition (SVD) on every change appears prohibitive, and a change of embedding model seems to force a full re-embedding. We argue and show empirically that maintenance cost scales with the amount of change, not corpus size. On a controlled synthetic pilot (dimension 256, rank 32, a corpus grown from 3,000 to 9,000 documents over 50 update events), incremental low-rank updates were 33.7 times cheaper per update than full re-SVD and 23.8 times cheaper cumulatively, while the incremental subspace tracked the full recomputation to within floating-point precision (maximum principal-angle drift below 1e-11 degrees; recall@10 = 1.0). An orthogonal Procrustes virtual axis update recovered 0.95 mean cosine to truly re-embedded vectors by re-embedding only about 10 percent of the corpus. The results support maintaining, rather than repeatedly reconstructing, a semantic substrate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将语料语义在摄入时一次性"编译"为紧凑的可查询语义基质，并通过增量低秩更新来维护，替代每次查询时重新推导语义的做法。实验表明维护成本与变更量而非语料规模成正比，增量更新比全量重算便宜33.7倍/次、23.8倍累计，且精度可达到浮点级别。
AI.motivation: 检索增强和智能体问答系统在每次查询时都重新推导语料语义，效率低下。作者提出在文档摄入时一次性"编译"语义基质并随语料演化进行维护，但核心质疑是维护成本过高——每次变更都重建SVD或更换嵌入模型都需要全量重嵌入，似乎代价高昂。本文旨在证明成本可控制。
AI.method: 采用"编译器而非解释器"的类比喻：在摄入阶段将语料编译为紧凑可查询的语义基质。通过增量低秩更新（而非全量重建SVD）维护基质；使用正交Procrustes虚拟轴更新来处理嵌入模型更换问题。在合成数据集（维度256、秩32，语料从3000增长至9000文档、50次更新事件）上进行对照实验。
AI.result: 增量低秩更新比全量重SVD每次更新便宜33.7倍，累计便宜23.8倍；增量子空间跟踪全量重算达到浮点精度（最大主角度漂移低于1e-11度，recall@10=1.0）。正交Procrustes虚拟轴更新仅重嵌入约10%语料即恢复0.95平均余弦相似度。
AI.conclusion: 维护语义基质的成本与语料变更量成正比而非语料规模，因此"维护而非反复重建"语义基质是可行且高效的策略。该发现支持从"解释器模式"转向"编译器模式"的语义管理系统设计。

title: GeoPose: Patient-agnostic CTA-to-DSA registration through projection-space calibration
summary: Aligning intraoperative biplanar digital subtraction angiography (DSA) to pre-procedural computed tomography angiography (CTA) requires rapid and accurate 3D-to-2D registration. Optimization-based methods are sensitive to initialization and may require hundreds of iterations, whereas learning-based approaches commonly rely on patient-specific training. We propose GeoPose, a population-trained framework that estimates the C-arm pose in a learned canonical frame and transfers it to the native frame of an unseen CTA through projection-space calibration and transform composition. A population-trained residual network refines the pose, followed optionally by low-budget image-driven optimization. GeoPose requires neither patient-specific adaptation nor explicit inter-volume preregistration. On 80 DSA observations from 20 held-out patients, optimization-free GeoPose achieved a carotid mean projected centerline distance (mPCD) of 5.8 mm and a clDice of 0.45, compared with 14.5 mm and 0.28 for the best-performing baseline, while requiring only 0.15 s. After 25 optimization iterations, GeoPose reached an mPCD of 4.6 mm and a clDice of 0.58 in approximately two seconds. Under the same budget, native-initialized optimization achieved 14.6 mm and 0.15, respectively. GeoPose thus provides rapid native-frame registration with fixed population-level weights and the geometric correspondence required for downstream biplanar 3D vascular reconstruction.

AI.tldr: GeoPose是一个群体训练的框架，用于将术中双平面DSA与术前CTA进行快速准确的3D-to-2D配准。它通过学习规范坐标系中的C臂姿态并迁移到未见CTA的原始坐标系，无需患者特定训练或显式体积间预配准，在0.15秒内即达到优于基线的配准精度，经25次优化迭代后进一步提升。
AI.motivation: 术中双平面数字减影血管造影（DSA）与术前CT血管造影（CTA）的配准（3D-to-2D）需要快速且准确。现有优化方法对初始化敏感且需数百次迭代，而学习方法通常依赖患者特定训练，泛化能力有限。因此需要一种无需患者特定适配且高效的配准方案。
AI.method: 提出GeoPose框架：（1）在学习的规范坐标系中估计C臂姿态，通过投影空间校准和变换组合将其迁移到未见CTA的原始坐标系；（2）使用群体训练的残差网络细化姿态；（3）可选地加入低预算的图像驱动优化。该方法既不需要患者特定适配，也不需要显式的体积间预配准。
AI.result: 在20位留出患者的80个DSA观测上，无优化的GeoPose达到颈动脉平均投影中心线距离（mPCD）5.8mm和clDice 0.45（基线分别为14.5mm和0.28），仅需0.15秒；经25次优化迭代后达到mPCD 4.6mm和clDice 0.58（约2秒），而同预算的原生初始化优化仅为14.6mm和0.15。
AI.conclusion: GeoPose以固定的群体级权重实现快速的原生坐标系配准，无需患者特定训练，并提供了下游双平面3D血管重建所需的几何对应关系，在精度和速度上均显著优于现有基线方法。

title: A Shop Floor Production Scheduling Case based on RFID-supported Smart Factory
summary: Radio frequency identification (RFID) technology has been widely implemented for real-time data collection in manufacturing shop floors, which, in turn, can be used to support dynamic shop floor production planning and scheduling. Within such an environment, uncertainty in operation and production processes collectively contribute to the dynamicity in manufacturing, thereby hampering the scheduling system from achieving maximal utility. To highlight the importance of handling such uncertainty, this paper addresses the problem of dynamic shop floor scheduling for a real-life case smart factory equipped with RFID technology. Feasible production sequence mining and real-time processing rate estimation are conducted on RFID-collected production data to quantify the operation and production uncertainties. A deep reinforcement learning approach based on the RFID data analysis is then presented for shop floor production scheduling. Simulation studies based on real-life case data have demonstrated the feasibility and practicality of the proposed dynamic production scheduling framework. Specifically, it is observed that the proposed framework outperforms existing dispatch methods in terms of minimizing operation makespan, including first in first out (FIFO), last in first out (LIFO) and deep Q network (DQN).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于RFID数据分析和深度强化学习的动态车间生产调度框架，通过挖掘可行生产序列和实时估计加工速率来量化操作与生产不确定性，并在真实智能工厂案例中验证其优于FIFO、LIFO和DQN等调度方法。
AI.motivation: RFID技术在制造车间被广泛用于实时数据采集以支持动态生产计划与调度，但实际操作和生产过程中的不确定性共同导致制造动态性，阻碍调度系统实现最大效用。因此需要一种能够有效处理这些不确定性的动态车间调度方法。
AI.method: 首先对RFID采集的生产数据进行可行生产序列挖掘和实时加工速率估计，以量化操作不确定性和生产不确定性；然后基于RFID数据分析结果提出一种深度强化学习方法来求解车间生产调度问题。
AI.result: 基于真实案例数据的仿真研究证明了所提动态生产调度框架的可行性和实用性，该框架在最小化完工时间（makespan）方面优于FIFO、LIFO和DQN等现有调度方法。
AI.conclusion: 该研究验证了将RFID数据分析和深度强化学习相结合用于动态车间调度的有效性，为不确定性环境下的智能工厂生产调度提供了切实可行的解决方案。

title: Learning to Unlearn: Machine Unlearning via Learning the Unlearning Behaviors
summary:
Various machine unlearning techniques have been developed in response to privacy legislation requirements, enabling individuals to exercise their legal right to have their data $D_f$ removed from a machine learning model. This process is typically accomplished via the use of an unlearning function denoted as $U$. Existing methods focus on designing an intricate $U$ to unlearn $D_f \subset D$ from a previous model $A(D)$, so that the unlearned model performs as closely as possible to the retrained model $A(D \setminus D_f)$. However, these methods often suffer from high computational costs when dealing with massive training data, as the complex structures of $U$ become a bottleneck even for models with fewer parameters.
  Inspired by Learning to Optimize, we introduce the first learning-based model-agnostic approach, Learning-to-UnLearn (L2UL). Our core insight is to shift from manually designing $U$ to learning the unlearning behaviors from a distribution perspective, thereby acquiring a simple and efficient $U$ via learning. Our experimental results demonstrate that the accuracy achieved by L2UL is comparable to that of retraining while exhibiting impressive efficiency, particularly in data-intensive scenarios. Furthermore, we validate the performance and scalability of our method on larger models ResNet.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Learning-to-UnLearn（L2UL），这是首个基于学习而非手工设计的模型无关机器遗忘方法。其核心思想是从分布角度学习遗忘行为，而不是手动设计复杂的遗忘函数U，从而获得简单高效的遗忘过程，在数据密集型场景下性能媲美重训练且效率显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有机器遗忘方法通过手工设计复杂的遗忘函数U来从模型中移除指定数据，但在大规模训练数据场景下，U的复杂结构成为计算瓶颈，导致高昂的计算成本，即使模型参数较少也是如此。
AI.method: 受Learning to Optimize启发，首次提出基于学习的模型无关方法L2UL。核心创新是从手工设计U转向从分布视角学习遗忘行为，通过学习获得一个简单且高效的遗忘函数U，从而实现模型无关的机器遗忘。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，L2UL在准确率上与重训练方法相当，同时在数据密集型场景下展现出显著的计算效率优势。此外，在更大的ResNet模型上验证了其性能与可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: L2UL证明了从学习角度替代手工设计遗忘函数的可行性，为大规模机器遗忘提供了一种简单、高效且模型无关的解决方案，并在大模型上展现出良好的可扩展性。

title: Interactive Whole Slide Images for RL-based Tumour Segmentation
summary: Whole-slide image (WSI) analysis remains computationally challenging due to the extremely large spatial resolution of slides and the sparse distribution of tumour regions. We propose an end-to-end reinforcement learning framework for sequential tumour segmentation directly on WSIs. Instead of treating the slide as a predefined collection of candidate patches, we formulate the WSI itself as a hierarchical multi-resolution environment through which an agent navigates using movement, zooming, and tumour selection actions. The agent jointly processes local observations and a global thumbnail representation within an actor-critic architecture trained using proximal policy optimization (PPO). Experiments on pulmonary adenocarcinoma WSIs demonstrate the feasibility of direct sequential tumour segmentation on full slides, achieving comparable coarse segmentation quality relative to patch-based approaches operating at similar magnification levels, while reducing inference time to a few seconds per slide. We further analyse the impact of environment design and action-space granularity. Our results suggest that modelling WSIs as interactive environments provides a promising direction for RL-based computational pathology

AI.tldr: 提出一种端到端强化学习框架，将WSI建模为分层多分辨率环境，通过智能体导航与分割动作直接在整张全切片图像上实现肿瘤顺序分割，推理时间仅需数秒。
AI.motivation: 全切片图像分析因极高的空间分辨率和肿瘤区域的稀疏分布而面临巨大计算挑战，现有方法通常依赖预定义的候选patch集合，缺乏直接在整张WSI上进行端到端分割的方案。
AI.method: 将WSI构建为分层多分辨率环境，智能体通过移动( movement)、缩放(zoom)和肿瘤选择(tumour selection)三类动作进行导航；采用actor-critic架构联合处理局部观察与全局缩略图表示，并使用近端策略优化(PPO)进行训练。
AI.result: 在肺腺癌WSI上的实验证明了直接在全切片上进行序列肿瘤分割的可行性，在相似放大倍率下实现了与基于patch方法相当的粗分割质量，同时将每张切片的推理时间降至数秒。此外还分析了环境设计与动作空间粒度的影响。
AI.conclusion: 将WSI建模为交互式环境为基于强化学习的计算病理学提供了有前景的方向。

title: Hypergraph-based Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Incremental Refinement
comment: Accepted to the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM 2026)
summary: Modern Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (M-RAG) systems are fundamentally limited by the binary connectivity paradigm of traditional simple graphs, which fails to capture the intricate, high-order correlations among heterogeneous entities, such as the N-ary relationships between a visual chart, its scattered textual descriptions, and underlying numerical data. Furthermore, existing refinement strategies often rely on exhaustive, full-page reconstruction to align cross-modal information, leading to prohibitive computational redundancy and the introduction of contextual noise in long-form document processing. In this paper, we propose Hyper-M2RAG, a novel framework that redefines multimodal document retrieval through High-order Hypergraph Representation Learning. We first formalize the document structure as a Multimodal Hypergraph, utilizing hyperedges as unified semantic containers to encapsulate multi-way associations across text, images, and tables, thereby transcending point-to-point modeling. To mitigate semantic fragmentation caused by physical pagination, we introduce an Anchor-driven Incremental Refinement mechanism. Rather than performing a global sweep, our approach identifies boundary-crossing anchor nodes and reconstructs their local hyper-topology using one-hop neighborhood contexts. This targeted refinement effectively bridges cross-page knowledge gaps with minimal computational footprints. Extensive evaluations on multimodal benchmarking datasets demonstrate that Hyper-M2RAG significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both retrieval precision and generation coherence. Our code is available at https://github.com/ShenAoChen2001/MMHRAG.

AI.tldr: 提出Hyper-M2RAG框架，利用高阶超图表示学习重新定义多模态文档检索，通过超边封装文本、图像和表格之间的多元关联，并结合锚点驱动的增量精化机制，以最小计算代价弥合跨页知识鸿沟，在检索精度和生成连贯性上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统多模态RAG系统受限于简单二元图连接范式，无法捕捉异构实体间的高阶N元关联（如视觉图表、分散文本描述与底层数值数据之间的关系）。同时，现有精化策略依赖全页重建来对齐跨模态信息，导致长文档处理中计算冗余和上下文噪声严重。
AI.method: 1) 将文档结构形式化为多模态超图，用超边作为统一语义容器封装文本、图像和表格间的多路关联，超越点对点建模；2) 提出锚点驱动的增量精化机制（Anchor-driven Incremental Refinement），识别跨页边界锚节点，利用一跳邻域上下文重建局部超拓扑，避免全局扫描，以最小计算足迹弥合跨页知识鸿沟。
AI.result: 在多模态基准数据集上的广泛评估显示，Hyper-M2RAG在检索精度和生成连贯性两方面均显著优于当前最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 高阶超图表示学习与目标化局部精化相结合能有效提升多模态文档RAG系统的检索与生成性能，同时大幅降低计算开销。

title: The Ethical Decision Head: Operationalizing Normative Ethics in Autonomous Vehicles via Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
summary: As autonomous vehicles (AVs) approach Level 4 and Level 5 operational capability [SAE International, 2018], their on- board decision systems must handle not only safety-critical locomotion but also their subsequent moral weight. This paper details the Ethical Decision Head (EDH), a deep re- inforcement learning (RL) framework that encodes ethical reasoning as a differentiable reward signal, enabling a pol- icy gradient agent to learn morally-aligned driving behavior in scenarios whose state representation is aligned with the CARLA simulation environment [Dosovitskiy et al., 2017]. Two normative frameworks are instantiated and evaluated: a Utilitarian framework minimizing total casualties and a Kan- tian framework enforcing course maintenance as a categori- cal imperative. The EDH is trained via Proximal Policy Op- timization (PPO) [Schulman et al., 2017] against a Bradley- Terry reward model [Bradley and Terry, 1952] learned from pairwise human preference annotations over 200 collision- imminent scenarios. Results reveal an asymmetry in the learnability of normative ethical frameworks under human su- pervision. The Kantian condition, which reduces to a con- stant prediction task under the codebook, serves as a pipeline control: it confirms training stability and rules out infrastruc- ture failure as an explanation for the utilitarian result. The Utilitarian agent learned something more unsettling: human raters rewarded self-sacrifice over casualty minimization, and the model learned that preference faithfully. This divergence between what humans prescribe in theory and what they re- ward in practice suggests that RLHF does not learn ethics as philosophers define it, but as humans live it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了伦理决策头（EDH），一个基于深度强化学习的框架，将伦理推理编码为可微分的奖励信号，使用PPO和基于偏好标注的Bradley-Terry奖励模型，在CARLA模拟环境中训练自动驾驶车辆的道德驾驶行为。实验发现功利主义框架下人类评分者实际奖励自我牺牲而非伤亡最小化，揭示了人类在理论上宣称的伦理与实践中奖励的伦理存在显著分歧。
AI.motivation: 随着自动驾驶车辆达到L4/L5级别，其决策系统不仅需要处理安全关键的运动控制，还必须承担随之而来的道德责任。现有研究缺乏将伦理推理系统性地编码到自动驾驶决策框架中的方法，特别是在人类监督下的伦理学习方面存在空白。
AI.method: 提出EDH框架，通过将伦理推理编码为可微分奖励信号，使用PPO训练策略梯度智能体。实例化并评估了两种规范性伦理框架：功利主义框架（最小化总伤亡）和康德主义框架（强制维持车道作为绝对命令）。奖励模型采用从200个碰撞场景的成对人类偏好标注中学习的Bradley-Terry模型。
AI.result: 康德条件简化为恒定预测任务，可作为管线控制以确认训练稳定性并排除基础设施故障。功利主义智能体显示：人类评分者实际奖励自我牺牲而非伤亡最小化，而模型忠实地学习了这种偏好，说明人类在理论上规定的伦理与实际奖励的伦理之间存在不对称性。
AI.conclusion: RLHF（基于人类反馈的强化学习）并不学习哲学家所定义的伦理，而是学习人类实际生活中所展现的伦理。这一发现对自动驾驶的道德对齐具有深远意义。

title: Beyond Accuracy: Assessing Calibration of Geospatial Foundation Models and Their Sensitivity to Distribution Shifts
summary: Geospatial Foundation Models (GeoFMs) are most commonly ranked and selected by accuracy on standard benchmark conditions via averaged ranks. We show that this protocol is too narrow: the promised deployment in critical EO tasks requires further angles of analysis, mainly calibration, the agreement between a model's confidence and its correctness. Across 16 frozen encoders, four classification and five segmentation datasets, and two orthogonal stress axes, every encoder degrades as corruption intensifies, and the ranking changes as well. Across the four classification benchmarks, EO-pretrained and ImageNet-pretrained encoders are indistinguishable on clean accuracy and clean calibration, and EO pretraining provides no more stability under shift than ImageNet pretraining. Under shift the GeoFMs drift further into overconfidence than the ImageNet-pretrained encoders, at every grade and in every corruption family. A centered kernel alignment (CKA) analysis ties this to representational rigidity: EO-pretrained embeddings move less under corruption while losing just as much task information and remaining overconfident. We apply three commonly explored uncertainty quantification methods and find that temperature scaling and deep ensembles cannot counteract the degradation, while a Gaussian-process probe roughly halves ECE under severe cloud only by tripling it on clean data. In selective prediction experiments, we find that confidence-based abstention cannot defer around confidently wrong predictions, and advocate that benchmark rankings and evaluations should therefore operate across a multitude of conditions and metrics to more holistically evaluate model development progress and close the gap to real world deployment scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地指出，地理空间基础模型（GeoFMs）仅凭标准基准上的平均准确率排名进行选择过于狭隘，遗漏了校准（模型置信度与正确性的一致性）这一关键维度。实验发现，在16个冻结编码器、4个分类和5个分割数据集以及两个应力轴上，所有编码器在腐蚀增强时性能退化且排名变化；EO预训练与ImageNet预训练在干净数据上无显著差异，但在分布偏移下GeoFMs更易过度自信；温度缩放和深度集成无法抵消退化，高斯过程探针虽在严重云覆盖下将ECE减半却使干净数据ECE翻三倍；置信度弃权无法规避自信错误。因此，基准评估应跨多条件多指标进行。
AI.motivation: 当前GeoFMs的排名与选择几乎完全依赖于标准基准条件下的平均准确率，这一协议过于狭窄。由于GeoFMs承诺部署于关键对地观测（EO）任务中，若缺乏对模型置信度与正确性一致性的考量（即校准），模型在实际部署中的可靠性和安全性无法得到保证，因此需要补充多维度的分析视角。
AI.method: 作者设计了系统性实验：涵盖16个冻结编码器、4个分类数据集和5个分割数据集，引入两个正交的压力轴（腐蚀类型与强度）；对比EO预训练与ImageNet预训练编码器在干净准确率、干净校准和分布偏移下的表现；使用CKA分析表征刚性；应用三种不确定性量化方法（温度缩放、深度集成、高斯过程探针）检验其缓解能力；并进行选择性预测实验评估置信度弃权策略。
AI.result: 1) 所有编码器随腐蚀增强而退化，且排名发生变化；2) EO预训练与ImageNet预训练在干净准确率和校准上无显著差异，EO预训练在偏移稳定性上并无优势；3) 偏移下GeoFMs比ImageNet预训练编码器更易过度自信；4) CKA显示EO预训练嵌入在腐蚀下移动更少但丢失同等任务信息且保持过度自信（表征刚性）；5) 温度缩放和深度集成无法抵消退化，高斯过程探针仅在严重云覆盖下将ECE减半但使干净数据ECE翻三倍；6) 置信度弃权无法规避自信错误的预测。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭平均准确率排名的基准协议不足以评估GeoFMs的部署就绪性。作者倡导基准评估应跨多种条件与多种指标综合进行，以更全面地衡量模型开发进展，弥合与真实世界部署场景之间的差距。

title: PDDLCoder: Agentic PDDL Generation for LLM-Assisted Symbolic Planning
summary: LLMs remain unreliable for long-horizon planning, often generating logically inconsistent or non-applicable plans. Recent hybrid methods instead translate natural language into the Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL), allowing symbolic planners to produce verifiable plans. However, existing methods frequently rely on rigid generation pipelines, a partial PDDL definition, or human feedback. Furthermore, their evaluation is hindered by the lack of standardized benchmarks with automated verification. To address these limitations, we present PDDLCoder, an agentic framework for PDDL generation from natural language that iteratively generates, analyzes, and refines planning specifications. We further introduce NL-pddlgym, a benchmark dataset comprising 711 planning problems across 23 domains with executable gym environments for the automated verification of plan applicability. Experiments on the NL-pddlgym test set containing 106 problems across 4 held-out domains show that PDDLCoder generates applicable plans for 89.6\% of tested planning problems. This improves upon our adaptations of previous PDDL generation methods, which achieved up to 45.3\%, and outperforms direct LLM planning approaches, which reached up to 74.5\% on the same test set. Our work demonstrates the effectiveness of agentic PDDL generation for planning and establishes a reproducible benchmark for future research on LLM-assisted symbolic planning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PDDLCoder，一个基于智能体框架的自然语言到PDDL生成方法，通过迭代生成、分析和精炼规划规范来解决LLM在长时程规划中不可靠的问题；同时引入NL-pddlgym基准数据集（23个领域711个规划问题），在4个留出领域的106个问题上达到89.6%的可应用计划生成率，远超基线方法。
AI.motivation: LLM在长时程规划中生成的计划常缺乏逻辑一致性或不可执行。现有混合方法（将自然语言翻译为PDDL后交给符号规划器）存在依赖刚性生成流程、部分PDDL定义或人类反馈等问题，且缺乏标准化基准和自动化验证手段，阻碍了公平评估与方法改进。
AI.method: 提出PDDLCoder智能体框架，通过迭代生成-分析-精炼的循环过程从自然语言生成PDDL规划规范；同时构建NL-pddlgym基准数据集，包含23个领域711个规划问题，并配备可执行的gym环境以支持计划适用性的自动化验证。
AI.result: 在NL-pddlgym测试集（4个留出领域、106个问题）上，PDDLCoder生成可应用计划的成功率高达89.6%，显著优于改编的先前PDDL生成方法（最高45.3%）和直接LLM规划方法（最高74.5%）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了智能体化PDDL生成在规划任务上的有效性，并为LLM辅助符号规划的未来研究提供了可复现的基准数据集。

title: Le Critique: Privileged Value Functions for LLM Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning algorithms for Large Language Models (LLMs) are largely distinguished by their variance reduction strategy. Group-relative methods like GRPO reduce gradient variance by sampling multiple rollouts per prompt, but provide only sequence-level credit. Training is also blocked by straggler rollouts, reducing throughput and increasing off-policyness. Learned value functions theoretically address both problems, providing token-level advantages without requiring large groups. However, additional infrastructure engineering challenges combined with the practical success of critic-free methods have made it difficult to justify their inclusion in RL pipelines. We propose two complementary strategies to improve the performance of value function RL: 1) Privileged Value Functions (PVF) which provide an elegant mechanism to inject additional task-relevant token-level signal without biasing the policy objective; 2) TETHER, a baseline that adaptively interpolates between group-relative and value baselines depending on the value function accuracy. Across several reasoning tasks, both strategies consistently improve over the standard value function baseline, and are competitive with or outperform mean-baseline GRPO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种互补策略来提升值函数强化学习在LLM中的应用效果：特权值函数（PVF）通过注入任务相关的token级信号而不引入策略偏差；TETHER基线根据值函数精度自适应地在组相对基线和值基线之间插值。实验表明两种策略均优于标准值函数基线，并与均值基线GRPO相当或更优。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的强化学习算法主要依赖方差缩减策略。GRPO等组相对方法通过每提示采样多条轨迹降低梯度方差，但仅提供序列级信用分配，且被慢速轨迹阻塞训练，降低吞吐量并增加off-policy程度。学习值函数理论上可解决这两个问题（提供token级优势且不需大组），但因额外基础设施工程挑战以及无批评家方法的实际成功，其价值难以被证明。
AI.method: 提出两种策略：1) 特权值函数（Privileged Value Functions, PVF）——通过优雅机制注入额外任务相关的token级信号，且不引入策略目标偏差；2) TETHER——一种根据值函数准确度自适应地在组相对基线与值基线之间进行插值的基线方法。
AI.result: 在多个推理任务上，两种策略一致优于标准值函数基线，并与均值基线GRPO具有竞争力或表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 通过PVF注入任务相关token级信号和TETHER自适应基线插值，可以有效解决值函数RL在LLM中的应用瓶颈，使其成为GRPO等组相对方法的可行且具有竞争力的替代方案。

title: HarmTrace: Anchor-Calibrated Decoupled Optimization for Fine-Grained Target Identification in Harmful Memes
summary: Multimodal harmful meme detection is typically formulated as image--text harmfulness classification. A model may correctly predict harmfulness while misidentifying the attacked target or its supporting evidence. We therefore extend harmful meme detection with fine-grained target identification, asking what type of target is attacked, who is targeted, and where the target appears in the meme. The model predicts harmfulness for every meme and, for harmful memes, outputs the target category, target entity, textual mention, and visual region. To support this task, we introduce Meme3W, which unifies multiple public harmful meme datasets and provides human-verified annotations for harmful instances. We further introduce Joint Record Accuracy (JRA), a strict record-level metric requiring the harmfulness label and all target-identification fields to be jointly correct. Experiments with representative multimodal large language models reveal a substantial gap between harmfulness accuracy and JRA. To narrow this gap, we propose HarmTrace, an anchor-calibrated decoupled optimization framework. HarmTrace strengthens target-entity supervision through entity-aware supervised fine-tuning. It then applies Conditional Target-identification Policy Optimization (CTPO) to decouple harmfulness and target-identification advantages, restricting target-identification optimization to label-correct responses for harmful examples. CTPO uses a Virtual Positive Anchor (VPA) as a fully correct reference for target-identification advantage normalization. HarmTrace improves both JRA and harmfulness accuracy across the evaluated backbones, with JRA on the Qwen3-VL-8B backbone increasing from 17.58\% to 52.51\%. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/llly1234/HarmTrace-for-Harmful-Memes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HarmTrace框架，将多模态有害梗检测扩展为细粒度目标识别任务（识别攻击目标类型、目标实体、文本提及和视觉区域），并引入Meme3W数据集和JRA严格评估指标。HarmTrace通过实体感知监督微调和条件目标识别策略优化（CTPO），在Qwen3-VL-8B骨干上将JRA从17.58%提升至52.51%。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态有害梗检测仅关注图像-文本的"有害/无害"二分类。然而，模型可能正确预测有害性却错误识别攻击目标或其支撑证据，导致检测缺乏可解释性和细粒度。作者希望回答"攻击什么类型的目标、谁被攻击、目标在梗中的什么位置"这些细粒度问题，以增强有害检测的实用性和透明性。
AI.method: (1) 提出Meme3W数据集，统一多个公开有害梗数据集并为有害实例提供人工验证的细粒度标注；(2) 引入JRA（Joint Record Accuracy）严格评估指标，要求有害标签及所有目标识别字段联合正确；(3) 提出HarmTrace框架，由两个阶段组成：实体感知监督微调（entity-aware SFT）强化目标实体监督，以及条件目标识别策略优化（CTPO），通过虚拟正锚点（VPA）解耦有害性与目标识别优势，仅对有害样本的标签正确响应进行目标识别优化。
AI.result: 实验表明，代表性多模态大语言模型在有害性准确率与JRA之间存在显著差距。HarmTrace在不同的骨干网络（包括Qwen3-VL-8B）上同时提升了JRA和有害性准确率，其中Qwen3-VL-8B骨干的JRA从17.58%提升至52.51%。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度目标识别是多模态有害检测中一个重要的补充维度，JRA揭露出当前MLLM在联合识别上的严重不足；HarmTrace通过解耦优化策略有效弥合了有害性分类与细粒度目标识别之间的差距，代码已开源。

title: Would this change your answer? Evaluating Explanations of LLM Behavior In The Wild with Counterfactual Experiments
summary: Many areas of AI research, such as language model interpretability and chain of thought faithfulness, seek to explain model behaviors. But what constitutes a "good" explanation? In this work, we evaluate explanations through the lens of counterfactual simulatability-whether the explanation is useful for predicting model behaviors on related counterfactual inputs. To this end, we introduce CHIVE (Counterfactual Hypothesis Investigation Via Edits), a novel agentic pipeline that identifies unexpected model behaviors in the wild and investigates them with counterfactual prompt edits. This yields thousands of high-quality explanations for naturally-occurring model behaviors along with supporting counterfactual evidence. We apply CHIVE in two ways. First, we evaluate whether common LLM interpretability techniques improve an agent's ability to predict counterfactual model behaviors. Surprisingly, we find no uplift from any of the interpretability techniques studied. Second, we use CHIVE to generate training data. We find that training models to predict outcomes of CHIVE-generated counterfactual experiments generalizes to various out-of-distribution settings. Overall, CHIVE automatically discovers explanations of naturally-occurring LLM behaviors, enabling us to evaluate and improve methods for explaining LLM behaviors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CHIVE（反事实假设编辑调查）框架，通过agentic流水线自动发现并解释LLM在自然场景中的意外行为，以反事实可模拟性作为评估解释质量的标准。应用发现：常见可解释性技术并未提升预测反事实行为的能力，但用CHIVE生成的数据训练模型可泛化到分布外场景。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释性研究缺乏对"好解释"的明确定义，无法系统地评估解释方法是否真正有助于理解模型行为。作者提出以反事实可模拟性作为解释质量的衡量标准，并构建自动化流水线来发现和解释现实中的模型行为。
AI.method: 引入CHIVE，一种agentic流水线，通过三步工作：1）在野外自动识别意外模型行为；2）生成反事实提示编辑来假设性解释这些行为；3）产生大量高质量解释及其配套反事实证据。该框架被用于两个目标：评估不同可解释性技术对预测反事实行为的能力提升，以及生成训练数据来提升模型预测反事实实验结果的能力。
AI.result: 1）所有被研究的常见LLM可解释性技术（包括语言模型可解释性和思维链忠实性相关方法）均未提升agent预测反事实模型行为的能力；2）使用CHIVE生成的反事实实验数据训练模型，能够泛化到多种分布外设置。
AI.conclusion: CHIVE能够自动发现和解释自然发生的LLM行为，为评估和改进可解释性方法提供了新途径。但研究也揭示了现有可解释性技术在提升反事实预测能力方面的局限，提示可解释性研究需要更严格的效果验证。

title: DRAFE: Domain-Robust Asymmetric Fusion of Heterogeneous Detection Transformers for Cross-City Fine-Grained Traffic Object Detection
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Code available at: https://github.com/dyagbobli/VisionOps-Trainer
summary: Deep learning-based object detectors are fundamental to intelligent transportation systems, enabling traffic monitoring, vehicle analytics, and infrastructure management. However, achieving both fine-grained vehicle recognition and robust cross-city domain generalization remains challenging. We present the Domain-Robust Asymmetric Fusion Ensemble (DRAFE), which combines independently trained LW-DETR and RF-DETR detectors for cross-city fine-grained traffic object detection. DRAFE employs a two-stage training strategy that first pretrains complementary detectors on diverse public traffic datasets using pseudo-label expansion and human-in-the-loop annotation refinement, producing a curated corpus of 6,049 images and 203,619 annotations, before challenge-compliant fine-tuning on the Project Hafnia Track 6 dataset. At inference, DRAFE applies anchor-conditioned class-consistent matching, reliability-weighted coordinate fusion, agreement-aware confidence recalibration, and complementary hypothesis recovery. On AI City Challenge 2026 Track 6, DRAFE achieves 0.4022 mAP, ranks sixth among 25 participating teams, and improves by 0.0553 mAP over a preliminary ensemble evaluated under identical benchmark conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DRAFE（域鲁棒非对称融合集成）方法，结合独立训练的LW-DETR和RF-DETR检测器，用于跨城市细粒度交通目标检测。通过两阶段训练（先在大规模公开交通数据集上进行预训练，再在Project Hafnia Track 6数据集上进行挑战赛合规微调），并结合推理时的锚点条件类别一致性匹配、可靠性加权坐标融合、一致性感知置信度重校准和互补假设恢复等策略，在AI City Challenge 2026 Track 6上取得0.4022 mAP，排名第六（共25支队伍），较初始集成提升0.0553 mAP。
AI.motivation: 基于深度学习的物体检测器是智能交通系统的基石，但现有方法难以同时实现细粒度车辆识别和跨城市域泛化。细粒度车辆识别与跨城市域泛化之间的矛盾是核心挑战，作者旨在构建一个能够同时兼顾两者性能的检测框架。
AI.method: DRAFE采用以下核心方法：(1) 两阶段训练策略：先在多样化公开交通数据集上预训练互补型检测器（LW-DETR和RF-DETR），期间使用伪标签扩展和人在环标注精修，构建6,049张图像和203,619个标注的精选数据集；随后在Project Hafnia Track 6数据集上进行挑战赛合规微调。(2) 推理阶段集成策略：锚点条件类别一致性匹配、可靠性加权坐标融合、一致性感知置信度重校准和互补假设恢复四种机制协同工作。
AI.result: 在AI City Challenge 2026 Track 6上，DRAFE取得0.4022 mAP，在25支参赛队伍中排名第六，相比相同基准条件下评估的初始集成方法提升了0.0553 mAP。
AI.conclusion: DRAFE验证了非对称集成策略（结合不同类型检测器）配合精心设计的数据筛选与推理对齐机制，能够有效提升跨城市细粒度交通目标检测的鲁棒性和精度，为智能交通系统中的多域泛化检测提供了可行方案。

title: Chronocooked: A Benchmark for Implicit Interval Timing in Reinforcement Learning Agents
summary: This paper presents Chronocooked, a reinforcement learning (RL) benchmark suite for studying implicit interval timing in RL agents. Inspired by Overcooked, the suite comprises cooking scenarios that require temporal decision making. The tasks and reward functions are designed such that temporal information is unobserved yet critical for optimal performance. The environment is intentionally kept simple to enable controlled experiments and support biologically plausible models. Evaluation metrics are designed to expose limitations in timing abilities of RL agents, and we report baselines using a non-recurrent, a recurrent, and a biologically plausible model. This work ultimately aims to underscore the need to incorporate time perception and temporal processing in artificial agents designed for human robot interaction and deployment in time dependent human societies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Chronocooked，一个基于Overcooked灵感设计的强化学习基准测试套件，用于研究RL智能体中的隐式间隔计时能力。环境保持简洁以便控制实验并支持生物合理模型，评测指标旨在暴露RL智能体在时序能力上的局限。
AI.motivation: 现有RL智能体缺乏时间感知与时间处理能力，这限制了其在人机交互和时间依赖的人类社会场景中的部署。需要一个专门设计的基准来系统研究RL智能体的隐式间隔计时能力。
AI.method: 基于Overcooked灵感设计烹饪场景任务；任务与奖励函数中时间信息不被直接观测但对其最优表现至关重要；环境刻意简化以支持受控实验和生物合理模型；设计了专门的评测指标暴露计时能力缺陷；报告了非循环、循环及生物合理三类基线模型的结果。
AI.result: 提供了使用非循环、循环和生物合理模型的基线结果，用于对比不同架构RL智能体在隐式间隔计时任务中的表现差异。
AI.conclusion: 强调在面向人机交互和部署于时间依赖人类社会的AI智能体中，必须纳入时间感知和时间处理机制。

title: On the Principles Behind Neural Network Optimizers
summary: Reliable optimization is central to neural network (NN) training, yet Adam, the default optimizer for modern LLMs, rests on a fragile foundation. This thesis develops a principled grounding for Adam and motivates new designs. First, we revisit Adam's divergence--convergence debate and show the existence of a problem-dependent phase transition: with properly chosen, batch-size-dependent hyperparameters, Adam converges, whereas under small-$β_2$ regimes it can diverge. Second, we investigate why Adam substantially outperforms SGD on Transformers through Hessian structure. We find that the Hessian evolves toward a near-block-diagonal form along training, accompanied by strong block heterogeneity. We prove that this structure makes Adam's diagonal preconditioner effective. We further show that this special Hessian structure originates from consecutive multiplications of large matrix variables, and we provide a rigorous analysis based on random matrix theory. Finally, these insights motivate Adam-mini, a new optimizer that reduces Adam's memory footprint by 50\% while preserving its performance. Our results also have broader implications beyond Adam: they reveal new local structures in matrix-based nonconvex problems, and also help understand and improve recent NN optimizers, such as Muon.

AI.tldr: 本论文为Adam优化器建立理论基础，揭示了其收敛/发散的条件、在Transformer上优于SGD的原因（Hessian近块对角结构），并据此设计了内存减少50%且性能不变的Adam-mini优化器。
AI.motivation: Adam是现代大语言模型训练中的默认优化器，但其理论基础薄弱。关于Adam发散与收敛的争议悬而未决，且Adam为何在Transformer上显著优于SGD的原因也缺乏理论解释。本文旨在为Adam提供严谨的理论根基，并推动新优化器的设计。
AI.method: 1) 重新审视Adam的收敛-发散悖论，证明存在依赖问题的相变：当超参数随批大小适当调整时Adam收敛，而小β₂区域可导致发散；2) 通过Hessian结构分析，证明训练中Hessian演化为近块对角形式并伴随强块间异质性，从而解释Adam对角预条件器的有效性；3) 利用随机矩阵理论严格分析，证明这种Hessian结构源于大型矩阵变量的连续乘法；4) 基于以上洞见设计Adam-mini优化器，将内存占用减少50%。
AI.result: 建立了Adam收敛与发散之间的相变理论；证明Transformer的Hessian呈现近块对角结构使得Adam的对角预条件有效；基于这些洞见设计了Adam-mini，在保持性能的前提下将内存占用降低50%；此外，研究结果对理解Muon等新型优化器也具有启示意义。
AI.conclusion: 本文为Adam优化器提供了更坚实的理论基础，揭示了问题相关的相变现象和Hessian的局部结构，并以此推动了更高效优化器（Adam-mini）的设计。这些发现同时揭示了基于矩阵的非凸问题中的新局部结构，对理解和改进未来NN优化器具有广泛影响。

title: Training-Free Reconstruction-Based AI-Generated Image Detectors Are Inherently Vulnerable to Adversarial Examples
comment: Accepted at AI4MFDD (AI for Multimedia Forensics & Disinformation Detection) Workshop, ECCV 2026
summary: The impressive visual quality and ubiquity of AI-generated images call for reliable and robust detection methods. Reconstruction-based detectors have emerged as a promising direction for transparent and training-free identification of synthetic images. However, due to their fundamentally different mode of operation (compared to standard, classifier-based methods), little is known about their adversarial robustness. In this work, we propose two novel attack methods targeted at detectors that leverage autoencoder reconstruction error. We find that by constructing imperceptible adversarial examples, the distance between original and reconstruction can be artificially increased, causing fake images to be wrongly classified as real. Our evaluation including images from three state-of-the-art generators and three detectors demonstrates that detection performance is significantly decreased, even if attacked images additionally undergo real-world degradations. Critically, our adversarial examples naturally transfer across detectors, as they all share the same principle, pointing towards an inherent vulnerability of reconstruction-based detectors.

AI.tldr: 本文针对基于重建的AI生成图像检测器，提出了两种新的对抗攻击方法。通过构造不可感知的对抗样本，人为增大原始图像与重建图像之间的距离，使伪造图像被错误分类为真实图像。实验表明，即使在真实世界图像退化条件下，检测性能仍显著下降，且对抗样本可跨检测器迁移，揭示了重建检测器的固有脆弱性。
AI.motivation: AI生成图像的质量和普及度日益提高，需要可靠且鲁棒的检测方法。基于重建的检测器因其透明性和无需训练的特性成为有前景的方向，但其与标准分类器方法的操作模式根本不同，其对抗鲁棒性尚未得到充分研究。
AI.method: 提出两种针对基于自编码器重建误差的检测器的对抗攻击方法。通过构造不可感知的对抗样本，人为增大原始图像与重建图像之间的距离，使伪造图像被误分类为真实图像。评估涵盖三个最先进的图像生成器和三个检测器，并测试了真实世界图像退化条件下的攻击效果。
AI.result: 实验表明，所提出的攻击方法能使检测性能显著下降，即使在攻击图像经历真实世界退化后仍然有效。更重要的是，对抗样本在检测器之间自然迁移，因为所有检测器共享相同的重建原理，这表明重建检测器存在固有脆弱性。
AI.conclusion: 基于重建的AI生成图像检测器存在固有的对抗脆弱性。由于所有重建检测器共享相同的原理，对抗攻击可在不同检测器之间迁移，这一发现指出了该方向检测器的根本性安全隐患，需要进一步研究防御策略。

title: FabriMAE I Trust Myself? Self-Evaluating VLA Action Generation with Markov Attention Entropy
summary: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) integrate visual perception, language instruction, and action generation into end-to-end policies across heterogeneous architectures. However, enabling VLAs to self-evaluate their action generation reliability without external supervision remains a major challenge. Existing methods either rely on expert annotations or estimate uncertainty only from output statistics, largely ignoring internal signals. In this work, we observe that internal visual modality entropy exhibits consistent distinctions between successful and failed tasks across heterogeneous VLAs. Although VLAs' architectures differ in their action generation, we show that they share a common latent action generation abstraction evolving under visual perception, language instruction, and state input, which we formulate as a Conditional Generative Markov Chain. Based on this formulation, we propose MAE (Markov Attention Entropy), a self-evaluation framework that directly converts internal attention signals into architecture-aware reliability scores, and introduce LIBERO-Reflect, a 4,000-episode benchmark combining 2,000 standard episodes and 2,000 challenging episodes across four subsets. Extensive experiments across heterogeneous VLA architectures and diverse scenarios show that MAE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on AUPR, AUROC, and FPR@95. We further instantiate FabriMAE for verifier-free test-time action selection, showing that MAE-guided multiple sampling improves PI-family robustness on LIBERO-Plus with small observed runtime overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAE（马尔可夫注意力熵）框架，通过将异构VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型的内部注意力信号转化为架构感知的可靠性评分，实现无需外部监督的自评估，并引入LIBERO-Reflect基准（4000集）验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型（视觉-语言-动作模型）缺乏自评估能力，无法在无外部监督情况下判断自身动作生成的可靠性。已有方法要么依赖专家标注，要么仅从输出统计估计不确定性，忽略了模型内部信号（如注意力分布）中蕴含的信息。
AI.method: 作者首先观察到异构VLA中内部视觉模态熵在成功与失败任务间具有一致区分性。基于此，他们提出VLA虽架构各异，但共享一个潜在的动作生成抽象（建模为条件生成马尔可夫链）。据此设计MAE框架，将内部注意力信号直接转换为架构感知的可靠性评分；同时构建LIBERO-Reflect基准（含2000标准集+2000挑战集，覆盖四个子集），并实现FabriMAE用于无验证器的测试时动作选择。
AI.result: 在异构VLA架构和多样场景上的大量实验中，MAE在AUPR、AUROC和FPR@95指标上一致优于现有最优基线。FabriMAE通过MAE引导的多重采样在LIBERO-Plus上提升了PI系列模型的鲁棒性，且运行开销很低。
AI.conclusion: MAE证明了VLA模型内部注意力信号可被有效利用进行自评估，且这种能力可跨架构泛化。条件生成马尔可夫链的公式化为理解VLA内部工作机制提供了新视角，MAE引导的测试时采样策略则为无验证器的动作选择提供了实用方案。

title: Beyond $L_2$: Generalizing Abductive Latent Explanations to Diverse Prototype-Based Architectures
summary: Prototype-based neural networks are hailed as interpretable-by-design architectures. Recently, Abductive Latent Explanations (ALE) were introduced to provide formal, mathematically guaranteed explanations that leverage the intrinsic structure of these networks to ensure both predictive safety and human readability. ALEs rely on computing tight bounds on latent space distances to produce formal explanations. However, existing ALE formulations are rigidly confined to Euclidean latent spaces. This leaves a critical gap: modern state-of-the-art architectures increasingly rely on non-Euclidean representations - such as spherical metrics, Gaussian densities, and dimensional projections - rendering current formal explanation methods incompatible. In this work, we generalize the ALE framework to support non-Euclidean prototype architectures. For each geometric variant, we systematically derive how to either map the architecture to existing bounds or construct novel, architecture-specific bounding algorithms. We validate our theoretical constructions by computing subset-minimal formal explanations on fully trained image classifiers. By unifying these diverse models under a single formal framework, we enable the first rigorous, cross-architecture comparison of their interpretability.

AI.tldr: 本文将Abductive Latent Explanations (ALE)框架从欧几里得潜在空间推广到非欧几里得原型网络架构（如球面度量、高斯密度和维度投影），为每种几何变体推导了相应的距离上界算法，并在训练好的图像分类器上验证了子集最小形式解释的可行性，首次实现了跨架构的可解释性严格比较。
AI.motivation: 现有ALE形式解释框架仅适用于欧几里得潜在空间，而现代最先进的原型网络越来越多地采用非欧几里得表示（球形度量、高斯密度、维度投影），导致当前形式化解释方法无法应用于这些架构，存在关键的研究空白。
AI.method: 作者将ALE框架推广到非欧几里得原型架构：针对每种几何变体，系统性地推导两种策略——要么将架构映射到现有界，要么构造新颖的架构特定边界算法。具体而言，为球面度量、高斯密度空间和维度投影分别设计了对应的潜在空间距离紧上界计算方法。
AI.result: 在完全训练的图像分类器上计算了子集最小的形式解释，验证了理论构造的有效性；通过统一这些不同模型于单一形式框架下，实现了首个严格的跨架构可解释性比较。
AI.conclusion: 该工作弥合了非欧几里得原型网络与形式化可解释性之间的鸿沟，使ALE框架能够涵盖现代多样化架构，为跨架构比较模型的内在可解释性提供了统一的数学基础。

title: X$^2$Localizer: Cross-grained Alignment for Progressive Cross-view Video Geo-localization
comment: Accepted to The 37th British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC 2026)
summary: Cross-view Video Geo-localization (CVG) aims to localize ground-view videos by retrieving their corresponding geo-tagged aerial images.
