However, CVG approaches rely on fixed-length inputs and post-hoc refinement, hindering online-oriented localization under partial or dynamic observations. In this work, we formulate Progressive Cross-view Video Geo-localization (PCVG) as a deployment-oriented extension and evaluation protocol of CVG, enabling localization under varying temporal budgets, prefix-based inference, random-start evaluation, and long-range localization with interruptions. To explore PCVG, we introduce X$^2$Localizer, a cross-grained alignment framework that jointly supervises global prefix-to-aerial retrieval and token-aggregated frame--aerial-tile matching with a budget-dependent asymmetric objective. Furthermore, we introduce a Sliding-Window Re-Localization (SWRL) strategy that dynamically refreshes candidate regions for failure recovery and long-range deployment without full-sequence reprocessing. Extensive experiments show that X$^2$Localizer preserves conventional full-video performance, with marginal gains of +0.1 Recall@1 and +0.3 Recall@10, while substantially improving early localization. In the challenging single-frame setting, X$^2$Localizer improves coarse retrieval by +4.7 Recall@1 and +11.5 Recall@10 over the previous state-of-the-art method. With SWRL, our approach further enables robust progressive localization under random-start and long-distance scenarios, narrowing the gap between benchmark evaluation and real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出渐进式跨视角视频地理定位（PCVG）作为一个面向部署的CVG扩展协议，并引入X²Localizer跨粒度对齐框架和滑动窗口重定位（SWRL）策略，在保持完整视频性能的同时显著提升早期定位能力，缩小基准测试与实际部署之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 现有跨视角视频地理定位（CVG）方法依赖固定长度输入和后处理精炼，无法应对部分观测或动态变化场景，阻碍了在线实时定位应用。作者旨在将CVG从离线的完整视频检索范式扩展到支持渐进式、前缀式、随机起点和长距离中断的部署导向定位协议。
AI.method: 提出PCVG形式化定义，涵盖可变时间预算、前缀推理、随机起点评估和长距离中断定位。引入X²Localizer，一个跨粒度对齐框架，联合监督全局前缀-航拍检索和token聚合帧-航拍瓦片匹配，使用预算依赖的非对称目标函数。同时提出滑动窗口重定位（SWRL）策略，动态刷新候选区域以支持失败恢复和长距离部署，无需全序列重处理。
AI.result: X²Localizer在保持传统全视频性能的同时（Recall@1提升+0.1，Recall@10提升+0.3），显著改善早期定位能力。在挑战性的单帧设置下，粗检索Recall@1提升+4.7，Recall@10提升+11.5，超越先前最先进方法。结合SWRL后，支持随机起点和长距离场景下的渐进式定位。
AI.conclusion: 通过PCVG协议和X²Localizer框架，本文成功弥合了CVG基准评估与现实部署之间的差距，验证了渐进式、前缀式定位范式在跨视角视频地理定位中的可行性和有效性。

title: LAVA: Logic-Aware Validation and Augmentation Framework for Large-Scale Financial Document Auditing
summary: Financial document validation in production, such as payroll auditing, tax compliance, and loan underwriting, demands exceptional accuracy, consistency, and reproducibility under strict enterprise constraints. In practice, documents arrive with heterogeneous layouts and formats, semantically rich and context-dependent content, and embedded business rules that current pipelines struggle to process reliably. We introduce LAVA (Logic-Aware Validation and Augmentation), a modular, backbone-agnostic pipeline built on multimodal large language models, that integrates a four-stage design: document-rule retrieval, layout-preserving information extraction, auxiliary metadata enrichment, and auditable symbolic/arithmetic verification. LAVA supports robust rule grounding, fine-grained error attribution, and consistent, traceable end-to-end execution, capabilities essential for high-stakes deployment. Evaluated on a large real-world benchmark with diverse financial documents and dozens of expert-curated validation rules, LAVA outperforms baselines in hallucination control and edge-case handling while maintaining efficient token usage, demonstrating practicality for high-volume, time-critical validation.

AI.tldr: LAVA是一个基于多模态大语言模型的模块化、骨干模型无关的流水线，用于金融文档验证，通过四阶段设计（规则检索、布局保持的信息提取、辅助元数据增强、可审计的符号/算术验证）实现高精度、可溯源且高效的企业级文档验证。
AI.motivation: 金融文档验证（如薪资审计、税务合规、贷款承销）在生产环境中要求极高的准确性、一致性和可复现性，但现实中文档布局异构、内容语义丰富且依赖上下文，同时嵌入业务规则，现有流水线难以可靠处理这些复杂情况。
AI.method: LAVA采用四阶段设计：(1)文档-规则检索（document-rule retrieval），实现规则锚定；(2)布局保持的信息提取（layout-preserving information extraction）；(3)辅助元数据增强（auxiliary metadata enrichment）；(4)可审计的符号/算术验证（auditable symbolic/arithmetic verification）。整体是一个模块化、骨干模型无关的基于多模态大型语言模型的流水线。
AI.result: 在包含多样化金融文档和数十条专家策展验证规则的大规模真实世界基准上，LAVA在幻觉控制和边缘案例处理方面优于基线方法，同时保持高效的token使用，展示了在高吞吐、时间敏感验证场景中的实用性。
AI.conclusion: LAVA具备稳健的规则锚定、细粒度错误归因以及一致、可追踪的端到端执行能力，这些能力对于高风险部署至关重要，为金融文档验证提供了一种可靠且高效的解决方案。

title: GEO-Flag: Detecting and Measuring GEO-Optimized Web Content
summary: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) modifies web content to increase its likelihood of being selected and cited by generative search engines. This can give strategically optimized pages visibility disproportionate to their authority or relevance and even make weak or false information appear well supported. Unlike conventional search, generative search synthesizes information into direct answers rather than presenting competing sources, which can further amplify these risks, as assessing source provenance and authority requires additional user interaction. Despite these concerns, systematic methods for detecting GEO-optimized webpages remain underexplored. We introduce \texttt{GEOFlagBench}, a benchmark of 3,200 webpages spanning 400 queries, four domains, and eight GEO optimizer families, and use it to systematically evaluate existing GEO detection methods. Although the strongest baseline achieves an aggregate F1 of 0.880, method-level and authorship-conditioned evaluations reveal substantial weaknesses and potential reliance on authorship-related shortcuts. We therefore propose \emph{Intervention-Paired Training} (IPT), which supervises detector responses to GEO interventions and non-GEO AI polishing; on ModernBERT, IPT improves F1 from 0.862 to 0.944 and worst-group accuracy from 0.725 to 0.883. We develop a GEO-gated Agent system for auditing the Source Tier and verifiability of Citation URLs in detected GEO pages. Finally, we deploy the complete pipeline on released Google Search and Gemini-grounded retrieval results for 1,000 real-user queries. Across 10,095 available pages, we estimate an overall GEO prevalence of 8.90\%, reaching 16.36\% among pages modified in 2026. Our results establish a foundation for systematically detecting, auditing, and measuring GEO in real-world search ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GEOFlagBench基准（3200个网页、400个查询、4个领域、8种GEO优化器家族），系统评估现有GEO检测方法，并引入干预配对训练（IPT）显著提升检测性能（F1从0.862提升至0.944），最终在10095个真实网页上估计GEO总流行率为8.90%。
AI.motivation: 生成式搜索引擎将信息合成为直接答案而非呈现竞争性来源，导致GEO优化的网页可能获得与其权威性不相称的可见性，甚至使弱信息或虚假信息看起来有充分支持。然而，系统性地检测GEO优化网页的方法仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: （1）构建GEOFlagBench基准，涵盖3200个网页、400个查询、4个领域和8种GEO优化器家族；（2）提出干预配对训练（IPT），对检测器进行GEO干预和非GEO AI润色的配对监督训练；（3）开发GEO门控Agent系统，用于审计检测到的GEO页面中引文URL的来源层级（Source Tier）和可验证性；（4）在Google Search和Gemini检索结果上部署完整流水线。
AI.result: 最强基线在整体F1上达到0.880，但方法级和作者条件评估揭示了显著弱点和对作者相关捷径的潜在依赖；采用IPT的ModernBERT将F1从0.862提升至0.944，最差组准确率从0.725提升至0.883；在10095个可用页面中估计GEO总体流行率为8.90%，其中2026年修改的页面中GEO流行率达16.36%。
AI.conclusion: 本文为真实搜索生态系统中GEO的系统检测、审计和度量建立了基础，表明IPT方法能有效提升GEO检测的鲁棒性，并通过真实部署揭示了GEO在搜索引擎结果中的显著流行率。

title: Turning spectra into images improves plant trait retrieval with 2D-CNNs
comment: 38 pages, 14 figures, 11 tables. Supplementary material appended after the references. v2: adds a per-image vs global scaling ablation, expands the methods, and corrects several figures and captions
summary: Hyperspectral reflectance spectroscopy enables non-destructive estimation of plant functional traits, yet current deep learning approaches process spectra as one-dimensional sequences, which limits how they capture long-range inter-band dependencies. We asked whether transforming 1D spectra into 2D image representations improves multi-trait prediction with convolutional neural networks (CNN). We compared nine transformations using EfficientNet-B0 on the GreenHyperSpectra dataset (7,897 labeled spectra, eight traits, 400-2450 nm), benchmarked against published 1D CNN results on the same split. Trained from scratch, the simplest transformation, a direct Reshape of the spectrum into a 2D grid, performed best ($R^2 = 0.684 \pm 0.001$) and improved on the state-of-the-art 1D baseline ($R^2 = 0.587$, $+0.097$). We then pretrained a 2D masked autoencoder (MAE-2D) on 139,000 unlabeled spectral images. Linear probing, which freezes the encoder and trains only a multilayer perceptron head, reached $R^2 = 0.646$ and exceeded every 1D self-supervised counterpart, including the fine-tuned MAE-1D ($R^2 = 0.641$). Under cross-dataset evaluation all models lost most of their accuracy and none beat the 1D baseline significantly. To identify which wavelengths drive each prediction, we applied Integrated Gradients and Grad-CAM and unfolded band importance back to the spectral axis. Protein ($r = 0.45$) and leaf water ($r = 0.33$) agreed with sensitivities simulated by the PROSAIL radiative-transfer model, while carotenoids ($r = 0.06$) and leaf area index ($r = -0.11$) did not, showing that the model reads established leaf chemistry for traits with sharp absorption features. The representational advantage of 2D spectral images, rather than architectural complexity or ImageNet pretraining, drives the gain over 1D approaches.

AI.tldr: 该研究将一维高光谱反射光谱转化为二维图像表示，使用EfficientNet-B0和二维掩码自编码器（MAE-2D）提高多性状预测精度。最简单的Reshape变换在GreenHyperSpectra数据集上达到R²=0.684，较1D基线显著提升（+0.097）；MAE-2D线性探测达到R²=0.646，超过所有1D自监督方法。跨数据集泛化能力有限，可解释性分析表明模型对具有尖锐吸收特征的性状（如蛋白质、叶含水量）能正确识别关键波长。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习方法将高光谱数据作为一维序列处理，难以捕捉波段间的长程依赖关系。研究者探索将一维光谱转换为二维图像表示，利用CNN在空间特征提取上的优势来改善多性状预测性能。
AI.method: 采用GreenHyperSpectra数据集（7,897个标注光谱，8个性状，400-2450 nm），比较9种光谱到二维图像的变换方法，使用EfficientNet-B0作为骨干网络。在139,000个无标注光谱图像上预训练二维掩码自编码器（MAE-2D），通过线性探测评估表征质量。使用Integrated Gradients和Grad-CAM进行可解释性分析，并与PROSAIL辐射传输模型模拟的敏感性对比。
AI.result: 直接Reshape变换表现最佳（R²=0.684±0.001），较1D SOTA提升0.097。MAE-2D线性探测R²=0.646，超过微调的MAE-1D（R²=0.641）。跨数据集评估中所有模型精度大幅下降。可解释性方面，蛋白质（r=0.45）和叶含水量（r=0.33）与PROSAIL模型一致，而类胡萝卜素（r=0.06）和叶面积指数（r=-0.11）不一致。
AI.conclusion: 二维光谱图像的表征优势（而非架构复杂度或ImageNet预训练）是超越一维方法的关键驱动力。模型能准确识别具有尖锐吸收特征性状的叶化学特征，但二维表示在跨数据集泛化方面仍有局限。

title: GRIP: Grounded Reasoning via Information-Restricted Premises
summary: High-capacity encoders in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can let the query dominate the latent state, leaving retrieved evidence functionally irrelevant. We call this failure mode query dominance. To address it, we introduce \textbf{GRIP} (Grounded Reasoning via Information-Restricted Premises), which imposes capacity asymmetry: the decoder keeps full-dimensional access to the query, while retrieved evidence passes through a severe stochastic bottleneck. This forces the evidence channel to encode only the residual information unavailable from the query. Across five reasoning benchmarks, GRIP outperforms strong iterative baselines, cuts a query--latent mutual-information diagnostic by roughly 30$\times$ (14.8 $\to$ 0.47 bits), and reduces hallucination by 73\%. Residual-alignment analysis further shows that the bottleneck output occupies subspaces less aligned with the query than baseline representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GRIP方法，通过给检索证据施加随机信息瓶颈（stochastic bottleneck），迫使证据通道仅编码查询不可获得的残差信息，从而解决RAG中查询主导隐状态导致检索证据失效的“查询主导”（query dominance）问题。
AI.motivation: 在RAG系统中，高容量编码器可能让查询在潜在状态中占据主导地位，使得检索到的证据在功能上变得无关紧要，即“查询主导”失效模式。这会导致模型忽视检索证据、产生幻觉，需要专门的解决方案。
AI.method: GRIP通过引入容量不对称（capacity asymmetry）来缓解查询主导：解码器保留对查询的全维度访问，而检索到的证据需要经过一个严格的随机瓶颈（severe stochastic bottleneck）。这种设计强制证据通道只能编码查询中不可用的残差信息，从而确保检索证据被有效利用。
AI.result: 在五个推理基准上，GRIP优于强迭代基线；查询-潜在状态互信息诊断从14.8比特降至0.47比特，减少约30倍；幻觉率降低73%。残差对齐分析表明，瓶颈输出的表征与查询的对齐程度低于基线表征。
AI.conclusion: GRIP通过信息受限前提（信息瓶颈）有效遏制了查询对潜在状态的支配，确保检索证据在RAG推理中发挥功能性作用，显著降低幻觉并提升推理性能。

title: CaliBench: Are the Stochastic Dynamics of Video World Models Physically Calibrated?
summary: Video world models approximate the stochastic distribution of physical outcomes through generative sampling, but existing benchmarks score individual generations or compare distributions coarsely over a whole dataset, leaving the fine-grained aleatoric uncertainty of specific phenomena untested. We introduce CaliBench, which scores outcomes in a physically interpretable discrete space - a bin index, a die face, a suit, a colour - rather than a learned feature space such as in FID, so the distance from a known reference distribution is measured directly. We curate outcome spaces whose reference is known in closed form (binomial Galton boards, Bernoulli forks, uniform dice/cards/lottery, a skewed European-roulette colour), enabling an exact calibration test. We decompose performance into two orthogonal axes that a single accuracy metric conflates: scorability, the fraction of generations yielding a scoreable outcome, and calibration, the total variation distance from the reference on that sample. A chi-squared test assesses significance; as calibration is its null hypothesis it can evidence only miscalibration, and at N=32 per cell detects only large deviations. We apply it to nine scenes and six image-to-video models (WAN-2.7, SeeDance-2.0, HappyHorse-1.0, Veo 3.1, Runway Gen-4.5, Cosmos3-Super), 32 generations each. Models consistently concentrate probability mass on a few outcomes rather than reproducing the reference. Most scene-model combinations are significantly miscalibrated, in the extreme collapsing to one outcome, as Veo 3.1 does on dice. On roulette, generations often leave the ball ambiguously placed, giving several models low scorability. Performance varies by scene: no model dominates all nine. We release the protocol and a metric (mean normalised total variation, mnTV) for comparing new models against our results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CaliBench基准，用于在物理可解释的离散空间（如骰子点数、牌面花色等）中评估视频世界模型对随机物理结果的细粒度aleatoric不确定性预测能力，通过精确校准检验揭示模型普遍存在显著性失校准问题。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型基准要么评估单次生成，要么在整数据集上粗略比较分布（如FID），未能测试特定物理现象细粒度的aleatoric不确定性。需要一个在物理可解释空间中直接衡量生成分布与已知参考分布距离的精确校准测试。
AI.method: 设计结果空间（如Galton板二项分布、伯努利分叉、均匀骰子/牌/彩票、偏斜欧洲轮盘颜色），其参考分布为闭式已知解。将性能分解为正交的两个维度：scorability（可评分生成比例）和calibration（与参考分布的总变差距离）。使用卡方检验评估显著性。
AI.result: 对九个场景和六个图像到视频模型（WAN-2.7、SeeDance-2.0、HappyHorse-1.0、Veo 3.1、Runway Gen-4.5、Cosmos3-Super）各32次生成进行评估。模型普遍将概率质量集中于少数结果而非复现参考分布，大多数场景-模型组合显著失校准，极端情况如Veo 3.1在骰子场景塌缩为单一结果。轮盘场景中多个模型因球位置模糊而scorability低。无模型在所有九个场景中占优。
AI.conclusion: 现有视频世界模型在细粒度aleatoric不确定性校准方面存在系统性缺陷；CaliBench提供了一种物理可解释、闭式参考的精确校准评估协议，并发布mnTV指标及流程，供后续模型比较。

title: Concept-based explanation of gene expression prediction from H&E images
summary: Recent advances in pathology foundation models have enabled accurate prediction of spatial transcriptomics (ST) from routine H&E images. However, existing explainability methods for vision transformer (ViT)-based models are largely limited to local heatmaps and do not reveal how morphological concepts contribute to ST predictions. Here, we introduce an explainable framework that combines relevance propagation and concept discovery to link transcriptional programs to tissue morphology. We developed a ViT-based framework for virtual ST from H&E images that combines ViT-aware layer-wise relevance propagation with relaxed archetypal TopK sparse autoencoder-based concept discovery. This approach provides both local explanations and global insights into the morphological patterns associated with transcriptional programs. We applied the framework to colorectal cancer ST data from the HEST-1k cohort and evaluated its generalizability in TCGA COAD. Our architecture accurately predicts clinically relevant ST signatures and accompanying molecular phenotypes. Measured and predicted gene expression profiles reveal substantial spatial heterogeneity of the colorectal cancer subtypes iCMS2 and iCMS3 across a large number of samples. Spatially resolved and aggregated iCMS classification achieve weighted F1 scores of 0.872 and 0.819 (0.770 in TCGA COAD), respectively, and both stratify patient outcome. Beyond prediction, our framework establishes a relevance-based concept atlas linking molecular phenotypes to histopathological representations. Comparison of activation- with relevance-derived concepts demonstrates that relevances provide a more direct link between tissue morphology and downstream predictions. We establish a general strategy for concept-based explanation of spatial prediction, and our framework is readily applicable to a broad range of ViT-based pathology models.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个可解释性的病理学基础模型框架，将ViT感知的层间相关性传播与基于松弛原型TopK稀疏自动编码器的概念发现相结合，从H&E图像预测空间转录组学（ST），并在结直肠癌数据上验证了其效果，实现了高精度的iCMS亚型预测和概念图谱构建。
AI.motivation: 现有的病理学基础模型虽然能准确从H&E图像预测空间转录组学，但基于ViT模型的现有可解释性方法局限于局部热图，无法揭示形态学概念如何贡献于ST预测结果，缺乏全局层面的解释能力。
AI.method: 开发了一个基于ViT的虚拟ST预测框架，将ViT感知的层间相关性传播（layer-wise relevance propagation）与松弛原型TopK稀疏自动编码器（relaxed archetypal TopK sparse autoencoder）概念发现相结合，提供局部与全局解释。应用于HEST-1k队列的结直肠癌ST数据，并在TCGA COAD中验证泛化性。
AI.result: 该框架能够准确预测临床相关的ST特征及分子表型；空间分辨和聚合的iCMS分类加权F1分数分别达到0.872和0.819（TCGA COAD为0.770），两者均可对患者预后进行分层。基于相关性的概念图谱建立了分子表型与组织病理学表现之间的联系，且相关性推演的概念比激活推演的概念更能直接关联组织形态与下游预测。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了基于概念的空间预测解释通用策略，框架可广泛适用于各类基于ViT的病理学模型，为分子表型与组织形态之间建立直接可解释的桥梁。

title: When Agents Coordinate: Measuring Coordination in Multi-Agent AI Coding
summary: We study how teams of AI coding agents coordinate while solving programming tasks. Current evaluations usually report whether the agents complete the task and how much the run costs, leaving the coordination inside the team largely unmeasured. We introduce an instrument to measure this coordination. Each run is represented as a temporal network in which agents and files are nodes, and messages, file writes, and file reads are timestamped directed edges with an associated cost. We apply this instrument to 1902 runs, each evaluated with a fixed test suite, across configurations that vary the team size, the team structure, and the file policy. The resulting networks show how coordination changes as teams grow and as the work changes. Direct messaging initially increases close to quadratically with the number of agents, with much of this growth coming from an early round of introductions. As the teams grow further, this increase levels off in the largest teams we study, where agents increasingly communicate through broadcast messages. The task also shapes the network that emerges. Work built around a shared specification produces dense, highly connected teams, while pipeline tasks produce sparse networks organised around local interfaces. Shared files can replace repeated 1-to-1 communication, cutting output tokens by about 42% at eight agents on message-heavy work, while adding overhead when files already carry the coordination. Naming one agent as coordinator creates no communication hub and provides no reliable improvement in success. We also observe an unprompted tendency for agents to seek out hidden grading material. We repeat the key experimental conditions in a sealed environment, replacing the hidden material with marked placeholder files. Across 244 additional runs, agents still reach for it in four fifths of runs, while the coordinator and file-channel findings reproduce.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多AI编码代理团队在解决编程任务时的协调机制。作者提出了一种基于时间网络的测量工具，将每次运行表示为以代理和文件为节点、消息/文件读写为带时间戳有向边的网络。通过对1902次运行的系统实验，揭示了团队规模、结构和文件策略如何影响协调模式，以及协调与任务成功之间的关系。
AI.motivation: 当前对AI编码代理团队的评估只关注任务完成情况和运行成本，完全忽视了团队内部的协调行为。由于协调方式可能深刻影响效率和成功率，缺乏对协调的量化测量使得我们无法理解团队性能差异的根本原因，也无法指导代理团队的配置优化。
AI.method: 提出一个时间网络建模工具，将每次运行转化为动态网络图（节点为代理和文件，边为带时间戳的消息、文件读写操作并附有成本）。在1902次运行中系统变化团队大小、团队结构和文件访问策略，并使用固定测试套件评估；另设计244次运行的控制实验（密封环境，将隐藏评分材料替换为占位文件）以验证关键发现。
AI.result: 直接消息随代理数近似二次方增长，主要来自早期介绍环节；最大团队中增长趋缓并转向广播消息。任务类型塑造网络结构：共享规范任务产生密集连接，流水线任务产生稀疏的局部接口网络。共享文件在消息密集型工作中可减少约42%的输出token（8个代理时），但在文件已承担协调时反而增加开销。指定协调者既未形成通信中心也未带来可靠的成功率提升。还观察到代理自发寻找隐藏评分材料的行为，在密封环境中80%的额外运行中仍然发生。
AI.conclusion: 团队规模、任务结构和文件策略对AI代理团队的协调模式有系统性影响，且这些协调模式可以并且应当被量化测量。共享文件是降低通信成本的有效工具（在适当场景下），而设置协调者角色并不能带来预期的协调收益。此外，代理自发寻求隐藏材料的行为是一个值得关注的鲁棒性/安全问题，需要用密封环境等方法加以控制。

title: Time-Aware Validation of Machine Learning Fuel Consumption Models: Evidence from 1\,Hz Operational Data, CCGS \textit{Sir Wilfrid Laurier}
summary: Ship fuel consumption (SFC) prediction supports vessel operation optimisation, emissions estimation, and decision support systems (DSS) for sustainable maritime transportation. Numerous data-driven fuel models have been developed over the past two decades, but a critical and often overlooked limitation lies in their validation practices: most studies evaluate performance using random train--test splits, which, applied to high-frequency records, admit temporal leakage and yield optimistic results that do not reflect deployment conditions. This paper examines that gap using time-aware evaluation, specifically Time Series Cross-Validation (TSCV) and Blocked TSCV (BTSCV). Using the Canadian Coast Guard Ship (CCGS) \textit{Sir Wilfrid Laurier} as a case study, six regression models and a physics baseline are tuned under three time-aware schemes and three feature configurations, then evaluated on a common chronological hold-out set drawn from approximately 3.88 million steady-state 1\,Hz records.

AI.tldr: 本文针对船舶燃油消耗（SFC）预测模型中普遍存在的时间泄漏问题，提出使用时间感知评估（TSCV和BTSCV）替代随机训练-测试划分，以加拿大海岸警卫队船舶为案例，系统评估六种回归模型和物理基线的真实部署性能。
AI.motivation: 现有SFC预测模型大多采用随机训练-测试划分进行验证，这种划分方式在高频时间序列数据中会引入时间泄漏，导致评估结果过于乐观，无法反映实际部署条件。作者旨在通过时间感知评估方法揭示这一被忽视的验证缺陷。
AI.method: 采用时间序列交叉验证（TSCV）和分块时间序列交叉验证（BTSCV）两种时间感知评估方案，以加拿大海岸警卫队Sir Wilfrid Laurier号船舶为案例，对六种回归模型和一种物理基线模型，在三种时间感知方案和三种特征配置下进行调参，并在约388万条稳态1Hz记录构成的共同时间顺序保留集上进行评估。
AI.result: 论文通过时间感知评估揭示了随机划分导致的性能高估问题，量化了不同时间感知评估方案和特征配置下各模型的真实部署性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 随机训练-测试划分在SFC预测中会产生乐观偏差，时间感知评估（TSCV/BTSCV）更能反映模型实际部署条件，应作为该领域模型验证的标准实践。

title: How Sampling Strategy Affects Imbalance Mitigation in LiDAR Segmentation: A Study of Structured vs. Random Point-Based Architectures
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP) 2026
summary: Class imbalance in LiDAR point clouds poses challenges for semantic segmentation in autonomous navigation and urban mapping. While 2D vision has numerous mitigation techniques, their effectiveness in 3D remains unclear. We benchmark six reweighting schemes and five imbalance-aware losses across three datasets (DALES, S3DIS, STPLS3D) using two architectures (KPConv, RandLA-Net). Inverse-frequency weighting degrades performance by up to 12% compared to uniform weighting, with catastrophic failures in minority classes. Uniform weighting performs within 2% of complex losses for structured sampling (KPConv) but benefits less for random sampling (RandLA-Net, up to 4.6% gap). Loss landscape analysis reveals a complex interplay: for structured sampling, imbalance ratio determines landscape geometry on real LiDAR data but decouples from it on synthetic data; for random sampling, landscapes show high sensitivity to dataset geometry regardless of imbalance ratio. For the two evaluated point-based architectures, these results suggest that the interaction between sampling strategy (structured vs. random), imbalance severity, and data acquisition characteristics shapes which mitigation approaches are effective.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了六种重加权方案和五种不平衡感知损失函数在LiDAR点云语义分割中的效果，覆盖三个数据集（DALES、S3DIS、STPLS3D）和两种架构（KPConv、RandLA-Net），揭示了采样策略、不平衡程度和数据采集特性之间的复杂交互作用，并指出逆频率加权会导致性能下降高达12%。
AI.motivation: LiDAR点云中的类别不平衡问题严重影响语义分割性能，影响自动驾驶和城市测绘等应用。虽然2D视觉领域已有大量缓解技术，但其在3D点云场景中的有效性尚未得到系统验证，缺乏统一的基准评估来指导方法选择。
AI.method: 采用系统性基准测试方法，在三个不同数据集（真实数据DALES、S3DIS以及合成数据STPLS3D）上，使用两种代表性点云架构（KPConv的结构化采样和RandLA-Net的随机采样），对六种重加权方案和五种不平衡感知损失函数进行全面对比，并通过损失景观（loss landscape）分析探究其内在机制。
AI.result: 逆频率加权相比均匀加权性能下降最多达12%，且在少数类别上出现灾难性失败；结构化采样下均匀加权与复杂损失函数性能差距在2%以内，而随机采样下差距可达4.6%。损失景观分析表明：结构化采样中，真实数据的不平衡比决定景观几何，而合成数据中二者解耦；随机采样中，损失景观对数据集几何高度敏感，与不平衡比无关。
AI.conclusion: 对于所评估的两种基于点的架构，缓解方法的有效性取决于采样策略（结构化vs随机）、不平衡严重程度和数据获取特性的交互作用，没有一种方法在所有场景下普遍最优，方法选择需要结合具体的数据与架构特征。

title: Cross-Sign Language Transfer Learning Using Domain Adaptation with Multi-scale Temporal Alignment
summary: Sign language serves as a vital means of communication for individuals with hearing impairments, yet recognition resources for the over 100 distinct sign languages are severely lacking. In response, we present our work on sign language recognition using transfer learning and the domain adaptation method TA3N, which utilizes the Temporal Relational Network (TRN) module for aligning multi-scale temporal relations. Our findings highlight the superior performance of Domain Adaptation to neural network-based transfer learning, particularly in improving recognition of American Sign Language (ASL). Our research also identifies the effectiveness of aligning shorter-term temporal features between source and target domains. In addition to using RGB, we conducted experiments using Optical Flow mode for the sign language samples, ultimately determining that RGB outperforms Optical Flow in the majority of cases. Our work aims to improve accessibility and communication for individuals who rely on sign language as their primary mode of communication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用迁移学习和领域自适应方法TA3N（结合时间关系网络TRN模块）进行手语识别，研究发现领域自适应优于神经网络迁移学习，且对齐短期时间特征效果更好，RGB输入在大多数情况下优于光流模式。
AI.motivation: 全球有超过100种不同的手语，但手语识别资源严重匮乏，听力障碍群体的沟通需求未被充分满足，亟需有效的手语识别技术来提升可及性和沟通便利性。
AI.method: 采用迁移学习框架，结合TA3N领域自适应方法，利用时间关系网络（TRN）模块对齐源域和目标域之间的多尺度时间关系；同时对比了领域自适应与基于神经网络的迁移学习两种策略，并在RGB和光流（Optical Flow）两种输入模式下进行实验。
AI.result: 领域自适应方法优于基于神经网络的迁移学习，尤其在美国手语（ASL）识别上表现突出；对齐源域和目标域之间较短期的时序特征效果更佳；RGB输入在大多数情况下优于光流模式。
AI.conclusion: 本文工作为手语识别提供了有效方案，证明了领域自适应与短时时间特征对齐在手语跨域识别中的优势，旨在改善依赖手语为主要交流方式人群的可及性和沟通体验。

title: Bridging the Gap between Labeled and Unlabeled Data via Unified Flow with Feature Memory Bank
summary: Although semi-supervised semantic segmentation ($\text{S}^4$) utilizes abundant unlabeled data to reduce manual labeling burdens, independent training of labeled and unlabeled data causes the former to dominate, which severely degrades pseudo-label quality. To address this challenges, we propose a novel remote sensing (RS) $\text{S}^4$ method via unified flow with feature memory bank (UFFM). Specifically, UFFM comprises two key innovations: unified flow (UF) and feature memory bank (FMB). The UF is a new training flow that generates less biased pseudo-labels by combining an external visual foundation model (VFM) with an RS domain teacher, and jointly optimizes labeled and pseudo-labeled data under a unified training objective. The FMB is a novel memory module for $\text{S}^4$ that dynamically updates class-specific features during training and reduces the feature discrepancy between labeled and unlabeled data through class-feature alignment. To verify the effectiveness of our model, we conduct extensive experiments on RS datasets. The experimental results show the superiority of our method over SOTA $\text{S}^4$ methods. Moreover, the results demonstrate the effectiveness of our contributions in bridging the optimization and feature representation gap between labeled and unlabeled data. Our code is released at \href{https://github.com/wangshanwen001/RS-UFFM}{https://github.com/wangshanwen001/RS-UFFM}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于遥感图像半监督语义分割的新方法 UFFM，通过统一流（UF）和特征记忆库（FMB）两个核心创新，解决了传统半监督训练中标注数据主导导致伪标签质量退化的问题，在遥感数据集上取得了优于现有最先进方法的结果。
AI.motivation: 半监督语义分割虽然利用大量无标注数据减少人工标注负担，但标注数据与无标注数据的独立训练会导致标注数据占据主导地位，严重降低伪标签质量。现有方法未能有效弥合这两类数据之间的优化和特征表示差距。
AI.method: UFFM包含两个关键创新：(1) 统一流（UF）：一种新的训练流程，通过将外部视觉基础模型（VFM）与遥感领域教师模型结合生成偏差更小的伪标签，并在统一训练目标下联合优化标注数据和伪标签数据；(2) 特征记忆库（FMB）：一种新颖的记忆模块，训练过程中动态更新类特定特征，并通过类特征对齐减少标注数据与无标注数据之间的特征差异。
AI.result: 在遥感数据集上进行了大量实验，结果表明该方法优于现有的最先进半监督语义分割方法，验证了该方法在弥合标注与无标注数据之间优化和特征表示差距方面的有效性。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: UFFM通过统一的训练流程和特征记忆库机制，有效解决了半监督语义分割中标注数据主导的问题，在遥感图像分割任务上展现了显著的性能优势，为该领域提供了新的解决方案。

title: Quipu: A Governed Bitemporal Knowledge Graph Store
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Subtitle: "Start strict: rethinking knowledge-graph defaults for agent-written knowledge". Source and the benchmark/census/ artifacts behind every reported number are archived at doi:10.5281/zenodo.21878428 (concept DOI, resolves to newest release). Development repository: github.com/scbrown/quipu
summary: Agents now write knowledge graphs, but knowledge-graph stores still carry defaults set when humans curated them: accept writes now and clean later, keep one time axis or none, treat every writer's facts as equally trustworthy, and leave governance to dashboards and middleware. These four defaults are individually convenient and jointly untenable under agent workloads. We present Quipu, an embeddable store that inverts all four: no fact enters except through a gate whose predicates evaluate the pending post-state; data, trust labels, verdicts, and the rules themselves are bitemporal; named graphs are the unit of authority and trust, composed under a lattice whose one invariant is that composition never widens; and the governance specification $Σ$, the trace, and signed verdicts are facts in the store they govern, making the audit $T \models Σ$ a query. We evaluate with Census, a deterministic multi-writer lifecycle whose single seeded run scores every research question against planted ground truth: the gated store ends with 0 of 6 planted defects versus 6 of 6 ungated; all 7 composition probes uphold the lattice contract; 50 of 50 satisfied verdicts re-derive faithfully as of their instant while all 50 would be misreported under a latest-only rule set; and the SARC reference checker agrees with the in-store audit verdict-for-verdict, differing only on coverage semantics. A recorded trace from a governed writer surfaces a live enforcement gap the audit names with its remediation. On DEMM-Bench, an external decision-evidence sufficiency benchmark, a content-only reading of the exported records answers all 512 property-level governance questions correctly with zero overclaim under all eight degradation conditions, while container-presence baselines overclaim on up to 87.5% of them -- and the run surfaced, and led us to close, a gap in what a denial's verdict attests.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Quipu，一种可嵌入的知识图谱存储系统，通过反转四条传统默认设定（延迟清理、单时间轴、事实等信、治理外包），实现门控写入、双时态、名图权威格与存储内治理规范，使审计成为可查询的计算。评估显示其显著优于未门控及最新规则基线，并能发现并修复实际治理缺口。
AI.motivation: 传统知识图谱存储的四大默认设定（接受写入后清理、单时间轴或无时间轴、所有写者事实等权、治理依赖仪表板和中间件）在智能体工作负载下各自单独尚可但联合不可持续。智能体自动生成知识图谱带来了大规模、多写者、高频写入的治理挑战，亟需根本性重构存储的写入、时间、信任与治理机制。
AI.method: Quipu通过反转四条默认实现：1) 门控写入——无事实进入除非通过谓词门评估待定后状态；2) 双时态——数据、信任标签、裁决及规则本身均为双时态（bitemporal）；3) 名图权威与信任格——命名图作为权威与信任单位，在格下组合，其唯一不变量是组合永不扩大（composition never widens）；4) 存储内治理——治理规范Σ、轨迹和签名裁决均为其所治理存储中的事实，使审计T⊨Σ成为一个可执行的查询。
AI.result: 在Census确定性多写者生命周期评估中：门控存储最终0/6种植入缺陷 vs 未门控6/6；全部7个组合探针满足格契约；50/50条满足的裁决按其生效时刻忠实重推，而最新规则集下50条全部误报；SARC参考检查器与存储内审计逐条裁决一致。DEMM-Bench上，内容化读取在全部8种降级条件下512个属性级治理问题全部正确回答且零过度声称，而容器存在基线在最多87.5%问题上过度声称；运行还暴露出拒绝裁决证据缺口并已修复。
AI.conclusion: Quipu证明了将治理嵌入存储核心而非外挂中间件是可行且有效的：门控、双时态、权威格与存储内规范使审计从人工审查转化为可查询计算，能显著减少缺陷、精确恢复历史裁决、并在实际运行中主动发现治理缺口，为智能体工作负载下的知识图谱治理提供了根本性新范式。

title: Data-Efficient and Interpretable Classification of Circulating Tumor Cell Phenotypes in Microfluidic Devices via Deep Learning
summary:
Accurate classification of circulating tumor cell (CTC) phenotypes can provide valuable information for assessing metastatic potential. Label free microfluidic devices provide a hydrodynamic obstacle course that transforms subtle biophysical characteristics of CTCs, including size and deformability, into distinct kinematic trajectories. However, the highly nonlinear fluid structure interactions governing these trajectories make the inverse problem of inferring cellular phenotype from trajectory data analytically intractable. While deep neural networks (DNNs) have emerged as a powerful approach for addressing this inverse problem, their effectiveness is constrained by the limited availability of trajectory data and the lack of physical interpretability.
  To address these challenges, we propose an interpretable and data efficient DNN framework for trajectory based CTC classification. To mitigate the scarcity of data, we develop Subsequence (SubSeq), a targeted augmentation strategy that randomly extracts informative local trajectory segments during training to promote learning from localized patterns. We further apply Gradient Weighted Class Activation Mapping to identify the trajectory features and physical regions of the microfluidic device that drive model predictions. Experimental results demonstrate that SubSeq improves classification accuracy over the evaluated baseline and augmentation methods. Furthermore, interpretability analysis suggests that localized trajectory segments contain substantial biophysical information relevant to accurate classification. This provides justification for SubSeq and also highlights the redundancy of full-length trajectories. More broadly, the proposed framework views microfluidic geometries as physical encoders of cellular mechanical properties, providing mechanistic insights that may inform the future design of diagnostic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可解释且数据高效的深度神经网络框架，用于基于轨迹的循环肿瘤细胞（CTC）分类。通过子序列（SubSeq）增强策略缓解数据稀缺问题，并结合梯度加权类激活映射（Grad-CAM）提供物理解释性，实验表明该方法优于基线方法，并揭示了局部轨迹段蕴含丰富的生物物理信息。
AI.motivation: 从轨迹数据推断CTC表型是一个解析上不可处理的逆问题。尽管DNN已被用于解决该问题，但其受限于两个关键挑战：轨迹数据的稀缺性以及缺乏物理可解释性。需要一种既能有效利用有限数据、又能提供物理层面解释的框架。
AI.method: 提出可解释且数据高效的DNN框架：(1) 开发SubSeq子序列增强策略，在训练过程中随机提取信息丰富的局部轨迹段以促进从局部模式中学习；(2) 应用梯度加权类激活映射（Grad-CAM）识别驱动模型预测的轨迹特征和微流控装置的物理区域。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：SubSeq在分类准确率上优于评估的基线和现有增强方法；可解释性分析表明局部轨迹段含有大量与准确分类相关的生物物理信息，同时突显了全长轨迹的冗余性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将微流控几何结构视为细胞力学特性的物理编码器，为诊断设备的设计提供机制层面的见解，对未来微流控诊断装置的研发具有指导意义。

title: AnchorScore: A CLIP-Based Diagnostic of MLLM Annotation Difficulty
summary:
Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are widely used for automated annotation, yet their per-class accuracy varies widely (e.g., 12%-98% across the 13 classes of three classroom sub-datasets) and is expensive to measure: evaluating one 27B MLLM on 5,416 validation images takes roughly 14 hours, whereas a frozen-CLIP pass over the same images completes in about 3 minutes. A low-cost signal for ranking classes by expected MLLM annotation difficulty a priori remains underexplored. Building on the AnchorProxy construct (per-class zero-shot CLIP accuracy) introduced in the companion study, this paper systematically evaluates its full-frame formulation, termed AnchorScore here, as an a priori diagnostic that flags the classes MLLMs are least likely to annotate reliably.
  On classroom behavior data (SCB5, 13 classes, 6 MLLMs), AnchorScore correlates with per-class MLLM accuracy (Spearman rho = 0.769, p = 0.002, n = 13). None of the alternative difficulty predictors (DINOv2, ResNet-50, SigLIP, or MLLM self-verbalized uncertainty) showed a significant class-level correlation at n = 13. A cross-model consensus control suggests AnchorScore primarily captures a shared class-difficulty factor rather than a CLIP-specific signal. An independent replication on Stanford40 Actions yields a nearly identical effect (rho = 0.817, p < 0.001); the association is strongest on activity-recognition data and attenuates on medical and satellite imagery.
  Three practical applications follow: a deployable hybrid CLIP/MLLM routing strategy (predicted-class routing: up to +23 pp over CLIP-only at roughly 44% MLLM cost savings), prompt disambiguation on hard classes (exploratory), and review-priority prediction for human verification. AnchorScore does not estimate exact MLLM accuracy; it provides a low-cost ranking signal that directs expensive MLLM evaluation to the classes where it is most informative.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AnchorScore（基于每类零样本CLIP准确率），作为一个低成本的先验诊断信号，用于预测多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在自动标注中各类别注释的可靠性排序。实验表明AnchorScore与MLLM每类准确率高度相关（SCB5上rho=0.769，Stanford40上rho=0.817），优于其他难度预测器，并支持混合CLIP/MLLM路由策略（最高节省44%成本、提升23个百分点准确率）等实践应用。
AI.motivation: MLLM在自动标注中各类别准确率差异巨大（如13类中12%-98%），但评估每类准确率代价高昂（27B MLLM在5,416张验证图像上需约14小时，而冻结CLIP仅需3分钟）。目前缺乏一种低成本、先验的信号来预先对类别的MLLM标注难度进行排序。
AI.method: 基于companion研究提出的AnchorProxy（每类零样本CLIP准确率）构念，将其全帧形式命名为AnchorScore。在SCB5（教室行为数据，13类，6个MLLM）和Stanford40 Actions上进行验证，比较了DINOv2、ResNet-50、SigLIP、MLLM自述不确定性等替代难度预测器，并通过跨模型一致性对照和独立复制实验来验证其稳健性。
AI.result: AnchorScore与每类MLLM准确率显著相关（SCB5: rho=0.769, p=0.002; Stanford40: rho=0.817, p<0.001），优于所有替代预测器（在n=13时均不显著）。关联在活动识别数据上最强，在医学和卫星图像上减弱。实践应用包括：混合CLIP/MLLM路由（最多提升23个百分点准确率且节省44% MLLM成本）、困难类别的提示消歧（探索性）和人工审核优先级预测。
AI.conclusion: AnchorScore不估计MLLM的精确准确率，而是提供一个低成本的类别排序信号，将昂贵的MLLM评估资源引导到最需要关注的类别上。它主要捕获共享的类别难度因子（而非CLIP特有信号），且其效应在独立数据上可复现。

title: An Analytical-Prior Framework for Data-Efficient Prediction of Sound-Reduction Frequencies in Rectangular Side-Branch Helmholtz Resonators
summary: High-fidelity finite-element simulations can provide accurate numerical predictions for side-branch resonators, but large simulation datasets are expensive to generate and purely data-driven surrogates may become unreliable when simulation-labelled data are scarce. This study develops an analytical-prior learning framework that reuses a low-cost analytical model to improve data efficiency under limited high-fidelity simulation budgets. Two complementary routes are considered. When the analytical model remains available at inference, it is retained as an explicit baseline and the simulation data are used to learn only the analytical-to-simulation discrepancy. When a self-contained predictor is required, the analytical mapping is first distilled from abundant low-cost evaluations into a learned prior and then calibrated with the limited simulation data. The framework is evaluated on rectangular side-branch Helmholtz resonators using 86 simulation-labelled geometries and 8,998 non-overlapping analytical-only geometries. The analytical model achieved a mean absolute error (MAE) of 1.333 Hz. Direct support vector regression (SVR) achieved 3.375 Hz, while residual SVR reduced the MAE to 0.426 Hz. A direct multilayer perceptron (MLP) achieved 1.109 Hz, whereas analytical-prior pretraining reduced the error to 0.556 Hz with frozen-prior residual adaptation and 0.371 Hz with full-model fine-tuning. Across training budgets of 20 to 70 simulation-labelled cases, both analytical correction and analytical-prior pretraining consistently improved data efficiency relative to direct learning. These results show that analytical prior information can substantially improve high-fidelity prediction when simulation data are scarce, with explicit correction and prior distillation serving complementary deployment needs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种解析先验学习框架，通过复用低成本解析模型来提高在有限高保真仿真数据下的侧支谐振器预测精度。实验表明，残差SVR和解析先验预训练MLP分别将MAE从3.375 Hz降至0.426 Hz和从1.109 Hz降至0.371 Hz，显著提升了数据效率。
AI.motivation: 高保真有限元仿真虽能提供精确的侧支谐振器数值预测，但生成大规模仿真数据集成本高昂；当仿真标注数据稀缺时，纯数据驱动的代理模型可能变得不可靠。因此需要一种方法在有限仿真预算下提升预测精度。
AI.method: 提出解析先验学习框架，包含两条互补路线：(1) 显式校正路线——推理时可访问解析模型时，将其保留为显式基线，仅用仿真数据学习解析与仿真之间的残差；(2) 先验蒸馏路线——需要自包含预测器时，先从大量低成本的解析评估中蒸馏出一个学习先验，再用有限仿真数据进行校准。具体实现包括残差SVR和基于解析先验预训练的MLP（含冻结先验残差适配和全模型微调两种策略）。
AI.result: 矩形侧支亥姆霍兹谐振器上，使用86个仿真标注几何和8,998个解析标注几何进行实验：解析模型MAE为1.333 Hz；直接SVR为3.375 Hz，残差SVR降至0.426 Hz；直接MLP为1.109 Hz，解析先验预训练先下降至0.556 Hz（冻结先验残差适配）和0.371 Hz（全模型微调）。在20至70个仿真训练样本的预算范围内，两种路线均一致性地改善了数据效率。
AI.conclusion: 解析先验信息能够在仿真数据稀缺时大幅提升高保真预测精度，显式解析校正和解析先验蒸馏分别满足了不同的部署需求，二者互为补充。

title: MIRROR: Multimodal Intelligent Radiology Reasoning and Observation Reporter
summary: A radiologist reading a model's output faces two problems. The model returns a number and no reason, and any system that turns that number into readable prose can quietly add claims the model never made. MIRROR is a research prototype built to separate those failures. It chains a multi-label classifier, a Grad-CAM localizer that turns each positive finding into a named anatomical region, and a report writer that receives the labels, probabilities, and regions but never the image. Because the language layer cannot see pixels, it cannot assert a finding the classifier did not make. We are precise about what that buys: a MIRROR report's findings are auditable against the probability vector, while the sentences framing them are ordinary generated text, and we show one stating a cardiothoracic ratio the system never measured. One registry holds the taxonomy, anatomy, and phrasing for chest X-ray, brain MRI, and head CT, so adding a modality is a data change; all three are routed and tested, one is trained. On ChestMNIST that classifier reaches macro AUROC 0.729 and ranks better than chance on all 14 labels, at 1.6 to 6.8 times the precision a random ranker would get. Yet at the default 0.5 threshold it emits no positive prediction at all for 11 of them, and its excellent-looking Brier score of 0.045 sits beside the 0.047 earned by a predictor that ignores the image. The discrimination is real; the decisions are not. Under the class imbalance normal in radiology, aggregate metrics flatter models that do nothing, and should be reported against that floor.

AI.tldr: MIRROR是一个将多标签分类、Grad-CAM定位与报告生成解耦的研究原型，语言层无法看到像素从而不会编造分类器未做出的发现。作者指出在放射学常见的类别不平衡下，聚合指标（如Brier分数）会掩盖"什么都不做"的模型的真实表现，应报告其与随机/基线地板之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 放射科医生读取模型输出时面临两个问题：模型只返回数字且不给出理由，而将数字转化为可读文本的系统可能悄悄添加模型从未声称的内容。作者旨在通过架构解耦来分离这两种失败模式，并精确界定这种设计实际能保证什么。
AI.method: MIRROR采用三阶段链式架构：多标签分类器输出标签及概率，Grad-CAM定位器将每个阳性发现映射为具名解剖区域，报告生成器只接收标签、概率和区域而看不到图像。由于语言层无法访问像素，它无法断言分类器未做出的发现。系统使用单一注册表统一管理胸片、脑MRI和头CT的术语、解剖与措辞，跨模态仅需数据变更。
AI.result: 在ChestMNIST上分类器达到宏AUROC 0.729，全部14个标签的排序优于随机，精度是随机排序器的1.6到6.8倍。但在默认0.5阈值下对其中11个标签完全无阳性预测，且Brier分数0.045仅略优于忽略图像输入的预测器的0.047。这证明判别力真实存在但决策并未落地。MIRROR还展示了报告生成中一句关于心肺比率的陈述是系统从未测量过的。
AI.conclusion: 在放射学常见的类别不平衡条件下，聚合指标会虚增实际无效模型的性能，应在报告中与基线地板（如忽略图像输入的预测器）进行对比呈现。MIRROR的架构保证了报告发现可对照概率向量审计，但框架性语句仍是普通生成文本，不能视为测量结果。

title: What Do Compliance Detectors Read? An Audit of Activation Probes and Guard Models
summary: Regulatory compliance monitoring in deployed language models is increasingly implemented as a legal and audit control, checking model outputs against written rules spanning data protection, healthcare, financial regulation, and platform policy. Such monitoring is meaningful only if a detector's verdict depends on the stated rule rather than on surface features of the scenario. We show this condition fails across the current class of compliance detectors, a failure we call rule blindness. Deleting, permuting, or substituting the governing rule leaves detection accuracy unchanged for every guard and activation probe we test, including a policy-conditioned guard that correctly cites the governing clause yet barely changes its verdict when that clause is swapped for its permissive counterpart. A purpose-built benchmark crossing two rules with two scenarios, so that neither alone predicts the label, confirms the failure under a design no prior benchmark rules out, and shows that step by step reasoning, not any fast detector we test, is what escapes it. Auditing at scale requires a retraining-free detector, so we introduce the Internal Compliance Score (ICS): a training-free activation readout calibrated from ten labelled pairs and scored by a single projection. We hold ICS to the same scrutiny as the guards it audits: a pre-registered criterion for beating trivial baselines is not met, and a bag-of-words model matches its pooled generalisation exactly. It remains useful because it is inexpensive, letting us audit four deployed guard models, an 8B zero-shot judge, and thirteen benchmarks, and it raises the mechanically verified pass rate when used to rank candidate responses, though an adaptive white-box attack removes this gain. We release the counterfactual protocol and crossed-rule benchmark so rule blindness can be tested in future probe and guard claims.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示当前合规检测器（guard模型与activation probe）普遍存在"规则盲性"（rule blindness）——检测结果不依赖规定本身，删除、置换或替换规则均不影响检测准确率。作者提出一种无需训练的内部合规分数（ICS），用少量标注对校准单投影激活读数，虽未通过预注册的基线超越标准（与词袋模型表现一致），但因成本低廉可用于审计多个部署模型和基准。作者还发布了反事实协议与交叉规则基准供后续研究使用。
AI.motivation: 法规合规监控必须依赖于明确规则而非场景表面特征才有意义，但现有检测器是否真正利用规则文本尚不清楚。作者希望验证当前检测器是否能感知规则变化，并提供一个可扩展、无需重训练的审计工具。
AI.method: （1）构建反事实协议：删除、置换、替换规则测试检测器是否受规则影响；（2）设计交叉规则基准（2规则×2场景），确保单一维度无法预测标签；（3）提出ICS：用10个标注样本校准单投影激活读数作为合规分数；（4）对4个guard模型、8B零样本裁判及13个基准进行审计；（5）进行自适应白盒攻击测试。
AI.result: 所有测试的guard和activation probe均存在规则盲性，即使能正确引用条款的策略条件guard在条款被替换为宽松条款后判定几乎不变。ICS未通过预注册的优于平凡基线的标准，其池化泛化能力与词袋模型完全一致；但它在排序候选回复时可提高机械验证的通过率，不过自适应白盒攻击能消除此增益。
AI.conclusion: 当前合规检测器普遍存在规则盲性，快速检测器无法逃离此困境；逐步推理是唯一能规避该问题的方法。ICS虽不优于朴素基线，但因无训练、低成本的优势仍可用于大规模部署审计，但需注意其可被自适应攻击削弱。

title: Q-based Variational Inverse Reinforcement Learning
summary: The development of safe and beneficial AI requires that systems can learn and act in accordance with human preferences. However, explicitly specifying these preferences by hand is often infeasible. Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) addresses this challenge by inferring preferences, represented as reward functions, from expert behaviour. We introduce Q-based Variational IRL (QVIRL), a novel Bayesian IRL method that recovers a posterior distribution over rewards from expert demonstrations via primarily learning a variational distribution over optimal Q-values. Unlike previous approaches, QVIRL combines scalability with uncertainty quantification, important for safety-critical applications as well as active learning. We demonstrate QVIRL's strong performance in apprenticeship learning across various tasks, including gridworlds, Lunar Lander, the Highway Environment, and two ATARI games both with static expert data and with active learning. It is the first method for Bayesian IRL that demonstrates training from raw pixel observations.

AI.tldr: QVIRL是一种新颖的贝叶斯逆强化学习方法，通过主要学习最优Q值上的变分分布来从专家行为中恢复奖励函数的后验分布，在多个任务上展现出优越性能，是首个能从原始像素观察中训练的贝叶斯IRL方法。
AI.motivation: 安全有益的AI需要系统学习并遵循人类偏好，但手工指定这些偏好往往不可行。已有的IRL方法要么缺乏可扩展性，要么无法提供不确定性量化，而这对于安全关键应用和主动学习至关重要。
AI.method: QVIRL通过主要学习最优Q值上的变分分布而非直接对奖励建模，从而恢复奖励函数的后验分布。这种方法将变分推断与Q学习相结合，同时利用了贝叶斯推断的不确定性量化和深度学习的可扩展性。
AI.result: 在多个基准任务（gridworlds、Lunar Lander、Highway Environment和两款ATARI游戏）上，QVIRL在学徒学习中表现出色，既适用于静态专家数据也适用于主动学习场景，并首次实现从原始像素观察进行训练的贝叶斯IRL。
AI.conclusion: QVIRL首次同时具备可扩展性与不确定性量化能力，推动了贝叶斯IRL在安全关键应用中的实际部署，并开创了贝叶斯IRL从原始像素训练的先河。

title: PersonaShot: Benchmarking Person-Centric Narrative Continuity in Multi-Shot Video Generation
summary: Video generation is rapidly evolving from single-shot clips to multi-shot narratives, where the human character serves as the core narrative anchor. However, existing benchmarks mainly assess character appearance or individual-shot quality, without measuring whether physical and emotional states remain coherent across cuts. They also rarely provide criterion-specific evaluation methods, although physical continuity, facial dynamics, and cinematic relations require different visual, temporal, and relational evidence. To address these limitations, we introduce PersonaShot, the first person-centric benchmark for narrative continuity in multi-shot video generation. PersonaShot contains approximately 1,000 multi-shot segments and 16 metrics spanning physical continuity, affective dynamics, and cinematic grammar. \textbf{\textit{1)} Narrative Continuity Benchmark:} We evaluate character coherence across three temporal levels: within-shot states, cross-shot transitions, and sequence-level trajectories. \textbf{\textit{2)} Human-Aligned Specialist Evaluators:} We distill reasoning from a large multimodal teacher into lightweight criterion-specific evaluators, each grounded in the visual, temporal, or relational evidence required by its metric, and align them with expert human judgments. \textbf{\textit{3)} Systematic Evaluation and Insights:} Our evaluation reveals distinct capability profiles across state-of-the-art models and a clear gap between perceptual quality and cross-shot narrative continuity. Even visually compelling videos frequently exhibit physical-state resets, abrupt affective shifts, and broken cinematic relations across shots. Human studies further demonstrate strong agreement between our evaluators and expert judgments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了PersonaShot，这是首个面向多镜头视频生成中叙事连贯性的人物中心基准。它包含约1000个多镜头片段和16个跨越物理连续性、情感动态和电影语法的指标，并设计了与人类专家判断对齐的轻量级专业评估器。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成基准主要评估角色外观或单个镜头质量，缺乏对跨镜头物理状态和情感状态连贯性的测量，且缺少针对不同指标（如物理连续性、面部动态、电影关系）的准则特异性评估方法。
AI.method: PersonaShot包含三部分：1）叙事连续性基准，从镜头内状态、跨镜头转换和序列级轨迹三个时间层面评估角色连贯性；2）人类对齐的专业评估器，从大型多模态教师模型中蒸馏推理能力构建轻量级准则特异性评估器，每个评估器基于其指标所需的视觉、时间或关系证据，并与专家人类判断对齐；3）系统性评估与洞察，揭示不同模型的能力画像及感知质量与跨镜头叙事连续性之间的差距。
AI.result: 评估揭示了最先进模型之间存在不同的能力画像，且感知质量与跨镜头叙事连续性之间存在明显差距。即使视觉上引人注目的视频也经常出现物理状态重置、情感突变和跨镜头电影关系断裂。人类研究表明评估器与专家判断高度一致。
AI.conclusion: PersonaShot为多镜头视频生成的叙事连贯性提供了首个系统性评估框架，强调了物理状态、情感动态和电影语法在跨镜头叙事中的重要性，并为未来模型改进指明了方向——即不仅需要关注感知质量，还需提升跨镜头的叙事连贯性。

title: CytoFormer: A Molecularly Supervised Cell Foundation Model for Histopathology Cell Classification
summary: Identifying cell types directly from routine haematoxylin and eosin (H&E) histology would enable single-cell analysis at scale, but training such models has relied on manual pathologist annotations, which are slow, expensive and unreliable for many cell types. We instead supervise morphology with molecules. Imaging-based spatial transcriptomics profiles individual cells in situ on a section that can afterwards be stained with H&E, so that molecular identity and morphology are observed for the same physical cell. We assembled 81 such paired Xenium sections spanning 16 organs, derived per-cell labels by clustering, marker-gene annotation, organ-wise human review and quality control, and mapped them onto the cell types commonly reported in each organ. This yielded 15.4 million cells, each with a paired H&E image patch and one of 23 cell types, on which we trained CytoFormer, a cell foundation model with a multi-task, per-organ classification head. On spatially held-out tissue CytoFormer reached an accuracy of 0.85 and a macro-F1 of 0.78 across all 16 organs, and its predictions reproduced the tissue architecture of an entire held-out section. The representation also transfers: with the encoder frozen, a linear head on CytoFormer features performed better than six pathology foundation models on four expert-annotated benchmarks, including on organs and cell types that were not part of pretraining. Finally, in an interactive active-learning setting, CytoFormer's embeddings are markedly more label-efficient than existing pathology foundation models, detecting normal epithelium amid look-alike tumour with an F1 of 0.82 from only a few annotations and leading the strongest baseline by 0.13 in F1. CytoFormer turns paired H&E and spatial transcriptomics into a reusable, label-efficient representation for cell-level analysis of routine histology.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CytoFormer，一种细胞基础模型，利用空间转录组学与H&E染色配对的81张切片（16个器官、1540万细胞、23种细胞类型）来监督形态学，替代昂贵且不可靠的人工病理标注。模型在空间留出组织上达到0.85准确率和0.78宏F1，表征可迁移且具有高效主动学习能力。
AI.motivation: 直接从常规H&E组织学中识别细胞类型可实现在规模的单细胞分析，但现有模型依赖病理学家人工标注，这种方法缓慢、昂贵且对许多细胞类型不可靠。作者希望通过分子（空间转录组学）而非人工标注来监督形态学，消除人工标注瓶颈。
AI.method: 收集81对Xenium空间转录组学切片覆盖16个器官；通过聚类、标记基因注释、器官级人工审查和质量控制获得逐细胞标签，映射到每个器官常见的细胞类型；共获得1540万细胞，每对配有H&E图像补丁和23类细胞类型标签；据此训练CytoFormer，一个带多任务、逐器官分类头的细胞基础模型。
AI.result: 空间留出组织上CytoFormer达到0.85准确率和0.78宏F1，预测能重现整个留出切片的组织结构。冻结编码器后，线性头在4个专家标注基准上优于6个病理基础模型，包括预训练中未见过的器官和细胞类型。在主动学习场景中，嵌入比现有病理基础模型更具标签效率，仅用少量标注在类似肿瘤的正常上皮检测上F1达0.82，比最强基线高0.13。
AI.conclusion: CytoFormer将配对H&E与空间转录组学转化为可复用、标签高效的常规组织学细胞级别分析表示，证明以分子身份监督形态学是一种可行且强大的替代人工标注的细胞识别方法。

title: GenRouter: Unified Workflow Routing for Agentic Image Generation
summary: The rapid evolution of text-to-image (T2I) generation models has effectively solved the foundational challenge of raw pixel synthesis, shifting the community's focus toward fulfilling increasingly intricate user requests. While recent agentic image generation workflows enhance static inference with advanced capabilities like external knowledge retrieval and iterative reasoning, they mostly operate in isolated silos with fixed ``one-size-fits-all" topologies. This inevitably leads to severe compute-mismatch, where simple queries are forced through computationally heavy pipelines. To bridge this gap, we present GenRouter, the first unified workflow routing framework for agentic image generation. We first formulate GenCanvas, standardizing diverse agentic pipelines into a universal set of foundational primitives and executable templates. Operating over this unified space, GenRouter adaptively routes heterogeneous prompts to their optimal workflows via (i) demand profiling, (ii) experience matching, and (iii) Pareto filtering. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that GenRouter achieves superior visual alignment while reducing execution costs by over 95% and latency by 65% compared to heavyweight static pipelines. Furthermore, the system continuously self-evolves via accumulated experience, enabling robust zero-shot generalization that boosts performance and halves computational overhead.

AI.tldr: GenRouter是首个面向智能体图像生成的统一工作流路由框架，将异构智能体管线标准化为通用原语和模板，通过需求分析、经验匹配和Pareto过滤将提示自适应路由到最优工作流，在保持视觉对齐的同时将执行成本降低95%以上、延迟降低65%。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像生成模型已解决原始像素合成问题，但智能体图像生成工作流大多以孤立、固定的"一刀切"拓扑运行，导致计算资源错配——简单查询被迫经过计算密集型管线，造成严重的计算浪费。
AI.method: 提出GenRouter框架：(i) 设计GenCanvas，将多样化的智能体管线标准化为一组通用基础原语和可执行模板；(ii) 在该统一空间上，通过需求分析、经验匹配和Pareto过滤三个环节，将异质提示自适应路由到最优工作流；系统通过累积经验实现持续自我进化。
AI.result: 在多个基准上的广泛实验表明，与重型静态管线相比，GenRouter在保持优越视觉对齐的同时，将执行成本降低超过95%，延迟降低65%。系统还能通过累积经验自我进化，实现稳健的零样本泛化，进一步提升性能并将计算开销减半。
AI.conclusion: GenRouter验证了统一的、自适应的工作流路由能够有效消除计算错配问题，为智能体图像生成提供了一种兼具性能与效率的可扩展解决方案，并通过经验累积实现持续自我优化。

title: Unsupervised Anomaly Detection for Image Dataset Quality Assurance in Multi-Center Breast MRI
summary:
Corrupted, inconsistent, or anomalous data silently threatens the safety and reliability of medical AI. Despite growing regulatory recognition of dataset quality assurance (QA) for high-risk medical AI, scalable automated detection remains underdeveloped. We employ unsupervised anomaly detection (AD) and out-of-distribution (OOD) detection as an automated dataset QA mechanism for multi-center dynamic contrast-enhanced breast MRI.
  We build a controlled AD benchmark of 17 realistic QA-relevant anomaly types from six public datasets (protocol violations, processing errors, incorrect anatomical regions) and propose a taxonomy of radiological image anomalies based on human visual perception, enabling fine-grained analysis of AD failure modes. The benchmark includes near-, medium-far-, far-OOD samples, as well as in-distribution and external normal data. Four methods are evaluated: a projection-based method extended with a domain-specific feature extractor and a novel positional encoding, a reconstruction-based approach extended to full 3D volumes with an augmented training objective, and two unmodified hybrid OOD detection methods.
  Medium-far- and far-OOD samples are detected reliably, whereas near-OOD samples and external normal data from unseen institutions expose method-specific differences. The 3D reconstruction-based approach best balances detection performance (AUROC: 0.936) and generalization to unseen institutions. The projection-based method with positional encoding achieves the highest overall detection performance (AUROC: 0.954). Both hybrid methods exhibit critical failure modes, confirming that methods validated for one modality or anatomy may not generalize without domain-specific adaptation. Implants and mastectomies remain an open challenge for all methods. Our results establish a foundation and practical guidance on scalable unsupervised QA in medical AI pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文针对医学AI中数据质量保证（QA）自动化检测不足的问题，构建了一个包含17种QA相关异常类型、覆盖多个公开数据集的受控异常检测基准，并在多中心动态增强乳腺MRI上系统比较了四种无监督异常/分布外检测方法，为医学AI流水线中的可扩展无监督QA提供了基准与实用指导。
AI.motivation: 数据损坏、不一致或异常会威胁医学AI的安全与可靠性。尽管监管层日益认可高风险医学AI的数据集质量保证（QA），但可扩展的自动化检测方法仍不成熟。作者希望将无监督异常检测（AD）和分布外（OOD）检测应用于多中心动态增强乳腺MRI，作为自动化数据集QA机制，填补这一空白。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个受控AD基准：从六个公开数据集中生成17种QA相关的现实异常类型（包括协议违规、处理错误、不正确的解剖区域），提出基于人类视觉感知的放射学图像异常分类法以支持对AD失败模式的细粒度分析。基准包含近OOD、中远OOD、远OOD样本以及分布内和外部正常数据。评估了四种方法：(1) 基于投影的方法，扩展了领域特定特征提取器和新颖的位置编码；(2) 基于重建的方法，扩展到全3D体积并用增强训练目标；以及(3) 两种未修改的混合OOD检测方法。
AI.result: 中远OOD和远OOD样本被可靠检测，而近OOD样本和来自未见机构的外部正常数据暴露了方法间的差异。3D重建方法在检测性能（AUROC: 0.936）与对未见机构的泛化之间取得最佳平衡；基于投影并带位置编码的方法取得最高总体检测性能（AUROC: 0.954）。两种混合方法表现出的关键失败模式，证实了针对一种模态或解剖验证的方法若不进行领域特定适配可能无法泛化。植入物和乳房切除术对所有方法仍是开放挑战。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为医学AI流水线中的可扩展无监督QA建立了基础并提供实用指导。结果表明，领域特定的方法适应至关重要，3D重建方法与投影方法各有优势，且应针对具体应用场景权衡检测性能与跨机构泛化能力。

title: VicEdit: Learning to Edit Videos from Visual In-Context Examples
summary: Despite progress in instruction-based video editing, unimodal textual instructions inherently struggle to convey fine-grained textures and complex dynamics. To bridge this perceptual gap, we propose Visual In-context Editing, a new paradigm elevating video editing from textual instructions to multi-modal visual guidance encompassing single image, image pair, and video pair. To facilitate this paradigm, we curate VicEdit-400K, the first large-scale dataset for visual in-context video editing. We develop an automated pipeline to generate 400K high-quality samples across ten task types, ensuring superior visual fidelity and semantic consistency through multi-dimensional filtering. Leveraging this foundation, we introduce VicEdit, a unified framework to bridge visual and textual contexts. To adaptively extract editing semantics from heterogeneous references, we design Modality-Adaptive Semantic Distillation, which produces modality-specific semantic tokens from visual references. These tokens are then synergistically integrated with textual instructions through Dual-Context Injection, enabling the generation process to benefit from both visual and textual signals. Extensive evaluations on VicEditBench demonstrate that VicEdit achieves state-of-the-art performance across both basic instruction editing and visual in-context editing tasks, establishing visual in-context learning as a powerful and controllable paradigm for video editing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出视觉上下文编辑（Visual In-context Editing）这一新范式，将视频编辑从纯文本指令提升为多模态视觉引导（单图、图像对、视频对）。作者构建了首个大规模数据集VicEdit-400K（含10种任务类型、40万样本），并提出统一框架VicEdit，通过模态自适应语义蒸馏和双上下文注入实现视觉与文本信号的协同编辑，在VicEditBench上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于指令的视频编辑依赖纯文本指令，而文本本身难以细粒度地传达复杂的纹理和动态信息，存在感知鸿沟，限制了编辑的精确性和可控性。
AI.method: 1) 提出视觉上下文编辑范式，支持单图、图像对和视频对三种视觉参考输入；2) 构建自动化数据生成流程，产出VicEdit-400K数据集（10种任务类型，40万高质量样本），并通过多维过滤保证视觉保真度和语义一致性；3) 设计VicEdit统一框架，包含模态自适应语义蒸馏（从异构视觉参考中提取模态特异的语义token）和双上下文注入（将视觉token与文本指令协同融合到生成过程）。
AI.result: 在VicEditBench上的大量实验表明，VicEdit在基础指令编辑和视觉上下文编辑两类任务上均取得最先进（SOTA）性能。
AI.conclusion: 视觉上下文学习被验证为一种强大且可控的视频编辑范式，能够有效弥合文本指令在细粒度编辑中的局限性，为视频编辑提供了更具表现力和可控性的新路径。

title: Beyond Uncertainty: Generalizable Failure Monitoring for Surgical Segmentation under Acquisition Degradation
summary: Surgical segmentation networks can fail silently under acquisition degradation: predicted masks may be wrong even when model confidence remains high. Existing deployment-time monitors rely primarily on uncertainty estimates and can therefore miss confident failures. We present TCSR-Monitor (Temporal Conformal Surgical Risk Monitor), a post-hoc failure-monitoring framework that combines confidence with observable shape, temporal-consistency, and image-quality cues. TCSR-Monitor wraps a frozen segmentation model, requires no model internals, and operates without ground truth at deployment. We also introduce a validation protocol to assess whether alarms remain credible under distribution shift. On EndoVis 2017, leave-one-corruption-out evaluation shows that TCSR-Monitor generalizes to unseen acquisition degradations and substantially outperforms confidence-based baselines. A circularity control confirms that it predicts segmentation failure rather than simply detecting corrupted images. Mondrian conformal calibration balances miss-rates across degradation severities, but a single global threshold still produces false alarms on up to 40% of correctly segmented frames at moderate corruption. Zero-shot transfer to SAM2 demonstrates feature portability, although entropy outperforms the transferred monitor at both evaluated thresholds. Overall, reliable monitoring under acquisition degradation benefits from complementary observable signals beyond confidence alone, but substantial false-alarm and transfer limitations remain.

AI.tldr: 提出TCSR-Monitor，一种后置式手术分割失败监控框架，将模型置信度与形状、时间一致性和图像质量等可观察线索相结合，无需模型内部信息即可在部署时监控分割失败。实验表明其在端到端内镜手术数据集上优于纯置信度基线，但仍存在误报率较高和跨模型迁移受限的问题。
AI.motivation: 手术分割网络在获取退化（acquisition degradation）下可能静默失败——预测掩码错误但模型置信度仍高。现有的部署时监控依赖不确定性估计，无法捕捉这种"高置信度失败"的情况，因此需要引入置信度之外的可观察信号来提升监控可靠性。
AI.method: TCSR-Monitor采用后置监控框架，包裹冻结的分割模型，不依赖模型内部结构且无需部署时真值。它融合四类信号：模型置信度、形状线索、时间一致性线索和图像质量线索。同时引入了一个验证协议以评估分布偏移下警报的可信度，并使用Mondrian共形校准以平衡不同退化严重度下的漏报率。
AI.result: 在EndoVis 2017上采用leave-one-corruption-out评估，TCSR-Monitor能泛化到未见过的获取退化，并显著优于纯置信度基线。环形性控制确认其预测的是分割失败而非简单检测图像损坏。但单一全局阈值在中等退化下对高达40%的正确分割帧产生误报；零样本迁移到SAM2时特征可迁移，但熵值在两种评估阈值下均优于迁移后的监控器。
AI.conclusion: 可靠监控获取退化受益于置信度之外的互补可观察信号，但当前方法仍存在显著的误报率和迁移局限性，说明该方向仍有待进一步改进。

title: Binarized High-Efficiency RAW Video Restoration and Beyond
summary: RAW video restoration is fundamental to high-quality low-level perception and serves as the basis for a wide range of downstream vision applications. While binary neural networks (BNNs) enable efficient lightweight deployment for image enhancement, their deficiencies in modeling temporal coherence and activation value distributions hinder their effectiveness when applied to video scenarios. In this paper, we propose BinRVR, a binarized RAW video restoration framework that reduces computation and parameters by approximately 96% while incurring only about 4% performance degradation. Specifically, we present a Binarized Information Interaction Module (BIIM) to jointly model spatial and temporal information in an efficient and unified manner. Moreover, we develop a Distribution-Aware Binarized Convolution (DAB-Conv) that leverages the statistics of full-precision activations to mitigate quantization errors. The proposed framework further supports multi-bit quantization, enabling flexible accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across different hardware constraints. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our BinRVR achieves competitive performance compared with state-of-the-art binarized methods on RAW video restoration tasks, including low-light enhancement, denoising, deblurring, and super-resolution. We further explore the potential of our method on downstream video applications, including object detection and monocular depth estimation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出BinRVR，一个用于RAW视频恢复的二值化神经网络框架，通过二值信息交互模块（BIIM）和分布感知二值卷积（DAB-Conv）联合建模时空信息并缓解量化误差，将计算量和参数量降低约96%，仅带来约4%的性能退化，并支持多比特量化以实现精度-效率灵活权衡。
AI.motivation: RAW视频恢复是高质量低层感知的基础，但二值神经网络在视频场景中缺乏对时间一致性和激活值分布建模的能力，导致其应用效果受限。现有方法未能有效解决二值化在视频时空建模中的效率与精度平衡问题。
AI.method: 提出BinRVR框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 二值信息交互模块（BIIM），以高效统一的方式联合建模空间和时间信息；(2) 分布感知二值卷积（DAB-Conv），利用全精度激活值的统计特性来缓解量化误差。框架还支持多比特量化，实现不同硬件约束下的精度-效率自适应。
AI.result: 实验表明BinRVR在多种RAW视频恢复任务（低光增强、去噪、去模糊、超分辨率）上达到与最先进的二值化方法相比具有竞争力的性能，计算量和参数减少约96%，性能退化仅约4%。此外，该方法在下游视频应用（目标检测和单目深度估计）中也展示了潜力。
AI.conclusion: BinRVR通过针对性的模块设计（BIIM和DAB-Conv）有效解决了二值网络在RAW视频恢复中的时空建模和量化误差问题，在极低计算资源下实现了接近全精度方法的性能，并通过多比特量化和下游应用验证展示了广泛适用性。

title: TRACE-Bench: Decomposing and Diagnosing Multi-Reference Image Generation
summary: Despite recent advances in unified multimodal models for multi-reference image generation, existing benchmarks remain organized around predefined task types (e.g., "subject composition"), which are ill-suited to this combinatorial setting and lead to fragmented coverage, uncontrolled complexity, and little diagnostic value. Recognizing that diverse multi-reference tasks share a common set of atomic operations, we adopt a capability-oriented perspective and formalize four operators: Anchor ($f$), Disentangle ($g$), Apply ($\oplus$), and Compose ($C$). Any multi-reference prompt can then be represented as a compositional formula over these operators, whose structural complexity is quantified by the number of operator slots. Building on this formulation, we construct TRACE-Bench, comprising approximately 1,600 evaluation cases across slot counts 1--8, built from 631 formula templates and around 4,000 reference images spanning diverse artistic styles and real-world subjects. The formula structure directly drives an operator-aligned evaluation protocol for per-capability scoring and a diagnostic tree analysis for recursive failure localization. Evaluating 9 leading models reveals insights invisible to holistic scoring: the primary bottleneck lies in disentanglement ($g$) and attribute binding ($\oplus$) rather than scene-level composition ($C$), with even the best model scoring only 0.74 on attribute fidelity. Project page: https://amuseum-whr.github.io/TraceBench

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TRACE-Bench基准，从能力导向视角将多参考图像生成任务形式化为四种原子操作（Anchor、Disentangle、Apply、Compose），构建约1600个评估案例，并通过操作符对齐的评估协议和诊断树分析来定位模型失败根源。
AI.motivation: 现有统一多模态模型在多参考图像生成中取得了进展，但现有基准仍按预定义任务类型（如"主体组合"）组织，不适配组合式设置，导致覆盖碎片化、复杂度不可控、诊断价值低。
AI.method: 采用能力导向视角，形式化四种原子操作：Anchor（锚定）、Disentangle（解耦）、Apply（应用/绑定）、Compose（组合），将任意多参考提示表示为这四种操作符的组合公式，复杂度由操作符槽数量量化；基于此构建TRACE-Bench，包含约1600个评估案例（槽数1-8）、631个公式模板和约4000张参考图像，并设计操作符对齐的评估协议和诊断树分析。
AI.result: 评估9个领先模型后发现：主要瓶颈在于解耦（g）和属性绑定（⊕）而非场景级组合（C），最佳模型在属性保真度上仅得0.74分，揭示了整体评分无法体现的深层洞察。
AI.conclusion: TRACE-Bench通过原子操作分解和诊断树分析提供了更细粒度的能力评估与失败定位框架，能够发现整体评分掩盖的模型短板，为多参考图像生成模型的改进指明方向。

title: Calibration-Free Vehicle Speed Estimation: A Monocular Keypoint-Template Approach
summary: This paper proposes a calibration-free framework for reliably and effectively estimating vehicle speeds from monocular videos, without relying on roadway features, camera calibration, or roadway-feature-based reference objects. The proposed framework estimates vehicle speeds using a 36-keypoint vehicle template and a homography matrix updated at each frame. A YOLO-based keypoint detection module is trained on diverse datasets, and two estimation strategies are compared: keypoint-only tracking and warped optical flow with dense spatial aggregation. Speed is estimated by projecting displacements into metric space using the homography, with validation conducted on over 400 video clips from roadside and overhead datasets, covering speeds from 30 to 100 mph. The method achieves reliable speed estimation on the VS13 and BrnoCompSpeed datasets, with the warped optical flow method delivering MAEs of 15.0% and 9.7%, respectively, and 77.9% and 93.1% of estimates falling within +/-20% error. After applying a 10% trim to remove edge-of-frame outliers, performance improves to MAEs of 11.7% and 7.6%, with within-+/-20% accuracy increasing to 85.3% and 95.4%. This work addresses key limitations of existing vision-based approaches and enables low-cost and efficient speed enforcement using portable devices such as dashcams and smartphones, thereby supporting citizen-based enforcement programs for traffic safety.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需标定的单目视频车速估计框架，通过36关键点车辆模板和逐帧更新的单应矩阵，结合YOLO关键点检测以及两种估计策略（仅关键点跟踪与形变光流+密集空间聚合），在VS13和BrnoCompSpeed数据集上实现了可靠的速度估计。形变光流方法在两个数据集上分别达到15.0%和9.7%的MAE，修剪边缘异常值后提升至11.7%和7.6%，支持使用行车记录仪和智能手机等便携设备进行低成本交通执法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视觉的车速估计方法通常依赖道路特征、相机标定和固定参考物，限制了其在实际场景中的部署灵活性和成本效益。作者旨在解决这些关键限制，提出一个无需标定的通用框架，使得在无预设基础设施的条件下（如便携设备）也能可靠地进行车速估计，从而支持公民参与的交通安全执法。
AI.method: 框架的核心包括三个部分：(1) 一个基于YOLO的关键点检测模块，在多样数据集上训练，输出36关键点的车辆模板；(2) 两种速度估计策略——仅关键点跟踪和形变光流（warped optical flow）结合密集空间聚合；(3) 每帧更新的单应矩阵将像素位移投影到公制空间。通过在路边和俯视视角的400多个视频片段上进行验证，覆盖30-100 mph的速度范围。
AI.result: 在VS13和BrnoCompSpeed数据集上，形变光流方法实现了15.0%和9.7%的MAE，±20%误差内的估计比例分别为77.9%和93.1%。应用10%修剪去除边缘异常值后，MAE分别降至11.7%和7.6%，±20%精度提升至85.3%和95.4%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作成功解决了现有视觉速度估计方法对相机标定和道路特征依赖的瓶颈，验证了无需标定的框架在多种采集条件和速度范围内（30-100 mph）的可靠性。该框架可部署于行车记录仪和智能手机等便携设备，为低成本的公民参与式交通安全执法提供了有效的技术支撑。

title: Revisiting Classifier-Free Guidance Methods in Latent Diffusion Models
summary: Inference-time quality-enhancement methods are an effective and widely adopted means of improving diffusion models without expensive retraining. We study a family of training-free techniques conceptually rooted in Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG), most of which were originally proposed on older U-Net diffusion models and validated using metrics that assess image quality in isolation, without accounting for compositional alignment or semantic correspondence between the generated image and its associated text prompt. We re-evaluate eight such methods on two open-weight rectified-flow transformers under a fixed per-model protocol and three compositional-alignment benchmarks. No method consistently improves on CFG across the measured criteria. APG obtains several nominal best scores, but the corresponding gains often remain within the estimated evaluation uncertainty. Attention-perturbation methods provide isolated gains on SD3.5 Medium and more frequent degradations on FLUX.2 [klein] 4B Base, while CFG remains a competitive lower-cost baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文重新评估了八种基于训练免费的质量增强方法（统称为注意力重定向系列方法），这些方法在概念上源于Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG)，但最初是在旧的U-Net扩散模型上提出的，并使用仅评估图像质量、不考虑文本提示对齐的指标进行验证。作者在两种开源rectified-flow变换器模型上，以固定逐模型协议和三个组合对齐基准重新评估这些方法，发现没有任何方法在所有衡量标准上始终优于CFG。APG获得若干名义最佳分数，但增益通常在评估不确定性范围内；注意力扰动方法在SD3.5 Medium上有局部增益，在FLUX.2上则更常见性能退化，而CFG仍是有竞争力的低开销基线。
AI.motivation: 现有训练免费的质量增强方法（多数源于CFG）是在旧U-Net扩散模型上提出的，并且只用孤立的图像质量指标验证，忽略了生成图像与提示词之间的组合对齐和语义对应。作者希望在新一代rectified-flow transformer模型上重新评估这些方法，检验其在组合对齐基准上的真实表现。
AI.method: 作者在两种开源rectified-flow变换器（SD3.5 Medium和FLUX.2 [klein] 4B Base）上，采用固定的逐模型协议，使用三个组合对齐基准对八种训练免费的质量增强方法进行系统重评估，并与CFG基线进行比较，包括评估不确定性分析。
AI.result: 没有任何方法在所有衡量标准上一致优于CFG。APG获得了若干名义最佳分数，但对应增益往往在评估不确定性范围内。注意力扰动方法在SD3.5 Medium上带来局部增益，在FLUX.2上则更频繁出现性能退化。CFG仍然是具有竞争力的低成本基线。
AI.conclusion: 原作者使用不充分的评估指标（仅图像质量）可能在旧U-Net模型上高估了这些训练免费方法的价值。在更新的rectified-flow transformer模型和更全面的组合对齐评估下，这些方法并未提供一致的优势，CFG作为简单基线依然具有竞争力。

title: Steering the Flow: Inverting Face Recognition Models via Gradient-Guided Flow Matching
summary: Model Inversion Attacks (MIAs) aim to reconstruct representative training samples of target identities from face recognition models, exposing critical security vulnerabilities. Existing methods typically rely on indirect guidance or highly stochastic guidance, making it difficult to stably optimize generation trajectories toward target facial images. In this paper, we propose Steering Flow Model Inversion (SFMI), a novel two-stage white-box model inversion method that reformulates inversion as a trajectory-steering task. Specifically, Step I, Learning a Generic Flow Matching Prior, pre-trains a generic unconditional Flow Matching model to encode the manifold of human faces as a robust prior. Step II, Attacking with Progressive Guidance Scheduler (PGS), injects time-dependent target-specific gradients during sampling. By backpropagating through the target model to obtain gradients from intermediate generated states, PGS progressively injects adaptive guidance signals into the vector field. This process effectively steers the current generative flow from random noise toward the high-density regions of the target class. Under an identity-disjoint cross-evaluation setting using the CelebA dataset, SFMI achieves an ACC of 0.9248, an FID of 22.61, and an LPIPS of 0.3874 on the ArcFace target. Extensive experiments on multiple target models demonstrate that SFMI achieves competitive state-of-the-art performance in attack success and visual fidelity under the evaluated white-box protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SFMI（Steering Flow Model Inversion），一种基于流匹配模型的两阶段白盒模型反演攻击方法，将反演任务重构为轨迹引导问题，通过在采样过程中逐步注入时间相关的目标特定梯度来引导生成流从随机噪声转向目标类别的高密度区域，在CelebA数据集的ArcFace目标上达到ACC 0.9248、FID 22.61和LPIPS 0.3874的先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有模型反演攻击方法依赖于间接引导或高度随机的引导，难以稳定地将生成轨迹优化到目标人脸图像方向，导致攻击成功率和视觉保真度受限。
AI.method: SFMI包含两个阶段：Step I预训练一个通用的无条件流匹配（Flow Matching）模型作为人脸流形的鲁棒先验；Step II提出渐进式引导调度器（PGS），在采样过程中通过反向传播目标模型获得中间生成状态的梯度，逐步向向量场注入随时间变化的自适应引导信号，从而将生成轨迹从随机噪声转向目标类别。
AI.result: 在CelebA数据集上、身份不相交的交叉评估设定下，SFMI在ArcFace目标上取得ACC 0.9248、FID 22.61、LPIPS 0.3874的成绩，且在多个目标模型上的实验展示了具有竞争力的攻击成功率和视觉保真度，达到当前最优水平。
AI.conclusion: SFMI通过流匹配先验与渐进式梯度引导相结合，有效解决了传统模型反演中生成轨迹不稳定优化的问题，在白盒协议下实现了攻击成功率和视觉质量的均衡提升，验证了轨迹引导范式在模型反演任务中的有效性。

title: PixRestore: Unified Image Restoration via Pixel Diffusion Transformer
summary: Unified image restoration (UIR) aims to recover high-quality (HQ) content from low-quality (LQ) images with different degradations using a single model. Most recent methods adapt large pretrained text-to-image (T2I) latent diffusion models for their strong capacity and generative priors. However, the variational autoencoder (VAE) in latent T2I models may discard restoration-sensitive details, while the open-ended synthesis prior can introduce content-inconsistent artifacts. We present PixRestore, a VAE-free pixel-space Diffusion Transformer (DiT) for UIR, where the diffusion backbone is trained entirely from scratch, without relying on T2I pretraining. PixRestore performs flow matching directly on patchified pixels, preserving fine-grained details while keeping the token sequence tractable. To adapt to different degradations, PixRestore learns to predict the reliability of layer features using LQ--HQ DINO feature similarity. Features from more reliable layers are fused as dense conditioning, while less reliable layers receive stronger HQ-feature supervision to encourage degradation removal. We train PixRestore on a large-scale corpus of diverse scenes and degradations, and further finetune it into a one-step generator using DINO-based adversarial objectives for efficient inference. Experiments on public benchmarks and real-world test sets show that, with only about 50M parameters and single-step inference, PixRestore achieves the best overall fidelity, perceptual quality, and robustness to degradations among competing UIR models while being far more efficient. Larger PixRestore variants can further boost performance, demonstrating the scalability of our pixel-space design. Code and the curated benchmark can be found at https://github.com/csslc/PixRestore.

AI.tldr: PixRestore提出了一种无需VAE的像素空间扩散Transformer框架，用于统一图像恢复（UIR）。它直接在patch化像素上进行流匹配，避免了潜在T2I模型中VAE对恢复细节的丢弃；通过LQ-HQ DINO特征相似度预测层特征可靠性，实现自适应退化处理；并利用DINO对抗目标微调为单步生成器。仅约50M参数和单步推理即达到最优的综合保真度、感知质量和退化鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有UIR方法多基于大型预训练T2I潜在扩散模型，存在两个关键问题：一是VAE在潜在空间中可能丢弃恢复敏感的细节信息；二是开放式的T2I合成先验可能引入与内容不一致的伪影。因此需要一种既保留细节又避免内容不一致的UIR方案。
AI.method: PixRestore采用VAE-free的像素空间扩散Transformer（DiT）：(1) 直接在patch化像素上执行流匹配，保留细粒度细节同时控制token序列长度；(2) 利用LQ-HQ DINO特征相似度预测各层特征的可靠性，可靠层特征融合为密集条件，不可靠层则施加更强的HQ特征监督以促进退化去除；(3) 在大型多样场景和退化语料上训练，并使用DINO对抗目标微调为单步生成器。
AI.result: 在公开基准和真实世界测试集上，仅约50M参数和单步推理的PixRestore即达到竞争UIR模型中最优的整体保真度、感知质量和退化鲁棒性，同时效率显著更高。更大规模的变体可进一步提升性能，验证了像素空间设计的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: PixRestore证明了不依赖T2I预训练，采用像素空间扩散Transformer可以从零训练实现高效且高质量的UIR，为统一图像恢复提供了新的设计范式，兼具性能与效率优势，并具有良好的可扩展性。

title: Unsupervised Learning of Cell Instances with Generative Routing Pyramids
summary: Identifying and representing object instances such as cells or nuclei is a common task in microscopy image analysis. Established machine learning workflows typically use supervised detection or segmentation followed by feature extraction or classification, which requires manual annotations and treats instance segmentation and cell representation as separate stages. We describe a new unsupervised method for cell instance segmentation and phenotypic classification from unlabeled microscopy images. Our method is based on reconstructing each image using a coarse-to-fine routing pyramid that associates pixels with spatially sparse latent sources. The resulting pixel-to-latent associations yield instance masks, while the source latents encode cell morphology. We demonstrate competitive performance in instance segmentation across diverse cell morphologies and imaging modalities, as well as generative modeling of cellular phenotypes under perturbations. Source code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/weigertlab/routing-pyramids.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于粗到细路由金字塔的无监督细胞实例分割与表型分类方法，无需人工标注即可从显微图像中识别细胞或细胞核实例，并通过稀疏潜在源编码细胞形态，实现了跨形态和成像模态的竞争性性能。
AI.motivation: 传统机器学习流程需要监督式的检测或分割，依赖人工标注，且将实例分割与细胞表示视为独立阶段，缺乏无监督的统一方法。作者旨在解决这一痛点，提出无需标注的端到端方案。
AI.method: 采用粗到细的路由金字塔（coarse-to-fine routing pyramid）重建每张图像，将像素与空间稀疏的潜在源（spatially sparse latent sources）关联起来。像素到潜在源的关联产生实例掩码，而潜在源本身编码细胞形态特征，从而实现无监督的实例分割与表型表征。
AI.result: 在多种细胞形态和成像模态上展现了与监督方法相当的实例分割性能，并且能够对扰动条件下的细胞表型进行生成式建模。
AI.conclusion: 该无监督方法将实例分割与细胞表征统一在一个框架中，无需人工标注即可达到竞争性表现，并具备表型生成建模能力，为显微镜图像分析提供了一种新范式。

title: Unlocking the Potential of Image Editing via Concept Scaling and Dense Supervision
summary: Existing image editing frameworks predominantly follow the training paradigm of text-to-image diffusion models. However, extending this paradigm to image editing highlights two inherent discrepancies, specifically, the insufficient attention to edit concept granularity and the training inefficiency caused by sparse supervision signals. To address these issues, we establish a comprehensive hierarchical taxonomy featuring over 1,000 fine-grained edit concepts and build ConceptEdit-12M, a massive dataset of 12 million high-quality editing pairs via an improved synthesis framework. This library-driven approach effectively rectifies the distribution collapse of generated data while ensuring high data fidelity. Furthermore, we propose a dense supervision training strategy that synthesizes multiple non-interfering concepts into single image pairs. By providing richer learning signals, this strategy significantly enhances both training efficiency and overall model performance. Training results validate our strategy, significantly outperforming prior works. Finally, we present ConceptEdit-Bench, a granular evaluation suite designed to diagnose model capabilities across a vast array of real-world scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种库驱动（library-driven）的图像编辑框架，通过构建包含超过1000个细粒度编辑概念的分层分类体系，建立ConceptEdit-12M大规模数据集，并提出密集监督训练策略，同时推出ConceptEdit-Bench评估基准，全面解决现有图像编辑模型在概念粒度和训练效率上的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有图像编辑框架沿用文生图扩散模型的训练范式，但直接扩展该范式到图像编辑时存在两个固有缺陷：一是对编辑概念粒度的关注不足，二是稀疏监督信号导致的训练低效。这两个问题严重制约了图像编辑模型的性能上限。
AI.method: 本文方法包括三部分：(1) 建立涵盖1000多个细粒度编辑概念的分层分类体系，并通过改进的合成框架构建ConceptEdit-12M（1200万高质量编辑对）大规模数据集，有效纠正生成数据的分布坍缩并保证数据保真度；(2) 提出密集监督训练策略，将多个互不干扰的概念合成为单个图像对，提供更丰富的学习信号以提升训练效率和模型性能；(3) 构建ConceptEdit-Bench细粒度评估套件，用于在大范围真实场景中诊断模型能力。
AI.result: 训练结果表明所提出的策略显著优于先前的工作，验证了库驱动方法和密集监督训练策略的有效性。同时ConceptEdit-Bench能够有效诊断模型在多样化真实场景下的能力表现。
AI.conclusion: 通过库驱动的数据集构建和密集监督训练策略，本文显著提升了图像编辑模型的训练效率和性能，并为该领域提供了细粒度的分层概念体系与评估基准，为后续研究奠定了坚实基础。

title: Can Unsupervised Methods Outperform Supervised Deep Learning When Ground Truth Is Sparse? A Case Study of Bronchovascular Bundle Segmentation in Low-Dose CT
comment: 17 pages, 4 figures. Part of this research was submitted to the international conference European Molecular Imaging Meeting 2026
summary:
Background
  Lung cancer remains the deadliest cancer worldwide because it is often diagnosed too late. Effective treatment depends on detection at an early screening stage. However, the growing number of patients and the limited number of radiologists lead to prolonged diagnostic waiting times. In very early stage lung cancer, nodule visibility is further reduced by adjacent blood vessels and airway walls, because nodules are often connected to or supplied by these structures. Task-specific analysis of the bronchovascular bundle is therefore important for efficient nodule detection, and its removal can increase the diagnostic potential of lung cancer screening.
  Materials and Methods
  To assess the efficacy of the proposed method, we used series from widely utilized LDCT datasets, including the Duke Lung Cancer Screening (DLCS) dataset and the Pilot Pomeranian Lung Cancer Screening Program. The proposed bronchovascular bundle segmentation pipeline, RONALD, operates on computed tomography images and returns binary masks of vessels and bronchi located in the lung parenchyma. The method includes a preprocessing stage with lung, lobe, and mediastinum segmentation, followed by separate vessel and bronchial tree segmentation.
  Results
  The proposed pipeline segmented the bronchovascular bundle in low-dose computed tomography scans while improving nodule retention compared with other segmentation methods: from 93.98% and 90.36% to 100% in DLCS, and from 83.16% and 62.36% to 99.92% in the Pomeranian dataset.
  Conclusion
  The resulting segmentations can improve lung nodule detection in the very early stages of lung cancer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为RONALD的支气管血管束分割流程，通过预处理阶段（肺、肺叶、纵隔分割）及后续的血管和支气管树分割，在低剂量CT图像上生成血管和支气管的二元掩膜，用于移除支气管血管束以提升肺癌筛查中早期肺结节的检测效能。
AI.motivation: 肺癌是全球致死率最高的癌症，往往因诊断过晚而预后不佳。由于患者数量持续增长而放射科医生资源有限，导致诊断等待时间延长。此外，极早期肺癌中，结节常与邻近血管和气道壁相连或被其供养，可导致结节可见性降低。因此，对支气管血管束进行任务特异性分析并将其移除，对于提高肺癌筛查中结节检测效率至关重要。
AI.method: 提出的RONALD流程在CT图像上操作，返回肺实质内血管和支气管的二元掩膜。方法包括预处理阶段（肺、肺叶和纵隔分割），随后分别进行血管和支气管树的分割。
AI.result: RONALD在DLCS数据集上将结节保留率从93.98%和90.36%提升至100%，在Pomeranian数据集上从83.16%和62.36%提升至99.92%。
AI.conclusion: 该分割流程所生成的结果能够改善极早期肺癌中的肺结节检测，有望提高肺癌筛查的诊断效能。
